paras.en: Carlisle CBF will join our CentroMotion family at CONEXPO 2026 in booth #S82219 on the second level of the South Hall, where we will highlight our latest advancements in precision engineered braking systems.

articles.title: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 recap

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada, reaffirmed its position as the largest construction trade show in North America, drawing more than 140,000 construction professionals from 128 countries across the globe. For Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, the week was an incredible opportunity to showcase innovation, strengthen partnerships and gain valuable insights into the future of the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Throughout the busy week, attendees had the chance to speak with our experts and watch live demonstrations of our brake systems, along with our advanced brake and transmission friction solutions for the construction industry.
paras.zh: 在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 重申了其作为北美最大的建筑贸易展的地位，吸引了来自全球 128 个国家的超过 140,000 名建筑专业人士。对于 CentroMotion 品牌 Carlisle Brake & Friction 来说，本周是展示创新、加强合作伙伴关系以及获得对建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来的宝贵见解的绝佳机会。在忙碌的一周中，与会者有机会与我们的专家交谈并观看我们制动系统的现场演示，以及我们为建筑行业提供的先进制动和传动摩擦解决方案。

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG is more than a trade show, it’s a barometer for where the industry is headed. Top trends included integrating autonomous equipment, advanced digital tools and sustainable technologies. The exhibition footprint spanned more than 3 million square feet with greater than 2,000 exhibitors, and attendees covered miles of exhibits sprawled across indoor and outdoor spaces.
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 不仅仅是一个贸易展，它还是行业发展方向的晴雨表。主要趋势包括集成自主设备、先进的数字工具和可持续技术。展览面积超过 300 万平方英尺，参展商超过 2,000 家，与会者覆盖了遍布室内和室外空间的数英里展品。

paras.en: At the show, Carlisle Brake & Friction highlighted its advanced brake systems and friction technologies designed to withstand extreme duty cycles and demanding off‑highway applications. Attendees experienced firsthand the performance, quality, and engineering expertise that define the CarlisleCBF brand. The CentroMotion booth was a hub of activity, and the team welcomed OEM leaders and aftermarket specialists. These interactions went beyond showcasing our products, they enhanced relationships and increased our team’s understanding of the industry’s evolving needs. Check out this video https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8 for more detail about our booth and featured products serving the market.
paras.zh: 在展会上，卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司重点介绍了其先进的制动系统和摩擦技术，旨在承受极端的工作循环和苛刻的非公路应用。与会者亲身体验了 CarlisleCBF 品牌的性能、质量和工程专业知识。 CentroMotion 展位是活动中心，团队欢迎 OEM 领导者和售后市场专家。这些互动不仅仅是展示我们的产品，它们还增强了关系并增加了我们团队对行业不断变化的需求的了解。请观看此视频 https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8，了解有关我们的展位和服务于市场的特色产品的更多详细信息。

paras.en: The show floor was packed with the latest advancements across construction, aggregate, concrete and lifting. Attendees explored:
paras.zh: 展厅里充满了建筑、骨料、混凝土和起重方面的最新进展。与会者探讨：

paras.en: • New and upgraded equipment and machinery in action
paras.zh: • 新的和升级的设备和机械投入使用

paras.en: • Advances in automation, electrification and equipment intelligence
paras.zh: • 自动化、电气化和设备智能化的进步

paras.en: • Digital tools focused on productivity, fleet management and jobsite visibility
paras.zh: • 专注于生产力、车队管理和作业现场可视性的数字工具

paras.en: • Solutions designed to improve safety, efficiency and sustainability
paras.zh: • 旨在提高安全性、效率和可持续性的解决方案

paras.en: Hands on demos and a live equipment showcase gave attendees the opportunity to see innovations in action and understand how they can be applied on real jobsites.
paras.zh: 动手演示和现场设备展示让与会者有机会看到创新的实际应用，并了解如何将它们应用到实际工作现场。

paras.en: Technology continued to be a major focus at CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026. Exhibitors and education sessions highlighted these key updates as transformational in construction operations:
paras.zh: 技术仍然是 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 的主要焦点。参展商和教育会议强调了这些关键更新对建筑运营的变革：

paras.en: • Digital workflows and jobsite visibility
paras.zh: • 数字化工作流程和工地可视性

paras.en: • Sustainability and emissions reduction
paras.zh: • 可持续发展和减排

paras.en: • Workforce challenges and talent development
paras.zh: • 劳动力挑战和人才发展

paras.en: Together, these topics reflected an industry adapting to change while looking toward long term growth.
paras.zh: 这些主题共同反映了行业在适应变化的同时寻求长期增长。

paras.en: Looking ahead: The future of construction
paras.zh: 展望未来：建筑业的未来

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG shines a bold spotlight on the companies and innovations redefining what’s next in the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Our team’s conversations and key learnings will help shape our strategies for the coming year, and we’re committed to driving progress!

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India
paras.zh: 新工厂将非公路湿式摩擦摩擦片生产带至印度

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司 (Carlisle Brake & Friction) 已破土动工，以扩大其位于印度钦奈的制造业务，该工厂位于世界上增长最快的工业地区之一。 Carlisle CBF 在该地区生产机电一体化产品已超过 15 年，将搬迁至更大的工厂，增加非公路用纸湿式摩擦片和钢制隔板的生产。新设施计划于 2027 年开业。

paras.en: The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.
paras.zh: 扩大空间的目的是为了满足印度和东南亚农业、建筑业、特别是采矿业不断增长的需求所需的制造能力。本地生产将提高供应链响应能力，同时支持成本敏感市场的原始设备和售后市场要求。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 正在钦奈新工厂建立最先进的湿式摩擦制造设施，与成熟的全球制造工艺相媲美，以打造更具弹性的区域平台。此次扩张增强了我们提供耐用湿式摩擦产品的能力，有助于保持关键非公路设备的生产力。

paras.zh: 正在为您的下一个非公路设备制造寻找摩擦产品合作伙伴？填写下面的表格，与卡莱尔制动和摩擦印度团队联系并讨论您的项目需求。

articles.title: Yorkshire motor factors shortlisted for national aftermarket award
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Yorkshire motor factors shortlisted for national aftermarket award
paras.zh: 约克郡汽车因素入围国家售后市场奖

paras.en: South Yorkshire independent motor factors Leisureways of Rotherham and Butlers Automotive have been named finalists in the Car Parts Distributor – up to 10 Branches category at the 2026 Independent Automotive Aftermarket Federation (IAAF) Pride of the Aftermarket Awards.
paras.zh: 南约克郡独立汽车制造商 Leisureways of Rotherham 和 Butlers Automotive 入围 2026 年独立汽车售后市场联合会 (IAAF) 售后市场骄傲奖汽车零部件分销商 - 最多 10 个分支机构类别的决赛。

paras.en: Sponsored by Bosch, the category recognises regional distributors that deliver high standards in customer service, stock availability, and technical support for independent workshops.
paras.zh: 该类别由博世赞助，旨在表彰在客户服务、库存供应和独立车间技术支持方面提供高标准的区域经销商。

paras.en: Led by brothers Tom and Ben Clarke, the family-run businesses operate out of Rotherham and Barnsley, supplying local garages with replacement parts backed by specialist product knowledge and tailored account support.
paras.zh: 这家家族企业由汤姆·克拉克 (Tom Clarke) 和本·克拉克 (Ben Clarke) 兄弟领导，在罗瑟勒姆 (Rotherham) 和巴恩斯利 (Barnsley) 开展业务，在专业产品知识和定制客户支持的支持下，为当地车库提供替换零件。

paras.en: Tom Clarke, Leisureways branch manager, said: “Independent garages rely on their motor factor to understand their business and respond quickly when they need support. It’s the relationships our teams build with customers every day that make the difference.
paras.zh: Leisureways 分公司经理汤姆·克拉克 (Tom Clarke) 表示：“独立车库依靠动力因素来了解自己的业务，并在需要支持时快速做出响应。我们的团队每天与客户建立的关系才发挥了作用。”

paras.en: “Being shortlisted alongside other distributors from across the country is something everyone at Leisureways and Butlers should be proud of.”
paras.zh: “与来自全国各地的其他经销商一起入围是 Leisureways 和 Butlers 的每个人都应该感到自豪的事情。”

paras.en: Category winners and highly commended finalists will be announced at the IAAF Annual Awards Dinner on 3 December 2026 at The Vox in Birmingham.
paras.zh: 类别获奖者和高度赞扬的决赛入围者将于 2026 年 12 月 3 日在伯明翰 The Vox 举行的国际田联年度颁奖晚宴上公布。

articles.title: Car-O-Liner Frame Machines Help Collision Repairers Restore Structure, Rebuild Confidence
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Car-O-Liner premium auto body frame machine portfolio is designed and manufactured to help collision repair professionals measure, pull and align vehicles with consistent accuracy.
paras.zh: Car-O-Liner 优质车身框架机器产品组合的设计和制造旨在帮助碰撞修复专业人员以一致的精度测量、拉动和对齐车辆。

paras.en: Whether a vehicle has a minor impact or significant structural damage, every repair starts with a solid foundation, and the Car-O-Liner frame machines are engineered to provide that foundation.
paras.zh: 无论车辆受到轻微撞击还是严重结构损坏，每次维修都从坚实的基础开始，而 Car-O-Liner 框架机的设计就是为了提供该基础。

paras.en: “Shops today face a wider mix of vehicles within the same workspace, and they need equipment that keeps up,” said Doug Bortz, manager, collision sales, North America, Car-O-Liner. “Our frame machines are engineered to give repairers the accuracy and control they need, whatever comes through the door. That is why collision repair professionals around the world trust Car-O-Liner.”
paras.zh: Car-O-Liner 北美碰撞销售经理 Doug Bortz 表示：“如今，商店在同一工作空间内面临着更广泛的车辆组合，他们需要能够跟上的设备。” “我们的车架机器经过精心设计，无论发生什么情况，都能为维修人员提供所需的准确性和控制力。这就是世界各地的碰撞维修专业人士信任 Car-O-Liner 的原因。”

paras.en: The machines use state-of-the-art technology and robust materials. Technicians get controlled pulling power, flexible repair capabilities and manufacturer-aligned results.
paras.zh: 这些机器采用最先进的技术和坚固的材料。技术人员可以获得受控的牵引力、灵活的维修能力和制造商一致的结果。

paras.en: - Speed 3T: A lightweight bench supporting vehicles up to three tons. It handles light and medium cosmetic repairs with quick draw aligner setup and five-ton multi-angle pulling capacity.
paras.zh: - Speed 3T：轻型长凳，可支撑重达三吨的车辆。它具有快速牵引对准器设置和五吨多角度牵引能力，可处理轻度和中度美容修复。

paras.en: - BenchRack: Combines drive-on convenience with a hydraulic lift and removable ramps. Available in four lengths, it suits unibody and full-frame vehicles, from small cars to light trucks, vans and SUVs, and covers light cosmetic work to full-frame repairs.
paras.zh: - BenchRack：将驾驶便利性与液压升降机和可拆卸坡道相结合。它有四种长度可供选择，适合一体式和全车架车辆，从小型汽车到轻型卡车、货车和 SUV，涵盖轻型装饰工作到全车架维修。

paras.en: - BenchRack Versa: An in-ground straightening system designed to improve access, ergonomics and workflow efficiency. Selectable bench lengths and integrated measuring support help maintain repair accuracy across a broad mix of vehicle types.
paras.zh: - BenchRack Versa：一种地下矫直系统，旨在改善通道、人体工程学和工作流程效率。可选择的工作台长度和集成测量支持有助于保持各种车辆类型的维修精度。

paras.en: - Quick42: A multi-functional alignment bench system offering a complete repair solution. It provides a streamlined process to diagnose and repair vehicles, helping body shops expand repair capabilities, increase efficiency and improve customer satisfaction.
paras.zh: - Quick42：多功能对准工作台系统，提供完整的维修解决方案。它提供了诊断和维修车辆的简化流程，帮助车身修理厂扩大维修能力、提高效率并提高客户满意度。

paras.en: For more information about Car-O-Liner frame machines and other Car-O-Liner equipment, visit Car-O-Liner.com.
paras.zh: 有关 Car-O-Liner 框架机和其他 Car-O-Liner 设备的更多信息，请访问 Car-O-Liner.com。

articles.title: CMT.AI: Thanksgiving, Christmas see most distracted driving and speeding of winter holidays
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Thanksgiving and Christmas Day see the most distracted driving of the seven holidays CMT.AI analyzed in its U.S. Fall and Winter Holiday Road Risk Report.
paras.zh: CMT.AI 在其《美国秋季和冬季假期道路风险报告》中分析的七个假期中，感恩节和圣诞节是驾驶最分心的节日。

paras.en: Across the seven holidays, the report finds that increased distraction contributes to an estimated 1,930 additional crashes, 1,080 injuries, and nine fatalities in a typical year.
paras.zh: 报告发现，在这 7 个假期中，注意力分散的增加估计每年会导致 1,930 起车祸、1,080 人受伤和 9 人死亡。

paras.en: The report looks at 312 million trips from 2021 through 2025. It compares distraction, speeding, and hard braking on each holiday with similar non-holiday days in the surrounding weeks.
paras.zh: 该报告调查了 2021 年至 2025 年的 3.12 亿次出行。它将每个假期的分心、超速和紧急刹车情况与接下来几周的类似非假期日进行了比较。

paras.en: “Road risk patterns reflect how people celebrate,” states a press release about the report. “Distraction and speeding surge during daytime travel on Thanksgiving and Christmas. On Halloween and New Year’s Eve, distraction and sudden braking rise as evening celebrations get underway. Risk also extends past midnight, into the hours when drivers return home.”
paras.zh: “Road risk patterns reflect how people celebrate,” states a press release about the report. “感恩节和圣诞节白天出行时分心和超速的情况会激增。万圣节和除夕夜，随着晚间庆祝活动的进行，分心和突然刹车的情况也会增加。风险还会延伸到午夜之后，一直到司机回家的几个小时内。”

paras.en: The largest distractions occurred on Thanksgiving at 15.1% and Christmas Day at 12.3%, the report found. New Year’s Day followed at 9.9%.
paras.zh: The largest distractions occurred on Thanksgiving at 15.1% and Christmas Day at 12.3%, the report found.元旦紧随其后，这一比例为 9.9%。

paras.en: Thanksgiving recorded 510 crashes and 290 injuries, and Christmas 420 crashes and 230 injuries. On New Year’s Day, there were 330 crashes and 190 injuries.
paras.zh: 感恩节发生了 510 起车祸和 290 人受伤，圣诞节发生了 420 起车祸和 230 人受伤。元旦那天，发生了 330 起车祸和 190 人受伤。

paras.en: Evening holidays saw less distraction, but still showed increases — 5.8% on New Year’s Eve, 3.9% on Halloween and 2.9% on Christmas Eve.
paras.zh: 晚间假期的干扰较少，但仍然有所增加——除夕夜为 5.8%，万圣节为 3.9%，平安夜为 2.9%。

paras.en: “The difference is especially clear at Christmas, when the increase in distraction on Christmas Day is more than four times that on Christmas Eve,” the report states. “Distraction is also elevated on the days after celebrations. Black Friday sees a 7.2% rise after Thanksgiving.”
paras.zh: 报告指出：“这种差异在圣诞节尤其明显，圣诞节当天分心的事情增加是平安夜的四倍多。” “庆祝活动结束后的几天里，注意力分散的情况也有所增加。感恩节后的黑色星期五上涨了 7.2%。”

paras.en: Distraction peaks reflect how the holidays are celebrated, according to the report.
paras.zh: 报告称，分心高峰反映了节日的庆祝方式。

paras.en: Christmas and Thanksgiving distractions increased by 22.3% and 20.5% in the morning before easing to 1.4% and 3.6% in the evening.
paras.zh: 圣诞节和感恩节早上的干扰因素增加了 22.3% 和 20.5%，晚上则分别降至 1.4% 和 3.6%。

paras.en: Thanksgiving distracted driving peaks at 22.7% between 9 a.m. and 2 p.m., the report found. Distraction rises from 1 minute and 44 seconds to 2 minutes and 8 seconds per driving hour.
paras.zh: 报告发现，感恩节上午 9 点至下午 2 点期间，分心驾驶率达到峰值，达到 22.7%。每个驾驶小时的分心时间从 1 分 44 秒增加到 2 分 8 秒。

paras.en: Christmas distraction surges between 4 p.m. and 6 p.m., reaching 9.5%, and rising from 1 minute and 51 seconds to 2 minutes and 1 second per driving hour.
paras.zh: 圣诞节的干扰在下午 4 点到下午 4 点之间激增。下午6点，达到9.5%，每行驶小时从1分51秒上升到2分1秒。

paras.en: New Year’s Eve and Halloween, however, see distraction close to typical mornings. It then rises to 8.3% and 7.3% in the evening.
paras.zh: 然而，除夕夜和万圣节，在典型的早晨附近却会出现一些让人分心的事情。晚上则升至 8.3% 和 7.3%。

paras.en: New Year’s Eve sees its largest distraction at 11 p.m., increasing by 12.7%. Distraction goes from 2 minutes and 2 seconds to 2 minutes and 17 seconds per hour.
paras.zh: 除夕夜晚上 11 点是最让人分心的时刻，增加了 12.7%。分散注意力的时间从每小时 2 分 2 秒减少到 2 分 17 秒。

paras.en: Halloween distraction is the highest at 10 p.m., with a 9.9% increase. Distraction jumps from 2 minutes to 2 minutes and 12 seconds.
paras.zh: 万圣节晚上 10 点的干扰程度最高，增加了 9.9%。分心时间从 2 分钟跃升至 2 分 12 秒。

paras.en: Thanksgiving and Christmas also have the largest increase in speeding, the report found. Drivers spend 128.1% more time speeding on Thanksgiving morning and 140% more time in the afternoon. Christmas follows with 87.1% more speeding in the morning and 109.4% in the afternoon.
paras.zh: 报告发现，感恩节和圣诞节的超速率增幅也最大。感恩节早上，司机超速行驶的时间增加了 128.1%，下午则增加了 140%。圣诞节过后，早上超速行驶的比例增加了 87.1%，下午超速的比例增加了 109.4%。

paras.en: The speeding peak on Thanksgiving happens at 7 a.m. with a 185.4% increase. Drivers spend 4 minutes and 28 seconds per hour speeding during this time, nearly three times the typical 1 minute and 34 seconds.
paras.zh: 感恩节超速高峰发生在早上 7 点，增幅达 185.4%。在此期间，司机每小时超速行驶的时间为 4 分 28 秒，几乎是典型时间 1 分 34 秒的三倍。

paras.en: Christmas sees its peak speeding from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. with a 111% increase. Drivers spend nearly twice as much time speeding, going from 2 minutes and 11 seconds to 4 minutes and 12 seconds per hour.
paras.zh: 圣诞节高峰时段为上午 11 点至下午 5 点。增长了 111%。司机超速行驶的时间几乎是原来的两倍，从每小时 2 分 11 秒增加到 4 分 12 秒。

paras.en: Black Friday and New Year’s Day also see increases in speeding for more than half the day.
paras.zh: 黑色星期五和元旦也有超过一半的时间超速行驶。

paras.en: Speeding on Black Friday peaks at 7 a.m. with a 103.2% increase. New Year’s Day sees a peak from 1 p.m. to 5 p.m. with an increase of 31.3%.
paras.zh: 黑色星期五的超速高峰出现在上午 7 点，增幅达 103.2%。元旦下午 1 点是高峰期。至下午 5 点增长31.3%。

paras.en: Speeding eases in the evening on every holiday, according to the report.
paras.zh: 报告称，每个节假日晚上超速行驶都会有所缓解。

paras.en: Christmas speeding is elevated by 36.4% in the evening and by 30.5% on Thanksgiving. Speeding also falls on Halloween (7.7%) and New Year’s Eve (2.1%).
paras.zh: 圣诞节晚上的超速率增加了 36.4%，感恩节则增加了 30.5%。万圣节（7.7%）和新年前夜（2.1%）也出现超速现象。

paras.en: “Hard braking runs counter to distraction and speeding through most of the day,” the report states. “On six of the seven holidays, drivers brake hard less often in the morning and afternoon than on similar days.”
paras.zh: 报告指出：“在一天的大部分时间里，急刹车与分心和超速是背道而驰的。” “在七个假期中的六个假期中，司机在早上和下午猛踩刹车的频率比类似的日子要少。”

paras.en: Hard braking is down 31.6% in the morning on Christmas and 31.9% in the afternoon. On Thanksgiving, it is down 29.8% in the morning and 23.5% in the afternoon.
paras.zh: 圣诞节早上的硬制动下降了 31.6%，下午下降了 31.9%。感恩节上午下跌29.8%，下午下跌23.5%。

paras.en: Halloween is the exception, with hard braking 7.9% more frequent in the afternoon as trick-or-treating begins.
paras.zh: 万圣节是个例外，随着“不给糖就捣蛋”活动开始，下午的紧急制动频率增加了 7.9%。

paras.en: “The overnight hours tell a different story,” the report states. “After Thanksgiving Eve, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, and New Year’s Eve gatherings, drivers stop short more often from 12:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m.”
paras.zh: 报告指出：“通宵时间讲述了一个不同的故事。” “感恩节前夕、感恩节、平安夜和除夕聚会之后，司机在凌晨 12:00 至早上 6:00 之间更频繁地停车。”

paras.en: Hard braking is most frequent overnight on New Year’s Day, with a 26% increase. Black Friday follows with 13.9% and Thanksgiving at 13%.
paras.zh: 元旦夜间紧急制动最为频繁，增加了 26%。黑色星期五紧随其后，占 13.9%，感恩节占 13%。

paras.en: New Year’s Eve sees its peak at 21.9% at about 11 p.m. Black Friday hard braking climbs to 22.7% from noon to 3 p.m., and on Thanksgiving hard braking increases to 27.3% from midnight to 4 a.m.
paras.zh: 除夕夜 11 点左右达到峰值 21.9%。黑色星期五从中午到下午 3 点的硬制动比例攀升至 22.7%，感恩节从午夜到凌晨 4 点的硬制动比例上升至 27.3%。

articles.title: 2027 WIN Founding Mothers Award nomination open, Techs Rock winners announced
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Nominations for the Women’s Industry Network (WIN) second annual Founding Mothers Award are open, and the TechForce Foundation Techs Rock winners have been announced.
paras.zh: 女性工业网络 (WIN) 第二届年度开国母亲奖提名现已开放，TechForce 基金会 Techs Rock 获奖者也已公布。

paras.en: WIN says the award celebrates founding mothers Frederica Carter, Geri Kottschade, Gigi Walker, Patricia Serratore, Kathy Mello, and Marcy Tieger by honoring active female technicians or painters who demonstrate passion, perseverance, and purpose; those who are making their mark in shops and communities while advancing WIN’s mission of supporting and connecting women in collision repair.
paras.zh: WIN 表示，该奖项旨在表彰建国之母 Frederica Carter、Geri Kottschade、Gigi Walker、Patricia Serratore、Kathy Mello 和 Marcy Tieger，表彰表现出热情、毅力和目标的活跃女性技术人员或画家；这些人在商店和社区中留下了自己的印记，同时推进了 WIN 支持和连接女性碰撞修复的使命。

paras.en: The six women who pioneered WIN 21 years ago saw a need for connection, mentorship, and opportunity in the automotive collision industry, a WIN press release states.
paras.zh: WIN 新闻稿称，21 年前开创 WIN 的六位女性看到了汽车碰撞行业需要联系、指导和机会。

paras.en: “When WIN was created, they had a goal in mind of creating a safe space where shop females were welcomed,” said Laura Kottschade, WIN chair, in the release. “Key considerations for this still new, prestigious award include excellence in their craft, as well as mentoring others to success in repair excellence.
paras.zh: “当 WIN 创建时，他们的目标是创造一个安全的空间，欢迎商店女性，”WIN 主席 Laura Kottschade 在新闻稿中说道。 “这个仍然是新的、享有盛誉的奖项的关键考虑因素包括卓越的工艺，以及指导他人在卓越的维修方面取得成功。

paras.en: “The annual Founding Mothers award is another continuous way for WIN to bring awareness to the availability and skills that women can successfully bring in professional collision repairs and refinishing excellence.”
paras.zh: “年度开国元勋奖是 WIN 的另一种持续方式，旨在让人们认识到女性可以成功地带来专业碰撞修复和卓越修补的可用性和技能。”

paras.en: WIN says specific award evaluation criteria are based on:
paras.zh: WIN表示，具体奖项评估标准基于：

paras.en: - Industry Visibility & Leadership – Inspiring others and advancing the trade
paras.zh: - 行业知名度和领导力 - 激励他人并推动行业发展

paras.en: - Professional Accomplishments – Demonstrated excellence and at least two years of full‑time shop experience
paras.zh: - 专业成就——表现出卓越的能力和至少两年的全职商店经验

paras.en: - Mentorship & Support – Guiding and empowering coworkers
paras.zh: - 指导与支持 – 指导并赋予同事权力

paras.en: - Community Involvement – Promoting diversity, inclusion, and outreach
paras.zh: - 社区参与——促进多样性、包容性和外展

paras.en: Nominations are open through Jan. 18. Neither the nominator nor nominee is required to be a WIN member. The winner will be announced March 22, and honored at WIN’s annual conference May 3-4, 2027, in Portland, Oregon.
paras.zh: 提名截止日期为 1 月 18 日。提名人和被提名人都不需要是 WIN 成员。获奖者将于 3 月 22 日公布，并于 2027 年 5 月 3 日至 4 日在俄勒冈州波特兰举行的 WIN 年会上进行颁奖。

paras.en: - Up to $3,000 toward tools or equipment of their choice
paras.zh: - 高达 3,000 美元用于购买他们选择的工具或设备

paras.en: - An all-expenses-covered experience at the 2027 WIN Annual Conference, including conference pass, lodging, and round-trip flights (up to $600)
paras.zh: - 2027 WIN 年会的全费用体验，包括会议通行证、住宿和往返机票（最高 600 美元）

paras.en: - A $400 apparel stipend toward conference gala attire, with any remaining to purchase workwear
paras.zh: - 400 美元的服装津贴用于购买会议晚会服装，剩余的费用可用于购买工作服

paras.en: Haylie Colby, a painter with Nuss Collision Center in East Bethel, Minnesota, was the inaugural award recipient in May of this year. Colby is an emerging talent in the collision repair industry and has quickly established herself as a top painter in under four years, a WIN press release states. It adds that what began as a part-time opportunity for her evolved into a full-time career, where she demonstrated skill, attention to detail, and a strong commitment to quality.
paras.zh: 海莉·科尔比 (Haylie Colby) 是明尼苏达州东伯特利努斯碰撞中心的一名画家，她是今年 5 月的首届获奖者。 WIN 新闻稿称，科尔比是碰撞修复行业的新兴人才，并在不到四年的时间里迅速成为顶级画家。它补充说，她最初的兼职机会逐渐发展成为全职职业，在那里她展示了技能、对细节的关注以及对质量的坚定承诺。

paras.en: TechForce Foundation recently announced this year’s Techs Rock Awards national grand prize winners, and honored them during SEMA Week in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: TechForce 基金会最近公布了今年的 Techs Rock Awards 国家大奖获得者，并在拉斯维加斯 SEMA 周期间向他们颁发了奖项。

paras.en: Dylan Bliss, a diesel technology student at Universal Technical Institute (UTI) in Orlando, Florida, is the Future Tech grand prize winner. Nathalie Ortiz, an aviation technician at Honeywell who is studying avionics at the Aviation Institute of Maintenance (AIM) in Phoenix, Arizona, is the Working Tech grand prize winner.
paras.zh: Dylan Bliss 是佛罗里达州奥兰多通用技术学院 (UTI) 的柴油技术学生，他是未来科技大奖获得者。纳塔莉·奥尔蒂斯 (Nathalie Ortiz) 是霍尼韦尔 (Honeywell) 的一名航空技术员，正在亚利桑那州凤凰城的航空维修学院 (AIM) 学习航空电子设备，她是工作技术大奖获得者。

paras.en: TechForce says nearly 800 from 46 states were nominated for an award this year. Twelve finalists, six Future Techs and six Working Techs, were chosen across six technical categories. Supporters cast more than 6,300 votes.
paras.zh: TechForce 表示，今年来自 46 个州的近 800 人获得了该奖项的提名。六个技术类别中选出了十二名决赛入围者，其中六名未来技术人员和六名工作技术人员。支持者投了超过6,300张选票。

paras.en: “Techs Rock celebrates the next generation of technicians who are helping shape the future of the industry, ” said Jennifer Maher, TechForce CEO, in a press release. “Dylan is still in school, and he’s already thinking about the kind of mentor he wants to be. Nathalie is working at Honeywell, studying avionics and making time to help her classmates. That’s what stood out to me about both of them. They’re building careers they’re proud of, and they’re already helping other people see a place for themselves in this industry.”
paras.zh: TechForce 首席执行官 Jennifer Maher 在一份新闻稿中表示：“Techs Rock 旨在表彰下一代技术人员，他们正在帮助塑造行业的未来。” “迪伦还在上学，他已经在考虑自己想成为什么样的导师。娜塔莉在霍尼韦尔工作，学习航空电子设备，并抽出时间帮助她的同学。这就是他们俩对我来说最突出的地方。他们正在建立自己引以为豪的职业生涯，并且已经在帮助其他人在这个行业中找到自己的位置。”

paras.en: Bliss is preparing to become a third-generation diesel technician. His goal is to become a master technician and one day mentor the next generation of techs, according to the release.
paras.zh: 布利斯正准备成为第三代柴油技术员。据新闻稿称，他的目标是成为一名技术大师，并有一天指导下一代技术人员。

paras.en: Ortiz supports fellow students with study strategies, finding course material, and developing confidence in hands-on work. TechForce says she is especially committed to encouraging women to recognize their abilities and pursue their place in aviation maintenance.
paras.zh: 奥尔蒂斯为同学提供学习策略、查找课程材料以及培养动手工作的信心等方面的支持。 TechForce 表示，她特别致力于鼓励女性认识到自己的能力并在航空维修领域追求自己的地位。

paras.en: Bliss and Ortiz received a trip for two to Las Vegas, including round-trip airfare, a hotel stay on the Strip, full access to the SEMA Show and the SEMA Industry Awards, and two tickets to SEMA Fest. Both also received a 580-piece Carlyle master tool set and equipment package valued at $8,000.
paras.zh: Bliss 和 Ortiz 获得了两人拉斯维加斯之旅，包括往返机票、拉斯维加斯大道上的酒店住宿、SEMA 展会和 SEMA 行业奖的完整参与权，以及两张 SEMA Fest 门票。两人还获得了价值 8,000 美元的 580 件 Carlyle 主工具套件和设备包。

paras.en: The 10 other finalists each received a 224-piece Carlyle master tool set and multipurpose stool valued at $1,500. The full list of finalists with biographies is available at techforce.org/techs-rock.
paras.zh: 其他 10 名决赛入围者每人获得一套由 224 件组成的凯雷大师工具套装和价值 1,500 美元的多功能凳子。决赛入围者的完整名单及其传记可在 techforce.org/techs-rock 上获取。

paras.en: Featured image credit: filadendron/iStock
paras.zh: 特色图片来源：filadendron/iStock

paras.en: 2026 WIN Founding Mothers Award recipient Haylie Colby (center) with the organization’s six founding mothers. (Provided by WIN)
paras.zh: 2026 年 WIN 创始人母亲奖获得者海莉·科尔比（中）与该组织的六位创始人母亲。 （WIN提供）

paras.en: 2026 Techs Rock Awards grand prize winners, Dylan Bliss and Nathalie Ortiz, at this year’s SEMA Show. (Provided by TechForce Foundation)
paras.zh: 2026 年 Techs Rock Awards 大奖获得者 Dylan Bliss 和 Nathalie Ortiz 在今年的 SEMA 车展上亮相。 （TechForce基金会提供）

articles.title: Delphi Introduces 188 New SKUs
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Delphi, a Phinia Inc. brand, has announced an expansion of its aftermarket fuel management, steering and suspension, and vehicle electronics product lines. This expansion introduces 188 new SKUs, including 24 first-to-market part numbers, the company says.
paras.zh: Phinia Inc. 旗下品牌德尔福宣布扩大其售后燃油管理、转向和悬架以及车辆电子产品线。该公司表示，此次扩展引入了 188 个新 SKU，其中包括 24 个首次上市的部件号。

paras.en: Delphi’s fuel management line adds nine new part numbers, including four first-to-market parts, expanding coverage to more than four million vehicles in operation (VIO) in the United States and Canada.
paras.zh: 德尔福的燃油管理系列增加了九个新零件号，其中包括四个率先上市的零件，将覆盖范围扩大到美国和加拿大超过四百万辆运营车辆 (VIO)。

paras.en: The steering and suspension category introduces 20 first-to-market parts, with the overall line expansion adding 72 SKUs. These first-to-market parts include suspension control arms, steering tie rod ends, and suspension control arm and ball joint assemblies. Together, these additions expand coverage to more than 81 million VIO in the United States and Canada.
paras.zh: 转向和悬架类别引入了 20 个率先上市的零件，整体产品线扩展增加了 72 个 SKU。这些率先上市的零件包括悬架控制臂、转向横拉杆端部以及悬架控制臂和球接头组件。这些新增内容将覆盖范围扩大到美国和加拿大超过 8100 万个 VIO。

paras.en: The vehicle electronics category features the addition of 107 part numbers. These include ABS wheel speed sensors, exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valves, nitrogen oxide (NOx) sensors, manifold absolute pressure sensors, vehicle speed sensors and more. These new part SKUs represent more than 91 million VIO.
paras.zh: 车辆电子类别增加了 107 个零件号。其中包括 ABS 轮速传感器、废气再循环 (EGR) 阀、氮氧化物 (NOx) 传感器、歧管绝对压力传感器、车速传感器等。这些新零件 SKU 代表超过 9100 万个 VIO。

articles.title: What Makes the Perfect ADAS Technician?
articles.author: Mitch Becker

paras.en: I was recently asked, “What makes the perfect technician?” Before I could answer, I had to think about whether we were talking about a forward-facing camera specialist in the glass industry, an ADAS technician or a diagnostic technician for vehicle electronics.
paras.zh: 最近有人问我：“什么才是完美的技术人员？”在回答之前，我必须思考我们谈论的是玻璃行业的前置摄像头专家、ADAS 技术人员还是车辆电子诊断技术人员。

paras.en: Was the person who asked me that question seeking a wish list of skills or a description of what I would want in that person? It really is two trains of thought with a list of variables and bunny trails of conversation to go down no matter who you ask. My answer might be totally different than someone else based on the needs of that person.
paras.zh: 问我这个问题的人是在寻求一份我想要的技能清单，还是我想要那个人具备什么素质的描述？这实际上是两条思路，包含一系列变量和兔子对话轨迹，无论你问谁。根据那个人的需求，我的答案可能与其他人完全不同。

paras.en: I can describe the “unicorn” technician who knows everything, or I can describe the work ethic of someone who will be a diamond in the rough. The factor I personally look at is what’s ahead for the automotive repair industry, not where the industry is today. The perfect technician in my mind will adapt to change as it happens.
paras.zh: 我可以描述一个无所不知的“独角兽”技术人员，或者我可以描述一个将成为未经加工的钻石的人的职业道德。我个人关注的是汽车维修行业的未来，而不是行业的现状。我心目中完美的技术人员会适应发生的变化。

paras.en: As I started writing this article, I started thinking of the things a technician needs to be successful and how to “build” or develop that technician’s abilities — a key factor. Do you find an already-built model technician, or do you build your own and develop him or her to be the best technician? Then you must address whether or not you hire experience or if you have the time and commitment to develop that person into a technician or team and dedicate resources to keep training them and keep moving with new technology? It’s a dilemma that many shops and companies face in the repair industry today. If hiring experience is the course you take, then I hope you remember the one thing that will be a constant throughout all of the industry: change. Also, no one knows it all.
paras.zh: 当我开始写这篇文章时，我开始思考技术人员要成功需要具备哪些条件，以及如何“构建”或发展技术人员的能力——这是一个关键因素。您是找到一个已经建立的模型技术人员，还是建立自己的模型技术人员并将其培养成最好的技术人员？然后，您必须解决是否雇用有经验的人，或者您是否有时间和承诺将该人发展为技术人员或团队并投入资源来继续培训他们并继续采用新技术？这是当今维修行业许多商店和公司面临的困境。如果您学习的是招聘经验，那么我希望您记住整个行业中不变的一件事：变化。而且，没有人知道这一切。

paras.en: The first thing I observe when I see a technician who’s successful or a technician who wants to be successful is the ability or desire to constantly learn. As the changes continue in vehicle electronics, a technician will need to adapt to all the changes we’ve experienced, plus the change we’ll be dealing with in the future. This will require constant learning through reading, training and research. The minute you stop learning and adapting, you start falling behind. This goes hand-in-hand with the ability to solve problems through challenges. The learning constantly being gained gives a solid base of knowledge to draw from when challenges and “situations” arise that complicate repairs and/or calibrations.
paras.zh: 当我看到一个成功的技术人员或一个想要成功的技术人员时，我观察到的第一件事就是不断学习的能力或愿望。随着汽车电子设备的不断变化，技术人员将需要适应我们经历过的所有变化，以及我们未来将要处理的变化。这需要通过阅读、培训和研究不断学习。一旦你停止学习和适应，你就开始落后。这与通过挑战解决问题的能力密切相关。当出现使维修和/或校准复杂化的挑战和“情况”时，不断获得的学习提供了坚实的知识基础。

paras.en: The technician who’s constantly learning also follows all the processes correctly without taking shortcuts or cutting corners. Recognizing the importance of doing all the steps and processes every time not only provides consistent results but improves diagnostic capabilities and speed in parsing through the multiple causes of, say, a failed calibration to determine the root cause. Those technicians who are not following all the processes and steps will find themselves in quicksand very easily trying to find out why repairs or calibrations are failing to complete.
paras.zh: 不断学习的技术人员也能正确遵循所有流程，不走捷径或偷工减料。认识到每次执行所有步骤和过程的重要性，不仅可以提供一致的结果，还可以提高诊断能力和解析多种原因（例如校准失败）以确定根本原因的速度。那些没有遵循所有流程和步骤的技术人员会很容易发现自己陷入流沙，试图找出维修或校准无法完成的原因。

paras.en: Being a good partner versus merely providing a service to a customer helps a technician actually build a career and grow opportunities within the company. A technician can have all the talent in the world, but if he or she does not understand the customers’ needs, that potential will be limited — and the customers’ business will be negatively affected.
paras.zh: 作为一个好的合作伙伴，而不是仅仅为客户提供服务，可以帮助技术人员在公司内真正建立职业生涯并增加机会。一个技术人员可以拥有世界上所有的才能，但如果他或她不了解客户的需求，那么他或她的潜力就会受到限制，客户的业务也会受到负面影响。

paras.en: This is also where work ethic comes into play. Being on time and keeping commitments means a great deal to a customer and builds trust that serves both the technician and customer well. This is the start of both the technician and the company establishing a good reputation. If you’re the best technician but not dependable, this creates a counterproductive situation for all. Having the right mindset and also understanding the customer provides a foundation for the technician that’s priceless in the repair industry; the rest is skills and experience needed to do the job.
paras.zh: 这也是职业道德发挥作用的地方。准时和信守承诺对客户来说意义重大，并建立信任，为技术人员和客户提供良好的服务。这是技术人员和公司建立良好声誉的开始。如果您是最好的技术人员但不可靠，这会给所有人带来适得其反的情况。拥有正确的心态并了解客户为技术人员奠定了基础，这在维修行业中是无价的；剩下的就是完成这项工作所需的技能和经验。

paras.en: I already mentioned that following the OEM procedures is a key factor for all successful technicians. But there are other pieces of knowledge that all level of vehicle electronics technicians must have to do the tasks required. For example, an understanding of:
paras.zh: 我已经提到过，遵循 OEM 程序是所有成功技术人员的关键因素。但各级车辆电子技术人员还必须具备其他知识才能完成所需的任务。例如，了解：

paras.en: Add to this a variety of competencies needed depending on the level of technician needed. These competencies can be broken down into a multitude of skills for a technician:
paras.zh: 根据所需技术人员的水平，添加所需的各种能力。对于技术人员来说，这些能力可以细分为多种技能：

paras.en: - Navigating aftermarket and OE software
paras.zh: - 导航售后市场和原厂软件

paras.en: - Establishing and measuring geometric angles
paras.zh: - 建立和测量几何角度

paras.en: When you add all this together, you get a technician who will perform at an optimum level and grow him- or herself and your business. This technician will be dependable and will be appreciated by employer and customer alike.
paras.zh: 当您将所有这些加在一起时，您将获得一名能够以最佳水平工作并发展自己和您的业务的技术人员。该技术人员将是值得信赖的，并将受到雇主和客户的赞赏。

paras.en: This is a hard business, given that you have to keep up with all the changes in every make and model of vehicle out there. The diagnostic technician position is not for everyone. We’ve all seen companies and individuals who talk a big game but fall short when called upon to perform.
paras.zh: 这是一项艰巨的任务，因为您必须跟上每种品牌和型号的车辆的所有变化。诊断技术员职位并不适合所有人。我们都见过一些公司和个人口口声声说得很大，但在实际行动中却表现不佳。

paras.en: Without the kind of foundation I mentioned that a technician needs, you end up with an interesting situation.
paras.zh: 如果没有我提到的技术人员所需的基础，您最终会遇到一个有趣的情况。

paras.en: I see all the new equipment being produced that makes it easier and somewhat faster to perform operations such as calibrations with consistency and accuracy. I think that is great, to a point. But what happens when the vehicle fails to calibrate with this equipment? Who will be the one figuring out what’s wrong or doing the diagnostics on the situation? For the work being done, do you need a diagnostic technician or, if you’re in the glass industry, do you need a forward-facing camera specialist? The difference would be in the competencies and skills needed for the position. Collision-industry level of skills would be different than for the auto glass or mechanical industry. Mechanical-industry level would be different than the collision industry, depending on shop services provided.
paras.zh: 我看到所有正在生产的新设备使执行诸如校准之类的操作变得更加容易和更快，并且具有一致性和准确性。我认为这在某种程度上很棒。但是，当车辆无法使用该设备进行校准时会发生什么情况呢？谁将是找出问题所在或对情况进行诊断的人？对于正在进行的工作，您是否需要一名诊断技术人员，或者，如果您从事玻璃行业，您是否需要一名前置摄像头专家？区别在于该职位所需的能力和技能。碰撞行业的技能水平与汽车玻璃或机械行业不同。机械行业的水平与碰撞行业不同，具体取决于所提供的商店服务。

paras.en: These different levels of technician are interesting angles on what a technician needs in terms of competencies but also in the level of training and experience required to do the tasks and/or job required. I’ve seen where ASE is addressing this with different levels of certification for technicians, which I fully support. ASE is breaking down the levels to a certification for the glass industry for forward-facing cameras, ADAS calibration technicians and diagnostic technicians. This to me shows a career path for potential technicians in all aspects of the repair industry, be it collision or mechanical (either light-duty or heavy-duty).
paras.zh: 这些不同级别的技术人员从有趣的角度来了解技术人员在能力方面的需求，以及完成所需任务和/或工作所需的培训和经验水平。我看到 ASE 正在通过为技术人员提供不同级别的认证来解决这个问题，我完全支持。 ASE 正在将前向摄像头、ADAS 校准技术人员和诊断技术人员的认证级别分解为玻璃行业认证。对我来说，这展示了维修行业各个方面的潜在技术人员的职业道路，无论是碰撞还是机械（轻型或重型）。

paras.en: The Auto Glass Safety Council (AGSC) is offering a certification for forward-facing calibration technicians in the auto glass industry. This is exciting, as a new career path is definitely growing in the auto glass repair industry, bringing in new people and a whole new interest. I also want to give SkillsUSA a shout-out, as there is talk of creating a competition at its state-level and national events for diagnostic technicians.
paras.zh: 汽车玻璃安全委员会 (AGSC) 正在为汽车玻璃行业的前向校准技术人员提供认证。这是令人兴奋的，因为汽车玻璃维修行业肯定会出现一条新的职业道路，带来新的人才和全新的兴趣。我还想对 SkillsUSA 表示赞扬，因为有人讨论在其州级和全国性活动中为诊断技术人员举办一场竞赛。

paras.en: This diagnostic technician repair path, no matter what level, is a mentally and physically challenging career. Having the correct mindset and developing the knowledge foundation will certainly help a technician build his or her skills and develop all the competencies required for a solid career. This will also develop good problem-solving skills, which will be highly respected and coveted by all as experience is gained.
paras.zh: 诊断技术人员的维修之路，无论处于何种水平，都是一项对精神和身体都具有挑战性的职业。拥有正确的心态和发展知识基础肯定会帮助技术人员培养自己的技能并发展扎实的职业所需的所有能力。这也将培养良好的解决问题的能力，随着经验的积累，这种能力将受到所有人的高度尊重和垂涎。

paras.en: A technician can be taught a lot of the skills needed and will become what you teach; a technician who has the right mindset and desire to learn will be more than what you taught. As a shop manager or owner, it’s wise to listen to your technicians and encourage them to learn — and pay attention to what they tell you they want to learn. You know what they need for training and to grow their knowledge and skills, but be careful not to dismiss requests you may feel are not relevant to position. Keeping technicians interested in learning and encouraging technicians on what they want to learn helps create the mindset you want.
paras.zh: 技术人员可以学到很多所需的技能，并且会成为你所教的人；一个拥有正确心态和学习欲望的技术人员将比你所教的更多。作为商店经理或业主，明智的做法是倾听技术人员的意见并鼓励他们学习，并注意他们告诉您他们想学习的内容。您知道他们需要什么培训以及增长知识和技能，但请注意不要拒绝您可能认为与职位无关的请求。让技术人员保持学习兴趣并鼓励技术人员学习他们想要学习的内容有助于形成您想要的心态。

articles.title: Arnott Adds 10 Suspension Products
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Arnott expanded its suspension replacement portfolio with 10 products for Tesla, Ram, Land Rover, Audi, Porsche and other applications. The October release includes two air struts and five electronic stabilizer bars. It also includes one electronic shock, one eRide electronic strut and one solenoid valve block.
paras.zh: Arnott 扩大了其悬架更换产品组合，推出了 10 种适用于 Tesla、Ram、Land Rover、Audi、Porsche 和其他应用的产品。十月份发布的产品包括两个空气支柱和五个电子稳定杆。它还包括一个电子减震器、一个 eRide 电子支柱和一个电磁阀块。

paras.en: The additions provide replacement options for air and electronically controlled suspension systems. The fitment details below reflect Arnott’s confirmed U.S. release list and product team corrections.
paras.zh: 这些新增功能为空气和电子控制悬架系统提供了替代选择。下面的适配细节反映了 Arnott 确认的美国发布列表和产品团队的更正。

paras.en: - AS-5143 — Air Strut, Front — September 2015-February 2021 Tesla Model X, without adaptive damping, AWD Dual Motor
paras.zh: - AS-5143 — 空气支柱，前部 — 2015 年 9 月至 2021 年 2 月 Tesla Model X，无自适应阻尼，AWD 双电机

paras.en: - AS-5679 — Air Strut, Front — 2019-Present RAM 1500 (DT)
paras.zh: - AS-5679 — 空气支柱，前部 — 2019 年至今 RAM 1500 (DT)

paras.en: - SBE-5724 — Electronic Stabilizer Bar, Front — 2013-2017 Land Rover Range Rover (L405)
- SBE-5725 — Electronic Stabilizer Bar, Front — Range Rover (L405) and Range Rover Sport (L494)
paras.zh: - SBE-5725 — 前电子稳定杆 — 路虎揽胜 (L405) 和路虎揽胜运动版 (L494)

paras.en: - SBE-5726 — Electronic Stabilizer Bar, Front — 2018-2022 Range Rover (L405) and Range Rover Sport (L494)
paras.zh: - SBE-5726 — 前电子稳定杆 — 2018-2022 路虎揽胜 (L405) 和路虎揽胜运动版 (L494)

paras.en: - SBE-5727 — Electronic Stabilizer Bar, Rear — Range Rover (L405) and Range Rover Sport (L494)
paras.zh: - SBE-5727 — 后电子稳定杆 — 路虎揽胜 (L405) 和路虎揽胜运动版 (L494)

paras.en: - SBE-5728 — Electronic Stabilizer Bar, Rear — Range Rover (L405)
paras.zh: - SBE-5728 — 后电子稳定杆 — 路虎揽胜 (L405)

paras.en: - SKE-4356 — Electronic Shock, Front — 2017-2025 Audi SQ5 (FY), standard suspension
paras.zh: - SKE-4356 — 前电子减震器 — 2017-2025 奥迪 SQ5 (FY)，标准悬架

paras.en: - SKE-5775 — eRide Electronic Strut, Rear — 2018-2023 Porsche Cayenne (9Y), excluding GTS
paras.zh: - SKE-5775 — eRide 电子支柱，后 — 2018-2023 保时捷卡宴 (9Y)，不包括 GTS

paras.en: - VB-5206 — Solenoid Valve Block, RAPA — selected Audi, Porsche, Volkswagen, Bentley and Lamborghini applications
paras.zh: - VB-5206 — 电磁阀块，RAPA — 选定的奥迪、保时捷、大众、宾利和兰博基尼应用

paras.en: Two new front air struts extend Arnott coverage for the Tesla Model X and RAM 1500. The Tesla application covers AWD Dual Motor vehicles without adaptive damping.
paras.zh: 两个新的前空气支柱扩大了阿诺特对 Tesla Model X 和 RAM 1500 的覆盖范围。Tesla 应用涵盖了不带自适应阻尼的 AWD 双机动车辆。

paras.en: Five new electronic stabilizer bars add front and rear coverage for Range Rover and Range Rover Sport applications. The company notes that installers should confirm the exact vehicle configuration before ordering.
paras.zh: 五个新的电子稳定杆增加了路虎揽胜和路虎揽胜运动版应用的前后覆盖范围。该公司指出，安装人员应在订购前确认确切的车辆配置。

paras.en: Arnott adds a front electronic shock for the Audi SQ5 with standard suspension.
paras.zh: 阿诺特为带有标准悬架的奥迪 SQ5 添加了前电子减震器。

paras.en: The new rear eRide electronic strut extends Arnott’s electronically controlled suspension coverage to the Porsche Cayenne, excluding GTS models.
paras.zh: 新型后 eRide 电子支柱将 Arnott 的电子控制悬架覆盖范围扩展到保时捷卡宴（不包括 GTS 车型）。

paras.en: The RAPA solenoid valve block adds a replacement option across several luxury SUV applications. Confirm the specific vehicle and year before ordering.
paras.zh: RAPA 电磁阀块为多种豪华 SUV 应用添加了替换选项。订购前请确认具体车辆和年份。

articles.title: ZF Lifetec Launches Adaptive Seatbelt Load Limiter
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: ZF LIFETEC, a supplier of passive safety systems for passenger cars, has brought its Multi Stage Load Limiter (MSLL) into series production. The technology advances adaptive safety belt load limitation with four selectable load levels and 11 load profiles. It offers vehicle manufacturers options to adapt restraint characteristics to different occupants and crash scenarios. The Volvo EX60 is the first production vehicle to feature the technology.
paras.zh: 乘用车被动安全系统供应商 ZF LIFETEC 已将其多级负载限制器 (MSLL) 投入批量生产。该技术通过四个可选负载水平和 11 个负载配置文件改进了自适应安全带负载限制。它为汽车制造商提供了根据不同乘员和碰撞场景调整约束特性的选项。沃尔沃 EX60 是第一款采用该技术的量产车。

paras.en: “Car passengers obviously differ in size, weight and seating position. The MSLL enables adaptive restraint solutions that can better account for different occupant types and crash situations. The technology is a key element of the Multi-Adaptive Safety Belt system in the Volvo EX60,” says Rudolf Stark, CEO of ZF LIFETEC.
paras.zh: “汽车乘客在体型、体重和座椅位置上存在明显差异。MSLL 支持自适应约束解决方案，可以更好地考虑不同的乘员类型和碰撞情况。该技术是沃尔沃 EX60 多功能自适应安全带系统的关键要素，”ZF LIFETEC 首席执行官 Rudolf Stark 说道。

paras.en: Addressing Diverse Occupant Characteristics
paras.zh: 满足不同的居住者特征

paras.en: Occupants can differ significantly in their physical characteristics. Drivers and passengers may sit upright or adopt a more relaxed seating position. For front passengers, this may include moving the seat farther rearward.
paras.zh: 居住者的身体特征可能存在显着差异。驾驶员和乘客可以坐直或采用更放松的座位位置。对于前排乘客，这可能包括将座椅向后移动得更远。

paras.en: “For decades, restraint systems were primarily designed around an average occupant. Today, vehicle sensors allow us to better understand who is sitting in the vehicle and how they are positioned. This creates new opportunities for us to adapt restraint performance more precisely to real-world occupant situations,” explains Harald Lutz, senior vice president, research and development at ZF LIFETEC.
paras.zh: “几十年来，约束系统主要是针对普通乘员而设计的。如今，车辆传感器使我们能够更好地了解谁坐在车内以及他们的位置。这为我们创造了新的机会，使约束性能更精确地适应现实世界乘员的情况，”ZF LIFETEC 研发高级副总裁 Harald Lutz 解释道。

paras.en: How MSLL Integrates With Vehicle Safety Architectures
paras.zh: MSLL 如何与车辆安全架构集成

paras.en: Information from vehicle sensors and occupant monitoring systems is processed by the vehicle’s safety architecture to determine a protection strategy. System-level intelligence and computing, informed by the vehicle manufacturer’s knowledge and expertise, determine which restraint settings are appropriate for a given occupant and crash situation.
paras.zh: 来自车辆传感器和乘员监控系统的信息由车辆的安全架构处理，以确定保护策略。系统级智能和计算根据车辆制造商的知识和专业知识确定哪些约束设置适合特定的乘员和碰撞情况。

paras.en: The MSLL provides the capability to implement these settings by using different safety belt force levels. Depending on the manufacturer’s calibration strategy, the system can select higher or lower load levels to address different occupant and crash scenarios. The objective is to adapt crash loads more closely to individual occupant requirements.
paras.zh: MSLL 能够通过使用不同的安全带力水平来实施这些设置。根据制造商的校准策略，系统可以选择更高或更低的负载水平来应对不同的乘员和碰撞情况。目的是使碰撞载荷更贴近个体乘员的要求。

paras.en: Modern restraint systems rely on the interaction of vehicle sensing, occupant monitoring, control software, and safety belts, steering wheels, and airbags. Within this environment, the MSLL provides access to up to 11 load profiles and four load levels, expanding the range of available restraint strategies.
paras.zh: 现代约束系统依赖于车辆传感、乘员监控、控制软件以及安全带、方向盘和安全气囊的相互作用。在此环境中，MSLL 提供多达 11 个负载配置文件和四个负载级别，扩大了可用约束策略的范围。

paras.en: The MSLL translates protection strategies determined by the vehicle’s safety architecture into corresponding physical restraint characteristics. While the vehicle’s computing and system-level intelligence determine the appropriate restraint setting, the MSLL provides the means to implement the selected load level.
paras.zh: MSLL 将车辆安全架构确定的保护策略转化为相应的物理约束特性。虽然车辆的计算和系统级智能决定了适当的约束设置，但 MSLL 提供了实现所选负载水平的方法。

paras.en: It turns the safety belt into an actuator within a connected restraint system. The technology is designed as an open architecture and can be integrated into OEM-specific software environments, allowing manufacturers to implement their own protection strategies while leveraging the capabilities of the MSLL.
paras.zh: 它将安全带变成连接的约束系统内的执行器。该技术被设计为开放式架构，可以集成到 OEM 特定的软件环境中，允许制造商在利用 MSLL 功能的同时实施自己的保护策略。

paras.en: Supporting Present and Future Vehicle Safety Concepts
paras.zh: 支持当前和未来的车辆安全概念

paras.en: With occupant monitoring, occupant classification, and software-defined vehicle architectures, vehicle safety is becoming more data-driven. Euro NCAP’s 2030 roadmap reflects this trend by emphasizing a broader range of occupants and crash scenarios. For manufacturers, this growing complexity requires more flexible restraint systems.
paras.zh: 通过乘员监控、乘员分类和软件定义的车辆架构，车辆安全变得更加由数据驱动。 Euro NCAP 的 2030 年路线图通过强调更广泛的乘员和碰撞场景反映了这一趋势。对于制造商来说，这种日益增长的复杂性需要更灵活的约束系统。

paras.en: With four load levels and 11 load profiles, the MSLL expands available restraint options and supports future safety concepts. The Volvo EX60 is the first production vehicle to feature the MSLL.
paras.zh: MSLL 具有四个负载级别和 11 个负载配置文件，扩展了可用的约束选项并支持未来的安全概念。沃尔沃 EX60 是第一款配备 MSLL 的量产车。

articles.title: Big Kahuna Getaway Sweepstakes  Fall Promotion Wrapping Up
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Big Kahuna Getaway Sweepstakes is bringing an exciting fall promotion to a close, giving professional technicians across North America one final opportunity to earn entries, win prizes, and get one step closer to an unforgettable getaway to Oahu, Hawaii.
paras.zh: Big Kahuna Getaway 抽奖活动即将结束，激动人心的秋季促销活动即将结束，为北美各地的专业技术人员提供最后一次机会，赢得参赛资格、赢取奖品，距离夏威夷欧胡岛难忘的度假更近一步。

paras.en: Running from September through November, the promotion gives technicians the opportunity to participate through MyPlace4Parts by earning entries with qualifying purchases for a chance to win one of 25 trips for two to Oahu or a share of $45,000 in gift card prizes. With the promotion wrapping up November 30, there’s still time for eligible participants to get in on the excitement!
paras.zh: 该促销活动从 9 月持续到 11 月，技术人员有机会通过 MyPlace4Parts 参与活动，通过符合资格的购买获得参赛资格，有机会赢得 25 次前往瓦胡岛的两人旅行中的一次，或分享 45,000 美元的礼品卡奖品。促销活动将于 11 月 30 日结束，符合资格的参与者还有时间享受兴奋！

paras.en: The 25 lucky winners will soon have the opportunity to trade their toolboxes for tropical breezes. In May 2027, winners and their guests will enjoy six nights and seven days in Oahu, including accommodations, travel, exclusive meals and receptions, VIP experiences, and curated activities designed to showcase the beauty, culture, and aloha spirit of the island.
paras.zh: 25 名幸运获奖者很快就有机会用他们的工具箱换取热带微风。 2027 年 5 月，获奖者及其宾客将在欧胡岛享受 7 天 6 晚的住宿，包括住宿、旅行、专属餐食和招待会、VIP 体验以及旨在展示该岛美丽、文化和阿罗哈精神的精心策划的活动。

paras.en: “We want to thank every technician and shop participating in The Big Kahuna Getaway and helping make this promotion such an exciting opportunity,” said Kendall Lozano, sales and marketing manager for the Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc. “We know how hard our customers work every day, and we’re excited to have the opportunity to give them something to look forward to. We also want to extend our sincere thanks to our channel partners whose continued support helps make experiences like this possible. We’re looking forward to celebrating with our winners and welcoming them to Oahu next May.”
paras.zh: 售后汽车配件联盟公司销售和营销经理 Kendall Lozano 表示：“我们要感谢参加 The Big Kahuna Getaway 的每一位技术人员和商店，他们帮助我们使这次促销活动成为一个令人兴奋的机会。我们知道我们的客户每天工作有多么辛苦，我们很高兴有机会为他们提供一些值得期待的东西。我们还要向我们的渠道合作伙伴表示诚挚的谢意，他们的持续支持使这样的体验成为可能。我们期待与获奖者一起庆祝，并欢迎他们的到来。”明年五月他们将前往欧胡岛。”

paras.en: The Big Kahuna Getaway is powered through MyPlace4Parts, giving participating technicians the opportunity to earn entries while placing their everyday orders. Every qualifying $150 invoice earns one entry, with bonus entries awarded for additional $150 increments purchased throughout the promotion.
paras.zh: Big Kahuna Getaway 由 MyPlace4Parts 提供支持，让参与的技术人员有机会在下日常订单的同时赚取参赛资格。每一张符合条件的 150 美元发票均可获得一次参与机会，在整个促销活动期间购买额外 150 美元的增量即可获得奖励参与机会。

paras.en: As the final days of the sweepstakes approach, anticipation continues to build for the 25 winners who will soon be on their way to Waikiki for an unforgettable island experience filled with adventure, relaxation, and plenty of aloha.
paras.zh: 随着抽奖活动最后几天的临近，人们对 25 名获奖者的期待不断增强，他们很快将前往威基基，享受充满冒险、放松和阿罗哈风情的难忘岛屿体验。

paras.en: “Promotions like The Big Kahuna Getaway are made possible through the incredible support of our customers, our channel partners, and the entire Auto Value and Bumper to Bumper network,” added Lozano. “We’re grateful to everyone participating and helping bring this promotion to life. We can’t wait to celebrate our winners and give them an experience they’ll remember for years to come. There’s still time to enter, and we look forward to seeing everyone in Oahu!”
paras.zh: “像 Big Kahuna Getaway 这样的促销活动是通过我们的客户、渠道合作伙伴以及整个 Auto Value 和 Bumper to Bumper 网络的大力支持才得以实现的，”Lozano 补充道。 “我们感谢所有参与并帮助实现这一促销活动的人。我们迫不及待地想要庆祝我们的获奖者，并为他们提供一次终生难忘的体验。还有时间参加，我们期待在欧胡岛见到大家！”

paras.en: With the promotion coming to a close on November 30, the countdown to May 2027 is just beginning. There’s still time to earn entries, get in on the excitement, and possibly find yourself headed to paradise!
paras.zh: 随着促销活动于 11 月 30 日结束，2027 年 5 月的倒计时才刚刚开始。现在还有时间赢得参赛资格，享受刺激，并可能发现自己正前往天堂！

paras.en: For complete promotion details, entry information, and to view the official list of winners as they are announced, visit BigKahunaGetaway.com.
paras.zh: 如需了解完整的促销详情、参赛信息以及查看公布的获奖者官方名单，请访问 BigKahunaGetaway.com。

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Foundation Awards 24 Scholarships
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Advance Auto Parts Foundation today announced the recipients of its 2026 scholarship program, awarding 24 scholarships to students pursuing higher education. The annual program helps family members of Advance Auto Parts team members continue their education and work toward earning degrees.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts Foundation 今天宣布了 2026 年奖学金计划的获得者，向接受高等教育的学生颁发了 24 份奖学金。该年度计划帮助 Advance Auto Parts 团队成员的家庭成员继续接受教育并努力获得学位。

paras.en: This year’s recipients stood out for their academic achievement, leadership, community involvement, personal accomplishments and future goals. Each student will receive a one-time scholarship of $3,500 to support their education.
paras.zh: 今年的获奖者在学术成就、领导力、社区参与、个人成就和未来目标方面脱颖而出。每位学生将获得 3,500 美元的一次性奖学金，以支持他们的学业。

paras.en: “Supporting our team members also means supporting their families, and we’re proud to recognize these students and their achievements,” said Anthony Sarlanis, president of the Advance Auto Parts Foundation and senior vice president, professional at Advance Auto Parts. “Their hard work and dedication have earned this recognition, and we’re proud to help them take the next step in their education. We congratulate each recipient and look forward to seeing all they accomplish in the years ahead.”
paras.zh: “支持我们的团队成员也意味着支持他们的家庭，我们很自豪能够认可这些学生和他们的成就，”Advance Auto Parts 基金会主席兼 Advance Auto Parts 专业高级副总裁 Anthony Sarlanis 说道。 “他们的辛勤工作和奉献精神赢得了这一认可，我们很自豪能够帮助他们在教育上迈出下一步。我们祝贺每位获奖者，并期待看到他们在未来几年取得的成就。”

articles.title: Ancient 'supermountains' under Antarctica supercharged complex life on Earth, study claims ‪—‬ but not everyone agrees
articles.author: Sarah Wild

paras.en: Scientists have found the remnants of supermountains in the seabed around Antarctica. They say these ancient peaks may have provided the nutrients that led to an explosion of complex life millions of years later. However, others are more skeptical about these conclusions.
paras.zh: 科学家在南极洲周围的海底发现了超级山脉的遗迹。他们说，这些古老的山峰可能提供了导致数百万年后复杂生命爆发的营养物质。然而，其他人对这些结论更加怀疑。

paras.en: About 600 million years ago, landmasses in the Southern Hemisphere collided to form the supercontinent Gondwana, which included what is now South America, Africa, Arabia, Madagascar, India, Australia and Antarctica. At that time, there was multicellular life, but it was very primitive.
paras.zh: 大约6亿年前，南半球的陆地碰撞形成了冈瓦纳超大陆，其中包括现在的南美洲、非洲、阿拉伯、马达加斯加、印度、澳大利亚和南极洲。那时，已经有多细胞生命，但很原始。

paras.en: Previous research suggested that the continental collision created massive Himalaya-like mountains in what is now Antarctica. Now, in a new study, published online Sept. 12 in the journal Earth and Planetary Science Letters, scientists say they've found the sediment that accumulated in the oceans when the Gondwanan mountains eroded over millennia.
paras.zh: 先前的研究表明，大陆碰撞在现在的南极洲形成了巨大的喜马拉雅山脉。现在，在 9 月 12 日《地球与行星科学快报》杂志在线发表的一项新研究中，科学家们表示，他们发现了冈瓦纳山脉数千年侵蚀时在海洋中积累的沉积物。

paras.en: "The results suggest that the assembly of Gondwana involved multiple major continental collisions, producing an extensive network of mountain belts comparable in scale to the modern Himalayas and Tibetan Plateau," Nathan Daczko, a petrologist at Macquarie University in Australia who was not involved in the research, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: “结果表明，冈瓦纳大陆的组装涉及多次重大的大陆碰撞，产生了一个与现代喜马拉雅山和青藏高原规模相当的广泛的山脉网络，”未参与这项研究的澳大利亚麦考瑞大学岩石学家内森·达茨科（Nathan Daczko）在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: "The study highlights just how much geological history remains hidden beneath Antarctica."
paras.zh: “这项研究凸显了南极洲地下还隐藏着多少地质历史。”

paras.en: Most of Antarctica is trapped beneath an ice sheet, so it is difficult to understand its evolutionary history.
paras.zh: 南极洲大部分地区都被冰盖覆盖，因此很难了解其演化历史。

paras.en: To address this, the team drilled into the seabed at 12 locations around Antarctica, extracting soil samples. They were looking for ancient crystals called detrital zircon. Zircon is a mineral that grows in rocks and is strong enough to remain chemically intact when the rock erodes.
paras.zh: 为了解决这个问题，研究小组在南极洲周围 12 个地点的海底进行了钻探，提取了土壤样本。他们正在寻找一种叫做碎屑锆石的古老晶体。锆石是一种生长在岩石中的矿物，其强度足以在岩石侵蚀时保持化学完整性。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "We can date it very, very precisely, and from the geochemistry, and especially the trace elements, we can determine where the zircon came from," Ian Campbell, a geochemist at the Australian National University and a co-author of the study, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚国立大学地球化学家、该研究的合著者伊恩·坎贝尔 (Ian Campbell) 告诉《生活科学》杂志：“我们可以非常非常精确地确定它的年代，通过地球化学，尤其是微量元素，我们可以确定锆石的来源。”

paras.en: They dated 1,712 zircon grains extracted from marine sediments and compared the abundance of zircons in Antarctica with a global zircon database, across different time scales.
paras.zh: 他们对从海洋沉积物中提取的 1,712 颗锆石颗粒进行了测定，并将不同时间尺度的南极洲锆石丰度与全球锆石数据库进行了比较。

paras.en: "We have used the zircon record to show that the mountains that formed during the amalgamation of Gondwana were the largest and most extensive in the history of the Earth, and they included some very high mountains like the Himalayas today," Campbell said.
paras.zh: 坎贝尔说：“我们利用锆石记录表明，冈瓦纳大陆合并期间形成的山脉是地球历史上最大、最广泛的山脉，其中包括一些非常高的山脉，例如今天的喜马拉雅山。”

paras.en: Alan Collins, an earth scientist at the University of Adelaide in Australia, said that he was surprised by the scale of the erosion from these rocks. "It beautifully supports ideas that the mountains that formed as the supercontinent Gondwana amalgamated were amongst the largest on Earth through deep time," he told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚阿德莱德大学地球科学家艾伦·柯林斯表示，他对这些岩石侵蚀的规模感到惊讶。他在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“它完美地支持了这样的观点，即超级大陆冈瓦纳大陆合并而成的山脉是地球上最大的山脉之一。”

paras.en: The formation of Gondwama produced one-fifth of the world's zircons, and the creation of the supercontinent Pangaea around 320 million years ago produced 14%, the study found.
paras.zh: 研究发现，冈瓦玛的形成过程产生了世界上五分之一的锆石，而大约 3.2 亿年前超级大陆盘古大陆的形成产生了 14% 的锆石。

paras.en: Elias Rugen, a geochemist at the University of Southampton in the U.K. who wasn't involved in the research, was surprised by the "abundance of zircons associated with Gondwana's assembly in the Antarctica samples." "It is remarkable how much information about Antarctica's geological past can be recovered from these tiny minerals, particularly when so much of the continent remains hidden beneath ice," he said.
paras.zh: 英国南安普顿大学地球化学家埃利亚斯·鲁根（Elias Rugen）没有参与这项研究，他对“南极洲样本中与冈瓦纳大陆聚集相关的大量锆石”感到惊讶。他说：“从这些微小矿物中可以发现有关南极洲地质历史的大量信息，尤其是当南极大陆的大部分地区仍然隐藏在冰层之下时，这是值得注意的。”

paras.en: However, he cautioned against estimating the range's height from the zircon data. "It is really difficult to infer a mountain's height from data like this," he said.
paras.zh: 然而，他警告不要根据锆石数据估计山脉的高度。 “从这样的数据推断出一座山的高度确实很困难，”他说。

paras.en: The formation and erosion of the Gondwana supermountains had consequences for the rest of the planet and the life on it, the authors said.
paras.zh: 作者说，冈瓦纳超级山脉的形成和侵蚀对地球的其他部分及其上的生命产生了影响。

paras.en: "In order to get life, you need nutrients," Campbell said. "At that time, most of the life was in the oceans, so you need to get nutrients into the ocean."
paras.zh: “为了获得生命，你需要营养，”坎贝尔说。 “当时，大部分生命都在海洋中，所以你需要从海洋中获取营养。”

paras.en: Today, the world's biggest ongoing erosion event is the Himalayas. This massive mountain range is eroding, and sending sediment down rivers and into the ocean. This deep-sea sediment deposit is called the Bengal Fan and is Earth's largest such deposit.
paras.zh: 今天，世界上最大的持续侵蚀事件是喜马拉雅山。这座巨大的山脉正在受到侵蚀，沉积物顺流而下，流入海洋。这个深海沉积物被称为孟加拉扇，是地球上最大的此类沉积物。

paras.en: In a similar way, Gondwana's massive mountains also "sent lots of nutrients into the ocean," Campbell said, which "significantly advanced the evolution of life" on Earth.
paras.zh: 坎贝尔说，类似地，冈瓦纳大陆的巨大山脉也“将大量营养物质输送到海洋中”，这“极大地促进了地球上生命的进化”。

paras.en: Soon after the formation of Gondwana, the planet entered the Cambrian period. This era, which lasted from about 541 million to 485 million years ago, saw a dramatic diversification of life on Earth, known as the Cambrian explosion. The period saw the rise of creatures such as chordates (animals with a dorsal nerve, including humans) and arthropods (the ancestors of insects and crustaceans).
paras.zh: 冈瓦纳大陆形成后不久，地球进入寒武纪。这个时代持续了大约 5.41 亿年前到 4.85 亿年前，地球上的生命发生了戏剧性的多样化，被称为寒武纪大爆发。这一时期见证了脊索动物（有背神经的动物，包括人类）和节肢动物（昆虫和甲壳类动物的祖先）等生物的兴起。

paras.en: The study's authors drew a link between Gondwana's supermountains and this rapid evolution of complex life. While the supermountains don't explain the Cambrian Explosion directly, they "provide the opportunity for it to happen," Campbell said. The paper suggests that these nutrients fed organisms that formed the base of the animal food web.
paras.zh: 该研究的作者将冈瓦纳大陆的超级山脉与复杂生命的快速进化联系起来。坎贝尔说，虽然超级山脉不能直接解释寒武纪大爆发，但它们“为其发生提供了机会”。该论文表明，这些营养物质为构成动物食物网基础的生物体提供了食物。

paras.en: However, Daczko and Rugen are skeptical. "The methods used in this study cannot directly demonstrate that this particular mountain belt was directly responsible for the rise in oxygen or the Cambrian Explosion," Rugen said. "However, the evidence for a Gondwanan supermountain belt that would inevitably have had a substantial impact on Earth's biogeochemical cycles is growing."
paras.zh: 然而，达茨科和鲁根对此表示怀疑。鲁根说：“这项研究中使用的方法不能直接证明这一特定的山脉直接导致氧气上升或寒武纪大爆发。” “然而，越来越多的证据表明，冈瓦纳超级山脉带不可避免地会对地球的生物地球化学循环产生重大影响。”

paras.en: Daczko said he would frame the link between the Gondwana's supermountains and the Cambrian explosion as "an exciting hypothesis rather than an established causal relationship."
paras.zh: 达茨科表示，他会将冈瓦纳超级山脉与寒武纪大爆发之间的联系视为“一个令人兴奋的假设，而不是既定的因果关系”。

paras.en: However, the study did show that there was much more to discover under the ice in Antarctica.
paras.zh: 然而，这项研究确实表明，南极洲冰层下还有更多东西有待发现。

paras.en: "The most exciting aspect is the possibility that some of the largest mountain systems in Earth's history are effectively hidden beneath the East Antarctic ice sheet," Daczko said. "Antarctica potentially holds some of the most important remaining evidence for understanding the tectonic and environmental evolution of our planet."
paras.zh: 达茨科说：“最令人兴奋的方面是，地球历史上一些最大的山脉系统可能实际上隐藏在东南极冰盖之下。” “南极洲可能拥有一些最重要的剩余证据，可以帮助我们了解地球的构造和环境演化。”

paras.en: How much do you know about Earth's frozen continent? Test your smarts with our Antarctica quiz!
paras.zh: 你对地球上的冰冻大陆了解多少？通过我们的南极洲测验测试您的智慧！

paras.en: Sarah Wild is a British-South African freelance science journalist. She has written about particle physics, cosmology and everything in between. She studied physics, electronics and English literature at Rhodes University, South Africa, and later read for an MSc Medicine in bioethics.
paras.zh: 莎拉·怀尔德（Sarah Wild）是一位英国裔南非自由科学记者。她写过关于粒子物理学、宇宙学以及介于两者之间的一切的文章。她在南非罗德大学学习物理学、电子学和英语文学，后来攻读生物伦理学医学硕士学位。

paras.en: Since she started perpetrating journalism for a living, she's written books, won awards, and run national science desks. Her work has appeared in Nature, Science, Scientific American, and The Observer, among others. In 2017 she won a gold AAAS Kavli for her reporting on forensics in South Africa.
paras.zh: 自从她开始以新闻为生以来，她写了书，赢得了奖项，并管理着国家科学部门。她的作品曾发表在《自然》、《科学》、《科学美国人》和《观察家报》等杂志上。 2017 年，她因对南非法证学的报道而荣获 AAAS Kavli 金奖。

articles.title: Earliest monster black hole found at the universe's edge — pushing theories to their limits
articles.author: Joanna Thompson

paras.en: Astronomers have just discovered the earliest-known quasar — and it's 40 million years older than the previous record holder. The finding, which observed the object at just 630 million years after the Big Bang, could help researchers to better understand how black holes developed in the early universe.
paras.zh: 天文学家刚刚发现了已知最早的类星体，它比之前的记录保持者还要老 4000 万年。这一发现是在大爆炸后仅 6.3 亿年观测到该物体，可以帮助研究人员更好地了解黑洞在早期宇宙中是如何形成的。

paras.en: "Finding quasars at ever-increasing distances, at the edge of the observable universe, teaches us something about how the black holes in their centres grew," study co-author Julien Wolf, a researcher at the Max Planck Institute for Astronomy, said in a statement. "The closer to the Big Bang we find them, the faster their black holes must have grown or the more massive they must have been at birth — or both."
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、马克斯·普朗克天文学研究所的研究员朱利安·沃尔夫在一份声明中说：“在可观测宇宙的边缘，在距离不断增加的地方寻找类星体，让我们了解类星体中心的黑洞是如何生长的。” “我们发现它们越接近大爆炸，它们的黑洞生长得越快，或者它们出生时的质量就越大——或者两者兼而有之。”

paras.en: The object — estimated to have the mass of 360 million suns — was described in a new study published Tuesday (Nov. 24) in the journal Astronomy and Astrophysics.
paras.zh: 周二（11 月 24 日）《天文学与天体物理学》杂志上发表的一项新研究描述了这个物体的质量，估计有 3.6 亿个太阳的质量。

paras.en: A quasar, short for "quasi-stellar radio source," is an incredibly bright core at the center of some galaxies — a region known as the active galactic nucleus (AGN). They form when supermassive black holes, which lurk at the hearts of most galaxies, start to binge on nearby matter. Once enough swirling material accumulates around these black holes, it heats up and glows intensely before falling into the object. What sets quasars apart from other AGNs is their sheer luminosity; they can be brighter than all the stars in a galaxy combined.
paras.zh: 类星体是“准恒星射电源”的缩写，是位于某些星系中心的极其明亮的核心，该区域被称为活动星系核（AGN）。当潜伏在大多数星系中心的超大质量黑洞开始吞噬附近的物质时，它们就形成了。一旦足够多的旋转物质聚集在这些黑洞周围，它就会升温并剧烈发光，然后落入物体中。类星体与其他活动星系核的区别在于它们的光度。它们的亮度可能比银河系中所有恒星的总和还亮。

paras.en: Quasars were much more common early in the universe than they are today. They are thought to have peaked in number about 10 billion years ago. Observing them can give scientists important clues as to how galaxies evolve — and how their supermassive black holes develop.
paras.zh: 类星体在宇宙早期比现在更为常见。据认为，它们的数量在大约 100 亿年前达到顶峰。观察它们可以为科学家提供关于星系如何演化以及它们的超大质量黑洞如何发展的重要线索。

paras.en: Because it takes time for light to travel, observing celestial objects that are very far away is tantamount to peering back in time. We see galaxies very near to Earth as they were only a few thousand years ago; conversely, we see galaxies very far away from us as they were billions of years ago, because their light is only now reaching our telescopes. The older the galaxy, the more red its light becomes as it stretches across the universe — a phenomenon called "redshift."
paras.zh: 因为光的传播需要时间，所以观察很远的天体就相当于回顾过去。我们看到的星系距离地球非常近，就像它们在几千年前一样；相反，我们看到的星系距离我们很远，就像数十亿年前一样，因为它们的光现在才到达我们的望远镜。星系越古老，它在宇宙中延伸时发出的光就越红，这种现象称为“红移”。

paras.en: Using data from NASA's James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) and the European Space Agency's Euclid Wide Survey, the researchers behind the new study identified a quasar with a redshift of 8.13 — the first such object ever found with a redshift beyond 8. This makes it the oldest quasar yet observed, at approximately 13.1 billion years old. For reference, the universe itself is thought to be 13.8 billion years old.
paras.zh: 利用美国宇航局詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜 (JWST) 和欧洲航天局欧几里得大巡天的数据，这项新研究的研究人员发现了一颗红移为 8.13 的类星体，这是有史以来发现的第一个红移超过 8 的天体。这使其成为迄今为止观测到的最古老的类星体，年龄约为 131 亿岁。作为参考，宇宙本身被认为有 138 亿年的历史。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: - 'Baby quasars' spotted by James Webb telescope could transform our understanding of monster black holes
paras.zh: - 詹姆斯·韦伯望远镜发现的“婴儿类星体”可能会改变我们对巨型黑洞的理解

paras.en: - The oldest, brightest black holes in the universe were born from violent gas attacks, new study suggests
paras.zh: - 新研究表明，宇宙中最古老、最明亮的黑洞是由剧烈的气体攻击而诞生的

paras.en: - James Webb Space Telescope sees lonely supermassive black hole-powered quasars in the early universe
paras.zh: - 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜在早期宇宙中看到了孤独的超大质量黑洞驱动的类星体

paras.en: The scientists named the object Dún Aonghasa, after a prehistoric cliff fort on the Atlantic-facing edge of Inis Mór, an island off the coast of Ireland. The name is meant to reflect the quasar's position at the very edge of our current observational frontier for the cosmos.
paras.zh: 科学家们将这个物体命名为 Dún Aonghasa，以爱尔兰海岸附近岛屿伊尼斯莫尔 (Inis Mór) 面向大西洋边缘的一座史前悬崖堡垒命名。该名称旨在反映类星体位于我们当前宇宙观测前沿边缘的位置。

paras.en: According to the researchers, Dún Aonghasa also appears to be growing more slowly than astronomers previously thought possible, given its size. This suggests that its supermassive black hole may have gone through a massive growth spurt, followed by a period of much slower growth in the distant past. The discovery could put new constraints on black hole growth models, which are already being challenged by previous JWST detections of supermassive monsters that seem to have grown too big for their early place in cosmic history.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，考虑到敦安哈萨的大小，它的生长速度似乎也比天文学家之前认为的要慢。这表明它的超大质量黑洞可能经历了一次大规模的增长突增，随后在遥远的过去经历了一段增长缓慢得多的时期。这一发现可能会给黑洞生长模型带来新的限制，该模型已经受到之前 JWST 检测到的超大质量怪物的挑战，这些怪物似乎已经变得太大，不适合它们在宇宙历史中的早期地位。

paras.en: Future observations from Euclid and JWST could help researchers test this hypothesis and see if it holds for other ancient quasars, the researchers said.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，欧几里得和 JWST 的未来观测可以帮助研究人员检验这一假设，并看看它是否适用于其他古代类星体。

paras.en: See how much you know about black holes with our black hole quiz!
paras.zh: 通过我们的黑洞测验看看您对黑洞了解多少！

paras.en: Joanna Thompson is a science journalist and runner based in New York. She holds a B.S. in Zoology and a B.A. in Creative Writing from North Carolina State University, as well as a Master's in Science Journalism from NYU's Science, Health and Environmental Reporting Program. Find more of her work in Scientific American, The Daily Beast, Atlas Obscura or Audubon Magazine.
paras.zh: 乔安娜·汤普森 (Joanna Thompson) 是一位驻纽约的科学记者和跑步者。她拥有学士学位。动物学学士学位和学士学位拥有北卡罗来纳州立大学创意写作学士学位，以及纽约大学科学、健康和环境报告项目科学新闻学硕士学位。在《科学美国人》、《每日野兽》、《Atlas Obscura》或《奥杜邦杂志》中找到她的更多作品。

articles.title: Your risk of heart attack and stroke could be forecasted 30 years in advance, study suggests
articles.author: RJ Mackenzie

paras.en: Cardiovascular disease has long been linked to risk factors like high blood pressure and cholesterol — but a new study suggests that these factors, combined with proteins in the blood, could help forecast people's risk of heart attack and stroke decades in advance.
paras.zh: 心血管疾病长期以来一直与高血压和胆固醇等危险因素有关，但一项新的研究表明，这些因素与血液中的蛋白质相结合，可以帮助提前几十年预测人们患心脏病和中风的风险。

paras.en: The new study, published Monday (Nov. 23) in the journal JAMA Network Open, took a broad view of the factors that spike the risk of stroke or heart attack. The researchers found that warning signs for these conditions can be seen in patients' health data up to 30 years before they happen.
paras.zh: 这项新研究于周一（11 月 23 日）发表在《JAMA Network Open》杂志上，对导致中风或心脏病风险增加的因素进行了广泛的研究。研究人员发现，在这些情况发生前 30 年内，患者的健康数据中就可以看到这些情况的警告信号。

paras.en: The researchers say their work shows that some understudied biomarkers — measurable signals in the blood — could be useful tools in anticipating later conditions.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，他们的工作表明，一些未被充分研究的生物标志物（血液中的可测量信号）可能是预测后期状况的有用工具。

paras.en: "We did know that there are some well-established risk factors that are related to heart disease, for example, blood pressure, cholesterol," said study co-author Dorien Kimenai, an epidemiologist at the University of Edinburgh. But "nobody really has looked at the patterns of these risk factors prior to when these people are getting cardiovascular events — not systematically."
paras.zh: 研究合著者、爱丁堡大学流行病学家多里恩·基梅奈 (Dorien Kimenai) 表示：“我们确实知道有一些与心脏病相关的明确风险因素，例如血压、胆固醇。”但“在这些人发生心血管事件之前，没有人真正研究过这些危险因素的模式——没有系统地研究过。”

paras.en: For the new study, the scientists tracked data patterns from a diverse group of nearly 114,000 healthy people over 34 years. Their data spanned four long-term health studies conducted in the U.S., U.K., and Norway. At the end of the study period, the researchers divided data from participants who were still healthy at that juncture from those who had experienced heart attacks or strokes and either died or survived the events.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，科学家们追踪了 34 年来近 114,000 名健康人群的不同群体的数据模式。他们的数据涵盖在美国、英国和挪威进行的四项长期健康研究。在研究期结束时，研究人员将当时仍然健康的参与者的数据与经历过心脏病或中风并且死亡或幸存的参与者的数据分开。

paras.en: But even at the study's outset, these two groups' blood pressure and cholesterol data showed a clear divergence.
paras.zh: 但即使在研究开始时，这两组的血压和胆固醇数据也显示出明显的差异。

paras.en: "We did see that, even three decades before, already, that these patterns were different," said Kimenai. That suggests, she added, that the difference between the two groups likely began even earlier than that.
paras.zh: “我们确实看到，甚至在三十年前，这些模式就已经不同了，”基梅奈说。她补充说，这表明这两个群体之间的差异可能开始得更早。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The team also divided their participants by sex and age, finding that men and women experienced different trajectories in their cardiovascular disease risk over time. Women, on average, started with lower blood pressure than men in middle age, but that switched later in life.
paras.zh: 研究小组还按性别和年龄对参与者进行了划分，发现随着时间的推移，男性和女性的心血管疾病风险经历了不同的轨迹。平均而言，女性在中年时期开始时的血压低于男性，但这种情况在以后的生活中发生了变化。

paras.en: "It shows that the age effect is as important as the sex differences," Kimenai said. In short, both factors need to be taken into account.
paras.zh: “这表明年龄影响与性别差异同样重要，”基梅奈说。简而言之，这两个因素都需要考虑。

paras.en: Dr. Sintip Pattanakuhar, a clinician scientist at the University of Strathclyde in Scotland who was not involved in the study, said that while these risk factors can't be modified in the way blood pressure or cholesterol can, age and sex could be incorporated into personalized screening programs for cardiovascular risk.
paras.zh: 苏格兰斯特拉斯克莱德大学临床科学家 Sintip Pattanakuhar 博士（未参与这项研究）表示，虽然这些危险因素不能像血压或胆固醇那样改变，但年龄和性别可以纳入个性化心血管风险筛查计划。

paras.en: The team also looked at the trajectories of biomarker proteins that circulate in the bloodstream and are linked to cardiovascular disease. These include cardiac troponin and N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP), which are released by damaged heart muscle tissue and used to diagnose a heart attack. They also included C-reactive protein, a liver-borne molecule that signals rising inflammation in the body.
paras.zh: 研究小组还研究了在血液中循环并与心血管疾病相关的生物标志物蛋白质的轨迹。其中包括心肌肌钙蛋白和 N 末端 B 型钠尿肽原 (NT-proBNP)，它们由受损的心肌组织释放，用于诊断心脏病发作。它们还含有 C 反应蛋白，这是一种肝源性分子，发出体内炎症加剧的信号。

paras.en: Differences in cardiac troponin and C-reactive protein were visible in people who would go on to have a heart attack or stroke up to 30 years before they happened. For NT-proBNP, the differences emerged about 10 years before.
paras.zh: 在心脏病发作或中风发生 30 年前的人群中，心肌肌钙蛋白和 C 反应蛋白的差异非常明显。对于 NT-proBNP，差异大约在 10 年前就出现了。

paras.en: That said, Kimenai cautioned that the biomarker data came from fewer participants than the full study cohort, so these results bear further confirmation.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，基梅奈警告说，生物标志物数据来自的参与者少于整个研究队列，因此这些结果需要进一步证实。

paras.en: Dr. Deepak Bhatt, director of the Mount Sinai Fuster Heart Hospital in New York, said the study's blood pressure and cholesterol data confirmed what cardiologists had long suspected about these risk factors: that these modifiable factors predict cardiovascular disease. Bhatt, who was not involved in the study, added that the biomarker data in this study built on other studies that have also shown that cardiovascular events can be predicted years before they happen.
paras.zh: 纽约西奈山富斯特心脏医院院长迪帕克·巴特博士表示，这项研究的血压和胆固醇数据证实了心脏病专家长期以来对这些危险因素的怀疑：这些可改变的因素可以预测心血管疾病。巴特没有参与这项研究，他补充说，这项研究中的生物标志物数据建立在其他研究的基础上，这些研究也表明心血管事件可以在发生前几年进行预测。

paras.en: "What this adds is that it's actually predicting events decades before," he said.
paras.zh: “这增加了它实际上是在预测几十年前的事件，”他说。

paras.en: The study's clearest message was that people should get their cardiovascular risk factors checked early, Kimenai said.
paras.zh: 基梅奈说，这项研究最明确的信息是，人们应该尽早检查心血管危险因素。

paras.en: "When you're 40 years old, get your risk assessments and your blood pressure measured," she said. "Because these are the things you can change. If you've then been identified as having hypertension, then you can get those drugs that are very effective and safe and efficient to alter the pattern."
paras.zh: “当你 40 岁时，进行风险评估并测量血压，”她说。 “因为这些是你可以改变的事情。如果你被确定患有高血压，那么你可以获得那些非常有效、安全和高效的药物来改变这种模式。”

paras.en: However, while the value of checking blood pressure and cholesterol is well established, Kimenai and Bhatt agreed that the clinical value of the biomarker data was less clear at this stage. Bhatt said that he might advise a patient with high blood pressure to start medication and cut out salt, for example, but the way forward for someone with an elevated biomarker reading is less clear for now.
paras.zh: 然而，虽然检查血压和胆固醇的价值已得到充分证实，但 Kimenai 和 Bhatt 一致认为，现阶段生物标志物数据的临床价值尚不清楚。巴特说，例如，他可能会建议高血压患者开始用药并戒盐，但对于生物标志物读数升高的患者来说，前进的道路目前还不太明确。

paras.en: "Ideally, more work will be done" to see whether panels of biomarkers, perhaps combined with tools that measure genetic risk, could flag patients at very high risk of having heart attacks and strokes and should be treated differently than a patient with lower risk, Bhatt suggested. "That's sort of the missing piece of the Holy Grail of prevention."
paras.zh: 巴特建议，“理想情况下，我们将做更多的工作”，看看生物标志物组，或许与测量遗传风险的工具相结合，是否可以标记心脏病和中风风险极高的患者，并应与风险较低的患者进行不同的治疗。 “这就是预防圣杯中缺失的一环。”

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: RJ Mackenzie is an award-nominated science and health journalist. He has degrees in neuroscience from the University of Edinburgh and the University of Cambridge. He became a writer after deciding that the best way of contributing to science would be from behind a keyboard rather than a lab bench. He is a former staff writer of Technology Networks.
paras.zh: RJ Mackenzie 是一位荣获奖项提名的科学与健康记者。他拥有爱丁堡大学和剑桥大学的神经科学学位。在决定为科学做出贡献的最佳方式是在键盘后面而不是在实验室工作台后面后，他成为了一名作家。他报道了从大脑接口技术到变形材料科学，从掠夺性会议的兴起到新生儿筛查计划的重要性等各个方面。他是《科技网络》的前特约撰稿人。
