articles.title: Astronomers Accidentally Find a Rare Triple-Star System That They Say Shouldn't Exist. It's Located Just 28 Light-Years From Earth

paras.en: Astronomers searching for exoplanets—worlds beyond our solar system—accidentally uncovered something much stranger. The team stumbled upon an odd triple-star system located merely 28 light-years from Earth. The findings, described November 19 in the journal Astronomy & Astrophysics, challenge scientists’ understanding of how stellar systems work, since this weird one shouldn’t be possible based on our current knowledge.
paras.zh: 天文学家在寻找系外行星（太阳系之外的世界）时意外地发现了一些更奇怪的东西。研究小组偶然发现了一个奇怪的三星系统，距离地球仅 28 光年。 11 月 19 日发表在《天文学与天体物理学》杂志上的研究结果挑战了科学家对恒星系统如何工作的理解，因为根据我们目前的知识，这种奇怪的系统是不可能发生的。

paras.en: “It’s a freak thing. It was an annoying object,” lead author Étienne Artigau, an astrophysicist at the University of Montreal in Canada, tells CBC News’ Nicole Mortillaro. “It’s not what we were looking for.”
paras.zh: “这是一件奇怪的事情。这是一个令人讨厌的物体，”主要作者、加拿大蒙特利尔大学的天体物理学家艾蒂安·阿蒂高 (Étienne Artigau) 告诉 CBC 新闻的妮可·莫蒂拉罗 (Nicole Mortillaro)。 “这不是我们要找的。”

paras.en: Artigau and colleagues had been hunting for faraway planets with a special instrument on the Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope on Mauna Kea, a volcano on Hawaii’s Big Island. It helps researchers identify distant worlds by measuring minuscule changes in a star’s velocity, which can be caused by orbiting planets. But when the instrument turned toward a neighboring red dwarf, a small, cool, orange-ish type of star, the scientists found that its velocity variations were much greater than expected—more than 1,000-fold.
paras.zh: 阿蒂高和同事一直在使用位于夏威夷大岛莫纳克亚火山的加拿大-法国-夏威夷望远镜上的特殊仪器寻找遥远的行星。它可以帮助研究人员通过测量恒星速度的微小变化来识别遥远的世界，这种变化可能是由绕轨道运行的行星引起的。但当仪器转向邻近的红矮星（一种小型、凉爽、橙色的恒星）时，科学家们发现它的速度变化比预期大得多——超过 1000 倍。

paras.en: “Typically, we measure fluctuations in a star’s velocity of just a few meters per second. In this case, however, we detected a shift of nearly 16 kilometers per second,” study co-author Atanas Stefanov, an astrophysicist at the University of Geneva in Switzerland, says in a statement. “That was when we realized that what we had encountered was not an ordinary planet, but a much more massive companion.”
paras.zh: “通常情况下，我们测量到的恒星速度波动仅为每秒几米。然而，在这种情况下，我们检测到每秒近 16 公里的移动，”该研究的合著者、瑞士日内瓦大学的天体物理学家阿塔纳斯·斯特凡诺夫 (Atanas Stefanov) 在一份声明中表示。 “那时我们意识到我们遇到的不是一颗普通的行星，而是一颗质量大得多的伴星。”

paras.en: Analyses suggested the mysterious satellite must contain more than half the mass of our sun. This high mass and low brightness pointed toward a dead star. So, the researchers conducted follow-up observations in 2023 and 2024 using an instrument on the Gemini North telescope on Mauna Kea. That allowed them to directly detect the culprit behind the dramatic velocity variations: a white dwarf. It’s a dense stellar core left behind by a deceased low- to medium-mass star, like the sun.
paras.zh: 分析表明，这颗神秘卫星的质量一定超过太阳质量的一半。这种高质量和低亮度指向一颗死星。因此，研究人员在2023年和2024年利用莫纳克亚山双子座北望远镜上的仪器进行了后续观测。这使他们能够直接探测到速度剧烈变化背后的罪魁祸首：白矮星。它是一颗已死亡的中低质量恒星（如太阳）留下的致密恒星核心。

paras.en: This newly discovered white dwarf is quite close to the red dwarf, orbiting at a maximum distance of about 4.6 times the space between the sun and Earth. However, researchers already knew the central star hosted a much more distant white dwarf, and the team estimates it circles the inner pair at about 124 times the distance between our star and our planet. The previously known white dwarf appears to loop around the star duo, while the newly discovered one and the red dwarf orbit close to each other in a binary system.
paras.zh: 这颗新发现的白矮星与红矮星相当接近，其轨道最大距离约为太阳与地球之间空间的4.6倍。然而，研究人员已经知道这颗中心恒星拥有一颗距离更远的白矮星，研究小组估计它围绕内对恒星运行的距离约为我们恒星与行星之间距离的 124 倍。先前已知的白矮星似乎围绕着这对恒星旋转，而新发现的白矮星和红矮星在双星系统中彼此靠近。

paras.en: While astronomers have spotted white dwarf pairs before, Keith Cooper reports for Space.com, a triple system with two white dwarfs and a regular star is exceptionally rare. In fact, this system, dubbed Welopōʻai, is the only one of its kind known in the sun’s neighborhood, according to a separate statement. Astronomers haven’t discovered anything similar within 100 light-years of our planet.
paras.zh: 基思·库珀在 Space.com 上报道说，虽然天文学家以前发现过白矮星对，但由两颗白矮星和一颗普通恒星组成的三重系统极为罕见。事实上，根据另一份声明，这个被称为“Welopō'ai”的系统是太阳附近唯一已知的此类系统。天文学家在距地球 100 光年范围内尚未发现任何类似的东西。

paras.en: Welopōʻai combines the Hawaiian words welo, meaning an inherited or family trait, and pō‘ai, an orbit or circular path. Together, the name translates to a “path of family traits.”
paras.zh: Welopō´ai 结合了夏威夷语 welo（意思是遗传或家族特征）和 pō‘ai（轨道或圆形路径）。总之，这个名字翻译过来就是“家庭特质之路”。

paras.en: Welopōʻai is even more mysterious because, according to astrophysicists’ current understanding, it is an impossible stellar system. The star that became the newly discovered white dwarf was originally about 1.4 times as massive as our sun. As it neared the end of its life, it should have ballooned to several hundred times its initial size. Researchers would have expected the enlarging star to engulf the nearby red dwarf and possibly even merge with it.
paras.zh: 韦洛波艾更加神秘，因为根据天体物理学家目前的理解，它是一个不可能的恒星系统。这颗新发现的白矮星恒星最初的质量约为太阳的 1.4 倍。当它接近生命终点时，它的体积应该会膨胀到原来的数百倍。研究人员原本预计这颗不断增大的恒星会吞没附近的红矮星，甚至可能与其合并。

paras.en: But surprisingly, that didn’t happen in Welopōʻai. The red dwarf seems to be alive and well, following a wide, stable orbit.
paras.zh: 但令人惊讶的是，这种情况并没有发生在韦洛波艾。这颗红矮星似乎还活着，而且运行良好，沿着宽阔、稳定的轨道运行。

paras.en: “This system should not exist,” study co-author Patrick Dufour, an astrophysicist at the University of Montreal, says in the second statement. “We have no clean explanation for how it got here. That is the question driving our next observations.”
paras.zh: “这个系统不应该存在，”研究合著者、蒙特利尔大学天体物理学家帕特里克·杜福尔在第二份声明中说道。 “对于它是如何到达这里的，我们没有明确的解释。这是推动我们下一步观察的问题。”

paras.en: Even the faraway white dwarf may have once been less of a third wheel, Paul Delaney, an astrophysicist who retired from York University in Canada and wasn’t involved in the study, tells CBC News.
paras.zh: 从加拿大约克大学退休并没有参与这项研究的天体物理学家保罗·德莱尼 (Paul Delaney) 告诉 CBC 新闻，即使是遥远的白矮星也可能曾经不那么像第三轮。

paras.en: “I would bet that they were relatively proximate to each other and then they did engage in a bit of gravitational embracing, and the farther white dwarf today was much, much closer in its heyday.”
paras.zh: “我敢打赌，它们彼此相对较近，然后它们确实进行了一些引力拥抱，而今天更远的白矮星在其全盛时期距离要近得多。”

articles.title: America's Thanksgiving Parade in Detroit Is Celebrating 100 Years of Elaborate Floats, Papier-Mâché 'Big Heads' and a Distinguished Clown Corps

paras.en: For festive Detroiters, this year’s Thanksgiving Day is cause for a larger celebration than usual. On Thursday morning, the city will host its 100th annual America’s Thanksgiving Parade, marking a major milestone for what is already one of the oldest holiday traditions in the nation.
paras.zh: 对于喜庆的底特律人来说，今年的感恩节比往常更盛大的庆祝活动。周四上午，该市将举办第 100 届年度美国感恩节游行，这标志着美国最古老的节日传统之一的一个重要里程碑。

paras.en: Founded in 1924, the yearly procession (minus two cancellations due to World War II, in 1943 and 1944) has sent floats, larger-than-life balloons and popular recurring characters down Woodward Avenue in downtown Detroit. This year’s procession will include 33 floats, five giant balloons and seven marching bands, as well as the city’s beloved Big Heads and Distinguished Clown Corps.
paras.zh: 这个一年一度的游行始建于 1924 年（减去 1943 年和 1944 年两次因第二次世界大战而取消的情况），沿底特律市中心的伍德沃德大道运送花车、巨型气球和常见的流行人物。今年的游行队伍将包括 33 个花车、五个巨型气球和七个游行乐队，以及这座城市深受喜爱的大头乐队和杰出小丑乐队。

paras.en: Just across town, a second spectacle is also getting in on the fun. Now on display at the Detroit Historical Society, which itself is celebrating its centennial, a new exhibition, “This is 100: America's Thanksgiving Parade,” is honoring the cherished parade with a display of historic footage, props and well-known artifacts. Visitors to the installation will have the opportunity to walk through an interactive timeline of the parade’s benchmark moments, try on famous costumes and even sit on the gilded throne of the only person who has featured in the event since the beginning: Santa Claus.
paras.zh: 就在城镇对面，第二场奇观也正在热闹起来。正在庆祝成立一百周年的底特律历史学会正在举办一个新展览，名为“这是 100 周年：美国感恩节游行”，通过展示历史镜头、道具和著名文物来纪念这一珍贵的游行。参观该装置的游客将有机会浏览游行基准时刻的互动时间线，试穿著名的服装，甚至坐在镀金宝座上，这是自活动开始以来唯一出现在活动中的人：圣诞老人。

paras.en: “Santa has been a part of our parade every single year since 1924,” Rebecca Salminen-Witt, the museum’s chief strategy and marketing officer, tells WDIV’s Jay Scott Smith. “Back in the day, the parade ended right in front of Hudson’s [department store]. Santa would exit his sleigh, he would go upstairs to the 12th floor of Hudson’s and he would open Toy Land for all the children.”
paras.zh: “自 1924 年以来，圣诞老人每年都会成为我们游行的一部分，”博物馆首席战略和营销官 Rebecca Salminen-Witt 告诉 WDIV 的 Jay Scott Smith。 “当时，游行在 Hudson's [百货商店] 前结束。圣诞老人会从他的雪橇上下来，上楼到 Hudson's 的 12 楼，然后为所有孩子们开放玩具乐园。”

paras.en: The exhibit features standout pieces from the world’s largest collection of papier-mâché heads, better known as “the Big Heads” in Detroit, which have been worn by performers since the parade’s beginning. Standing between two and four feet tall and weighing between five pounds and 50 pounds, the first masks arrived from the Carnival of Viareggio in Italy and immediately gained notoriety for their eerie look, the Detroit News’ Francis X. Donnelly reports.
paras.zh: 该展览展出了世界上最大的纸型头像收藏中的杰出作品，这些头像在底特律被称为“大头像”，自游行开始以来表演者就一直佩戴着这些头像。据《底特律新闻》的弗朗西斯·X·唐纳利报道，第一批面具高 2 到 4 英尺，重 5 到 50 磅，从意大利维亚雷焦狂欢节运来，并立即因其怪异的外观而臭名昭著。

paras.en: Over the decades, some 300 new masks were made in caricature of celebrities with connections to Detroit, including Aretha Franklin, Bob Seger, Stevie Wonder, Gordie Howe, Barry Sanders and Sparky Anderson. About half of these feature in the parade each year, while the others are kept in a warehouse with other retired parade paraphernalia.
paras.zh: 几十年来，大约有 300 个新面具以与底特律有联系的名人漫画为主题，包括艾瑞莎·富兰克林、鲍勃·西格、史蒂维·旺德、戈迪·豪、巴里·桑德斯和斯帕克·安德森。其中大约一半会出现在每年的游行中，而其他的则与其他退役的游行用具一起保存在仓库中。

paras.en: “Members of the Big Head Corps pay $300 apiece and pick out what Big Head costume they want to be,” Tony Michaels, president of the Parade Company, which organizes the event, tells MLive’s Edward Pevos and Santino Mattioli. “We have a breakfast for them and they march as a team down Woodward Avenue. This year the new Big Head is Jeff Daniels.”
paras.zh: “大头军团的成员每人支付 300 美元，然后挑选他们想要成为的大头服装，”组织该活动的 Parade Company 总裁托尼·迈克尔斯 (Tony Michaels) 告诉 MLive 的爱德华·佩沃斯 (Edward Pevos) 和桑蒂诺·马蒂奥利 (Santino Mattioli)。 “我们为他们准备了早餐，然后他们作为一个团队沿着伍德沃德大道游行。今年的新大头是杰夫·丹尼尔斯。”

paras.en: The installation also features several costumes worn by past members of the Distinguished Clown Corps, a group of community and business leaders who march in the parade in clown attire. With each consecutive year they march, members of the Distinguished Clown Corps earn ever-more-detailed colors, patterns and accoutrements.
paras.zh: 该装置还展示了杰出小丑军团前成员所穿的几套服装，这是一群穿着小丑服装参加游行的社区和商界领袖。随着每年的连续游行，杰出小丑军团的成员都会获得越来越详细的颜色、图案和装备。

paras.en: “The first five years, [the costume] has to be white,” Lena Antoon, a professor at Wayne State University, told CBS Detroit’s Sandra McNeill in 2023, her eighth year as a distinguished clown. “And then it’s the pattern of your choice.”
paras.zh: “头五年，[服装]必须是白色的，”韦恩州立大学教授莉娜·安东 (Lena Antoon) 在 2023 年告诉 CBS 底特律的桑德拉·麦克尼尔 (Sandra McNeill)，这是她作为杰出小丑的第八个年头。 “然后就是你选择的模式了。”

paras.en: The exhibit traces the story of the parade through factoids and trivia from its long history. In 1934, the Detroit Lions played their first annual Thanksgiving Day football game. The parade was televised for the first time in 1947, though it wasn’t until 1966 that the broadcast was in color. Lassie (the TV dog) was the parade’s grand marshal in 1964, and in 1976, the lit candles from a birthday cake float, made to commemorate the parade’s 50th anniversary, set several small fires along the route. In 1985, a Detroit Free Press article reported that “Santa buckled up in his sleigh because of Michigan’s new seat belt law,” per Midbrow’s Erica Hobbs.
paras.zh: 该展览通过其悠久历史中的轶事和琐事追溯了游行的故事。 1934 年，底特律雄狮队进行了他们的第一场年度感恩节橄榄球比赛。 1947 年，阅兵式首次进行电视转播，但直到 1966 年才以彩色形式播出。莱西（电视狗）是 1964 年游行的大元帅，1976 年，为纪念游行 50 周年而制作的生日蛋糕花车上点燃的蜡烛在沿途点燃了几处小火。 1985 年，《底特律自由报》的一篇文章报道称，“由于密歇根州新的安全带法，圣诞老人在雪橇上系好了安全带”，Midbrow 的艾丽卡·霍布斯 (Erica Hobbs) 如此报道。

paras.en: “Both Thanksgiving and football emerged in the 1860s as efforts to reunite a fractured nation in the aftermath of the Civil War,” Smithsonian magazine’s Gabby Shell writes. “In the nearly two centuries since, the rituals have evolved in tandem, expanding along with the growing nation and adopting its increasingly consumerist character.”
paras.zh: 史密森尼杂志的盖比·谢尔 (Gabby Shell) 写道：“感恩节和足球都是在 1860 年代出现的，目的是为了让内战后分裂的国家重新团结起来。” “在此后的近两个世纪里，这些仪式同步发展，随着国家的发展而扩展，并呈现出日益消费主义的特征。”

paras.en: “It really starts out [featuring] like Mother Goose and storybook characters … and then you slowly see pop culture introduced into the parade, where there’s a Donald Duck float or there’s flying saucers and space-inspired things in the 1960s,” Jeremy Dimick, the exhibit’s curator, tells Hobbs for the Detroit News. “It really just becomes a sign of the times into what’s going on in culture; when you look back at it in its totality, it tells the whole history of the city almost through this lens of the parade.”
paras.zh: 展览策展人杰里米·迪米克 (Jeremy Dimick) 在接受《底特律新闻》采访时表示：“游行一开始确实以鹅妈妈和故事书中的人物为特色……然后你会慢慢看到游行中引入了流行文化，其中有唐老鸭花车、飞碟和 20 世纪 60 年代的太空灵感物品。” “它确实成为了文化中正在发生的事情的时代标志；当你回顾它的整体时，它几乎通过游行的这个镜头讲述了这座城市的整个历史。”

paras.en: Detroit’s parade is tied with New York City’s Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade as the second-oldest in the country. Philadelphia’s Thanksgiving parade, which began in 1920, holds the title of the oldest.
paras.zh: 底特律的感恩节游行与纽约市的梅西百货感恩节游行并列，是美国历史第二悠久的感恩节游行。费城的感恩节游行始于 1920 年，被誉为历史最悠久的感恩节游行。

paras.en: “This is 100: America's Thanksgiving Parade” is on view at the Detroit Historical Society through January 3, 2027.
paras.zh: “这是 100 周年：美国感恩节大游行”将在底特律历史学会展出至 2027 年 1 月 3 日。

articles.title: While Exploring a 500-Year-Old Shipwreck Off the Coast of Sweden, Underwater Archaeologists Discovered Medieval Chain Mail That May Have Belonged to German Mercenaries

paras.en: More than five centuries after a royal Danish warship exploded and sank off the coast of Sweden, underwater archaeologists have uncovered finely crafted chain mail armor resting on the Baltic seafloor.
paras.zh: 一艘丹麦皇家军舰在瑞典海岸爆炸沉没五个多世纪后，水下考古学家在波罗的海海底发现了精工制作的锁子甲。

paras.en: The copper-alloy mail fragments were recovered in October from the wreck of Gribshunden, or Griffin, the 15th-century flagship of King Hans of Denmark and Norway. Researchers discovered the armor alongside a rare munitions chest while surveying the area beneath the vessel’s forecastle, an elevated combat platform at the ship’s bow.
paras.zh: 铜合金邮件碎片于 10 月在格里布顺登号（Gribshunden）（或称格里芬号）的残骸中被发现，这是丹麦和挪威国王汉斯的 15 世纪旗舰。研究人员在勘察船艏楼下方区域时发现了装甲，旁边有一个罕见的弹药箱，艏楼是船头的一个高架作战平台。

paras.en: “It was in the process of documenting the chest that I unexpectedly discovered exposed mail-armor fragments in the vicinity of the chest, along other items that could indicate more chests,” Rolf Warming, an archaeologist at Stockholm University who leads the project with Södertörn University’s Johan Rönnby, tells Live Science’s Kristina Killgrove in an email. “It was only by chance that we came across it, and it shows just how much is still on the wreck site.”
paras.zh: “在记录箱子的过程中，我意外地发现了箱子附近暴露的锁甲碎片，以及其他可能表明还有更多箱子的物品，”斯德哥尔摩大学考古学家罗尔夫·沃明（Rolf Warming）在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》的克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫（Johan Rönnby），他与南顿大学的约翰·伦比（Johan Rönnby）一起领导了该项目。 “我们只是偶然发现了它，它表明了沉船现场还有多少东西。”

paras.en: To map the newly explored section of the ship, the researchers paired diver-led excavation with high-resolution 3D photogrammetry and an uncrewed robotic survey boat operating on the surface, according to a statement. Together, the armor, the munitions chest and earlier finds of lead objects possibly linked to ammunition molds could point to a dedicated military storage zone.
paras.zh: 一份声明称，为了绘制该船新勘探部分的地图，研究人员将潜水员主导的挖掘工作与高分辨率 3D 摄影测量技术以及在水面上运行的无人机器人勘测船结合起来。装甲、弹药箱和早期发现的可能与弹药模具有关的铅制品可能指向一个专用的军事储存区。

paras.en: “Historical sources indicate that German mercenaries, or Landsknechts, were aboard Griffin when it sank in 1495,” Rodrigo Pacheco-Ruiz, a maritime archaeologist at the University of Southampton and co-investigator on the project, says in the statement. “This part of the ship may therefore have been used to stow equipment associated with these soldiers, including their armor, although we’ve yet to establish a precise function for the space.”
paras.zh: “历史资料表明，1495 年格里芬号沉没时，有德国雇佣兵，即 Landsknechts，”南安普顿大学海洋考古学家、该项目的联合调查员罗德里戈·帕切科-鲁伊斯 (Rodrigo Pacheco-Ruiz) 在声明中表示。 “因此，船的这一部分可能被用来存放与这些士兵相关的设备，包括他们的装甲，尽管我们尚未确定该空间的精确功能。”

paras.en: When Gribshunden set sail from Copenhagen in the summer of 1495, it led an 18-ship royal fleet bound for a political summit in Kalmar, Sweden, as Smithsonian magazine’s Jo Marchant reported in 2021. Hans, who ruled Denmark and Norway from 1481 to 1513, hoped to quell Swedish rebels and revive the Kalmar Union, which united the three kingdoms. Acting as both a diplomatic showcase and a “floating castle,” Marchant wrote, the flagship carried Danish noblemen, courtiers, a royal astronomer and roughly 150 German mercenary soldiers.
paras.zh: 正如《史密森尼》杂志的 Jo Marchant 在 2021 年报道的那样，当格里布顺登号于 1495 年夏天从哥本哈根起航时，它率领一支由 18 艘船组成的皇家舰队前往瑞典卡尔马举行政治峰会。1481 年至 1513 年统治丹麦和挪威的汉斯希望平息瑞典叛乱并复兴统一这三个王国的卡尔马联盟。马尚特写道，这艘旗舰既是一个外交展示柜，又是一座“浮动城堡”，船上载有丹麦贵族、朝臣、一名皇家天文学家和大约 150 名德国雇佣兵。

paras.en: “It was important to demonstrate military prowess, and the German and Swiss mercenaries were the finest you could get at that time,” Warming tells Live Science.
paras.zh: “展示军事实力非常重要，德国和瑞士雇佣兵是当时你能找到的最优秀的雇佣兵，”沃明告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: The voyage ended in catastrophe while the ship lay anchored north of the small island of Stora Ekon, near Ronneby in southern Sweden. Gribshunden erupted in flames and sank rapidly. A 16th-century account of Hans’ life suggests its gunpowder stores accidentally ignited, while other hypotheses point to a possible lightning strike. Many aboard perished in the fire or drowned, though Hans survived because he was ashore at the time.
paras.zh: 当船停泊在瑞典南部龙讷比附近的斯道拉埃孔小岛北部时，这次航行以灾难告终。格里布顺登号起火并迅速沉没。 16 世纪对汉斯生活的描述表明，其火药库被意外点燃，而其他假设则表明可能是雷击。船上的许多人在火灾中丧生或溺水身亡，但汉斯由于当时在岸上而幸存下来。

paras.en: Rediscovered by local divers in 1971 and formally identified in 2013, the Gribshunden has survived in remarkable condition, thanks to the Baltic Sea’s low salinity, which keeps wood-eating shipworms at bay.
paras.zh: Gribshunden 于 1971 年被当地潜水员重新发现，并于 2013 年被正式确认。得益于波罗的海的低盐度，食木船蛆无法进入，Gribshunden 一直保存完好。

paras.en: Shipworms—which are actually a type of saltwater clam—have tormented seafarers for centuries. In fact, they may have weakened the hulls of the ships of the Spanish Armada when it failed in attacking England in 1588, leaving the ships vulnerable to cannonballs and storms.
paras.zh: 船蛆——实际上是一种咸水蛤——几个世纪以来一直折磨着海员。事实上，当 1588 年西班牙无敌舰队攻击英格兰失败时，它们可能削弱了其船体，使船只容易受到炮弹和风暴的攻击。

paras.en: Measuring nearly 100 feet long and resting in about 30 feet of water, the vessel is a rare surviving example of a late-medieval “caravel”-style ship, constructed with hull planks laid edge to edge over an internal frame so it could carry heavy cargoes and guns. That design placed Gribshunden in the same technological generation as the vessels sailed by Christopher Columbus and Vasco da Gama. Previous dives also yielded a fearsome carved figurehead depicting a monster swallowing a screaming man.
paras.zh: 该船长近 100 英尺，停泊在约 30 英尺的水中，是中世纪晚期“卡拉维尔”式船舶的罕见现存例子，其船体板边对边铺设在内部框架上，因此可以运载重型货物和枪支。这一设计使格里布顺登号与克里斯托弗·哥伦布和瓦斯科·达·伽马航行的船只属于同一代技术。之前的潜水还发现了一个可怕的雕刻人物雕像，描绘了一个怪物正在吞噬一个尖叫的男人。

paras.en: Despite the exceptional craftsmanship of the newly recovered chain mail, its quality does not automatically tie it to an elite knight or king. “This kind of armor could remain in use for extended periods, often undergoing repairs or being reused, so these fragments may represent older military equipment that was still active,” Warming explains in the statement.
paras.zh: 尽管新发现的锁子甲工艺精湛，但其质量并不能自动将其与精英骑士或国王联系在一起。沃明在声明中解释说：“这种装甲可以长时间使用，经常进行维修或重复使用，因此这些碎片可能代表仍在使用的旧军事装备。”

paras.en: Researchers are now conducting chemical analyses on the armor and on samples taken from the munitions chest to determine the chain mail’s origins and the chest’s contents.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在正在对装甲和从弹药箱中取出的样本进行化学分析，以确定链甲的来源和箱内的物品。

paras.en: It is actually a really fascinating research question of ours that could illuminate supply chains and the military logistics,” Warming tells Live Science. “Did the mercenary forces bring their own ammunition and tool kit aboard, or was this supplied by the royal fleet?”
paras.zh: 这实际上是我们的一个非常有趣的研究问题，可以阐明供应链和军事后勤，”沃明告诉《生活科学》。“雇佣军是否携带了自己的弹药和工具包，还是由皇家舰队提供的？”

paras.zh: 沃尔玛有数千种每周更换的限时优惠，科技产品、家电、季末和节日商品最高可享受 65% 的折扣。请务必经常检查以找到最佳的轮换优惠。如果你像我一样，你总是在不花太多钱的情况下寻找最好的技术交易。无论您是想购买全新 17 件套不粘炊具套装、戴森无绳吸尘器，还是本季最新的男装、女装或儿童服装趋势，沃尔玛都是您的一站式商店。

paras.en: You can also enjoy great benefits with Walmart+, a paid membership that gives early access to promotions and events like Walmart Black Friday deals, free delivery, free shipping with no order minimum, savings on fuel, streaming with Paramount+, and more. You can pay monthly or annually, and you’ll get a free 30-day trial of Walmart+. Walmart+ Assist helps qualifying government aid recipients get a membership at a lower cost.
paras.zh: 您还可以享受 Walmart+ 的巨大优惠，这是一种付费会员资格，可以提前享受沃尔玛黑色星期五优惠等促销和活动、免费送货、无最低订单限制的免费送货、节省燃油、通过 Paramount+ 进行流媒体播放等。您可以按月或按年付费，并且可以免费试用 Walmart+ 30 天。 Walmart+ Assist 帮助符合条件的政府援助接受者以较低的成本获得会员资格。

paras.en: Did you know Walmart has its own Amazon Prime-like membership plan? It's called Walmart+, and it's a great option for frequent Walmart shoppers. It offers free grocery delivery, free shipping with no order minimum, fuel savings, and early access to promotions and events. Plus, you can try Walmart+ free for 30 days to see if the service is right for you or your family. The annual plan is $98 (roughly $8 per month) after the trial, meaning you’ll get $57 in savings annually.
paras.zh: 您知道沃尔玛有自己的类似亚马逊 Prime 的会员计划吗？它被称为沃尔玛+，对于经常在沃尔玛购物的人来说是一个不错的选择。它提供免费杂货配送、无最低订单限制的免费送货、节省燃油以及提前参与促销和活动。另外，您可以免费试用 Walmart+ 30 天，看看该服务是否适合您或您的家人。试用后，年度计划为 98 美元（每月约 8 美元），这意味着您每年将节省 57 美元。

paras.en: If you don’t want to leave your home, Walmart offers fast delivery in as little as an hour! You’ll just need to book a time slot through the site to get your favorites and essentials right to your door. This even includes delivery of important refrigerated prescriptions, like insulin, GLP-1s, antibiotics, and more. Plus, it’s great when you’re sick and need cold/flu remedies like DayQuil, Theraflu, tea, and more.
paras.zh: 如果您不想出门，沃尔玛可提供最快一小时内的送货服务！您只需通过网站预订一个时段，即可将您喜爱的商品和必需品送到家门口。这甚至包括运送重要的冷藏处方药，如胰岛素、GLP-1、抗生素等。另外，当您生病并需要 DayQuil、Theraflu、茶等感冒/流感药物时，它会非常有用。

paras.en: The OnePay Walmart Spend Card is a Walmart-exclusive credit card, meaning it can only be used at Walmart and Walmart.com. If you don’t qualify for the OnePay CashRewards Mastercard (and have poor credit scores), this is a great way to build credit history—but you won’t get the cash-back rewards of the CashRewards card. This card not only helps you build credit but also doesn’t require an annual fee. When you apply for a OnePay Card, you’ll first be considered for the OnePay CashRewards Mastercard. If you don’t qualify, you’ll be considered for a OnePay Walmart Spend Card. Interested applicants can apply online at Walmart.com, in the Walmart app, or in-store.
paras.zh: OnePay 沃尔玛消费卡是沃尔玛专用信用卡，这意味着它只能在 Walmart 和 Walmart.com 上使用。如果您不符合 OnePay CashRewards 万事达卡的资格（并且信用评分较差），这是建立信用记录的好方法，但您将无法获得 CashRewards 卡的现金返还奖励。这张卡不仅可以帮助您建立信用，而且不需要年费。当您申请 OnePay 卡时，您将首先被考虑使用 OnePay CashRewards Mastercard。如果您不符合资格，我们将考虑您申请 OnePay 沃尔玛消费卡。有兴趣的申请人可以在 Walmart.com、沃尔玛应用程序或店内进行在线申请。

paras.en: Being a student usually means sleep deprivation, caffeine overconsumption, and being broke. When students shop at Walmart, they can stretch their limited funds even further with 50% off Walmart+ memberships for students. That means a student Walmart+ membership is $6.47 per month or $49 per year. Plus, you can get a free 30-day trial to decide if the service is right for you! To get this deal, verify your eligibility, then choose your discounted plan—either monthly or annual. Either option is still 50%. With the free trial, you’ll get perks like free delivery on orders over $35, free shipping, and either a free Paramount+ or Peacock streaming service (that amounts to up to $109 per year in video streaming savings!).
paras.zh: 作为一名学生通常意味着睡眠不足、咖啡因摄入过量以及破产。当学生在沃尔玛购物时，他们可以进一步利用有限的资金，为学生提供 50% 的 Walmart+ 会员资格折扣。这意味着 Walmart+ 学生会员的费用为每月 6.47 美元或每年 49 美元。此外，您还可以获得 30 天免费试用，以确定该服务是否适合您！要获得此优惠，请验证您的资格，然后选择您的折扣计划 - 每月或每年。任一选项仍然是 50%。通过免费试用，您将获得一些福利，例如订单超过 35 美元的免费送货、免费送货以及免费的 Paramount+ 或 Peacock 流媒体服务（每年最多可节省 109 美元的视频流媒体费用！）。

paras.en: Get 5% Cashback at Walmart as a Walmart+ Member
paras.zh: 作为 Walmart+ 会员，在 Walmart 获得 5% 现金返还

paras.en: Being a Walmart+ member comes with many perks, including 5% cash back when you shop at Walmart with Plus and 1.5% cash back on all other purchases, with zero annual fees. When you open a OnePay Card and spend over $75 on that card within 30 days, you’ll get an extra $35 in cash back. To get these rewards, all you need to do is pay with your OnePay CashRewards Card at Walmart (or anywhere Mastercard is accepted), earn OnePay points on your purchases, and redeem them for cash or a statement credit into a OnePay Cash Account.
paras.zh: 成为 Walmart+ 会员可享受许多福利，包括使用 Plus 在 Walmart 购物时可享受 5% 的现金返还，所有其他购物可享受 1.5% 的现金返还，且年费为零。当您开立 OnePay 卡并在 30 天内在该卡上消费超过 75 美元时，您将获得额外 35 美元的现金返还。要获得这些奖励，您只需在沃尔玛（或接受万事达卡的任何地方）使用 OnePay CashRewards 卡付款，在购买时赚取 OnePay 积分，然后将其兑换成现金或将积分存入 OnePay 现金账户。

paras.en: Managing a medical condition like diabetes can be anxiety-inducing, and it can also be extremely expensive. (Thanks, USA, for not having universal healthcare!) Walmart knows your health is a priority and wants to make medically necessary items more affordable for folks with diabetes. Walmart has a dedicated online section for (often) discounted diabetes essentials to take the headache and guesswork out of shopping. You can get up to 35% off items like glucose monitors, insulin coolers, test strips, and medical bags. Plus, diabetic supplies and wearables like socks, footwear, and mobility aids are available for fast shipping, and most are FSA/HSA eligible.
paras.zh: 治疗糖尿病等疾病可能会引起焦虑，而且费用也可能非常昂贵。 （感谢美国没有全民医疗保健！）沃尔玛知道您的健康是首要任务，并希望为糖尿病患者提供更实惠的医疗必需品。沃尔玛有一个专门的在线专区，出售（通常）打折的糖尿病必需品，以消除购物时的头痛和猜测。血糖监测仪、胰岛素冷却器、试纸和医疗包等商品可享受高达 35% 的折扣。此外，糖尿病用品和可穿戴设备（如袜子、鞋类和助行器）可快速发货，而且大多数都符合 FSA/HSA 资格。

articles.title: I Found the Best Black Friday Deals on Phones (2026): iPhone, Pixel, and Moto Up to 50% Off
articles.author: Simon Hill

paras.en: We see tempting Black Friday phone deals every year, and 2026 is no exception. I spotted several phones we have tested and already recommend at a cheaper price than usual, and collected them below. A few of these made our absolute best Black Friday deals, and we’ll update this guide as we spot more phone deals worth your time.
paras.zh: 每年我们都会看到诱人的黑色星期五手机优惠，2026 年也不例外。我发现了几款我们已经测试过并已经以比平常更便宜的价格推荐的手机，并将它们收集在下面。其中一些是我们绝对最好的黑色星期五优惠，当我们发现更多值得您花时间的手机优惠时，我们将更新本指南。

paras.en: Want more deals? Check out our guide to the Best Black Friday Deals on Amazon, the Best Black Friday TV Deals, and Black Friday Deals at Home Depot. Plus, read our related shopping guides, including how to avoid scams and sketchy wares on Amazon.
paras.zh: 想要更多优惠吗？查看我们的亚马逊最佳黑色星期五优惠、最佳黑色星期五电视优惠和家得宝黑色星期五优惠指南。另外，请阅读我们的相关购物指南，包括如何避免亚马逊上的诈骗和粗略商品。

paras.en: Updated Saturday, November 28: We've added more deals on Motorola and Samsung phones, and a few case and accessory deals.
paras.zh: 11 月 28 日星期六更新：我们增加了更多摩托罗拉和三星手机的优惠，以及一些手机壳和配件的优惠。

paras.en: The iPhone Air impressed us with its super-svelte form factor when it came out last year. A lovely 6.5-inch OLED screen and excellent performance, courtesy of Apple’s A19 Pro chipset, are wrapped up in a body that’s just 5.6 millimeters thick and only weighs 165 grams. Battery life isn’t stellar, and the main camera is a lone 48-MP shooter, but it’s so thin. Discounts on iPhones can be hard to find, so if you’ve had your eye on the iPhone Air, this deal is worth grabbing.
paras.zh: 去年推出的 iPhone Air 以其超薄的外形给我们留下了深刻的印象。可爱的 6.5 英寸 OLED 屏幕和卓越的性能，得益于苹果的 A19 Pro 芯片组，机身厚度仅为 5.6 毫米，重量仅为 165 克。电池寿命不是很长，主摄像头是一个单独的 48MP 射手，但它太薄了。 iPhone 的折扣很难找到，所以如果您关注 iPhone Air，那么这笔交易值得抓住。

paras.en: They may be last year's Apple flagships, but Best Buy still has some stock. They are currently on offer for $100 less than usual, which is a rare deal. These powerful iPhones promise fantastic battery life, great performance, with nice thermal management, and bright 120-Hz screens. You also get a versatile triple-camera system, with some of the best video recording capabilities on a phone.
paras.zh: 它们可能是去年的苹果旗舰产品，但百思买仍然有一些库存。目前它们的售价比平常低 100 美元，这是一笔罕见的交易。这些功能强大的 iPhone 承诺出色的电池寿命、出色的性能、良好的热管理和明亮的 120 Hz 屏幕。您还可以获得多功能三摄像头系统，具有手机上最好的视频录制功能。

paras.en: Best Black Friday Google Pixel Phone Deals
paras.zh: 黑色星期五 Google Pixel 手机最佳优惠

paras.en: The most powerful Pixels in Google's range are the 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL, and they're on sale at the deepest discount since they launched this summer. Classy designs, bright, colorful screens, and powerfully versatile camera systems, make these the best Android phones you can buy right now. The cameras are the best Google offers, with faster low light performance and powerful telephoto lenses to zoom in from afar. Google’s AI features offer proactive assistance, more conversational ability, and handy photography features like Magic Capture to automatically capture photos and videos for you. Pixels are also the only major Android phones with full Qi2 support, including magnets for easy mounting.
paras.zh: Google 系列中最强大的 Pixel 是 11 Pro 和 11 Pro XL，它们以自今年夏天推出以来的最大折扣出售。优雅的设计、明亮多彩的屏幕以及功能强大的多功能相机系统，使这些成为您现在可以购买的最好的 Android 手机。这些相机是谷歌提供的最好的相机，具有更快的低光性能和强大的长焦镜头，可以从远处放大。 Google 的人工智能功能提供主动帮助、更多对话能力以及方便的摄影功能（例如 Magic Capture），可自动为您捕捉照片和视频。 Pixel 也是唯一一款完全支持 Qi2 的主流 Android 手机，包括易于安装的磁铁。

paras.en: While it’s not my favorite folding phone, this is a polished update to Google’s foldable line, offering some genuine improvements, including impressive durability with an IP68 water and dust resistance rating. You get two lovely, sharp OLED displays: an 8-inch main screen and a 6.5-inch cover screen. It misses out on the better cameras in the other Pro models, but the same smart AI features are present and correct. This is a return to the lowest price we've seen on the device.
paras.zh: 虽然它不是我最喜欢的折叠手机，但这是对谷歌可折叠产品线的完美更新，提供了一些真正的改进，包括令人印象深刻的耐用性和 IP68 防水防尘等级。您将获得两个可爱、清晰的 OLED 显示屏：一个 8 英寸主屏幕和一个 6.5 英寸覆盖屏幕。它错过了其他 Pro 型号中更好的相机，但同样的智能 AI 功能仍然存在且正确。这是我们在该设备上看到的最低价格的回归。

paras.en: The regular Pixel 11 isn't far behind the Pro models, with the same Tensor G6 chipset, smart features, and Qi2 25W support. But it comes in more fun colors, including the bright pink Hibiscus I tested. You can also get Pistachio (warm green), Frost (pale lavender), or Obsidian (black). This phone is the perfect size, and the sweet spot in Google’s range for most folks, at least until the cheaper A series variant comes along.
paras.zh: 普通 Pixel 11 与 Pro 型号相差不远，具有相同的 Tensor G6 芯片组、智能功能和 Qi2 25W 支持。但它有更有趣的颜色，包括我测试过的亮粉色木槿花。您还可以获得开心果色（暖绿色）、霜色（淡紫色）或黑曜石色（黑色）。这款手机的尺寸非常完美，对于大多数人来说是谷歌产品系列中的最佳选择，至少在更便宜的 A 系列变体出现之前是这样。

paras.en: Our top pick of the best folding phones pulls all of Samsung’s experience together into a fresh form factor that feels just right. The 5.5-inch cover screen is usable, and the 7.7-inch inner screen is perfect for opening two apps side by side. This is also a powerful phone with a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and has plenty of stamina thanks to the 4,800-mAh silicon-carbon battery. This $400 discount brings it to the lowest price we’ve seen so far.
paras.zh: 我们精选的最佳折叠手机将三星的所有经验汇集到一个全新的外形中，感觉恰到好处。 5.5英寸的盖屏可用，7.7英寸的内屏非常适合并排打开两个应用程序。这也是一款功能强大的手机，配备 Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 芯片组，并配备 4,800mAh 硅碳电池，具有充足的续航能力。 400 美元的折扣使其达到我们迄今为止见过的最低价格。

paras.en: If you prefer a compact flip phone, the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 is calling. Samsung’s eighth-generation clamshell is wonderfully refined, slimmer than ever, and offers a 4.1-inch AMOLED cover screen with a 6.9-inch display inside. Performance and battery life are excellent. The camera will be enough for most folks, and there’s a healthy dose of AI. Best of all, this discount deletes the annual $100 price bump and knocks another $125 off. It has never been cheaper.
paras.zh: 如果您更喜欢紧凑型翻盖手机，那么三星 Galaxy Z Flip8 就是您的最佳选择。三星的第八代翻盖非常精致，比以往任何时候都更纤薄，并提供 4.1 英寸 AMOLED 盖屏，内部显示屏为 6.9 英寸。性能和电池寿命都非常出色。对于大多数人来说，相机已经足够了，而且还有适量的人工智能。最重要的是，此折扣消除了每年 100 美元的价格上涨，并再降低 125 美元。从来没有这么便宜过。

paras.en: Samsung’s most powerful phone is the pick for professionals. It combines excellent performance, great battery life, and a reliable quad-camera system. The Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra has a special Privacy Display to keep folks from peeking over your shoulder at what’s on your screen. The Ultra is also the only Samsung phone with the integrated S Pen stylus.
paras.zh: 三星最强大的手机是专业人士的选择。它结合了卓越的性能、出色的电池续航时间和可靠的四摄像头系统。三星 Galaxy S26 Ultra 配备了特殊的防窥显示屏，可防止人们偷看您的屏幕上的内容。 Ultra 也是唯一一款集成 S Pen 手写笔的三星手机。

paras.en: Here are a couple of other Samsung phones on sale:
paras.zh: 以下是其他几款在售的三星手机：

paras.en: - Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra for $1,700 ($400 Off)
paras.zh: - 三星 Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra 售价 1,700 美元（立减 400 美元）

paras.en: - Samsung Galaxy S26 for $800 ($200 off)
paras.zh: - 三星 Galaxy S26 售价 800 美元（立减 200 美元）

paras.en: - Samsung Galaxy S26 FE for $500 ($200 Off)
paras.zh: - 三星 Galaxy S26 FE 仅需 500 美元（立减 200 美元）

paras.en: - Samsung Galaxy A37 for $340 ($150 off)
paras.zh: - 三星 Galaxy A37 售价 340 美元（立减 150 美元）

paras.en: While we prefer the Google Pixel 10a as a midrange phone, the Nothing Phone (4a) Pro is a full $200 cheaper with this Black Friday discount, making it a better pick today for folks on a budget. It promises good performance, a nice screen, reliable battery life, and a solid triple-camera system with 3.5X zoom. You also get to enjoy Nothing’s unique software design with the fun Glyph Matrix pixelated screen on the back.
paras.zh: 虽然我们更喜欢 Google Pixel 10a 作为中端手机，但 Nothing Phone (4a) Pro 在黑色星期五折扣下足足便宜了 200 美元，这使其成为预算有限的人的更好选择。它承诺良好的性能、漂亮的屏幕、可靠的电池寿命以及具有 3.5 倍变焦的坚固三摄像头系统。您还可以享受 Nothing 独特的软件设计以及背面有趣的 Glyph Matrix 像素化屏幕。

paras.en: Find other Nothing phones on sale right now below:
paras.zh: 立即在下面查找其他正在销售的 Nothing 手机：

paras.en: This compact flip icon is our favorite Motorola phone right now. The 4-inch OLED cover screen is customizable. It opens to reveal a 7-inch AMOLED display that’s sharp, bright, and smooth thanks to the 165-Hz refresh rate. You can easily squeeze two days from the 5,000-mAh silicon-carbon battery. This $200 discount is the deepest we've seen so far.
paras.zh: 这款紧凑的翻盖图标是我们目前最喜欢的摩托罗拉手机。 4英寸OLED盖屏可定制。打开它，可以看到 7 英寸 AMOLED 显示屏，由于 165 Hz 刷新率，该显示屏清晰、明亮且平滑。 5,000mAh 硅碳电池可以轻松满足您两天的使用时间。此次 200 美元的折扣是迄今为止我们见过的最大折扣。

paras.en: Last year’s Moto G Stylus was our pick of the best cheap phones under $400, and it’s down by another $200 right now, making it a pretty tempting deal. It could be ideal if you miss a headphone jack and microSD card slot. This is the 2025 model, but Motorola increased the price by $100 for the 2026 Moto G Stylus, and, apart from the upgraded active stylus, there’s little to justify the extra cost.
paras.zh: 去年的 Moto G Stylus 是我们挑选的 400 美元以下最便宜的手机，现在它又下跌了 200 美元，这使得它成为一个相当诱人的交易。如果您缺少耳机插孔和 microSD 卡插槽，它可能是理想的选择。这是 2025 年的型号，但摩托罗拉将 2026 年 Moto G Stylus 的价格提高了 100 美元，而且除了升级的有源手写笔之外，没有什么理由证明额外的成本是合理的。

paras.en: - Motorola Razr Fold for $1,500 ($400 off)
paras.zh: - Motorola Razr Fold 售价 1,500 美元（立减 400 美元）

paras.en: Black Friday Phone Case and Accessory Deals
paras.zh: 黑色星期五手机壳和配件优惠

paras.en: There are loads of discounts on the best iPhone cases, best Pixel cases, and cases for other phones, and many of our favorite case and accessory makers are running Black Friday sales. Here are a few worth checking out:
paras.zh: 最好的 iPhone 手机壳、最好的 Pixel 手机壳和其他手机手机壳都有大量折扣，许多我们最喜欢的手机壳和配件制造商都在进行黑色星期五促销。以下是一些值得一看的内容：

paras.en: - Nimble has taken up to 35% off many of its power banks and other accessories.
paras.zh: - Nimble 的许多移动电源和其他配件均享受高达 35% 的折扣。

paras.en: - Satechi slashed up to 50% off some of its mobile chargers and accessories.
paras.zh: - Satechi 部分手机充电器和配件降价高达 50%。

paras.en: - Nomad is offering up 35% off a range of cases, Apple Watch bands, and chargers.
paras.zh: - Nomad 提供一系列保护壳、Apple Watch 表带和充电器 35% 的折扣。

paras.en: - Anker has a wide array of charging gear on sale right now.
paras.zh: - Anker 目前有多种充电设备在售。

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo Shares Second Holiday Song ‘Miss This Christmas’ on Amazon Music
articles.author: Mitchell Peters

paras.en: Olivia Rodrigo is keeping the holiday spirit alive with another festive release.
paras.zh: 奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 推出另一款节日新品，延续节日气氛。

paras.en: Just weeks after making her Christmas debut with “Take Me Home (4 Christmas),” the 23-year-old pop star has returned with a second holiday offering, “Miss This Christmas,” exclusively through Amazon Music.
paras.zh: 就在她以“Take Me Home (4 Christmas)”首次推出圣诞歌曲几周后，这位 23 岁的流行歌星又通过亚马逊音乐独家推出了第二张节日歌曲“Miss This Christmas”。

paras.en: Rodrigo debuted “Miss This Christmas” live during her concert at Nashville’s Bridgestone Arena on Monday (Nov. 23), introducing it to the crowd as a “really sad Christmas song” and noting that “no one’s ever really heard it before,” according to Rolling Stone.
paras.zh: 据《滚石》报道，罗德里戈周一（11 月 23 日）在纳什维尔普利司通体育场举行的音乐会上首次现场演唱了《Miss This Christmas》，向观众介绍这首歌是一首“非常悲伤的圣诞歌曲”，并指出“以前没有人真正听过这首歌”。

paras.en: The track was also included as the B-side on the vinyl edition of “Take Me Home (4 Christmas),” which arrived in early November. The holiday tune peaked at No. 32 on the Billboard Hot 100 in mid-November.
paras.zh: 该曲目还作为 B 面收录在 11 月初发行的黑胶唱片《Take Me Home (4 Christmas)》中。 11 月中旬，这首假日歌曲在 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜上最高排名第 32 位。

paras.en: While “Take Me Home (4 Christmas)” leans into festive pop with a nostalgic feel, “Miss This Christmas” takes a more melancholy approach, exploring the heartache of missing someone during the holiday season.
paras.zh: 《Take Me Home (4 Christmas)》倾向于带有怀旧感觉的节日流行音乐，而《Miss This Christmas》则采取了更为忧郁的方式，探讨了节日期间思念某人的心痛。

paras.en: “Happy Christmas to the lonely/ Broken hearts that feel just like me,” Rodrigo sings before adding, “Yeah, next year’s gonna look real different/ Tell your folks I’ll miss their Christmas.”
paras.zh: “祝那些和我一样的孤独/破碎的心圣诞快乐，”罗德里戈唱道，然后补充道，“是的，明年看起来会很不一样/告诉你的家人我会想念他们的圣诞节。”

paras.en: The new release arrives during a particularly busy stretch for Rodrigo, who earned seven nominations at the 2027 Grammy Awards, including album of the year for her third studio album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love.
paras.zh: 新专辑发布之际，罗德里戈 (Rodrigo) 特别忙碌，她在 2027 年格莱美奖上获得了七项提名，其中包括她的第三张录音室专辑的年度最佳专辑，对于一个如此相爱的女孩来说，你似乎很悲伤。

paras.en: “I am over the moon!!!!!” Rodrigo wrote on Instagram after the Grammy noms were announced. “I love this album so much and for it to be recognized in this way is the biggest honor.”
paras.zh: “我欣喜若狂！！！！”格莱美提名公布后，罗德里戈在 Instagram 上写道。 “我非常喜欢这张专辑，能以这样的方式得到认可是我最大的荣幸。”

paras.en: You seem pretty sad for a girl so in love also recently earned its fifth nonconsecutive week at No. 1 on the Billboard 200.
paras.zh: 你似乎对一个女孩感到非常悲伤，所以恋爱最近还连续第五周在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第一。

articles.title: The Killers’ Dave Keuning Says He Survived a Major Stroke: ‘By Some Miracle I Am Fine’
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: The Killers guitarist Dave Keuning has revealed he suffered a major stroke two weeks ago and went straight into surgery.
paras.zh: Killers 吉他手戴夫·科宁 (Dave Keuning) 透露，他两周前遭遇严重中风，并直接接受了手术。

paras.en: Keuning, 50, shared the news in an Instagram post on Thursday (Nov. 26), writing that a blood clot had cut off the blood supply to the right side of his brain. “Two weeks ago, I had a major stroke, and thanks to my wife acting fast, I went straight to the hospital and into surgery,” he wrote. “The first hour after a stroke is critical when it comes to getting to the hospital.”
paras.zh: 50 岁的科宁于周四（11 月 26 日）在 Instagram 上分享了这一消息，他写道，血凝块切断了他右脑的血液供应。 “两周前，我发生了一次严重中风，多亏了我妻子反应迅速，我直接去了医院并接受了手术，”他写道。 “中风后的第一个小时对于前往医院至关重要。”

paras.en: “By the time I arrived at the hospital, I was blind in one eye and had lost function on my left side,” Keuning continued, adding that even then he didn’t realize he was having a stroke. Doctors gave him a 40% chance of survival and told him to expect lasting disabilities, he said, “but by some miracle I am fine.”
paras.zh: “当我到达医院时，我的一只眼睛失明了，左眼也失去了功能，”科宁继续说道，并补充说，即使在那时，他也没有意识到自己中风了。他说，医生给了他 40% 的生存机会，并告诉他要做好长期残疾的准备，“但奇迹般的是，我没事。”

paras.en: “And yes I can play guitar just as good as before,” he wrote. “It was the first thing I checked when I woke up from surgery.”
paras.zh: “是的，我可以像以前一样弹吉他，”他写道。 “这是我从手术中醒来后检查的第一件事。”

paras.en: “I feel extremely fortunate that I am alive and well, and that I can use my hands and feet and talk just like before,” he added. “I am thankful for my wife, my son, my daughter, and all of my bandmates, who I feel closer to than ever.”
paras.zh: “我感到非常幸运，我还活着，而且身体健康，我可以像以前一样用手脚说话，”他补充道。 “我感谢我的妻子、我的儿子、我的女儿以及我所有的乐队成员，我感觉与他们比以往任何时候都更加亲密。”

paras.en: A founding member of the Las Vegas band, Keuning stepped back from touring with the Killers in 2017 and has stayed off the road since, though he returned to the studio for 2021’s Pressure Machine. He has also released two solo albums under the name Keuning: Prismism (2019) and A Mild Case of Everything (2021).
paras.zh: 作为拉斯维加斯乐队的创始成员，科宁于 2017 年退出了 Killers 乐队的巡演，此后就不再上路，不过他在 2021 年的《Pressure Machine》中又回到了录音室。他还发行了两张个人专辑《Keuning: Prismism》（2019 年）和《A Mild Case of Everything》（2021 年）。

paras.en: The Killers earned their first No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with 2017’s Wonderful Wonderful and have notched eight No. 1 albums on the Official U.K. Albums Chart, most recently with 2023’s Rebel Diamonds. Their 2004 debut, Hot Fuss, produced “Mr. Brightside,” which in 2021 became the first song to log 260 weeks on the U.K. singles chart.
paras.zh: Killers 凭借 2017 年的《Wonderful Wonderful》首次登上 Billboard 200 排行榜第一名，并在英国官方专辑排行榜上获得了八张专辑第一名，最近的一张专辑是 2023 年的 Rebel Diamonds。他们 2004 年的首张专辑《Hot Fuss》制作了《Mr. Brightside》，该歌曲于 2021 年成为第一首在英国单曲榜上停留 260 周的歌曲。

paras.en: Brandon Flowers released his third solo album, Thrasher, in August, and has said he expects the next Killers album to arrive in 2027.
paras.zh: Brandon Flowers 于 8 月发行了他的第三张个人专辑《Thrasher》，并表示他预计 Killers 的下一张专辑将于 2027 年推出。

articles.title: Strong ‘I Play Rocky,’ ‘How to Rob a Bank’ KO and More: Amazon MGM Distribution Head on 2026 Highs and Lows
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: Amazon MGM Studios‘ team is relishing the thrill of the theatrical fight as I Play Rocky looks to capitalize on its muscular start.
paras.zh: 亚马逊米高梅影业的团队正在享受戏剧打斗的快感，《我玩洛奇》希望充分利用其强劲的开局。

paras.en: Peter Farrelly’s fact-based underdog drama stars Anthony Ippolito as Sylvester Stallone amid his battle in the 1970s to get his script for Rocky into production with himself in the lead role. After two weekends in limited release, I Play Rocky rose to No. 2 at the domestic box office as it expanded wide last weekend. It is expected to gross roughly $9 million for the five-day Thanksgiving frame, which would bring its North American cume to around $22 million through Sunday.
paras.zh: 彼得·法拉利这部基于事实的失败者剧情片由安东尼·伊波利托饰演西尔维斯特·史泰龙，他在 20 世纪 70 年代为自己主演的《洛奇》剧本投入制作而奋斗。经过两个周末的限量上映后，《我玩洛奇》随着上周末的广泛上映，升至国内票房第二位。预计在为期五天的感恩节期间，该片的票房收入约为 900 万美元，这将使该片到周日的北美收入达到约 2200 万美元。

paras.en: I Play Rocky is the latest release in a buzzy year for the studio, following the mammoth success of this spring’s Project Hail Mary — set for rerelease Dec. 11 as awards season comes out swinging — and a winning path for Verity. Amazon MGM also sparked recent conversation with its unusual release plan for Sacha Baron Cohen’s Ali G: Who Iz I?, which received a two-day theatrical run just before hitting Prime Video, and for its tough turnout for David Leitch’s How to Rob a Bank, the $40 million-budgeted heist film that opened earlier this month with just $5.1 million domestically.
paras.zh: 《I Play Rocky》是该工作室在热闹的一年中推出的最新作品，继今年春季的《万福玛丽计划》取得巨大成功之后，该计划将于 12 月 11 日随着颁奖季的到来而重新发行，也是 Verity 的制胜之路。最近，亚马逊米高梅还因其萨莎·拜伦·科恩 (Sacha Baron Cohen) 的《阿里·G：谁是我？》(Ali G: Who Iz I?) 的不同寻常的上映计划而引发热议，该片在 Prime Video 上线前就在院线上映了两天，而大卫·雷奇 (David Leitch) 的《如何抢劫银行》(How to Rob a Bank) 的上座率也很高，这部预算为 4000 万美元的抢劫电影于本月初首映，国内票房仅为 510 万美元。

paras.en: During a conversation with The Hollywood Reporter conducted ahead of Thanksgiving, Amazon MGM head of domestic theatrical distribution Kevin Wilson shares insight into I Play Rocky’s broad appeal and the hopes that it continues to find younger audiences after that impressive A+ CinemaScore. Wilson also weighs in on the releases for How to Rob a Bank, Ali G and David O. Russell’s Madden, not to mention the company’s big James Bond casting news.
paras.zh: 在感恩节前与《好莱坞报道》进行的对话中，亚马逊米高梅国内影院发行部负责人凯文·威尔逊 (Kevin Wilson) 分享了对《我玩洛奇》广泛吸引力的见解，并希望它在获得令人印象深刻的 A+ CinemaScore 之后继续吸引年轻观众。威尔逊还对《如何抢劫银行》、《Ali G》和大卫·O·拉塞尔的《Madden》的上映发表了评论，更不用说该公司的詹姆斯·邦德选角新闻了。

paras.en: How are you feeling with I Play Rocky now playing wide?
paras.zh: 您对《I Play Rocky》现在打边路感觉如何？

paras.en: It’s a great start. From the first time we saw the movie — and really from the first time I read the script — I knew we had a special story. What Pete [Farrelly] and the filmmaking team were able to put on screen, coupled with Anthony Ippolito’s performance, we got magic. As we went [wide last] weekend, we saw the audience response, which is always good just to validate our own intuition. With that A+ CinemaScore and a 97 percent in the top two boxes [on PostTrak] and an 88 definite recommend, we always hoped that this thing would have legs. We’re pretty confident.
paras.zh: 这是一个很好的开始。从我们第一次看这部电影——实际上从我第一次读剧本——我就知道我们有一个特别的故事。皮特（法雷利）和电影制作团队能够在银幕上呈现的内容，再加上安东尼·伊波利托的表演，我们得到了魔法。当我们[上周末]广泛进行时，我们看到了观众的反应，这总是很好的，只是为了验证我们自己的直觉。 CinemaScore 的 A+ 评分、[PostTrak] 前两名的 97% 评分以及 88 分的明确推荐度，我们一直希望这部电影能有立足之地。我们非常有信心。

paras.en: The movie was the subject of Oscar talk ever since premiering at TIFF.
paras.zh: 自 TIFF 首映以来，这部电影一直是奥斯卡话题的话题。

paras.en: Something we’re consistently seeing is the ability of Anthony to portray Sly, [and] that is not the easiest character in the world to play. It’s one of those feel-good, perseverance stories that doesn’t come around that often. The unique thing about this one is, we rolled it out, and we saw good numbers in New York and L.A. and, of course, Philly, but it’s interesting to see [now that it’s wide]. I’m not super surprised, but the movie’s playing broad from a geographical standpoint. It’s playing solid across the country. We’ve got theaters in Redlands, California, in the top 10 — Goodyear, Arizona [and] Santa Clarita [in California]. It’s performing really well in the South Central part of the country and those Texas regions. We are getting a nice percentage of the Hispanic audience in.
paras.zh: Something we’re consistently seeing is the ability of Anthony to portray Sly, [and] that is not the easiest character in the world to play. It’s one of those feel-good, perseverance stories that doesn’t come around that often.这个的独特之处在于，我们推出了它，我们在纽约和洛杉矶看到了很好的数字，当然还有费城，但看到它很有趣[现在它很广泛]。 I’m not super surprised, but the movie’s playing broad from a geographical standpoint.它在全国范围内表现强劲。 We’ve got theaters in Redlands, California, in the top 10 — Goodyear, Arizona [and] Santa Clarita [in California]. It’s performing really well in the South Central part of the country and those Texas regions.我们吸引了相当一部分西班牙裔观众。

paras.en: I know that Hollywood loves movies about Hollywood, but it’s sometimes hard to predict if broad audiences will, too.
paras.zh: 我知道好莱坞喜欢关于好莱坞的电影，但有时很难预测广大观众是否也会喜欢。

paras.en: I think it just goes to [show], these are Rocky fans. They’re fans of Sly, and they’re fans of the Rocky franchise. We’re definitely playing a little bit older right now, which is not a surprise — 53 percent of our audience is 45-plus [as of last weekend]. As we get into Thanksgiving, the hope is that maybe that age playability comes down a little bit. I do think it could be one of those Thanksgiving films in the marketplace that’s a good choice for adult families to all agree on a movie.
paras.zh: 我认为这只是为了[表演]，这些都是洛奇的粉丝。他们是《狡猾》的粉丝，也是《洛奇》系列的粉丝。我们现在的播放年龄确实有点大，这并不奇怪——我们 53% 的观众年龄在 45 岁以上（截至上周末）。当我们进入感恩节时，我们希望这个年龄段的可玩性可能会有所下降。我确实认为这可能是市场上感恩节电影之一，对于成年家庭来说，这部电影是一个不错的选择。

paras.en: Another movie focusing on a public figure and sparking social buzz is Madden. Was there talk of putting that one in theaters?
paras.zh: 另一部聚焦公众人物并引发社会热议的电影是《麦登》(Madden)。有没有讨论过要把那个上映？

paras.en: That movie was always greenlit as a streaming movie. That was always the plan, to release it in that Thanksgiving corridor at home for audiences. Christian Bale’s performance is unbelievable in that movie.
paras.zh: 那部电影一直被视为流媒体电影。这一直是我们的计划，在家里的感恩节走廊上向观众发布它。克里斯蒂安·贝尔在那部电影中的表演令人难以置信。

paras.en: Speaking of Rocky, your year got off to a great start with Project Hail Mary, which continues to be part of the Oscar conversation.
paras.zh: 说到《洛奇》，你的一年以“万福玛丽计划”有了一个良好的开端，该计划仍然是奥斯卡话题的一部分。

paras.en: We’re really excited. I came over from the MGM team, so I’ve always been releasing theatrical movies. But it’s our first big year at Amazon MGM putting a pretty robust slate together, and to have that movie pop the way it did early on in this theatrical journey, obviously, was a really good thing. Between [directors] Chris [Miller] and Phil [Lord] and [star] Ryan [Gosling], what they were able to put on screen was really something special. We’re rereleasing it back in theaters on Dec. 11th, and we’ll have some IMAX screens and back in 70mm in locations. Just get that audience back out to see it in a theater where it deserves to be seen. We’ll see what happens.
paras.zh: 我们真的很兴奋。我是从米高梅团队过来的，所以一直都在发行院线电影。但这是我们在亚马逊米高梅的第一个重要的一年，将相当强大的阵容放在一起，并且让这部电影像在这个戏剧之旅的早期那样流行，显然是一件非常好的事情。在[导演]克里斯[米勒]、菲尔[洛德]和[主演]瑞恩[高斯林]之间，他们能够在银幕上呈现的东西确实很特别。我们将于 12 月 11 日在影院重新上映，我们将在一些地点配备一些 IMAX 银幕和 70 毫米的银幕。只要让观众回到值得观看的剧院就可以了。我们会看看会发生什么。

paras.en: Any thoughts on what happened with How to Rob a Bank?
paras.zh: 对于《如何抢劫银行》中发生的事情有什么想法吗？

paras.en: Tough one. Obviously, not what we were hoping for and certainly not what our expectations were [with] releasing this film theatrically. It’s a tough marketplace. That’s the unique thing about the marketplace right now, is there’s no floor on these movies. It was tough to connect with a younger audience on this movie, and we’re still trying to figure it out a little bit internally, why this thing didn’t at least click for that younger audience in a bigger way. Have you seen the movie?
paras.zh: 很难的一个。显然，这不是我们所希望的，当然也不是我们对影院上映这部电影的期望。这是一个艰难的市场。目前市场的独特之处在于，这些电影没有底线。在这部电影中与年轻观众建立联系是很困难的，我们仍在内部尝试弄清楚为什么这件事至少没有以更大的方式吸引年轻观众。你看过这部电影吗？

paras.en: The movie’s fun. Nick [Hoult] and Pete [Davidson] and that crew, it’s fun to watch, but then Zoë [Kravitz] and John C. Reilly, that relationship is really good in the movie. It’s a little bit of a head-scratcher, and we’re still living in that world where the theatrical hurdle is not small. Trying to convince audiences to get off their couch, to get off YouTube, to get off all the streaming services — it’s not an easy thing to do. For this particular movie, it was just tough to get audiences into a theater. The unique thing about Amazon MGM, comparative to some other studios — and it’s not an excuse or deflecting the underperformance theatrically — but we have the second biggest streaming platform on the planet. The life cycle of our films are a little bit different than other studios. So I’m really hopeful that that’s where audiences are going to find this movie.
paras.zh: 这部电影很有趣。尼克（霍尔特）和皮特（戴维森）以及剧组人员，观看起来很有趣，但是佐伊（克拉维茨）和约翰·C·赖利（John C. Reilly）在电影中的关系非常好。这有点令人头疼，而且我们仍然生活在那个戏剧障碍不小的世界里。试图说服观众离开沙发、离开 YouTube、离开所有流媒体服务——这并不是一件容易的事。对于这部特殊的电影来说，让观众走进影院是很困难的。与其他一些电影公司相比，亚马逊米高梅的独特之处在于——这不是借口，也不是在戏剧上转移表现不佳的原因——但我们拥有全球第二大流媒体平台。我们电影的生命周期与其他工作室略有不同。所以我真的希望观众能在那里找到这部电影。

paras.en: How did the team decide on the unique strategy for Ali G: Who Iz I?, with just the two-day theatrical run?
paras.zh: 团队是如何决定《Ali G: Who Iz I?》的独特策略的，只需要两天的剧场放映？

paras.en: We always wanted to do some sort of a theatrical event with that movie. That was always the plan. We know he has this rabid fan base, so we wanted to create an event in theaters. We decided just to do that two-night event in theaters and then get it to Prime Video as quickly as possible. It’s just like we’ve seen with the Jackass movie and some of these other comps: That theatrical hurdle is just tough. To convince a really wide audience that they need to go see a film like that in theaters is not the easiest thing to do. We came up with that event-style release and got it to Prime Video as quickly as we could, and the performance on Prime Video has been solid.
paras.zh: 我们一直想用那部电影举办某种戏剧活动。这一直是计划。我们知道他拥有如此狂热的粉丝群，所以我们想在剧院举办一场活动。我们决定在影院举办为期两晚的活动，然后尽快在 Prime Video 上播放。就像我们在《蠢驴》电影和其他一些作品中看到的那样：戏剧障碍非常艰难。要让广大观众相信他们需要去电影院看这样的电影并不是一件容易的事。我们想出了这个活动风格的版本，并尽快将其发布到 Prime Video，并且在 Prime Video 上的表现一直很稳定。

paras.en: Your team certainly dominated headlines recently with Robert Pattinson’s casting as Bond.
paras.zh: 最近，罗伯特·帕丁森饰演邦德，你们的团队无疑占据了头条新闻。

paras.en: Super, super excited for that one. I got to release No Time to Die, which is Daniel [Craig’s] last movie [as Bond]. This one’s going to be really fun — a reinvention of the franchise, and it’ll be super interesting as this cast starts to fill out.
paras.zh: 超级，超级兴奋。我要发行《无暇赴死》，这是丹尼尔（克雷格）的最后一部电影（饰演邦德）。这部电影将会非常有趣——对这个系列的重新设计，而且随着演员阵容的不断充实，这将会非常有趣。

paras.en: I’ve gone full circle with Rob Pattinson. I was at Summit Entertainment and released the Twilight movies way back in the day. God, I think he was 17 at the time. It’s been a fun journey to see his career, and now his Bond will be great.
paras.zh: 我和罗伯·帕丁森兜了一圈。那天我在顶峰娱乐公司发行了《暮光之城》电影。天哪，我想他当时17岁。他的职业生涯是一次有趣的旅程，现在他的邦德将会很棒。
