articles.title: Jermaine Haley, WWE Wrestler Known as Bronson Reed, Dies at 38
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Jermaine Haley, the WWE wrestler known as Bronson Reed, has died. He was 38.
paras.zh: 杰梅因·哈利 (Jermaine Haley)，WWE 摔跤手，绰号布朗森·里德 (Bronson Reed)，去世了。他38岁了。

paras.en: Haley died Friday following medical complications, the WWE announced. No further details were reported.
paras.zh: WWE 宣布，海莉于周五因医疗并发症去世。没有报道更多细节。

paras.en: “Jermaine was a larger-than-life figure in WWE. But more importantly, he was a phenomenal person, a devoted family man, and a beloved colleague,” the WWE shared in an Instagram post. “Our thoughts and deepest condolences are with Jermaine’s entire family, including his pregnant wife Paige, their daughter, as well as all his friends, co-workers and fans.”
paras.zh: “杰梅因是 WWE 中一位传奇人物。但更重要的是，他是一个非凡的人、一个忠诚的家庭男人和一位敬爱的同事，”WWE 在 Instagram 帖子中分享道。 “我们向杰梅因的整个家庭致以最深切的哀悼，包括他怀孕的妻子佩奇、他们的女儿，以及他所有的朋友、同事和粉丝。”

paras.en: Born in 1988 in Adelaide, South Australia, Haley began his professional wrestling career in 2007 under the names Jonah Rock and J-Rock in the Australian independent circuit. He accumulated titles and worked on various promotions before his transition into the WWE.
paras.zh: Haley 1988 年出生于南澳大利亚阿德莱德，2007 年在澳大利亚独立巡回赛中以乔纳·洛克 (Jonah Rock) 和 J-Rock 的名字开始了职业摔跤生涯。在转入 WWE 之前，他积累了冠军头衔并进行了各种晋升。

paras.en: He officially joined the WWE in 2019, performing on its training ground NXT. He was would become an NXT North American champion, but was released in 2021. Haley continued competing with New Japan Pro-Wrestling and Impact Wrestling.
paras.zh: 他于 2019 年正式加入 WWE，并在其训练场 NXT 进行表演。他本应成为 NXT 北美冠军，但于 2021 年被释放。海莉继续参加新日本职业摔跤和冲击摔跤比赛。

paras.en: Haley did not stay away from the WWE for long, as he joined the main roster in 2022, and went on to win the Andre the Giant Memorial Battle Royal in 2024. His most recent WWE appearance was roughly three weeks ago at the Crown Jewel event in Saudi Arabia, where he faced off against Oba Femi.
paras.zh: 海利并没有离开 WWE 太久，他于 2022 年加入了主力阵容，并于 2024 年赢得了巨人安德烈纪念之战。他最近一次出现在 WWE 是在大约三周前的沙特阿拉伯皇冠宝石赛事上，在那里他与奥巴·费米对决。

paras.en: Haley married his high school sweetheart, Paige, and they welcomed their first child in February 2024. As the WWE announced, his wife was pregnant with their second child at the time of his death.
paras.zh: 海利与他的高中恋人佩奇结婚，他们于 2024 年 2 月迎来了他们的第一个孩子。正如 WWE 所宣布的那样，他的妻子在他去世时正怀着他们的第二个孩子。

articles.title: Africa’s richest man is taking his mega-refinery public in a blockbuster IPO

paras.en: One of the world's largest oil refineries is set to become Africa's biggest public firm in a highly anticipated offering that the continent's richest man has marketed as an "IPO for the people."
paras.zh: 世界上最大的炼油厂之一将成为非洲最大的上市公司，非洲大陆首富将这次备受期待的IPO宣传为“为人民而设的首次公开募股”。

paras.en: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE, founded by Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote, is expected to begin trading in Lagos on Dec. 1, according to multiple media reports, following regulatory approval. A Dangote Refinery spokesperson did not respond to a CNBC request for comment.
paras.zh: 据多家媒体报道，尼日利亚亿万富翁阿利科·丹格特(Aliko Dangote)创立的丹格特石油炼油厂和石化公司FZE预计将于12月1日在监管部门批准后在拉各斯开始交易。丹格特炼油厂发言人没有回应 CNBC 的置评请求。

paras.en: Reuters' calculations put Dangote Refinery's IPO-implied valuation at about $47 billion, based on the offer price and the company's registered share count. That would make it the biggest stock market listing Africa has ever seen.
paras.zh: 根据发行价和公司登记股数，路透社计算得出，丹格特炼油厂 IPO 的隐含估值约为 470 亿美元。这将使其成为非洲有史以来最大的上市股票市场。

paras.en: The Lagos-based refinery is regarded as a crown jewel of Nigeria's energy industry given the facility's role in transforming the oil-rich country's fuel market since it started operating in 2024.
paras.zh: 这家位于拉各斯的炼油厂自 2024 年开始运营以来，在改变这个石油资源丰富的国家的燃料市场方面发挥了重要作用，被视为尼日利亚能源行业皇冠上的明珠。

paras.en: "With a minimum subscription of just 10 shares, the offer is designed to give ordinary Nigerians and Africans an opportunity to own a stake in the refinery," Aliko Dangote said at the IPO launch in early September.
paras.zh: 阿利科·丹格特 (Aliko Dangote) 在 9 月初的 IPO 启动仪式上表示：“此次发行的最低认购量仅为 10 股，旨在为普通尼日利亚人和非洲人提供拥有炼油厂股份的机会。”

paras.en: "The IPO is positioned not simply as a capital-raising exercise, but as an opportunity for workers, entrepreneurs and everyday Nigerians to participate in the refinery's future growth," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“首次公开募股的定位不仅仅是一项融资活动，而且是工人、企业家和普通尼日利亚人参与炼油厂未来发展的机会。”

paras.en: Built for around $20 billion, the Dangote Refinery is now one of the largest in the world, with a crude oil distillation capacity of between 650,000 to 700,000 barrels per day.
paras.zh: 丹格特炼油厂耗资约 200 亿美元建成，现已成为世界上最大的炼油厂之一，原油蒸馏能力为每天 65 万至 70 万桶。

paras.en: It has emerged as a key provider of jet fuel in recent months, with buyers pivoting to West Africa amid Middle Eastern supply disruptions due to the Iran war.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，它已成为航空燃油的主要供应商，由于伊朗战争导致中东供应中断，买家转向西非。

paras.en: "In theory, it's a win-win situation," Cyril Widdershoven, a maritime, energy and geopolitical analyst at Blue Water Strategy, told CNBC by phone.
paras.zh: 蓝水战略公司海事、能源和地缘政治分析师西里尔·威德斯霍文 (Cyril Widdershoven) 在电话中对 CNBC 表示：“理论上，这是一个双赢的局面。”

paras.en: Dangote Refinery has bolstered its reputation as a key Atlantic Basin facility amid soaring global demand for refined petroleum products, Widdershoven said, and the company intends to double its refining capacity to 1.4 million barrels per day by 2029, which could further strengthen its competitiveness in global markets.
paras.zh: Widdershoven表示，在全球精炼石油产品需求飙升的背景下，丹格特炼油厂提升了其作为大西洋盆地重要设施的声誉，该公司计划到2029年将其炼油能力提高一倍，达到每天140万桶，这可能会进一步增强其在全球市场的竞争力。

paras.en: However, despite the refinery's importance to Nigeria's economy, questions remain over its investment case, Widdershoven said, citing construction costs, commissioning delays, and the possibility that new capacity comes online with weaker margins.
paras.zh: 然而，维德斯霍文表示，尽管该炼油厂对尼日利亚经济很重要，但其投资案例仍存在疑问，理由是建设成本、调试延误以及新产能上线时利润率可能下降。

paras.en: "Right now it's like Anthropic or Nvidia, you are now buying the hype," Widdershoven said.
paras.zh: Widdershoven 表示：“现在就像 Anthropic 或 Nvidia 一样，你现在相信的是炒作。”

paras.en: The Dangote Refinery has had "an extremely strong year," Mick Strautmann, market analyst at Vortexa, told CNBC by phone.
paras.zh: Vortexa 市场分析师米克·斯特劳特曼 (Mick Strautmann) 在电话中告诉 CNBC，丹格特炼油厂经历了“极其强劲的一年”。

paras.en: Between January and October, Vortexa data showed Dangote's seaborne refined product loadings stood at around 400,000 barrels per day, which is roughly 50% more than the same period last year.
paras.zh: Vortexa数据显示，1月至10月期间，Dangote的海运精炼产品装载量约为每天40万桶，比去年同期增加约50%。

paras.en: More recently, however, the facility has seen refined-product loading jump to a record of 575,000 barrels per day through the first three weeks of November, surpassing an October record of 550,000 barrels per day, Strautmann said.
paras.zh: 不过，斯特劳特曼表示，最近该设施的成品油装载量在 11 月的前三周跃升至创纪录的每天 575,000 桶，超过了 10 月份创下的每天 550,000 桶的纪录。

paras.en: "It's been able to ramp up quite spectacularly and provide a lot of these products to the market in an extremely high price environment," Strautmann added.
paras.zh: 斯特劳特曼补充道：“它的增长速度相当惊人，并以极高的价格环境向市场提供了大量此类产品。”

paras.en: "So, it's been one of the few places that's adding a lot of fuel supply to the Atlantic Basin, and at the same time, you know, to make West Africa less reliant on imports from other regions, particularly Europe for its gasoline supply," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“因此，它是少数几个向大西洋盆地增加大量燃料供应的地方之一，同时，你知道，这也是为了减少西非对其他地区进口的依赖，特别是欧洲的汽油供应。”

paras.en: David Omojomolo, an emerging market economist focused on Africa at Capital Economics, said the upcoming Dangote Refinery IPO has captured global attention because the facility is seen as a rare example of an industrial policy success story on the African continent.
paras.zh: 凯投宏观研究非洲的新兴市场经济学家大卫·奥莫乔莫洛表示，即将到来的丹格特炼油厂首次公开募股引起了全球关注，因为该工厂被视为非洲大陆产业政策成功故事的罕见例子。

paras.en: "It's been a good news story, and it's been an optimistic one as well," Omojomolo told CNBC.
paras.zh: 奥莫乔莫洛告诉 CNBC：“这是一个好消息，也是一个乐观的消息。”

paras.en: "I don't want to be a hostage to fortune and say this time is different … but it does feel like a buzz and it's a question as to does it force other, say, billionaire industrialists to put their money where their mouth is in terms of helping the region's industrialisation prospects," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我不想成为财富的人质，并说这次是不同的……但这确实让人感觉很热闹，问题是它是否会迫使其他亿万富翁实业家说出自己的钱来帮助该地区的工业化前景。”

articles.title: Saudi Arabia shifts Vision 2030 spending amid economic and security pressure

paras.en: Saudi Arabia's economic diversification strategy has moved from "spending and delivery at any cost" to "spending and delivery at the right cost," Economy Minister Faisal Alibrahim told CNBC on Friday.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯经济部长费萨尔·阿里布拉希姆 (Faisal Alibrahim) 周五对 CNBC 表示，沙特阿拉伯的经济多元化战略已从“不惜一切代价支出和交付”转变为“以适当成本支出和交付”。

paras.en: It comes after the Kingdom scaled back or cut several flagship projects as it endures a sharp economic contraction.
paras.zh: 此前，沙特王国因经济急剧萎缩而缩减或削减了几个旗舰项目。

paras.en: Alibrahim also said Saudi Arabia would "stop at nothing from realizing long-term sustainable stability in the region" amid ongoing Houthi strikes on civilian and energy infrastructure that have killed and injured dozens and repeatedly rocked oil markets.
paras.zh: 阿里布拉希姆还表示，在胡塞武装对民用和能源基础设施持续发动袭击、造成数十人伤亡并多次震撼石油市场之际，沙特阿拉伯将“不惜一切代价实现该地区的长期可持续稳定”。

paras.en: "The phase we're in today is one where every riyal is deployed with greater precision... it was clear that while we want to diversify or restructure our economy to depend less on government spend, there was a lot of catch-up that needed to be done, and for that, you saw government spend leading the way," Alibrahim told CNBC's Dan Murphy.
paras.zh: 阿里布拉希姆对 CNBC 的 Dan Murphy 表示：“我们今天所处的阶段是每个里亚尔的配置都更加精确……很明显，虽然我们希望实现经济多元化或重组经济以减少对政府支出的依赖，但仍有很多工作要做，为此，你会看到政府支出在引领。”

paras.en: "Right now, that is shifting from spending and delivery at any cost to spending and delivering at the right cost. We're moving towards a policy-first approach to many of our policy areas and... objectives. We're also creating a clearer business environment, one that aligns the regulatory environment in the Kingdom with international laws."
paras.zh: “目前，这种情况正在从不惜一切代价支出和交付转向以适当成本支出和交付。我们正在对许多政策领域和……目标采取政策优先的方法。我们还在创造一个更清晰的商业环境，使沙特王国的监管环境与国际法保持一致。”

paras.en: That includes the recent announcement of a 15% minimum effective tax rate on multinational profits, which Alibrahim said would "create a clearer environment for the private sector to operate," as the government looks to attract more external investment.
paras.zh: 其中包括最近宣布对跨国公司利润实行 15% 的最低有效税率，Alibrahim 表示，随着政府寻求吸引更多外部投资，这将“为私营部门的运营创造一个更清晰的环境”。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia has been on a mammoth capital spending spree since it launched its Vision 2030 plan to reduce its dependence on oil revenue in 2016, deploying the resources of its sovereign wealth fund — the Public Investment Fund, or PIF.
paras.zh: 自2016年推出“2030年愿景”计划以减少对石油收入的依赖以来，沙特阿拉伯一直在进行大规模的资本支出，并动用了其主权财富基金——公共投资基金（PIF）的资源。

paras.en: But more recently, it has reassessed the cost and commercial prospects of initiatives such as the new economic region NEOM and the futuristic "The Line" city, withdrawn funding from the LIV Golf tournament and halted construction on a planned giant skyscraper in Riyadh. In January, it said it would postpone hosting the 2029 Asian Winter Games, which had been scheduled for Trojena, a planned part of NEOM.
paras.zh: 但最近，它重新评估了新经济区 NEOM 和未来“The Line”城市等举措的成本和商业前景，撤回了 LIV 高尔夫锦标赛的资金，并停止了利雅得一座计划中的巨型摩天大楼的建设。今年 1 月，它表示将推迟举办 2029 年亚洲冬季运动会，该赛事原定于 NEOM 计划的一部分特洛伊纳举办。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia is meanwhile grappling with the destabilizing effects of ongoing strikes by Iran-backed Houthi militants in Yemen, which have hit targets including the PIF tower, Riyadh Airport and the country's largest oil refinery. The danger forced the Kingdom to call off its big international investor conference, dubbed "Davos in the Desert," which was due to be attended by some of the biggest figures in global finance in November.
paras.zh: 与此同时，沙特阿拉伯正在努力应对伊朗支持的也门胡塞武装分子持续发动袭击所造成的不稳定影响，袭击目标包括 PIF 塔、利雅得机场和该国最大的炼油厂。这种危险迫使沙特取消了被称为“沙漠中的达沃斯”的大型国际投资者会议，全球金融界的一些大人物原定于 11 月份出席。

paras.en: "The human cost of crisis has been real, and so has been the economic cost," Alibrahim told CNBC.
paras.zh: 阿里布拉希姆对 CNBC 表示：“危机造成的人员伤亡和经济损失都是真实存在的。”

paras.en: Alibrahim said infrastructure investments had allowed the Kingdom's energy sector to restore production to near pre-crisis levels. It has meanwhile moved its import and export hub from the east to the west of the country via land-based transport due to the airport strikes, which has restored cargo levels.
paras.zh: 阿里布拉希姆表示，基础设施投资使沙特能源部门将生产恢复到接近危机前的水平。与此同时，由于机场罢工，它已将其进出口枢纽通过陆路运输从该国东部转移到西部，从而恢复了货运水平。

paras.en: He added that the attacks highlight the importance of diversification to the Saudi economy.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这些袭击凸显了多元化对沙特经济的重要性。

paras.en: Real GDP contracted by 3.8% in the third quarter, according to government figures, with oil activities down 20.4% year-on-year partially offset by a 1.9% rise in non-oil activities. Net foreign direct investment inflows dropped 19.5% year-on-year in the second quarter.
paras.zh: 根据政府数据，第三季度实际 GDP 收缩 3.8%，其中石油活动同比下降 20.4%，但被非石油活动增长 1.9% 部分抵消。第二季度外国直接投资净流入同比下降19.5%。

paras.en: The Saudi Ministry of Finance expects an overall contraction of around 2.1% this year and a rebound of 10.9% next year.
paras.zh: 沙特财政部预计今年整体收缩2.1%左右，明年反弹10.9%。

paras.en: Advisory group Oxford Economics forecasts a more negative outlook. It sees the Saudi economy shrinking 3.4% this year and by 4% in 2027, amid escalating attacks on energy infrastructure even as a new minimum wage and continued Vision 2030 spending are expected to support incomes and domestic demand.
paras.zh: 牛津经济研究院咨询小组预测前景更为负面。尽管新的最低工资和持续的 2030 年愿景支出预计将支持收入和国内需求，但由于能源基础设施遭受的攻击不断升级，沙特经济今年将萎缩 3.4%，2027 年将萎缩 4%。

paras.en: Akanksha Samdani, lead economist at Oxford Economics, said Vision 2030 was entering a new phase focused on returns.
paras.zh: 牛津经济研究院首席经济学家 Akanksha Samdani 表示，2030 年愿景正在进入一个注重回报的新阶段。

paras.en: "The government is managing fiscal pressures and shifting budgetary spending towards essential services and strategic priorities, while PIF is becoming more selective in its capital allocation and seeking greater private-sector participation," Samdani said, adding that some giga projects are being scaled back or delayed, while investment continues in sectors such as manufacturing, logistics, tourism, mining and technology.
paras.zh: 萨姆达尼表示：“政府正在管理财政压力，并将预算支出转向基本服务和战略重点，而公共投资基金在资本配置方面变得更加有选择性，并寻求更多私营部门的参与。”他补充说，一些巨型项目正在缩减或推迟，而制造业、物流、旅游、采矿和技术等领域的投资仍在继续。

paras.en: "Our forecasts already assume that some of the Vision 2030 targets will be achieved later than originally planned. But the overarching goal of economic diversification remains unchanged," Samdani told CNBC by email.
paras.zh: 萨姆达尼通过电子邮件告诉 CNBC：“我们的预测已经假设《2030 年愿景》的部分目标将晚于原计划实现。但经济多元化的总体目标保持不变。”

paras.en: Neil Quilliam, managing director of consultancy Azure Strategy, said investors are assessing whether Houthi attacks demonstrate a persistent vulnerability that could increase the cost and complexity of delivering Vision 2030.
paras.zh: 咨询公司 Azure Strategy 董事总经理尼尔·奎利亚姆 (Neil Quilliam) 表示，投资者正在评估胡塞武装的攻击是否存在持久性漏洞，可能会增加实现 2030 年愿景的成本和复杂性。

paras.en: "They have repeatedly demonstrated an ability to target important economic infrastructure and expose weaknesses in Saudi air defences," he told CNBC, with the attacks challenging the "assumption that Saudi Arabia has insulated itself from regional instability."
paras.zh: 他对 CNBC 表示：“他们一再表现出有能力瞄准重要的经济基础设施，并暴露沙特防空系统的弱点。”这些袭击挑战了“沙特阿拉伯已免受地区不稳定影响的假设”。

paras.en: The economic impact of the strikes will be less about physical damage and more about whether they affect confidence in Saudi Arabia as a destination for tourism, entertainment and sports, a key part of Vision 2030 and a source of foreign capital and expatriate talent, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，罢工对经济的影响将不再是物质损失，而是是否会影响人们对沙特阿拉伯作为旅游、娱乐和体育目的地的信心，沙特阿拉伯是“2030 年愿景”的关键部分，也是外国资本和外籍人才的来源。

articles.title: U.S. military repelled drones at UK airbase this month, FT reports

paras.en: The U.S. military repelled a half dozen drones swarming Britain's RAF Lakenheath base earlier this month, the Financial Times reported on Saturday, saying Iran was suspected of being linked to the incident.
paras.zh: 据英国《金融时报》周六报道，美国军方本月早些时候击退了六架蜂拥而至英国皇家空军拉肯希思基地的无人机，称伊朗疑似与这起事件有关。

paras.en: The newspaper, citing people familiar with the matter, said the U.S. deployed counter-drone technology to repel the unmanned aerial systems but that the drones were not retrieved by British or American personnel.
paras.zh: 该报援引知情人士的话称，美国部署了反无人机技术来击退无人机系统，但英国或美国人员并未收回这些无人机。

paras.en: Asked for comment on the report, a spokesperson for the UK's Ministry of Defence told Reuters in an emailed statement: "Ministry of Defence Police and Suffolk Police worked closely with USAF Security Forces to respond to reports of unauthorised drone activity at RAF Lakenheath on 13 November and the situation was quickly resolved, with RAF Lakenheath returning to normal security and force protection measures."
paras.zh: 当被要求对此报道发表评论时，英国国防部发言人在一份电子邮件声明中告诉路透社：“国防部警察局和萨福克警察局与美国空军安全部队密切合作，对 11 月 13 日英国皇家空军拉肯希思空军基地未经授权的无人机活动的报告做出回应，情况很快得到解决，英国皇家空军莱肯希思空军基地恢复了正常的安全和部队保护措施。”

paras.en: The White House and Pentagon did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 白宫和五角大楼没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: In the incident, U.S. Air Force personnel at the base responded to "suspected unauthorised drone activity", and an Air Force spokesperson said at the time that no personnel, aircraft or infrastructure were affected.
paras.zh: 在这起事件中，该基地的美国空军人员对“涉嫌未经授权的无人机活动”做出了反应，空军发言人当时表示，没有人员、飞机或基础设施受到影响。

paras.en: In a September incident at RAF Fairford, another British base used by the U.S. Air Force, a threat linked to Iran prompted the removal of American B-1 bombers, President Donald Trump said last month.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统上个月表示，9月在美国空军使用的另一个英国基地皇家空军费尔福德发生的一起事件中，与伊朗有关的威胁促使美国 B-1 轰炸机被撤走。

paras.en: Tehran has rejected accusations of involvement in the Fairford incident or other malign activity in Britain, where the authorities have for years accused Iran of being involved in plots and attempted assassinations against dissidents and Israeli and Jewish targets.
paras.zh: 德黑兰否认参与英国费尔福德事件或其他恶意活动的指控，英国当局多年来一直指责伊朗参与针对持不同政见者以及以色列和犹太人目标的阴谋和企图暗杀。

articles.title: Why AI’s proof of the Riemann hypothesis is so bittersweet

paras.en: I have ζ(s), the zeta function at the center of the Riemann hypothesis, tattooed on my leg, so I took last Friday’s news harder than most. That morning I read my colleague Joseph Howlett’s story: Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, said he had proved the hypothesis, with a heavy dose of help from the company’s artificial intelligence model Claude. By Saturday, outside experts had validated the proof.
paras.zh: 我的腿上纹有 δ(s)，即黎曼假设中心的 zeta 函数，所以我比大多数人都更加认真地对待上周五的新闻。那天早上，我读了同事 Joseph Howlett 的故事：Anthropic 的数学家 Levent Alpöge 表示，在公司人工智能模型 Claude 的大力帮助下，他已经证明了这一假设。到周六，外部专家已经验证了这一证据。

paras.en: This is likely the capstone of AI’s yearlong rampage through mathematics. Earlier results dazzled mathematicians and former mathematicians like me, but this was the first one to flip my stomach. Honestly, I felt like I was going to throw up.
paras.zh: 这很可能是人工智能长达一年的数学横冲直撞的顶峰。早期的结果让数学家和像我这样的前数学家眼花缭乱，但这是第一个让我反胃的结果。老实说，我感觉我要吐了。

paras.en: The Riemann hypothesis and I have history. In college I studied it and its connections to the primes and cryptography, and after about 18 months I made the relationship permanent. My tattoo artist admitted he had limited experience with math but said he enjoyed learning more about primes once he had heard my request. Like many math lovers, Alpöge among them, I revere the problem.
paras.zh: 黎曼猜想和我有历史渊源。在大学里，我研究了它及其与素数和密码学的联系，大约 18 个月后，我使这种关系永久化。我的纹身师承认他在数学方面的经验有限，但他说一旦听到我的请求，他就喜欢了解更多关于素数的知识。和许多数学爱好者（其中包括 Alpöge）一样，我热爱这个问题。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Friday should have been cause for celebration. Instead math’s most famous problem was resolved in a way that, so far, no one can figure out. And figuring it out is meant to be the fun part.
paras.zh: 星期五本来应该值得庆祝。相反，数学最著名的问题是以一种迄今为止无人能解的方式解决的。弄清楚它应该是有趣的部分。

paras.en: Much of this problem’s beauty lies in how every aspect of it unfurls until it touches far-flung areas of mathematics. The zeta function starts as a simple sum over the integers, but a mathematical trick rewrites it as a product over the primes. That’s usually the first hint of what lies beneath the surface.
paras.zh: 这个问题的美妙之处很大程度上在于它的各个方面如何展开，直到它触及广泛的数学领域。 zeta 函数一开始是整数的简单求和，但数学技巧将其重写为素数的乘积。这通常是表面之下的第一个暗示。

paras.en: Mathematicians can then extend it across the entire complex plane, the plane containing numbers with real and imaginary parts. There, other formulas tie it to other famous functions, such as the factorial. The hypothesis itself can be generalized to an infinite family of functions, which Alpöge says he proved. Even the problem’s consequences seem limitless because the primes are the building blocks of numbers.
paras.zh: 然后，数学家可以将其扩展到整个复平面，该平面包含具有实部和虚部的数字。在那里，其他公式将其与其他著名的函数联系起来，例如阶乘。这个假设本身可以推广到无限个函数族，阿尔波格说他证明了这一点。甚至这个问题的后果似乎也是无限的，因为素数是数字的组成部分。

paras.en: Understanding the Riemann hypothesis is like sticking your finger into a puddle, expecting to hit bottom quickly, only to realize the pool stretches deeper than you can reach.
paras.zh: 理解黎曼猜想就像把你的手指伸进水坑里，期望很快触底，却发现水坑比你够得着的更深。

paras.en: Honestly, I felt like I was going to throw up.
paras.zh: 老实说，我感觉我要吐了。

paras.en: Yet most of us, myself included, had long assumed the hypothesis was true. The first 10 trillion or so solutions to the function were already known to satisfy the hypothesis, and there was little reason to think the streak would end. Even the Clay Mathematics Institute, which offers a $1-million prize for a resolution, mentions only “a proof that it is true” in a summary.
paras.zh: 然而，我们大多数人，包括我自己，长期以来一直认为这个假设是正确的。已知该函数的前 10 万亿个左右的解可以满足假设，并且没有理由认为这种连续现象会结束。就连克莱数学研究所（Clay Mathematics Institute）为一项决议提供了 100 万美元的奖金，但在摘要中也只提到了“证明其正确性的证据”。

paras.en: The way I always heard it, the real prize would be the techniques used to prove it. Nobody had any idea how. Whoever finally cracked it would have to dredge up something from the depths, and that discovery could lead to whole new ways of thinking about numbers.
paras.zh: 我一直听说，真正的奖品是用来证明这一点的技术。没有人知道怎么做。无论谁最终破解了它，都必须从深处挖出一些东西，而这一发现可能会带来思考数字的全新方式。

paras.en: It’s more than a little ironic, then, that the problem is now solved, and those techniques have yet to surface. Or rather they’re stuck inside millions of lines of code written in the programming language Lean and in an AI-written explanation that Alpöge hasn’t released. (He first said that explanation ran past 250,000 pages and then backpedaled on X, calling the number a joke: “I find big number extremely hilarious.”) Some experts say true human understanding could be months or years away. And who knows what that understanding will be worth next to the models of a couple of years from now?
paras.zh: 那么，问题现在已经解决了，而这些技术还没有浮出水面，这就有点讽刺了。或者更确切地说，它们被困在用 Lean 编程语言编写的数百万行代码中，以及 Alpöge 尚未发布的人工智能编写的解释中。 （他首先说这个解释已经超过了 250,000 页，然后在 X 上反悔了，称这个数字是一个笑话：“我发现大数字非常搞笑。”）一些专家表示，人类真正的理解可能需要几个月或几年的时间。谁知道这种理解对于几年后的模型来说价值几何呢？

paras.en: I used to think the issue at the heart of AI and mathematics was labor, the same concern artists have raised about AI’s use in their own field. My mathematician and computer scientist friends worry most about their jobs: whether there will be any and what the work will look like. Anyone finishing a typical American Ph.D. this year probably started it before ChatGPT existed. They had no way of knowing the job description would one day include interpreting an AI oracle.
paras.zh: 我曾经认为人工智能和数学的核心问题是劳动力，就像艺术家对人工智能在自己领域的使用提出的同样的担忧。我的数学家和计算机科学家朋友最担心的是他们的工作：是否会有工作以及工作会是什么样子。任何完成典型美国博士学位的人都可以。今年可能在 ChatGPT 出现之前就开始了。他们无法知道有一天工作描述会包括解释人工智能预言。

paras.en: I still believe labor is an essential part of the conversation, but Friday showed me what AI’s prowess means for doing math in its purest and most mathemagical sense. And while I am in awe of what we’ve seen so far and excited for what is to come, I do feel a little emptier, still waiting on an answer to the real question: How?
paras.zh: 我仍然相信劳动是对话的重要组成部分，但周五向我展示了人工智能的能力对于最纯粹、最神奇的数学意义上的数学意味着什么。虽然我对迄今为止所看到的感到敬畏，并对即将发生的事情感到兴奋，但我确实感到有点空虚，仍在等待真正问题的答案：如何？

articles.title: In 2022 NASA struck an asteroid. Now we are finally seeing the massive impact up close

paras.en: In 2022 NASA smashed a spacecraft into an asteroid called Dimorphos to see what would happen—and now, some four years later, another space probe is finally revealing the effects of the impact up close.
paras.zh: 2022 年，美国宇航局 (NASA) 将一艘航天器撞向一颗名为 Dimorphos 的小行星，看看会发生什么——大约四年后的现在，另一个太空探测器终于近距离揭示了撞击的影响。

paras.en: On Wednesday the European Space Agency (ESA) released several new images of Dimorphos taken by Hera, a mission that launched in 2024 to study the asteroid in the impact’s aftermath. These observations offer new insights into how, in 2022, the Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) indelibly changed Dimorphos, a moonlet satellite of the larger asteroid Didymos. The impact altered Dimorphos’s orbit around Didymos and the entire binary system’s orbit around the sun, demonstrating, for the first time, that such a strategy could perhaps keep Earth safe from any asteroids found on a collision course with our planet.
paras.zh: 周三，欧洲航天局 (ESA) 发布了几张由 Hera 拍摄的 Dimorphos 的新图像，该任务于 2024 年启动，旨在研究这颗小行星撞击后的情况。这些观测结果为了解 2022 年双小行星重定向测试 (DART) 如何不可磨灭地改变了较大小行星 Didymos 的一颗小卫星 Dimorphos 提供了新的见解。这次撞击改变了迪莫福斯围绕迪迪莫斯的轨道以及整个双星系统围绕太阳的轨道，这首次证明这种策略也许可以保护地球免受任何在与我们的星球相撞过程中发现的小行星的伤害。

paras.en: The ESA images reveal that the DART impact left a massive crater on Dimorphos, which is itself a mere 151 meters in diameter. “The face struck by DART has been flattened into an impact crater the size of a sports stadium, which extends across the asteroid’s entire width,” said Hera principal investigator Patrick Michel in a statement. Until now, it was unclear if the DART mission had left a small crater or if it had reshaped the asteroid entirely, Michel said at a press conference on Wednesday.
paras.zh: ESA 图像显示，DART 撞击在 Dimorphos 上留下了一个巨大的陨石坑，而陨石坑本身的直径仅为 151 米。赫拉首席研究员帕特里克·米歇尔（Patrick Michel）在一份声明中表示：“被 DART 击中的表面已被夷为一个体育场大小的撞击坑，其宽度横跨小行星的整个宽度。”米歇尔在周三的新闻发布会上表示，到目前为止，尚不清楚 DART 任务是否留下了一个小陨石坑，或者是否完全重塑了小行星​​。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “It’s really strange because you have a big crater, and the rest seems not really perturbed, so we are perturbed actually,” Michel said. “Scientists are perturbed,” added Ian Carnelli, Hera mission lead.
paras.zh: 米歇尔说：“这真的很奇怪，因为有一个大陨石坑，而其余部分似乎并没有受到真正的干扰，所以我们实际上受到了干扰。” “科学家们感到不安，”赫拉任务负责人伊恩·卡内利补充道。

paras.en: The images also show that after DART struck Dimorphos, the little asteroid has been “tumbling wildly” in its orbit around Didymos, said Michael Küppers, ESA Hera mission scientist, in the same statement. In fact, Dimorphos appears to be the most chaotically rotating object in the solar system, Michel said at the Wednesday press event.
paras.zh: 欧空局赫拉任务科学家迈克尔·库珀斯在同一份声明中表示，这些图像还显示，在 DART 撞击 Dimorphos 后，这颗小行星一直在围绕 Didymos 的轨道上“疯狂翻滚”。米歇尔在周三的新闻发布会上表示，事实上，双形态似乎是太阳系中旋转最混乱的天体。

paras.en: Hera launched to space in October 2024. Accompanied by two small CubeSats, the mission is designed to assess how DART altered Dimorphos and its structure, as well as its composition and gravity. These data will help refine planetary defense models. The Hera mission has also found hundreds of boulders in the binary system that the team previously did not know about, adding targets for future observation.
paras.zh: Hera 于 2024 年 10 月发射升空。在两颗小型立方体卫星的陪伴下，该任务旨在评估 DART 如何改变 Dimorphos 及其结构、成分和重力。这些数据将有助于完善行星防御模型。赫拉任务还在双星系统中发现了数百块团队之前不知道的巨石，为未来的观测增加了目标。

paras.en: During Wednesday’s press conference, officials discussed how, in Earth’s past, catastrophic asteroid impacts had led to planetary-scale mass extinctions, most famously eradicating the nonavian dinosaurs at the end of the Cretaceous period.
paras.zh: 在周三的新闻发布会上，官员们讨论了在地球过去，灾难性的小行星撞击如何导致全球范围内的大规模灭绝，最著名的是白垩纪末期非鸟类恐龙的灭绝。

paras.en: “We just heard the story that happened 66 million years ago,” Carnelli said. “Clearly, that day dinosaurs had a very bad day, but they didn’t have a space agency. So today we are a better species. We have wonderful space agencies, and we know what to do.”
paras.zh: “我们刚刚听说了 6600 万年前发生的故事，”卡内利说。 “显然，那天恐龙度过了非常糟糕的一天，但他们没有航天机构。所以今天我们是一个更好的物种。我们有很棒的航天机构，我们知道该怎么做。”

paras.en: Editor’s Note (11/25/26): This is a developing story and may be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（11/25/26）：这是一个正在发展的故事，可能会更新。

articles.title: Math Puzzle: A disagreeable drive

paras.en: At ten o’clock one morning Mr. Smith and his wife left their house in Connecticut to drive to the home of Mrs. Smith’s parents in Pennsylvania. They planned to stop once along the way for lunch at Patricia Murphy’s Candlelight Restaurant in Westchester County, New York.
paras.zh: 一天早上十点，史密斯先生和他的妻子离开康涅狄格州的家，开车前往史密斯夫人父母在宾夕法尼亚州的家。他们计划沿途在纽约州韦斯特切斯特县的帕特里夏·墨菲烛光餐厅停下来吃午餐。

paras.en: The prospective visit with his in-laws, combined with business worries, put Mr. Smith in a sullen, uncommunicative mood. It was not until eleven o’clock that Mrs. Smith ventured to ask: “How far have we gone, dear?”
paras.zh: 即将拜访姻亲，再加上生意上的担忧，史密斯先生心情郁闷、沉默寡言。直到十一点钟，史密斯夫人才大胆地问：“亲爱的，我们走了多远？”

paras.en: Mr. Smith glanced at the mileage meter. “Half as far as the distance from here to Patricia Murphy’s,” he snapped. They arrived at the restaurant at noon, enjoyed a leisurely lunch, then continued on their way. Not until five o’clock, when they were 200 miles from the place where Mrs. Smith had asked her first question, did she ask a second one. “How much farther do we have to go, dear?”
paras.zh: 史密斯先生看了一眼里程表。 “只有从这里到帕特里夏·墨菲家的一半距离，”他厉声说道。中午，他们到达餐厅，悠闲地享用了午餐，然后继续赶路。直到五点钟，当他们距离史密斯夫人问第一个问题的地方有200英里时，她才问了第二个问题。 “亲爱的，我们还要走多远？”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “Half as far,” he grunted, “as the distance from here to Patricia Murphy’s.”
paras.zh: “一半远，”他咕哝道，“是从这里到帕特里夏·墨菲家的距离的一半。”

paras.en: They arrived at their destination at seven that evening. Because of traffic conditions, Mr. Smith had driven at widely varying speeds. Nevertheless, it is quite simple to determine (and this is the problem) exactly how far the Smiths traveled from one house to the other.
paras.zh: 当晚七点，他们到达了目的地。由于交通状况的原因，史密斯先生的驾驶速度差别很大。尽管如此，要确定史密斯一家从一栋房子到另一栋房子到底走了多远（这就是问题所在）是相当简单的。

paras.en: To find the mileage covered by the Smiths on their trip from Connecticut to Pennsylvania, the various times of day that are given are irrelevant because Mr. Smith drove at varying speeds. At two points along the way Mrs. Smith asked a question. Mr. Smith’s answers indicate that the distance from the first point to Patricia Murphy’s Candlelight Restaurant is two thirds of the distance from the start of the trip to the restaurant, and the distance from the restaurant to the second point is two thirds of the distance from the restaurant to the end of the trip. It is obvious, therefore, that the distance from point to point (which we are told is 200 miles) is two thirds of the total distance. This makes the total distance 300 miles.
paras.zh: 要查找史密斯夫妇从康涅狄格州到宾夕法尼亚州的行程所行驶的里程，一天中的不同时间是无关紧要的，因为史密斯先生的驾驶速度不同。一路上史密斯夫人有两次问了一个问题。史密斯先生的回答表明，从第一个点到帕特里夏·墨菲的烛光餐厅的距离是从行程开始到餐厅距离的三分之二，从餐厅到第二个点的距离是从餐厅到行程结束的距离的三分之二。因此，很明显，点到点的距离（我们被告知是 200 英里）是总距离的三分之二。这使得总距离为 300 英里。

paras.en: This illustration should make it all clear.
paras.zh: 这张图应该能说明一切。
