articles.title: Math’s holy grail, the Riemann hypothesis, appears solved with AI’s help
articles.author: Kathryn Hulick

paras.en: A long-sought pinnacle of mathematics has apparently been reached. In a feat that will go down in mathematics history, a human working with AI appears to have solved the most famous puzzle in math, proving the Riemann hypothesis. The problem has foiled repeated and valiant attempts at solution for more than a century.
paras.zh: 显然已经达到了长期以来寻求的数学顶峰。人类与人工智能的合作似乎已经解决了最著名的数学难题，证明了黎曼猜想，这是一项将载入数学史册的壮举。一个多世纪以来，人们多次勇敢地尝试解决这个问题，但都失败了。

paras.en: Now, mathematicians are working to understand the proof, posted by Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, on November 20. The Riemann hypothesis, if true, reveals the secrets of prime numbers. In a statement on his website, Alpöge said he’d developed the proof alongside Anthropic’s AI tool Claude.
paras.zh: 现在，数学家们正在努力理解 Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 于 11 月 20 日发布的证明。如果黎曼假设成立，它将揭示素数的秘密。 Alpöge 在其网站上的一份声明中表示，他与 Anthropic 的人工智能工具 Claude 一起开发了证明。

paras.en: By the next day, independent mathematicians had confirmed the result. “We have full confidence that Alpöge’s proof of the Riemann hypothesis is correct, and we congratulate him on this achievement,” read a joint statement from Lean Focused Research Organization and Mathlib Initiative.
paras.zh: 第二天，独立数学家证实了这一结果。 “我们完全相信 Alpöge 对黎曼假设的证明是正确的，我们祝贺他取得这一成就，”精益聚焦研究组织和 Mathlib Initiative 的联合声明中写道。

paras.en: A proof of the Riemann hypothesis is one of the most sought after achievements in mathematics. “As a mathematical landmark, it really doesn’t get bigger than this. I can’t think of a theorem proven not only in my lifetime, maybe in the history of mathematics that is as important as this,” says mathematician Ken Ono of Axiom Math and the University of Virginia in Charlottesville.
paras.zh: 黎曼猜想的证明是数学界最受追捧的成就之一。 “作为一个数学里程碑，它真的没有比这更伟大的了。我想不出一个不仅在我有生之年得到证明的定理，也许在数学史上也如此重要，”Axiom Math 和夏洛茨维尔弗吉尼亚大学的数学家肯·小野 (Ken Ono) 说道。

paras.en: “It’s an historic achievement,” says Bryna Kra, a mathematician at Northwestern University in Evanston, Ill.
paras.zh: “这是一项历史性的成就，”伊利诺伊州埃文斯顿西北大学的数学家布赖娜·克拉 (Bryna Kra) 说。

paras.en: Importantly, this was not the work of AI alone, Kra says. First of all, Claude had been trained on the work of thousands of human mathematicians, plus Alpöge was an experienced mathematician himself. He did not just ask for the proof then “push a button and wait,” Kra says.
paras.zh: 克拉说，重要的是，这不仅仅是人工智能的工作。首先，克劳德接受过数千名人类数学家工作的培训，而且阿尔波格本人也是一位经验丰富的数学家。克拉说，他不只是要求提供证据，然后“按下按钮然后等待”。

paras.en: Over six weeks, he worked back and forth with Claude. As an AI agent, Claude can use outside tools to perform tasks. The precise version of Claude that Alpöge used has not been disclosed, but the AI checked its work using Lean, software that converts mathematical arguments into code in order to confirm that a chain of logic holds up. It also had access to Mathlib, a library of known arguments already converted into Lean.
paras.zh: 六个星期以来，他与克劳德一起工作。作为人工智能代理，克劳德可以使用外部工具来执行任务。 Alpöge 使用的 Claude 的精确版本尚未公开，但人工智能使用 Lean 检查其工作，该软件将数学参数转换为代码，以确认逻辑链是否成立。它还可以访问 Mathlib，这是一个已经转换为 Lean 的已知参数库。

paras.en: The result is 250,000 pages of dense, complex math. The world’s mathematicians are still working to translate the proof into a form people can understand. “What’s amazing about this proof is that it involves so many different areas of mathematics,” Ono says. “And I don’t know how a single human being could hold all of the ideas in their mind.”
paras.zh: 结果是 250,000 页的密集、复杂的数学。世界上的数学家仍在努力将证明转化为人们可以理解的形式。 “这个证明的惊人之处在于它涉及数学的许多不同领域，”小野说。 “我不知道一个人怎么能把所有的想法都记在脑子里。”

paras.en: The Riemann hypothesis, which dates to 1859, is closely linked with prime numbers. Prime numbers seem to be sprinkled randomly along the number line, but the Riemann hypothesis reveals a hidden order. At play is a mathematical enigma called the Riemann zeta function. The zeros of this function — the values that, when plugged into the function, produce a zero — are closely related to prime numbers. The Riemann hypothesis says that certain zeros — of which there are an infinite number — all sit on a particular line on a graph. If that is true, it would reveal how many primes exist below a given number.
paras.zh: 黎曼猜想可以追溯到 1859 年，它与素数密切相关。素数似乎沿着数轴随机散布，但黎曼假设揭示了隐藏的顺序。起作用的是一个称为黎曼 zeta 函数的数学谜题。该函数的零点（当插入该函数时产生零的值）与素数密切相关。黎曼假设指出，某些零（其中有无限多个）都位于图上的特定线上。如果这是真的，它将揭示给定数字以下存在多少个素数。

paras.en: Because so much of mathematics involves prime numbers, many other mathematical statements rest on the correctness of the hypothesis. The new proof will have wide implications. “It’s an earthquake throughout mathematics,” Ono says.
paras.zh: 由于许多数学涉及素数，因此许多其他数学陈述都依赖于假设的正确性。新的证明将产生广泛的影响。 “这是整个数学界的一场地震，”小野说。

paras.en: Alpöge claims to have solved not only the Riemann hypothesis itself, but a more general form of it, called the generalized Riemann hypothesis, which extends the idea to related functions. Though he guided the AI, Alpöge wrote that “what I saw during the course of progress so amazed me that I believe it is one dawn across science of something far greater … Claude far outpaced me near the finish line.”
paras.zh: Alpöge 声称不仅解决了黎曼假设本身，而且还解决了它的更一般形式，称为广义黎曼假设，它将这一想法扩展到相关函数。尽管阿尔波格是人工智能的指导者，但他写道，“我在进展过程中所看到的一切让我感到非常惊讶，我相信这是科学界的一个黎明，它的意义要大得多……克劳德在终点线附近远远超过了我。”

paras.en: AI has been steadily felling major problems of mathematics, and this is the biggest one yet. But according to cognitive scientist Gary Marcus of New York University, AI’s genius at math will not carry over to more open-ended types of problems in biology, business or robotics. “In short, it’s not at all obvious that whatever Alpöge did has the generality many people are hoping for,” he wrote in a Substack post.
paras.zh: 人工智能一直在稳步解决数学的重大问题，这是迄今为止最大的一个。但根据纽约大学认知科学家加里·马库斯的说法，人工智能在数学方面的天赋不会延续到生物学、商业或机器人技术等更开放式的问题类型上。 “简而言之，无论 Alpöge 所做的事情是否具有许多人所希望的普遍性，这一点并不明显，”他在 Substack 帖子中写道。

paras.en: And some mathematicians have pushed back against the dominance of AI, disputing the utility of proofs created with the technology. The Association for Human Mathematics wrote in a November 20 statement on their website that no human being can claim to be responsible for the Riemann hypothesis proof, and that no mathematician can “confirm with full certainty that the proof is correct.”
paras.zh: 一些数学家反对人工智能的主导地位，质疑该技术创建的证明的效用。人类数学协会在其网站上11月20日的一份声明中写道，没有人可以声称自己对黎曼假设的证明负责，也没有数学家可以“完全确定地证实证明是正确的”。

paras.en: Kra has been critical of achievements where AI agents worked largely on their own, independent of human intervention. The recent solution, by OpenAI, to a puzzle about the Navier-Stokes equations that describe fluids came about that way. But Alpöge’s approach was different, Kra says. “There is someone to stand behind [the work],” she says. She just hopes that people don’t see this as an end to math. “I think that this is a beginning, this is opening up more questions than it answers. … I think we have to use our imagination and find what’s the next frontier.”
paras.zh: 克拉一直对人工智能代理在很大程度上独立于人类干预而独立工作的成就持批评态度。 OpenAI 最近提出的关于描述流体的纳维-斯托克斯方程难题的解决方案就是通过这种方式实现的。但克拉说，阿尔波格的方法有所不同。 “[工作]背后有人支持，”她说。她只是希望人们不要认为这是数学的终结。 “我认为这是一个开始，它提出的问题多于答案。……我认为我们必须发挥我们的想象力，找到下一个前沿领域。”

articles.title: Australia’s legless geckos evolved like snakes did
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: Australia’s limbless geckos look a lot like snakes. It turns out they’ve evolved like snakes too.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚的无肢壁虎看起来很像蛇。事实证明它们也像蛇一样进化。

paras.en: Snakes are technically a highly modified group of legless lizards. Dozens of other lizard lineages have independently lost their legs, too. But the legless pygopod geckos aren’t quite like their slithering nonsnake kin. Pygopods have dietary pickiness and physical diversity patterns that are more reminiscent of those found in snakes than in other legless lizards, researchers report in a preprint posted at bioRxiv.org on October 23.
paras.zh: 从技术上讲，蛇是一种经过高度改造的无腿蜥蜴。其他数十个蜥蜴谱系也独立地失去了腿。但无腿尾足类壁虎与它们滑行的非蛇类亲戚不太一样。研究人员在 10 月 23 日发布在 bioRxiv.org 上的预印本中报告称，尾足类动物的饮食挑剔和身体多样性模式比其他无腿蜥蜴更容易让人想起蛇。

paras.en: The 50 recognized species of pygopod geckos are found throughout Australia and New Guinea. Pygopods range from a meter long to the size of half a cooked spaghetti noodle. They have odd tails, which in some species can be fantastically long, exceeding 400 percent of their less-than-1-centimeter-long bodies. Some use their tails like a spring to leap.
paras.zh: 50 种公认的尾足壁虎遍布澳大利亚和新几内亚。尾足类动物的长度从一米到半条煮熟的意大利面条大小。它们有奇怪的尾巴，在某些物种中尾巴可以长得惊人，超过它们不到 1 厘米长的身体的 400%。有些用尾巴像弹簧一样跳跃。

paras.en: “They create a little sine wave and they shoot themselves up in the air, and they can do successive jumps,” says Ian Brennan, an evolutionary biologist at the Queensland Museum Kurilpa in Brisbane, Australia.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚布里斯班库里尔帕昆士兰博物馆的进化生物学家伊恩·布伦南 (Ian Brennan) 说：“它们会产生一点正弦波，然后将自己射向空中，并且可以连续跳跃。”

paras.en: But not much else is known about them, Brennan says.
paras.zh: 但布伦南说，人们对它们知之甚少。

paras.en: “They’re real oddballs,” he says, noting that geckos are typically thought of as skilled climbers on walls or glass surfaces. “[Pygopods are] a group that’s gone the exact opposite direction.”
paras.zh: “它们真的很奇怪，”他说，并指出壁虎通常被认为是墙壁或玻璃表面上的熟练攀爬者。 “[Pygopods]是一个走向完全相反方向的群体。”

paras.en: As part of a large project tackling the genetics of Australia’s lizards and snakes, Brennan and his colleagues gathered data on pygopods’ genes, diet and physical features. They analyzed DNA from all 50 species of pygopod and generated an evolutionary tree. The team also put together data from the literature on the ratio of their body and tail lengths and compared this with a dataset of similar information on over 3,100 lizard and snake species.
paras.zh: 作为解决澳大利亚蜥蜴和蛇遗传学的大型项目的一部分，布伦南和他的同事收集了有关尾足动物基因、饮食和身体特征的数据。他们分析了所有 50 种尾足动物的 DNA，并生成了进化树。研究小组还汇总了文献中关于它们身体和尾巴长度比例的数据，并将其与超过 3,100 种蜥蜴和蛇物种的类似信息数据集进行了比较。

paras.en: As they evolved, snakes got longer by lengthening their bodies. Limbed lizards tend to get longer by lengthening their tails. The team found that pygopods have done both, an unusual strategy among legless lizards. This dual strategy resulted in some unexpected physical diversity in tail and body ratio.
paras.zh: 随着进化，蛇通过拉长身体而变得更长。有肢蜥蜴往往会通过加长尾巴来变得更长。研究小组发现尾足类动物两者都做到了，这在无腿蜥蜴中是一种不寻常的策略。这种双重策略导致了尾巴和身体比例的一些意想不到的身体多样性。

paras.en: Next, the team tackled diet, comparing between 1,738 lizard and snake species. Snakes as a group have a broad diet with lots of specialization, which might be partly why they’ve been so successful at diversifying into so many ecological roles in so many habitats, Brennan says. There are pythons that eat only large mammals and sea snakes that eat only fish eggs, for instance.
paras.zh: 接下来，研究小组解决了饮食问题，对 1,738 种蜥蜴和蛇进行了比较。布伦南说，蛇作为一个群体，有着广泛的饮食和很多专业化，这可能是它们在如此多的栖息地中如此成功地多样化、扮演如此多的生态角色的部分原因。例如，有只吃大型哺乳动物的蟒蛇和只吃鱼卵的海蛇。

paras.en: This pattern is rare in lizards. Most geckos eat insects such as beetles and cockroaches, Brennan says. This is especially true of the legless groups, which mostly gobble down whatever insects they happen to slither past.
paras.zh: 这种图案在蜥蜴中很少见。布伦南说，大多数壁虎以甲虫和蟑螂等昆虫为食。对于无腿群体来说尤其如此，它们大多会吃掉它们滑过的任何昆虫。

paras.en: But the team found that the wide variety in what pygopods as a group will eat is exceeded among reptiles only by monitor lizards and colubrid snakes, a hyperdiverse group of over 2,000 snake species. Within that broad dietary range, particular pygopods flirt with snakelike pickiness. Some pygopods chiefly hunt spiders and scorpions. Another group targets ants and termites. One predatory pygopod — the Lialis genus — gulps down other lizards snake-style.
paras.zh: 但研究小组发现，在爬行动物中，尾足类动物的食性种类繁多，仅次于巨蜥和游蛇，这是一个由 2000 多种蛇组成的高度多样化的类群。在如此广泛的饮食范围内，某些尾足类动物有着像蛇一样的挑剔。一些尾足类动物主要捕猎蜘蛛和蝎子。另一组的目标是蚂蚁和白蚁。一种掠食性尾足动物——蜥蜴属——会像蛇一样吞下其他蜥蜴。

paras.en: Pygopods’ evolutionary history may provide hints about how this heightened diversity developed. The team’s findings suggest they split off from other geckos in Australia 50 million years ago — much more recently than when the first snakes evolved around 160 million years ago, but before any modern snake groups reached Australia. Brennan thinks pygopods filled the roles of small snakes on the continent for millions of years in isolation.
paras.zh: 尾足类动物的进化史可能提供了关于这种高度多样性如何发展的线索。研究小组的研究结果表明，它们在 5000 万年前就从澳大利亚的其他壁虎中分离出来——比大约 1.6 亿年前第一批蛇进化时要晚得多，但在任何现代蛇类到达澳大利亚之前。布伦南认为，尾足类动物在数百万年来与世隔绝的情况下，在这片大陆上扮演着小蛇的角色。

paras.en: “Pygopods were probably on a trajectory to do something spectacular, like snakes,” says Brennan. “But then all of these [snake] groups showed up in Australia and filled into those niches.”
paras.zh: 布伦南说：“尾足类动物可能会做出一些惊人的事情，比如蛇。” “但随后所有这些[蛇]群体都出现在澳大利亚并填补了这些空白。”

paras.en: Sonal Singhal — an evolutionary biologist at California State University, Dominguez Hills in Carson — would like to see this study’s data combined with data on pygopods’ skull shape, their habitat use and how their bodies move.
paras.zh: 索纳尔·辛哈尔 (Sonal Singhal) 是加州州立大学卡森分校多明格斯山分校的进化生物学家，他希望看到这项研究的数据与尾足类动物的头骨形状、栖息地利用以及身体移动方式的数据相结合。

paras.en: “For example, Lialis can swallow prey whole because their jaws are so flexible and kinetic and their teeth hinge back and forth, allowing them to trap prey.”
paras.zh: “例如，利亚利斯可以吞下整个猎物，因为它们的下巴非常灵活和动能，而且它们的牙齿前后铰接，使它们能够捕获猎物。”

paras.en: For Brennan, a lesson from the findings is that lacking limbs need not be an evolutionary constraint. Both snakes and pygopods “have diversified to do really interesting things, either due to or in spite of being limbless,” he says.
paras.zh: 对于布伦南来说，研究结果的一个教训是，缺乏四肢不一定是进化的限制。他说，蛇和尾足类动物“无论是由于无肢还是尽管无肢，都已经多样化，可以做真正有趣的事情”。

articles.title: A cosmically close supernova may spill the stellar explosion’s secrets
articles.author: Meghan Bartels

paras.en: When astronomers first spotted the supernova now designated SN 2026ahvu, it was just one of the dozens detected every day. But scientists soon realized this one was something very special, and they’ve been hustling to study it ever since.
paras.zh: 当天文学家第一次发现这颗超新星（现在被命名为 SN 2026ahvu）时，它只是每天检测到的数十颗超新星之一。但科学家们很快意识到这是一种非常特别的东西，从那时起他们就一直在努力研究它。

paras.en: “I think almost everyone in the world is trying to trigger a telescope and look at this,” says astrophysicist Sumit Sarbadhicary of Johns Hopkins University.
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学的天体物理学家苏米特·萨巴迪卡里 (Sumit Sarbadhicary) 表示：“我认为世界上几乎每个人都在尝试启动望远镜来观察这一现象。”

paras.en: Soon after scientists spotted the explosion on November 2, they determined it hadn’t yet peaked in brightness, giving scientists an early glimpse at the event. Even more thrilling, within a day of the explosion’s discovery, astronomers had classified it as a type Ia supernova. These particular outbursts are rare, but they’re astronomical superstars: Scientists use their trademark explosion pattern as a “standard candle” to measure distance into the universe — most notably to discover that the universe’s expansion is accelerating. And to round out a trifecta of reasons to be excited, these blasts rarely occur so close to Earth.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日，科学家们发现爆炸后不久，他们确定爆炸的亮度尚未达到峰值，这让科学家们得以初步了解这一事件。更令人兴奋的是，在发现爆炸的一天之内，天文学家就将其归类为 Ia 型超新星。这些特殊的爆发很罕见，但它们是天文学上的超级巨星：科学家们使用它们标志性的爆炸模式作为“标准蜡烛”来测量宇宙的距离——最值得注意的是发现宇宙的膨胀正在加速。更令人兴奋的是，这些爆炸很少发生在距离地球如此近的地方。

paras.en: Astronomers know type 1a supernovas occur upon the reignition and resulting self-destruction of a white dwarf star, the small cool remnants of a star like the sun that’s too small to become a superdense neutron star or black hole at its demise. Scientists also know that powering back on requires reaching about 1.44 times the mass of the sun, which can occur only if something is giving the white dwarf extra mass.
paras.zh: 天文学家知道，1a 型超新星是在白矮星重新点燃并导致自毁时发生的，白矮星是像太阳这样的恒星的小型冷残余物，它太小而无法在死亡时成为超致密中子星或黑洞。科学家还知道，重新启动需要达到太阳质量的 1.44 倍，而只有在某些东西给予白矮星额外的质量时才会发生这种情况。

paras.en: But scientists aren’t sure what that something is — whether these supernovas are triggered by a second white dwarf or some sort of star that’s still burning. Usually, these explosions occur so far away that astronomers can’t get a good look at where they come from. But SN 2026ahvu is perhaps 50 million light-years or less away from Earth.
paras.zh: 但科学家们不确定那是什么东西——这些超新星是否是由第二颗白矮星或某种仍在燃烧的恒星引发的。通常，这些爆炸发生的距离很远，天文学家无法仔细观察它们的来源。但 SN 2026ahvu 距离地球可能 5000 万光年或更短。

paras.en: “They happen so rarely at this distance that it could hopefully help us figure out why this white dwarf exploded in the first place,” says astronomer Yvette Cendes of the University of Oregon in Eugene, who has been arranging for radio telescopes to observe the outburst.
paras.zh: 俄勒冈大学尤金分校的天文学家伊维特·森德斯（Yvette Cendes）表示：“在这么远的距离上，这种情况很少发生，因此它有望帮助我们弄清楚这颗白矮星爆炸的原因。”她一直在安排射电望远镜来观察这次爆发。

paras.en: Sarbadhicary and colleagues have already submitted preliminary findings November 6 at arXiv.org suggesting that the former white dwarf was less than 100 million years old. That’s remarkably young compared with other supernovas of this type, and may help scientists finetune their understanding of these outbursts.
paras.zh: Sarbadhicary 及其同事已于 11 月 6 日在 arXiv.org 上提交了初步调查结果，表明这颗前白矮星的年龄还不到 1 亿年。与其他此类超新星相比，它非常年轻，可能有助于科学家微调他们对这些爆发的理解。

paras.en: “These explosions have been enduring mysteries for us for decades, and whenever something happens this close, it’s just really exciting,” Sarbadhicary says.
paras.zh: 萨巴迪卡里说：“几十年来，这些爆炸对我们来说一直是个谜，每当如此接近的事情发生时，都会非常令人兴奋。”

articles.title: Physicist Finds a Mathematical Way to Make Wormholes Safe For Human Travel
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: It could take a mere six days to cruise through a wormhole, without having to fire the starship thrusters even once.
paras.zh: 巡航穿过虫洞可能只需要六天的时间，甚至不需要发射一次星舰推进器。

paras.en: That's the scenario described by physicist Mauricio Cataldo of the University of Bío-Bío in Chile, who has now painstakingly calculated the mathematical conditions for a human to safely travel through one of these hypothetical structures and emerge from the other side.
paras.zh: 这就是智利比奥比奥大学的物理学家毛里西奥·卡塔尔多（Mauricio Cataldo）描述的场景，他现在精心计算了人类安全穿过这些假设结构之一并从另一侧出来的数学条件。

paras.en: Don't go making vacation plans just yet, though; there's a rather significant catch. It would require simply enormous quantities of a form of matter that we don't even know exists – let alone how to produce.
paras.zh: 不过，现在先不要制定假期计划；有一个相当重要的问题。它只需要大量的某种我们甚至不知道其存在的物质——更不用说如何生产了。

paras.en: So what, you may be wondering, is the point?
paras.zh: 那么，您可能想知道，重点是什么？

paras.en: Well, Cataldo has spent years investigating wormholes – and his new work, he says, demonstrates that we've been exploring their possibilities through too narrow a mathematical lens.
paras.zh: 卡特多花了数年时间研究虫洞，他说，他的新工作表明我们一直在通过过于狭窄的数学视角探索虫洞的可能性。

paras.en: "Einstein's field equations," he writes, "admit Casimir-like wormhole solutions at scales far beyond the Planck length."
paras.zh: “爱因斯坦的场方程，”他写道，“承认卡西米尔式虫洞解的尺度远远超出了普朗克长度。”

paras.en: Wormholes occupy the fascinating space between science fiction and scientific reality. These hypothetical shortcuts through spacetime form the basis of many a space opera's travel system – but the real-world physics is famously far less forgiving.
paras.zh: 虫洞占据了科幻小说与科学现实之间的迷人空间。这些假设的时空捷径构成了许多太空歌剧旅行系统的基础——但众所周知，现实世界的物理学远没有那么宽容。

paras.en: According to the mathematics of Einstein's general relativity, wormholes are possible; keeping one open long enough for anything to pass through it, however, is where trouble appears.
paras.zh: 根据爱因斯坦广义相对论的数学原理，虫洞是可能存在的。然而，如果保持一个足够长的开放时间，让任何东西都能通过它，就会出现麻烦。

paras.en: One way to accomplish this, at least mathematically, is to use what's known as exotic matter to wedge the throat of the wormhole open, like a stick in an alligator's maw. That's matter that has properties quite unlike those of the ordinary matter that makes up stars, planets, and people.
paras.zh: 至少在数学上实现这一目标的一种方法是使用所谓的奇异物质来打开虫洞的喉咙，就像鳄鱼嘴里的一根棍子一样。这种物质的性质与构成恒星、行星和人类的普通物质完全不同。

paras.en: One such exotic property is negative energy density – and a rather intriguing phenomenon in quantum mechanics gives us a tantalizing glimpse of how such a thing might be achieved.
paras.zh: 其中一个奇特的特性就是负能量密度——量子力学中一个相当有趣的现象让我们对如何实现这样的事情有了一个诱人的了解。

paras.en: Even the emptiest space in the Universe is not truly empty, but fizzing with tiny quantum fluctuations.
paras.zh: 即使宇宙中最空的空间也不是真正空的，而是充满了微小的量子涨落。

paras.en: If you place two conducting plates extremely close together in a vacuum, you restrict the wavelengths of the fluctuations that can occur between them. This changes the vacuum energy between the plates, drawing them towards each other in what's known as the Casimir effect.
paras.zh: 如果将两个导电板在真空中非常靠近地放置在一起，就会限制它们之间可能发生的波动的波长。这改变了板块之间的真空能量，将它们吸引到彼此，这就是所谓的卡西米尔效应。

paras.en: The density of energy between those plates is negative relative to that of the undisturbed vacuum – and that's the part that's relevant to the physics of wormholes.
paras.zh: 这些板块之间的能量密度相对于未受干扰的真空的能量密度是负的——这就是与虫洞物理学相关的部分。

paras.en: In 2019, physicist Remo Garattini of the University of Bergamo in Italy used the mathematics of the Casimir effect to describe a traversable wormhole.
paras.zh: 2019年，意大利贝加莫大学的物理学家雷莫·加拉蒂尼（Remo Garattini）利用卡西米尔效应的数学原理描述了可穿越的虫洞。

paras.en: It was groundbreaking stuff, but it had a significant limitation – the radius of the throat of the wormhole was just a smidge over a Planck length. That's 10-35 meters – not even a proton would be able to squeeze through.
paras.zh: 这是开创性的东西，但它有一个很大的局限性——虫洞喉部的半径仅比普朗克长度略多一点。那是 10-35 米——即使是质子也无法挤过去。

paras.en: And this is where Cataldo picked up the chalk. He realized that the size restriction was not an inherent property of the wormhole – and that he may be able to jimmy it open wider.
paras.zh: 这就是卡塔尔多拿起粉笔的地方。他意识到尺寸限制并不是虫洞的固有属性，而且他也许能够将其打开得更大。

paras.en: The limitation came from the specific energy scale of the Casimir effect. So, rather than tying his wormhole to this known physical phenomenon, Cataldo explored what would happen if he allowed the magnitude of the energy density to vary freely, while retaining some of the mathematical properties of Casimir energy.
paras.zh: 限制来自卡西米尔效应的特定能量尺度。因此，卡塔尔多没有将他的虫洞与这种已知的物理现象联系起来，而是探索了如果允许能量密度的大小自由变化，同时保留卡西米尔能量的一些数学特性，会发生什么。

paras.en: That distinction is subtle, but key. Cataldo wasn't modeling wormholes sustained by the Casimir effect, but wormholes sustained by hypothetical matter that behaves in mathematically similar ways.
paras.zh: 这种区别很微妙，但却很关键。卡塔尔多并没有模拟卡西米尔效应所维持的虫洞，而是模拟了由数学上类似的行为方式的假设物质维持的虫洞。

paras.en: He calls them Casimir-like wormholes – and, in his calculations, there is no upper limit on how large they can be.
paras.zh: 他将它们称为卡西米尔状虫洞，并且在他的计算中，它们的大小没有上限。

paras.en: This gave him the mathematical freedom to investigate another intriguing question: Just how large would a wormhole need to be for a human to travel through it in relative comfort?
paras.zh: 这给了他数学上的自由来研究另一个有趣的问题：虫洞需要多大才能让人类相对舒适地穿过它？

paras.en: It's not a simple question with an answer defined by the size of the human; there are several facets. One is the acceleration the traveler would experience, which could create deadly G-forces.
paras.zh: 这不是一个简单的问题，其答案取决于人类的体型；有几个方面。一是旅行者将经历的加速度，这可能会产生致命的重力。

paras.en: Another is the difference in the strength of gravity acting on different parts of their body – what's known as a tidal force.
paras.zh: 另一个是作用在身体不同部位的重力强度的差异，即所谓的潮汐力。

paras.en: For example, if the gravitational pull on your feet is significantly stronger than that on your head, you're going to have a bad time. That way lies spaghettification.
paras.zh: 例如，如果你脚上的引力明显强于你头上的引力，你就会过得很糟糕。这就是意大利面条化。

paras.en: To circumvent the first problem, Cataldo devised a scenario in which the traveler would simply let themselves to fall through the wormhole under its gravity.
paras.zh: 为了解决第一个问题，卡塔尔多设计了一个场景，旅行者可以在虫洞的重力作用下让自己掉进虫洞。

paras.en: Much like an astronaut in orbit around Earth, a traveler in free fall would feel weightless, even as they accelerated to tremendous speeds.
paras.zh: 就像绕地球轨道运行的宇航员一样，自由落体的旅行者即使加速到极快的速度，也会感到失重。

paras.en: The tidal forces, however, would still be a problem – and this is where the size of the wormhole becomes important.
paras.zh: 然而，潮汐力仍然是一个问题——这就是虫洞大小变得重要的地方。

paras.en: The gravitational environment of Cataldo's wormhole is dramatic, with strong tidal forces acting both along and perpendicular to the direction of travel.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔多虫洞的重力环境非常引人注目，沿着和垂直于行进方向都有强大的潮汐力。

paras.en: However, if you increase the size of the wormhole, the curvature of its spacetime becomes gentler, relaxing those steep gravitational gradients so that the gravitational pull on the traveler's head would not be fatally different from that on their feet.
paras.zh: 然而，如果增加虫洞的大小，它的时空曲率就会变得更平缓，从而缓和那些陡峭的引力梯度，这样旅行者头部的引力就不会与脚部的引力有致命的不同。

paras.en: Cataldo calculated that a wormhole with a throat radius of around 100,000 kilometers (62,000 miles) – making its opening wider than Jupiter – would keep the tidal accelerations experienced by a freely falling human below 1 g, the gravitational acceleration at Earth's surface.
paras.zh: Cataldo 计算出，一个喉部半径约为 100,000 公里（62,000 英里）的虫洞（其开口比木星还宽）将使自由落体的人类所经历的潮汐加速度低于 1 g（地球表面的重力加速度）。

paras.en: Released from rest at a space station on one side of the wormhole, a human traveler would accelerate under the influence of gravity alone, reaching 66 percent of the speed of light as they crossed the throat.
paras.zh: 人类旅行者在虫洞一侧的空间站中从静止状态中释放出来，仅在重力的影响下就会加速，在穿过喉咙时达到光速的 66%。

paras.en: Related: Quantum Gravity Could Blur The Boundary Between Cause And Effect
paras.zh: 相关：量子引力可能会模糊因果之间的界限

paras.en: On the other side, the wormhole's gravitational pull would gradually slow them down, bringing them to a gentle stop at a second space station.
paras.zh: 另一方面，虫洞的引力会逐渐减慢它们的速度，使它们在第二个空间站轻轻停下来。

paras.en: The entire journey would take just 6.1 days.
paras.zh: 整个旅程仅需6.1天。

paras.en: "Gravity thus accelerates the traveler on the way in and decelerates it on the way out, and no rocket acceleration is required at any stage," Cataldo writes.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔多写道：“因此，重力使旅行者在进入时加速，在离开时减速，并且在任何阶段都不需要火箭加速。”

paras.en: But then there's the small matter of… well, the exotic matter.
paras.zh: 但还有一个小问题……嗯，奇异的事情。

paras.en: The good news is that, unlike some other models that require an infinite amount of exotic matter, the amount required for Cataldo's model is finite.
paras.zh: 好消息是，与其他需要无限量奇异物质的模型不同，卡塔尔多的模型所需的量是有限的。

paras.en: The bad news is that there's a lot of room under "finite".
paras.zh: 坏消息是“有限”之下还有很大的空间。

paras.en: Although increasing the size of the wormhole lowers the required density of the exotic matter, it increases the total quantity needed to sustain the structure.
paras.zh: 尽管增加虫洞的尺寸会降低所需的外来物质密度，但它会增加维持该结构所需的总量。

paras.en: For a wormhole large enough for a human to safely traverse, that requirement would be equivalent to the mass of around 45,000 Suns.
paras.zh: 对于一个足以供人类安全穿越的虫洞来说，这一要求相当于大约 45,000 个太阳的质量。

paras.en: And nothing in our current understanding of physics tells us how to produce negative energy densities anywhere near those required to sustain such a structure.
paras.zh: 我们目前对物理学的理解中没有任何内容告诉我们如何产生接近维持这种结构所需的负能量密度。

paras.en: Related: A 367-Year-Old Physics Problem Just Got a Surprising Quantum Twist
paras.zh: 相关：一个 367 年历史的物理问题刚刚发生了令人惊讶的量子扭曲

paras.en: Cataldo also did not investigate whether such a structure would even be stable. For all we know, you could get halfway through and have the danged thing collapse on you.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔多也没有调查这样的结构是否稳定。据我们所知，你可能会走到一半，然后那个危险的东西倒在你身上。

paras.en: Still, the work has done what it set out to do. As Cataldo notes, "The solutions obtained here therefore establish what the field equations permit, not what is physically realizable."
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这项工作还是完成了预定的任务。正如 Cataldo 指出的，“因此，这里获得的解建立了场方程允许的范围，而不是物理上可实现的范围。”

paras.en: And that opens up a much bigger mathematical playground for exploring the possibilities of wormholes.
paras.zh: 这为探索虫洞的可能性开辟了一个更大的数学游乐场。

paras.en: "The physical realizability of macroscopic Casimir-like wormholes remains an open question, intimately connected to the broader problem of exotic matter sources in general relativity," he writes.
paras.zh: “宏观卡西米尔虫洞的物理可实现性仍然是一个悬而未决的问题，与广义相对论中奇异物质来源的更广泛问题密切相关，”他写道。

paras.en: "Nevertheless, the existence of these solutions within the classical theory suggests that the search for traversable wormholes need not be confined to Planckian scales, opening intriguing possibilities for future theoretical and observational investigations."
paras.zh: “尽管如此，经典理论中这些解决方案的存在表明，对可穿越虫洞的搜索不必局限于普朗克尺度，这为未来的理论和观测研究开辟了有趣的可能性。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Classical and Quantum Gravity.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《经典与量子引力》杂志上。

articles.title: Men Can Lose Their Y Chromosome With Age, And We May Finally Know The Cost
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: In the next 5 million years or so, some geneticists think the sex-determining chromosome will vanish completely from our species.
paras.zh: 在接下来的五百万年左右的时间里，一些遗传学家认为决定性别的染色体将从我们的物种中完全消失。

paras.en: In the meantime, we have a bigger concern at hand.
paras.zh: 与此同时，我们手头还有一个更大的问题。

paras.en: As some men age, they are losing the Y chromosome in their blood, brain, or immune cells, and that could have serious health effects.
paras.zh: 随着一些男性年龄的增长，他们的血液、大脑或免疫细胞中的 Y 染色体正在丢失，这可能会对健康产生严重影响。

paras.en: A loss of the Y chromosome has surprising connections to cancer, kidney disease, heart disease, and Alzheimer's.
paras.zh: Y 染色体缺失与癌症、肾病、心脏病和阿尔茨海默氏症有着惊人的联系。

paras.en: For decades, researchers have noticed that as some men grow older, certain cells in their bodies begin to lose their Y chromosome.
paras.zh: 几十年来，研究人员注意到，随着一些男性年龄的增长，他们体内的某些细胞开始失去 Y 染色体。

paras.en: Among 70-year-old men, roughly 40 percent show loss of Y in their blood cells, and among 93-year-olds, that number rises to 57 percent.
paras.zh: 在 70 岁的男性中，大约 40% 的人血细胞中出现 Y 缺失，而在 93 岁的男性中，这一数字上升至 57%。

paras.en: Once, this loss of Y was considered a 'benign' marker of aging.
paras.zh: 曾经，这种 Y 的缺失被认为是衰老的“良性”标志。

paras.en: But recently, emerging genetic evidence suggests that a lack of the Y chromosome in some cells may be actively contributing to death and disease.
paras.zh: 但最近，新出现的遗传证据表明，某些细胞中 Y 染色体的缺乏可能会导致死亡和疾病。

paras.en: The Y chromosome is known to be crucial for sex determination and sperm function, but historically, it wasn't thought to do much else.
paras.zh: 众所周知，Y 染色体对于性别决定和精子功能至关重要，但从历史上看，人们并不认为它还有其他作用。

paras.en: Although it exists in most cells of the body, the odd little chromosome seems to just sit there, twiddling its thumbs.
paras.zh: 尽管它存在于身体的大多数细胞中，但奇怪的小染色体似乎就坐在那里，摆弄它的拇指。

paras.en: It is a fragile, finicky unit that often leads to mutations during replication.
paras.zh: 它是一个脆弱、挑剔的单位，经常导致复制过程中的突变。

paras.en: Of all 46 chromosomes contained in most of a male human's cells, the Y chromosome is the only one that can be lost without the cell dying.
paras.zh: 大多数男性细胞含有 46 条染色体，其中 Y 染色体是唯一一条可以在细胞不死亡的情况下丢失的染色体。

paras.en: But that doesn't mean it can disappear without issue.
paras.zh: 但这并不意味着它可以毫无问题地消失。

paras.en: In 2022, a study found that when specialized immune cells in the hearts of mice lacked Y chromosomes, it led to cardiovascular dysfunction and death.
paras.zh: 2022年，一项研究发现，当小鼠心脏中的特化免疫细胞缺乏Y染色体时，会导致心血管功能障碍和死亡。

paras.en: Further clinical studies suggest that among elderly men, those who show Y chromosome losses are more likely to die early or develop cancer.
paras.zh: 进一步的临床研究表明，在老年男性中，Y染色体缺失的人更有可能早逝或患癌症。

paras.en: While these losses are rare in younger individuals, they can also be associated with infertility and developmental defects.
paras.zh: 虽然这些损失在年轻人中很少见，但它们也可能与不孕和发育缺陷有关。

paras.en: In 2023, researchers found that up to 40 percent of older men with bladder cancer lack the Y chromosome in their tumors.
paras.zh: 到 2023 年，研究人员发现，高达 40% 的患有膀胱癌的老年男性的肿瘤中缺乏 Y 染色体。

paras.en: Because men are up to five times more likely to develop bladder cancer than women, this led some scientists to suspect that the Y chromosome was playing a role in the disease.
paras.zh: 由于男性患膀胱癌的可能性是女性的五倍，这导致一些科学家怀疑 Y 染色体在这种疾病中发挥了作用。

paras.en: Preliminary evidence supports that idea. In 2025, a study found that immune cells lacking the Y chromosome are less effective at attacking cancerous cells.
paras.zh: 初步证据支持这一想法。 2025 年，一项研究发现，缺乏 Y 染色体的免疫细胞攻击癌细胞的效果较差。

paras.en: That same year, a review concluded that the loss of the Y chromosome is likely to be important in shaping the activity of the male immune system.
paras.zh: 同年，一项综述得出的结论是，Y 染色体的丢失可能对塑造男性免疫系统的活性很重要。

paras.en: Even though the Y chromosome contains roughly 0.9 percent of the total DNA in a male cell, it was only fully sequenced a few years ago.
paras.zh: 尽管 Y 染色体约占男性细胞 DNA 总量的 0.9%，但它直到几年前才被完全测序。

paras.en: Since then, advances in genomic sequencing have ushered in a new era for Y chromosome research.
paras.zh: 从那时起，基因组测序的进步开创了 Y 染色体研究的新时代。

paras.en: Studies are just beginning, but these initial findings suggest that the Y chromosome may be involved in more cellular functions than scientists previously assumed.
paras.zh: 研究才刚刚开始，但这些初步发现表明，Y 染色体可能参与比科学家之前假设的更多的细胞功能。

paras.en: In some ways, that is why evolutionary biologist Jennifer Hughes thinks the Y chromosome is not doomed to vanish from our species.
paras.zh: 在某些方面，这就是为什么进化生物学家詹妮弗·休斯认为 Y 染色体注定不会从我们物种中消失。

paras.en: "The genes that are retained on the Y serve crucial functions across the whole body, so the selective pressure to maintain those genes is too great for them to be lost," Hughes explained to ScienceAlert in 2025.
paras.zh: 休斯在 2025 年向 ScienceAlert 解释道：“Y 上保留的基因在整个身体中发挥着至关重要的作用，因此保留这些基因的选择压力太大，以至于它们无法丢失。”

paras.en: But not everyone is convinced by that logic.
paras.zh: 但并不是所有人都相信这种逻辑。

paras.en: Evolutionary biologist Jenny Graves agrees with Hughes that the genes on Y are important and may be linked to health and disease; however, she argues that important genes like these can always be 'picked up' by other chromosomes.
paras.zh: 进化生物学家 Jenny Graves 同意 Hughes 的观点，即 Y 上的基因很重要，可能与健康和疾病有关。然而，她认为像这样的重要基因总是可以被其他染色体“拾取”。

paras.en: Related: US Experts Issue New Guidelines For Prostate Cancer Screening
paras.zh: 相关：美国专家发布前列腺癌筛查新指南

paras.en: "Yes, there are deeply conserved core genes," Graves told ScienceAlert in 2025.
paras.zh: “是的，存在深度保守的核心基因，”格雷夫斯在 2025 年告诉 ScienceAlert。

paras.en: "But the spiny rat and mole vole had no trouble relocating or replacing them."
paras.zh: “但是刺鼠和鼹鼠可以轻松地重新定位或更换它们。”

paras.en: These mammals no longer have a Y chromosome; another chromosome has taken over the role of sex determination instead.
paras.zh: 这些哺乳动物不再有Y染色体；另一条染色体取代了性别决定的作用。

paras.en: It's a good reminder that genes have no problem 'jumping ship'. The Y chromosome may be sinking, whether we like it or not.
paras.zh: 这是一个很好的提醒，基因没有“跳船”的问题。不管我们喜欢与否，Y染色体可能正在下沉。

paras.en: Today, the human Y retains only 3 percent of its ancestral genes.
paras.zh: 如今，人类 Y 基因仅保留了 3% 的祖先基因。

paras.en: What remains may hold clues not only to the health of the male sex today but also to our species' evolutionary history and our future.
paras.zh: 剩下的东西不仅可以为当今男性的健康提供线索，还可以为我们物种的进化历史和未来提供线索。

articles.title: Astronomers Detect Evidence of Vast Tunnels Beneath The Surface of The Moon
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: The scarred gray face of the Moon is a picture of inscrutable stoicism, but there may be quite a bit more going on below.
paras.zh: 月球伤痕累累的灰色表面是一幅难以理解的坚忍主义图画，但下面可能还有更多的事情发生。

paras.en: Scientists have long suspected that the Moon's volcanic past left it riddled with tunnels, hollowed out by rivers of molten rock eons ago.
paras.zh: 科学家们长期以来一直怀疑月球过去的火山活动使其布满了隧道，这些隧道在亿万年前就被熔岩河流挖空了。

paras.en: Now, subtle variations in the Moon's gravitational pull have yielded evidence of four such tunnels – each potentially more than a kilometer wide, concealed beneath just 100 meters of lunar rock.
paras.zh: 现在，月球引力的微妙变化已经证明存在四个这样的隧道——每个隧道可能超过一公里宽，隐藏在仅 100 米厚的月球岩石之下。

paras.en: Such tunnels – particularly ones that haven't collapsed – are a bit of a scientific Orthrus.
paras.zh: 这样的隧道——尤其是那些没有倒塌的隧道——有点像科学的Orthrus。

paras.en: On one hand, they represent an important window into the Moon's geological history. On the other, they could one day become safe havens for lunar explorers, offering protection from the harsh radiation and temperature extremes to which the Moon is prone.
paras.zh: 一方面，它们是了解月球地质历史的重要窗口。另一方面，它们有一天可能成为月球探险家的安全港，为月球容易遭受的严酷辐射和极端温度提供保护。

paras.en: Lava tubes are not a Moon-only phenomenon. They can be found right here on Earth, forming when the surface of a flowing river of lava cools and hardens, creating an insulating roof beneath which molten rock continues to flow.
paras.zh: 熔岩管并不是月球独有的现象。它们就在地球上，当流动的熔岩河表面冷却并变硬时就形成了，形成了一个隔热的屋顶，熔岩在其下方继续流动。

paras.en: As the eruption subsides and the remaining lava drains away, it can leave in its wake a long, hollow tunnel, capped by a roof of volcanic stone.
paras.zh: 当喷发平息，剩余的熔岩流走时，它会留下一条长长的中空隧道，上面覆盖着火山石的屋顶。

paras.en: On the Moon, these structures could be much more imposing, owing to different formation conditions.
paras.zh: 在月球上，由于形成条件不同，这些结构可能更加雄伟。

paras.en: Weaker gravity, higher rates of lava eruption, and the relative ease with which lunar lava flowed could have allowed the formation of subterranean structures on a scale that dwarfs their terrestrial counterparts.
paras.zh: 较弱的重力、较高的熔岩喷发率以及月球熔岩流动的相对容易，可能导致地下结构的形成，其规模使地面结构相形见绌。

paras.en: The problem lies in finding them. At an average distance of 384,400 kilometers (238,855 miles) from Earth, picking out small details on the craggy surface of the Moon by eye can be tricky enough – let alone working out what lurks beneath.
paras.zh: 问题在于找到他们。距离地球的平均距离为 384,400 公里（238,855 英里），用肉眼辨别月球崎岖表面上的小细节可能已经够棘手的了，更不用说找出潜伏在下面的东西了。

paras.en: There are clues, though. The lunar surface is marked by long, winding channels known as sinuous rilles, some of which may be the remnants of collapsed lava tubes.
paras.zh: 不过，还是有线索的。月球表面有被称为蜿蜒细沟的长而蜿蜒的通道，其中一些可能是塌陷熔岩管的残余物。

paras.en: And dotted across the lunar landscape are deep pits that could be skylights – places where a small section of a lava tube's roof has caved in.
paras.zh: 月球表面上点缀着一些可能是天窗的深坑——熔岩管顶部的一小部分塌陷的地方。

paras.en: There's also more than one way to skin a cat – or try to figure out what's inside the Moon.
paras.zh: 剥猫皮或者尝试弄清楚月球内部有什么的方法也不止一种。

paras.en: A hollow tunnel, you see, contains less mass than an equivalent volume of solid rock. This means that the Moon's gravitational pull should be ever so slightly weaker in the vicinity of a lava tube – a discrepancy that can be detected by spacecraft orbiting overhead.
paras.zh: 你看，空心隧道的质量比同等体积的实心岩石要小。这意味着在熔岩管附近，月球的引力应该稍微弱一些——这种差异可以被在头顶轨道运行的航天器检测到。

paras.en: Between 2011 and 2012, NASA's twin Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory (GRAIL) spacecraft mapped the Moon's gravitational field in unprecedented detail, measuring tiny changes in the distance between them as they flew over regions of differing gravity.
paras.zh: 2011 年至 2012 年间，美国宇航局的双胞胎重力恢复和内部实验室 (GRAIL) 航天器以前所未有的细节绘制了月球引力场图，测量了它们飞越不同重力区域时它们之间距离的微小变化。

paras.en: Using that data, studies in 2017 and 2024 identified several spots where lava tubes could be hiding, with estimated widths of up to 9 kilometers.
paras.zh: 利用这些数据，2017 年和 2024 年的研究确定了几个可能隐藏熔岩管的地点，估计宽度可达 9 公里。

paras.en: It didn't take too long for the kibosh to arrive, though – subsequent studies found that, in all likelihood, many of those tunnels would have been too wide to support the weight of their own roofs.
paras.zh: 不过，没过多久，大屠杀就到来了——随后的研究发现，许多隧道很可能太宽，无法支撑自己屋顶的重量。

paras.en: So, when NASA released a higher-resolution model of the Moon's gravitational field in May 2025, geoscientists Juan Losarcos and Andrew Dombard of the University of Illinois Chicago took another look to see if they could find something a bit more structurally sound.
paras.zh: 因此，当美国宇航局 (NASA) 于 2025 年 5 月发布月球引力场的高分辨率模型时，伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校的地球科学家胡安·洛萨科斯 (Juan Losarcos) 和安德鲁·多姆巴德 (Andrew Dombard) 重新审视，看看他们是否能找到结构更合理的东西。

paras.en: They painstakingly mapped tiny dips in the gravitational field, after accounting for the Moon's surface topography, comparing them with simulations of the gravitational signatures that hollow tunnels of different dimensions would produce.
paras.zh: 在考虑了月球表面地形后，他们煞费苦心地绘制了引力场中的微小倾角，并将其与不同尺寸的中空隧道产生的引力特征的模拟进行比较。

paras.en: Then, they compared these with observations of the lunar surface, looking for geological features that might support the presence of an underground cavity.
paras.zh: 然后，他们将这些与月球表面的观测结果进行比较，寻找可能支持地下洞穴存在的地质特征。

paras.en: Four candidates stood out – one in the vicinity of Vallis Schröteri, the largest sinuous rille on the Moon; one at Rima Mairan; and two near the Wollaston crater.
paras.zh: 有四个候选者脱颖而出，其中一个位于月球上最大的蜿蜒细沟 Vallis Schröteri 附近；另一个位于月球上最大的蜿蜒溪流 Vallis Schröteri 附近；一间在 Rima Mairan；两个位于沃拉斯顿陨石坑附近。

paras.en: In each case, the gravitational signature was consistent with a tunnel less than 2 kilometers wide, buried beneath around 100 meters of rock – dimensions much more in keeping with what we now know about the structural limitations of lunar lava tubes.
paras.zh: 在每种情况下，重力特征都与埋在约 100 米岩石下的宽度不足 2 公里的隧道一致——该尺寸更符合我们现在所了解的月球熔岩管的结构限制。

paras.en: And the geological features associated with all four suggest that they may have formed in a slightly different way from the process described earlier.
paras.zh: 与所有四个相关的地质特征表明，它们的形成方式可能与之前描述的过程略有不同。

paras.en: Rather than forming a roof over a vast, open river of lava, they may have started out as much smaller underground channels, gradually enlarged as the molten rock flowing through them melted and wore away the surrounding material – like a giant Moon worm boring a hole, rather than a Moon caterpillar building a cocoon.
paras.zh: 它们并不是在一条巨大、开放的熔岩河上形成屋顶，而是可能是从更小的地下通道开始的，随着流过它们的熔岩融化并磨损周围的物质而逐渐扩大——就像一条巨大的月球蠕虫在钻一个洞，而不是一条筑茧的月球毛毛虫。

paras.en: However, at this point, all four can only be classified as candidates rather than confirmed detections. Other variations in the density of lunar rock could produce similar gravitational signatures, and the researchers can't directly measure the dimensions of the cavities using gravity data alone.
paras.zh: 然而，此时，所有四个只能被归类为候选者，而不是确认的检测。月球岩石密度的其他变化可能会产生类似的重力特征，研究人员无法仅使用重力数据直接测量空腔的尺寸。

paras.en: Future radar observations and more detailed geological mapping could help establish whether the tunnels really are there.
paras.zh: 未来的雷达观测和更详细的地质测绘可以帮助确定隧道是否真的存在。

paras.en: The researchers also note that their reliance on geological clues on the surface means that entirely intact lava tubes, with no telltale collapses in their roofs, could be particularly difficult to find.
paras.zh: 研究人员还指出，他们对地表地质线索的依赖意味着完全完整的熔岩管（顶部没有明显的塌陷）可能特别难以找到。

paras.en: The results suggest that the Moon may be even better at hiding its crannies and hollows than we thought it was, and that there may be far more of these hidden passages lurking beneath the ground than its surface might suggest.
paras.zh: 结果表明，月球可能比我们想象的更善于隐藏裂缝和空洞，而且潜伏在地下的这些隐藏通道可能比其表面所显示的要多得多。

paras.en: "Such pristine tubes," the researchers write, "could preserve important evidence of lunar volcanic and thermal evolution, even if they are less accessible for exploration."
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“这种原始的管子可以保存月球火山和热演化的重要证据，即使它们不太容易探索。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Icarus.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《伊卡洛斯》杂志上。

articles.title: These bizarre prehistoric mammals may have been misunderstood for 150 years

paras.en: These bizarre prehistoric mammals may have been misunderstood for 150 years
paras.zh: 这些奇异的史前哺乳动物可能被误解了 150 年

paras.en: Giant horned mammals that emerged shortly after the extinction of the dinosaurs may have had far fewer physical differences between males and females than scientists once believed. The discovery challenges a classic example of sexual dimorphism and raises questions about how historical biases have shaped our understanding of extinct animals.
paras.zh: 恐龙灭绝后不久出现的巨角哺乳动物，雄性和雌性之间的身体差异可能比科学家曾经认为的要小得多。这一发现挑战了性别二态性的经典例子，并提出了历史偏见如何影响我们对灭绝动物的理解的问题。

paras.en: For generations, paleontologists have regarded an extinct group of giant mammals known as uintatheres as a textbook example of sexual dimorphism, the physical differences between males and females of the same species.
paras.zh: 几代人以来，古生物学家一直将一种已灭绝的巨型哺乳动物（称为 uintathares）视为性别二态性（同一物种的雄性和雌性之间的身体差异）的教科书例子。

paras.en: Recognizable by their enormous bodies, prominent horns, and oversized canine teeth, uintatheres first appeared approximately 58 million years ago, less than 10 million years after an asteroid wiped out the dinosaurs. These unusual mammals persisted for roughly 20 million years.
paras.zh: 尤恩塔瑟兽的巨大身体、突出的角和超大的犬齿可以识别它们，它们首次出现于大约 5800 万年前，距离小行星消灭恐龙还不到 1000 万年。这些不寻常的哺乳动物生存了大约 2000 万年。

paras.en: However, new research from the University of Kansas published in PLOS One suggests that the physical differences between male and female uintatheres may have been considerably less pronounced than scientists have long assumed.
paras.zh: 然而，堪萨斯大学在《PLOS One》上发表的新研究表明，雄性和雌性尤恩塔雷人之间的身体差异可能远没有科学家长期以来假设的那么明显。

paras.en: "Males have been interpreted as being much larger and possessing far more dramatic cranial features than females," said study author Kevin Mulcahy, doctoral student at the KU Biodiversity Institute & Natural History Museum.
paras.zh: 研究作者、堪萨斯大学生物多样性研究所和自然历史博物馆的博士生凯文·马尔卡希 (Kevin Mulcahy) 表示：“男性被认为比女性体型更大，颅骨特征也更引人注目。”

paras.en: A Broken Fossil Tooth Leads to an Unexpected Discovery
paras.zh: 破碎的牙齿化石带来了意想不到的发现

paras.en: The investigation began when Mulcahy and his doctoral adviser, K. Christopher Beard, senior curator at the institute, attempted to identify a broken upper molar recovered during fieldwork in Montana. The researchers suspected the tooth belonged to a uintathere but needed additional fossil specimens to confirm its identity.
paras.zh: 当马尔卡希和他的博士生导师、该研究所的高级馆长 K.克里斯托弗·比尔德 (K. Christopher Beard) 试图识别蒙大拿州实地考察期间发现的一颗破损的上臼齿时，调查开始了。研究人员怀疑这颗牙齿属于尤因塔那里，但需要额外的化石标本来确认其身份。

paras.en: "We had a research visit at the American Museum of Natural History in New York, where our main goal was just to compare that tooth to teeth from other uintatheres and figure out what type of animal we had," Mulcahy said. "They have this big collection -- entire shelves occupied with these skulls, and each one of them is almost a meter long. These are famous specimens that are in the literature, and I was originally just looking at them to compare their teeth, and I noticed a ton of variation in a way that didn't appear binary."
paras.zh: “我们在纽约的美国自然历史博物馆进行了一次研究访问，我们的主要目标是将这颗牙齿与其他尤因塔动物的牙齿进行比较，并找出我们拥有的动物类型，”马尔卡希说。 “他们有这么大的收藏——整个架子上都摆满了这些头骨，每个头骨都几乎一米长。这些都是文献中著名的标本，我最初只是看它们来比较它们的牙齿，然后我注意到了很多变化，但它们并不显得二元化。”

paras.en: Intrigued by the unexpected range of physical characteristics, Mulcahy began measuring the skulls in the museum's collection.
paras.zh: 马尔卡希对这些意想不到的物理特征很感兴趣，他开始测量博物馆藏品中的头骨。

paras.en: "I just, really hastily, with a ruler, gathered a bunch of measurements of the skulls while we were there," Mulcahy said. "I started playing around with statistics, and there are ways you can look at different measurements to see if they're best fit by a classic unimodal distribution, or if you were to think you're dealing with something that exhibits strong sexual dimorphism, you'd see something with a bimodal distribution -- that there are two means, one for males and one for females."
paras.zh: “当我们在那里时，我只是非常匆忙地用一把尺子收集了一系列头骨的测量数据，”马尔卡希说。 “我开始研究统计数据，你可以通过多种方法查看不同的测量结果，看看它们是否最适合经典的单峰分布，或者如果你认为你正在处理表现出强烈性别二态性的东西，你会看到一些具有双峰分布的东西——有两种方法，一种针对男性，另一种针对女性。”

paras.en: Ancient Skulls Challenge a Classic Example of Sexual Dimorphism
paras.zh: 古代头骨挑战性别二态性的经典例子

paras.en: If males and females differed as dramatically as paleontologists had suggested, the skull measurements would be expected to cluster into two relatively distinct groups. Instead, Mulcahy's initial analysis failed to reveal such a clear separation.
paras.zh: 如果男性和女性的差异像古生物学家所认为的那样显着，那么头骨测量结果预计会分为两个相对不同的群体。相反，马尔卡希的初步分析未能揭示如此明显的分离。

paras.en: "It wasn't like there's one group of specimens that look bigger than another, and then there's another group that are smaller with smaller horns and canines," he said. "So I was kind of interested -- are these really good examples of sexual dimorphism after all? Is there actual evidence in the morphology of these skulls, in the distribution in particular of the ranges of morphology we're seeing, that that's what's going on?"
paras.zh: “并不是说有一组标本看起来比另一组更大，而另一组则较小，有较小的角和犬齿，”他说。 “所以我有点感兴趣——这些真的是性别二态性的好例子吗？这些头骨的形态，特别是我们所看到的形态范围的分布，是否有实际证据表明，这就是正在发生的事情？”

paras.en: To investigate further, Mulcahy collected additional measurements from fossils housed at other institutions and expanded his analysis using new statistical methods. His final dataset encompassed approximately 30 skulls belonging to a single extinct species, Uintatherium anceps.
paras.zh: 为了进一步调查，马尔卡希从其他机构收藏的化石中收集了额外的测量结果，并使用新的统计方法扩展了他的分析。他的最终数据集包含大约 30 个属于单一灭绝物种 Uintatherium anceps 的头骨。

paras.en: Although the results offered some hints of physical differences between the sexes, the evidence was far less convincing than expected. One major challenge in studying extinct animals is that researchers generally cannot independently determine the sex of individual fossil specimens.
paras.zh: 尽管结果提供了一些性别之间身体差异的线索，但证据远没有预期那么令人信服。研究灭绝动物的一大挑战是研究人员通常无法独立确定单个化石标本的性别。

paras.en: "Maybe there were some little signals of dimorphism here and there, but nothing really concrete," he said. "I had an idea: Maybe it's just that the techniques I'm using aren't robust enough to actually measure sexual dimorphism. With fossil animals, you don't actually know which specimens are males and which are females. You can guess and then test whether or not the ones you guess are males differ from the ones you guess are females, but that's super circular, because you could just be picking the most extreme ones to be one sex and the least extreme to be the other. Of course they're going to differ."
paras.zh: “也许到处都有一些二态性的小信号，但没有什么真正具体的，”他说。 “我有一个想法：也许只是我使用的技术不够强大，无法实际测量性别二态性。对于化石动物，你实际上不知道哪些标本是雄性，哪些是雌性。你可以猜测，然后测试你猜测的雄性和你猜测的雌性是否不同，但这是超级循环，因为你可能只是选择最极端的作为一种性别，最不极端的作为另一种性别。当然，它们会不同。”

paras.en: Modern Bison Provide an Important Comparison
paras.zh: 现代野牛提供了重要的比较

paras.en: To determine whether his statistical methods could reliably detect sexual dimorphism, Mulcahy turned to a living mammal: the bison. Unlike fossil uintatheres, modern bison specimens could be classified by sex with confidence.
paras.zh: 为了确定他的统计方法是否能够可靠地检测性别二态性，马尔卡希转向了一种活生生的哺乳动物：野牛。与尤因塔瑟斯化石不同，现代野牛标本可以放心地按性别进行分类。

paras.en: Bison also offered a useful comparison because they are large, horned herbivores whose ecology shares similarities with what researchers have proposed for uintatheres.
paras.zh: 野牛也提供了一个有用的比较，因为它们是大型、有角的食草动物，其生态与研究人员提出的野牛有相似之处。

paras.en: "When you're dealing with living animals, you can just take the males, take the females and compare them," he said. "Bison are another really big herbivore, with a similar sort of ecology that's been proposed for uintatheres, and they also have big horns. What I noticed is that the signals of dimorphism I was picking up in bison were a lot clearer. When I was looking at the bison, it was almost perfect that all of the females were most similar to the females, and all the males were most similar to the males."
paras.zh: “当你处理活体动物时，你可以只拿雄性和雌性进行比较，”他说。 “野牛是另一种非常大的食草动物，具有与野牛类相似的生态系统，而且它们也有大角。我注意到，我在野牛身上发现的二态性信号要清晰得多。当我观察野牛时，几乎完美的是，所有雌性都与雌性最相似，所有雄性都与雄性最相似。”

paras.en: The contrast suggests that the relatively weak evidence for sexual dimorphism in uintatheres cannot be attributed solely to limitations of the statistical techniques. The same methods successfully identified much clearer physical differences between male and female bison.
paras.zh: 这一对比表明，尤因塔动物的性别二态性相对较弱的证据不能仅仅归因于统计技术的局限性。同样的方法成功地识别出雄性和雌性野牛之间更明显的身体差异。

paras.en: Victorian-Era Bias May Have Shaped Paleontology
paras.zh: 维多利亚时代的偏见可能影响了古生物学

paras.en: Mulcahy believes that historical cultural attitudes may help explain why paleontologists came to accept such pronounced differences between male and female uintatheres. Many extinct species were first identified and described during the late 19th and early 20th centuries, when prevailing views about the sexes may have influenced scientific interpretations.
paras.zh: 马尔卡希认为，历史文化态度可能有助于解释为什么古生物学家开始接受雄性和雌性尤因塔瑟斯之间如此明显的差异。许多灭绝物种在 19 世纪末和 20 世纪初首次被识别和描述，当时关于性别的流行观点可能影响了科学解释。

paras.en: "Back then, this is right when evolutionary theory, sexual selection, natural selection, all of that is kind of coming into play," he said. "I think it's really important to remember that these things were first discovered in the late 1800s by a bunch of male paleontologists working in a very Victorian-era mindset. The idea is basically assumed at that point that males are going to be bigger and scarier than females. It's really interesting: When you step back and actually test that hypothesis, it doesn't really hold up."
paras.zh: “当时，当进化论、性选择、自然选择等所有这些都开始发挥作用时，这是正确的，”他说。 “我认为重要的是要记住，这些东西是在 1800 年代末由一群以维多利亚时代的思维方式工作的男性古生物学家首次发现的。这个想法基本上被认为是雄性会比雌性更大、更可怕。这真的很有趣：当你退后一步并实际检验这个假设时，它并没有真正成立。”

paras.en: Because uintatheres have long been regarded as one of the clearest examples of sexual dimorphism in the fossil record, the new findings could have implications beyond these unusual prehistoric giants. Other extinct species may also have exhibited less pronounced physical differences between males and females than scientists have traditionally believed.
paras.zh: 由于尤因塔动物长期以来一直被认为是化石记录中性别二态性最明显的例子之一，因此新发现的影响可能超出了这些不寻常的史前巨人的范围。其他灭绝的物种在雄性和雌性之间的身体差异也可能没有科学家传统上认为的那么明显。

paras.en: Rethinking the Evolution of Sex Differences in Mammals
paras.zh: 重新思考哺乳动物性别差异的进化

paras.en: The research also adds to a growing body of evidence challenging the widespread assumption that male mammals are typically larger than females. Dramatic differences in body size and physical appearance may have evolved independently in multiple mammalian lineages rather than being a characteristic inherited from their earliest common ancestors.
paras.zh: 这项研究还提供了越来越多的证据，挑战了雄性哺乳动物通常比雌性哺乳动物体型大的普遍假设。体型和外貌的显着差异可能是在多个哺乳动物谱系中独立进化的，而不是从它们最早的共同祖先继承的特征。

paras.en: Research on living mammals has similarly challenged conventional thinking, suggesting that pronounced differences favoring larger males are less widespread than historically assumed.
paras.zh: 对现存哺乳动物的研究也同样挑战了传统思维，表明有利于体型较大雄性的明显差异并不像历史上假设的那样普遍。

paras.en: "Strong, big male-style sexual dimorphism was probably not ancestral at the root of the mammalian tree, and among the mammals where we do see this pattern today, it's almost certainly shown up independently several times," Mulcahy said. "It had long been assumed that sexual dimorphism is the norm, that most species show that males are bigger than females. But just a couple years ago, a paper came out showing that among living mammals, most species either don't show any dimorphism or actually have larger females. The idea that males are always bigger than females is really just a choice of what animals were people looking at, what are the things that biologists in the past were interested in."
paras.zh: 马尔卡希说：“强大、巨大的雄性型性别二态性可能并不是哺乳动物树根上的祖先，而在我们今天看到这种模式的哺乳动物中，几乎可以肯定它已经独立出现过多次。” “长期以来，人们一直认为两性二态性是常态，大多数物种都表现出雄性比雌性更大。但就在几年前，一篇论文表明，在现存的哺乳动物中，大多数物种要么没有表现出任何二态性，要么实际上有更大的雌性。雄性总是比雌性更大的想法实际上只是人们所关注的动物以及过去生物学家感兴趣的事物的选择。”

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Kansas. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由堪萨斯大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Kevin D. Mulcahy. Linear morphometrics fail to support strong sexual dimorphism in Uintatherium anceps. PLOS One, 2026; 21 (10): e0345236 DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0345236
paras.zh: - 凯文·D·马尔卡希。线性形态测量无法支持 Uintatherium anceps 中强烈的性别二态性。 PLOS One，2026 年； 21 (10): e0345236 DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0345236

articles.title: Scientists discover signs of a hidden extinction crisis deep beneath the ocean

paras.en: Scientists discover signs of a hidden extinction crisis deep beneath the ocean
paras.zh: 科学家发现海底深处隐藏的灭绝危机的迹象

paras.en: The deep sea has long been considered a safe haven for marine life, but new genetic research suggests a hidden biodiversity crisis may be unfolding far beneath the waves. Scientists analyzing more than a decade of genetic data from five species of deep-sea fish and shrimp in the Gulf discovered troubling signs of extinction risk in every species examined.
paras.zh: 深海长期以来一直被认为是海洋生物的安全港，但新的基因研究表明，隐藏的生物多样性危机可能正在海浪深处展开。科学家分析了海湾地区五种深海鱼和虾十多年来的遗传数据，发现每个受检物种都存在令人不安的灭绝风险迹象。

paras.en: New genetic findings reveal that marine animals living deep beneath the surface of the Gulf may be at greater risk of extinction than scientists once thought.
paras.zh: 新的基因发现表明，生活在海湾表面深处的海洋动物面临的灭绝风险可能比科学家曾经认为的更大。

paras.en: As biodiversity declines around the world, the deep ocean has largely been regarded as a natural sanctuary where marine life is better protected from environmental threats. However, new research led by scientists at Florida International University (FIU) is challenging that assumption.
paras.zh: 随着世界各地生物多样性的减少，深海在很大程度上被视为自然保护区，海洋生物在这里得到更好的保护，免受环境威胁。然而，佛罗里达国际大学 (FIU) 科学家领导的新研究正在挑战这一假设。

paras.en: Drawing on 12 years of genetic data, researchers identified concerning signs of extinction risk in five marine species that inhabit waters hundreds of meters below the surface of the Gulf. Their findings suggest that a biodiversity crisis may also be developing in one of Earth's most extensive and poorly understood environments.
paras.zh: 研究人员利用 12 年的遗传数据，发现了栖息在海湾表面以下数百米水域的五种海洋物种的灭绝风险迹象。他们的发现表明，生物多样性危机也可能正在地球上最广泛且人们知之甚少的环境之一中发展。

paras.en: The research was led by FIU marine scientist Pedro A. Peres of the Bracken-Grissom Lab and focused on three species of lanternfish and two species of deep-sea shrimp collected between 2011 and 2023.
paras.zh: 这项研究由佛罗里达国际大学 Bracken-Grissom 实验室的海洋科学家 Pedro A. Peres 领导，重点研究了 2011 年至 2023 年间收集的三种灯笼鱼和两种深海虾。

paras.en: The team examined DNA from 486 specimens to determine how the populations have changed over time and assess their ability to withstand future environmental stress. According to Peres, few studies have investigated changes in the genetic makeup of deep-sea animals over an extended period.
paras.zh: 研究小组检查了 486 个样本的 DNA，以确定种群随时间的变化，并评估它们承受未来环境压力的能力。佩雷斯表示，很少有研究调查深海动物基因组成在较长时期内的变化。

paras.en: Every species examined displayed genetic characteristics linked to a greater risk of extinction, Peres said. One species of lanternfish, Diaphus dumerilii, experienced an approximately 8% reduction in genetic diversity in just 12 years. This loss matches or exceeds declines recorded in some threatened and endangered animals across considerably longer timespans.
paras.zh: 佩雷斯说，每个被检查的物种都显示出与更大的灭绝风险相关的遗传特征。一种灯笼鱼——Diaphus dumerilii，在短短 12 年内遗传多样性减少了约 8%。这一损失与一些受威胁和濒临灭绝的动物在相当长的时间内记录的下降量相当或超过。

paras.en: All five species also had relatively small effective population sizes. Rather than indicating that the animals are necessarily scarce, this finding suggests that only a limited proportion of individuals are passing their genetic information on to subsequent generations.
paras.zh: 所有五个物种的有效种群规模也相对较小。这一发现并不表明这些动物必然稀缺，而是表明只有有限比例的个体将其遗传信息传递给后代。

paras.en: "This challenges the idea that deep-sea species are naturally more resilient because they occupy such vast environments," Peres said. "It shows how much we can miss when we look only at population abundance without considering their genetic diversity and long-term viability."
paras.zh: 佩雷斯说：“这对深海物种由于占据如此广阔的环境而自然更具适应力的观点提出了挑战。” “这表明，当我们只关注种群丰度而不考虑其遗传多样性和长期生存能力时，我们可能会错过多少。”

paras.en: Genetic variation plays a fundamental role in determining whether a species can survive environmental changes, explained Heather Bracken-Grissom, assistant director of the Institute of Environment's Coastlines and Oceans Division. Bracken-Grissom, a co-author of the study, has led research exploring the genetic health and resilience of animals living in the deep ocean.
paras.zh: 环境研究所海岸线和海洋部助理主任希瑟·布拉肯-格里索姆解释说，遗传变异在决定一个物种能否在环境变化中生存方面发挥着重要作用。该研究的合著者布雷肯-格里索姆领导了一项探索生活在深海动物的遗传健康和恢复能力的研究。

paras.en: "Genetic diversity provides the variation populations need to adapt to changing conditions, resist disease and recover from environmental disturbances," she said. "When that diversity disappears, a species can also lose the ability to withstand future threats."
paras.zh: “遗传多样性提供了适应不断变化的条件、抵抗疾病和从环境干扰中恢复所需的变异种群，”她说。 “当这种多样性消失时，一个物种也会失去抵御未来威胁的能力。”

paras.en: Climate Change Could Dramatically Shrink Deep-Sea Habitats
paras.zh: 气候变化可能会急剧缩小深海栖息地

paras.en: The team also used climate models to estimate how environmental conditions in the Gulf could affect the availability of suitable deep-sea habitats by 2050 and 2100. The projections indicate that four of the five species could face substantial habitat losses, potentially reaching 70%.
paras.zh: 该团队还使用气候模型来估计到 2050 年和 2100 年，海湾的环境条件将如何影响合适的深海栖息地的可用性。预测表明，五个物种中的四个可能面临栖息地的严重丧失，可能达到 70%。

paras.en: Peres noted that these results are especially troubling given the longstanding belief that the enormous habitats and widespread geographic distributions of deep-sea animals allow them to maintain large, resilient populations.
paras.zh: 佩雷斯指出，鉴于长期以来人们认为深海动物巨大的栖息地和广泛的地理分布使它们能够维持大量、有弹性的种群，这些结果尤其令人不安。

paras.en: The discoveries also prompt new questions about the long-term environmental impact of the 2010 Deepwater Horizon oil spill. Earlier research revealed considerable reductions in deep-sea animal populations in the aftermath of the disaster.
paras.zh: 这些发现还引发了有关 2010 年深水地平线漏油事件的长期环境影响的新问题。早期研究表明，灾难发生后深海动物数量大幅减少。

paras.en: While the scientists have not established a direct link between the oil spill and the genetic changes they observed, their results indicate that environmental disruptions could have repercussions extending well beyond their initial impact.
paras.zh: 虽然科学家们尚未建立漏油事件与他们观察到的基因变化之间的直接联系，但他们的研究结果表明，环境破坏可能产生的影响远远超出其最初的影响。

paras.en: "Our results suggest some deep-sea populations may have already been genetically vulnerable before the Deepwater Horizon oil spill," Peres said. "This has important implications for understanding the consequences of environmental disturbances. Events such as oil spills may affect populations that already have limited genetic resilience."
paras.zh: 佩雷斯说：“我们的结果表明，在深水地平线漏油事件发生之前，一些深海种群可能已经在基因上变得脆弱。” “这对于了解环境干扰的后果具有重要意义。石油泄漏等事件可能会影响基因恢复能力已经有限的人群。”

paras.en: An Urgent Need To Monitor Deep-Sea Biodiversity
paras.zh: 迫切需要监测深海生物多样性

paras.en: The study, which also includes co-authors Keith Sellers of FIU and Tracey T. Sutton of Nova Southeastern University, highlights the importance of examining the genetic health of marine populations. Monitoring changes in DNA over time could help scientists identify threats to species survival that conventional population surveys fail to detect.
paras.zh: 这项研究的合著者还包括佛罗里达国际大学的基思·塞勒斯和新星东南大学的特雷西·T·萨顿，强调了检查海洋种群遗传健康的重要性。监测DNA随时间的变化可以帮助科学家识别传统种群调查无法检测到的对物种生存的威胁。

paras.en: "This study serves as a wake-up call for the scientific community," Peres said, "highlighting the urgent need to integrate genetic monitoring into biodiversity assessments and emphasizing the importance of long-term monitoring to better understand and detect changes in marine populations over time."
paras.zh: 佩雷斯说：“这项研究为科学界敲响了警钟，强调了将基因监测纳入生物多样性评估的迫切需要，并强调了长期监测对于更好地了解和检测海洋种群随时间变化的重要性。”

paras.zh: 材料由佛罗里达国际大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: One type of physical activity is linked to a 20% higher dementia risk

paras.en: One type of physical activity is linked to a 20% higher dementia risk
paras.zh: 一种体力活动会使患痴呆症的风险增加 20%

paras.en: A massive study has revealed that exercising for pleasure and performing physical labor at work may have surprisingly different implications for brain health. While recreational exercise was linked to a 24% lower dementia risk, physically demanding work was associated with a 20% higher risk, suggesting that the context of movement matters.
paras.zh: 一项大规模研究表明，为了快乐而锻炼和在工作中进行体力劳动可能对大脑健康产生令人惊讶的不同影响。虽然休闲运动与痴呆症风险降低 24% 相关，但体力要求较高的工作与痴呆症风险升高 20% 相关，这表明运动环境很重要。

paras.en: Regular physical activity has long been recognized as a way to help protect against dementia. However, new research from the University of Southern California (USC) suggests that the circumstances in which people are physically active may be just as important as the amount of activity they get.
paras.zh: 长期以来，定期进行体育锻炼一直被认为是有助于预防痴呆症的一种方法。然而，南加州大学 (USC) 的新研究表明，人们进行身体活动的环境可能与他们进行的活动量同样重要。

paras.en: An analysis involving more than 4.2 million people found that recreational activities such as walking, cycling, running, swimming, and playing sports were associated with a significantly lower risk of dementia. Surprisingly, people who engaged in higher levels of physical activity at work appeared to face an increased risk of developing the condition.
paras.zh: 一项涉及超过 420 万人的分析发现，步行、骑自行车、跑步、游泳和体育运动等休闲活动与痴呆症风险显着降低有关。令人惊讶的是，在工作中从事较高水平体力活动的人似乎面临更高的患这种疾病的风险。

paras.en: Published in The Lancet Public Health, the study is the first systematic investigation into whether a phenomenon known as the "physical activity paradox" also applies to dementia. Already well established in cardiovascular research, this paradox refers to the observation that physical labor does not necessarily offer the same health advantages as recreational exercise and may even be associated with a greater risk of disease.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《柳叶刀公共卫生》上，是首次系统调查“体力活动悖论”现象是否也适用于痴呆症。这一悖论在心血管研究中已经得到证实，它指的是体力劳动不一定能提供与休闲运动相同的健康益处，甚至可能与更大的疾病风险相关。

paras.en: Led by David Raichlen, professor of biological sciences and anthropology at the USC Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences, the research team examined data from 74 cohort and case-control studies. Together, the studies included more than 4.2 million people between the ages of 45 and 93 from 30 countries. Over a median follow-up period of 10 years, researchers monitored diagnoses of all-cause dementia, Alzheimer's disease, and vascular dementia.
paras.zh: 由南加州大学多恩西夫文学、艺术与科学学院生物科学和人类学教授 David Raichlen 领导的研究小组检查了 74 项队列研究和病例对照研究的数据。这些研究总共涵盖了来自 30 个国家的超过 420 万名年龄在 45 岁至 93 岁之间的人。在平均 10 年的随访期内，研究人员监测了全因痴呆、阿尔茨海默病和血管性痴呆的诊断。

paras.en: Participants who engaged in higher levels of recreational physical activity had a 24% lower risk of dementia compared with the least active individuals. Physical activity associated with household chores also appeared to offer benefits, although this finding was supported by only one study. In contrast, higher levels of physical activity at work were linked to a 20% greater risk of dementia. Physically active commuting was also associated with a modest increase in risk, but evidence for this relationship came from just two studies.
paras.zh: 与活动最少的人相比，从事较高水平娱乐性体育活动的参与者患痴呆症的风险降低了 24%。与家务劳动相关的体力活动似乎也有好处，尽管这一发现仅得到一项研究的支持。相比之下，工作中体力活动水平越高，患痴呆症的风险就会增加 20%。体力活跃的通勤也与风险的适度增加有关，但这种关系的证据仅来自两项研究。

paras.en: "The findings challenge the long-held assumption that 'every move counts' for brain health," said Natan Feter, the study's first author, a postdoctoral fellow in Raichlen's Evolutionary Biology of Physical Activity Lab at USC and a researcher in the Graduate Program of Epidemiology at Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (Brazil).
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者、南加州大学 Raichlen 身体活动进化生物学实验室的博士后研究员、南里奥格兰德联邦大学（巴西）流行病学研究生项目的研究员 Natan Feter 说：“这些发现挑战了长期以来‘每一个动作对大脑健康都很重要’的假设。”

paras.en: Why Exercise and Physical Labor May Affect the Brain Differently
paras.zh: 为什么运动和体力劳动可能对大脑产生不同的影响

paras.en: Researchers often group recreational exercise, manual labor, household chores, and active commuting together when measuring "Physical activity." However, the authors suggest that the circumstances surrounding these activities vary considerably and could influence their long-term health effects.
paras.zh: 研究人员在测量“体力活动”时，经常将休闲运动、体力劳动、家务劳动和积极通勤放在一起。然而，作者认为，这些活动的环境差异很大，可能会影响其长期健康影响。

paras.en: People who exercise during their free time generally have greater control over the intensity and nature of their activities. Recreational exercise can also provide opportunities to socialize and relieve stress. In comparison, physically demanding occupations may require repeated movements, extended periods of standing, heavy lifting, and insufficient time to recover, along with exposure to potentially harmful workplace conditions.
paras.zh: 在空闲时间锻炼的人通常可以更好地控制自己活动的强度和性质。休闲运动还可以提供社交和缓解压力的机会。相比之下，体力要求较高的职业可能需要重复运动、长时间站立、提重物、没有足够的时间恢复，并且暴露在可能有害的工作场所条件下。

paras.en: The researchers do not believe that physical movement itself is likely to explain the elevated dementia risk associated with occupational activity. Instead, the relationship may arise from the social and environmental factors commonly associated with manual labor.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，身体运动本身并不能解释与职业活动相关的痴呆风险升高。相反，这种关系可能源于通常与体力劳动相关的社会和环境因素。

paras.en: Physically demanding occupations are more likely to expose workers to psychological and social stress, limited control over their work, unsafe conditions, and higher levels of air and noise pollution. Each of these factors has independently been associated with dementia risk. Workers may also struggle to participate in recreational exercise because of exhaustion, limited free time, or a lack of access to safe spaces for physical activity.
paras.zh: 体力要求较高的职业更有可能使工人面临心理和社会压力、对工作的控制有限、不安全的条件以及较高水平的空气和噪音污染。这些因素中的每一个都与痴呆风险独立相关。由于精疲力尽、空闲时间有限或缺乏安全的身体活动空间，工人也可能难以参加娱乐锻炼。

paras.en: The researchers also discovered that the relationship between physical activity and dementia risk was not linear and followed opposite patterns depending on the type of activity.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，体力活动与痴呆风险之间的关系不是线性的，并且根据活动类型遵循相反的模式。

paras.en: As recreational exercise increased, dementia risk gradually declined until the apparent benefits leveled off. Occupational physical activity showed the reverse pattern, with dementia risk increasing at higher activity levels before eventually reaching a plateau.
paras.zh: 随着休闲运动的增加，患痴呆症的风险逐渐下降，直到明显的好处趋于平稳。职业体力活动则表现出相反的模式，痴呆症风险随着活动水平的增加而增加，然后最终达到稳定水平。

paras.en: Important Limitations and Unanswered Questions
paras.zh: 重要的限制和未解答的问题

paras.en: The authors emphasize that there is still too little research on physical activity related to household chores and commuting to draw definitive conclusions about either. Most of the available evidence also comes from high-income countries, despite projections that low- and middle-income nations will experience the greatest increases in dementia cases in the coming decades.
paras.zh: 作者强调，对于与家务和通勤相关的身体活动的研究仍然太少，无法得出明确的结论。大多数现有证据也来自高收入国家，尽管预测低收入和中等收入国家的痴呆症病例将在未来几十年内出现最大增幅。

paras.en: Another limitation is that almost all the studies depended on participants reporting their own physical activity. This approach can introduce errors if people do not accurately remember their activity levels. Nevertheless, Feter said the consistency of the findings across several additional statistical analyses suggests that the observed relationships warrant serious attention.
paras.zh: 另一个限制是，几乎所有研究都依赖于参与者报告自己的身体活动。如果人们不能准确记住他们的活动水平，这种方法可能会产生错误。尽管如此，费特表示，其他几项统计分析结果的一致性表明，观察到的关系值得认真关注。

paras.en: The researchers stress that their findings should not discourage people from pursuing physically active occupations. Since the analysis relied on observational research, it cannot establish that occupational physical activity causes dementia.
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，他们的发现不应阻止人们从事体力活动。由于该分析依赖于观察研究，因此无法确定职业体力活动会导致痴呆。

paras.en: Instead, the results underscore the importance of examining the conditions under which people are physically active. Recreational exercise continued to be associated with a lower risk of dementia, while occupational activity remained linked to a higher risk even after researchers accounted for differences in age, education, and chronic health conditions.
paras.zh: 相反，结果强调了检查人们身体活动条件的重要性。即使研究人员考虑了年龄、教育程度和慢性健康状况的差异，休闲运动仍然与较低的痴呆风险相关，而职业活动仍然与较高的风险相关。

paras.en: How Sedentary Activities May Also Influence Brain Health
paras.zh: 久坐活动如何影响大脑健康

paras.en: The importance of context may extend beyond physical activity. Separate research by Raichlen, Feter, and their colleagues, published recently in the journal Alzheimer's & Dementia, suggests that different types of sedentary behavior may also be associated with differences in brain structure.
paras.zh: 背景的重要性可能超出了身体活动的范围。 Raichlen、Feter 及其同事最近在《阿尔茨海默病与痴呆》杂志上发表的另一项研究表明，不同类型的久坐行为也可能与大脑结构的差异有关。

paras.en: In that study, mentally stimulating activities performed while sitting, such as working at a desk, were associated with greater volume in certain regions of the cerebral cortex than more passive activities, such as watching television. These differences included brain regions involved in executive function.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，坐着时进行的精神刺激活动（例如在办公桌前工作）与大脑皮层某些区域的更大音量相关，而与被动活动（例如看电视）相比，则与更大的音量相关。这些差异包括涉及执行功能的大脑区域。

paras.en: Together, the findings could have important implications for public health strategies aimed at reducing dementia risk. The authors suggest that encouraging people to "move more" may not be sufficient without also addressing the circumstances in which physical activity takes place.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现可能对旨在降低痴呆风险的公共卫生战略产生重要影响。作者认为，如果不解决体育活动发生的环境，鼓励人们“多运动”可能还不够。

paras.en: "In other words, when it comes to protecting the brain, the context of physical activity may matter just as much as movement itself," Raichlen said. "Improving access to safe parks, walking trails and recreational facilities, ensuring people have adequate leisure time for exercise, and reducing harmful workplace exposures may ultimately prove as important as promoting physical activity itself."
paras.zh: “换句话说，当谈到保护大脑时，身体活动的背景可能和运动本身一样重要，”雷奇伦说。 “改善人们进入安全公园、步道和娱乐设施的机会，确保人们有足够的休闲时间进行锻炼，以及减少有害的工作场所暴露，最终可能会被证明与促进体育活动本身一样重要。”

paras.en: Raichlen and Feter's co-authors include Tiladia Markarian, Dylan M. Luong, Jack Gunnink, Anamika Nanda, Sarah Hourihan and Ashley Ventura of USC; Eduardo Caputo, Jayne Feter, Gustavo S. Silva and Airton José Rombaldi of Universidade Federal de Pelotas (Brazil); Paula Iso-Markku of the University of Helsinki (Finland); Daniela Benzano Bumaguin of Fundação Universitária de Cardiologia (Brazil); Yann C. Klimentidis and Gene E. Alexander of the University of Arizona; Daniel Umpierre and Natália Schröder of Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (Brazil); and Pedro C. Hallal of University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.
