articles.title: Who turned the W upside down? Why Cassiopeia won't sit still
articles.author: Jamie Carter

paras.en: Some constellations are like old friends. You know them well, they're always there, and they never seem to change. A case in point is Cassiopeia, the queen. Its beautiful name comes from Greek mythology — the mother of Andromeda — and its shape is said to represent a queen sitting on a throne. To a stargazer, Cassiopeia is best known as a prominent northern constellation shaped like the letter W.
paras.zh: 有些星座就像老朋友一样。你很了解它们，它们一直都在那里，而且似乎从未改变。女王卡西奥佩娅就是一个典型的例子。它美丽的名字来自希腊神话——仙女座的母亲——据说它的形状代表坐在王座上的女王。对于观星者来说，仙后座最为人所知的是一个形状像字母 W 的北方星座。

paras.en: It's easy to find — look north, find five reasonably bright stars making a W, congratulate yourself on finding Cassiopeia and use it to get somewhere more interesting. It's so often a signpost, not a destination.
paras.zh: 它很容易找到——向北看，找到五颗相当明亮的星星，形成一个W，祝贺自己找到了仙后座，并用它去更有趣的地方。它常常是一个路标，而不是目的地。

paras.en: But look north a few hours after dark this month, and you'll notice the W has gone. The five stars are still there, but the shape you may have memorized looks like it's been picked up and turned over. It looks more like an E or an M, depending on when you look. Now try and look for the Big Dipper/the Plough. It's gone.
paras.zh: 但本月天黑后几个小时向北看，你会发现 W 已经消失了。五颗星仍然在那里，但你可能已经记住的形状看起来像是被拿起并翻转了。它看起来更像是 E 或 M，具体取决于您何时查看。现在尝试寻找北斗七星/犁。它消失了。

paras.en: Nothing mysterious has happened, of course. Cassiopeia is doing exactly what it always does, but it's a reminder that the northern sky is where you can easily watch the stars move — and the seasons turn.
paras.zh: 当然，并没有发生什么神秘的事情。仙后座正在做它一贯做的事情，但它提醒人们，北方的天空是您可以轻松观看星星移动和季节更替的地方。

paras.en: Late November is an excellent time to reacquaint yourself with Cassiopeia from anywhere in the Northern Hemisphere. Look high in the northern sky during the evening for its five prominent stars — Caph, Schedar, Navi, Ruchbah and Segin. Depending on exactly when you look, it can look like a W, E, M or a 3.
paras.zh: 十一月下旬是从北半球任何地方重新认识仙后座的绝佳时机。晚上在北方天空高处观看五颗突出的恒星——卡夫星、斯切达星、纳维星、鲁奇巴星和塞金星。根据您观看的具体时间，它可能看起来像 W、E、M 或 3。

paras.en: This is because Cassiopeia is circumpolar. Rather than rising in the east and eventually setting in the west like many familiar constellations, it circles the north celestial pole — a position currently held by Polaris, the North Star. From sufficiently northerly latitudes, its main stars never disappear below the horizon.
paras.zh: 这是因为仙后座是绕极地的。它不像许多熟悉的星座那样从东方升起并最终在西方落下，而是围绕北天极运行——目前北极星所在的位置。从足够北的纬度来看，它的主要恒星永​​远不会消失在地平线以下。

paras.en: This gives us a simple observing experiment. Find Cassiopeia in the early evening and remember its orientation relative to the horizon. Go back several hours later and look again. The constellation has moved around Polaris, and its shape has changed. The stars haven't changed their arrangement — Earth has simply rotated from west to east. We all know this logically, but watching the familiar pattern of Cassiopeia's stars apparently tip over during a single night makes Earth's rotation a lot less abstract.
paras.zh: 这给了我们一个简单的观察实验。在傍晚找到仙后座并记住它相对于地平线的方向。几个小时后回去再看一次。该星座围绕北极星移动，其形状也发生了变化。恒星的排列并没有改变——地球只是从西向东旋转。从逻辑上讲，我们都知道这一点，但观察仙后座恒星在一个夜晚内明显翻转的熟悉模式，会让地球的自转不再那么抽象。

paras.en: I'm going to observe Cassiopeia twice on the same evening this week, which is about as complicated as the experiment needs to get. The first time will be shortly after darkness falls. I'll find the W, note which way it seems to be pointing and use something fixed — a rooftop, tree or chimney — to give myself a rough reference for its position. I'll return to my backyard before bed, and see where the pattern has shifted. Cassiopeia's main stars are bright enough to survive urban and suburban light pollution, so you don't need a particularly dark sky or a telescope.
paras.zh: 本周我将在同一晚对仙后座进行两次观测，这与实验所需的复杂程度差不多。第一次是在夜幕降临后不久。我会找到 W，记下它似乎指向哪个方向，并使用固定的东西（屋顶、树或烟囱）来给自己提供其位置的粗略参考。我会在睡觉前回到后院，看看模式发生了哪些变化。仙后座的主要恒星足够明亮，可以承受城市和郊区的光污染，因此不需要特别黑暗的天空或望远镜。

paras.en: While I'm gazing at Cassiopeia, I'll try to see the stars as they really are, and not just how they appear to us. Check out the distances of its stars from the sun:
paras.zh: 当我凝视仙后座时，我会尝试看到星星的真实面目，而不仅仅是它们在我们看来的样子。查看其恒星与太阳的距离：

paras.en: Only Caph and Ruchbah are within 100 light-years — the sun's local interstellar neighborhood. Does that destroy the very concept of Cassiopeia as a group of related stars? Cassiopeia, like all constellations, is a mirage, with a capital M.
paras.zh: 只有卡夫和鲁赫巴位于 100 光年之内——太阳当地的星际邻居。这是否会破坏仙后座作为一组相关恒星的概念？仙后座和所有星座一样，是一个海市蜃楼，大写字母 M。

paras.en: There's another reason I love Cassiopeia. Proxima Centauri, the closest star to our sun, lies just 4.24 light-years away. Travel there and look back towards our solar system, and our sun would appear as an extra star in Cassiopeia — effectively giving the constellation a sixth bright point. From a certain perspective, we are all Cassiopeians.
paras.zh: 我喜欢仙后座还有另一个原因。比邻星是距离太阳最近的恒星，距离我们仅 4.24 光年。前往那里并回头看我们的太阳系，我们的太阳将在仙后座中出现为一颗额外的恒星——有效地为该星座提供了第六个亮点。从某种角度来看，我们都是仙后座。

paras.en: Stargazer's corner: Nov. 27-Dec. 4, 2026
paras.zh: 观星者专区：11 月 27 日至 12 月 27 日2026年4月

paras.en: The last few evenings of November bring back darker early-night skies as the moon wanes from full earlier in the week and rises progressively later. It will rise in the middle of the night as it reaches its last-quarter phase on Dec. 1. It's an ideal time to sweep a pair of binoculars across the rich star fields around Cassiopeia and Perseus. On the boundary between the two constellations is the Double Cluster (NGC 869 and NGC 884), one of the finest binocular sights in the entire northern sky. These two dense concentrations of young stars sit side by side against the richer background of the Milky Way. Under a dark sky, you can see it with the naked eye. M52, NGC 457 (the Owl Cluster) and NGC 663 are other clusters also worth seeking out in Cassiopeia.
paras.zh: 十一月的最后几个晚上，随着月亮在本周早些时候从满月开始渐亏，并在晚些时候逐渐升起，初夜的天空会变得更加黑暗。它将在 12 月 1 日半夜升起，达到最后四分之一阶段。这是用双筒望远镜扫过仙后座和英仙座周围丰富星域的理想时机。两个星座之间的边界是双星团（NGC 869 和 NGC 884），它是整个北方天空中最美丽的双筒望远镜景观之一。这两颗密集的年轻恒星并排坐在更丰富的银河系背景下。在黑暗的天空下，你可以用肉眼看到它。 M52、NGC 457（猫头鹰星团）和 NGC 663 是仙后座中其他也值得寻找的星团。

paras.en: Conjunction of the week: Moon, Jupiter, Mars and Regulus
paras.zh: 本周合相：月亮、木星、火星和轩辕十四

paras.en: Get outside about 45 minutes before sunrise on Monday, Nov. 30, and look high in the southern sky for a fitting month-ending finale. A 61%-lit waning gibbous moon will appear alongside brilliant Jupiter, reddish Mars and Regulus, the brightest star in Leo. Together, the four objects will trace a striking crescent spanning just over five degrees of sky — roughly the width of three fingers held at arm's length. It's a much tighter version of a similar arrangement visible on Nov. 2, with Jupiter by far the brightest point and the contrasting colors of Mars and blue-white Regulus adding to the spectacle. No equipment will be needed, though binoculars will help you get a close-up of this rather unusual conjunction.
paras.zh: 11 月 30 日星期一，日出前 45 分钟左右到户外，仰望南方天空，欣赏一场恰到好处的月末大结局。亮度为 61% 的渐亏凸月将与明亮的木星、微红的火星和狮子座最亮的恒星轩辕十四一起出现。这四个物体将一起描绘出一个引人注目的新月形，横跨天空五度角——大约是三根手指的宽度。这是 11 月 2 日看到的类似排列的更紧凑版本，木星是迄今为止最亮的点，火星和蓝白色轩辕十四的对比色增添了奇观。不需要任何设备，尽管双筒望远镜可以帮助您近距离观察这一相当不寻常的结合。

paras.en: Jamie is an experienced science and travel journalist, stargazer and eclipse chaser who writes about exploring the night sky, solar and lunar eclipses, the Northern Lights, moon-gazing, astro-travel, astronomy and space exploration. He is the editor of WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com, author of A Stargazing Program For Beginners, co-author of The Eclipse Effect, and a senior contributor at Forbes.
paras.zh: 杰米是一位经验丰富的科学和旅行记者、观星者和日食追踪者，撰写有关探索夜空、日食和月食、北极光、观月、天文旅行、天文学和太空探索的文章。他是 WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com 的编辑、《A Stargazing Program For Beginners》的作者、《The Eclipse Effect》的合著者以及《福布斯》的高级撰稿人。

A keen photographer, Harry has strong experience with astrophotography and has captured celestial objects with a range of cameras and smart telescopes. As a lifelong skywatcher, Harry remembers watching the Perseid meteor shower every summer in his hometown and being amazed by the wonders of the night sky.

paras.en: On Aug. 12, 2026, the UK witnessed its best solar eclipse since 1999, wowing the entire country with coverage ranging between 88-96%. paras.en: After attaching the solar filter to the Equinox 2, I simply clicked "Go-to" on the sun from the Unistellar app and waited for it to find the blinding solar disk, which showed up on my screen as an orange disk. There was no issue with the eQuinox 2 finding the sun, so I could focus on capturing images or watching it with solar eclipse glasses.
paras.zh: 将太阳能滤镜安装到 Equinox 2 后，我只需从 Unistellar 应用程序中单击太阳上的“转到”，然后等待它找到令人眼花缭乱的太阳圆盘，它在我的屏幕上显示为橙色圆盘。 eQuinox 2 找到太阳没有任何问题，因此我可以专注于捕捉图像或使用日食眼镜观看它。

paras.en: It not only gave me the opportunity to photograph the event, but it gave me a closer view than I had with my solar eclipse glasses. For something that is unlikely to happen again in my lifetime, I am amazed to get such a front-row seat.
paras.zh: 它不仅让我有机会拍摄这一事件，而且还让我比使用日食眼镜看得更近。对于我一生中不太可能再次发生的事情，我很惊讶能获得如此前排的座位。

articles.title: Commercial Space Federation Welcomes CesiumAstro as a New Associate Member
articles.author: Commercial Space Federation

paras.en: November 13, 2026— Washington, D.C.—The Commercial Space Federation (CSF) is pleased to welcome CesiumAstro as its newest Associate Member. A global leader in advanced connectivity solutions for the space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. CesiumAstro’s addition further strengthens CSF’s diverse membership and the Federation’s work to advance a competitive, innovative, and sustainable U.S. commercial space economy.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 13 日——华盛顿特区——商业航天联合会 (CSF) 很高兴欢迎 CesiumAstro 成为其最新准会员。 CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。 CesiumAstro 的加入进一步加强了 CSF 的多元化成员资格以及联合会推动竞争性、创新性和可持续的美国商业太空经济的工作。

paras.en: CesiumAstro is a lobal leader in advanced connectivity solutions for space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. Its full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads and advanced computing systems. CesiumAstro maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards. Headquartered near Austin, Texas, the company operates additional facilities in Colorado, California, Washington, D.C., Florida, the United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore, Taiwan, and Japan.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，CesiumAstro 提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。其全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。 CesiumAstro 保持与内部设计、制造和测试能力的完全垂直整合，并通过了 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证。该公司总部位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀附近，在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、华盛顿特区、佛罗里达州、英国、德国、新加坡、台湾和日本设有其他工厂。

paras.en: CesiumAstro recently announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion, and unveiled Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation. The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 最近宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元，并推出了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划中的 737 颗卫星、支持人工智能的星座。新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has expanded its capabilities through three strategic acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr, strengthening the company’s capabilities across semiconductor technology, mission software, and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 在过去的 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项战略收购扩大了其能力：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr，增强了公司在半导体技术、任务软件和人工智能方面的能力。

paras.en: CesiumAstro’s full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads, and advanced compute systems. The company maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 的全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。该公司与通过 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证的内部设计、制造和测试能力保持完整的垂直整合。

paras.en: “A thriving commercial economy in low Earth orbit needs reliable communications and a clear path from development to operations. CesiumAstro is joining CSF’s Commercial LEO Council to bring our communications expertise to that effort. We look forward to advancing policies that encourage investment, expand government use of commercial services, and support companies building the next generation of space infrastructure.”
paras.zh: “近地轨道蓬勃发展的商业经济需要可靠的通信以及从开发到运营的清晰路径。CesiumAstro 正在加入 CSF 的商业 LEO 委员会，将我们的通信专业知识用于这一努力。我们期待推进鼓励投资、扩大政府对商业服务的使用以及支持企业建设下一代空间基础设施的政策。”

paras.en: – Josh Ingersoll, Director of Spectrum and Regulatory Affairs at CesiumAstro
paras.zh: – Josh Ingersoll，CesiumAstro 频谱和监管事务总监

paras.en: Founded in 2006, the Commercial Space Federation (CSF) and its members are laying the foundation for democratizing access to outer space for scientists, students, civilians, and businesses. All while working towards the goal of expanding the U.S. Commercial Space Economy. Through the promotion of technological innovation, CSF and its diverse membership are guiding the bolstering of U.S. leadership in aerospace and inspiring America’s next generation of engineers and explorers. CSF also serves as the commercial space industry’s primary advocate with the U.S. Congress and the Administration, helping inform the development and implementation of policy priorities. By engaging with congressional players, CSF is able to provide recommendations on commercial space issues that will impact the commercial space industry in the short and long term.
paras.zh: 商业太空联盟 (CSF) 及其成员成立于 2006 年，正在为科学家、学生、平民和企业进入外太空的民主化奠定基础。同时努力实现扩大美国商业太空经济的目标。通过促进技术创新，CSF 及其多元化成员正在指导巩固美国在航空航天领域的领导地位，并激励美国下一代工程师和探险家。 CSF 还担任美国国会和政府商业航天业的主要倡导者，帮助为政策优先事项的制定和实施提供信息。通过与国会参与者合作，CSF 能够就商业航天问题提供建议，这些问题将在短期和长期影响商业航天行业。

articles.title: SpaceNukes Opens Los Alamos Manufacture and Materials Facility to Build Its Next-Generation Space Reactor
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M., Nov. 16, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) opened its Manufacture and Materials Development Facility at 150 Central Park Square in Los Alamos on Nov. 13. The facility is dedicated to manufacture and materials development for the company’s Generation 2 reactor, including additive manufacturing of nickel-based and refractory alloys. No radioactive material is handled in the facility.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，2026 年 11 月 16 日 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) 于 11 月 13 日在洛斯阿拉莫斯中央公园广场 150 号开设了制造和材料开发设施。该设施致力于该公司第二代反应堆的制造和材料开发，包括镍基和耐火合金的增材制造。该设施内不处理任何放射性物质。

paras.en: SpaceNukes’ next-generation reactor is designed to run much hotter. A hotter reactor needs a much smaller radiator, which makes up most of the mass of a space fission power system. Raising the temperature at which heat is rejected lets the same-size radiator shed roughly six times as much heat. The limit is not the nuclear physics but the materials. Today’s power conversion hardware already sits at the edge of what nickel-based superalloys tolerate over a long mission, so going hotter means moving to refractory alloys of tungsten, molybdenum, tantalum, rhenium and niobium. These metals are difficult to form, and many of the component shapes and materials SpaceNukes needs cannot be bought from any supplier.
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 的下一代反应堆设计为运行温度更高。更热的反应堆需要更小的散热器，它构成了空间裂变动力系统的大部分质量。提高散热温度可以让相同尺寸的散热器散发出大约六倍的热量。限制不是核物理而是材料。当今的电力转换硬件已经处于镍基高温合金长期任务承受能力的边缘，因此变得更热意味着转向钨、钼、钽、铼和铌的难熔合金。这些金属很难成型，而且 SpaceNukes 所需的许多部件形状和材料无法从任何供应商处购买。

paras.en: “Our next-generation reactor is a bet on temperature,” said Andrew Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “What stands between us and that is not the nuclear physics. The physics is in good shape, and it was proven in 2018. The limit is metal. Our next reactor is a materials and manufacturing challenge before it is a reactor problem, and that is what this building is for.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps) 表示：“我们的下一代反应堆押注于温度。” “阻碍我们的不是核物理学。物理学状况良好，并在 2018 年得到了证明。限制是金属。我们的下一个反应堆在成为反应堆问题之前首先是材料和制造挑战，而这就是这座建筑的用途。”

paras.en: The facility is led by Omar Mireles, director of manufacture and materials, who heads the Generation 2 program. Mireles spent 13 years as a research engineer and principal investigator at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center, where he led the $25 million Refractory Alloy Additive Manufacturing Build Optimization project.
paras.zh: 该工厂由制造和材料总监 Omar Mireles 领导，他也是第二代项目的负责人。 Mireles 在 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心担任了 13 年的研究工程师和首席研究员，领导了价值 2500 万美元的耐火合金增材制造构建优化项目。

paras.en: “Additive manufacturing is used only for specific circumstances,” Mireles said. “You have parts that are highly complex, made from materials that are difficult to form, have a low production rate that won’t benefit from economy of scale, and have the design flexibility that can optimize designs to the manufacturing process. These lessons were learned over the last two decades in the liquid rocket engine community, and we are applying them to the needs of SpaceNukes, which have very similar conditions. We are manufacturing aerospace components at aerospace-quality standards. This building is where we learn to make them.”
paras.zh: “增材制造仅用于特定情况，”米雷莱斯说。 “零件高度复杂，由难以成型的材料制成，生产率低，无法从规模经济中受益，并且具有可以优化制造过程设计的设计灵活性。这些经验教训是液体火箭发动机界在过去二十年中吸取的经验教训，我们正在将它们应用于具有非常相似条件的 SpaceNukes 的需求。我们正在按照航空航天质量标准制造航空航天部件。这座建筑是我们学习制造它们的地方。”

paras.en: The Los Alamos facility complements SpaceNukes’ integration and test facility in Medina, Ohio, led by chief engineer Marc Gibson. SpaceNukes is now building hardware to test components for its Generation 2 reactors at the Ohio facility.
paras.zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯工厂补充了 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的集成和测试工厂，该工厂由总工程师马克·吉布森 (Marc Gibson) 领导。 SpaceNukes 目前正在俄亥俄州工厂建造硬件来测试其第二代反应堆的组件。

paras.en: The grand opening featured remarks from Phelps and Mireles, a ribbon cutting and tours of the new facility. Guests included staff from the office of Sen. Martin Heinrich, D-N.M.; Los Alamos National Laboratory and its Feynman Center for Innovation; the Los Alamos County Council; the Los Alamos County Community Development Department; the Los Alamos Commerce & Development Corp.; the Los Alamos Chamber of Commerce; Century Bank; Merrill Lynch; and space industry partners.
paras.zh: 菲尔普斯和米雷莱斯在盛大的开幕式上致辞，并剪彩并参观了新设施。嘉宾包括新墨西哥州民主党参议员马丁·海因里希 (Martin Heinrich) 办公室的工作人员；洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室及其费曼创新中心；洛斯阿拉莫斯县议会；洛斯阿拉莫斯县社区发展部；洛斯阿拉莫斯商业发展公司；洛斯阿拉莫斯商会；世纪银行；美林；以及航天工业合作伙伴。

paras.en: The facility opening follows SpaceNukes’ Oct. 21 announcement of an agreement with the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, under its Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program, to design, build and ground-test an actively controlled Kilopower reactor with Los Alamos National Laboratory. It comes as SpaceNukes works to fly a nuclear reactor by 2028.
paras.zh: 该设施开业之前，SpaceNukes 于 10 月 21 日宣布与国防高级研究计划局达成协议，根据其快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划，与洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室一起设计、建造和地面测试主动控制 Kilopower 反应堆。 SpaceNukes 正致力于在 2028 年之前飞行一座核反应堆。

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) builds nuclear reactors that power missions in space for government and commercial clients. In March 2018, the team that is now SpaceNukes ran a space reactor at full temperature and power for 28 hours, and it performed as predicted. It was the first time this had been done in the United States in 50 years. The team took it from concept to full power in three years for less than $20 million. Today, SpaceNukes has roughly 15 full-time employees, more than $50 million in contracts and agreements with the Department of War and NASA, two completed Space Force design reviews and a Los Alamos National Laboratory license for the reactor technology its founders invented there. Space Nuclear Power Corp., headquartered in Los Alamos, New Mexico, is committed to delivering safe, affordable, reliable nuclear power wherever people and machines go in space.
paras.zh: 太空核动力公司 (SpaceNukes) 建造核反应堆，为政府和商业客户的太空任务提供动力。 2018 年 3 月，SpaceNukes 团队在全温度和全功率下运行了一个空间反应堆 28 小时，其性能符合预期。这是美国 50 年来首次这样做。该团队用了不到 2000 万美元的时间，在三年内将其从概念转变为全面发挥作用。如今，SpaceNukes 拥有大约 15 名全职员工，与战争部和 NASA 签订了价值超过 5000 万美元的合同和协议，完成了两项太空部队设计审查，并为其创始人在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室发明的反应堆技术获得了许可证。太空核电公司总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，致力于为人类和机器进入太空的任何地方提供安全、负担得起、可靠的核电。

paras.en: Andrew Phelps, CEO, Space Nuclear Power Corp.
paras.zh: 安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps)，太空核电公司首席执行官

articles.title: Türk warns of widening risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians

paras.en: Türk warns of widening risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians
paras.zh: 蒂尔克警告巴勒斯坦人遭受暴行罪的风险不断扩大

paras.en: UN human rights chief Volker Türk on Wednesday warned of a widening risk of further atrocity crimes by Israel against Palestinians, saying violence in the occupied West Bank in recent months has heightened existential fears.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克周三警告称，以色列对巴勒斯坦人实施进一步暴行的风险不断加大，称近几个月来被占领的约旦河西岸发生的暴力事件加剧了人们的生存恐惧。

paras.en: “In Gaza, my office has repeatedly warned against the risk of Israeli actions posing a real threat to the continued existence of Palestinians as a group,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在加沙，我的办公室一再警告以色列的行动可能对巴勒斯坦人作为一个群体的继续存在构成真正的威胁。”

paras.en: “Events over the past months in the occupied West Bank exacerbate our fear of such risk across the entirety of the occupied Palestinian territory.”
paras.zh: “过去几个月在被占领的约旦河西岸发生的事件加剧了我们对整个被占领巴勒斯坦领土出现这种风险的担忧。”

paras.en: “Our warnings have not been heeded, and atrocity crimes continue to recur,” the High Commissioner said. “Civilians continue to be killed, and hundreds of thousands of Palestinians have been forcibly displaced, with senior Israeli officials indicating intent for such displacement to be permanent.”
paras.zh: 高级专员表示：“我们的警告没有得到重视，暴行犯罪仍在继续发生。” “平民继续被杀害，数十万巴勒斯坦人被迫流离失所，以色列高级官员表示有意让这种流离失所成为永久性的。”

paras.en: Since the 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attacks, 42,666 Palestinians have been forcibly displaced by Israeli forces and settlers in the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, according to the UN human rights office. In Gaza, nearly two million have been forcibly displaced, often multiple times.
paras.zh: 据联合国人权办公室称，自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击以来，包括东耶路撒冷在内的西岸地区有 42,666 名巴勒斯坦人被以色列军队和定居者强迫流离失所。在加沙，近两百万人被迫流离失所，而且往往是多次流离失所。

paras.en: “I am extremely worried about the increasingly widespread and systematic nature of the violations being perpetrated across both the West Bank and Gaza,” Mr. Türk said.
paras.zh: “我对约旦河西岸和加沙地带日益普遍和系统性的侵犯行为感到极其担忧，”蒂尔克先生说。

paras.en: “Civilian infrastructure is destroyed in Gaza, as illegal settlements advance in the West Bank,” he added. “Palestinians are persistently arbitrarily detained, subjected to torture and mistreatment, and exposed to a two-tier justice system. The list goes on and on.”
paras.zh: “随着非法定居点在西岸的推进，加沙的民用基础设施遭到破坏，”他补充道。 “巴勒斯坦人持续遭到任意拘留，遭受酷刑和虐待，并面临两级司法系统的制裁。这样的例子不胜枚举。”

paras.en: He expressed particular concern over continued unlawful killings in Gaza even after a ceasefire was announced last year.
paras.zh: 他对去年宣布停火后加沙持续发生的非法杀戮表示特别关注。

paras.en: Gaza’s population is confined to an ever-shrinking sliver of the territory, he said, while Israel’s continued blockade and closure deprive Palestinians of basic survival necessities, including food, medicine and shelter.
paras.zh: 他说，加沙的人口被限制在不断缩小的领土上，而以色列的持续封锁和封锁剥夺了巴勒斯坦人的基本生存必需品，包括食品、药品和住所。

paras.en: Mr. Türk also reminded Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups of their obligation to protect civilians and to respect the safety and independence of humanitarian personnel and operations, as well as the prohibitions of summary executions, arbitrary detention, torture and other ill-treatment.
paras.zh: 图尔克先生还提醒哈马斯和其他巴勒斯坦武装团体有义务保护平民、尊重人道主义人员和行动的安全和独立性，并禁止即决处决、任意拘留、酷刑和其他虐待行为。

paras.en: In the West Bank, he pointed to systematic, violent efforts to replace Palestinian communities with Israeli settlers and to fragment the territory in a way that undermines any prospect of a contiguous future Palestinian State.
paras.zh: 他指出，在西岸，以色列定居者以系统性的暴力行为取代巴勒斯坦社区，并分裂领土，从而破坏了未来巴勒斯坦国的任何前景。

paras.en: He also cited a system of racial segregation, oppression and domination, seen most clearly in a separate legal system for Palestinians and a discriminatory movement regime that prioritises settlers’ freedom of movement over Palestinians’ ability to exercise their basic rights in daily life.
paras.zh: 他还列举了种族隔离、压迫和统治的制度，最明显地体现在针对巴勒斯坦人的单独法律制度和歧视性运动制度中，该制度优先考虑定居者的行动自由，而不是巴勒斯坦人在日常生活中行使其基本权利的能力。

paras.en: “Israeli Government representatives at highest levels have time and again spelled out policies of annexation, ethnic cleansing, and collective punishment in the West Bank,” he said. “Across society, the incitement to hatred and to perpetration of violations amounting to atrocity crimes – war crimes, crimes against humanity and even genocide – has been appalling.”
paras.zh: “以色列政府最高层代表一再阐明在西岸的吞并、种族清洗和集体惩罚政策，”他说。 “在整个社会，煽动仇恨和实施相当于暴行罪——战争罪、反人类罪甚至种族灭绝罪——的行为令人震惊。”

paras.en: “All States have the obligation to act, now, to prevent further atrocity crimes against the Palestinians,” Mr. Türk said.
paras.zh: “所有国家现在都有义务采取行动，防止针对巴勒斯坦人的进一步暴行，”蒂尔克先生说。

paras.en: “There must be independent investigations, and those responsible must be held to account. The work of the international courts in this regard must be supported by all States.”
paras.zh: “必须进行独立调查，必须追究责任人的责任。国际法院在这方面的工作必须得到所有国家的支持。”

articles.title: DR Congo: Peacekepers step up civilian protection amid fighting in Ituri

paras.en: DR Congo: Peacekepers step up civilian protection amid fighting in Ituri
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国：维和人员在伊图里战斗中加强平民保护

paras.en: United Nations peacekeepers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have stepped up efforts to protect civilians in Ebola-hit Ituri province following renewed armed clashes in Djugu territory.
paras.zh: 在朱古地区再次爆发武装冲突后，联合国驻刚果民主共和国维和人员加大力度保护受埃博拉疫情影响的伊图里省的平民。

paras.en: The UN mission in the country, MONUSCO, reports that security has significantly deteriorated in several areas due to clashes between Congolese forces and the Convention for the Popular Revolution (CRP), one of dozens of armed groups in the resource-rich east.
paras.zh: 联合国驻该国特派团联刚稳定团报告称，由于刚果军队与人民革命公约组织（资源丰富的东部地区数十个武装组织之一）之间的冲突，多个地区的安全状况显着恶化。

paras.en: The fighting has displaced thousands of people and threatened access to essential health services.
paras.zh: 战斗导致数千人流离失所，并威胁到基本医疗服务的获得。

paras.en: MONUSCO said that heavy fighting had been reported on 18 November around Bule locality and the Savo Plain displacement site which hosts roughly 70,000 people.
paras.zh: 联刚稳定团表示，据报道，11 月 18 日，布勒地区和容纳约 7 万人的萨沃平原流离失所地点周围发生了激烈战斗。

paras.en: “The violence has triggered further population displacement, including among people who had already fled insecurity,” the UN mission said, noting that 24 civilians, mostly women and children, had sought refuge with its peacekeepers in Bayoo.
paras.zh: 联合国代表团表示：“暴力事件引发了更多人口流离失所，其中包括那些已经逃离不安全局势的人。”并指出，有 24 名平民（其中大部分是妇女和儿童）在巴尤向维和人员寻求庇护。

paras.en: Clashes and displacement in the Akwe, Damas and Mbidjo areas prompted MONUSCO’s Bangladeshi Rapid Deployment Battalion (BANRDB) to strengthen its presence on the ground and provide assistance to people in need, particularly healthcare workers.
paras.zh: 阿克维、达马斯和姆比乔地区的冲突和流离失所促使联刚稳定团的孟加拉国快速部署营（BANRDB）加强其在当地的存在，并向有需要的人，特别是医护人员提供援助。

paras.en: As a result, peacekeepers were able to evacuate 10 health workers from the Akwe General Referral Hospital on Tuesday, where they had been sheltering for over three days.
paras.zh: 结果，维和人员于周二从阿克维综合转诊医院撤离了 10 名卫生工作者，他们已经在那里避难了三天多。

paras.en: “These healthcare workers, who are actively involved in the response to the Ebola outbreak, play a vital role in assisting communities already weakened by violence and displacement,” MONUSCO said.
paras.zh: 联刚稳定团表示：“这些积极参与应对埃博拉疫情的医护人员在援助因暴力和流离失所而受到削弱的社区方面发挥着至关重要的作用。”

paras.en: The rescue operation had faced significant logistical challenges as the peacekeepers were forced to abandon their initial planned route due to difficult terrain, poor road conditions and a wooden bridge deemed too fragile to cross.
paras.zh: 由于地形崎岖、路况恶劣以及一座木桥过于脆弱而无法穿越，维和人员被迫放弃最初计划的路线，救援行动面临着巨大的后勤挑战。

paras.en: “This intervention is part of MONUSCO’s support for Ebola response efforts, particularly through the protection of healthcare personnel and the facilitation of safe access to healthcare for populations affected by violence,” the mission said.
paras.zh: 特派团表示：“这项干预措施是联刚稳定团支持埃博拉应对工作的一部分，特别是通过保护医护人员和促进受暴力影响的人群安全获得医疗服务。”

paras.en: MONUSCO noted that just four days earlier, Bangladeshi and Nepalese peacekeepers had facilitated the safe return of 380 civilians from Fataki locality to the Savo Plain displacement site after clashes had forced them to flee.
paras.zh: 联刚稳定团指出，就在四天前，孟加拉国和尼泊尔维和人员协助 380 名平民从法塔基地区安全返回萨沃平原流离失所地点，此前他们因冲突而逃离。

paras.en: The mission has also increased patrols in the area to protect civilians from violence on the part of armed groups.
paras.zh: 特派团还增加了该地区的巡逻，以保护平民免受武装团体的暴力侵害。

articles.title: Maritime trade stagnates amid geopolitical uncertainty

paras.en: Maritime trade stagnates amid geopolitical uncertainty
paras.zh: 地缘政治不确定性导致海上贸易停滞

paras.en: Seaborne trade that underpins the global economy continues to slow, while disruption from conflict and climate-related factors is hitting least-developed economies and small island nations hardest, UN economists said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国经济学家周四表示，支撑全球经济的海运贸易继续放缓，而冲突和气候相关因素造成的破坏对最不发达经济体和小岛屿国家造成的打击最为严重。

paras.en: In an update on worldwide maritime commerce, UN Trade and Development (UNCTAD) said that overall volumes transported on water reached 12.3 billion tonnes in 2025, but growth slowed to 1.9 per cent, which is half the pace of 2024.
paras.zh: 联合国贸易和发展会议 (UNCTAD) 在全球海运贸易最新情况中表示，2025 年水路运输总量达到 123 亿吨，但增速放缓至 1.9%，仅为 2024 年增速的一半。

paras.en: This year, with no less than four critical maritime chokepoints under pressure at the same time – the Strait of Hormuz, the Red Sea, the Black Sea and the Panama Canal – the agency projects no growth for 2026, followed by a recovery of 3.2 per cent in 2027.
paras.zh: 今年，霍尔木兹海峡、红海、黑海和巴拿马运河等至少四个重要的海上咽喉要道同时面临压力，该机构预计 2026 年不会出现增长，但到 2027 年将恢复 3.2%。

paras.en: “When shipping costs rise, consumers ultimately pay the price: but not everybody pays it equally,” said UNCTAD Acting Secretary-General, Pedro Manuel Moreno.
paras.zh: 贸发会议代理秘书长佩德罗·曼努埃尔·莫雷诺表示：“当运输成本上升时，消费者最终会付出代价：但并不是每个人都平等地付出代价。”

paras.en: Highlighting how attacks on shipping linked to the Iran-US war created a near-standstill in the flow of oil and gas from the Strait of Hormuz, Mr. Moreno noted that economies with little capacity to absorb shocks had suffered most from costlier fuel and greater transport and production costs, which had pushed up food prices and inflation.
paras.zh: 莫雷诺先生强调了与美伊战争有关的航运袭击如何导致霍尔木兹海峡的石油和天然气流动几乎停滞，他指出，那些无力吸收冲击的经济体受到燃料价格上涨以及运输和生产成本上涨的影响最大，这些成本推高了食品价格和通货膨胀。

paras.en: “Small island economies and least developed countries are particularly exposed,” he stressed, as the imports they rely on often require multiple shipping connections. “Every additional mile means more fuel, more time, and more cost.”
paras.zh: 他强调说：“小岛屿经济体和最不发达国家尤其容易受到影响，”因为它们所依赖的进口往往需要多个航运连接。 “每增加一英里就意味着更多的燃料、更多的时间和更多的成本。”

paras.en: According to UNCTAD, war risk premiums for a $100 million tanker reportedly jumped within days of disruption in Hormuz from about $200,000 to $1 million per voyage. Container lines added emergency war risk charges and fuel surcharges to cover their higher operating costs.
paras.zh: 据 UNCTAD 称，据报道，一艘价值 1 亿美元的油轮的战争险保费在霍尔木兹港中断后的几天内从每航次约 20 万美元跃升至 100 万美元。集装箱航运公司增加了紧急战争风险费用和燃油附加费，以弥补较高的运营成本。

paras.en: More than 80 per cent of the goods the world trades travel by sea, including the food and fuel that countries rely on. Rerouting ships keeps goods moving, but lengthens journeys and raises costs, especially for smaller economies.
paras.zh: 世界贸易中 80% 以上的货物通过海上运输，包括各国所依赖的食品和燃料。船舶改道可以保持货物运输，但会延长航程并增加成本，特别是对于较小的经济体而言。

paras.en: UNCTAD data underscores this trend, with trade volumes expected to see no growth this year whereas miles travelled are projected to increase by 1.5 per cent.
paras.zh: 贸发会议的数据强调了这一趋势，预计今年的贸易量不会增长，而行驶里程预计将增加 1.5%。

paras.en: According to the agency’s authoritative annual shipping report, if the current “fuel shock” continues into 2027, higher shipping costs alone could fuel consumer price hikes in least developed countries to almost twice the global average. “Disruption in one critical maritime corridor can quickly become a cost-of-living crisis thousands of miles away,” Mr. Moreno explained. “This is how disruptions to maritime transport translate into higher costs of living and widen inequalities between economies.”
paras.zh: 该机构权威的年度航运报告显示，如果当前的“燃油冲击”持续到2027年，仅航运成本上涨就可能导致最不发达国家的消费价格上涨至全球平均水平的近两倍。莫雷诺先生解释说：“一个关键海上走廊的中断可能很快就会成为数千英里之外的一场生活成本危机。” “这就是海上运输中断导致生活成本上升并扩大经济体之间不平等的方式。”

paras.en: In more positive developments, so-called “South-South” container routes that link markets, manufacturing centres and ports across Asia, Africa, the Middle East and Latin America grew by 12.1 per cent last year, accounting for nearly one-third of growth in containerized trade.
paras.zh: 更积极的发展是，连接亚洲、非洲、中东和拉丁美洲市场、制造中心和港口的所谓“南南”集装箱航线去年增长了12.1%，占集装箱贸易增长的近三分之一。

paras.en: In addition, over the past two decades, Least Developed Countries – most of them in Africa – have improved their shipping connectivity three times faster than the rest of the world, the UNCTAD report finds.
paras.zh: 此外，贸发会议报告发现，在过去二十年中，最不发达国家（其中大部分在非洲）改善航运连通性的速度是世界其他国家的三倍。

paras.en: “These gains matter, but they do not remove the underlying vulnerabilities,” Mr. Moreno said, reiterating the fragility of the world’s main maritime chokepoints.
paras.zh: 莫雷诺先生表示：“这些成果很重要，但它们并没有消除潜在的脆弱性。”他重申了世界主要海上咽喉要道的脆弱性。

paras.en: They offer the shortest and most efficient routes between two seas “and in some cases, the only route…but they are also among the hardest to replace”, he stressed, highlighting the high additional cost of having to redirect ships around southern Africa to avoid security risks in the Red Sea (since late 2023) and the Persian Gulf.
paras.zh: 他强调说，它们提供了两个海域之间最短、最高效的航线，“在某些情况下，是唯一的航线……但它们也是最难取代的航线之一”，并强调了必须在南部非洲重新调整船只以避免红海（自 2023 年底以来）和波斯湾的安全风险的高昂额外成本。

paras.en: To help vulnerable countries withstand ongoing and future disruption to shipping, UNCTAD’s Review of Maritime Transport urges shared stocks of food staples and fuel, along with pre-agreed alternative trade routes and customs procedures to keep essential goods moving.
paras.zh: 为了帮助脆弱国家抵御当前和未来的航运中断，贸发会议的海运审查敦促共享主食和燃料库存，以及预先商定的替代贸易路线和海关程序，以保持必需品的流通。

articles.title: What went wrong for Alonso's Chelsea at Forest?

paras.en: What went wrong for Chelsea as Xabi Alonso's side slip to new low following dismal defeat at Nottingham Forest
paras.zh: 切尔西出了什么问题，哈维·阿隆索的球队在诺丁汉森林惨败后跌至新低

paras.en: Sky Sports analyses the decisions from Xabi Alonso that contributed to Chelsea's 3-2 defeat to Nottingham Forest; Wesley Fofana started despite his controversial interview, while Levi Colwill was dropped; Xabi Alonso called for fundamentals but Chelsea were outrun
paras.zh: 天空体育分析了哈维·阿隆索导致切尔西 3-2 输给诺丁汉森林的决定；韦斯利·福法纳（Wesley Fofana）尽管接受了颇具争议的采访，但仍首发出场，而利瓦伊·科尔威尔（Levi Colwill）则被放弃；哈维·阿隆索呼吁基本面，但切尔西落后

paras.en: Xabi Alonso called for his Chelsea side to get back to the fundamentals before kick-off - and then watched on as they were outworked and outclassed on their way to a miserable 3-2 defeat at Nottingham Forest.
paras.zh: 哈维·阿隆索呼吁他的切尔西队在开球前回归基本面，然后眼睁睁地看着他们在诺丁汉森林队以 3-2 惨败的过程中劳累不堪、实力落后。

paras.en: "Everyone in the club and team, we need to stick together and go through this moment. We have to deal with it and we are responsible," Alonso told Sky Sports after the game, which marked their third successive defeat in the Premier League.
paras.zh: “俱乐部和球队的每个人，我们需要团结起来，度过这一刻。我们必须应对它，我们有责任。”赛后阿隆索告诉天空体育，这标志着他们在英超联赛中的第三场失利。

paras.en: "It is a difficult moment for everyone at the club. For the team and the fans. Disappointed to lose again but we need to keep trying to find solutions.
paras.zh: “对于俱乐部的每个人来说，这都是一个艰难的时刻。对于球队和球迷来说。再次失利令人失望，但我们需要继续努力寻找解决方案。

paras.en: "We can't stop. We are low in confidence. At this level you need to hold results and not concede so much. That is why we are losing."
paras.zh: “我们不能停下来。我们信心不足。在这个水平上，你需要保持结果，不要让步太多。这就是我们失败的原因。”

paras.en: Alonso now has as many losses in 15 games across all competitions as he did in 34 for Real Madrid (6). Since March, no side has more defeats in the top-flight than the Blues (14). And their problems are mounting by the day.
paras.zh: 阿隆索目前在各项赛事中的 15 场比赛中失利次数与他在皇马 34 场比赛中的失利次数（6 场）一样多。自三月份以来，没有哪支球队在顶级联赛中的失利次数超过蓝军（14 场）。他们的问题与日俱增。

paras.en: Here, Sky Sports analyses the decisions that contributed to the worrying defeat at the City Ground.
paras.zh: 在此，天空体育分析了导致城市球场令人担忧的失败的决定。

paras.en: Despite the calls from Alonso to strip the game back to basics and get the fundamentals right, Chelsea felt short from minute one.
paras.zh: 尽管阿隆索呼吁将比赛回归到基础并让基本面正确，但切尔西从第一分钟起就感觉很短暂。

paras.en: At the half-time interval, facing a 1-0 deficit and with zero shots on target, Chelsea had ran 3.8km less than Oliver Glasner's side.
paras.zh: 半场休息时，切尔西0-1落后，射正次数为零，比奥利弗·格拉斯纳的球队少跑了3.8公里。

paras.en: The Forest boss was then quick to point out that they had outrun their opponents by 6km after the game. Yes, Chelsea had more possession, but they were also well behind in high-speed runs.
paras.zh: 森林队主帅赛后很快指出，他们已经领先对手6公里。是的，切尔西拥有更多的控球权，但他们在高速跑动方面也远远落后。

paras.en: "I've seen one team jogging after the ball and one team sprinting after the ball and in this day and age, you cannot do that," said Jamie Redknapp.
paras.zh: “我见过一支球队在接球后慢跑，另一支球队在接球后冲刺，在当今时代，你不能这样做，”杰米·雷德克纳普说。

paras.en: "Distance covered is not always the barometer, but one thing is for sure, high-speed runs will tell you everything."
paras.zh: “跑步距离并不总是晴雨表，但有一件事是肯定的，高速跑步会告诉你一切。”

paras.en: Fofana in the firing line - should he have started?
paras.zh: 福法纳在前线——他应该首发吗？

paras.en: Starting Wesley Fofana in the same week the player had to apologise for his controversial interview, where he said he can "laugh about" the penalty miss that contributed to their Carabao Cup exit to Liverpool and contemplated retirement during injury spells at the club, was a bold move from Alonso. It did not pay off.
paras.zh: 韦斯利·福法纳在同一周首发，球员不得不为他有争议的采访道歉，他在采访中表示，他可以“嘲笑”导致卡拉宝杯被利物浦淘汰的点球失误，并在俱乐部受伤期间考虑退役，这是阿隆索的大胆举动。但它没有得到回报。

paras.en: The tone was set early on. Fofana's first touches were heavily booed by the travelling Chelsea fans who had made the 130-mile journey in the cold and rain to watch their side slip to yet another dismal defeat.
paras.zh: 基调很早就定下来了。福法纳的第一次触球遭到了切尔西球迷的强烈嘘声，他们在寒冷和雨中长途跋涉了 130 英里，眼睁睁地看着球队再次惨败。

paras.en: The centre-back could only watch on as Igor Jesus volleyed in his stunning opener but was at the centre of attention, for all the wrong reasons, for the second.
paras.zh: 这位中后卫只能眼睁睁地看着热苏斯在他令人惊叹的揭幕战中凌空抽射，但由于种种错误的原因，他在第二个进球中成为了人们关注的焦点。

paras.en: After misjudging the ball while battling with former teammate Liam Delap, who caused problems all evening, Fofana rushed to atone for his error and fouled the striker in the penalty area.
paras.zh: 在与前队友利亚姆·德拉普（Liam Delap）缠斗时误判球，造成整个晚上的麻烦，福法纳赶忙弥补自己的错误，并在禁区内对前锋犯规。

paras.en: Morgan Gibbs-White doubled the lead from the spot and ultimately the comeback, led by substitute Emmanuel Emegha, fell short.
paras.zh: 摩根·吉布斯·怀特 (Morgan Gibbs-White) 在点球大战中将领先优势扩大了一倍，但最终在替补出场的伊曼纽尔·埃梅加 (Emmanuel Emegha) 的带领下翻盘，但未能如愿。

paras.en: He was cautioned for the challenge and eventually taken off for Levi Colwill, who was dropped by Alonso instead of Fofana, and the fans booed him once again.
paras.zh: 他因挑战而受到黄牌警告，最终被利维·科尔威尔换下，后者被阿隆索代替福法纳换下，球迷们再次向他发出嘘声。

paras.en: "It didn't feel like a game for him tonight. He had a bad week with the podcast," said Jamie Redknapp after the game.
paras.zh: “今晚对他来说感觉不像一场比赛。他在播客方面度过了糟糕的一周，”杰米·雷德克纳普赛后说道。

paras.en: "By playing Fofana tonight, you created that. It was inevitable. He is lacking so much confidence; he needs some time.
paras.zh: “通过今晚对阵福法纳，你创造了这一点。这是不可避免的。他缺乏信心；他需要一些时间。

paras.en: "He is having a real difficult run of it at the moment."
paras.zh: “他现在正经历着一段非常艰难的时期。”

paras.en: After making the decision to drop Colwill, options at the centre of defence were limited with Maxence Lacroix and Reece James both sidelined.
paras.zh: 在决定放弃科尔威尔后，后防中锋的选择受到限制，马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦和里斯·詹姆斯都缺席。

paras.en: Playing Josh Acheampong at centre-back and giving a rare start to Malo Gusto, an unused substitute on the night, seemed the more obvious choice but Alonso opted to play Moises Caicedo, arguably the best midfielder in the league, in the back four instead.
paras.zh: 让乔什·阿奇姆蓬担任中后卫，并为当晚未上场的替补马洛·古斯托提供罕见的首发机会，这似乎是更明显的选择，但阿隆索选择让莫伊塞斯·凯塞多——可以说是联盟中最好的中场球员——担任后四名。

paras.en: He was then tasked with dealing with a strike partnership of Delap and Igor Jesus. A difficult task for even the tallest of centre-backs, let alone a makeshift one standing at 5-foot-10.
paras.zh: 随后，他的任务是处理德拉普和伊戈尔·热苏斯的罢工搭档。即使对于最高的中后卫来说，这也是一项艰巨的任务，更不用说身高 5 英尺 10 英寸的临时中后卫了。

paras.en: He gave space to the Brazil striker for the opener and his presence in midfield was missed. He still led the way with 114 passes on the night, but Chelsea needed him in the middle of the park to deal with the likes of James McAtee and Xaver Schlager.
paras.zh: 他在揭幕战中为巴西前锋提供了空间，但他在中场的表现却被错过了。当晚他仍然以 114 次传球领先，但切尔西需要他在中场对付詹姆斯·麦卡蒂和 Xaver Schlager 等人。

paras.en: "They have bought players but if they do not sign a centre back, they cannot compete," said Redknapp after the game. He is right.
paras.zh: “他们买了球员，但如果不签下中后卫，他们就无法参加比赛，”雷德克纳普赛后说道。他是对的。

paras.en: Emegha's impact was too little, too late
paras.zh: Emegha 的影响太小，也太晚了

paras.en: Alonso admitted that Emegha's performance after scoring twice off the bench was the lone positive for his side to take from their trip to the East Midlands. "For sure, he is having a good impact," he said. "He has done well. That is a positive."
paras.zh: 阿隆索承认，埃梅加替补上场梅开二度后的表现是他的球队在东米德兰兹之旅中获得的唯一积极因素。 “当然，他正在产生良好的影响，”他说。 “他做得很好。这是积极的。”

paras.en: He scored his first goal in the 4-1 defeat to Leeds United last time out but lost his place in the starting line-up on Friday.
paras.zh: 他在上一场1-4输给利兹联的比赛中打进了自己的首个进球，但在周五失去了首发位置。

paras.en: Danny Welbeck, 36, was given the nod ahead of him and his performance mirrored the struggles Chelsea had as a unit.
paras.zh: 36 岁的丹尼·维尔贝克（Danny Welbeck）在他之前获得了认可，他的表现反映了切尔西作为一个整体所面临的困境。

paras.en: Alonso called on the experience of Jordan Henderson and Welbeck to help weather their current struggles but it only whipped up the storm.
paras.zh: 阿隆索依靠乔丹·亨德森和维尔贝克的经验来帮助他们渡过目前的困境，但这只是激起了风暴。

paras.en: Welbeck was a bystander in the first half and had just seven touches before being replaced at the break, Emegha then scored with his first two to help spark hopes of a comeback.
paras.zh: 维尔贝克在上半场作为旁观者，只触球七次，中场休息时被换下，随后埃梅加打进两球，帮助点燃了翻盘的希望。

paras.en: His header for the second, holding off Jair Cunha, was one of the rare moments Chelsea matched the physicality of their opponents. He has to start moving forward without Joao Pedro available.
paras.zh: 第二个进球，他的头球顶住了贾尔·库尼亚的头球，这是切尔西为数不多的与对手身体对抗的时刻之一。如果若奥·佩德罗无法上场，他必须开始前进。

paras.en: Alonso said the only way he knows how to address these issues is to attack them on the training ground. He has just five days to do that before they are put to the test against Crystal Palace, live on Sky Sports, who will be desperate for a win.
paras.zh: 阿隆索表示，他知道解决这些问题的唯一方法就是在训练场上解决这些问题。他只有五天的时间来做到这一点，然后他们将接受天空体育直播对阵水晶宫的考验，水晶宫将迫切希望获胜。

articles.title: Dawson: Rashid is still England's No 1 white-ball spinner

paras.en: England T20s in Australia: Liam Dawson says Adil Rashid still No 1 spinner as tourists target series victory in Sydney
paras.zh: 英格兰T20在澳大利亚：利亚姆·道森表示阿迪尔·拉希德仍然是第一旋转选手，游客瞄准了悉尼系列赛的胜利

paras.en: Liam Dawson has been preferred to Adil Rashid in ODIs of late but spinners play together in T20s, helping England into a 2-1 series lead over Australia with two matches left; Dawson hails two more spinners in James Coles and Rehan Ahmed ahead of Sunday's fixture in Sydney (8.15am UK)
paras.zh: 利亚姆·道森（Liam Dawson）最近在 ODI 中比阿迪尔·拉希德（Adil Rashid）更受青睐，但旋转选手在 T20 中一起比赛，帮助英格兰在还剩两场比赛的情况下以 2-1 领先澳大利亚；在周日悉尼比赛（英国上午 8.15）之前，道森对另外两名旋转选手 James Coles 和 Rehan Ahmed 表示欢迎

paras.en: Liam Dawson insists Adil Rashid remains England's No 1 white-ball spinner - even though he has seemingly taken the Yorkshireman's place as first-choice pick in ODIs.
paras.zh: 利亚姆·道森（Liam Dawson）坚称阿迪尔·拉希德（Adil Rashid）仍然是英格兰第一白球旋转手，尽管他似乎已经取代了约克郡人成为 ODI 的第一选择。

paras.en: Stalwart Rashid, 38, has been left out of England's last six 50-over encounters - three in Pakistan and then three in Australia - with Dawson the frontline slow bowler for those games.
paras.zh: 38岁的坚定拉希德（Stalwart Rashid）被排除在英格兰队过去六场50岁以上交锋之外——三场在巴基斯坦，三场在澳大利亚——道森是这些比赛中的前线慢速投球手。

paras.en: The duo form a potent pairing in T20 internationals, though, and bowled economically - and in Dawson's case prolifically, as he took 3-16 from three overs - in Brisbane on Friday as England took a 2-1 lead over Australia in the five-match series.
paras.zh: 不过，两人在 T20 国际赛中形成了强有力的搭档，并且在周五的布里斯班比赛中，英格兰队在五场系列赛中以 2-1 领先澳大利亚，并且在布里斯班的比赛中，道森的投球表现非常出色，他在三轮比赛中取得了 3-16 的成绩。

paras.en: - Jamie Overton goes 'back to basics' to deliver big England win
paras.zh: - 杰米·奥弗顿“回归基础”为英格兰队带来重大胜利

paras.en: - Australia's Sandpapergate probe to include 2017-18 Ashes
paras.zh: - 澳大利亚的 Sandpapergate 调查将包括 2017-18 灰烬

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream contract-free with NOW
paras.zh: - 最新的天空体育优惠或通过 NOW 进行无合同直播

paras.en: Speaking ahead of Sunday's fourth fixture in Sydney (8.15am UK), Dawson, 36, said: "I'm not sure I've knocked him out [of the team] because it's all conditions dependent, but he's still England's best white-ball spinner, without doubt," he said.
paras.zh: 周日在悉尼举行的第四场比赛（英国上午 8 点 15 分）前，36 岁的道森表示：“我不确定我是否已经将他排除在球队之外，因为这取决于具体情况，但毫无疑问，他仍然是英格兰最好的白球旋转手，”他说。

paras.en: "I wouldn't look too far into what's happened on this trip, or in Pakistan before that. He'll certainly come good again because he's a world-class performer."
paras.zh: “我不会过多关注这次旅行或之前在巴基斯坦发生的事情。他肯定会再次表现出色，因为他是一位世界级的表演者。”

paras.en: On his own ascent into a key player for England, Dawson said: "Having the backing of [captain Harry Brook] for the past 18 months, and to play as much as I have, has been brilliant. I've really enjoyed it and hopefully I can carry on and keep performing.
paras.zh: 在谈到自己成为英格兰队的关键球员时，道森表示：“在过去 18 个月里得到[队长哈里·布鲁克]的支持，并尽可能多地踢球，这真是太棒了。我真的很享受它，希望我能继续下去并继续表现。”

paras.en: "It's obviously nice but I'm very realistic from a personal point of view. I know how good Rash is, everybody in world cricket knows how good he is."
paras.zh: “这显然很好，但从个人角度来看，我非常现实。我知道拉什有多好，世界板球界的每个人都知道他有多好。”

paras.en: Dawson also hailed two more England spinners, in Sussex's James Coles, who made his debut against Australia in this T20 series, and Rehan Ahmed, who has been added to the squad for the final two fixtures following Will Jacks' trip ending early due to a broken hand.
paras.zh: 道森还赞扬了另外两名英格兰旋转球员，分别是苏塞克斯队的詹姆斯·科尔斯（James Coles）和雷汉·艾哈迈德（Rehan Ahmed），前者在T20系列赛对阵澳大利亚的比赛中首次亮相，后者在威尔·杰克斯（Will Jacks）因手部骨折提前结束行程后被列入最后两场比赛的阵容。

paras.en: The Hampshire bowler added: "Colesy has done so well for someone so young, I think people forget that, and he's got a hell of a lot of cricket ahead of him.
paras.zh: 这位汉普郡保龄球手补充道：“科尔西对于一个如此年轻的人来说表现得非常好，我认为人们忘记了这一点，而且他还有很多板球比赛等着他。

paras.en: "Rehan's a great lad, I've known him a couple of years now and he's one of the hardest workers - always wants to bat, always wants to bowl, always wants to field. He's got a fantastic attitude.
paras.zh: “雷汉是一个很棒的小伙子，我已经认识他几年了，他是最努力的人之一——总是想击球，总是想投球，总是想上场。他的态度非常棒。

paras.en: "I've played a lot of cricket and I'm a lot older than those guys so I'll chat to them in training.
paras.zh: “我打过很多板球，而且我比那些家伙年长很多，所以我会在训练中和他们聊天。

paras.en: "You've always got to find your own way as well, work it out a little bit, but I'm very happy to speak to them both and help, of course."
paras.zh: “你也总是必须找到自己的方式，稍微解决一下，但我很高兴与他们交谈并提供帮助，当然。”

articles.title: Explosive Fury vs Klitschko canvas row revisited

paras.en: Tyson Fury vs Wladimir Klitschko: Revisit the furious canvas row that changed the course of the heavyweight division
paras.zh: 泰森·富里 vs 弗拉基米尔·克里琴科：重温改变重量级赛程的激烈帆布争吵

paras.en: On November 28 in 2015 Tyson Fury toppled the man who had dominated the heavyweight division when he beat Wladimir Klitschko in Dusseldorf; But he almost had to scuttle the contest on the day of the fight in an explosive row over the ring surface, which saw Vitali Klitschko weighing in
paras.zh: 2015年11月28日，泰森·富里在杜塞尔多夫击败弗拉基米尔·克里琴科，推翻了重量级拳王的统治地位；但在比赛当天，他在擂台表面发生了一场爆炸性的争吵，差点毁掉了比赛，维塔利·克里琴科也加入了进来。

paras.en: On this day in 2015 Tyson Fury scaled his Everest. He dethroned Wladimir Klitschko, the dominant heavyweight of that era, to win the unified WBO, IBF and WBA world heavyweight championships.
paras.zh: 2015 年的这一天，泰森·福里 (Tyson Fury) 登上了珠穆朗玛峰。他击败了那个时代重量级拳王弗拉基米尔·克里琴科，统一赢得了WBO、IBF和WBA世界重量级冠军。

paras.en: It was the goal Fury had targeted throughout his career. Klitschko had ruled the division for a decade and was selling out stadiums in Germany.
paras.zh: 这是弗瑞整个职业生涯的目标。克里琴科统治了该级别十年，德国的体育场门票全部售空。

paras.en: Fury travelled to Dusseldorf as the underdog but utterly confident he had the tools to unravel Klitschko.
paras.zh: 富里以失败者的身份前往杜塞尔多夫，但他完全相信自己有能力击败克里琴科。

paras.en: However on the day of the fight, an explosive row at the Esprit Arena threatened to scuttle the whole event.
paras.zh: 然而比赛当天，Esprit Arena 发生了一场爆炸性的争吵，有可能破坏整个赛事。

paras.en: Peter Fury, Tyson's uncle and then trainer, decided he wanted to inspect the ring in advance. Then they spotted something they hadn't expected. Feeling the canvas, they realised that the layers under it were spongy.
paras.zh: 泰森的叔叔、当时的教练彼得·弗瑞决定提前检查擂台。然后他们发现了一些意想不到的事情。触摸画布，他们意识到画布下面的层是海绵状的。

paras.en: Tyson Fury climbed through the ropes to bounce on the balls of his feet on the canvas where he was due, a few hours later, to stage a remarkable win.
paras.zh: 泰森·富里爬过绳索，用脚掌在画布上弹跳，几个小时后，他将取得一场非凡的胜利。

paras.en: "No way you can fight on that," his father John Fury said.
paras.zh: “你不可能为此而战，”他的父亲约翰·弗瑞说。

paras.en: "You know what they've done that for," the then heavyweight title challenger said, "so I can't move."
paras.zh: “你知道他们这么做是为了什么，”当时的重量级冠军挑战者说道，“所以我不能动。”

paras.en: Speaking to the camera, Tyson Fury declared: "They must have half a foot deep of sponge on the canvas. It's like training on a beach on the sand. It's absolutely ridiculous and I can tell you now, Sky Sports viewers, there's no fight if that ring ain't sorted.
paras.zh: 泰森·富里对着镜头宣称：“他们的画布上一定有半英尺深的海绵。这就像在沙滩上训练一样。这绝对是荒谬的，我现在可以告诉你们，天空体育的观众，如果戒指没有整理好，就没有战斗。”

paras.en: "I'm a mover and I move, that's the way I fight. I can't move in that ring."
paras.zh: “我是一个移动者，我移动，这就是我战斗的方式。我不能在那个环里移动。”

paras.en: History could have been very different. If he'd gone ahead with the fight, he could - probably would - have lost. He certainly wouldn't have been able to box in the way he did so successfully later that night.
paras.zh: 历史可能会大不相同。如果他继续战斗，他可能——很可能——会失败。他当然不可能像那天晚上晚些时候那样成功地进行拳击。

paras.en: "My fighter is not fighting in quicksand," his trainer Peter Fury declared at the time.
paras.zh: “我的拳手不是在流沙中战斗，”他的教练彼得·弗瑞当时宣称。

paras.en: They undid the ring canvas to look underneath; there were two soft layers that they insisted had to be removed.
paras.zh: 他们解开环形帆布看下面；他们坚持认为必须除去两层软层。

paras.en: Vitali Klitschko, Wladimir's older brother and a fearsome former world heavyweight champion himself, was on hand to respond. He stood in the ring himself, towering over the top rope and glowering down at Fury's team on the floor of the arena.
paras.zh: 弗拉基米尔的哥哥、令人畏惧的前世界重量级冠军维塔利·克里琴科也在现场做出回应。他亲自站在擂台上，高高地耸立在最上面的绳子上，怒视着竞技场地板上的弗瑞的球队。

paras.en: Mick Hennessy, Fury's promoter, told him: "You're trying to control this but it's not in the interest of health and safety. So we need it sorted.
paras.zh: 弗瑞的发起人米克·轩尼诗（Mick Hennessy）告诉他：“你试图控制这一点，但这不符合健康和安全的利益。所以我们需要解决这个问题。”

paras.en: "Your ankle or your knee could go on this, it's too thick."
paras.zh: “你的脚踝或膝盖可能会被压到，它太厚了。”

paras.en: Vitali, a formidable advocate for his brother, argued fiercely, gesturing animatedly as he said: "Both fighters have the same conditions. Same gloves, same ring and you're unhappy always.
paras.zh: 维塔利是他兄弟的强大支持者，他激烈争论，并生动地打着手势说：“两位拳手的条件都是一样的。同样的手套，同样的戒指，你总是不高兴。”

paras.en: "Everything you say is excuses," he roared. "Do you want to fight or not?"
paras.zh: “你所说的一切都是借口，”他咆哮道。 “你想打还是不想打？”

paras.en: Fury's team weren't bluffing though. They were prepared to walk away.
paras.zh: 不过，弗瑞的团队并没有虚张声势。他们准备走开。

paras.en: John Fury raged at Bernd Boente, Klitschko's manager, in a corridor at the arena. He told him directly: "The fight's off, forget about it." Then he stormed off.
paras.zh: 约翰·弗瑞在球馆的走廊里对克里琴科的经纪人贝恩德·博恩特大发雷霆。他直接告诉他：“战斗结束了，别想了。”然后他怒气冲冲地走了。

paras.en: He later said: "If they hadn't replaced it, there wouldn't have been a fight."
paras.zh: 他后来说：“如果他们没有更换它，就不会发生战斗。”

paras.en: Fury's team got their way. The offending layers were removed and Fury did indeed use his footwork and mobile long-range boxing to defuse Klitschko, a dangerous puncher, so adept normally at controlling distance but who just couldn't pin down an inspired Fury.
paras.zh: 弗瑞的团队如愿以偿。进攻层被移除，富里确实用他的步法和移动远程拳击来化解克里琴科，一个危险的拳击手，通常擅长控制距离，但就是无法压制住充满灵感的富里。

paras.en: That blazing row did change the course of the heavyweight division. It was an important element in a monumental victory for the Englishman. Fury became the dominant figure in the weight class. He was unable to meet Klitschko again in a rematch; struggling with depression, he stepped away from the sport.
paras.zh: 那场激烈的争吵确实改变了重量级比赛的进程。这是英国人取得巨大胜利的重要因素。弗瑞成为了重量级别的统治者。他无法在复赛中再次遇到克里琴科；由于与抑郁症作斗争，他退出了这项运动。

paras.en: But Fury's mental health improved and he was able to make a famous comeback. He cemented his legend against Deontay Wilder, becoming a two-time heavyweight world champion without losing a fight.
paras.zh: 但富里的心理健康状况有所改善，他得以完成著名的复出。他在与德昂泰·维尔德的比赛中巩固了自己的传奇，在不输一场比赛的情况下成为两届重量级世界冠军。

paras.en: Now he has the chance to become a three-time champion when he fights his great rival Anthony Joshua for the first time with a vacant WBA title on the line.
paras.zh: 现在，当他首次与劲敌安东尼·约书亚交锋时，他有机会成为三届冠军，而空缺的WBA冠军头衔也岌岌可危。

paras.en: That climactic fight is two weeks away as Fury looks to start the final chapter in a championship story that began 11 years ago today.
paras.zh: 距离这场巅峰之战还有两周时间，富里希望开启 11 年前今天开始的冠军故事的最后一章。

articles.title: 2 men charged with burglary after break-in at Prince William and Princess Kate’s country home
articles.author: Henry Austin

paras.en: LONDON — Two men have been charged in connection with a burglary at the royal family’s Sandringham estate, British police said Wednesday, after a reported break-in at the country home of Prince William and Princess Kate.
paras.zh: 伦敦——英国警方周三表示，在威廉王子和凯特王妃的乡村住宅发生入室盗窃事件后，英国警方周三表示，两名男子因涉嫌入室盗窃而被指控。

paras.en: The pair were charged with entering a dwelling with intent to steal and trespassing on a protected site, the local police force said in a statement.
paras.zh: 当地警方在一份声明中称，两人被指控进入住宅意图盗窃和侵入受保护的地点。

paras.en: Officers were called just before 6 p.m. local time (1 p.m. ET) on Monday “to reports of suspicious activity at a property,” Norfolk Constabulary said. “Police and specialist resources attended and two men were arrested nearby on suspicion of burglary and trespass and taken into custody for questioning,” the statement added.
paras.zh: 下午 6 点左右，警方接到报警。诺福克警察局表示，当地时间周一（美国东部时间下午 1 点）“接到有关某处房产可疑活动的报告”。声明补充说：“警察和专家人员赶到现场，两名男子因涉嫌入室盗窃和非法侵入而在附近被捕，并被拘留接受审讯。”

paras.en: The two men, named by police as Mirgen Doku, 34, and Arilen Ndoci, 32, have now been charged.
paras.zh: 警方称这两名男子为 34 岁的米尔根·多库 (Mirgen Doku) 和 32 岁的阿里伦·恩多西 (Arilen Ndoci)，现已受到指控。

paras.en: The pair were remanded in custody after a brief court appearance in the eastern city of Norwich on Wednesday morning, according to Britain’s Press Association news agency. Describing the accused as Albanian nationals, the agency reported that they were accused of stealing six pairs of cuff links and a clock, value unknown.
paras.zh: 据英国新闻协会通讯社报道，周三上午，两人在东部城市诺维奇短暂出庭后被还押。该机构将被告描述为阿尔巴尼亚国民，称他们被指控盗窃六对袖扣和一个时钟，价值未知。

paras.en: David Harrison, the games and conservation manager at the Sandringham Estate, told the court he was conducting a patrol when he saw two males jump through a hedgerow and run into a wooded area using a thermal spotter, according to the PA. He said he followed in a utility motor vehicle but could not locate the men.
paras.zh: 据 PA 报道，桑德灵厄姆庄园的游戏和保护经理戴维·哈里森 (David Harrison) 告诉法庭，他当时正在巡逻，看到两只雄性使用热观测仪跳过树篱，跑进树林里。他说，他开着一辆多功能汽车跟踪，但找不到这些人。

paras.en: The property, gifted to the heir to the British throne and his wife by the late Queen Elizabeth II as a wedding present, is nestled in the heart of the royals’ sprawling estate.
paras.zh: 该房产是已故女王伊丽莎白二世作为结婚礼物赠送给英国王位继承人及其妻子的礼物，坐落在王室庞大庄园的中心。

paras.en: In an earlier statement, police said the property which has its own private swimming pool, a full-size, artificial grass tennis court and vast grounds, was unoccupied at the time of the incident.
paras.zh: 警方在早些时候的一份声明中表示，该房产拥有自己的私人游泳池、一个全尺寸的人造草地网球场和广阔的场地，但在事件发生时无人居住。

paras.en: Separately, a royal source told NBC News that the couple and their three children, George, Charlotte and Louis, were not there at the time.
paras.zh: 另外，一位王室消息人士告诉 NBC 新闻，这对夫妇和他们的三个孩子乔治、夏洛特和路易斯当时并不在场。

paras.en: The couple and their children have often enjoyed weekend breaks and holidays at the royal estate in eastern England.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇和他们的孩子经常在英格兰东部的皇家庄园享受周末和假期。

paras.en: While they weren’t present at the time of the burglary, the incident is a significant security breach for the royals.
paras.zh: 虽然入室盗窃发生时他们并不在场，但这一事件对王室来说是一个重大的安全漏洞。

paras.en: The break in “of course, raises huge concerns,” NBC News royal contributor Emily Nash said Wednesday. “This is the home of our future king and queen.”
paras.zh: NBC 新闻皇家撰稿人艾米丽·纳什 (Emily Nash) 周三表示，这次闯入“当然引起了巨大的担忧”。 “这是我们未来国王和王后的家。”

paras.en: “Nobody wants to feel as though their home, their private space is being violated,” she said. “They do have a great deal of security in place and so they’ll be looking at why that has lapsed.”
paras.zh: “没有人愿意感觉自己的家、私人空间受到侵犯，”她说。 “他们确实有大量的安全措施，所以他们会研究为什么安全措施失效了。”

paras.en: Security arrangements “are naturally cloaked in secrecy because they don’t want to let people know too much about what’s happening,” she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，安全安排“自然是保密的，因为他们不想让人们过多了解正在发生的事情”。

paras.en: “Essentially, it’s a bit like an onion. They have multiple layers of security,” she said, adding that when they were on the estate “they also have their armed police protection officers who ensure that nobody can get close to them.”
paras.zh: “本质上，这有点像洋葱。他们有多层安全措施，”她说，并补充说，当他们进入庄园时，“他们还有武装警察保护人员，确保没有人可以接近他们。”

paras.en: Anmer Hall, a 10-bedroom country house built in the early 1800s, entered the royals’ extensive property portfolio when it was bought in 1898 by Queen Victoria’s son, who would later become King Edward VII.
paras.zh: 安默厅 (Anmer Hall) 是一座建于 1800 年代初、拥有 10 间卧室的乡间别墅，于 1898 年被维多利亚女王的儿子（后来成为国王爱德华七世）买下，进入了王室的广泛财产组合。

paras.en: The prince and princess of Wales’ main home is Forest Lodge in Windsor, a small town around 30 miles west of London. The couple said they moved there for a “fresh start” in 2025 after the death of the late queen and Kate’s cancer diagnosis.
paras.zh: 威尔士王子和王妃的主要住所是位于伦敦以西约 30 英里的小镇温莎的森林小屋。这对夫妇表示，在已故女王去世和凯特被诊断出癌症后，他们于 2025 年搬到了那里，希望有一个“新的开始”。

paras.en: There have been several previous high profile security breaches involving the royal family.
paras.zh: 此前曾发生过数起涉及王室的引人注目的安全漏洞事件。

paras.en: In October 2024, burglars broke into the Windsor Castle estate and stole a pickup truck and a quad bike from a farm building. King Charles and Queen Camilla weren’t at the property at the time.
paras.zh: 2024 年 10 月，窃贼闯入温莎城堡庄园，从一座农场建筑中偷走了一辆皮卡车和一辆四轮摩托车。查尔斯国王和卡米拉王后当时并不在庄园。

paras.en: But perhaps the most famous break in came in 1982, when a man called Michael Fagan managed to sneak into the queen’s private chambers while she was in bed. The queen spent 10 minutes talking with the intruder before raising the alarm when he asked for a cigarette.
paras.zh: 但最著名的闯入事件可能发生在 1982 年，当时一名名叫迈克尔·费根 (Michael Fagan) 的男子趁女王睡觉时潜入了她的私人卧室。女王花了10分钟与入侵者交谈，然后当他要香烟时才发出警报。

paras.en: The latest incursion came days before the release of a new documentary about Kate’s cancer diagnosis and remission, called “Heal.”
paras.zh: 最近一次入侵发生在一部关于凯特癌症诊断和缓解的新纪录片《治愈》发布前几天。

paras.en: Set to air on NBC on Nov. 30 at 8 p.m. ET/PT before streaming on Peacock from Dec. 1., the highly personal film will see her share her private thoughts on her illness and recovery.
paras.zh: 定于 11 月 30 日晚上 8 点在 NBC 播出这部高度个人化的电影将在美国东部时间/太平洋时间 12 月 1 日起在 Peacock 上播出，届时她将分享她对疾病和康复的私人想法。

paras.en: “It changes your body, it changes you physically, but there is a much, much deeper part to what a cancer diagnosis shifts in you,” Kate says in a clip released ahead of Sunday’s air date
paras.zh: 凯特在周日播出前发布的一段视频中说道：“它改变了你的身体，它改变了你的身体，但癌症诊断对你的改变还有更深层次的影响。”

paras.en: “It is often through pain that we realize there is a greater beauty that lies beyond that,” she adds.
paras.zh: “往往是通过痛苦，我们才意识到除此之外还有更伟大的美丽，”她补充道。

articles.title: Princess Kate wants people to learn from her cancer journey in vulnerable new documentary
articles.author: Jean-Nicholas Fievet

paras.en: LONDON — Catherine, Princess of Wales, reveals how cancer treatment terrified and changed her in a very personal documentary she said she hopes will help others reckon with the disease.
paras.zh: 伦敦——威尔士王妃凯瑟琳在一部非常私人的纪录片中讲述了癌症治疗如何让她感到恐惧和改变，她说她希望这能帮助其他人正视这种疾病。

paras.en: In “Heal,” the royal reflects on mortality with an openness and vulnerability that breaks with the royals’ trademark stoicism and reserve, describing the human challenges she faces after her treatment. The normally private princess gives viewers a glimpse — albeit a highly controlled one — of her cancer journey in the 30-minute film, which was produced to raise money for the Royal Marsden Hospital in London, where she received chemotherapy. The film marks a change in the way royals have spoken about their personal lives.
paras.zh: 在《治愈》中，王室成员以一种开放和脆弱的态度反思了死亡，这打破了王室成员标志性的坚忍和保守，描述了她在接受治疗后面临的人类挑战。在这部时长 30 分钟的电影中，这位一向低调的公主让观众一睹她的癌症之旅——尽管这是高度控制的——该片的制作目的是为伦敦皇家马斯登医院筹集资金，她在那里接受了化疗。这部电影标志着王室成员谈论个人生活的方式发生了变化。

paras.en: “William and Kate are communicating more directly with the public than ever before and being more open emotionally than we’ve ever seen,” said Emily Nash, NBC News’ royal contributor. “That really, I think, is as a result of her cancer diagnosis. It’s really changed their lives and they want to share what they’ve learned with the world.”
paras.zh: NBC 新闻的王室撰稿人艾米丽·纳什 (Emily Nash) 表示：“威廉和凯特与公众的沟通比以往任何时候都更加直接，情感上也比我们所见过的更加开放。” “我认为，这确实是她被诊断出癌症的结果。这确实改变了他们的生活，他们想与世界分享他们所学到的东西。”

paras.en: Speaking in London at a special screening of the documentary that will air on NBC on Nov. 30 at 8 p.m. ET/PT before streaming on Peacock from Dec. 1, Kate told reporters that cancer “doesn’t just affect the body. It changes how you think and feel and profoundly affects every aspect of life.”
paras.zh: 这部纪录片将于 11 月 30 日晚上 8 点在伦敦播出，并在 NBC 的特别放映会上发表讲话。在 12 月 1 日开始在 Peacock 直播之前，凯特告诉记者，癌症“不仅仅影响身体。它会改变你的思维和感觉，并深刻影响生活的方方面面。”

paras.en: “I know this personally, and that the journey through and beyond treatment requires more than medicine alone,” she said.
paras.zh: “我个人知道这一点，并且治疗和超越治疗的过程需要的不仅仅是药物，”她说。

paras.en: In the film, Kate explains how cancer changed her.
paras.zh: 在影片中，凯特解释了癌症如何改变了她。

paras.en: “Once you experience something like that, it’s very hard to go back to the person you were before,” she says.
paras.zh: “一旦你经历过类似的事情，就很难回到以前的样子，”她说。

paras.en: “Something like cancer strips everything away,” added Kate, who has made cancer support a central part of her work since her illness. “Yes, it’s physical, but it’s emotional too. The things you thought you knew are no longer there. And you do, in a way, lose yourself.”
paras.zh: “像癌症这样的东西会剥夺一切，”凯特补充道，自从患病以来，她就将癌症支持作为她工作的核心部分。 “是的，这是身体上的，但也是情感上的。你以为你知道的东西已经不复存在了。从某种程度上来说，你确实迷失了自己。”

paras.en: Rugged British landscapes play a central role in the film. It was simply shot and accompanied by a score by Scottish composer Erland Cooper, who drew inspiration from birdsong and the natural world.
paras.zh: 崎岖的英国风景在影片中扮演着核心角色。它是由苏格兰作曲家厄兰·库珀（Erland Cooper）简单拍摄并配乐的，他从鸟鸣和自然世界中汲取了灵感。

paras.en: The documentary “also carries with it a deeper message,” she added. “Healing, whether personal or collective, is not just about fixing what is wrong. It is about finding balance in how we live. Between effort and acceptance, between control and trust, between thinking and simply being.”
paras.zh: 她补充说，这部纪录片“还传达了更深刻的信息”。 “治疗，无论是个人的还是集体的，不仅仅是解决问题。它是在我们的生活方式中找到平衡。在努力和接受之间，在控制和信任之间，在思考和简单存在之间。”

paras.en: Kate had already broken with royal tradition when revealing her diagnosis and subsequent remission. Rather than issuing a traditional text statement, she announced she was receiving treatment for the disease in a three-minute video.
paras.zh: 凯特在透露自己的诊断结果和随后的病情缓解时就已经打破了王室传统。她没有发布传统的文字声明，而是通过一段三分钟的视频宣布她正在接受这种疾病的治疗。

paras.en: Alongside her family, in a sepia-toned follow-up video featuring mellow music, cinematic angles and slow-motion effects, Kate later announced her return to royal duties.
paras.zh: 在一段以柔和的音乐、电影般的角度和慢动作效果为特色的深褐色色调的后续视频中，凯特与家人一起宣布重返王室职责。

paras.en: The royals have invited cameras into their lives before, notably in 1969’s “Royal Family” documentary, which showed Queen Elizabeth II behind the scenes, but kept their distance through formality. Kate’s brother- and sister-in-law produced the six-part Netflix documentary series “Harry & Meghan” after they stepped down as working royals.
paras.zh: 王室成员此前曾邀请摄像机进入他们的生活，特别是在 1969 年的《王室》纪录片中，该纪录片展示了英国女王伊丽莎白二世的幕后故事，但通过形式保持了距离。凯特的姐夫和嫂子在辞去王室成员职务后，制作了六集 Netflix 纪录片系列《哈利和梅根》。

paras.en: Both then and now in her latest documentary, Kate has not revealed what type of cancer she was diagnosed with in March 2024 after major abdominal surgery, but in “Heal” she says that the disease changed her.
paras.zh: 无论是当时还是现在，凯特在她最新的纪录片中都没有透露她在 2024 年 3 月接受腹部大手术后被诊断出患有哪种癌症，但在《治愈》中她说这种疾病改变了她。

paras.en: Talking about her time in the hospital, she says in the film that it was “a really scary, disorientating experience.” On one occasion, she says, the simple act of someone holding her hand made all the difference.
paras.zh: 谈到她在医院的经历，她在影片中说，那是“一次非常可怕、令人迷失方向的经历”。她说，有一次，有人握着她的手这个简单的举动就让一切变得不同。

paras.en: “I think I was sort of in and out of consciousness. It was a really dark time. But also then, somewhere through that too, I became aware of someone holding my hand. They weren’t talking to me. They weren’t trying to fix anything. They were just there. And the presence of someone that stood by me in that time, I’ll forever be grateful for,” she says.
paras.zh: “我觉得我时而意识清醒，时而失去意识。那是一段非常黑暗的时光。但就在那时，我也意识到有人握着我的手。他们没有跟我说话。他们没有试图解决任何问题。他们只是在那里。当时有人站在我身边，我将永远感激不已，”她说。

paras.en: Although she is seen crying at one point when she hears messages of support from her three children, George, Charlotte and Louis, there are also lighter moments.
paras.zh: 尽管当她听到三个孩子乔治、夏洛特和路易斯的支持信息时，她一度哭泣，但也有轻松的时刻。

paras.en: Part of the film shows Kate completing what is known as the National Three Peaks Challenge, in which she scaled Scafell Pike, Ben Nevis and Snowdon, the highest mountains in England, Scotland and Wales, in just 24 hours.
paras.zh: 影片的一部分展示了凯特完成了所谓的全国三峰挑战赛，她在短短 24 小时内攀登了英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士最高的山脉斯卡菲尔派克山、本尼维斯山和斯诺登山。

paras.en: At one point, she plays a game of “Would you rather” with her brother James as they walk, challenging him to pick between two funny and difficult options. She told him she played the game with her children.
paras.zh: 有一次，她一边走路一边和弟弟詹姆斯玩“你愿意吗”游戏，挑战他在两个有趣又困难的选项中做出选择。她告诉他她和孩子们一起玩这个游戏。

paras.en: Along their journey, she also met up with some hikers and spoke to other people about the challenges they faced fighting cancer.
paras.zh: 在旅途中，她还遇到了一些徒步旅行者，并向其他人讲述了他们在抗击癌症方面面临的挑战。

paras.en: “You don’t get any help with that from doctors or the language that they use,” one told her. “There are no tools in the clinical settings to kind of help with that. Finding language or finding other people, that community or art or something, these are the only tools we have, I think, to explain and to exercise your uncertainty and become OK with it.”
paras.zh: 一位医生告诉她：“你无法从医生或他们使用的语言中得到任何帮助。” “临床环境中没有任何工具可以帮助解决这一问题。我认为，寻找语言或寻找其他人、社区或艺术或其他东西，这些是我们拥有的唯一工具，可以解释和锻炼你的不确定性并接受它。”

paras.en: The film makes no mention of King Charles III, who revealed his own cancer diagnosis in February 2024, a month before Kate.
paras.zh: 这部电影没有提及国王查尔斯三世，他于 2024 年 2 月（比凯特早一个月）透露了自己的癌症诊断结果。

paras.en: But the princess said ahead of the film’s release that she hoped it would “encourage compassion, showing the real value in standing alongside one another in the hardest of times.”
paras.zh: 但公主在电影上映前表示，她希望这部电影能“激发同情心，展现在最困难的时刻相互站在一起的真正价值”。

paras.en: “Above all, I hope it helps support the life-changing work of the Royal Marsden and all those navigating life with cancer to ensure no one faces this disease feeling unseen, unsupported or alone.”
paras.zh: “最重要的是，我希望它有助于支持皇家马斯登和所有与癌症抗争的人们改变生活的工作，以确保没有人在面对这种疾病时感到被忽视、得不到支持或孤独。”

articles.title: Bendigo Writers Festival offers 'unreserved' apology to author Abdel-Fattah
articles.author: Anna McGuinness

paras.en: Greater Bendigo City Council and La Trobe University have unreservedly apologised to Palestinian Australian author Randa-Abdel-Fattah.
paras.zh: 大本迪戈市议会和拉筹伯大学毫无保留地向巴勒斯坦澳大利亚作家兰达-阿卜杜勒-法塔赫道歉。

paras.en: Dr Abdel-Fattah withdrew from the 2025 Bendigo Writers Festival over a controversial code of conduct which led to an author boycott.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜勒-法塔博士因一项有争议的行为准则而退出 2025 年本迪戈作家节，该行为准则导致作家抵制。

paras.en: Plans for a 2027 Bendigo Writers Festival are yet to be announced.
paras.zh: 2027 年本迪戈作家节的计划尚未公布。

paras.en: The organisers of a disastrous 2025 Bendigo Writers Festival have apologised to author Randa Abdel-Fattah.
paras.zh: 2025 年灾难性的本迪戈作家节的组织者已向作家兰达·阿卜杜勒-法塔赫道歉。

paras.en: The Palestinian Australian academic launched legal action against Greater Bendigo City Council and event sponsor La Trobe University in June, claiming she was discriminated against on the basis of her political beliefs or activity.
paras.zh: 这位巴勒斯坦澳大利亚学者于六月对大本迪戈市议会和活动赞助商拉筹伯大学提起法律诉讼，声称她因其政治信仰或活动而受到歧视。

paras.en: On Friday, a joint statement from the council and university confirmed the legal dispute had been resolved.
paras.zh: 周五，理事会和大学的联合声明证实法律纠纷已经解决。

paras.en: Council chief executive Andrew Cooney apologised unreservedly to Dr Abdel-Fattah "for the harm the council caused to her".
paras.zh: 委员会首席执行官安德鲁·库尼毫无保留地向阿卜杜勒-法塔赫博士“为委员会对她造成的伤害”道歉。

paras.en: "[The council] acknowledges and sincerely regrets that we infringed Dr Abdel-Fattah's intellectual and artistic freedom," the council statement said.
paras.zh: 委员会声明称：“[委员会]承认我们侵犯了阿卜杜勒-法塔赫博士的知识和艺术自由，并对此表示诚挚的遗憾。”

paras.en: La Trobe University's Vice-Chancellor Theo Farrell also unreservedly apologised to the author.
paras.zh: 拉筹伯大学副校长Theo Farrell也毫无保留地向作者道歉。

paras.en: "The university respects the importance of academic freedom and freedom of speech, and the need for respect of these powerful human rights," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“大学尊重学术自由和言论自由的重要性，以及尊重这些强大人权的必要性。”

paras.en: "The university has learned lessons from the 2025 Bendigo Writers Festival and will do better in the future."
paras.zh: “学校从2025年本迪戈作家节中吸取了教训，未来会做得更好。”

paras.en: Dr Abdel-Fattah was due to speak at the August 2025 festival about her book, Discipline, when a code of conduct was sent to authors three days prior.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜勒-法塔博士原定在 2025 年 8 月的节日上就她的书《纪律》发表演讲，三天前向作者发送了一份行为准则。

paras.en: It included an expectation for speakers on La Trobe University's sponsored session, including Dr Abdel-Fattah, to comply with a contested Universities Australia definition of antisemitism.
paras.zh: 其中包括期望拉筹伯大学主办的会议上的发言者（包括阿卜杜勒-法塔博士）遵守澳大利亚大学联盟对反犹太主义有争议的定义。

paras.en: Dr Abdel-Fattah withdrew from the festival and more than 50 other authors boycotted, leading to the cancellation of events, including the opening and closing nights.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜勒-法塔赫博士退出了电影节，其他 50 多名作家也进行了抵制，导致包括开幕式和闭幕式在内的活动被取消。

paras.en: "I accept the unreserved apologies as acknowledgement of the harm inflicted on me, my right to intellectual and artistic freedom and my human rights," Dr Abdel-Fattah said yesterday.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜勒-法塔赫博士昨天表示：“我接受毫无保留的道歉，这是对我所受伤害、我的知识和艺术自由权以及我的人权的承认。”

paras.en: Historian Clare Wright was a guest curator for the 2025 festival and was among those who boycotted the event. She shared the joint statement in a social media post yesterday.
paras.zh: 历史学家克莱尔·赖特 (Clare Wright) 是 2025 年艺术节的客座策展人，也是抵制该活动的人之一。她昨天在社交媒体帖子中分享了联合声明。

paras.en: "Would be nice if both institutions also unreservedly apologised to the staff who were collateral damage… and the 50+ authors who also pulled out of BWF, either in solidarity with Randa and/or because they themselves could not in all good conscience and practice sign the Code of Conduct," she wrote.
paras.zh: 她写道：“如果两个机构也毫无保留地向受到附带损害的工作人员道歉……以及也退出世界羽联的 50 多名作者，要么是为了声援兰达，要么是因为他们自己无法凭良心和实践签署行为准则，那就太好了。”

paras.en: Ms Wright recently took a voluntary redundancy from La Trobe University.
paras.zh: 赖特女士最近从拉筹伯大学自愿离职。

paras.en: Launching the legal action in June, Dr Abdel-Fattah said universities and cultural institutions must be held accountable for discrimination and anti-Palestinian racism.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜勒-法塔赫博士在六月发起了法律行动，他表示大学和文化机构必须对歧视和反巴勒斯坦种族主义负责。

paras.en: "This is not a time for normalising the racism and repression demanded by the antisemitism definitions that are being used to silence those who speak out against Israel, an apartheid state and genocidal settler colony," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“现在不是反犹太主义定义所要求的种族主义和镇压正常化的时候，反犹太主义定义被用来压制那些公开反对以色列这个种族隔离国家和种族灭绝定居者殖民地的人。”

paras.en: Greater Bendigo City Council reviewed the 2025 writers festival and decided to take the year off in 2026, in part due to the "reputational damage incurred".
paras.zh: 大本迪戈市议会审查了 2025 年作家节，并决定在 2026 年休会，部分原因是“声誉受损”。

paras.en: Plans for a 2027 festival are yet to be announced.
paras.zh: 2027 年音乐节的计划尚未公布。

articles.title: Live: Matildas take on Colombia in Canberra
articles.author: Marnie Vinall

paras.en: Matildas live updates: Australia vs Colombia at Canberra stadium
paras.zh: 玛蒂尔达斯实时更新：澳大利亚在堪培拉体育场对阵哥伦比亚

paras.en: The Matildas are in action in the first of two international friendlies against Colombia at Canberra Stadium.
paras.zh: 玛蒂尔达队将参加在堪培拉体育场对阵哥伦比亚的两场国际友谊赛中的第一场比赛。

paras.en: The matches are important preparation for the fast-approaching 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil.
paras.zh: 这些比赛是为即将到来的2027年巴西女足世界杯做的重要准备工作。

paras.en: Steph Catley reaches impressive 150th cap, while Kyra Cooney-Cross returns after more than 250 days.
paras.zh: 斯蒂芬·卡特利 (Steph Catley) 第 150 次出场，令人印象深刻，而凯拉·库尼·克罗斯 (Kyra Cooney-Cross) 在 250 多天后回归。

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: You're going to be hearing it more and more. Every time the Matildas take the field, it's in preparation for the Women's World Cup in Brazil next year.
paras.zh: 你会越来越多地听到它。玛蒂尔达夫妇每次上场，都是在为明年的巴西女足世界杯做准备。

paras.en: Sam Kerr on the broadcast said these friendlies against Colombia were 'a good test ahead of the World Cup', particularly for younger players still getting international minutes into their legs.
paras.zh: 萨姆·科尔在转播中表示，对阵哥伦比亚的友谊赛是“世界杯前的一次很好的考验”，特别是对于仍在参加国际比赛的年轻球员来说。

paras.en: Some great news for Kyra Cooney-Cross fans (me), she's making her first appearance in 252 days for the Matildas.
paras.zh: 对于凯拉·库尼-克罗斯 (Kyra Cooney-Cross) 的粉丝（我）来说，这是一个好消息，她将在 252 天内首次为玛蒂尔达 (Matildas) 亮相。

paras.en: Matildas vice-captain Steph Catley will play her 150th game for the national team tonight. Where has all the time gone?
paras.zh: 玛蒂尔达队副队长斯蒂芬·卡特利今晚将参加国家队的第 150 场比赛。时间都去哪儿了？

paras.en: I remember when she was a spring chicken running around in the A-Leagues!
paras.zh: 记得那时她还是一只在甲A联赛跑来跑去的春鸡啊！

paras.en: Given we are the same age, it's a stark reminder of my own clock. Although her knees seem to be holding up a lot better than mine.
paras.zh: 考虑到我们同龄，这让我想起了我自己的时钟。虽然她的膝盖看起来比我的好得多。

paras.en: But back to Catley... She's just the seventh player to reach the milestone. A huge effort from the stalwart defender.
paras.zh: 但回到卡特利......她只是第七位达到这一里程碑的球员。这位坚定的后卫付出了巨大的努力。

paras.en: Matildas coach Joe Montemurro described this week as one of the world's best footballers. Something I won't be quick to argue against.
paras.zh: 玛蒂尔达斯教练乔·蒙特穆罗本周将其描述为世界上最好的足球运动员之一。我不会很快反对这一点。

paras.en: Catley has been at the heart of this generation that has driven women's football in Australia at full throttle.
paras.zh: 凯特利是这一代人的核心人物，全速推动了澳大利亚女足的发展。

paras.en: "This team feels like my family. We've grown up together, and I'm honoured every single time I touch the pitch with these girls, and I wear that jersey," Catley said.
paras.zh: “这支球队感觉就像我的家人。我们一起长大，每次和这些女孩一起踏上球场，我都很荣幸，而且我穿着那件球衣，”卡特利说。

paras.en: "So 150 times is massive, and I'm very, very proud of that."
paras.zh: “所以 150 次是一个巨大的数字，我对此感到非常非常自豪。”

paras.en: We're back for some more Matildas' friendlies. Can you believe it?
paras.zh: 我们又回来观看更多玛蒂尔达斯的友谊赛了。你能相信吗？

paras.en: In the first of two matches, Australia will take on Colombia tonight in Canberra. Kick off 7:35pm AEDT.
paras.zh: 在两场比赛中的第一场比赛中，澳大利亚今晚将在堪培拉迎战哥伦比亚。澳大利亚东部时间晚上 7:35 开始。

articles.title: What's the result in your electorate? Take a look at the map of your seat
articles.author: Casey Briggs

paras.en: This Victorian election may come to redefine the meaning of a "change election". A three-term Labor government is up against a Coalition opposition led by a first-term MP while Pauline Hanson's resurgent One Nation looks to win seats in what is considered Australia's most progressive state.
paras.zh: 这次维多利亚州选举可能会重新定义“变革选举”的含义。三届工党政府正面临着由第一任议员领导的联盟党反对派的挑战，而宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）复兴的一国党则希望在这个被认为是澳大利亚最进步的州赢得席位。

paras.en: You can see the results in your seat and Victoria's regions in the maps below.
paras.zh: 您可以在下面的地图中查看您所在座位和维多利亚地区的结果。

paras.en: These figures will continue to update until all the votes have been counted.
paras.zh: 这些数字将继续更新，直到所有选票都已清点完毕。

paras.en: For the latest figures, visit the ABC News results page.
paras.zh: 有关最新数据，请访问 ABC 新闻结果页面。

paras.en: Melbourne's western and northern suburbs
paras.zh: 墨尔本西郊和北郊

paras.en: The Liberal Party hasn't won a single seat north or west of the Yarra this side of the year 2000. But how will One Nation perform in the working class seats in Melbourne's outer suburbs?
paras.zh: 2000年这一年，自由党在亚拉河以北或以西的地区都没有赢得一个席位。但是一国党在墨尔本远郊的工人阶级席位上会表现如何呢？

paras.en: This is the Liberal party's traditional heartland in Melbourne. Typically, when the Coalition forms government in Victoria, it sweeps all or nearly all these seats.
paras.zh: 这里是自由党在墨尔本的传统中心地带。通常，当联盟党在维多利亚州组建政府时，它会横扫所有或几乎所有这些席位。

paras.en: Melbourne's south-east and bayside suburbs
paras.zh: 墨尔本东南部和海湾郊区

paras.en: Securing this part of Melbourne will likely be key to a Coalition victory, particularly the swing seats that follow the Frankston train line, which have historically had a big role in determining government.
paras.zh: 确保墨尔本这一地区的安全可能是联盟党获胜的关键，特别是弗兰克斯顿火车线沿线的摇摆席位，这些席位历来在决定政府方面发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: The seats that cover and surround the CBD are expected to be contests between Labor and the Greens, where the minor party could extend its hold on Melbourne's inner suburbs.
paras.zh: 覆盖和围绕中央商务区的席位预计将在工党和绿党之间展开争夺，小党可能会扩大对墨尔本内城区的控制。

paras.en: It will be hoping to perform well in seats held marginally by Labor, such as Footscray, Northcote and Preston, and to win back Prahran, which it held for a decade before the Liberals secured it in a 2025 by-election.
paras.zh: 它希望在工党微弱占据的席位上表现出色，例如Footscray、Northcote和Preston，并赢回普拉兰(Prahran)。普拉兰在自由党在2025年补选中赢得席位之前已经占据了十年之久。

paras.en: Labor has been able to win government so regularly in Victoria in part because of its strength in regional centres, including the cities of Geelong, Ballarat and Bendigo.
