paras.zh: 工党能够在维多利亚州如此频繁地赢得政府胜利，部分原因在于其在吉朗、巴拉瑞特和本迪戈等区域中心的实力。

paras.en: At this election, the regional centres of Ballarat and Geelong could be three-way contests.
paras.zh: 在这次选举中，巴拉瑞特和吉朗两个区域中心可能会进行三路较量。

paras.en: The Coalition has generally dominated this part of the state, with the National Party holding many of these seats — some comfortably — for decades.
paras.zh: 联盟党总体上在该州的这一地区占据主导地位，国家党几十年来一直占据着许多席位——其中一些席位还很舒服。

paras.en: But this could be under threat by One Nation. The party performed well in Morwell in the 2025 federal election and is also expected to poll highly in other seats across this region.
paras.zh: 但这可能会受到一国党的威胁。该党在 2025 年联邦选举中在莫韦尔 (Morwell) 表现出色，预计在该地区其他席位也将获得高支持率。

paras.en: The seats outside Melbourne have often been won by well-known locals, either independents or from the Nationals. But One Nation are bringing party politics to the regions and threatening the Coalition's grip on rural Victoria, particularly in Gippsland and the Mallee.
paras.zh: 墨尔本以外的席位通常是由当地知名人士赢得的，无论是独立人士还是国民党。但一国党正在将政党政治引入这些地区，并威胁联盟党对维多利亚农村地区的控制，特别是在吉普斯兰和马利。

paras.en: Victorian Labor have performed better in the state's rural seats than other state Labor branches across the country and their preferences could be crucial to deciding those contests.
paras.zh: 维州工党在该州农村选区的表现比全国其他州工党分支要好，他们的偏好可能对决定这些竞争至关重要。

articles.title: The corruption case against Benjamin Netanyahu just suffered a serious blow. What comes next?
articles.author: Mark Gollom

paras.en: The corruption case against Benjamin Netanyahu just suffered a serious blow. What comes next?
paras.zh: 本杰明·内塔尼亚胡腐败案刚刚遭受严重打击。接下来会发生什么？

paras.en: Israeli prime minister faces charges of bribery, fraud and breach of trust in years-long corruption trial
paras.zh: 以色列总理在长达数年的腐败审判中面临贿赂、欺诈和失信指控

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was handed a major legal victory this week when the judges in the years-long corruption trial against him suggested the prosecution reconsider one case, work out a plea deal in another and entirely drop the third — the most serious.
paras.zh: 本周，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在法律上取得了重大胜利，在长达数年的腐败审判中，法官建议检方重新考虑一个案件，在另一个案件中达成认罪协议，并完全放弃第三个案件——最严重的案件。

paras.en: While the court clarified these were recommendations and not rulings, it was still a significant blow to the prosecution, which has sought to convict the prime minister on a series of charges related to allegations of bribery, fraud and breach of trust after he was indicted in 2019.
paras.zh: 尽管法院澄清这些只是建议而非裁决，但这对检方来说仍然是一个重大打击，检方在总理于 2019 年被起诉后，试图就一系列与贿赂、欺诈和背信指控相关的指控对总理定罪。

paras.en: The prime minister has denied any wrongdoing, casting the charges as a witch hunt by hostile media, police and prosecutors.
paras.zh: 总理否认有任何不当行为，并将这些指控视为敌对媒体、警察和检察官的政治迫害。

paras.en: But now, the future of the trial is in serious doubt as prosecutors decide how to proceed.
paras.zh: 但现在，随着检察官决定如何进行，审判的未来受到严重怀疑。

paras.en: Here's a look at the cases, the charges, what the judges said and where it may go next.
paras.zh: 以下是案件、指控、法官的言论以及下一步可能的进展。

paras.en: Netanyahu is facing charges of bribery, fraud and breach of trust in three separate cases known as case 1000, case 2000 and case 4000.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在案件 1000、案件 2000 和案件 4000 三个独立案件中面临贿赂、欺诈和失信指控。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the judges overseeing the trial summoned Israel's Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara to appear at the Jerusalem District Court.
paras.zh: 周三，监督审判的法官传唤以色列总检察长加利·巴哈拉夫-米亚拉在耶路撒冷地方法院出庭。

paras.en: "That never happens," Yael Friedman, the legal correspondent for the Israeli newspaper Haaretz, told CBC News. She has been covering the trial since it began in May 2020. "You just need to understand that it was a very irregular act."
paras.zh: 以色列《国土报》法律记者耶尔·弗里德曼 (Yael Friedman) 告诉加拿大广播公司新闻 (CBC News)，“这种情况永远不会发生。”自 2020 年 5 月审判开始以来，她一直在报道该审判。“你只需要明白，这是一种非常不正常的行为。”

paras.en: Speaking for the court, Judge Rivka Friedman-Feldman proceeded to lay out their concerns or recommendations for each of the three cases.
paras.zh: 里夫卡·弗里德曼-费尔德曼法官在法庭上发言，随后对这三个案件分别提出了他们的担忧或建议。

paras.en: In this case, Netanyahu is accused of accepting nearly $200,000 in gifts from Hollywood producer Arnon Milchan and Australian billionaire James Packer.
paras.zh: 在本案中，内塔尼亚胡被指控收受好莱坞制片人阿农·米尔坎和澳大利亚亿万富翁詹姆斯·帕克近20万美元的礼物。

paras.en: Film producer Arnon Milchan leaves the Old Ship Hotel in Brighton, England, on on June 25, 2023, after giving testimony in Benjamin Netanyahu's corruption trial. His testimony was transmitted via videolink to the District Court of Jerusalem. Prosecutors allege Milchan gave the Israeli prime minister expensive gifts in return for personal favours. (Chris Eades/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 2023 年 6 月 25 日，电影制片人阿农·米尔坎 (Arnon Milchan) 在本杰明·内塔尼亚胡 (Benjamin Netanyahu) 腐败案审判中作证后离开英国布莱顿的老船酒店。他的证词通过视频链接传送到耶路撒冷地方法院。检察官指控米尔坎向以色列总理赠送昂贵的礼物以换取个人恩惠。 （克里斯·伊兹/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Prosecutors allege that Netanyahu lobbied on Milchan’s behalf on U.S. visa matters, tried to legislate a generous tax break for him and sought to promote his interests in the Israeli media market.
paras.zh: 检察官指控内塔尼亚胡代表米尔坎就美国签证问题进行游说，试图为他立法慷慨的税收减免，并寻求促进他在以色列媒体市场的利益。

paras.en: What the judges said: Work out a plea deal or settlement
paras.zh: 法官怎么说：制定认罪协议或和解协议

paras.en: “It seems to us that it is possible to get to a conclusion," Friedman-Feldman said, according to the Times of Israel. "We are open to all possibilities — we need to find the procedural way to get there."
paras.zh: 据《以色列时报》报道，弗里德曼-费尔德曼表示：“在我们看来，有可能得出结论。” “我们对所有可能性持开放态度——我们需要找到实现这一目标的程序方式。”

paras.en: Friedman told CBC News that she believes the court was suggesting that though there could be a conviction, the two sides should instead get together to come up with some kind of plea arrangement to finish the trial.
paras.zh: 弗里德曼告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，她认为法院的建议是，尽管可能会被定罪，但双方应该共同提出某种认罪安排来完成审判。

paras.en: This case centres around two audio recordings of conversations between Netanyahu and Arnon Mozes in 2014.
paras.zh: 此案围绕 2014 年内塔尼亚胡和阿农·莫泽斯之间的两段对话录音展开。

paras.en: Mozes is the the publisher of Yedioth Ahronoth, one of Israel's largest newspapers and Ynet, one of the largest news websites.
paras.zh: 莫泽斯是以色列最大的报纸之一《新消息报》和最大的新闻网站之一《Ynet》的出版商。

paras.en: Arnon Mozes, left, the owner and publisher of Yedioth Ahronoth, one of Israel's leading newspapers, is seen in Lod, Israel, in January 2017. At right, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and U.S. President Donald Trump speak at the White House in January 2020, as U.S. casino magnate Sheldon Adelson looks on. (Reuters, Alex Wong/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 2017 年 1 月，以色列主要报纸之一《新消息报》的所有者兼出版商阿农·莫泽斯（左）在以色列罗德。右图，以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于 2020 年 1 月在白宫发表讲话，美国赌场巨头谢尔登·阿德尔森在一旁观看。 （路透社，亚历克斯·黄/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Netanyahu was accused of offering to put forward legislation that would have helped restrict the circulation of the free daily newspaper Israel Hayom, also known as Israel Today, which is the main rival to Mozes' paper.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡被指控提议提出立法，帮助限制自由日报《以色列日报》（也称为《今日以色列》）的发行，该报纸是莫泽斯报纸的主要竞争对手。

paras.en: The irony is that Israel Hayom (Israel Today) is owned by the family of Sheldon Adelson, the late U.S. billionaire and casino magnate, who was also a supporter of Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 讽刺的是，Israel Hayom（《今日以色列》）的所有者是美国已故亿万富翁、赌场大亨谢尔登·阿德尔森（Sheldon Adelson）家族，阿德尔森也是内塔尼亚胡的支持者。

paras.en: The judges recommended prosecutors reconsider case 2000.
paras.zh: 法官建议检察官重新考虑 2000 号案件。

paras.en: "Legally, this is a very, very problematic, case," said Moshe Cohen-Eliya, law professor and former president of the Tel Aviv-based College of Law and Business.
paras.zh: “从法律上讲，这是一个非常非常有问题的案件，”特拉维夫法律与商业学院法学教授、前院长摩西·科恩-埃利亚说。

paras.en: "What the court actually said is that basically there is no legal offence," Cohen-Eliya said in an interview with CBC News. "Maybe you have very good evidence about these kinds of negotiation between Netanyahu and Mozes. However there is no offence."
paras.zh: 科恩-埃利亚在接受 CBC 新闻采访时表示：“法院实际上所说的是，基本上不存在法律犯罪。” “也许你有很好的证据来证明内塔尼亚胡和莫泽斯之间的此类谈判。不过，这并没有冒犯的意思。”

paras.en: According to Friedman, the judge said that while she doesn't see the court convicting Netanyahu on case 2000, she gave the prosecution a chance to explain the charges.
paras.zh: 据弗里德曼称，法官表示，虽然她不认为法院会就 2000 号案件对内塔尼亚胡定罪，但她给了检方一个解释指控的机会。

paras.en: "They're leaving it a bit open," Friedman said.
paras.zh: “他们对此持开放态度，”弗里德曼说。

paras.en: Charges: bribery, fraud, breach of trust
paras.zh: 指控：贿赂、欺诈、失信

paras.en: This was considered the most serious of the three cases as it includes the charge of bribery.
paras.zh: 这被认为是三起案件中最严重的，因为其中包括贿赂指控。

paras.en: Netanyahu, while serving as both primer minister and communications minister from 2014 to 2017, was accused of seeking to ease regulations that would have benefitted Shaul Elovitch, then the controlling shareholder in Bezeq, Israel's largest telecommunications company.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在 2014 年至 2017 年期间担任总理和通信部长，被指控寻求放宽监管，这些监管本来有利于当时以色列最大电信公司 Bezeq 的控股股东 Shaul Elovitch。

paras.en: Israeli businessman Shaul Elovitch appears in the Justice Court in Tel Aviv in one of the graft probes threatening Netanyahu on Feb. 22, 2018. Elovitch is accused of having given Netanyahu positive coverage on his Walla news site in exchange for policies benefiting his telecommunications business. (Jack Guez/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 2018 年 2 月 22 日，以色列商人沙乌尔·埃洛维奇 (Shaul Elovitch) 在特拉维夫法院出庭，参与威胁内塔尼亚胡的一项腐败调查。埃洛维奇被指控在他的瓦拉新闻网站上给予内塔尼亚胡正面报道，以换取有利于其电信业务的政策。 （杰克·格斯/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: In return, it's alleged that the news website Walla, owned by Elovitch at the time, would provide positive coverage of Netanyahu and his family.
paras.zh: 作为回报，据称当时由埃洛维奇拥有的新闻网站 Walla 将为内塔尼亚胡及其家人提供正面报道。

paras.en: The regulatory favours would be worth around 1.8 billion shekels (about $500 million US) to Bezeq.
paras.zh: Bezeq 获得的监管优惠价值约为 18 亿谢克尔（约合 5 亿美元）。

paras.en: What the judges said: Consider dropping the charges
paras.zh: 法官怎么说：考虑撤销指控

paras.en: As for case 4000, in relation to the bribery charge, Friedman-Feldman said there was "serious doubt as to whether the evidentiary basis supports this claim." The Times of Israel reported that she said "the chances of conviction are low" for all three charges.
paras.zh: 至于第 4000 号案件，涉及贿赂指控，弗里德曼-费尔德曼表示，“对于证据基础是否支持这一主张存在严重疑问”。据《以色列时报》报道，她表示，这三项指控“被定罪的可能性都很低”。

paras.en: This wasn't the first time the judges have raised concerns about the ability to prove the bribery charge. In May 2023, judges said prosecutors should consider withdrawing the charge, but the prosecutors declined to do so.
paras.zh: 这并不是法官第一次对证明贿赂指控的能力表示担忧。 2023年5月，法官表示检察官应考虑撤回指控，但检察官拒绝这样做。

paras.en: "So, from that perspective, it was already kind of like known that [the bribery charge] was the more weaker charge," Friedman said. "But what was surprising was how they basically overruled the whole 4000 case."
paras.zh: “因此，从这个角度来看，人们已经知道[贿赂指控]是较弱的指控，”弗里德曼说。 “但令人惊讶的是，他们基本上否决了整个 4000 案。”

paras.en: Netanyahu has testified in 98 hearings in 18 months of the trial, while Israel was at war in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在 18 个月的审判中在 98 场听证会上作证，当时以色列正在加沙、黎巴嫩和伊朗交战。

paras.en: "It was quite crazy, the situation where he gets, like, this note from one of his secretaries saying he needs to take an urgent call," Friedman said. "And he goes up to the judges and says, 'Um, excuse me, I need to take a break.' "
paras.zh: 弗里德曼说：“这真是太疯狂了，他收到一位秘书的来信，说他需要接一个紧急电话。” “然后他走到评委面前说，‘嗯，对不起，我需要休息一下。’” ”

paras.en: She says Netanyahu's testimony, which included many breaks within the 18 month time span, is the longest in Israel's history of criminal trials, and also notes that Netanyahu would show up for the testimony of major witnesses.
paras.zh: 她说，内塔尼亚胡的证词在 18 个月的时间跨度内多次中断，是以色列刑事审判历史上最长的证词，她还指出内塔尼亚胡将出庭听取主要证人的证词。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the judges overseeing the trial summoned Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara to appear at the Jerusalem District Court. (Gil Cohen-Magen/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周三，监督审判的法官传唤司法部长加利·巴哈拉夫-米亚拉在耶路撒冷地方法院出庭。 （吉尔·科恩-马根/美联社）

paras.en: The prosecution said it will take time to review the recommendations of the court. But Cohen-Eliya said he believes the attorney general will ignore the judges and continue with the trial.
paras.zh: 检方表示，需要时间审查法院的建议。但科恩-埃利亚表示，他相信司法部长将无视法官的裁决并继续审判。

paras.en: "I can guess that she would go back to the court, and she would say, 'I heard you, but I'm still pursuing the case,' " he said.
paras.zh: “我猜她会回到法庭，她会说，‘我听到了你的声音，但我仍在追查此案，’”他说。

paras.en: Cohen-Eliya says the corruption case against Netanyahu is the most important one in Israel's history besides the trial of Nazi Adolf Eichmann in the 1960s.
paras.zh: 科恩-埃利亚表示，内塔尼亚胡腐败案是继20世纪60年代对纳粹阿道夫·艾希曼的审判之外，以色列历史上最重要的一起案件。

paras.en: "It's a lot at stake for the prosecution," he said.
paras.zh: “这对于检方来说是一个很大的利害关系，”他说。

paras.en: Friedman says if the prosecutors "believe in the case and think that the judges are wrong" they could continue with the trial, get a verdict — even one that goes against them — and then appeal to the Israeli Supreme Court.
paras.zh: 弗里德曼表示，如果检察官“相信案件并认为法官是错误的”，他们可以继续审判，获得判决——即使是对他们不利的判决——然后向以色列最高法院上诉。

paras.en: Another option, she says, is to start negotiating a plea deal.
paras.zh: 她说，另一种选择是开始谈判认罪协议。

paras.en: "And then it depends how much they would want to compromise. And what would Netanyahu agree [to] compromise from his side?"
paras.zh: “然后这取决于他们想要妥协多少。内塔尼亚胡会同意他这边妥协什么？”

articles.title: This suspected North Korean operative said he had an IT company in Toronto. It wasn't real
articles.author: Matthew Pierce, Scott Anderson, Mark Kelley

paras.en: This suspected North Korean operative said he had an IT company in Toronto. It wasn't real
paras.zh: 这名疑似朝鲜特工表示，他在多伦多有一家 IT 公司。这不是真的

paras.en: Aku Alatao claimed to be founder and CEO of Canadian-based software company
paras.zh: 阿库·阿拉托 (Aku Alatao) 自称是加拿大软件公司的创始人兼首席执行官

paras.en: Aku Alatao seemed like the perfect job applicant to create a cryptocurrency and design a website for the Canadian startup Bananacoin.
paras.zh: Aku Alatao 似乎是为加拿大初创公司 Bananacoin 创建加密货币并设计网站的完美求职者。

paras.en: His resumé boasted lots of previous front- and back-end coding experience. He had his own IT company based in Toronto and he was eager to get started right away.
paras.zh: 他的简历拥有大量以前的前端和后端编码经验。他在多伦多拥有自己的 IT 公司，他渴望立即开始工作。

paras.en: "Aku, let me ask you a question. What do you think of Bananacoin? I'm not sure if I like the name Bananacoin," company executive Clark Shelley said to Alatao during an online job interview this past summer.
paras.zh: “阿库，让我问你一个问题。你觉得香蕉币怎么样？我不确定我是否喜欢香蕉币这个名字，”公司高管克拉克·雪莱在去年夏天的一次在线求职面试中对阿拉托说道。

paras.en: "Yeah, maybe it is very good," Alatao replied.
paras.zh: “是的，也许这很好。”​​阿拉涛回答道。

paras.en: He got the job. The company offered to start him at $8,000 per month. He said he would work remotely.
paras.zh: 他得到了这份工作。公司开出的起步价是每月 8,000 美元。他说他将远程工作。

paras.en: But there was a catch — Bananacoin wasn't real and neither was Aku Alatao.
paras.zh: 但有一个问题——香蕉币不是真实的，Aku Alatao 也不是真实的。

paras.en: For the last year, the fifth estate has investigated multiple suspected North Korean operatives posing online as Canadian residents. They have been able to secure remote jobs in Canadian companies and government, their paycheques propping up the heavily sanctioned regime.
paras.zh: 去年，第五部门调查了多名在网上冒充加拿大居民的朝鲜特工嫌疑人。他们能够在加拿大公司和政府找到远程工作，他们的薪水支撑着受到严厉制裁的政权。

paras.en: Alatao has been presenting himself around the world as the founder and CEO of Toronto-based Neiluno Software.
paras.zh: 阿拉托一直以多伦多 Neiluno Software 的创始人兼首席执行官的身份在世界各地展示自己。

paras.en: But according to our research and experts, Alatao is a suspected North Korean operative working under a false Canadian identity.
paras.zh: 但根据我们的研究和专家的说法，阿拉涛疑似是一名朝鲜特工，以虚假的加拿大身份从事工作。

paras.en: - Watch the full documentary, "For Hire: North Korea's IT Army," from the fifth estate on YouTube, CBC Gem or CBC-TV on Friday at 9 p.m.
paras.zh: - 周五晚上 9 点在 YouTube、CBC Gem 或 CBC-TV 上观看来自第五庄园的完整纪录片“雇佣：朝鲜的 IT 军队”。

paras.en: To find out more about him and the scheme he is involved in, we created a fictitious crypto company, Bananacoin, and posed as potential employers looking to hire him.
paras.zh: 为了更多地了解他和他所参与的计划，我们创建了一家虚构的加密货币公司 Bananacoin，并冒充为想要雇用他的潜在雇主。

paras.en: Alatao proved to be a phantom. As we tracked his operation online and around the globe, he was everywhere and nowhere and certainly not where he claimed to be based in Canada.
paras.zh: 阿拉托被证明是一个幻影。当我们在网上和全球范围内追踪他的行动时，他无处不在，却又无处不在，当然也不是他声称的加拿大所在地。

paras.en: Ruled by leader Kim Jong Un, the state has been wracked by mismanagement and economic sanctions aimed at curbing its nuclear ambitions and human rights violations.
paras.zh: 在领导人金正恩的统治下，该国饱受管理不善和旨在遏制其核野心和侵犯人权行为的经济制裁的困扰。

paras.en: So to make money, experts say, the regime has turned to crime — including counterfeiting currency, trafficking heroin and massive multibillion-dollar crypto hacks.
paras.zh: 专家表示，为了赚钱，该政权已经转向犯罪——包括伪造货币、贩运海洛因和大规模的数十亿美元的加密货币黑客攻击。

paras.en: According to cryptocurrency intelligence firm TRM Labs, North Korea-backed hackers stole $7.4 billion in crypto in 2026.
paras.zh: 根据加密货币情报公司 TRM Labs 的数据，朝鲜支持的黑客在 2026 年窃取了 74 亿美元的加密货币。

paras.en: The regime has also trained an army of information technology workers to get remote IT jobs around the world — including in Canada.
paras.zh: 该政权还培训了一支信息技术工人队伍，以便在世界各地（包括加拿大）获得远程 IT 工作。

paras.en: One U.S. Department of the Treasury estimate put the total take from North Korean IT work at nearly $800 million from the U.S. for 2024 alone.
paras.zh: 美国财政部估计，仅 2024 年朝鲜 IT 工作从美国获得的总收入就接近 8 亿美元。

paras.en: Cybersecurity expert Evan Gordenker, who has led more than 150 investigations into threat actors and testified before a United Nations hearing on North Korean IT workers, estimates there are thousands involved in this scheme.
paras.zh: 网络安全专家 Evan Gordenker 领导了 150 多项针对威胁行为者的调查，并在联合国有关朝鲜 IT 工人的听证会上作证，他估计有数千人参与了这一计划。

paras.en: "Fraud has been their job for, in most cases, at least six years, but in some cases even much longer than that and they're a well-oiled machine," Gordenker told the fifth estate in an interview.
paras.zh: 戈登克在接受第五庄园采访时表示：“在大多数情况下，他们的工作已经持续了至少六年，但在某些情况下甚至比这更长，而且他们是一台运转良好的机器。”

paras.en: In early 2026, the fifth estate received a tip regarding a cache of documents on the computer programming website GitHub. It contained passports, resumés and other documents North Korean IT workers use to ply their trade. It was left available for anyone with an internet connection to access.
paras.zh: 2026 年初，第五庄园收到了有关计算机编程网站 GitHub 上的文档缓存的举报。它包含朝鲜 IT 工人用来开展业务的护照、简历和其他文件。任何有互联网连接的人都可以访问它。

paras.en: Using open source intelligence tools and an artificial intelligence agent tasked with looking for specific quirks associated with North Korean IT workers, we scanned thousands of Github accounts to see what else might be available on public websites.
paras.zh: 我们使用开源情报工具和负责寻找与朝鲜 IT 员工相关的特定怪癖的人工智能代理，扫描了数千个 Github 帐户，看看公共网站上还可能有哪些内容。

paras.en: What we found surprised us. Alongside fake IDs and fake resumés were working documents, including digital notebooks, shopping lists and photos that appear to have been taken inside North Korea.
paras.zh: 我们的发现让我们感到惊讶。除了假身份证和假简历之外，还有工作文件，包括数字笔记本、购物清单和似乎是在朝鲜境内拍摄的照片。

paras.en: Metadata for this photo, linked to a suspected North Korean IT worker’s GitHub account, indicates the photo was taken inside North Korea. (Devops920719/GitHub)
paras.zh: 这张照片的元数据链接到一名疑似朝鲜 IT 员工的 GitHub 帐户，表明该照片是在朝鲜境内拍摄的。 (Devops920719/GitHub)

paras.en: In the middle of it all emerged one particular account that caught our attention, alleycat1, owned by Toronto-based Aku Alatao.
paras.zh: 在这一切中间出现了一个引起我们注意的特殊帐户，alleycat1，由多伦多的 Aku Alatao 拥有。

paras.en: According to Ontario corporate filings, Alatao registered his company, Neiluno Software, in April 2025.
paras.zh: 根据安大略省公司备案文件，Alatao 于 2025 年 4 月注册了他的公司 Neiluno Software。

paras.en: But when we visited the registered address in Toronto, a converted house on a busy commercial strip in the west-end district of Etobicoke, we found a fast-food restaurant on the main floor and another unrelated small business in the basement. The building owner told us he'd never heard of Alatao or Neiluno.
paras.zh: 但当我们走访多伦多的注册地址——怡陶碧谷西区繁华商业街的一栋改建房屋时，我们发现主层有一家快餐店，地下室有另一家不相关的小企业。业主告诉我们，他从未听说过阿拉套或内鲁诺。

paras.en: When we looked into Neiluno's employees listed on its website, they were largely internet phantoms — strange accounts with changing names, connected to gambling websites and cryptocurrency ventures.
paras.zh: 当我们调查 Neiluno 网站上列出的员工时，他们大多是互联网幽灵——名字不断变化的奇怪账户，与赌博网站和加密货币企业有关。

paras.en: The company website also listed former clients. One of them, Aqualoan, was connected by cryptocurrency experts to North Korea and the theft of $50 million from crypto firm Radiant Capital.
paras.zh: 该公司网站还列出了以前的客户。其中之一，Aqualoan，被加密货币专家与朝鲜以及加密货币公司 Radiant Capital 的 5000 万美元盗窃案联系起来。

paras.en: When we invited Alatao to an online interview to discuss Bananacoin, using false identities ourselves, we weren't sure what to expect.
paras.zh: 当我们邀请阿拉涛参加在线采访讨论香蕉币时，我们自己使用了虚假身份，并不确定会发生什么。

paras.en: He logged onto the meeting a few minutes early, eager to discuss the details of our proposed project.
paras.zh: 他提前几分钟登录了会议，渴望讨论我们拟议项目的细节。

paras.en: "I imagine you're taking on multiple projects. You must be busy," the fifth estate host Mark Kelley, posing as Bananacoin CEO Clark Shelley, asked in the interview
paras.zh: “我想你正在承担多个项目。你一定很忙，”第五产业主持人马克·凯利（Mark Kelley）冒充香蕉币首席执行官克拉克·雪莱（Clark Shelley）在采访中问道

paras.en: "It is no problem to work for this project all day," Alatao responded.
paras.zh: “为这个项目工作一整天是没有问题的。”阿拉托回应道。

paras.en: Among Neiluno's advertised portfolio project was a fake Forbes website, which the real Forbes confirmed was inauthentic. (Neiluno.io)
paras.zh: Neiluno 宣传的投资组合项目中有一个假的《福布斯》网站，真正的《福布斯》证实该网站不真实。 （Neiluno.io）

paras.en: "Your company, Neiluno, I see its head office is based here in Toronto?" Shelley asked.
paras.zh: “你们公司Neiluno，我看到它的总部在多伦多？”雪莱问道。

paras.en: When asked where he was personally located, Alatao stumbled, pronouncing the Toronto suburb of Etobicoke incorrectly multiple times before providing the fake Etobicoke address where the fifth estate had confirmed neither he nor his business was.
paras.zh: 当被问及他个人所在的位置时，阿拉托结结巴巴，多次错误地发音为多伦多郊区怡陶碧谷，然后提供了虚假的怡陶碧谷地址，而第五庄园既没有确认他也没有确认他的公司在哪里。

paras.en: When the topic of money came up, Alatao asked to be paid in cryptocurrency.
paras.zh: 当谈到钱的话题时，阿拉涛要求用加密货币支付。

paras.en: "They would love to move money across cryptocurrency where once a transfer is done, it is done," Gordenker said, adding "from there, making it invisible and having it disappear into the bytes and bits of the blockchain space, and really the many blockchains that they use, is totally trivial for them to do."
paras.zh: 戈登克说：“他们希望通过加密货币转移资金，一旦转账完成，一切就完成了。”他补充道，“从那里开始，让它变得不可见，并让它消失在区块链空间的字节和位中，而实际上他们使用的许多区块链对他们来说是完全微不足道的。”

paras.en: We asked Alatao for a regular bank account, and he sent us the details for a CitiBank account in his name. CitiBank declined to comment on the record.
paras.zh: 我们向阿拉托索要一个普通银行账户，他向我们发送了以他的名义开设的花旗银行账户的详细信息。花旗银行拒绝就记录置评。

paras.en: Providing his ID for our fictitious payroll, Alatao sent a picture of an Ontario driver's licence we determined to be fake. The licence number was invalid, the photo appeared to be a cutout from a picture he had used in an online profile and the address was that same Etobicoke address that Neiluno and Alatao had no connection to.
paras.zh: 阿拉托为我们虚构的工资单提供了他的身份证件，并发送了一张安大略省驾驶执照的照片，我们确定这是假的。许可证号无效，照片似乎是从他在线个人资料中使用的照片中剪下来的，地址与 Neiluno 和 Alatao 没有联系的 Etobicoke 地址相同。

paras.en: A photo of a fake Ontario driver’s licence provided by Aku Alatao. (Aku Alatao)
paras.zh: Aku Alatao 提供的假安大略省驾驶执照照片。 （阿库阿拉涛）

paras.en: North Korean IT workers often enlist the help of domestic facilitators in the countries where they pretend to be. Facilitators help them keep the scheme going by completing tasks the worker cannot do remotely, like opening a bank account or receiving mail.
paras.zh: 朝鲜 IT 工人经常寻求他们假装所在国家的国内协助者的帮助。协调员通过完成员工无法远程完成的任务（例如开设银行账户或接收邮件）来帮助他们继续该计划。

paras.en: Local facilitators also get paid to host laptop computers that the North Koreans remotely work from, fooling their employers into believing they are based in a friendly location like Canada or the U.S.
paras.zh: 当地服务人员还获得报酬来托管朝鲜人远程工作的笔记本电脑，欺骗他们的雇主，让他们相信他们位于加拿大或美国等友好地区。

paras.en: We told Alatao during our interview that he would need to do all his work from a company-provided laptop in the hopes that we could locate him or a Canadian facilitator working with him.
paras.zh: 我们在采访中告诉阿拉托，他需要通过公司提供的笔记本电脑完成所有工作，希望我们能够找到他或与他一起工作的加拿大协调员。

paras.en: - Suspected North Korean computer programmers did contract work for B.C. government
paras.zh: - 疑似朝鲜计算机程序员为 BC 省从事合同工作政府

paras.en: - Ontario architect's seal forged by remote worker believed to be North Korean fraudster
paras.zh: - 安大略省建筑师的印章由远程工人伪造，据信是朝鲜诈骗者

paras.en: The day after our interview, Alatao emailed to tell us there was an urgent matter that required him to be out of the country.
paras.zh: 我们采访的第二天，阿拉托通过电子邮件告诉我们有一件紧急事情需要他出国。

paras.en: "I am currently navigating some significant personal matters involving my girlfriend in Indonesia, which requires my immediate departure for that country tomorrow," he wrote. "This absence is anticipated to last several months. I believe I have no issues working for this project there."
paras.zh: "I am currently navigating some significant personal matters involving my girlfriend in Indonesia, which requires my immediate departure for that country tomorrow," he wrote. “这种缺席预计将持续几个月。我相信我在那里为这个项目工作没有任何问题。”

paras.en: He gave us an address in Cirebon, Indonesia, for delivery of the laptop and a contact name: Aisyah Isaa, who appeared on the Neiluno website as an employee
paras.zh: 他给了我们一个位于印度尼西亚井里汶的地址，用于运送笔记本电脑，并提供了联系人姓名：Aisyah Isaa，他作为员工出现在 Neiluno 网站上

paras.en: Indonesia-based Aisyah Zahira Isaa was one of multiple employees listed on the Neiluno website. (Neiluno.io)
paras.zh: 总部位于印度尼西亚的 Aisyah Zahira Isaa 是 Neiluno 网站上列出的多名员工之一。 （Neiluno.io）

paras.en: Cirebon is more than 220 kilometres east of Jakarta. We hired a freelance journalist there to investigate and keep up the appearance that we were trying to legitimately get a Bananacoin company laptop to Alatao.
paras.zh: 井里汶位于雅加达以东 220 多公里处。我们在那里聘请了一名自由记者来调查并维持我们试图合法地将香蕉币公司笔记本电脑运往阿拉涛的表象。

paras.en: The address turned out to be the home of Isaa's parents and neither she nor Alatao was there.
paras.zh: 事实证明，这个地址是伊萨父母的家，但她和阿拉托都不在那里。

paras.en: The parents called their daughter, who gave us two addresses in Jakarta — one was a co-working office space in a building in the centre of the city, the other was a home in the suburbs.
paras.zh: 父母给他们的女儿打电话，女儿给了我们两个在雅加达的地址——一个是市中心一栋大楼里的联合办公空间，另一个是郊区的一处住宅。

paras.en: Our freelancer went to the office building. Seeing no sign of Neiluno, he arranged to meet Isaa at her home.
paras.zh: 我们的自由职业者去了办公楼。由于没有看到尼鲁诺的踪影，他安排在伊萨家里与她见面。

paras.en: - North Korea fires two ballistic missiles off east coast in three hours
paras.zh: - 朝鲜在三小时内向东海岸发射了两枚弹道导弹

paras.en: - Binance says billions replaced from hack that FBI blames on North Korea
paras.zh: - 币安表示，FBI 归咎于朝鲜的黑客攻击导致数十亿美元损失

paras.en: Throughout a nearly hour-long discussion — during which our freelancer identified himself as working with the CBC — Isaa said that she had met Alatao in Singapore at a tech conference and that she had been working with him for about a year. Neiluno's CEO wasn't in Indonesia, she said. He was in Hong Kong or possibly back home in Canada, where she believed he grew up.
paras.zh: 在长达近一个小时的讨论中（我们的自由职业者自称与 CBC 合作），伊萨表示，她在新加坡的一次技术会议上认识了阿拉托，并且已经与他合作了大约一年。她说，Neiluno 的首席执行官不在印度尼西亚。他当时在香港，或者可能回到了加拿大的家，她相信他是在那里长大的。

paras.en: Isaa later sent emails to CBC explaining that she knew nothing about Alatao or any scheme that he may have been running and had connected with him online just a month prior, contradicting her statements from her conversation with our freelancer in Jakarta.
paras.zh: 伊萨后来向加拿大广播公司发送电子邮件，解释说她对阿拉托或他可能正在实施的任何计划一无所知，并在一个月前在网上与他联系，这与她在雅加达与我们的自由职业者谈话中的说法相矛盾。

paras.en: It seems we were not the only people trying to find Alatao. About a week prior, in Neiluno's Telegram channel, someone posted wondering if the channel's owner had "disappeared."
paras.zh: 看来我们并不是唯一试图寻找阿拉套的人。大约一周前，在 Neiluno 的 Telegram 频道中，有人发帖询问该频道的所有者是否“失踪”了。

paras.en: The reply came two days later, stating that the Neiluno's owner had just returned from a sailing trip that was extended due to stormy conditions.
paras.zh: 两天后收到回复，称“Neiluno”号的船主刚刚结束一次因暴风雨而延长的航行行程。

paras.en: A member of the Neiluno Software Inc. chat on Telegram wondered about the apparent disappearance of the company’s leader. (Telegram)
paras.zh: Neiluno Software Inc. 的一名成员在 Telegram 聊天中对该公司领导人的明显失踪表示好奇。 （电报）

paras.en: Wherever he was, it seemed that Neiluno's founder and CEO was a difficult man to pin down.
paras.zh: 无论在哪里，Neiluno 的创始人兼首席执行官似乎都是一个很难确定的人。

paras.en: "It's so easy for the North Koreans because for most ordinary citizens, I don't think the implications of doing some of these things is really registering," said Gordenker, "Certainly they're not registering, ‘Oh, this could be assisting a sanctioned country and I could be helping with illicit finance.'
paras.zh: 戈登克说：“这对朝鲜人来说很容易，因为对于大多数普通公民来说，我认为做这些事情的影响并没有真正被记录下来。”

paras.en: "Even people who are saying this is a little bit suspicious typically don't figure out the whole scope of the scheme. And that's partly a function of people just not understanding how serious this could be. But moreso, I think this is a function of people don't understand that they are being used. They're pawns in this grand scheme."
paras.zh: “即使是那些说这有点可疑的人通常也没有弄清楚该计划的整个范围。这在一定程度上是因为人们不了解这可能有多严重。但更重要的是，我认为这是因为人们不明白他们正在被利用。他们是这个宏伟计划中的棋子。”

paras.en: On one online profile, Aku claimed to be based in Rehoboth Beach, Del. According to other accounts, he graduated from a university in Hong Kong and another in Ankara, Turkey, in the same year. (Peopleperhour.com)
paras.zh: 在一份在线个人资料中，阿库声称自己居住在特拉华州里霍博斯比奇。根据其他说法，他于同年毕业于香港的一所大学和土耳其安卡拉的另一所大学。 （Peopleperhour.com）

paras.en: Alatao had heard from Isaa that something wasn't right about the conversation she had with our freelancer.
paras.zh: 阿拉托从伊萨那里听说她与我们的自由职业者的谈话有些不对劲。

paras.en: "She stated that two individuals approached her and proceeded to record video and audio using concealed equipment," Alatao wrote. "They have accused our organization of fraudulent activity, which has understandably caused Aisyah considerable distress."
paras.zh: 阿拉托写道：“她表示，有两个人走近她，并使用隐藏设备录制视频和音频。” “他们指责我们的组织进行欺诈活动，这给艾莎带来了巨大的痛苦，这是可以理解的。”

paras.en: We agreed to meet online and clear up the whole matter. Again, Alatao showed up to our video call as scheduled.
paras.zh: 我们同意在网上见面并澄清整个问题。阿拉涛再次如期出现在我们的视频通话中。

paras.en: When we informed Alatao that we had been by his office address in Toronto and no one had heard of him or Neiluno Software, he told us he had moved the office, but did not say to where.
paras.zh: 当我们告诉阿拉涛我们去过他在多伦多的办公室地址，但没有人听说过他或Neiluno Software时，他告诉我们他已经搬走了办公室，但没有说搬到哪里。

paras.en: The fifth estate could not independently verify that the man in the crowd was Alatao, but North Korea experts we interviewed said it could be him.
paras.zh: 第五庄园无法独立证实人群中的男子就是阿拉套，但我们采访的朝鲜专家表示可能是他。

paras.en: "This event was the first event when Kim Jong Un's aunt was reintroduced to the public after Kim Jong Un had her husband executed," Gordenker said.
paras.zh: 戈登克说：“这次活动是金正恩处决她的丈夫后，金正恩的姨妈首次被重新介绍给公众。”

paras.en: "That someone with a vaulted position, that could be so close to Kim Jong Un, is also out here scamming Canadian companies means that scam is so profitable and he is so successful at this sort of thing that he has really earned his way there.
paras.zh: “一个拥有金正恩地位的人，可能与金正恩如此接近，也在这里诈骗加拿大公司，这意味着诈骗是如此有利可图，而且他在这类事情上如此成功，他真的是靠自己的努力获得了成功。

paras.en: "I think you've probably stumbled into one of the more elite attackers that the North Koreans have for their cyber force," Gordenker said.
paras.zh: “我认为你可能无意中遇到了朝鲜网络部队中最精锐的攻击者之一，”戈登克说。

paras.en: This photo was made available by the Korean Central News Agency in January 2020. (Reuters)
paras.zh: 朝鲜中央通讯社于 2020 年 1 月提供了这张照片。（路透社）

paras.en: When we asked Alatao during our interview if he was in North Korea and if he was North Korean, he responded "no."
paras.zh: 当我们在采访中询问阿拉涛是否在朝鲜以及他是否是朝鲜人时，他回答“不”。

paras.en: When we pressed him on whether was in fact a North Korean operative, he said: "I don't know what you mean" and that the allegation was "very weird."
paras.zh: 当我们追问他是否确实是一名朝鲜特工时，他说：“我不知道你的意思”，并且这一指控“非常奇怪”。

paras.en: He told us we had him mixed up with someone else and left the meeting.
paras.zh: 他告诉我们，我们把他和其他人混在一起，然后就离开了会议。

articles.title: Thanksgiving storm on U.S. East Coast knocks out power, disrupts flights

paras.en: Thanksgiving storm on U.S. East Coast knocks out power, disrupts flights
paras.zh: 美国东海岸感恩节风暴导致电力中断、航班中断

paras.en: More than 900,000 U.S. utility customers had no power Thursday evening
paras.zh: 周四晚上超过 90 万美国公用事业客户断电

paras.en: A powerful storm disrupted the Thanksgiving holiday along much of the U.S. East Coast on Thursday, knocking out power to nearly one million customers at one point as wind gusts of up to 112 km/h toppled trees and power lines.
paras.zh: 周四，一场强大的风暴扰乱了美国东海岸大部分地区的感恩节假期，高达 112 公里/小时的阵风吹倒了树木和电线，一度导致近 100 万用户断电。

paras.en: The storm contributed to flight delays, with FlightAware reporting a total of 454 U.S.-related cancellations on Thursday and 2,411 delays. Major airports in the Washington and New York City areas were among the hardest hit.
paras.zh: 风暴导致航班延误，FlightAware 报告周四共有 454 架与美国相关的航班取消，其中 2,411 架延误。华盛顿和纽约地区的主要机场是受灾最严重的机场之一。

paras.en: Heavy rains flooded coastal areas, while utilities warned of an increased risk of falling trees and power outages.
paras.zh: 大雨淹没了沿海地区，公用事业公司警告说，树木倒下和停电的风险增加。

paras.en: More than 908,000 U.S. utility customers had no power as of 9:56 p.m. ET, according to PowerOutage.us, down from 961,000 at 7:30 p.m. ET.
paras.zh: 截至晚上 9 点 56 分，超过 908,000 名美国公用事业客户断电。根据 PowerOutage.us 的数据，东部时间下午 7:30 的数量为 961,000。等。

paras.en: - Macy's Thanksgiving Parade postponed to Saturday due to expected high winds
paras.zh: - 由于预计大风，梅西百货感恩节游行推迟至周六

paras.en: - Flooding triggers evacuation order for dozens of properties on Vancouver Island
paras.zh: - 洪水触发温哥华岛数十处房产的疏散令

paras.en: The data included more than 207,000 outages in Pennsylvania, over 179,000 in New Jersey, 139,000 in Maryland,106,000 in Virginia, 100,000 in Missouri and more than 68,000 in New York state.
paras.zh: 数据包括宾夕法尼亚州超过 207,000 次停电，新泽西州超过 179,000 次，马里兰州 139,000 次，弗吉尼亚州 106,000 次，密苏里州 100,000 次，纽约州超过 68,000 次。

paras.en: Waves crash over dunes and onto the boardwalk on Thursday in Bethany Beach, Delaware. (Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 周四，海浪冲过沙丘，冲上特拉华州贝瑟尼海滩的木板路。 （凯文迪奇/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Wind gusts of 80-112 km/h were reported or forecast across parts of Virginia, Maryland, Delaware, New Jersey, New York, and coastal New England, according to the U.S. National Weather Service (NWS).
paras.zh: 据美国国家气象局 (NWS) 称，弗吉尼亚州、马里兰州、特拉华州、新泽西州、纽约州和新英格兰沿海地区的部分地区报告或预测阵风为 80-112 公里/小时。

paras.en: It said conditions would gradually improve across the Mid-Atlantic overnight as the heaviest rain and strongest winds moved into New England, although blustery conditions with gusts of 40 to 55 km/h were expected across parts of the East Coast on Friday.
paras.zh: 报告称，随着最强降雨和最强风进入新英格兰，大西洋中部地区的情况将在夜间逐渐改善，但预计周五东海岸部分地区将出现时速 40 至 55 公里/小时的大风天气。

paras.en: New York City Emergency Management reported winds intensified on Thursday afternoon, reaching 90 km/h at LaGuardia Airport.
paras.zh: 纽约市应急管理部门报告称，周四下午，拉瓜迪亚机场风速增强，风速达到 90 公里/小时。

paras.en: - FedEx airplane overruns runway at Miami airport, temporarily closing all but 1 runway
paras.zh: - 联邦快递飞机冲出迈阿密机场跑道，暂时关闭除 1 条跑道外的所有跑道

paras.en: - Up to 9 hours of freezing rain in forecast for N.B., warning says
paras.zh: - 警告称，NB省预计将出现长达9小时的冻雨

paras.en: The NWS said strong onshore winds associated with the storm, combined with king tides, were causing coastal flooding in low-lying communities along portions of the East Coast.
paras.zh: 国家气象局表示，与风暴相关的强陆风加上大潮，正在导致东海岸部分低洼社区发生沿海洪水。

paras.en: Officials had already postponed Thursday's 100th edition of the annual Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City because of the storm threat, the first time the event has been rescheduled due to severe weather.
paras.zh: 由于风暴威胁，官员们已经推迟了周四在纽约市举行的第 100 届年度梅西百货感恩节游行，这是该活动首次因恶劣天气而重新安排。

paras.en: Separately on Thursday, President Donald Trump said he had approved about $100 million US in federal aid to Florida following severe storms and flooding there. He said the total included funding previously approved in connection with Hurricane Isaias.
paras.zh: 周四，唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，在佛罗里达州遭受严重风暴和洪水之后，他已批准向佛罗里达州提供约 1 亿美元的联邦援助。他说，总额包括先前批准的与伊萨亚斯飓风有关的资金。

articles.title: As Gambia gears up for election, can Barrow secure a third term?

paras.en: Gambia votes on December 5 in a presidential election that takes place nearly 10 years after voters ended the 22-year rule of military ruler Yahya Jammeh.
paras.zh: 冈比亚将于 12 月 5 日举行总统选举，距离选民结束军事统治者叶海亚·贾梅 (Yahya Jammeh) 22 年的统治近 10 年。

paras.en: President Adama Barrow, who succeeded Jammeh in 2017, is running for a third term despite an earlier pledge not to do so.
paras.zh: 2017 年接替贾梅的总统阿达马·巴罗 (Adama Barrow) 正在竞选第三个任期，尽管早些时候曾承诺不会这样做。

paras.en: Barrow is running against the tiny West African country's main opposition leader Ousainou Darboe of the United Democratic Party, youth candidate Talib Ahmed Bensouda, who until last week was mayor of Kanifing Municipality, and four other candidates.
paras.zh: 巴罗的竞选对手是这个西非小国的主要反对党领袖、联合民主党的乌塞努·达尔博(Ousainou Darboe)、青年候选人塔利布·艾哈迈德·本苏达(Talib Ahmed Bensouda)以及其他四名候选人，塔利布·艾哈迈德·本苏达上周一直担任卡尼芬市市长。

paras.en: The field also includes independent candidates Almameh Gibba, a lawmaker who is backed by Jammeh, and former Vice President Isatou Touray, the only woman in the presidential race.
paras.zh: 该领域还包括贾梅支持的独立候选人阿尔马梅·吉巴（Almameh Gibba）和前副总统伊萨图·图雷（Isatou Touray），她是总统竞选中唯一的女性。

paras.en: Gambia is still governed under its 1997 constitution, which was adopted during Jammeh's rule.
paras.zh: 冈比亚仍受贾梅统治期间通过的 1997 年宪法管辖。

paras.en: A proposed replacement, which included presidential term limits, was rejected by the National Assembly in July 2025 after failing to secure the required three-quarter majority.
paras.zh: 由于未能获得所需的四分之三多数，国民议会于 2025 年 7 月拒绝了一项包括总统任期限制在内的替代方案。

paras.en: Barrow has defended his decision to seek a third term, saying voters should decide who leads the country. While he says he supports presidential term limits, he has argued that their introduction depends on securing enough parliamentary backing for a new constitution.
paras.zh: 巴罗为他寻求第三个任期的决定进行了辩护，称选民应该决定谁来领导这个国家。虽然他表示支持总统任期限制，但他辩称，这些限制的引入取决于为新宪法获得足够的议会支持。

paras.en: "I believe in term limits. And the Gambian people are the ones who elect a president," Barrow told reporters after submitting his nomination papers to the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) earlier in November. "So they decide the fate of a president and it is up to the Gambian people to decide whether I should be president for a third time or not."
paras.zh: “我相信任期限制。冈比亚人民是选举总统的人，”巴罗在11月初向独立选举委员会（IEC）提交提名文件后告诉记者。 “因此，他们决定总统的命运，而由冈比亚人民决定我是否应该第三次担任总统。”

paras.en: Opposition parties have said their focus is not only on defeating Barrow but also on ensuring the election is conducted fairly.
paras.zh: 反对党表示，他们的重点不仅是击败巴罗，还要确保选举公平进行。

paras.en: Lamin Manneh, the United Democratic Party's administrative secretary, said the party's immediate priority is to ensure that the IEC conducts credible elections.
paras.zh: 联合民主党行政秘书拉明·曼内表示，该党的当务之急是确保独立选举委员会进行可信的选举。

paras.en: "The IEC has the responsibility of putting Gambians into confidence, ensuring that they guarantee us a credible election, a free election and a fair election," said Manneh.
paras.zh: 曼内说：“独立选举委员会有责任让冈比亚人信任，确保他们保证我们进行可信的选举、自由的选举和公平的选举。”

paras.en: Political analyst Malang Faye said the campaign was still taking shape after the official period began on November 16.
paras.zh: 政治分析家玛朗·费耶 (Malang Faye) 表示，在 11 月 16 日正式选举开始后，竞选活动仍在形成中。

paras.en: "The incumbent is already ahead," he told DW. "Some of the parties are yet to start their campaign." But he cautioned against judging electoral support by rally attendance alone.
paras.zh: “现任者已经领先了，”他告诉德国之声。 “一些政党尚未开始竞选活动。”但他警告不要仅通过集会出席率来判断选举支持率。

paras.en: "A large crowd at a political rally does not necessarily mean the same level of support at the ballot box," Faye added, noting that the election will test whether the democratic transition that began in 2016 can be consolidated.
paras.zh: 费耶补充道：“政治集会上有大量人群并不一定意味着投票箱中得到同样水平的支持。”他指出，这次选举将考验2016年开始的民主转型能否得到巩固。

paras.en: Many voters say their immediate concerns are jobs, affordable living costs and better public services.
paras.zh: 许多选民表示，他们最关心的是就业、负担得起的生活成本和更好的公共服务。

paras.en: The World Bank has projected economic growth of 5.3% in 2026, but said extreme poverty is expected to remain at about 21%.
paras.zh: 世界银行预计2026年经济增长5.3%，但表示极端贫困率预计将维持在21%左右。

paras.en: The 2025 Labour Force Survey puts youth unemployment at 11.5%, while 41.3% of young people are not in employment, education or training.
paras.zh: 2025 年劳动力调查显示，青年失业率为 11.5%，而 41.3% 的青年没有就业、教育或培训。

paras.en: The figures reflect concerns voiced by many young Gambians about the lack of economic opportunities.
paras.zh: 这些数字反映了许多冈比亚年轻人对缺乏经济机会的担忧。

paras.en: Alhagie Sama, a voter in Banjul, said young people need opportunities at home, rather than having to risk dangerous journeys abroad.
paras.zh: 班珠尔选民阿尔哈吉·萨马表示，年轻人需要国内的机会，而不是冒着危险出国旅行的风险。

paras.en: "We need a country where young people do not have to risk their lives crossing the Mediterranean Sea in search of opportunities," he said, adding that he wants the next government to deliver decent jobs, make basic necessities more affordable and improve access to health care and education.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们需要一个年轻人不必冒着生命危险穿越地中海寻找机会的国家。”他补充说，他希望下一届政府能够提供体面的就业机会，使基本必需品更加便宜，并改善获得医疗保健和教育的机会。

paras.en: Another voter and activist, Binta Bojang, said unemployment remains one of the country's biggest challenges.
paras.zh: 另一位选民和活动家宾塔·博扬 (Binta Bojang) 表示，失业仍然是该国最大的挑战之一。

paras.en: "I would want the next president to prioritize employment, like particularly youth employment," she told DW, noting that joblessness goes beyond conventional definitions.
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声：“我希望下一任总统优先考虑就业，尤其是青年就业。”她指出，失业超出了传统定义。

paras.en: "We need to understand unemployment beyond the conventional definition, I mean the dictionary definition. Because unemployment definitely manifests differently in the lives of ordinary Gambians."
paras.zh: “我们需要超越传统定义来理解失业，我指的是字典定义。因为失业在普通冈比亚人的生活中肯定有不同的表现。”

paras.en: The Independent Electoral Commission has said 1,146,474 people are registered to vote. They will cast their ballots across 53 constituencies, 730 polling centers and 1,773 polling stations.
paras.zh: 独立选举委员会表示，已有 1,146,474 人登记投票。他们将在53个选区、730个投票中心和1,773个投票站投票。

paras.en: The commission has been training election officials in voting procedures, counting, verification and the transmission of results. It said the preparations are aimed at ensuring a peaceful and credible election.
paras.zh: 该委员会一直在对选举官员进行投票程序、计票、核查和结果传输方面的培训。声明称，筹备工作旨在确保选举和平、可信。

paras.en: International observers are also monitoring the process.
paras.zh: 国际观察员也在监测这一进程。

paras.en: Following an invitation from Gambian authorities, the European Union has deployed an election observation mission, with teams of analysts and long-term observers across the country.
paras.zh: 应冈比亚当局的邀请，欧盟部署了一个选举观察团，在该国各地设有由分析师和长期观察员组成的团队。

paras.en: The United Nations has also urged candidates to honor the peace pact signed on November 16.
paras.zh: 联合国还敦促候选人遵守11月16日签署的和平协议。

paras.en: "History will judge not what you sign today, but what you do tomorrow and in the days to come," Barrie Freeman, the UN's deputy special representative for West Africa and the Sahel, told candidates.
paras.zh: 联合国西非和萨赫勒地区副特别代表巴里·弗里曼对候选人说：“历史不会评判你今天签署了什么，而是评判你明天和未来几天所做的事情。”

paras.en: Under the pact, presidential candidates pledged "to respect the independence and constitutional mandate of the IEC, to cooperate with it throughout the electoral process, and to seek redress through lawful and appropriate channels should disputes arise."
paras.zh: 根据协议，总统候选人承诺“尊重独立选举委员会的独立性和宪法授权，在整个选举过程中与其合作，并在出现争议时通过合法和适当的渠道寻求纠正。”

paras.en: The December 5 election will test not only Barrow's bid for another term, but also whether the democratic gains made since 2016 can be translated into lasting reforms and improved living conditions.
paras.zh: 12月5日的选举不仅将考验巴罗的连任，也将考验2016年以来取得的民主成果能否转化为持久的改革和改善的生活条件。

paras.en: DW correspondent Aminata Sanyang in Gambia contributed reporting.
paras.zh: 德国之声驻冈比亚记者阿米纳塔·桑阳 (Aminata Sanyang) 提供了报道。

articles.title: Airline Norse Atlantic files for bankruptcy, succumbing to aviation fuel costs

paras.en: Norwegian low-cost, long-haul airline Norse Atlantic's operating unit has declared bankruptcy, the carrier said on Friday.
paras.zh: 挪威低成本长途航空公司挪威大西洋航空公司周五表示，其运营部门已宣布破产。

paras.en: The airline had warned on Wednesday that its financial situation was "critical," and suspended all flights the following day, saying it was urgently seeking emergency funding to fend off bankruptcy.
paras.zh: 该航空公司周三警告称，其财务状况“危急”，并于第二天暂停了所有航班，并表示正在紧急寻求紧急资金以避免破产。

paras.en: Like many commercial airlines, Norse Atlantic is highly exposed to the vastly increased jet fuel prices of 2026, attributable in very large part to the war in Iran and resultant tension throughout the wider Middle East.
paras.zh: 与许多商业航空公司一样，挪威大西洋航空公司面临着 2026 年航空燃油价格大幅上涨的风险，这在很大程度上归因于伊朗战争以及由此引发的整个中东地区的紧张局势。

paras.en: What did Norse Atlantic say about the bankruptcy filing?
paras.zh: 挪威大西洋航空公司对破产申请有何评论？

paras.en: Norse had said slightly earlier on Friday that its lessors had terminated their leasing contracts for all 12 aircraft in the carrier's fleet, demanding that the planes be handed back. Initially the company said it planned to contest this claim, which would have rendered it effectively unable to operate.
paras.zh: Norse 周五早些时候表示，其出租人已终止该航空公司机队所有 12 架飞机的租赁合同，并要求归还这些飞机。最初，该公司表示计划对这一说法提出异议，否则该公司实际上将无法运营。

paras.en: But the announcement of plans to file for bankruptcy followed fairly soon after.
paras.zh: 但不久之后就宣布了申请破产的计划。

paras.en: "The Board of Norse Atlantic Airways AS has made the difficult decision to file for bankruptcy despite extensive efforts from the company and the group to find a solution," Norse CEO Eivind Roald said in a statement.
paras.zh: Norse 首席执行官埃温德·罗尔德 (Eivind Roald) 在一份声明中表示：“尽管公司和集团为寻找解决方案付出了巨大努力，但北欧大西洋航空公司董事会还是做出了申请破产的艰难决定。”

paras.en: Other companies in the group like the stock market-listed Norse Atlantic ASA parent company and the Norse Atlantic UK subsidiary are not part of the filing and are still attempting to stay in business, the company said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，该集团中的其他公司，如在股票市场上市的 Norse Atlantic ASA 母公司和 Norse Atlantic 英国子公司，并未纳入备案范围，仍在努力维持业务。

paras.en: "The board, management and advisers of the listed entity Norse Atlantic ASA and the UK subsidiary are working to find a solution for the remaining part of the business to continue operations," Roald said.
paras.zh: 罗尔德表示：“上市实体 Norse Atlantic ASA 和英国子公司的董事会、管理层和顾问正在努力寻找解决方案，让剩余业务继续运​​营。”

paras.en: The company said on Thursday that it planned to file for bankruptcy unless financing could be arranged and had warned: "There can be no assurance that a viable solution will be found."
paras.zh: 该公司周四表示，除非能够安排融资，否则计划申请破产，并警告称：“无法保证找到可行的解决方案。”

paras.en: Founded just five years ago and based in Arendal in Norway, Norse Atlantic had a fleet of 12 planes and serviced a total of 14 destinations. It had recorded a net loss of $61.9 million (€56.5 million) in 2025, even before the additional economic strains caused by the war in Iran.
paras.zh: Norse Atlantic 成立于五年前，总部位于挪威阿伦达尔，拥有一支由 12 架飞机组成的机队，为总共 14 个目的地提供服务。即使在伊朗战争造成额外经济压力之前，该公司 2025 年的净亏损为 6190 万美元（5650 万欧元）。

paras.en: Why has the war in Iran put such strain on the aviation industry?
paras.zh: 为什么伊朗战争给航空业带来如此大的压力？

paras.en: Small and lower-cost airlines are struggling in particular, but the aviation industry in general is facing severe problems amid the strains on global fuel deliveries caused by the conflict in the Gulf.
paras.zh: 小型和低成本航空公司尤其陷入困境，但由于海湾冲突导致全球燃油运输紧张，航空业总体上面临着严重问题。

paras.en: In early 2026, as the US launched attacks on Iran — soon leading to reduced traffic through the Strait of Hormuz — aviation fuel rapidly spiked, more than doubling in price at its peak.
paras.zh: 2026 年初，随着美国对伊朗发动袭击，很快导致霍尔木兹海峡的交通量减少，航空燃油价格迅速飙升，最高时价格翻了一番多。

paras.en: It rose higher even than in the immediate aftermath of Russia's full scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Although it dipped in mid-summer amid hopes of a resolution to the conflict, it rose once again as these faded and a stalemate developed.
paras.zh: 该汇率的涨幅甚至高于俄罗斯 2022 年全面入侵乌克兰后的汇率。尽管该汇率在仲夏因冲突得到解决的希望而有所下降，但随着冲突消退和僵局的发展，该汇率再次上升。

paras.en: This has posed the worst crisis for the industry since the COVID pandemic drastically reduced the volume of air traffic in 2020 and beyond, a much larger issue that many carriers were still struggling to recover from.
paras.zh: 这给该行业带来了自新冠疫情大流行导致 2020 年及以后航空运输量大幅减少以来最严重的危机，这是许多航空公司仍在努力恢复的一个更大的问题。

articles.title: Indian workers fill Germany's labor gaps but face hurdles and risks

paras.en: The 25-year-old from the northern Indian state of Haryana reached out to explore employment opportunities.
paras.zh: 这位来自印度北部哈里亚纳邦的 25 岁年轻人伸出援手寻找就业机会。

paras.en: Four years later, he is working as a butcher at Metzgerei Lederer in southern Germany, having completed a three-year apprenticeship at the butcher shop.
paras.zh: 四年后，他在德国南部的 Metzgerei Lederer 完成了三年的学徒期，成为一名屠夫。

paras.en: "I came to Baden-Württemberg with 180 other Indians who came here to do an Ausbildung [apprenticeship] program. Me and seven others did our Ausbildung at Lederer [butcher shop], while others went into the construction sector. I now have a full-time job here," Saikia told DW.
paras.zh: “我和其他 180 名印度人一起来到巴登符腾堡州，参加 Ausbildung [学徒] 项目。我和另外七个人在 Lederer [肉店] 完成我们的 Ausbildung，而其他人则进入建筑行业。我现在在这里有一份全职工作，”Saikia 告诉德国之声。

paras.en: He is not alone as the number of Indian workers subject to social security contributions in Germany has grown sevenfold over the past decade, to over 140,000 professionals.
paras.zh: 他并不孤单，在德国缴纳社会保障金的印度工人人数在过去十年中增长了七倍，达到超过 140,000 名专业人士。

paras.en: Many of them work in the IT and health care sectors.
paras.zh: 他们中的许多人在 IT 和医疗保健行业工作。

paras.en: Pressing need for workers, but hesitant to hire
paras.zh: 迫切需要工人，但犹豫是否雇用

paras.en: Germany, facing a shrinking and rapidly aging population, doesn't just need software specialists and nurses. It is also seeking skilled professionals such as electricians, mechatronics technicians, solar panel installers and truck drivers.
paras.zh: 德国面临着人口萎缩和迅速老龄化的问题，不仅需要软件专家和护士。该公司还在寻找熟练的专业人员，如电工、机电一体化技术人员、太阳能电池板安装人员和卡车司机。

paras.en: A 2024 study by Bertelsmann Foundation concluded that Germany needs 288,000 foreign skilled workers per year until 2040 to fill the shortage left by retiring workers. Another report from the consulting firm FMC Group noted that over 369,000 skilled job positions went unfilled in 2025.
paras.zh: 贝塔斯曼基金会 2024 年的一项研究得出的结论是，到 2040 年，德国每年需要 288,000 名外国技术工人，以填补退休工人留下的短缺。咨询公司 FMC Group 的另一份报告指出，2025 年有超过 369,000 个技术职位空缺。

paras.en: Despite the pressing need for skilled workers, many firms, particularly Germany's renowned Mittelstand (small and medium-sized enterprises), are reluctant to recruit from places like India, say observers.
paras.zh: 观察人士表示，尽管迫切需要熟练工人，但许多公司，特别是德国著名的中小型企业，不愿从印度等地招聘人才。

paras.en: "Hiring an electrician from India is a relatively new concept for German companies, so they are hesitant," said Daniel Raja, managing director of NM NextMittelstand GmbH, a Düsseldorf-based recruitment firm focused on connecting German firms with skilled workers from India.
paras.zh: “从印度聘请电工对于德国公司来说是一个相对较新的概念，因此他们犹豫不决，”位于杜塞尔多夫的招聘公司 NM NextMittelstand GmbH 的董事总经理丹尼尔·拉贾 (Daniel Raja) 表示，该公司致力于为德国公司与印度的技术工人牵线搭桥。

paras.en: The Mittelstand companies are often overlooked by young talent abroad, while many of these firms are not actively recruiting international skilled workers, Raja said.
paras.zh: 拉贾说，中小型企业经常被国外的年轻人才所忽视，而其中许多企业并没有积极招募国际技术工人。

paras.en: This disconnect, coupled with the often high German language requirements, means that many skilled positions remain unfilled, he explained.
paras.zh: 他解释说，这种脱节，加上德语语言要求往往很高，意味着许多技术职位仍然空缺。

paras.en: Saikia, the butcher, had studied German to the B1 level, considered intermediate proficiency. He soon realized it was not enough for everyday communication at work.
paras.zh: 屠夫萨基亚（Saikia）学过德语，达到了B1水平，算是中级水平。他很快意识到这不足以满足工作中的日常沟通。

paras.en: "Initially, I found the theory classes of my Ausbildung quite difficult. But my co-workers helped me. After one year, my German improved, and I realized integration happened automatically as my language level improved," he said.
paras.zh: “最初，我发现 Ausbildung 的理论课程相当困难。但是我的同事帮助了我。一年后，我的德语有所提高，我意识到随着我的语言水平的提高，融入会自动发生，”他说。

paras.en: David Kipp, researcher in the Global Issues Research Group at the German Institute for International and Security Affairs (SWP), said he's "skeptical" about lowering language requirements.
paras.zh: 德国国际与安全事务研究所（SWP）全球问题研究小组研究员戴维·基普（David Kipp）表示，他对降低语言要求持“怀疑”态度。

paras.en: "Language skills are an important selection criterion so people actually know where they are going. Sending people with very little language knowledge makes exploitation easier, because they have less direct contact with German institutions," he told DW.
paras.zh: “语言技能是一个重要的选择标准，因此人们实际上知道自己要去哪里。派出语言知识很少的人会更容易被剥削，因为他们与德国机构的直接接触较少，”他告诉德国之声。

paras.en: Language, however, isn't the only hurdle.
paras.zh: 然而，语言并不是唯一的障碍。

paras.en: Raja said workers' councils also often resist hiring from abroad.
paras.zh: 拉贾说，工人委员会也经常拒绝从国外招聘员工。

paras.en: "Company decisions in the Mittelstand involve the team and the shop floor," he pointed out. "In some cases, the workers' council resists hiring from India because they mistakenly believe 'cheap Indian labor' will take their jobs or undercut their wages."
paras.zh: “中小型企业的决策涉及团队和车间，”他指出。 “在某些情况下，工人委员会拒绝从印度招聘，因为他们错误地认为‘廉价的印度劳动力’会抢走他们的工作或降低他们的工资。”

paras.en: Raja said he often uses unconventional outreach methods, including hosting TikTok Live sessions, to engage directly with industrial employers and workers and dispel concerns and misconceptions.
paras.zh: Raja 表示，他经常使用非传统的外展方式，包括举办 TikTok Live 会议，直接与工业雇主和工人接触，消除担忧和误解。

paras.en: German companies have traditionally relied on workers from Central and Eastern European (CEE) nations such as Poland, Romania and Slovenia to fill labor market gaps.
paras.zh: 德国企业传统上依赖来自波兰、罗马尼亚和斯洛文尼亚等中东欧国家的工人来填补劳动力市场缺口。

paras.en: But studies show CEE workers are increasingly reluctant to relocate to Germany, as faster economic growth and stronger career prospects improve opportunities in their home countries.
paras.zh: 但研究表明，中东欧工人越来越不愿意搬到德国，因为更快的经济增长和更强劲的职业前景改善了他们祖国的机会。

paras.en: The situation has prompted recruitment agencies in these countries to look beyond the European Union for workers.
paras.zh: 这种情况促使这些国家的招聘机构将目光投向欧盟以外的地方寻找工人。

paras.en: These third-country nationals (TCNs) obtain residence permits in CEE states and are then posted to German job sites under the Vander Elst visa. The mechanism allows non-EU citizens legally employed in one EU member state to be temporarily sent to work in another.
paras.zh: 这些第三国国民 (TCN) 获得中东欧国家的居留许可，然后通过范德埃尔斯特签证被派往德国工作地点。该机制允许在一个欧盟成员国合法就业的非欧盟公民暂时被派往另一个欧盟成员国工作。

paras.en: "European Labour Authority's (ELA) 2025 study on the posting of third-country nationals found that the number of posted TCNs is increasing. The main sectors concerned are construction and transport," said Pia Fallstrom, ELA spokesperson.
paras.zh: ELA 发言人 Pia Fallstrom 表示：“欧洲劳工局 (ELA) 2025 年关于派遣第三国国民的研究发现，派遣 TCN 的数量正在增加。主要涉及的行业是建筑业和运输业。”

paras.en: The exact number of TCNs posted across the EU is difficult to gauge, as data exchange between sending and receiving countries by nationality and sector is limited.
paras.zh: 由于发送国和接收国之间按国籍和部门划分的数据交换有限，因此很难衡量欧盟各地发布的 TCN 的确切数量。

paras.en: "Finding out how blue-collar workers get here really requires fieldwork," said Kipp, noting that Indian recruiters are aware of this mobility loophole and take advantage of these opportunities.
paras.zh: 基普说：“要了解蓝领工人如何来到这里，确实需要进行实地考察。”他指出，印度招聘人员已经意识到了这一流动性漏洞，并利用了这些机会。

paras.en: While there are regulations to protect workers posted to Germany from another EU state, ELA said the practice has often led to wage-dumping.
paras.zh: 虽然有法规保护从其他欧盟国家派往德国的工人，但 ELA 表示，这种做法常常导致工资倾销。

paras.en: "ELA's work has identified issues such as difficulties accessing information on applicable rules, complex subcontracting arrangements, letterbox companies, bogus self-employment and other cases of non-compliance," noted Fallstrom.
paras.zh: Fallstrom 指出：“ELA 的工作发现了一些问题，例如难以获取有关适用规则的信息、复杂的分包安排、信箱公司、虚假自营职业和其他违规案例。”

paras.en: "Posted third-country nationals can be particularly vulnerable because they may also depend on their employer for their work and residence permits."
paras.zh: “被派驻的第三国国民可能特别容易受到影响，因为他们可能还依赖雇主来获取工作和居留许可。”

paras.en: Raja said he had seen cases of workers falling victim to recruitment scams and being exploited as a result.
paras.zh: 拉贾说，他见过工人成为招聘骗局的受害者并因此受到剥削的案例。

paras.en: "I know of a family that took out a loan so that their child could enroll in an institute which promised a job in Germany," said Raja. "When the candidate realized it's a scam, they ended up in Bahrain doing a tough manual labor job just to pay off the loan."
paras.zh: “我知道有一个家庭申请了一笔贷款，以便他们的孩子可以进入一家承诺在德国找到工作的机构，”拉贾说。 “当候选人意识到这是一个骗局时，他们最终在巴林做了一份艰苦的体力劳动，只是为了还清贷款。”

paras.en: What to do to prevent exploitative hiring practices?
paras.zh: 如何防止剥削性招聘行为？

paras.en: Saikia, the butcher, stressed the importance of workers verifying that a recruitment agency is legitimate.
paras.zh: 屠夫 Saikia 强调了工人验证招聘机构是否合法的重要性。

paras.en: In his case, he said the agency's detailed website and its CEO's willingness to speak with him during the early stages of the recruitment process gave him confidence that it was not a scam.
paras.zh: 就他的情况而言，他表示该机构详细的网站及其首席执行官愿意在招聘过程的早期阶段与他交谈，这让他相信这不是一个骗局。

paras.en: Kipp, the SWP expert, argued that preventing exploitative hiring practices requires streamlining migration procedures, expanding pre-departure cultural training and becoming more effective at identifying trusted entities and combating social media scams.
paras.zh: SWP 专家基普认为，防止剥削性招聘行为需要简化移民程序、扩大出发前文化培训，并更有效地识别可信实体和打击社交媒体诈骗。

paras.en: "India is the most important country for experimenting with how work migration functions. If we don't pay attention, we'll just send people into the low-wage sector and into disappointment," he said.
paras.zh: “印度是尝试工作移民如何运作的最重要国家。如果我们不注意，我们只会让人们进入低工资行业并陷入失望，”他说。

articles.title: How Israel is fast-tracking data centres in bid to become ‘AI superpower’

paras.en: As the artificial intelligence (AI) race between the United States and China heats up, with both superpowers vying to gain a competitive edge, a third party is looking to punch above its weight.
paras.zh: 随着美国和中国之间的人工智能（AI）竞赛愈演愈烈，两个超级大国都在争夺竞争优势，第三方正在寻求超越自己的力量。

paras.en: Israel, which Nvidia’s Jensen Huang has called a “second home“, is cutting red tape and fast-tracking data centre construction to position itself as a key hub for the AI ecosystem.
paras.zh: 以色列被英伟达 (Nvidia) 的黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 称为“第二故乡”，该国正在削减繁文缛节并加快数据中心建设，将自己定位为人工智能生态系统的关键枢纽。

paras.en: “We will turn Israel into a global AI superpower,” Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in June, as his government announced a sweeping national plan to accelerate AI intelligence development.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡 (Benjamin Netanyahu) 在 6 月份表示：“我们将把以色列变成全球人工智能超级大国。”当时，以色列政府宣布了一项全面的国家计划，以加速人工智能发展。

paras.en: Israel’s position on the AI landscape is arguably well set. US giant Nvidia began its stratospheric rise to the world’s most valuable semiconductor company with its acquisition of Mellanox, an Israeli company which supplies computer networking products, in April 2020 for nearly $7bn.
paras.zh: 以色列在人工智能领域的地位可以说是很明确的。美国巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 于 2020 年 4 月以近 70 亿美元收购了供应计算机网络产品的以色列公司 Mellanox，开始了向全球最有价值半导体公司的平流崛起。

paras.en: That acquisition was central to Nvidia’s success: its networking business, built around Mellanox, generated more than $21bn in revenues in the third quarter of 2026. That’s about 18 percent of Nvidia’s total quarterly revenue.
paras.zh: 这次收购对于 Nvidia 的成功至关重要：其围绕 Mellanox 构建的网络业务在 2026 年第三季度创造了超过 210 亿美元的收入。这约占 Nvidia 季度总收入的 18%。

paras.en: Now, Nvidia’s operations in Israel are its largest in research and development outside the US. It has doubled its employees there in the past three years to 6,000 people across seven research and development centres and has plans to build a major research and development campus in Kiryat Tivon near Haifa to accommodate up to 10,000 employees.
paras.zh: 现在，英伟达在以色列的研发业务是美国以外最大的。过去三年，该公司在七个研发中心的员工人数增加了一倍，达到 6,000 人，并计划在海法附近的基亚特蒂文 (Kiryat Tivon) 建立一个主要研发园区，可容纳多达 10,000 名员工。

paras.en: In an interview with Israeli media in September, Netanyahu laid out an ambitious timeframe for Israel’s AI roadmap. “Within five years, we will be the third AI power,” he said.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在 9 月份接受以色列媒体采访时，为以色列的人工智能路线图制定了雄心勃勃的时间表。 “五年之内，我们将成为第三个人工智能强国，”他说。

paras.en: Analysts view his infrastructure drive as a structural shift that will expand Israel’s high-speed data-processing capabilities, carrying major implications for both military strength and geopolitical influence.
paras.zh: 分析人士认为，他的基础设施建设是一种结构性转变，将扩大以色列的高速数据处理能力，对军事实力和地缘政治影响力产生重大影响。

paras.en: The pinnacle of Israel’s innovation drive is the planned Ofek Data Center, set to become Israel’s largest data-processing facility upon completion in the second half of 2029, north of the port of Ashdod.
paras.zh: 以色列创新驱动的顶峰是规划中的 Ofek 数据中心，该中心位于阿什杜德港以北，将于 2029 年下半年竣工，届时将成为以色列最大的数据处理设施。

paras.en: Financed by a consortium including US-based digital infrastructure firm Serverfarm and the Israel Infrastructure Fund (IIF), the project is expected to cost $1.5bn initially, with an additional $5bn planned for future upgrades.
paras.zh: 该项目由美国数字基础设施公司 Serverfarm 和以色列基础设施基金 (IIF) 等财团资助，预计初期耗资 15 亿美元，并计划额外投入 50 亿美元用于未来升级。

paras.en: The facility will connect directly to European markets via an underwater fibre-optic cable and will integrate Nvidia data centre GPUs to accelerate server workloads, launching with a capacity of 130MW before expanding to 200MW.
paras.zh: 该设施将通过水下光缆直接连接到欧洲市场，并将集成 Nvidia 数据中心 GPU 以加速服务器工作负载，启动容量为 130MW，然后扩展到 200MW。

paras.en: Israel currently counts 67 data centres, according to research group Data Center Map, and Netanyahu’s government has been removing regulatory bottlenecks to facilitate new projects.
paras.zh: 根据研究小组数据中心地图的数据，以色列目前有 67 个数据中心，内塔尼亚胡政府一直在消除监管瓶颈以促进新项目的开展。

paras.en: In February, the government launched an initiative to classify AI data centres as national infrastructure to bypass local regulation, but the rapid expansion hit a major bottleneck last month when the Israeli Electrical Authority capped the capacity of all new data centres in the country at 200MW due to high grid connection demand.
paras.zh: 今年 2 月，政府发起了一项举措，将人工智能数据中心归类为国家基础设施，以绕开当地监管，但上个月，由于并网需求较高，以色列电力局将该国所有新建数据中心的容量限制在 200 兆瓦，因此快速扩张遇到了主要瓶颈。

paras.en: Analysts say electricity availability is the largest operating expense for modern data centres, and a key factor in determining directly how quickly new facilities can be built and what profit margins they can achieve.
paras.zh: 分析师表示，电力供应是现代数据中心最大的运营支出，也是直接决定新设施建设速度及其利润率的关键因素。

paras.en: “Fast-tracking permits is a governance decision,” Rajiv Dalal, a London-based independent researcher and adviser on AI governability, told Al Jazeera. “Securing the electricity to run what gets built is a governability question, and the distance between the two is where the economic case gets tested.
paras.zh: “快速审批许可是一项治理决策，”伦敦独立研究员兼人工智能治理顾问拉吉夫·达拉尔 (Rajiv Dalal) 告诉半岛电视台。 “确保所建项目的电力供应是一个可治理性问题，而两者之间的距离是经济情况受到考验的地方。

paras.en: “Israel is small, grid-constrained and dependent on imported hardware,” Dalal said, while “superpower status requires gigawatt-level capacity, reliable power and steady access to advanced chips.”
paras.zh: 达拉尔表示：“以色列国土面积小，电网受限，依赖进口硬件，而超级大国地位则需要千兆瓦级的容量、可靠的电力以及稳定获得先进芯片。”

paras.en: In short, a greater AI vision requires a lot of power.
paras.zh: 简而言之，更大的人工智能愿景需要强大的力量。

paras.en: To allocate electricity to servers, Minister of Energy and Infrastructure Eli Cohen has stressed that Israel must develop nuclear energy as a power source, as well as using natural gas from the Eastern Mediterranean offshore fields Tamar, Leviathan and Karish – near disputed maritime waters with Lebanon – and a fourth, Katlan, expected to come online in 2027.
paras.zh: 为了给服务器分配电力，以色列能源和基础设施部长伊莱·科恩强调，以色列必须发展核能作为能源，并使用来自东地中海近海油田 Tamar、Leviathan 和 Karish 的天然气（靠近与黎巴嫩有争议的海域），第四个油田 Katlan 预计将于 2027 年上线。

paras.en: The Ofek Data Center will be directly powered by an 850MW gas-fired power station constructed adjacent to Ashdod’s port, according to Israeli media reports.
paras.zh: 据以色列媒体报道，Ofek 数据中心将由阿什杜德港口附近建造的 850 兆瓦燃气发电站直接供电。

paras.en: Mark Esposito, a public policy scholar at the Berkman Klein Center for Internet and Society at Harvard University in the US, said the rationale for building data centres is more geopolitical and strategic than narrowly commercial.
paras.zh: 美国哈佛大学伯克曼克莱因互联网与社会中心公共政策学者马克·埃斯波西托表示，建设数据中心的理由更多地是地缘政治和战略性的，而不是狭隘的商业目的。

paras.en: “On pure market-efficiency grounds, domestic AI data centres are often hard to justify,” Esposito told Al Jazeera. “For a country with strategic AI ambitions, a domestic data-centre footprint is less about immediate returns and more about owning a chokepoint in the next industrial phase.”
paras.zh: “纯粹从市场效率的角度来看，国内人工智能数据中心往往很难证明其合理性，”埃斯波西托告诉半岛电视台。 “对于一个有着人工智能战略雄心的国家来说，国内数据中心的足迹并不是为了立即回报，而是为了在下一个工业阶段占据一个瓶颈。”

paras.en: Domestic data centres do not by themselves make a country an AI superpower, but it is very hard to become one without them. “They are the territorial anchor of AI power,” Esposito said.
paras.zh: 国内数据中心本身并不能让一个国家成为人工智能超级大国，但没有它们就很难成为人工智能超级大国。 “他们是人工智能力量的领土锚，”埃斯波西托说。

paras.en: Over time, these facilities “draw in cloud providers, AI labs, semiconductor packaging, cooling specialists and energy infrastructure, building an ecosystem in which talent, capital and data reinforce one another,” the analyst added.
paras.zh: 这位分析师补充说，随着时间的推移，这些设施“吸引了云提供商、人工智能实验室、半导体封装、冷却专家和能源基础设施，建立了一个人才、资本和数据相互促进的生态系统”。

paras.en: When Netanyahu’s government approved the plan to fast-track AI data centres in February, citing national security, the prime minister said the move would be a “decisive factor in the continued cultivation of our power”.
paras.zh: 当内塔尼亚胡政府二月份以国家安全为由批准快速发展人工智能数据中心的计划时，总理表示此举将是“继续培养我们实力的决定性因素”。

paras.en: “However, it is not just about projecting or building power; it is also about gaining immense power advantages on a global scale,” he said. “We must do this because we are a small and threatened country.”
paras.zh: “然而，这不仅仅是投射或建设力量；这也是在全球范围内获得巨大的力量优势，”他说。 “我们必须这样做，因为我们是一个受到威胁的小国。”

paras.en: Erez Askal, the head of Israel’s National AI Directorate, echoed this sentiment. “In the coming years, it will become clear which countries will succeed in establishing their place at the global forefront of the artificial intelligence era, and which will be forced to rely on technologies, infrastructure and capabilities developed by others,” he said.
paras.zh: 以色列国家人工智能局局长埃雷兹·阿斯卡尔 (Erez Askal) 也表达了同样的观点。他表示：“未来几年，哪些国家将成功跻身人工智能时代全球前沿，哪些国家将被迫依赖其他国家开发的技术、基础设施和能力，这一点将变得显而易见。”

paras.en: According to Esposito at Harvard, AI is no longer just software but critical national infrastructure that determines geopolitical and economic power.
paras.zh: 哈佛大学的埃斯波西托认为，人工智能不再只是软件，而是决定地缘政治和经济实力的关键国家基础设施。

paras.en: “Countries with domestic AI infrastructure will hold meaningful bargaining power over those without it,” he said. “That asymmetry will shape trade negotiations, security alliances and access to technology for the next decade.”
paras.zh: “拥有国内人工智能基础设施的国家将比那些没有国内人工智能基础设施的国家拥有有意义的议价能力，”他说。 “这种不对称将影响未来十年的贸易谈判、安全联盟和技术获取。”

paras.en: Localising AI infrastructure allows governments to insulate part of the AI value chain from foreign disruption and supply bottlenecks, while raw materials and chips, foundation models, AI applications and cloud infrastructure also play crucial, interconnected roles in the AI stack.
paras.zh: 人工智能基础设施本地化使政府能够使人工智能价值链的一部分免受外国干扰和供应瓶颈的影响，而原材料和芯片、基础模型、人工智能应用程序和云基础设施也在人工智能堆栈中发挥着至关重要的、相互关联的作用。

paras.en: The advantage is also faster and more stable inference – or the generation of an output by running data through a trained AI model – according to Mark Muro, senior fellow with the Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technology Initiative at the Brookings Institution in Washington, DC.
paras.zh: 华盛顿特区布鲁金斯学会人工智能和新兴技术计划高级研究员马克·穆罗 (Mark Muro) 表示，其优势还在于更快、更稳定的推理，或者通过训练有素的人工智能模型运行数据来生成输出。

paras.en: “Stable local inferencing is going to become an important support of local business, grid and military advantage,” he said.
paras.zh: “稳定的本地推理将成为本地商业、电网和军事优势的重要支撑，”他说。

paras.en: Israel has been known to have deployed AI as part of its military arsenal in Gaza and the West Bank.
paras.zh: 众所周知，以色列已将人工智能部署为其在加沙和约旦河西岸的军事武库的一部分。

paras.en: Muro added that building smaller facilities to support local inference, rather than bigger data centres used for training AI models, is what matters for “keeping the lights on” and securing the country’s continued AI use.
paras.zh: Muro 补充说，建设较小的设施来支持本地推理，而不是用于训练人工智能模型的大型数据中心，才是“保持正常运转”和确保国家继续使用人工智能的关键。

paras.en: As Israel fast-tracks data centres, Europe is lagging behind due to severe power grid bottlenecks, slow permitting processes and public backlash against data centres.
paras.zh: 在以色列快速发展数据中心的同时，欧洲由于严重的电网瓶颈、缓慢的许可流程以及公众对数据中心的强烈反对而落在了后面。

paras.en: The European Union is already heavily dependent on data centres and cloud infrastructure controlled abroad, and analysts warn that this reliance is deepening.
paras.zh: 欧盟已经严重依赖国外控制的数据中心和云基础设施，分析人士警告说，这种依赖正在加深。

paras.en: The US hosts roughly 51 percent of the world’s data centres. Shifting computing workloads to the US or other cheaper or idle data centres outside the EU – including, potentially, Israel’s Ofek – allows for flexibility at times when local servers are busy or electricity consumption is high.
paras.zh: 美国拥有全球约 51% 的数据中心。将计算工作负载转移到美国或欧盟以外其他更便宜或闲置的数据中心（可能包括以色列的 Ofek）可以在本地服务器繁忙或电力消耗较高时实现灵活性。

paras.en: By contrast, confining data to the bounds of the EU comes at a price premium of 30 percent or more, according to European Commission estimates, but ensures its data falls strictly under European privacy laws, shielding citizens, businesses and governments from foreign surveillance.
paras.zh: 相比之下，根据欧盟委员会的估计，将数据限制在欧盟范围内的价格溢价为 30% 或更多，但可以确保其数据严格遵守欧洲隐私法，保护公民、企业和政府免受外国监视。

paras.en: Additionally, keeping servers within EU borders allows military, intelligence and government agencies to process classified or sensitive information without sending it abroad.
paras.zh: 此外，将服务器保留在欧盟境内允许军事、情报和政府机构处理机密或敏感信息，而无需将其发送到国外。

paras.en: “For politically and security-sensitive applications, you don’t want foreign powers to listen into your communications and computations,” Bertin Martens, a senior fellow at the Bruegel think tank in Brussels, Belgium, said. “Hence, the need for domestic data centres for sensitive applications.”
paras.zh: “对于政治和安全敏感的应用程序，你不希望外国势力监听你的通信和计算，”比利时布鲁塞尔布鲁盖尔智库的高级研究员贝尔廷·马滕斯说。 “因此，敏感应用需要国内数据中心。”

paras.en: Simone Vannuccini, junior professor chair of economics of artificial intelligence and innovation at the University Cote d’Azur in Nice, France, said relying on Israel or another foreign power for computing power opens up “new fronts” in terms of geopolitics.
paras.zh: 法国尼斯蔚蓝海岸大学人工智能与创新经济学初级教授西蒙娜·万努奇尼 (Simone Vannuccini) 表示，依靠以色列或其他外国大国的计算能力开辟了地缘政治方面的“新战线”。

paras.en: “Maybe we will be less prone to criticising something, and that’s indeed potentially the risk,” he said.
paras.zh: “也许我们将不再那么容易批评某些事情，这确实是潜在的风险，”他说。

paras.en: At present, Israel does not possess the capability to wield significant leverage, but its weight increases if taken cumulatively with the US. “The US have a big weapon in their hands,” Vannuccini concluded. “Israel also has a weapon in their hand, but it’s slightly smaller.”
paras.zh: 目前，以色列不具备发挥重要影响力的能力，但如果与美国叠加，其影响力就会增加。 “美国手中握有一件强大的武器，”万努奇尼总结道。 “以色列手里也有武器，只是稍微小一点。”

articles.title: Uganda starts mRNA Ebola vaccine trial in first for Africa

paras.en: Africa’s first clinical trial has begun in Uganda of an mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain behind a deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).
paras.zh: 非洲首个临床试验已在乌干达开始，针对刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 致命埃博拉疫情爆发后的 Bundibugyo 病毒株进行 mRNA 疫苗临床试验。

paras.en: The state-run Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI) said in a statement on Friday that the trial began in collaboration with Moderna, a United States-based company which manufactures the vaccine.
paras.zh: 国营乌干达病毒研究所（UVRI）在周五的一份声明中表示，该试验是与生产该疫苗的美国公司 Moderna 合作开始的。

paras.en: The Ugandan trial is the second for the vaccine, after Moderna began its first human trial of the shots in Canada in August, targeting adults from 18 to 65 years old.
paras.zh: 乌干达的试验是继 Moderna 于 8 月在加拿大开始针对 18 至 65 岁成年人的首次人体试验之后，对该疫苗进行的第二次试验。

paras.en: UVRI said the Ugandan trial will for the first time test the vaccine’s safety and ability to trigger an immune response in children aged 1 year and above, and aims to enrol 224 volunteers.
paras.zh: UVRI表示，乌干达试验将首次测试该疫苗的安全性以及在1岁及以上儿童中引发免疫反应的能力，目标是招募224名志愿者。

paras.en: “Children are often among those hardest hit when Ebola strikes, yet they ‌are too often the last to benefit from new vaccines,” said Richard Hatchett, chief executive officer of the Coalition ‌for ‌Epidemic Preparedness Innovations, which is helping fund the vaccine.
paras.zh: 为疫苗提供资金的流行病防范创新联盟首席执行官理查德·哈切特 (Richard Hatchett) 表示：“埃博拉病毒来袭时，儿童往往是受灾最严重的人群，但他们往往是最后受益于新疫苗的群体。”

paras.en: The other potential candidate for combating the Bundibugyo strain is the ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector vaccine developed by India’s Serum Institute and the University of Oxford. It will begin testing in the DRC on Monday.
paras.zh: 另一种对抗 Bundibugyo 菌株的潜在候选疫苗是印度血清研究所和牛津大学开发的 ChAdOx1 腺病毒载体疫苗。将于周一开始在刚果民主共和国进行测试。

paras.en: But Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, which brings together government and private donors to help developing countries acquire jabs at affordable prices, is not waiting.
paras.zh: 但全球疫苗免疫联盟 (Gavi) 并没有等待，该联盟汇集了政府和私人捐助者，帮助发展中国家以可承受的价格获得疫苗。

paras.en: It signed a purchase commitment last week with the Serum Institute for 1.5 million doses of ChAdOx1, and plans to have “hundreds of thousands” ready to deploy should the trials prove successful and be approved by the World Health Organization and the DRC government.
paras.zh: 该公司上周与血清研究所签署了购买 150 万剂 ChAdOx1 的承诺，并计划在试验成功并获得世界卫生组织和刚果民主共和国政府批准的情况下准备部署“数十万剂”。

paras.en: Emanuele Capobianco, Gavi’s director of global health security, said he hoped trials of the drug would conclude in early 2027 and that, if successful, the purchase deal could move up deployment by months.
paras.zh: Gavi 全球卫生安全主管埃马努埃莱·卡波比安科 (Emanuele Capobianco) 表示，他希望该药物的试验能够在 2027 年初结束，如果成功，购买协议可能会将部署时间提前几个月。

paras.en: On Thursday, DRC government data showed that at least 12,021 Ebola infections have been confirmed, including 5,904 deaths since the outbreak began in mid-May.
paras.zh: 周四，刚果民主共和国政府数据显示，自 5 月中旬疫情爆发以来，已确认至少 12,021 例埃博拉感染病例，其中 5,904 人死亡。

paras.en: Uganda declared its Ebola outbreak over on July 28. It had recorded 20 infections and two deaths, according to the Ministry of Health.
paras.zh: 乌干达于 7 月 28 日宣布埃博拉疫情结束。据乌干达卫生部称，该国已有 20 人感染，2 人死亡。

articles.title: Students killed or injured in school explosion in Afghanistan’s Kunar

paras.en: An unidentified number of students have been killed or injured in an explosion inside a school in eastern Afghanistan’s Kunar province, according to an Afghan government official speaking to Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 阿富汗政府官员告诉半岛电视台，阿富汗东部库纳尔省一所学校发生爆炸，造成人数不明的学生伤亡。

paras.en: The blast took place on Saturday morning a school in Kunar’s Andar Ser area, according to Farid Dehqan, spokesperson for the Kunar Provincial Police Headquarters, quoted by the Associated Press news agency.
paras.zh: 美联社援引库纳尔省警察总部发言人法里德·德赫坎 (Farid Dehqan) 的话说，爆炸发生在周六早上库纳尔安达尔塞地区的一所学校。

paras.en: There was no immediate information on what caused the explosion. Investigative teams from Kunar province, which is located on the border with Pakistan, were at the scene, Dehqan said.
paras.zh: 目前还没有关于爆炸原因的直接信息。德赫坎说，位于巴基斯坦边境的库纳尔省的调查小组已经赶到现场。

paras.en: In August, a hand grenade attack at a school complex in the Afghan capital of Kabul wounded more than 40 children aged between 9 and 14.
paras.zh: 8月，阿富汗首都喀布尔一所学校发生手榴弹袭击，造成40多名9岁至14岁的儿童受伤。

articles.title: Greetings from Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest point in all its splendor
articles.author: Emily Feng

paras.en: Greetings from Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest point in all its splendor
paras.zh: 来自非洲最壮丽的最高点乞力马扎罗山的问候

paras.en: As dawn broke one recent morning over camp, we got one of our first full views of the peak of Mount Kilimanjaro, normally hidden behind clouds.
paras.zh: 最近的一个早晨，当黎明破晓时，我们第一次看到了乞力马扎罗山峰的全景，它通常隐藏在云层后面。

paras.en: Climbing tall mountains like Kilimanjaro is a study in contrasts. The beating sun bakes you during the day, walking so close to the equator, but the nights quickly dip below freezing. Snow remains constantly in sight from humid rainforest and alpine landscapes, freshly charred from a wildfire three weeks before. And always beckoning is the peak, within sight, but seemingly never nearer; the high altitude means hikers need to walk slowly or else risk exhaustion and altitude sickness.
paras.zh: 攀登乞力马扎罗山这样的高山是一项对比研究。白天，烈日炙烤着你，走在离赤道如此之近的地方，但夜晚很快就会降至冰点以下。潮湿的雨林和高山地区始终可见积雪，三周前的一场野火刚刚烧焦。山峰总是在向我们招手，就在眼前，但似乎从未如此接近；高海拔意味着徒步旅行者需要缓慢行走，否则可能会出现疲惫和高原反应。

paras.en: A group of friends and fellow hikers and I spent days camping at altitude to acclimatize before a final summit push during our second-to-last evening on the mountain. We trudged through heavy snow under the stars, cresting a massive volcanic crater rim, and leaned against drifts of what had become a full blizzard to reach the top in the early morning hours. I stood on the peak I'd seen only from a distance for the last week but saw only whiteness: all snow and ice, the absence of life and color heightened by my low oxygen levels.
paras.zh: 我和一群朋友兼徒步旅行者花了几天时间在高海拔地区露营，以适应环境，然后在我们在山上的倒数第二个晚上进行最后一次冲顶。我们在星空下艰难地穿过大雪，登上了一个巨大的火山口边缘，并靠着已经变成暴风雪的雪堆，在清晨到达了山顶。我站在上周只能从远处看到的山峰上，但只看到一片白色：全是雪和冰，缺乏生命和颜色，因为我的低氧气含量更加突出。

paras.en: Days later, having descended and decompressed and readying myself to fly back home, I looked back at the mountain one last time. For a few minutes, in the dusk light, the clouds parted and she revealed herself before disappearing again into the darkening evening, still as elusive as ever.
paras.zh: 几天后，我下山减压，准备飞回家，最后一次回头看了一眼这座山。有几分钟，在暮色中，云层散开，她显露出来，然后又消失在夜色中，仍然像以前一样难以捉摸。

paras.en: For more Far-Flung Postcards, click here.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多遥远的明信片，请点击此处。

articles.title: Republican wants FBI and CIA answers before questioning Nvidia chief
articles.author: Michel Martin

paras.en: Republican wants FBI and CIA answers before questioning Nvidia chief
paras.zh: 共和党人希望联邦调查局和中央情报局在质询英伟达首席执行官之前得到答案

paras.en: Jensen Huang is back at the helm of Nvidia with President Trump's backing. But the questions surrounding the AI chipmaker and its ties to China are far from settled.
paras.zh: 在特朗普总统的支持下，黄仁勋重新执掌英伟达。但围绕这家人工智能芯片制造商及其与中国的关系的问题还远未解决。

paras.en: U.S. intelligence officials told congressional staff there is no evidence that Alice Huang, the woman who had an affair with the Nvidia chief, was a Chinese spy or intelligence asset, according to a person familiar with the matter who was granted anonymity to speak about a closed-door briefing.
paras.zh: 据一位不愿透露姓名的知情人士透露，美国情报官员告诉国会工作人员，没有证据表明与英伟达首席执行官有染的女性爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 是中国间谍或情报人员。

paras.en: There is also no evidence that she initiated the affair to collect intelligence for China's government, the person told NPR's Ryan Lucas on condition of anonymity because of the sensitive nature of the matter. She is, however, believed to have passed along information after the affair began.
paras.zh: 该人士对美国国家公共广播电台的瑞安·卢卡斯表示，也没有证据表明她发起了这起事件是为了为中国政府收集情报。由于此事敏感，该人士要求匿名。然而，据信她在事件开始后就传递了信息。
