paras.en: Trump has said he helped arrange Huang's return as CEO, and Nvidia's board maintains that his reinstatement presents no national security risk. Some Republican lawmakers, however, want to understand how those conclusions were reached.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他帮助安排了黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官，而英伟达董事会坚称，他的复职不会带来国家安全风险。然而，一些共和党议员想了解这些结论是如何得出的。

paras.en: Speaking to Morning Edition on Wednesday, before NPR obtained the new information, Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick, R-Pa., said he wants to hear from the FBI and CIA before Huang appears before House lawmakers next week.
paras.zh: 周三，在 NPR 获得新信息之前，宾夕法尼亚州共和党众议员布莱恩·菲茨帕特里克 (Brian Fitzpatrick) 表示，他希望在黄下周出现在众议院议员面前之前听取联邦调查局 (FBI) 和中央情报局 (CIA) 的意见。

paras.en: For Fitzpatrick, a former FBI special agent who sits on the House Intelligence Committee, the inquiry begins with what federal authorities knew and whether they warned the Nvidia chief of potential espionage threats.
paras.zh: 对于担任众议院情报委员会成员的前联邦调查局特工菲茨帕特里克来说，调查始于联邦当局所知道的情况以及他们是否警告过英伟达负责人潜在的间谍威胁。

paras.en: "What briefings did they give? When did they give them?" he asked.
paras.zh: “他们做了什么简报？什么时候做的？”他问道。

paras.en: Huang's reinstatement, Fitzpatrick said, should not put those questions to rest.
paras.zh: 菲茨帕特里克说，黄的复职不应消除这些问题。

paras.en: "The public is rightly concerned, and they deserve answers," he said.
paras.zh: “公众的担忧是正确的，他们应该得到答案，”他说。

paras.en: Fitzpatrick also wants to hear from Attorney General Todd Blanche, who on Tuesday described Nvidia as a good corporate citizen, and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, whose department faces questions over Nvidia's chip exports to China.
paras.zh: 菲茨帕特里克还希望听取司法部长托德·布兰奇（Todd Blanche）和商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克（Howard Lutnick）的意见，前者周二将英伟达描述为良好的企业公民，后者的部门面临英伟达向中国出口芯片的质疑。

paras.en: "Anytime you do an investigation, you follow the facts wherever they lead, and you report those facts with unimpeachable integrity," Fitzpatrick said. "You leave no stone unturned."
paras.zh: 菲茨帕特里克说：“无论何时进行调查，你都会遵循事实，无论事实如何，并以无可挑剔的诚信报告这些事实。” “你不遗余力。”

paras.en: The debate over Huang's reinstatement extends beyond Washington.
paras.zh: 关于黄的复职的争论超出了华盛顿范围。

paras.en: In Silicon Valley, his return has alarmed women and advocates who have spent years pushing for a better workplace culture, renewing questions about the limits of executive accountability.
paras.zh: 在硅谷，他的回归引起了女性和倡导者的警惕，她们多年来一直在推动更好的工作场所文化，并重新提出了关于高管问责制局限性的问题。

articles.title: Army to detonate tons of lead azide after delays. And, Abrego Garcia leaves U.S.
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Army to detonate tons of lead azide after delays. And, Abrego Garcia leaves U.S.
paras.zh: 军队在延误后引爆了数吨叠氮化铅。而且，阿布雷戈·加西亚离开了美国

paras.en: The Army will detonate a huge explosion in Middletown, Iowa, this morning to safely dispose of thousands of pounds of lead azide that could spontaneously explode. The explosive has been used since WWI and was moved to the Iowa bunker 17 years ago. The detonation is happening after officials found that the lead azide had crystallized and become unstable. Authorities have evacuated a 5-mile radius, and those within 20 miles are advised to stay indoors to avoid exposure to toxins.
paras.zh: 今天早上，陆军将在爱荷华州米德尔敦引爆一次巨大爆炸，以安全处置可能自爆的数千磅叠氮化铅。这种炸药自第一次世界大战以来一直被使用，并于 17 年前被转移到爱荷华州的掩体中。爆炸是在官员发现叠氮化铅结晶并变得不稳定后发生的。当局已疏散方圆 5 英里范围内的人员，建议方圆 20 英里以内的人员留在室内，以避免接触毒素。

paras.en: - 🎧 The U.S. Army rescheduled the detonation multiple times after the public got wind of it last week, NPR's Quil Lawrence tells Up First. Purdue University's Andrew Whelton, who has worked on disaster planning, tells Lawrence the detonation caused stress for residents, businesses and farmers. The Trump administration pushed back on the notion that this planned action was a surprise, citing town hall meetings on the topic. Lawrence says the biggest danger in the detonation is to kids and pregnant people due to the lead dust in the air or on surfaces. There are also worries about potential harm to livestock and crops, as well as the cleanup duration.
paras.zh: - NPR 的奎尔·劳伦斯 (Quil Lawrence) 告诉 Up First，上周公众获悉爆炸消息后，美国陆军多次重新安排了爆炸时间。普渡大学的安德鲁·惠尔顿（Andrew Whelton）从事灾难规划工作，他告诉劳伦斯，爆炸给居民、企业和农民带来了压力。特朗普政府反驳了这一计划中的行动令人意外的观点，并引用了有关该主题的市政厅会议。劳伦斯说，爆炸中最大的危险是儿童和孕妇，因为空气或表面存在铅尘。人们还担心对牲畜和农作物的潜在危害以及清理时间。

paras.en: Kilmar Abrego Garcia has voluntarily left the U.S. after a nearly two-year legal battle. He is the Salvadoran immigrant who became emblematic of the challenges posed by President Trump's mass deportation campaign. Abrego Garcia was arrested in 2025 and mistakenly deported to El Salvador. He returned to the U.S. but departed for Spain yesterday. His lawyer, Simon Sandoval-Moshenberg, said that Abrego Garcia boarded a commercial flight to a destination of his choice and "left the United States a free man." Sandoval-Moshenberg described the move as "a temporary departure," saying that Abrego Garcia, whose wife and child are U.S. citizens, has options to return to the U.S.
paras.zh: 经过近两年的法律斗争后，基尔马·阿布雷戈·加西亚自愿离开美国。他是萨尔瓦多移民，成为特朗普总统大规模驱逐运动所带来挑战的象征。阿布雷戈·加西亚 (Abrego Garcia) 于 2025 年被捕，并被错误地驱逐到萨尔瓦多。他返回美国，但昨天启程前往西班牙。他的律师西蒙·桑多瓦尔-莫申伯格表示，阿布雷戈·加西亚登上了商业航班飞往他选择的目的地，并“以自由人的身份离开了美国”。桑多瓦尔-莫申伯格将此举描述为“暂时离开”，并表示阿布雷戈·加西亚的妻子和孩子都是美国公民，他可以选择返回美国。

paras.en: - 🎧 Abrego Garcia's attorney said that he will essentially spend two years waiting abroad. His case raises concerns about due process and the risks of sending individuals to countries where they could be harmed, NPR's Juliana Kim says. The Department of Homeland Security said they are delighted by his decision to leave the U.S. The agency, in a statement, said that "now this El Salvadoran man cannot terrorize innocents." After being mistakenly deported, upon his return to the U.S., Abrego Garcia was charged with human smuggling, an allegation he has denied.
paras.zh: - 🎧 阿布雷戈·加西亚的律师表示，他基本上会在国外等待两年。 NPR 的朱莉安娜·金 (Juliana Kim) 表示，他的案件引发了人们对正当程序以及将个人送往可能受到伤害的国家的风险的担忧。美国国土安全部表示，他们对他离开美国的决定感到高兴。该机构在一份声明中表示，“现在这个萨尔瓦多男子不能恐吓无辜者。”被错误驱逐出境后，阿布雷戈·加西亚返回美国后被指控犯有人口走私罪，但他否认了这一指控。

paras.en: Nvidia's newly reinstated CEO, Jensen Huang, apologized to his staff yesterday for his previous behavior, according to the New York Times. He reportedly denied that Trump pressured the board for his return, despite the president saying otherwise. Huang had stepped down following reports of affairs, including one with a woman reportedly suspected by U.S. intelligence agencies of being recruited by China's spy agency. Some members of Congress still have concerns about the national security scandal.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，英伟达新任首席执行官黄仁勋昨天为自己之前的行为向员工道歉。据报道，他否认特朗普向董事会施压要求他回归，尽管总统另有说法。黄在一系列的婚外情报道后辞职，其中包括一名据报道美国情报机构怀疑被中国间谍机构招募的女性。一些国会议员仍然对国家安全丑闻感到担忧。

paras.en: - 🎧 Some lawmakers are upset with Huang, while others criticized Nvidia and its board, NPR's Maham Javaid says. Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren says that Huang owes Congress answers about Nvidia's compliance with laws designed to keep advanced chips out of China. Republican Sen. Tom Cotton of Arkansas is calling for a congressional investigation into Huang and urging faster action on chip-control legislation. House Democratic Committee leaders sent a letter to the president after he claimed he helped with Huang's reinstatement. They asked if he prioritizes friends and allies over the nation's economic and national security interests. They demanded a response by Dec. 8 on what he knew about Huang's ties to an alleged Chinese spy. Huang will attend a closed-door hearing with House members next week, followed by testimony before a Senate committee two days later.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Maham Javaid 表示，一些议员对黄仁勋感到不满，而另一些议员则批评 Nvidia 及其董事会。民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 表示，黄仁勋有责任向国会提供有关英伟达是否遵守旨在阻止先进芯片进入中国的法律的问题。阿肯色州共和党参议员汤姆·科顿呼吁国会对黄进行调查，并敦促加快芯片控制立法行动。在总统声称他帮助黄之复职后，众议院民主党委员会领导人致函总统。他们询问他是否将朋友和盟友置于国家经济和国家安全利益之上。他们要求在 12 月 8 日之前就他所了解的黄与一名被指控的中国间谍的关系做出回应。黄黄将于下周与众议院议员一起参加闭门听证会，两天后在参议院委员会作证。

paras.en: NPR launched the first-ever Senior Podcast Challenge this fall, inviting people over 65 to share their stories. Unlike the NPR Student Podcast Challenge, which has attracted more than 90,000 young voices since 2018, this contest focuses on the wisdom and experiences of older voices. While the contest is still open for a few more days, the judges have already listened to more than 100 submissions. Some stories explore life after retirement, dating after divorce or the loss of a partner, and coming to terms with being a senior. Take a listen to some of their favorite early entries.
paras.zh: NPR 今年秋天推出了首届高级播客挑战赛，邀请 65 岁以上的人分享他们的故事。与自 2018 年以来吸引了超过 90,000 名年轻声音的 NPR 学生播客挑战赛不同，本次比赛侧重于年长声音的智慧和经验。虽然比赛还有几天时间，但评委们已经听取了 100 多份参赛作品。有些故事探讨退休后的生活、离婚后的约会或失去伴侣，以及如何适应老年人的生活。听听他们最喜欢的一些早期作品。

paras.en: There's still time to enter. The competition will close on Nov. 30. These are the official rules for the 2026 NPR Senior Podcast Challenge and you can submit your entry here.
paras.zh: 还有时间进入。比赛将于 11 月 30 日结束。以下是 2026 年 NPR 高级播客挑战赛的官方规则，您可以在此处提交参赛作品。

paras.en: If you're spending your free time ruminating about work-related issues, you're essentially still on the clock, according to psychologist and author Guy Winch. Don't let workplace woes invade your home life. Winch shares techniques with Life Kit to help you reclaim your time, energy and attention when work consumes too much of your mental bandwidth.
paras.zh: 心理学家兼作家盖伊·温奇 (Guy Winch) 表示，如果你把空闲时间花在思考与工作相关的问题上，那么你基本上还是在赶时间。不要让工作场所的困境侵入你的家庭生活。 Winch 与 Life Kit 分享一些技巧，帮助您在工作占用过多精力时重新获得时间、精力和注意力。

paras.en: - 🧠 Instead of reliving the work issue, spend 15 minutes creating a plan to address the situation. Ask yourself, "How can I handle this? What outcome do I want?"
paras.zh: - 🧠 不要再重复工作问题，而是花 15 分钟制定一个计划来解决该情况。问问自己，“我该如何处理这个问题？我想要什么结果？”

paras.en: - 🧠 Adopt rituals that engage as many senses as possible to help your brain transition between tasks. For example, try changing your clothes to signal the end of the workday. The more you repeat rituals, the easier it is for your brain to shift from work to relaxation.
paras.zh: - 🧠 采用尽可能多的感官参与的仪式，以帮助您的大脑在任务之间进行转换。例如，尝试换衣服以表示工作日结束。你重复的仪式越多，你的大脑就越容易从工作转向放松。

paras.en: - 🧠 Do something that energizes you. Activities like screen time and doomscrolling may seem relaxing, but they aren't effective.
paras.zh: - 🧠 做一些让你充满活力的事情。像屏幕时间和末日滚动这样的活动可能看起来很放松，但它们并不有效。

paras.en: - 🧠 Ask yourself: "If my job disappeared tomorrow, what remains of me?" You might realize your worth isn't tied to your job title.
paras.zh: - 🧠 问问自己：“如果明天我的工作消失了，我还剩下什么？”您可能会意识到您的价值与您的职位无关。

paras.en: - Dancing with the Stars wrapped up Season 35 last night, crowning Paralympian Ezra Frech and his partner, Daniella Karagach, as the winners of this year's Len Goodman Mirrorball Trophy.
paras.zh: - 昨晚，《与星共舞》第 35 季落下帷幕，残奥会选手 Ezra Frech 和他的搭档 Daniella Karagach 成为今年 Len Goodman Mirrorball Trophy 的获得者。

paras.en: - Frailejon, a plant of Colombia's high-mountain wetlands that's vital to the country's water supply, is facing an array of threats from farmers, ranchers and climate change. Volunteers are working to save these plants, one seedling at a time.
paras.zh: - Frailejon 是哥伦比亚高山湿地的一种植物，对该国的供水至关重要，它正面临着来自农民、牧场主和气候变化的一系列威胁。志愿者正在努力拯救这些植物，一次拯救一株幼苗。

paras.en: - Doctors are combating disinformation about routine vitamin K shots for newborns, which prevent rare but life-threatening hemorrhaging. The rate of parents skipping these shots for their kids has increased from 3.1% in 2017 to 6.8% in 2025, according to new research in JAMA.
paras.zh: - 医生们正在打击有关新生儿常规注射维生素 K 的虚假信息，这种注射可以预防罕见但危及生命的出血。根据 JAMA 的最新研究，父母为孩子不注射这些疫苗的比例已从 2017 年的 3.1% 上升到 2025 年的 6.8%。

articles.title: Former Bears star Revie Sorey, who blocked for Walter Payton, dead at 73

paras.en: Former Chicago Bears offensive lineman Revie Sorey, who blocked for the legendary Walter Payton, died Thursday at 73.
paras.zh: 为传奇人物沃尔特·佩顿 (Walter Payton) 拦网的前芝加哥熊队进攻锋线球员雷维·索雷 (Revie Sorey) 周四去世，享年 73 岁。

paras.en: Sorey died at Northwestern Memorial Hospital, Anita Efron, a Chicago attorney and one of Sorey's closest friends, said, according to the Chicago Sun-Times.
paras.zh: 据《芝加哥太阳时报》报道，索雷最亲密的朋友之一、芝加哥律师安妮塔·埃夫隆 (Anita Efron) 表示，索雷在西北纪念医院去世。

paras.en: The Bears drafted Sorey in the fifth round of the 1975 NFL Draft out of Illinois, and he spent his entire nine-year career in Chicago. He played guard for all 109 games (77 starts) of his career.
paras.zh: 1975 年 NFL 选秀大会上，熊队在第五轮从伊利诺伊州选中了索雷，他在芝加哥度过了整个九年的职业生涯。他职业生涯全部 109 场比赛（77 场首发）中担任后卫。

paras.en: Following his retirement from football, the Brooklyn, New York, native dedicated his post-playing life to helping disadvantaged youth in Chicago. He served as director of educational services at Ada S. McKinley Community Services.
paras.zh: 退役后，这位土生土长的纽约布鲁克林人将退役后的生活奉献给了帮助芝加哥的弱势青少年。他曾担任艾达·麦金利社区服务中心的教育服务总监。

paras.en: With Efron, Sorey also founded the Revie Sorey Trunk Scholarship Program, which helped first-generation college-bound Chicago students go to school prepared, as they would get everything from computers to bedding.
paras.zh: 索雷还与埃夫隆一起创立了里维索雷特伦克奖学金计划，该计划帮助第一代即将上大学的芝加哥学生做好上学的准备，因为他们可以获得从电脑到床上用品的一切。

paras.en: "Everybody talks about his great infectious smile and how everybody he met became his buddy, his friend and how he went out of his way to make people feel special and guide people through their lives," Efron said, according to the Chicago Sun-Times.
paras.zh: 据《芝加哥太阳时报》报道，埃夫隆说：“每个人都在谈论他极具感染力的微笑，以及他遇到的每个人如何成为他的好友、他的朋友，以及他如何不遗余力地让人们感到特别，并指导人们度过他们的生活。”

paras.en: "I am getting literally hundreds of texts and emails from people who Revie helped. He just wanted to uplift people and show them how they could soar and be their best self," Efron told the outlet. "Everybody has said that there’s a connection with the Bears getting that win on Thanksgiving, the day he died, and, yeah, I think so, too."
paras.zh: “我收到了数百条来自雷维帮助过的人的短信和电子邮件。他只是想鼓舞人们，并向他们展示如何飞翔并成为最好的自己，”埃夫隆告诉媒体。 “每个人都说，熊队在感恩节（他去世的那天）取得胜利是有联系的，是的，我也这么认为。”

paras.en: Sorey's wife, Suzy O’Malley-Sorey, died of pancreatic cancer in 2011.
paras.zh: Sorey 的妻子 Suzy O’Malley-Sorey 于 2011 年死于胰腺癌。

paras.en: Sorey suffered a stroke in March 2012 that left him unable to speak or walk, and he required around-the-clock care following the health incident. He eventually regained limited use of his speech after therapy.
paras.zh: 2012 年 3 月，索雷中风，导致他无法说话或行走，健康事故发生后他需要全天候护理。经过治疗后，他最终恢复了有限的言语能力。

paras.en: In 2016, Sorey's son, Trace Sorey, died in an accidental drowning in a Los Angeles pool at 24 years old.
paras.zh: 2016年，Sorey的儿子Trace Sorey在洛杉矶泳池意外溺水身亡，年仅24岁。

articles.title: Former SEC head coach who landed in the Group of 5 abruptly steps down after underwhelming five-year run

paras.en: Joe Moorhead exited Mississippi State in 2019 after a two-year stint as head coach in the Southeastern Conference. He was then named Oregon's offensive coordinator.
paras.zh: 乔·穆尔黑德 (Joe Moorhead) 在担任东南联盟主教练两年后，于 2019 年离开密西西比州立大学。随后他被任命为俄勒冈州进攻协调员。

paras.en: Two years later, Moorhead returned to the head-coaching ranks, taking on the challenge of turning around a program competing at the Group of 5 level.
paras.zh: 两年后，穆尔黑德重返主教练行列，接受了扭转五人组比赛项目的挑战。

paras.en: After compiling a 15-44 record over five seasons at Akron, Moorhead says he is ready for another challenge.
paras.zh: 在阿克伦队的五个赛季中取得了 15 胜 44 负的战绩后，穆尔黑德表示他已经准备好迎接另一次挑战。

paras.en: Moorhead released a statement saying he decided to step down to pursue other opportunities.
paras.zh: 穆尔黑德发表声明称，他决定辞职以寻求其他机会。

paras.en: "After careful consideration and thoughtful discussions with my family, I informed University of Akron officials of my decision to pursue other opportunities at the conclusion of this season," he wrote on social media after the Zips' 17-9 loss to Buffalo on Friday.
paras.zh: “经过与家人的仔细考虑和深思熟虑的讨论，我通知阿克伦大学官员，我决定在本赛季结束后寻求其他机会，”周五Zips队以17-9输给布法罗队后，他在社交媒体上写道。

paras.en: "I am thankful to the school administrators, past and present, for providing me with the chance to lead this team for the past five seasons."
paras.zh: “我感谢过去和现在的学校管理人员，他们为我提供了过去五个赛季领导这支球队的机会。”

paras.en: "Lastly, I would like to express my most sincere gratitude to everyone who poured their heart and soul into this program, especially and most importantly our players. My family and I are excited for the next chapter in our journey and wish Zips football nothing but the best moving forward."
paras.zh: “最后，我要向所有为这个项目倾注心血的人表示最诚挚的谢意，特别是最重要的是我们的球员。我和我的家人为我们旅程的下一篇章感到兴奋，并祝愿 Zips 足球向前迈进。”

paras.en: The Zips finished the 2026 season with a 2-10 record. None of Moorhead’s five seasons at Akron ended with a winning record, with the 2025 season's 5-7 mark representing the best finish of his tenure.
paras.zh: Zips 队以 2 胜 10 负的战绩结束了 2026 年赛季。穆尔黑德在阿克伦的五个赛季都没有取得胜利记录，2025 年赛季的 5 胜 7 负的战绩代表了他任期内的最佳成绩。

paras.en: Moorhead held various assistant coaching positions at Akron from 2004 to 2008. He later landed his first head coaching job at his alma mater, Fordham, in 2012. Moorhead is credited for guiding Fordham to three consecutive FCS playoff appearances.
paras.zh: 2004 年至 2008 年，穆尔黑德在阿克伦担任过多个助理教练职位。随后，他于 2012 年在母校福特汉姆获得了第一份主教练职位。穆尔黑德因带领福特汉姆连续三年进入 FCS 季后赛而受到赞誉。

paras.en: He went 38-13 and led the Rams to the FCS playoffs in each of his final three seasons. Moorhead's resume also includes a two-year stint as Penn State’s offensive coordinator. He was fired by Mississippi State after posting a 14-12 record over two seasons, capped by a win over in-state rival Ole Miss in the Egg Bowl.
paras.zh: 他在最后三个赛季中取得了 38 胜 13 负的战绩，并带领公羊队连续进入 FCS 季后赛。穆尔黑德的简历还包括担任宾夕法尼亚州立大学进攻协调员两年。他在两个赛季取得 14 胜 12 负的战绩后被密西西比州立大学解雇，并在蛋碗赛中击败了州内对手 Ole Miss。

paras.en: There are now 11 head-coaching vacancies at the FBS level following Moorhead’s departure.
paras.zh: 穆尔黑德离开后，FBS 级别目前有 11 个主教练职位空缺。

paras.en: One FBS school has already filled its vacancy, with Georgia defensive coordinator Glenn Schumann agreeing to a five-year contract to become Florida State’s next head coach. Schumann is expected to remain in his current role through next week’s SEC Championship Game and potentially into the College Football Playoff.
paras.zh: FBS 的一所学校已经填补了空缺，佐治亚州防守协调员格伦·舒曼同意签订一份为期五年的合同，成为佛罗里达州的下一任主教练。舒曼预计将在下周的 SEC 冠军赛中继续担任目前的职务，并有可能进入大学橄榄球季后赛。

articles.title: Arch Manning, Longhorns avoid scare against Texas A&M to punch ticket to SEC Championship Game

paras.en: Texas came into Friday's game against Texas A&M in good shape. They were on track to take on Georgia in the SEC Championship game and also earn a spot in the College Football Playoff.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州在周五对阵德克萨斯农工大学的比赛中状态良好。他们有望在 SEC 锦标赛中对阵乔治亚州，并在大学橄榄球季后赛中获得一席之地。

paras.en: Of course, that all hinged on them taking care of the Aggies.
paras.zh: 当然，这一切都取决于他们照顾阿吉斯。

paras.en: In the first quarter, Texas A&M stood tall defensively to hold the Longhorns to just a field goal. Unfortunately, the Aggies also dealt with some sloppiness on special teams and failed to put any points on the board during a promising-looking drive late in the frame.
paras.zh: 第一节，德州农工大学的防守非常出色，让长角牛队仅投进一球。不幸的是，阿吉队在特殊球队的处理上也有些马虎，在比赛后期看似有希望的进攻中未能取得任何分数。

paras.en: It didn't take too much longer for Arch Manning and the Texas offense to find the end zone. Manning found wide receiver Cam Coleman for six with a short, three-yard touchdown pass.
paras.zh: 没过多久，阿奇·曼宁和德克萨斯进攻队就找到了达阵区。曼宁找到外接手卡姆·科尔曼（Cam Coleman），用一记三码短传达阵完成六分。

paras.en: The Aggies got rid of their goose egg with a late first-half field goal to send this game to the room with the Longhorns leading 10-3.
paras.zh: 上半场最后时刻，Aggies 队凭借一记射门摆脱了鹅蛋，将比赛拖入房间，长角牛队以 10-3 领先。

paras.en: That is a result you've got to think the Aggies would be pleased with, even if there were some elements of their game to clean up.
paras.zh: 你必须认为 Aggies 会对这个结果感到满意，即使他们的比赛中有一些元素需要清理。

paras.en: As the second half got underway, the Aggies forced the Longhorns to punt on their first possession, but then came another miscue.
paras.zh: 下半场比赛开始后，阿吉队在第一次控球时迫使长角牛队弃踢，但随后又出现了失误。

paras.en: Texas A&M receiver Mario Craver caught a pass for ten yards, but fumbled the ball, which was recovered by the Longhorns.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯农工大学接球手马里奥·克拉弗 (Mario Craver) 接住传球 10 码，但掉球，球被长角牛队追回。

paras.en: The play was reviewed and upheld after it was confirmed that Craver had made the catch before fumbling.
paras.zh: 在确认克拉弗在掉球之前接球后，该比赛得到了审查并维持原判。

paras.en: That gave Texas a short field, but the Aggies' defense managed to stand pat and held them to a field goal that made it a two-possession game.
paras.zh: 这给了德克萨斯队一个短的场地，但阿吉队的防守成功地保持住了他们的射门得分，使比赛变成了两次控球。

paras.en: Texas A&M responded with a field goal of their own, then their defense made a massive stop to force a turnover on downs. Unfortunately for them, the offense couldn't capitalize as the Longhorns held them to a three-and-out.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯农工大学以自己的射门回应，然后他们的防守进行了一次大规模的阻止，迫使对手在低位时出现失误。不幸的是，对他们来说，进攻无法利用，因为长角牛队将他们限制在三分出局。

paras.en: But once again, the Aggies' defense became the story as Tawfiq Byard picked off Arch Manning on the goal line.
paras.zh: 但当陶菲克·拜亚德 (Tawfiq Byard) 在球门线上挑衅阿奇·曼宁 (Arch Manning) 时，阿吉队的防守再次成为焦点。

paras.en: Yet the A&M offense couldn’t capitalize, turning the ball over on downs around midfield.
paras.zh: 然而A&M的进攻却无法利用这一点，在中场周围的低位上发生了失误。

paras.en: Texas tacked on a field goal, which once again made it a two-score game with just 5:19 left, and that was all they needed. Texas took the victory by a score of 16-6.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州队再进一球，在比赛还剩 5 分 19 秒时再次将比分变成两分，而这正是他们所需要的。德克萨斯队以16-6的比分取得胜利。

paras.en: Surely, they'll take the win... but they probably weren't ready to sweat for it that much.
paras.zh: 当然，他们会赢得胜利……但他们可能还没有准备好为此付出那么多的汗水。

paras.en: Manning finished the night completing 18 of 34 passing attempts for 143 yards, a touchdown, and one pick.
paras.zh: 曼宁当晚34次传球尝试18中，推进143码，达阵和1次接球。

paras.en: The win locks in a Georgia-Texas SEC Championship Game, and should also punch the Longhorns a ticket to the College Football Playoff.
paras.zh: 这场胜利锁定了佐治亚州-德克萨斯州 SEC 冠军赛的胜利，并且还应该为长角牛队赢得大学橄榄球季后赛的入场券。

articles.title: Nigeria's 'ultimate hard man' who become an online meme

paras.en: For generations of Nigerians, Pete Edochie was more than a celebrated actor.
paras.zh: 对于几代尼日利亚人来说，皮特·埃多奇不仅仅是一位著名演员。

paras.en: He was Okonkwo â the fierce, proud and troubled warrior whose portrayal in Things Fall Apart made him a household name and earned him a place in the hearts of millions.
paras.zh: 他就是奥孔科沃，一位凶猛、骄傲、麻烦不断的战士，他在《分崩离析》中的形象使他家喻户晓，并在数百万人的心中赢得了一席之地。

paras.en: Even in death, many Nigerians still refer to him by the character's name, a testament to the enduring impact of a role that defined his career.
paras.zh: 即使在他去世后，许多尼日利亚人仍然用这个角色的名字来称呼他，这证明了这个定义了他职业生涯的角色所产生的持久影响。

paras.en: Edochie died on 25 November, aged 79, in the south-eastern Nigerian city of Enugu following a prolonged battle with prostate cancer.
paras.zh: 埃多奇 (Edochie) 在与前列腺癌长期斗争后，于 11 月 25 日在尼日利亚东南部城市埃努古去世，享年 79 岁。

paras.en: In 1987, Edochie starred in a television adaptation of Chinua Achebe's acclaimed novel. His portrayal of Okonkwo would change his life, establishing him as one of Nigeria's most respected actors and bringing him international recognition.
paras.zh: 1987 年，Edochie 主演了根据 Chinua Achebe 广受好评的小说改编的电视剧。他对奥孔科沃的演绎改变了他的生活，使他成为尼日利亚最受尊敬的演员之一，并为他带来了国际认可。

paras.en: The series depicted the struggles of an African community as British colonial rule and Christianity began to transform its traditional way of life.
paras.zh: 该系列描绘了英国殖民统治和基督教开始改变其传统生活方式时非洲社区的斗争。

paras.en: Joy Nnamdi, a fan of both the novel and its television adaptation, believes Edochie was the perfect choice for the lead role.
paras.zh: 乔伊·纳姆迪 (Joy Nnamdi) 是小说及其改编电视剧的粉丝，他认为埃多奇是主角的完美选择。

paras.en: She said nobody else could have brought the character to life as convincingly.
paras.zh: 她说没有人能如此令人信服地把这个角色演绎得栩栩如生。

paras.en: "His character Okonkwo gave a face to the highly celebrated novel," she told the BBC in Nigeria's biggest city, Lagos.
paras.zh: “他的角色奥孔科沃为这部备受赞誉的小说赋予了面孔，”她在尼日利亚最大的城市拉各斯告诉英国广播公司。

paras.en: The role also cemented his reputation as a hard man, a screen persona he would maintain through much of his career.
paras.zh: 这个角色也巩固了他作为一个硬汉的声誉，这是他在职业生涯的大部分时间里一直保持的银幕形象。

paras.en: "It was very rare to see him laugh in movies. He was the ultimate tough man," Nnamdi added.
paras.zh: “很少在电影中看到他笑。他是终极硬汉，”纳姆迪补充道。

paras.en: With his deep, authoritative voice, imposing presence and effortless command of African proverbs, Edochie had a way of dominating a scene without raising his voice.
paras.zh: 埃多奇低沉、权威的声音、气势磅礴的气势以及对非洲谚语的轻松驾驭，让他不用提高嗓门就能主宰场面。

paras.en: Whether playing a village elder, a wealthy businessman or a feared traditional ruler, he became an enduring embodiment of patriarchal authority on screen.
paras.zh: 无论是扮演村长、富商还是令人畏惧的传统统治者，他都成为银幕上父权权威的持久体现。

paras.en: Edochie went on to become one of the most recognisable faces of Nollywood, Nigeria's film industry, which has grown into one of the world's largest.
paras.zh: 埃多奇后来成为尼日利亚诺莱坞电影业最知名的面孔之一，该电影业已发展成为世界上最大的电影业之一。

paras.en: From Kenya to South Africa, MultiChoice's Africa Magic channels helped take his films into millions of African homes as Nollywood became a cultural phenomenon across the continent.
paras.zh: 从肯尼亚到南非，随着诺莱坞成为整个非洲大陆的一种文化现象，MultiChoice 的 Africa Magic 频道帮助他的电影走进了数百万非洲家庭。

paras.en: Although many of his films were rooted in his Igbo culture, their themes of family loyalty, inheritance disputes, spiritual beliefs and the abuse of power resonated with audiences far beyond Nigeria.
paras.zh: 尽管他的许多电影都植根于伊博文化，但其家庭忠诚、继承纠纷、精神信仰和滥用权力等主题引起了尼日利亚以外观众的共鸣。

paras.en: Before becoming a household name in the film industry, however, Edochie had built a successful career in broadcasting.
paras.zh: 然而，在成为电影界家喻户晓的名字之前，Edochie 已经在广播领域建立了成功的职业生涯。

paras.en: Born on 7 March 1947 in Zaria, northern Nigeria, he attended primary and secondary school in Kaduna before studying journalism and television at the School of Journalism and Television in the UK.
paras.zh: 1947 年 3 月 7 日出生于尼日利亚北部扎里亚，在卡杜纳读小学和中学，之后在英国新闻电视学院学习新闻和电视。

paras.en: He joined the Eastern Nigerian Broadcasting Corporation in 1967, the year Nigeria's civil war broke out.
paras.zh: 1967 年，尼日利亚内战爆发，他加入了东尼日利亚广播公司。

paras.en: He joined the pro-separatist Voice of Biafra, and recently described the war years as the greatest personal challenge he ever faced.
paras.zh: 他加入了支持分离主义的比夫拉之声，最近将战争年代描述为他所面临的最大的个人挑战。

paras.en: "During the war, the experience that we had as Biafrans, you know, survival was difficult. Hunger was driving us into eating all sorts of nonsense," he recalled.
paras.zh: “在战争期间，我们作为比夫拉人的经历，你知道，生存是困难的。饥饿驱使我们吃各种垃圾，”他回忆道。

paras.en: He rose through the ranks to hold senior management positions but then switched to acting. Over a career spanning several decades, he appeared in numerous films, including Igodo, Rituals and Billionaire's Club.
paras.zh: 他晋升到高级管理职位，但后来转行从事演艺事业。在数十年的职业生涯中，他出演了多部电影，包括《伊戈多》、《仪式》和《亿万富翁俱乐部》。

paras.en: His career also bridged the transition from home-video productions to global streaming platforms.
paras.zh: 他的职业生涯还架起了从家庭视频制作到全球流媒体平台的过渡。

paras.en: The 2018 romantic comedy Lionheart, which became Netflix's first original Nigerian film, introduced his work to a wider international audience.
paras.zh: 2018 年浪漫喜剧《狮心王》成为 Netflix 首部尼日利亚原创电影，向更广泛的国际观众介绍了他的作品。

paras.en: He also worked in Ghana, where he starred alongside some of the country's biggest film stars in the 2017 comedy John and John.
paras.zh: 他还曾在加纳工作，与该国一些最知名的电影明星一起主演了 2017 年喜剧《约翰与约翰》。

paras.en: His contribution to the arts was recognised in 2003 when he received one of Nigeria's national honours, the Member of the Order of the Niger (MON).
paras.zh: 2003 年，他对艺术的贡献得到认可，荣获尼日利亚国家荣誉之一：尼日尔勋章 (MON)。

paras.en: He also received several other accolades, including the Industry Merit Award at the Africa Magic Viewers' Choice Awards.
paras.zh: 他还获得了其他多项荣誉，包括非洲魔术观众选择奖的行业优异奖。

paras.en: In recent years, Edochie found an unexpected new audience online.
paras.zh: 近年来，Edochie 在网上发现了意想不到的新受众。

paras.en: His distinctive facial expressions, witty remarks and memorable scenes from his films became popular social media memes, introducing his work to a younger generation of Africans.
paras.zh: 他独特的面部表情、诙谐的言论和电影中令人难忘的场景成为流行的社交媒体模因，向年轻一代的非洲人介绍了他的作品。

paras.en: For many who had never watched Things Fall Apart or his early Nollywood films, his stern expressions became a humorous way of conveying disbelief, disapproval or exasperation at everyday situations.
paras.zh: 对于许多从未看过《分崩离析》或他早期诺莱坞电影的人来说，他严厉的表情成为了在日常生活中表达怀疑、不满或愤怒的幽默方式。

paras.en: But his reputation as a formidable screen presence was no joke to those who grew up watching him.
paras.zh: 但对于那些看着他长大的人来说，他在银幕上令人敬畏的声誉可不是开玩笑。

paras.en: Sani Muazu recalls that parents in the northern Nigerian city of Kano would sometimes invoke Edochie's name to keep misbehaving children in check.
paras.zh: 萨尼·穆阿祖回忆说，尼日利亚北部城市卡诺的父母有时会引用埃多奇的名字来控制孩子的不当行为。

paras.en: "They would tell you: 'Okonkwo will come and visit you if you don't stop' and we would begin acting right," he said.
paras.zh: “他们会告诉你：‘如果你不停下来，奥孔科沃就会来拜访你’，然后我们就会开始采取正确的行动，”他说。

paras.en: "To be honest, we grew up scared of him. Even though he was on the screen and not physically present, some of his roles added to our fears because he played some popular occultic roles, and villain roles suited him."
paras.zh: “说实话，我们从小就害怕他。尽管他出现在银幕上，但他的一些角色却增加了我们的恐惧，因为他扮演了一些受欢迎的神秘角色，而且反派角色很适合他。”

paras.en: Tributes poured in from fans and fellow actors following news of his death, with many describing him as a giant who helped shape Nigeria's film industry.
paras.zh: 在他去世的消息传出后，粉丝和其他演员纷纷表示哀悼，许多人将他描述为帮助塑造尼日利亚电影业的巨人。

paras.en: Popular actress Genevieve Nnaji paid her tribute in a post on X.
paras.zh: 受欢迎的女演员吉纳维芙·纳吉 (Genevieve Nnaji) 在 X 上发帖表达了敬意。

paras.en: "I will let the assurance of the fact that you are a chosen one; and therefore, have returned to the most high God override my grief and heartbreak. May the heart of a true lion forever rest in peace. We love you," she wrote.
paras.zh: “我会让你被选中的事实保证；因此，你已经回到了至高的上帝身边，这超越了我的悲伤和心碎。愿真正的狮子的心永远安息。我们爱你，”她写道。

paras.en: Patience Ozokwor, popularly known as Mama G, who appeared alongside Edochie in several productions, remembered him as a brilliant actor and a source of wisdom.
paras.zh: 帕蒂斯·奥佐克沃（Patience Ozokwor），俗称“Mama G”，曾与埃多奇一起出演过多部作品，她认为埃多奇是一位出色的演员和智慧的源泉。

paras.en: "He has been a father to stories that are told, like an elder sitting down telling you how things were done in those days," she told BBC News Pidgin.
paras.zh: “他是故事之父，就像一位长者坐下来告诉你那些日子里的事情是如何做的，”她告诉英国广播公司新闻洋泾浜语。

paras.en: "I called him any time, any day. He'll tell you what to do and what not to do."
paras.zh: “我随时、任何一天都给他打电话。他会告诉你该做什么、不该做什么。”

paras.en: Film director Babangida Bangis told the BBC that Edochie's death was a loss not just for Nigeria or Africa, but for the global film industry.
paras.zh: 电影导演巴班吉达·班吉斯告诉英国广播公司，埃多奇的去世不仅是尼日利亚或非洲的损失，也是全球电影业的损失。

paras.en: "Just days ago, during a seminar for filmmakers across the country, his name popped up as an example of brilliance on the screen, longevity and professionalism," he said.
paras.zh: “就在几天前，在为全国电影制片人举办的研讨会上，他的名字突然出现，成为银幕上的才华、长寿和专业精神的典范，”他说。

paras.en: "I think his loss is one for the world, not just Nigeria or Africa. We all grew up watching and loving him."
paras.zh: “我认为他的去世是全世界的损失，而不仅仅是尼日利亚或非洲。我们都是看着他长大的，爱着他。”

paras.en: Nigeria's President Bola Ahmed Tinubu also mourned the veteran actor, describing his death as a major loss to the country's film industry and cultural heritage.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布也对这位资深演员表示哀悼，称他的去世是该国电影业和文化遗产的重大损失。

paras.en: The president, like many admirers, singled out Edochie's portrayal of Okonkwo, saying the performance and his subsequent roles had established him as one of Nigeria's most accomplished actors.
paras.zh: 总统和许多崇拜者一样，特别提到了埃多奇对奥孔科沃的演绎，称这场表演和他随后的角色使他成为尼日利亚最有成就的演员之一。

paras.en: But beyond the fame and formidable character he portrayed on screen, his family remembers a man whose greatest legacy was the importance he placed on honesty and speaking the truth.
paras.zh: 但除了他在银幕上所展现的名声和令人敬畏的性格之外，他的家人还记得这个人，他最伟大的遗产是他对诚实和说真话的重视。

paras.en: Leo Edochie, his son, told the BBC that his father was a strong-willed man.
paras.zh: 他的儿子 Leo Edochie 告诉 BBC，他的父亲是一个意志坚强的人。

paras.en: "Of all his legacies, I think the whole world would agree that these two were the most important: telling the truth and remaining honest," he said.
paras.zh: “在他的所有遗产中，我认为全世界都会同意这两项是最重要的：说真话和保持诚实，”他说。

paras.en: He described his father as a man who lived an exemplary life, offering a model that young people could learn from and aspire to follow.
paras.zh: 他形容他的父亲是一个生活模范的人，为年轻人提供了一个可以学习并渴望效仿的榜样。

paras.en: "I don't really have a choice, but the truth is that I have to carry on that legacy for our family," he added.
paras.zh: “我真的别无选择，但事实是我必须为我们的家庭继承这一遗产，”他补充道。

paras.en: Edochie's influence also extended to his family, with two of his six children, Yul and Linc Edochie, following him into the Nigerian film industry.
paras.zh: Edochie 的影响力也延伸到了他的家庭，他的六个孩子中的两个 Yul 和 Linc Edochie 跟随他进入了尼日利亚电影业。

paras.en: Yet, for an actor so closely associated with stern expressions and intimidating characters, some of his most endearing moments came when he let his guard down.
paras.zh: 然而，对于一个与严肃的表情和令人生畏的角色密切相关的演员来说，他最可爱的一些时刻是在他放松警惕的时候。

paras.en: In 2021, he made a brief appearance in music star Phyno's video for the song Highway, surprising fans with a display of dance moves that showed a lighter, more playful side of the septuagenarian.
paras.zh: 2021 年，他在音乐明星 Phyno 的歌曲《Highway》的视频中短暂露面，用舞蹈动作展示了这位七十多岁老人轻松、俏皮的一面，让粉丝们大吃一惊。

paras.en: It was a refreshing reminder that the man behind the formidable screen persona could also laugh, dance and enjoy himself.
paras.zh: 这令人耳目一新，提醒我们，在令人敬畏的银幕形象背后的男人也可以欢笑、跳舞和享受自己。

articles.title: Turkish officials 'destroyed' pro-opposition TV channel, owner tells BBC

paras.en: Turkish authorities have "destroyed" one of the country's most-watched news channels, its London-based owner has told the BBC.
paras.zh: 土耳其当局“摧毁”了该国收视率最高的新闻频道之一，该频道驻伦敦的所有者告诉英国广播公司。

paras.en: Speaking to the BBC's Newshour, Cafer MahiroÄlu said that nine people connected to Halk TV were arrested this week on charges including money laundering, bribery and spreading misleading information.
paras.zh: Cafer Mahiro?lu 在接受 BBC Newshour 采访时表示，本周有 9 名与 Halk TV 有关的人员被捕，罪名包括洗钱、贿赂和传播误导性信息。

paras.en: MahiroÄlu said that several of his family members were among those arrested when the pro-opposition channel was taken into government control last month, adding that the allegations against him and Halk TV are "completely wrong".
paras.zh: Mahiroälu 表示，上个月亲反对派频道被政府控制时，他的几名家人被捕，并补充说针对他和 Halk TV 的指控“完全错误”。

paras.en: The Istanbul Chief Public Prosecutor' Office said that two former news anchors of the channel were among the most recent group of people detained.
paras.zh: 伊斯坦布尔首席检察官办公室表示，最近一批被拘留的人包括该频道的两名前新闻主播。

paras.en: In a statement, prosecutors accused the anchors of producing "false reports" in exchange for money.
paras.zh: 检察官在一份声明中指控主播制作“虚假报道”以换取金钱。

paras.en: Authorities have also issued an arrest warrant for the channel's news coordinator KÃ¼rÅad OÄuz who is "abroad", the statement said, without specifying where.
paras.zh: 声明称，当局还对该频道的新闻协调员库尔阿德·奥兹（KürÅad Oäuz）发出了逮捕令，他“在国外”，但没有具体说明身在何处。

paras.en: MahiroÄlu told the BBC that he could be sent to prison if he tried to return to Turkey.
paras.zh: Mahiroälu 告诉 BBC，如果他试图返回土耳其，他可能会被送进监狱。

paras.en: "[The government] wants to be in control of the whole media... I'm more worried about my country and my democracy than my channel," he said.
paras.zh: “（政府）希望控制整个媒体……我更担心我的国家和我的民主，而不是我的频道，”他说。

paras.en: The headquarters of Halk TV was raided by Turkish authorities last month, halting the channel's live broadcasts, the latest in a series of crackdowns on news sources deemed to be critical of Turkish President Tayyip ErdoÄan and his administration.
paras.zh: 上个月，土耳其当局突击搜查了 Halk TV 的总部，导致该频道的直播停止，这是针对批评土耳其总统塔伊普·埃尔多安及其政府的新闻来源的一系列镇压行动中的最新一起。

paras.en: The government subsequently appointed a new administrator to run the channel.
paras.zh: 政府随后任命了一位新的管理员来管理该渠道。

paras.en: ErdoÄan's government controls much of the country's media, which ranks among the worst globally for press freedom, external, though the government insists that it does not detain media workers for carrying out journalistic activities.
paras.zh: 埃尔多安政府控制着该国的大部分媒体，尽管该国政府坚称不会拘留从事新闻活动的媒体工作者，但该国媒体的对外新闻自由度在全球范围内名列前茅。

paras.en: However, the president has scaled up a crackdown on dissent since his narrow victory in the 2023 presidential election.
paras.zh: 然而，自2023年总统选举以微弱优势获胜以来，总统加大了对异见人士的镇压力度。

paras.en: Earlier this month, authorities took control of pro-opposition network Sozcu TV.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，当局控制了亲反对派网络 Sozcu TV。

paras.en: ErdoÄan's main challenger, mayor of Istanbul Ekrem ImamoÄlu, has been jailed on corruption charges and for violating election laws, which he and his party have fiercely denied.
paras.zh: 埃尔多安的主要挑战者、伊斯坦布尔市长埃克雷姆·伊玛莫鲁因腐败指控和违反选举法而被监禁，但他和他的政党对此予以强烈否认。

paras.en: Hundreds of ImamoÄlu's supporters have faced similar accusations, while the government has also imprisoned other campaigners, lawyers and comedians.
paras.zh: 数百名伊玛莫鲁的支持者面临类似的指控，而政府还监禁了其他活动家、律师和喜剧演员。

articles.title: Eight killed in Peruvian military helicopter crash

paras.en: Eight military personnel have been killed in a helicopter crash in a remote area of Peru known for growing and trafficking drugs.
paras.zh: 秘鲁一个以种植和贩运毒品而闻名的偏远地区发生直升机坠毁事故，八名军事人员丧生。

paras.en: Authorities say the aircraft came down near the town of Sanabamba during a mission to evacuate an army patrol in the valley of the Apurimac, Ene, and Mantaro rivers, known by its Spanish acronym VRAEM.
paras.zh: 当局表示，这架飞机在执行疏散阿普里马克河、埃内河和曼塔罗河河谷（西班牙语缩写为 VRAEM）的一支军队巡逻任务时坠毁在萨纳班巴镇附近。

paras.en: Often referred to as 'Cocaine Valley', the area is Peru's largest coca-growing valley where gangs and the remnants of the former Shining Path rebel group operate.
paras.zh: 该地区通常被称为“可卡因谷”，是秘鲁最大的古柯种植山谷，这里有犯罪团伙和前光辉道路反叛组织的残余分子活动。

paras.en: The Peruvian ministry of defence said the pilot was the sole survivor of the crash, the cause of which is still unknown.
paras.zh: 秘鲁国防部表示，飞行员是坠机事故中唯一的幸存者，坠机原因尚不清楚。

paras.en: In its statement, the ministry said "search and rescue operations located the aircraft and the nine military personnel who were on board".
paras.zh: 国防部在声明中表示，“搜救行动找到了这架飞机和机上九名军事人员”。

paras.en: It named the pilot as Enzo Espinoza Roque and said he was evacuated to Lima to "receive specialised medical treatment".
paras.zh: 该公司称这名飞行员为恩佐·埃斯皮诺萨·罗克（Enzo Espinoza Roque），并表示他已被疏散到利马“接受专门医疗”。

paras.en: The aircraft was reported missing on Thursday night after rescuing three army personnel.
paras.zh: 据报道，这架飞机于周四晚在营救三名陆军人员后失踪。

paras.en: No further information was shared about why the group needed to be rescued, but it was confirmed that they were among those who were killed in the crash.
paras.zh: 没有透露有关为什么需要营救这群人的更多信息，但已证实他们是在坠机事件中丧生的人之一。

paras.en: Joint Command of the Peruvian Armed Forces posted a tribute online extending "deepest condolences to the family members, friends, and comrades-in-arms of the members of our VRAEM Special Command who lost their lives while carrying out a military mission. May God keep them in His glory".
paras.zh: 秘鲁武装部队联合司令部在网上发布悼文，“向在执行军事任务时丧生的 VRAEM 特别司令部成员的家人、朋友和战友表示最深切的哀悼。愿上帝保佑他们荣耀”。

paras.en: In February, a MI-17 helicopter crashed in southern Peru in February killing all 15 on board.
paras.zh: 2月，一架MI-17直升机在秘鲁南部坠毁，机上15人全部遇难。

paras.en: Peru, along with Colombia, is one of the world's largest producers of coca leaves and cocaine, according to the United Nations.
paras.zh: 据联合国称，秘鲁和哥伦比亚是世界上最大的古柯叶和可卡因生产国之一。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.

articles.title: NABC Donates Recycled Rides to Two Army Veterans
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: On Saturday, Nov. 14, two Phoenix-area U.S. Army veterans received refurbished vehicles through the NABC Recycled Rides program, with vehicles donated by Farmers and repairs completed by Caliber Collision and Fix Auto USA.
The presentation was part of a Veterans Appreciate Event, presented by Farmers and Operation BBQ Relief. Veterans were welcome to attend and receive a free barbecue meal.
Farmers donated both vehicles. A 2016 Dodge Charger refurbished by technicians at Caliber Collision was presented to Richard Crawford, who was nominated by Valors Veteran Community.
A 2021 Chevy Traverse refurbished by technicians at Fix Auto Norterra was presented to Jeffrey Morgan, nominated by Arizonia Coalition for Military Families.
Richard Crawford has faced barriers to steady employment without a reliable vehicle. He continues to volunteer and support veterans, relying on a bicycle and public transportation.

“This car means more than transportation to me,” said Crawford. “It means freedom. It will allow me to get out and see this great state I now call my home and to explore and experience things I haven’t been able to. It will allow me to get out and meet more people and help more people in the community.”

Jeffrey Morgan became ill during his service, resulting in a spinal injury that limits his mobility. He needed a vehicle that allowed easier access. Morgan relied on transportation that accommodated his needs, creating added costs. The vehicle will support medical appointments and activities that increase his quality of life.

Additional partners in this presentation included: Copart; Enterprise; Axalta; LKQ; Protech; PPG; Caliber Auto Glass; The Pulice Automotive Solutions; Discount Tire; Arizonia Auto Parts; Tasco Auto Color; AutoNation; Advanced Remarketing Services; and Cars for Charity.

Individuals can support the program by donating directly or by contributing unwanted or non-running vehicles through the Changing and Saving Lives Keys for Change program. Donors receive a tax donation, and proceeds help provide reliable transportation.
Farmers, a level one partner of the NABC, has donated nearly 100 vehicles through the Recycled Rides program.
Caliber Collision, also a level one partner, has donated more than 650 vehicles to military service members, veterans and other individuals in need of reliable transportation over the last 12 years.
For more information on Recycled Rides, click here.

articles.title: CIECA committee works on ADAS calibration standards
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Paul Barry, CIECA executive director and COO, said the organization seeks to set ADAS calibration standards through its Calibration Committee during an open mic session at the Collision Industry Conference Las Vegas meeting earlier this month.

“ADAS calibration is becoming an increasingly important part of restoring vehicle safety after a collision,” Barry said. “As these systems evolve, our industry needs a consistent way to document and communicate the calibration work performed.”

He said the committee will build on its previous work. This includes identifying the data and supporting documentation needed for reliable electronic exchange among repair facilities, calibration providers, insurers, technology companies, and other trading partners.
“Let me emphasize an important distinction here: vehicle manufacturers establish the technical procedures and specifications,” Barry said.
The committee’s goal will be to standardize who performs the work and ensure supporting evidence is documented and communicated.

“We also intend to work with the CIC Definitions Committee to promote consistent ADAS nomenclature and terminology across the industry,” Barry said. “The committee will review existing standards, identify gaps, and prioritize practical solutions to see this established standard process, and we welcome industry participation and look forward to collaborating on this important work with vehicle safety at the center of our effort.”

The committee is chaired by Dan Dutra, Collision Career Institute senior vice president of business development, and Chuck Olson, AirPro Diagnostics, senior vice president of automotive technology solutions.
Dutra further explained the initiative in a CIECA email, saying the committee “recognizes that a successful calibration involves more than a completed scan-tool procedure.”

“Committee members said the initiative can help simplify documentation, reduce administrative burdens, and provide greater confidence that required calibration procedures have been properly documented,” the email states.
Olsen also reiterated in the email that the committee intends to collaborate with the CIC Definitions Committee and other industry standards bodies.

Jordan Hendler, CIC administrator, told Repairer Driven News that the CIC Definitions Task Force has a review process for proposed industry definitions from both entities and the collision industry at large and, once completed, posts them to the CIC Wiki Glossary.

“The Task Force is a volunteer group of repairers, insurers, suppliers, and other stakeholders dedicated to clarifying and standardizing terminology across the automotive collision repair industry,” Hendler said. “As seen with the 2024 SAE Calibration Terms updates and the 2025 Total Loss and Salvage category updates, the terminology received from CIECA’s Calibration Committee would be treated similarly.”
Hendler adds that conversation surrounding the nomenclature, including its function and application in processes, documentation, or workflows, will likely prompt more in-depth discussions.

“As part of the vetting process, most submissions are also reviewed by a subject-related CIC committee and shared with the greater industry for feedback before final approval during a live meeting,” Hendler adds. “When a definition update or change is particularly sensitive or requires deeper clarification, it may also warrant a special presentation or dedicated discussion.”
The Consumer Advocacy Task Force presented an ADAS problem statement during the CIC meeting in Chicago earlier this year.

“ADAS, and ADAS calibration, are broad-ranging, complex, and constantly evolving,” the statement reads. “This is not a narrow technical issue that can be resolved by one company, one committee, or one segment of this industry. It touches calibration, liability, data access, training, equipment, repair procedures, the environment in which the work is performed, and, of course, consumer safety.”
It continues by saying that the task force believes ADAS is the greatest challenge the industry has ever faced and it needs input and cooperation from the entire industry.
“The problem simply stated is: the lack of clear, consistent and verifiable protocols is widespread and needs to be addressed by the collective industry,” the statement says.
Read the entire statement on the CIC website.
Paul Barry, CIECA executive director and COO, speaks during the CIC November 2026 meeting.

articles.title: What Tire Wear Reveals About Suspension and Alignments
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: A driver rolls into the shop complaining that their tires are wearing out faster than expected. The vehicle drives reasonably well, and there are no obvious suspension noises. But a closer look at the tread tells a different story.

Uneven tire wear can reveal problems with alignment, suspension components, tire inflation and ride control. Learning how to recognize these patterns gives technicians a valuable diagnostic advantage.
The key is understanding what each wear pattern means and knowing which components to inspect next.
Start With Tire Pressure and Tread Depth
Before recommending an alignment or replacing suspension components, check the basics.
Inspect all four tires. Measure and record tread depth across the inner, center and outer portions of each tire. Compare the readings to identify differences in wear.

Next, check inflation pressure against the vehicle manufacturer’s specifications. Underinflation often increases wear along both shoulders, while sustained overinflation can increase center tread wear.
Don’t overlook the tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS). A warning light, damaged sensor or incorrect pressure setting may contribute to a problem that has gone unnoticed.
Also look for mismatched tires, damaged wheels and evidence of missed tire rotations.
These initial checks help determine whether the cause is tire maintenance, vehicle geometry or a mechanical problem.
Inner-Edge Wear: Check Camber, Toe and Ride Height
When the inside shoulder wears faster than the rest of the tread, alignment geometry should be one of the first areas to investigate.
Negative camber means the top of the wheel tilts inward relative to the vehicle. Excessive negative camber can place additional load on the inner shoulder.
Toe settings also matter. When wheels point too far inward or outward relative to the vehicle’s direction of travel, the tires scrub against the road instead of rolling cleanly.
- Problems with an air suspension system
Independent rear suspensions deserve particular attention. Worn bushings can change wheel geometry during acceleration, braking and cornering.
Shop tip: Measure ride height before performing an alignment. If the suspension is sitting below specification, adjusting alignment angles alone may not solve the problem.
Outer-Edge Wear: Inspect Alignment and Body Control
Excessive wear on the outside shoulder may indicate an alignment problem or excessive loading during cornering.
Positive camber, incorrect toe settings and worn suspension components can contribute to outer-edge wear.
Consider how the vehicle is driven. Crossovers and SUVs have relatively high centers of gravity, which can increase weight transfer during turns.
When springs, shocks or struts no longer control suspension movement effectively, the tire may experience additional loading and irregular wear.
Diagnostic reminder: Outer-edge wear does not automatically mean the shocks are bad. Verify alignment and mechanical condition before recommending replacement parts.
Feathering occurs when the tread blocks develop a sharp edge on one side and a smoother, rounded edge on the other.
You may not notice feathering immediately during a visual inspection. Carefully running your hand across the tread in opposite directions can help identify the pattern.
Feathering commonly indicates an incorrect toe setting.
However, toe can change when worn steering or suspension components move under load. That means the alignment readings may not tell the entire story.
Check for looseness in tie rods, control arm bushings and other steering components before making adjustments.
Remember that changing camber or caster can affect toe. That’s why toe is normally adjusted after other applicable alignment angles.
Cupping and Scalloping: Look Beyond Alignment
Cupping creates irregular high and low spots around the tire’s circumference. The pattern may resemble a series of shallow dips in the tread.
- Loose or damaged suspension components
Shocks and struts help control wheel movement as the vehicle travels over bumps. If they lose damping ability, the tire may move excessively and develop irregular wear.
However, wheel imbalance can create similar symptoms.
Shop example: A driver complains of a humming noise that increases with road speed. The rear tires show scalloped wear, but there is no obvious wheel-bearing play.
Before replacing a bearing, inspect the tire surfaces, check wheel balance and evaluate suspension condition. Tire noise can sometimes resemble a failing wheel bearing.
A vehicle’s suspension geometry is designed around a specified operating height.
When springs weaken or suspension components wear, ride height can change. That affects camber, toe and the position of suspension control arms.
A small height difference may have a meaningful impact on tire wear.
Measure ride height using the manufacturer’s procedure and compare the results against specification. Don’t assume that springs are healthy simply because the vehicle appears level.
On vehicles with electronic air suspension, check for leaks and verify that ride-height sensors and calibration are operating correctly.
Don’t Forget Rear Alignment and Thrust Angle
Tire wear problems aren’t always limited to the front axle.

The thrust angle describes the direction the rear wheels point relative to the vehicle’s centerline. If the rear wheels are not aligned correctly, the driver may need to compensate with the steering wheel to keep the vehicle moving straight.
That condition can contribute to unusual tire wear and a steering wheel that appears off-center.
A four-wheel alignment can help identify these problems, particularly on vehicles with independent rear suspension.
When uneven tire wear enters the shop, use a consistent inspection process.
- Verify the complaint. Ask when the wear started and whether the vehicle pulls, vibrates or makes noise.
- Inspect the tires. Record tread depths, tire sizes, inflation pressures and visible wear patterns.
- Check the suspension. Inspect steering components, bushings, springs, shocks and struts.
- Measure ride height. Compare measurements with factory specifications.
- Check alignment. Review camber, caster, toe and thrust angle where applicable.
- Verify the repair. Correct the cause, evaluate tire safety and explain the findings to the customer.
The Takeaway: Let the Tires Guide Your Diagnosis
Tires are more than replaceable wear items. They provide clues about how the vehicle’s steering, suspension and alignment systems are working together.
Recognizing those clues helps technicians diagnose problems earlier, protect customers’ tire investments and avoid unnecessary repairs.

articles.title: Porsche TPMS: The First Carmaker To The Game
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Porsche was the first manufacturer to use a tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) on a vehicle in 1986 for the 959 supercar. The 959 was another first because it was equipped with world’s first self-supporting run-flat tires made by Bridgestone. This TPMS setup was again used on the 928 for model years 1990 to 1994.

The 959 did not have a spare tire as standard equipment. Instead, the dealership would dispatch a technician with a spare if a customer had a flat or loss of inflation. The run-flat tires could be driven for a limited distance at 50mph. The wheels used a system that locked a compatible tire into a channel that locked the bead to the wheel. This was called the Denloc system and prevented the tire from coming off the rim and suddenly deflating in the event of a puncture. The rims also used an innovative hollow-spoke system.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The early system used tire pressure sensors mounted in special holes in the valley of the wheel. This early tire pressure monitoring system was known as RDK, or Reifen Druck Kontrolle, which roughly translates to Tire Pressure Control.

The sensors looked like a stack of poker chips. A diaphragm inside the sensors connected to switches that were set to a reference pressure. The receiver was mounted on the knuckle and was an inductive coil that would pass current through the sensors wirelessly. Depending on the position of the diaphragm and which switches were open or closed, the amount of current flowing through the receiver’s coils, would change the voltage.
In 2004, Porsche started to use a conventional TPMS system for the Cayenne and select Boxster and 911 models. These systems were a lot like those found on BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Audi vehicles.

Porsche TPMS systems use four antennas mounted in the wheel wells and a designated module for the tire pressure. The sensors use a 433mHz frequency. On most models, the menu will have the option for two sets of tires and sensor IDs for summer and winter tires.

The system has a telltale malfunction indicator light and a low-pressure light. When the system detects a malfunction, the telltale light will flash for approximately one minute, and then will remain continuously illuminated. This sequence will continue upon subsequent vehicle startups, as long as the malfunction exists.

If a sensor is not transmitting, the warning light in the speedometer flashes for one minute, and then remains continuously illuminated. Codes and data from the TPMS control module can be accessed with a scan tool. If there is a problem, it is typically communication errors with the four receivers in the wheel wells.

It is also important to remember that the TPMS module starts hunting for sensor signals the second the ignition is turned on. Leaving the ignition in the “on” position when a wheel is removed may cause the information display to say, “Wheel change? Input new TPM settings.” Also, if the second set of wheels is in the vicinity of the vehicle, the same warning could be set.

Before starting any relearn process, set the tire to the pressure specified in the doorjamb for the cold temperature. The relearn process starts with turning the ignition on, accessing the vehicle’s computer and entering into the tire pressure control menu. On most models, you will need to select the winter or summer set of tires. The system will then start to learn the sensor IDs and positions.

The onboard computer displays the message “TPM is learning.” The process may take 2 to 10 minutes, and the vehicle speed needs to be above 15-16 mph. During this time, the current tire pressures are not available on the display. The tire pressure warning light will remain lit until all wheels have been learned.
Position and pressure information will be displayed as soon as the TPMS system has assigned the wheels identified as belonging to the vehicle and to the correct wheel positions.

articles.title: BendPak Releases OctaFlex Series Lifts
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: BendPak Inc. released the OctaFlex Series of eight-arm car lifts. The OctaFlex12DPS two-post lift is now shipping.

According to the company, this is how it works: “While the four primary arms support the vehicle, the four secondary arms can raise, lower or simply hold cabs, drivetrains, EV batteries, suspension assemblies and other heavy components without the need for additional equipment, helpers or bays. When they’re not required, the auxiliary arms can be moved up out of the way, so the lift can be used as a standard two-post model.”

It also comes with a magnetic pendant controller with two-speed controls. The pendant controller lets technicians stand back from the lift columns for enhanced visibility around the vehicle. Each set of arms can be operated independently at either “normal” or new “slow” speed.

“As dealers and independent repair shops continue to struggle with an aging and shrinking technician workforce, they also face surging demand for labor-intensive tasks like cab-off repairs and EV service,” says Jeff Kritzer, BendPak president and CEO. “OctaFlex eases the pressure by helping technicians handle complex jobs independently with greater efficiency and less physical strain, maximizing throughput and profit potential.”

articles.title: The AAM Group Celebrates 20 Years of Total Truck Centers
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The AAM Group is celebrating the 20th anniversary of Total Truck Centers, its flagship marketing program for independent truck accessory retailers and installers. Looking back on the past two decades, The AAM Group said the need for greater support in the truck accessories aftermarket led to the creation of Total Truck Centers. Distributing large, difficult-to-ship products presented unique challenges. In 2005, four distributors—Weller’s Auto Supply, North Central Truck, Nelson Truck and Titan Equipment—joined The AAM Group. Their participation laid the foundation for a dedicated truck accessories program.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Total Truck Centers officially launched in 2006 with a clear purpose: helping independent truck accessory retailers compete and grow.

As the truck accessories aftermarket has evolved, so have the challenges facing independent retailers. Jobbers often lack the time, staff and resources to manage their own marketing. Recognizing these challenges, The AAM Group developed four core tools to help level the playing field.

Aftermarket Websites® helps retailers establish an online presence and connect with customers searching for products. ReadyPosts provides free social media content and automation to help shops stay visible without adding to their workload.

N-Store TV brings supplier product education into showrooms, streaming more than 3 million minutes of content each month. Meanwhile, PRO Rebates has returned thousands of dollars to participating jobbers.

“We started Total Truck Centers because we recognized a need to better support independent truck accessory retailers,” said Tim Oddom, president of The AAM Group. “Twenty years later, the tools have changed, but our purpose hasn’t. Everything we do comes back to helping our jobbers sell more products and grow their businesses.”

As Total Truck Centers enters its next chapter, The AAM Group said it continues listening to its members and jobbers. The organization aims to understand their challenges and develop resources that meet their changing needs.

“The past 20 years have been about listening to our members and jobbers and responding to their needs,” said Andy Stacy, marketing director. “That same commitment will guide us for the next 20 years. As the industry changes, we’ll continue finding ways to help independent retailers succeed.”

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens New Store in Glen Allen
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its newest store in Glen Allen, Virgina, on November 19, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 10318 Washington Hwy. with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from Reynolds Community College who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.

The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training, and career opportunities through the school’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

“We’re excited to continue growing with our second location in Glen Allen,” said Mike Fogarty, Regional Vice President, Advance Auto Parts. “This store will help us better serve the community by making it easier for customers to get the right parts and products they rely on. As we celebrate this opening, we’re also proud to team up with Reynolds Community College and support programs that help prepare students for careers in the automotive industry.”

“We appreciate Advance Auto Parts’ support of our Automotive Technology students and program,” said Kendra Brinkley, Ph.D., dean of the School of STEM & Trades. “Gifts like this help us provide students with opportunities to apply what they learn in the classroom, gain valuable hands-on experience, and develop the skills they need to prepare for successful careers in the automotive industry.”

articles.title: NexaMotion Group Names Inaugural Vendors of the Year
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: NexaMotion Group (NMG) named UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) and Precision International the recipients of its first annual Vendor of the Year award. The program honors supplier partners whose commitment to NMG’s customers, team and strategy extends well beyond the purchase order.

For 50 years, from the founding of Transtar to the formation of NexaMotion Group, that kind of supplier partnership has been a cornerstone of how the company competes. Honorees were selected by NMG’s executive and supply chain leadership on availability, quality and responsiveness, and on a harder test: how far the supplier was willing to go in service of NMG’s strategy and its customers’ success.

“Anyone can fill an order. Our best partners help us build the business,” said Scott Weinstein, President of NexaMotion Group. “UAC and Precision International show up in the planning room, not just on the loading dock. They bring us coverage before our customers ask for it, they invest in our people and our shops, and when we make bold moves as a company they are right beside us. That is partnership, and it is what this award was created to honor.”

Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Mansfield, Texas, UAC designs and supplies automotive air conditioning components, from compressors and condensers to evaporators, driers, hose assemblies and electrical parts, backed by a factory audit process and an in-house validation team. NMG recently selected UAC as the lead air conditioning supplier for its general repair business, a decision shaped as much by UAC’s willingness to plan, train and invest alongside NMG’s teams as by the quality of its catalog. UAC is led by Francisco Coll, CEO, and Sophia Coll Crowley, CEO, with Luke Masters, Vice President of Business Development.
