paras.en: Founded in 1975 by Dennis Marshall and based in Yaphank, New York, Precision International supplies more than 3,000 transmission kits and nearly 10,000 parts and components to rebuilders worldwide. The company is ISO 9001 certified and a five-time consecutive General Motors Supplier of the Year. Precision International is led by Tina Parente, President, with Frank Miller, Executive Vice President, and John Sollazzo, Vice President of Sales and Marketing.

“Both companies share forecasts with us, solve problems before they reach a customer, and measure their success by whether our shops win the job,” said Tim Cox, EVP of Supply Chain, NexaMotion Group. “That is when a supplier relationship stops being a transaction and becomes a competitive advantage for everyone it touches.”
NMG said it will present the Vendor of the Year award annually. UAC and Precision International products are available through NMG’s business brands and sales representatives.

articles.title: DARPA is assessing Microsoft's controversial quantum computing technology. What will happen if the Majorana 2 platform is vindicated?
articles.author: Tristan Greene

paras.en: Microsoft scientists have doubled down on their controversial Majorana 2 quantum computing platform after encountering pushback for saying its "topological qubits" were powered by an enigmatic subatomic particle. In August of 2025, they said they would field a scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computer by 2033 — years ahead of schedule.

Now, after opening a new lab at the University of Maryland and partnering with the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) to conduct hardware validation, Microsoft has moved up this timeline to 2029.

The company's confidence is based on research suggesting that Majorana 2 represents a generational breakthrough in quantum computing. Scientists first announced that they had created this new qubit in a study published in the journal Nature in February 2025. Then, they followed up by announcing the Majorana 2 platform in a preprint study published this past June.

If verified, the prototype quantum processor would give Microsoft a commanding lead in the race to build a fault-tolerant, universal quantum computer, given that scientists said it can maintain a quantum state for much longer than alternative platforms. But some experts in the quantum physics community dispute the company's claims, suggesting that the qubit modality is highly experimental and had never been demonstrated in a working quantum computer prior to Microsoft's 2025 announcement.

Microsoft started its quantum computing program in 2005 after mathematician Michael Freedman convinced company leadership that conventional quantum architectures would eventually hit a brick wall. He advocated for a radical new approach to quantum computing based on a mathematical concept known as topological quantum field theory (TQFT). TQFT is a branch of theoretical physics and mathematics in which physical observables do not depend on local geometry (such as distances, curvature or angles) of space-time but rather on global topology.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Essentially, in TQFT, local geometry can change without disrupting qubits because its topology remains invariant. This feature of the theory is very attractive to hardware developers because it could yield qubits that are extremely resilient to disturbances such as atmospheric noise and perturbation. By contrast, conventional modalities, such as superconducting qubits, are perturbed pretty easily.

Microsoft subsequently built the first Majorana platform, named after theoretical physicist Ettore Majorana —who in 1937 hypothesized the existence of particles that act as their own antiparticles — to explore the use of TQFT in quantum computing.

If Microsoft's internal data holds up against DARPA's scrutiny, Freedman's theoretical bet may finally be paying off. According to internal research, Majorana 2 creates qubits that last between 20 seconds and a minute. By contrast, conventional qubits tend to last only microseconds.

In 2018, a research team that included Microsoft research scientist Roman Lutchyn published a study in the journal Nature Reviews Materials in which they claimed to have observed compelling evidence of Majorana "zero modes" — ostensibly demonstrating the existence of the theoretical Majorana quasiparticle.

However, when the data was released to reviewers in 2019, several noteworthy physicists raised objections centered on allegations of data trimming, confirmation bias and the potential misidentification of trivial electrical noise as exotic physics. That study was retracted in 2021, after the authors conceded that some of their methodology may have been flawed.

In the new study from June, Microsoft's claims were even bolder. The new study’s authors wrote that they observed physics indicating qubits built with the Majorana platform could last "orders of magnitude longer than typical qubit operation times."

The study was received with skepticism by many of the same critics of the 2018 research paper. The most common criticism, based on those that have been published, is that Microsoft researchers didn't operate a working qubit but instead tracked how long an electron state sits undisturbed before a stray charge flips its parity. The critics noted that measuring an electron's parity state isn't analogous to measuring a qubit's reliability.

Alex Khan, vice president of quantum research and development at physics acceleration firm BQP and a fellow at the University of Maryland QLab, dismissed much of the ballyhoo surrounding the Majorana research papers, comparing nascent quantum computing efforts such as Microsoft's to the Wright brothers' early airplane trials: There were only a few people there, and the aircraft went just a short distance. "And you could have had a lot of people sitting there saying, 'You know, this is never going to really do anything’,'" Khan, who wasn't involved in the Majorana 2 research, told Live Science.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: When it comes to quantum computing breakthroughs, he took a more utilitarian view. "I've used a lot of quantum computers, but in order for me to use a quantum computer, it needs to be available," he said. "My most important thing is, can I have access to the computer? What kind of algorithms can I run on it? What can I test or what can I benchmark? What kind of capability will this provide? And does it begin to show some of the quantum advantage that's coming out of the quantum computer versus a simulator?"
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Determining whether Microsoft or its critics are correct isn't as simple as running the team's experiments on another system. Microsoft is building Majorana 2 from scratch, one engineering feat at a time, Zulfi Alam, corporate vice president of Azure Quantum at Microsoft, told Live Science in an interview.
"The secret sauce is that we build our devices atom by atom, and that reduces disorder dramatically," Alam said.
Despite the back-and-forth between Microsoft and its critics, the question of whether the company has leapfrogged its competitors on the journey to build fault-tolerant, useful machines remains.

The U.S. government might be able to validate Microsoft's claims. The company will be included in DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, which seeks to determine whether it's possible to build an industrially useful quantum computer by 2033. From now until 2029, the government will evaluate Majorana and Microsoft’s timeline to establish a framework for testing quantum computing claims.
In support of this endeavor, Microsoft is building a quantum computing lab at the University of Maryland so DARPA researchers can conduct their own hands-on evaluation of the hardware.

Khan described the partnership as "exciting," adding that he hopes DARPA can help determine the system's capabilities. "The physics is already known now," he said. "But with the topological qubits, they might know how to read the topological state, but then the question is, what are they reading? Also, is it able to store quantum information? Is it able to build a quantum state?"

If DARPA validates the biggest Majorana 2 claims, not only will Microsoft be vindicated, but the QBI team will have demonstrated their capabilities at the furthest frontiers of quantum computing research.

Alam said Microsoft is looking forward to the challenge. He described the shift in focus from theoretical science to "productizing" results as a focusing mechanism. DARPA has a team of about 50 engineers who are looking at the results and operating the machine at the University of Maryland, he noted.
"We have this deliverable for DARPA, and every six months or so, we have these massive deliverable dumps that we are giving to them," Alam said. "They know everything about our program."
Essentially, Microsoft's claims indicate that Majorana 2 solves most of quantum computing's biggest bottlenecks.

Designing reliable qubits is often cited as quantum computing's greatest challenge — and to solve problems at the edges of cryptography, chemistry and physics, we'll need quantum computers capable of fielding millions of qubits.

The first bottleneck is hardware. Scaling current systems such as those developed by IBM, Google and other quantum hardware labs requires scaling infrastructure in lockstep. Superconducting and spin qubits, for example, both need dedicated analog microwave lines for each physical qubit. This equates to millions of physical cables per computer.
If Majorana 2 works as Microsoft scientists claim, the cable problem goes away because its qubits can be controlled digitally via an integrated processor core that needs only a few connecting wires.

The next bottleneck that Majorana 2 solves is the massive qubit counts required to conduct useful calculations. Majorana 2 purportedly produces exponentially more reliable qubits than other platforms do, which promises a dramatic reduction in the number of error-correcting qubits needed to run a stable quantum computing system.

As Alam put it: "Our own internal teams thought we would need 16 million qubits to look at Shor's algorithm.” This is in reference to a commonly used encryption algorithm that it’s believed would take a classical computer years to crack while a sufficiently powerful quantum system is hypothesized to reduce that time to months or even hours.
- An Anthropic mathematician claims to have proven the Riemann hypothesis. We have to rethink how we reward expertise.
- What if space and time don't exist? Physicists are chasing hints that our reality emerges from something deeper
- Could AI ever build itself? Scientists map the road to the 'last AI built by humans.'
"Since then," he added, "we have been able to publicly refine our estimates and think that we need more like 600,000 to 400,000 qubits."

Joseph Kearney, chief strategy officer and post-quantum cryptographer at Quantum Future in the U.K. who was not involved in the research, said that, if verified, Microsoft's Majorana 2 would revolutionize the field of quantum computing and shorten the timelines for quantum advantage in complex fields of study by years.

"If Microsoft had genuinely solved error correction, the 2035 deadline would no longer be credible,” he told Live Science in an email. "A breakthrough of this kind would remove our warning period, the clock is already running. Data intercepted today can be decrypted in the future, and Microsoft's claims, if they hold, would bring that future considerably closer than most organizations have planned for."

His work has been published in numerous outlets including Mother Jones, The Stack, The Next Web, and Undark Magazine.
Prior to journalism, Tristan served in the US Navy for 10 years as a programmer and engineer. When he isn’t writing, he enjoys gaming with his wife and studying military history.

articles.title: James Webb telescope discovers mysterious red object just 450 million years after the Big Bang — and it could be a baby black hole
articles.author: Shreejaya Karantha

paras.en: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) have spotted a tiny, extremely red object that existed just 450 million years after the Big Bang.

The object, called CW-LRD-z10, may be a "little red dot" — a mysterious class of objects that many researchers think are black holes growing inside dense cocoons of gas. If confirmed, the newfound object would be the earliest known example, potentially offering a window into how these enigmatic objects form.

"Such an object would be one of the most distant accreting black holes known," Roberto Maiolino, professor of experimental astrophysics at the University of Cambridge, who was not involved in the study, told Live Science in an email. The object may provide further evidence that little red dots trace some of the earliest phases of supermassive black hole formation, he added.
The study was published Nov. 24 in the Astrophysical Journal Letters.

Little red dots, or LRDs, are a population of tiny, very red objects in the early universe. The farther away they are, the more their light is stretched to longer, redder wavelengths. (This phenomenon is called redshift).

LRDs were only recently discovered thanks to JWST. The space telescope's near-infrared camera could only capture objects out to a redshift of about 9, corresponding to a lookback time of about 13.1 billion years ago. So in 2025, the team behind the new study also used JWST's mid-infrared instrument (MIRI) to search for even more distant sources.
CW-LRD-z10 was the only candidate that the search turned up, the study’s first author Takumi Tanaka, a doctoral student at the University of Tokyo, told Live Science.
Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.

In the study, the team measured the redshift of this compact, red object. They found it to be 10.36, suggesting it emitted its light when the universe was just 450 million years old. They measured it using a sharp drop in its light, interpreted as a ‘Lyman-alpha break.’

The result looks solid in one key respect, according to Maiolino. "The continuum drop attributed to a [Lyman-alpha] break appears relatively convincing, so I would say that the redshift determination is reasonably robust," he said.

The strongest clue that this object is a little red dot is its color, which is much redder in the mid-infrared than in the near-infrared band. The spectrum (its signature of emitted light) also shows the "V-shaped" dip typical of little red dots, possible iron emission, and tentatively detected emission lines whose ratios resemble those in other little red dots and active black holes. None of these three factors is conclusive on its own, Tanaka said, but together they support the little red dot interpretation.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: However, the spectrum does not show wide hydrogen lines, which are the telltale sign of a little red dot. This is because the region where these hydrogen lines can be found in the spectrum falls outside the wavelengths covered in the new study. Maiolino said that "at this stage, this should only be considered an LRD candidate."
Tanaka agrees that it is more appropriate to continue calling it a very promising little red dot candidate.

The object's spectrum could instead point to a Balmer break, a sharp drop produced by older stars at closer distances. When redshifted, this would suggest that the object is a much closer galaxy at a redshift of about 3, or about 11.4 billion light-years away.

Tanaka said the data doesn't support this interpretation, as the object's color is hard to explain for such a galaxy, and the emission lines expected at that distance were not seen. "The observed break feature is too strong to be explained by a normal Balmer break from a typical stellar population," he said.

Alternatively, an ordinary star-forming galaxy at redshift 10.36 could in principle produce the extreme red color, but it would need an unusually strong signature spectral line. That line falls outside the current spectrum, so future observations should help test it.

CW-LRD-z10's light also shows possible emission features from iron, which are thought to be emitted from the gas close to actively feeding black holes such as in quasars, rather than ordinary star-forming galaxies. "If confirmed, this would support the presence of actively accreting black holes and suggest that gas containing heavy elements was already present in the environment of the possible black hole," Tanaka said.

The nature of little red dots is highly debated. One of the leading theories suggests they host accreting black holes wrapped in dense gas, while other theories involve supermassive stars, black hole stars, or dense star clusters. Because the true nature of the little red dots and their position in black hole evolution scenarios are still uncertain, Tanaka stressed they cannot draw firm conclusions about what CW-LRD-z10 could mean for how supermassive black holes first formed.

Maiolino said that if CW-LRD-z10 really hosts an accreting black hole, then its properties could hold important information about how the first supermassive black holes formed. "Hence, studying its properties could shed light on the different black hole seeding scenarios, he said."

JWST's mid-infrared instrument is scheduled to take a spectrum of the object in 2027. The observations are designed to detect hydrogen and oxygen emission lines as well as the underlying continuum, which should let the team separate a genuinely red glow from the effect of strong emission lines. "We’re really looking forward to seeing the data," Tanaka said.

Shreejaya holds a bachelor's degree in science and a master's degree in physics with a specialization in astrophysics.

articles.title: Why are we the last humans standing? What interbreeding with Neanderthals reveals about the differences between us.
articles.author: Tia Ghose

paras.en: Across thousands of years, Neanderthals and modern humans (Homo sapiens) interbred, leaving traces of Neanderthal DNA in people alive today. But how these encounters happened is a huge unanswered question. Answering it may shed light on what made us different from our close cousins — and why we thrived while Neanderthals died out.

Live Science interviewed researchers deeply invested in human evolution, and in this exclusive video we explore what scientists are uncovering about these relationships from ancient DNA and archaeological evidence unearthed in Eurasia.

articles.title: Almost 90 Years After Discovering a Ship Burial That Rewrote British History, Archaeologists Returned to Sutton Hoo. This Time, They Uncovered a Ghostly 'Sand Body'

paras.en: Archaeologists have discovered an unusual grave at Sutton Hoo, a cemetery in Suffolk, England best known for its seventh-century ship burial of an early medieval king. The newly discovered grave contains no human remains—only ghost-like impressions in the shape of a body.
paras.zh: 考古学家在英格兰萨福克郡的萨顿胡墓地发现了一座不寻常的古墓。萨顿胡墓地以其七世纪时一位中世纪早期国王的船葬而闻名。新发现的墓葬中没有人类遗骸，只有类似幽灵的人体形状印痕。

paras.en: The “sand body” was discovered toward the end of a month-long excavation in the summer of 2025. The dig was conducted by “Time Team,” a popular British archaeology television series, in partnership with the National Trust, a conservation charity, and FAS Heritage, a field archaeology and historic preservation company based in York, England.
paras.zh: 这具“沙体”是在2025年夏季为期一个月的发掘即将结束时被发现的。此次发掘由英国热门考古电视节目《时间团队》（Time Team）与保护慈善机构国家信托（National Trust）以及总部位于英格兰约克郡的野外考古和历史保护公司FAS Heritage合作进行。

paras.en: Sand bodies are burials where “the bodies and bones had dissolved away in the acid soil, replaced by hard sand which held the form of the person,” Angus Wainwright, an archaeologist with the National Trust, says in a statement announcing the find.
paras.zh: 国家信托基金会（National Trust）的考古学家安格斯·温赖特（Angus Wainwright）在宣布这一发现的声明中表示：“沙体是墓葬，‘尸体和骨骼在酸性土壤中溶解，被保持着人形的硬沙所取代’。”

paras.en: In addition to the sand body, the archaeologists also found grave goods, including beads, tweezers, a knife and a brooch. They were also surprised to find evidence that suggests a second person might have been buried in the same grave. The discovery raises many questions, including whether the two individuals were buried there simultaneously or at different times. The relationship between the two individuals also remains a mystery.
paras.zh: 除了沙体之外，考古学家还发现了随葬品，包括珠子、镊子、一把刀和一枚胸针。他们还惊讶地发现了证据，表明同一座墓中可能还埋葬着第二个人。这一发现引发了许多问题，包括这两个人是同时还是在不同时间被埋葬在那里。这两个人之间的关系也仍然是个谜。

paras.en: “As ever with archaeology, the more we uncover, the more questions we find ourselves asking,” says Tim Taylor, the creator and producer of “Time Team,” per the BBC’s George King.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司（BBC）的乔治·金（George King）报道， “时间团队”（Time Team）的创作者兼制片人蒂姆·泰勒（Tim Taylor）表示：“一如既往，在考古学领域，我们发现的越多，我们提出的问题就越多。”

paras.en: Sand bodies have been discovered at Sutton Hoo before, during excavations conducted in the 1980s, as well as at other burial sites in the same region. In 2020, archaeologists announced the discovery of sand bodies, also known as “sand silhouettes,” at a seventh-century burial site in the town of Oulton, Suffolk. They recently found similar sand bodies at a “nationally significant” early medieval burial ground located near Theberton, Suffolk.
paras.zh: 在20世纪80年代进行的考古发掘中，人们曾在萨顿胡以及同一地区的其他墓葬遗址发现过沙体。2020年，考古学家宣布在萨福克郡奥尔顿镇的一处七世纪墓地发现了沙体，也称为“沙影”。他们最近在位于萨福克郡塞伯顿附近的一处“具有全国性重要意义”的早期中世纪墓地发现了类似的沙体。

paras.en: Sutton Hoo features two cemeteries dated to the sixth and seventh centuries. The site was discovered in the late 1930s, when landowner Edith Pretty hired self-taught archaeologist Basil Brown to explore her estate near the town of Woodbridge in Suffolk, England. One of the most significant discoveries was an 88-foot-long burial ship that once held human remains. Scholars suspect the ship burial may have been the final resting place of Raedwald, the ruler of the kingdom of East Anglia who died around 624 C.E.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The ship contained more than 260 items dating to the sixth or seventh centuries C.E., including a helmet, elaborately decorated weapons, armor, military equipment, gold coins and horse bridles.
paras.zh: 这艘船上载有260多件可追溯至公元六世纪或七世纪的文物，包括一顶头盔、精心装饰的武器、盔甲、军用装备、金币和马辔。

paras.en: Since then, archaeological investigations at Sutton Hoo have focused largely on the ship burial and other royal burial mounds. But, with their most recent digs, researchers wanted to learn more about the everyday people of the region.
paras.zh: 此后，萨顿胡的考古调查主要集中在船葬和其他皇家古墓上。然而，在最近的挖掘中，研究人员希望更多地了解该地区的普通百姓。

paras.en: In 2024, archaeologists began excavating a burial ground known as Garden Field, which they think may predate the famous ship burial. During that dig, they found the base of an intricately decorated, sixth-century container known as the Byzantine Bromeswell Bucket.

They carefully transported the base to a laboratory, where testing revealed that it contained cremated humans and animal remains. Researchers discovered part of an ankle bone, fragments of a skull and a double-sided comb that’s probably made from antler.

Archaeologists returned to Garden Field in June 2025, hoping to learn more about the size and scope of the cemetery, when it was used and whether the individuals buried there were connected to the communities associated with Sutton Hoo’s royal burial ground. They also explored a field located near the River Deben that they suspect might contain a ship, a medieval dock, a 19th-century saw pit or a modern cattle grave.
A new four-part documentary series about the 2025 dig is being released on YouTube. The recent excavations have shed new light on Sutton Hoo, but many questions remain unanswered.
“There is still much to discover about this iconic site,” Helen Geake, an archaeologist with “Time Team,” says in the statement.

articles.title: Astronauts Living at NASA's Planned Future Lunar Base Might One Day Snack on Moon-Grown Potatoes

paras.en: NASA aims to build the first permanent moon base within the next decade, allowing astronauts to live and work there for extended periods. But those lunar residents probably can’t depend on receiving all their food from Earth. They’ll likely need to grow some crops on their own—and new research suggests potatoes could be a viable option.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的目标是在未来十年内建成首个永久性月球基地，让宇航员能够在那里长期生活和工作。但这些月球居民可能无法完全依赖从地球运来的食物。他们很可能需要自己种植一些作物——而一项新研究表明，土豆可能是一个可行的选择。

paras.en: In a study published November 19 in the journal npj Microgravity, researchers report successfully growing edible potatoes in simulated lunar soil with an added nutrient-rich ingredient. The findings represent a promising avenue for lunar food-production systems and suggest that astronauts might one day feast on moon spuds.
paras.zh: 在11月19日发表于《npj Microgravity》杂志上的一项研究中，研究人员报告称，他们在添加了富含营养成分的模拟月壤中成功种植出了可食用的土豆。该研究结果为月球粮食生产系统开辟了一条有希望的道路，并表明宇航员有朝一日可能享用到月球土豆。

paras.en: “Potatoes provide more calories per land area than many other crops,” study co-author Aymeric Goyer, a plant biologist at Oregon State University, tells Reuters’ Will Dunham. “They are nutritious—they provide more potassium than a banana, are rich in vitamin C, have good proteins—and they have a high satiety index,” meaning they are very filling and satisfying.
paras.zh: 俄勒冈州立大学植物生物学家、该研究的共同作者Aymeric Goyer在接受路透社记者Will Dunham采访时表示：“与许多其他作物相比，土豆在单位土地面积上提供的热量更多。” “土豆营养丰富——钾含量比香蕉还高，富含维生素C，蛋白质含量较高——而且饱腹感指数很高，”这意味着土豆非常顶饱，能让人感到很满足。

paras.en: The researchers received funding from NASA to help figure out how to grow plants to feed future moon visitors. But the dirt there, called lunar regolith, doesn’t have nitrogen, which is one of plants’ essential macronutrients, Goyer tells El País’ Miguel Ángel Criado. It also contains low levels of organic matter to help supply other nutrients, as well as high levels of heavy metals, which can be toxic to plants and the people who eat them. What’s more, lunar regolith’s texture resembles that of tiny glass shards, which can be tough on tissues.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: So, the team tried to make a simulated moon dirt mixture more amenable to plant growth by adding vermicompost: a nutrient-rich organic ingredient that includes worm poop. They tested various proportions of vermicompost and imitation lunar regolith, resulting in three dirt combinations: one without vermicompost, one with 15 percent and one with 30 percent.
paras.zh: 因此，研究团队尝试通过添加蚯蚓肥（一种富含营养的有机成分，包括蚯蚓粪便）来使模拟月壤混合物更适合植物生长。他们测试了蚯蚓肥和模拟月球表土的各种比例，得到了三种土壤组合：一种不含蚯蚓肥，一种含15%的蚯蚓肥，一种含30%的蚯蚓肥。

paras.en: The experiments revealed that the simulant lunar regolith with the highest vermicompost content yielded just as many potatoes as those grown in Earth soil. Meanwhile, those planted without the nutrient-rich additive were stunted and had underdeveloped roots, signs associated with too much of the heavy metal copper.
paras.zh: 实验表明，蚯蚓肥含量最高的月壤模拟物所结的土豆与在地球土壤中生长的土豆一样多。与此同时，没有添加富含营养物质的添加剂的土豆植株发育不良，根系发育不全，这些迹象与重金属铜含量过高有关。

paras.en: The researchers also tested five different moon dirt simulants—mimicking regolith at different lunar locations—to make mixtures with 5 percent vermicompost. The smaller proportion of the additive allowed the team to measure the crop’s stress response, and it also represents the amount of organic matter that might go into moon dirt during an early stage. These plants grew, but they didn’t produce as many taters as the ones with the 30 percent mixture.
paras.zh: 研究人员还测试了五种不同的月壤模拟物（模拟月球不同地点的月壤），将其与5%的蚯蚓肥混合。较低的添加剂比例使研究团队能够测量作物的应激反应，这也代表了早期阶段可能进入月球土壤的有机物质含量。这些植物长出来了，但它们结出的土豆不如使用30%混合物的植物多。

paras.en: Earlier this year, a different research team reported that they grew chickpeas in simulated moon dirt. They added vermicompost and mycorrhizal fungi—microbes that have a mutually beneficial relationship with most land plant species on Earth—to help with growth.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，另一个研究团队报告称，他们在模拟月球土壤中种植了鹰嘴豆。他们添加了蚯蚓肥和菌根真菌（与地球上大多数陆生植物物种存在互利关系的微生物）来促进生长。

paras.en: “We believe the compost helps balance some of the toxicity we see in lunar regolith by reducing plant exposure to harmful compounds,” study co-author David Handy, a plant biologist at Oregon State University, says in a statement.
paras.zh: “我们认为，堆肥通过减少植物接触有害化合物来帮助平衡我们在月球表岩屑中看到的一些毒性。”俄勒冈州立大学植物生物学家、该研究的共同作者David Handy在声明中表示。

paras.en: According to the researchers, the potatoes are safe to eat. They’re also just as nutritious and don’t contain more glycoalkaloids—natural potato toxins that can build up in stressed plants—than terrestrial spuds.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这些土豆可以安全食用。它们的营养价值也同样高，并且与陆生土豆相比，它们并不含有更多的茄碱——这是一种天然的土豆毒素，会在受胁迫的植物中积累。

paras.en: But are these simulated moon spuds just as tasty as the Earthly ones we know and love? Unfortunately, the team did not conduct a taste test. “We used what we harvested for lab analyses,” Goyer tells Reuters.
paras.zh: 但是，这些模拟的月球土豆是否像我们所熟悉和喜爱的地球土豆一样美味呢？遗憾的是，该团队并未进行口感测试。“我们把收获的马铃薯用于实验室分析。”Goyer告诉路透社。

paras.en: Lunar regolith isn’t the only challenge that moon-grown potatoes would face, however. Our natural satellite has only about one-sixth the gravity we experience on Earth, so researchers will need a better understanding of how that might affect plant growth, Marshall Porterfield, a biological engineer at Purdue University who did not participate in the study, tells the Washington Post’s Eric Niiler. The lunar base’s greenhouse will also need devices that mix the air into the ideal cocktail of nutrients, water and carbon dioxide for the plants. Porterfield is skeptical that moon dirt, even with additives, could ever produce plants that can provide sufficient vitamins and minerals to people.

paras.en: Nevertheless, the team is moving forward one step at a time. Their next study will identify which specific potato varieties fare best in imitation moon dirt.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，该团队仍在稳步推进。他们的下一项研究将确定哪些特定马铃薯品种在模拟月壤中表现最佳。

articles.title: Biologists Discover a 'One-in-a-Million' Bright Yellow Burbot Fish in New York's Oswego Harbor

paras.en: Burbots typically blend into their surroundings with a mottled palette of olive green, earthy brown and golden yellow. So when biologists pulled a bright yellow fish from New York’s Oswego Harbor, they knew they had caught something unusual.
paras.zh: 江鳕通常以橄榄绿、泥土棕和金黄色相间的斑驳色调融入周围环境。因此，当生物学家从纽约奥斯威戈港拉出一条亮黄色的鱼时，他们就知道自己捕到了一种不寻常的鱼。

paras.en: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) scientists were conducting a routine invasive species survey last month when they caught a vibrantly colored burbot, which would “make even the brightest fall foliage look pale in comparison,” according to a November 10 announcement about the find.
paras.zh: 美国鱼类和野生动物管理局（USFWS）的科学家们上个月在进行例行入侵物种调查时，捕获了一条色彩鲜艳的杜父鱼，根据11月10日关于该发现的公告，这条鱼“会让最明艳的秋叶与之相比都黯然失色”。

paras.en: The burbot had a rare biological condition called xanthochromism, which produces an unusually saturated yellow or orange hue in otherwise normally colored animals. It results from a genetic mutation that reduces the production of black-brown melanin, which allows yellow pigment to dominate.
paras.zh: 这条杜父鱼患有一种名为黄变症的罕见生物性疾病，这种疾病会在正常着色的动物身上产生异常饱和的黄色或橙色色调。这是由一种基因突变引起的，该突变会减少黑褐色黑色素的产生，从而使黄色色素占主导地位。

paras.en: Xanthochromism has been observed in dozens of fish species, as well as birds and amphibians. It’s only been recorded in a handful of mammals, including anteaters, tayras, opossums, pikas, martens, weasels and coatis.
paras.zh: 在数十种鱼类以及鸟类和两栖动物中都观察到过黄化现象。迄今为止，仅在少数哺乳动物中记录过这种现象，包括食蚁兽、泰拉鼬、负鼠、鼠兔、貂、鼬和浣熊。

paras.en: USFWS describes the bright yellow fish as “one-in-a-million.” In wild fish, the agency notes, xanthochromism is much less common than albinism, which causes unusually pale or white coloring, or melanism, which produces unusually dark coloring.
paras.zh: 美国鱼类和野生动物管理局将这条亮黄色的鱼描述为“百万分之一”。该机构指出，在野生鱼类中，黄化现象远不如白化现象（导致异常浅色或白色）或黑化现象（导致异常深色）常见。

paras.en: Burbots are native to the Great Lakes, but they typically live in cooler, deeper waters than those in Oswego Harbor on Lake Ontario. Yellow coloring aside, the fish was in rough shape. Biologists noticed that it was emaciated and appeared to be in poor health, so they sent it off for a health analysis. The fish could ultimately help scientists better understand the species’ struggles in the lake, where populations are extremely low for unknown reasons.
paras.zh: 江鳕是五大湖的本土鱼类，但它们通常生活在比安大略湖奥斯威戈港水域更凉爽、更深的水域。除了黄色之外，这条鱼的状况很差。生物学家注意到它瘦骨嶙峋，看起来健康状况不佳，于是将其送去进行健康分析。这条鱼最终可能有助于科学家更好地了解该物种在湖中的生存困境，由于未知原因，该物种在湖中的种群数量极少。

paras.en: Veterinarians at Cornell University College of Veterinary Medicine performed a necropsy on the fish, which revealed an array of issues. The fish had stopped eating, had multiple skin lesions and had an “overall poor body condition,” according to a November 17 social media update from the USFWS’s Lower Great Lakes Fish & Wildlife Conservation Office.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学兽医学院的兽医对这条鱼进行了尸检，发现了一系列问题。根据美国鱼类和野生动物管理局下五大湖鱼类和野生动物保护办公室11月17日的社交媒体消息，这条鱼已经停止进食，有多处皮肤病变，并且“整体身体状况不佳”。

paras.en: The fish also had carcinoma, a type of cancer that originates from the epithelial cells lining the skin and organs, and it had a mild parasite infection in its kidneys. Scientists don’t know what causes cancer in this species, but they suspect age, contaminants, viruses and environmental conditions might play a role. Whatever the causes, this bright yellow individual will “help inform scientists about disease issues in this species, which can inform managers about causes for population decline,” according to the update.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: In 2024, sport fishers caught a bright orange nurse shark with xanthochromism off the east coast of Costa Rica. The shark, which was ultimately released back into the Caribbean Sea, was the first known member of its species to exhibit the condition.
paras.zh: 2024年，运动垂钓者在哥斯达黎加东海岸捕获了一条患有黄变症的亮橙色护士鲨。这条鲨鱼最终被放回加勒比海，是已知首例出现这种症状的同类鲨鱼。

paras.en: Burbots, also known as ling, freshwater codfish and eelpout, are cold-adapted fish found throughout Canada, Alaska and the northern United States, living as far south as Kentucky and Missouri; they also live in northern Eurasia.
paras.zh: 黄颡鱼又称鳕鱼、淡水鳕鱼和鳗鱼，是一种适应寒冷环境的鱼类，分布于加拿大、阿拉斯加和美国北部各地，最南可至肯塔基州和密苏里州；它们也生活在欧亚大陆北部。

paras.en: They can grow to about 33 inches long and can live for more than 20 years. When they’re young, burbots mainly eat insects and other creatures without backbones. However, by the time they reach age 5 or 6, they begin to feed almost exclusively on fish, including whitefish, sculpins, lampreys and other burbot; they also sometimes eat mice or shrews.
paras.zh: 它们可以长到约33英寸长，寿命可超过20年。黄鳌在幼年时主要以昆虫和其他无脊椎动物为食。然而，当它们长到5岁或6岁时，就开始几乎只吃鱼类，包括白鱼、杜父鱼、七鳃鳗和其他黄鳌鱼；它们有时也会吃老鼠或鼩鼱。

paras.en: Burbots might not look like fearsome predators. But they’re voracious hunters that use their large mouths, strong jaws and inward-slanting teeth to chomp down on prey, feeding mostly at night.
paras.zh: 黄尾拟鳕可能看起来不像可怕的掠食者。但它们是贪婪的猎手，利用大嘴、强有力的下颚和向内倾斜的牙齿咬住猎物，主要在夜间觅食。

paras.en: They’re becoming increasingly popular among anglers, in part because when cooked and dipped in butter, burbot tastes like lobster. (One of the species’ other nicknames is “poor man’s lobster.”)
paras.zh: 它们在钓鱼者中越来越受欢迎，部分原因在于，烹煮后蘸上黄油的杜父鱼味道像龙虾。（该鱼种的另一个绰号是“穷人的龙虾”。）

paras.en: “People think they’re ugly,” Andrew Shapiro, a biologist at Michigan State University, told Fox 2 Detroit’s Jack Nissen last year. “They eat stuff that other fish don’t. They’re pretty opportunistic and will eat anything, which has a negative connotation. But that’s changing. People think they’re pretty now. … In recent years, interest in burbot angling has been exponential.”
paras.zh: “人们认为它们很丑陋，”密歇根州立大学的生物学家Andrew Shapiro去年对福克斯2底特律电视台的Jack Nissen说。“它们吃其他鱼不吃的东西。它们相当机会主义，什么都吃，这带有负面含义。但情况正在发生变化。现在人们觉得它们很漂亮。……近年来，人们对钓黄盖头的兴趣呈指数级增长。”

paras.zh: 截至撰写本文时，亚马逊、百思买、塔吉特和沃尔玛的商品折扣为 40%。这是我见过的最低价格。换句话说，如果它们在你的愿望清单上，我现在就买一双。

paras.en: The AirPods Max 2’s newer H2 chip improves active noise cancellation and transparency mode and enables a suite of intelligent features, including conversation awareness, live translation, and improved Siri interactions. The AirPods Max 2 are designed with a new high-dynamic-range amplifier for deeper bass, more natural vocals, and cleaner highs. The ear cuffs, while plush and comfortable for longer listening sessions, do trap some heat, but I have yet to find a pair of over-ear headphones that don’t.
paras.zh: AirPods Max 2 的新型 H2 芯片改进了主动降噪和透明模式，并实现了一系列智能功能，包括对话感知、实时翻译和改进的 Siri 交互。 AirPods Max 2 采用全新高动态范围放大器设计，可实现更深沉的低音、更自然的人声和更干净的高音。耳套虽然毛绒且舒适，适合长时间聆听，但确实会积聚一些热量，但我还没有找到一副这样的包耳式耳机。

paras.en: At $549, the AirPods Max 2 can be a tough sell, especially with so many excellent, more affordable alternatives on the market. But at $130 off, they’re a lot easier to justify, especially if you want the seamless integration that comes with Apple’s ecosystem.
paras.zh: AirPods Max 2的售价为549美元，可能不太好卖，特别是在市场上有很多出色且更实惠的替代产品的情况下。但如果能享受130美元的优惠，那么这款耳机就更容易让人心动了，特别是如果您想要享受Apple生态系统带来的无缝集成体验。

articles.title: Goo Goo Dolls Fans Slam NBC Over Thanksgiving Halftime Show Snub: ‘Badly Handled’
articles.author: Mitchell Peters

paras.en: Goo Goo Dolls fans are outraged after NBC cut short the band’s Thanksgiving Day halftime performance.
paras.zh: NBC 缩短了 Goo Goo Dolls 感恩节中场表演的时间，这让 Goo Goo Dolls 的粉丝们感到愤怒。

paras.en: The network is facing backlash after airing just 90 seconds of the John Rzeznik-fronted group’s nine-minute set during Thursday’s (Nov. 26) Buffalo Bills-Kansas City Chiefs game.
paras.zh: 在周四（11 月 26 日）布法罗比尔队与堪萨斯城酋长队的比赛中，约翰·雷兹尼克领衔的一组 9 分钟的节目仅播出了 90 秒，该电视网就面临强烈反对。

paras.en: The Goo Goo Dolls performed “Iris,” “Slide” and “Broadway” in the pouring rain at Highmark Stadium in Orchard Park, New York, just outside the group’s hometown of Buffalo. NBC aired only a portion of “Iris” before cutting away to an interview with NBC commentator Mike Tirico and former Pittsburgh Steelers coach Mike Tomlin about quarterback Aaron Rodgers, who had recently been released by the team.
paras.zh: Goo Goo Dolls 在倾盆大雨中在纽约果园公园的海马克体育场表演了《Iris》、《Slide》和《Broadway》，该体育场就在乐队的家乡布法罗郊外。 NBC 只播出了《Iris》的一部分，然后就剪掉了对 NBC 评论员迈克·蒂里科 (Mike Tirico) 和前匹兹堡钢人队主教练迈克·汤姆林 (Mike Tomlin) 的采访，内容涉及最近被球队释放的四分卫亚伦·罗杰斯 (Aaron Rodgers)。

paras.en: “They are a great band. That was badly handled and disrespectful,” musician and actor Stevie Van Zandt wrote on X.
paras.zh: “他们是一支伟大的乐队。但处理不当且不尊重，”音乐家兼演员史蒂维·范·赞特 (Stevie Van Zandt) 在 X 上写道。

paras.en: NBC Sports PR promoted the Tomlin interview on social media about an hour before kickoff, but many viewers weren’t happy with the network’s decision.
paras.zh: NBC体育公关在开赛前大约一个小时在社交媒体上宣传了汤姆林的采访，但许多观众对该网络的决定并不满意。

paras.en: “The fact that NBC won’t show Goo Goo Dolls in the rain in Buffalo is despicable,” one person wrote on X. Another added, “NBC only aired the last 30 seconds. Wasting time on useless clown Rodgers.”
paras.zh: “NBC 不会在布法罗的雨中播放 Goo Goo Dolls，这一事实是卑鄙的，”一位网友在 X 上写道。另一位网友补充道，“NBC 只播出了最后 30 秒。在无用的小丑罗杰斯身上浪费时间。”

paras.en: A third wrote, “No one give a f#@k about a washed up Rodgers amd the dumpster fire he has left in Pittsburgh outside of Pittsburgh. @NBCsports should be embarrassed! Every other game on the other networks showed the entirety of the halftime shows but @NBC was amateurish by showing nonsense.”
paras.zh: 第三个人写道，“没有人在意罗杰斯被冲走以及他在匹兹堡郊外的匹兹堡留下的垃圾箱火灾。@NBCsports应该感到尴尬！其他网络上的每场比赛都播放了整个中场休息节目，但@NBC却表现得很业余，胡说八道。”

paras.en: Unlike the Goo Goo Dolls, Thanksgiving’s other halftime acts — Wu-Tang Clan on CBS and Miranda Lambert on Fox — had their performances aired in full during their respective game broadcasts.
paras.zh: 与 Goo Goo Dolls 不同的是，感恩节的其他中场表演——哥伦比亚广播公司的武当派和福克斯的米兰达·兰伯特——在各自的比赛转播期间完整播出了他们的表演。

paras.en: The Goo Goo Dolls hadn’t publicly commented on the situation at press time. Billboard has reached out to the band’s representatives for comment.
paras.zh: 截至发稿时，咕咕娃娃尚未公开评论此事。 《公告牌》已联系乐队代表征求意见。

paras.en: Watch the Goo Goo Dolls’ full halftime show performance below.
paras.zh: 请观看下面 Goo Goo Dolls 的完整中场表演。

paras.en: For the gamer in your life, the SteelSeries Arctis Nova 5 Wireless Gaming Headset, which is on sale for $99.99 (was $149.99), is ideal to enhance video games with detailed sound, thanks to impressive high-fidelity audio, advanced noise-cancelation and comfy all-day fit. It comes in white and black too.
paras.zh: 对于您生活中的游戏玩家来说，SteelSeries Arctis Nova 5 无线游戏耳机售价 99.99 美元（原价 149.99 美元），凭借令人印象深刻的高保真音频、先进的降噪功能和舒适的全天佩戴，非常适合增强视频游戏的细腻声音。它也有白色和黑色两种颜色。

paras.en: For audiophiles, you can save 50% off the Technics Hi-Fi True Wireless Earbuds, which are a pair of premium earbuds that deliver reference-quality audio. These earbuds feature masterfully-crafted 10mm dynamic drivers for deep and rich sound. They’re on sale for $99.99 (was $199.99), which is the earbuds’ cheapest price ever.
paras.zh: 对于发烧友来说，购买 Technics Hi-Fi 真无线耳机可节省 50% 的费用，这是一对可提供参考品质音频的优质耳机。这些耳塞采用精心制作的 10 毫米动态驱动器，可提供深沉而丰富的声音。它们的售价为 99.99 美元（原价 199.99 美元），这是该耳机有史以来最便宜的价格。

paras.en: On sale for $119 (was $199.99), which is the all-time lowest price ever, the Sony PULSE Explore Wireless Earbuds are a pair of true wireless earbuds specifically designed for the PS5, PS5 Pro and PS5 Portal. These accessories offer excellent gaming audio that’s crisp, full and immersive with deep and rumbling bass. It comes with a USB dongle that plugs directly into the back of the console to provide a low latency wireless audio connection with practically zero lag.
paras.zh: 索尼 PULSE Explore 无线耳机售价 119 美元（原价 199.99 美元），是有史以来的最低价格，是一对专为 PS5、PS5 Pro 和 PS5 Portal 设计的真正无线耳机。这些配件提供出色的游戏音频，清晰、饱满、身临其境，低音深沉而隆隆。它配备了一个 USB 适配器，可直接插入控制台背面，以提供几乎零延迟的低延迟无线音频连接。

paras.en: Starting at $129.97 (was $249), the Bowers & Wilkins Pi6 Wireless Earbuds look great with a sharp design and comfortable fit that come in four colors: storm grey (pictured above), forest green, cloud grey and glacier blue. The earbuds have a great level of performance with detailed and rich sound, and deep and rumbling bass. They perform very well with phone calls too.
paras.zh: Bowers & Wilkins Pi6 无线耳机起价 129.97 美元（原价 249 美元），外观精美，设计时尚，佩戴舒适，有四种颜色：风暴灰（如上图所示）、森林绿、云灰和冰川蓝。该耳塞具有出色的性能，声音细腻丰富，低音深沉而隆隆。他们在打电话方面也表现得很好。

paras.en: The Sony SS-CS5M2 Hi-Res Bookshelf Speakers, which are on sale for $153 (was $279.99), are an all-around three-way and three-driver system pair that feature high-resolution audio. It’s best for AV receivers and turntables. At 45% off, this is the cheapest price we’ve ever seen on this speaker pair.
paras.zh: 索尼 SS-CS5M2 高分辨率书架扬声器售价 153 美元（原价 279.99 美元），是一对全能三路三驱动器系统，具有高分辨率音频。最适合 AV 接收器和转盘。 45% 折扣，这是我们在这对扬声器上见过的最便宜的价格。

paras.en: Sony has raised the noise-cancelation game with the WF-1000XM5 Wireless Earbuds, which are on sale for $179.99 (was $329.99) on Amazon — the all-time lowest price ever. They feature adaptive audio controls to deliver an intimate listening experience with up to 24 hours of battery life when used with their charging case. The earbuds even support high-res audio listening.
paras.zh: 索尼通过 WF-1000XM5 无线耳机提升了降噪能力，该耳机在亚马逊上的售价为 179.99 美元（原价 329.99 美元），这是有史以来的最低价格。它们具有自适应音频控制功能，可提供亲密的聆听体验，与充电盒一起使用时电池续航时间长达 24 小时。耳塞甚至支持高分辨率音频收听。

paras.en: Marked down to $199 (was $359) and the lowest price on this model on Amazon, the Bose QuietComfort Headphones (second generation) are new for 2026 with premium audio, world-class noise cancelation and a comfortable fit. They are even stylish with three colors on sale for Black Friday, including hazelnut taupe (pictured above), dewdrop mint and eucalyptus green.
paras.zh: Bose QuietComfort 耳机（第二代）是 2026 年的新品，售价降至 199 美元（原价 359 美元），是亚马逊上该型号的最低价格，具有优质音频、世界一流的降噪功能和舒适的佩戴体验。它们甚至还为黑色星期五推出了三种时尚颜色，包括榛子灰褐色（如上图）、露珠薄荷色和桉树绿。

paras.en: The Bang & Olufsen Beosound Explore is a tough and durable Bluetooth speaker, while it pumps out rich, robust and crystal clear audio. It comes in five colors, including bonfire orange (pictured above), black anthracite, green and grey mist. The wireless speaker is on sale for $225 (was $199).
paras.zh: Bang & Olufsen Beosound Explore 是一款坚固耐用的蓝牙扬声器，同时可输出丰富、强劲且清晰的音频。它有五种颜色，包括篝火橙（如上图）、无烟煤黑色、绿色和雾灰色。该无线扬声器售价 225 美元（原价 199 美元）。

paras.en: On sale for $238 (was $398), the Sony PS-LX3BT Wireless Bluetooth Turntable features a sleek and minimalist design that runs quiet, but produces audio that’s rich and detailed. It’s built to last, thanks to premium components, like an aluminum die-cast platter and vibration-dampening isolation feet. It’s refreshingly simple, the design looks great in any space. At 40% off the list price, this is the cheapest price we’ve ever seen on this turntable model.
paras.zh: 索尼 PS-LX3BT 无线蓝牙转盘售价 238 美元（原价 398 美元），采用时尚简约的设计，运行安静，但可产生丰富而细致的音频。它采用优质组件，如铝压铸盘和减震隔离脚，经久耐用。它非常简单，设计在任何空间看起来都很棒。比标价低 40%，这是我们在该转盘型号上见过的最便宜的价格。

paras.en: The Samsung Music Frame, which is on sale for $247.99 (was $397.99) on Amazon, makes home audio look as good and premium as it sounds. It’s designed to seamlessly blend into home decor, while the speaker contains two woofers, two tweeters and two midrange drivers that creates a depth of sound, especially for medium- and larger-sized rooms. It can also be used as a stylish picture frame too.
paras.zh: 三星 Music Frame 在亚马逊上的售价为 247.99 美元（原价 397.99 美元），它让家庭音响看起来和听起来一样优质。它的设计旨在无缝融入家居装饰，而扬声器包含两个低音扬声器、两个高音扬声器和两个中音驱动器，可创造出深沉的声音，特别适合中型和大型房间。它也可以用作时尚的相框。

paras.en: For a sleek and compact design, the Sonos Beam is specifically made to amplify dialogue with crystal clear and robust audio. It has sleek curves with multiple speakers on all sides to give it a unique and fresh look, while ensuring sound reverberates throughout the listening space, thanks to Dolby Atmos. It’s on sale for $339 (was $499) on Amazon and the lowest price ever on this soundbar. It’s best for friends and family who love home entertainment.
paras.zh: Sonos Beam 设计时尚紧凑，专为放大对话而设计，具有清晰、强劲的音频。它拥有圆滑的曲线，两侧均配有多个扬声器，赋予其独特而清新的外观，同时借助杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 技术确保声音在整个聆听空间中回响。它在亚马逊上的售价为 339 美元（原价 499 美元），是该条形音箱有史以来的最低价格。它最适合喜欢家庭娱乐的朋友和家人。

paras.en: And since these Black Friday deals are from Amazon, you’ll get it shipped to you for free, if you’re a Prime member. Otherwise, your cart has to be more than $35 to get free shipping.
paras.zh: 由于这些黑色星期五优惠来自亚马逊，如果您是 Prime 会员，您将可以免费送货。否则，您的购物车必须超过 35 美元才能享受免费送货。

paras.en: Meanwhile, last-minute shopping can be frustrating for the holidays, but it helps to have a plan in place. When shopping online, you’ll want to factor in shipping deadlines so that your gift gets delivered in time. The holidays fall on Dec. 25, so it’s best to get your gifts shipped as soon as possible, or at least by Dec. 16-17, which is the delivery deadline for most online retailers.
paras.zh: 与此同时，假期里最后一刻的购物可能会令人沮丧，但制定一个适当的计划会有所帮助。在线购物时，您需要考虑发货期限，以便您的礼物能够及时送达。 12 月 25 日是假期，因此最好尽快寄出您的礼物，或者至少在 12 月 16 日至 17 日之前寄出，这是大多数在线零售商的寄送截止日期。

paras.en: If you’re looking for more deals, check out Shop Billboard’s list of the best Black Friday deals from across the internet here.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻找更多优惠，请在此处查看 Shop Billboard 的互联网上最佳黑色星期五优惠列表。

paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: Afterward the free trial is finished, Prime Video (as a standalone service) starts at $8.99 per month with an ad-supported plan, while Amazon Prime starts at $14.99 per month, or $139 per year. Learn more about Amazon Prime and its benefits here.
paras.zh: 免费试用结束后，Prime Video（作为独立服务）起价为每月 8.99 美元，包含广告支持计划，而 Amazon Prime 起价为每月 14.99 美元，或每年 139 美元。在此了解有关 Amazon Prime 及其优势的更多信息。

paras.en: FOX One has a great selection of networks, such as FOX, FOX Sports, FS2, FOX News, FOX Business, FOX Nation, FOX Weather, FOX Deportes, Big Ten Network, TMZ and your local FOX broadcasting affiliate.
paras.zh: FOX One 拥有众多网络可供选择，例如 FOX、FOX Sports、FS2、FOX News、FOX Business、FOX Nation、FOX Weather、FOX Deportes、Big Ten Network、TMZ 和您当地的 FOX 广播附属机构。

paras.en: The streaming service includes access to programming, like Hell’s Kitchen, DOC, Best Medicine, Fear Factor: House of Fear, Family Guy, Animal Control, Going Dutch, Crime Stories with Nancy Grace and much more. Additionally, the streaming service has hot music programming, including The Masked Singer, Name That Tune, Beat Shazam, All-American Summer Concert Series and many others. You’ll also get access to live sports from NFL, NCAA College Football, NASCAR, MLB, UFL, CONCACAF Nations League and others.
paras.zh: 该流媒体服务包括观看节目，如《地狱厨房》、《DOC》、《最佳医学》、《恐惧因素：恐惧屋》、《恶搞之家》、《动物控制》、《荷兰人》、《南希·格雷斯犯罪故事》等等。此外，该流媒体服务还提供热门音乐节目，包括《蒙面歌手》、《Name That Tune》、《Beat Shazam》、《全美夏季音乐会系列》等。您还可以观看 NFL、NCAA 大学橄榄球、NASCAR、MLB、UFL、CONCACAF 国家联盟等赛事的现场体育赛事。

paras.en: For Black Friday, you can get FOX One on sale for $4.99 per month (was $19.99 per month) for the first month of service, a 75% savings, on Prime Video.
paras.zh: 黑色星期五期间，您可以在 Prime Video 上以每月 4.99 美元的价格购买 FOX One（原价为每月 19.99 美元），第一个月的服务价格可节省 75%。

articles.title: Black Friday 2026: The 50 Best Sales From Streaming to Designer Fashion
articles.author: Erin Lassner

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.

paras.en: From Parke’s sitewide sale to over half off the Disney+, Hulu Bundle, some of the steepest savings of the year have arrived for Black Friday 2026.
paras.zh: 从 Parke 的全场促销到 Disney+、Hulu 捆绑包的一半以上折扣，今年最优惠的一些活动已在 2026 年黑色星期五到来。

paras.en: To narrow down the madness, The Hollywood Reporter‘s shopping editors have curated the crème de la crème of online sales, listed in alphabetical order within each main category: streaming, fashion, beauty, home, lifestyle, travel and major retailers. Stay tuned as THR will update this roundup as new and list-worthy Cyber Week promos are announced.
paras.zh: 为了缩小疯狂范围，《好莱坞报道》的购物编辑精心策划了网上销售的精英，按字母顺序列出了每个主要类别：流媒体、时尚、美容、家居、生活方式、旅游和主要零售商。请继续关注，THR 将随着新的、值得上榜的网络周促销活动的发布而更新本综述。

paras.en: Apple TV: Take 53% off for six months ($6.99/mo $14.99/mo).
paras.zh: Apple TV：六个月内享受 53% 折扣（每月 6.99 美元，每月 14.99 美元）。

paras.zh: Audible：三个月内享受 89% 折扣（$0.99/月 $8.99/月）并获得 20 美元奖金。

paras.zh: DirecTV：前两个月可享受 45-55 美元优惠（总计 90-110 美元），另加两个月免费 Peacock 和一个月免费 NFL RedZone（以及标准的五天免费试用）。

paras.zh: Disney+、Hulu 捆绑包：12 个月内享受 62% 折扣（4.99 美元/月 12.99 美元/月）。

Fubo: Get $30 off your first month following the standard free trial.

paras.zh: HBO Max：12 个月内享受 50% 折扣（每月 5.49 美元，每月 10.99 美元）。

paras.zh: Paramount+：享受两个月 79% 的折扣（2.99 美元/月 13.99 美元/月）。

paras.zh: Peacock：三个月内可享受高达 66% 的折扣（$2.99/月 $8.99/月）。

paras.zh: Prime Video：节省数十种 Prime Video 附加订阅费用（Britbox、MGM+、AMC+ 等）。

paras.en: Proton VPN: Secure 75% off for 24 months (2.49/mo $9.99/mo).
paras.zh: Proton VPN：24 个月内享受 75% 折扣（2.49/月 9.99 美元/月）。

paras.en: Starz: Get 83% off for 12 months ($11.99/yr $69.99/yr).
paras.zh: Starz：12 个月内享受 83% 折扣（11.99 美元/年 69.99 美元/年）。

paras.en: Abercrombie & Fitch: Take 25-50% off everything.
paras.zh: Abercrombie & Fitch：所有商品均可享受 25-50% 的折扣。

paras.en: Anthropologie: Take 40% off the retailer’s most-loved styles and 30% off nearly everything else, plus an extra 50% off its sale section.
paras.zh: Anthropologie：零售商最受欢迎的款式可享受 40% 的折扣，几乎所有其他商品可享受 30% 的折扣，再加上促销部分额外享受 50% 的折扣。

paras.zh: Béis：Shay Mitchell 旗下的旅行品牌正在全场促销 25%，部分款式最高可享受 50% 的折扣。

paras.zh: Bloomingdale's：每个类别均可享受 25-65% 的折扣。

paras.zh: Brooklinen：享受全场 25% 的折扣，以及床上用品和浴室套装高达 50% 的折扣。

paras.en: Crate & Barrel: Shop the retailer’s biggest sale of the year for up to 50% off plus free shipping.
paras.zh: Crate & Barrel：购买该零售商今年最大的促销活动，最高可享受 50% 的折扣，并免运费。

paras.en: CB2: Enjoy up to 60% off plus free shipping on orders $99-plus.
paras.zh: CB2：订单满 99 美元可享受高达 60% 的折扣，并免运费。

paras.en: Coach: Take up to 50% off Coach’s most popular bags, shoes, jewelry and clothing.
paras.zh: Coach：Coach 最受欢迎的包袋、鞋子、珠宝和服装可享受高达 50% 的折扣。

paras.zh: Coach Outlet：在 Coach Outlet 已打折的服装和配饰上可享受额外 25% 的折扣。

paras.en: Fleur du Mal: Take an extra 20% off sale and select full-price styles with discount code GIVEITTOME20.
paras.zh: Fleur du Mal：使用折扣码 GIVEITTOME20 享受额外 20% 折扣并选择全价款式。

paras.zh: Lola 毛毯：使用促销代码 BF50 即可享受好莱坞最受欢迎的毛毯品牌 50% 的折扣。

paras.zh: Macy's：截至 11 月 28 日星期六，每个类别最高可享受 70% 的折扣

paras.zh: Neiman Marcus：奢侈品百货公司提供三种省钱方式。首先，使用代码 THANKFUL 即可享受正价购买最高 1,500 美元的优惠。其次，在已经降价的情况下再享受 25% 的折扣，可节省 70% 以上。第三，设计师款式可享受高达 60% 的折扣。

paras.zh: Nordstrom：截至 12 月 1 日星期二，部分款式可享受高达 60% 的折扣。

paras.zh: 开：上一季最畅销款式最高可享受 40% 的折扣。

paras.en: Oura: Take $100 off the newer, thinner Oura Ring 5.
paras.zh: Oura：更新、更薄的 Oura Ring 5 立减 100 美元。

paras.zh: Parke：所有商品均可享受 20% 折扣，包括 Parke 标志性的 Varsity Mockneck，并且所有美国订单均免运费。

paras.en: Quince: Shop Quince’s Black Friday Sale for new deals every day.
paras.zh: Quince：购买 Quince 的黑色星期五特卖，每天都有新优惠。

paras.en: Reformation: Take 25% off sitewide during one of Ref’s rare annual sales.
paras.zh: 改革：在 Ref 罕见的年度销售活动之一期间，全场享受 25% 的折扣。

paras.en: Saks Fifth Avenue: Spend just $150 to receive a $75 gift card with code BFGIFT. Plus, take an additional 25% off already reduced prices for savings of over 70% and get 15-30% off beauty and fragrance.

articles.title: Ben Stiller Says Ariana Grande Exceeded His Expectations in ‘Focker-in-Law,’ Would Do a Fifth ‘Meet the Parents’ Film
articles.author: Lexi Carson

paras.en: Ariana Grande was the newest addition to the Focker family this Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 阿丽亚娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 是今年感恩节福克家族的最新成员。

paras.en: Following a 16-year gap since the last film in the Meet the Parents franchise, Little Fockers, hit theaters, a fourth installment, Focker-in-Law, was released this week by Universal and Paramount Pictures. Grande stars as Olivia, a former FBI hostage negotiator who accompanies her boyfriend Henry Focker (Skyler Gisondo), the son of Greg Focker (Ben Stiller), to a family reunion celebrating his grandfather Jack’s (Robert De Niro) 80th birthday.
paras.zh: 继《拜见父母》系列的上一部电影《小福克》上映后，时隔 16 年，环球影业和派拉蒙影业于本周发行了第四部《福克》。格兰德饰演前联邦调查局人质谈判代表奥利维亚，她陪同男友格雷格·福克（本·斯蒂勒饰）的儿子亨利·福克（斯凯勒·吉桑多饰）参加家庭聚会，庆祝祖父杰克（罗伯特·德尼罗饰）80岁生日。

paras.en: Grande’s performance has received raves, including from The Hollywood Reporter, where critic Frank Scheck called her “the best thing in the film, going toe-to-toe with her more cinematically experienced co-stars and displaying both formidable steeliness and deadpan comic skills.” Stiller, who shares multiple scenes with Grande as his character attempts to sabotage Henry’s proposal to Olivia throughout the film, wasn’t surprised by the Grammy winner’s acting chops.
paras.zh: 格兰德的表演受到了好评，包括《好莱坞报道》，影评人弗兰克·谢克称她为“电影中最好的部分，与更有电影经验的搭档正面交锋，展现了令人敬畏的钢铁般的毅力和面无表情的喜剧技巧。”斯蒂勒在整部电影中与格兰德分享了多个场景，因为他的角色试图破坏亨利向奥利维亚求婚，他对这位格莱美奖得主的演技并不感到惊讶。

paras.en: “I thought she was incredible in Wicked. I was pleasantly surprised by how incredible an actor she is to work with, and I wasn’t not expecting that, but she really surpassed all my expectations in terms of her sense of timing, her character and being able to pull off a character like this. It’s very specific,” he told THR of Grande, who’s returned to acting, alongside her music career in recent years, earning an Oscar nomination for best supporting actress at the 97th Academy Awards for Wicked. “She was great to work with and she’s just a really nice person and fun to hang out with.”
paras.zh: “我觉得她在《魔法坏女巫》中的表现非常出色。我对与她合作的演员如此出色感到惊喜，我并没有想到这一点，但她在时机感、性格以及能够演绎出这样的角色方面确实超出了我的所有预期。这是非常具体的，”他告诉 THR 格兰德。近年来，格兰德在音乐事业的同时又重返演艺圈，并凭借《魔法坏女巫》获得第 97 届奥斯卡金像奖最佳女配角奖提名。 “和她一起工作很棒，她是一个非常好的人，和她一起出去玩很有趣。”

paras.en: Stiller also recalled one scene that put him in an interesting position: performing in front of the pop star. One of Greg’s attempts to stop Henry from proposing comes when he serenades his father-in-law, Jack, in front of the whole family, singing John Legend’s “All of Me” — the song Henry intended to sing to Olivia before popping the question.
paras.zh: 斯蒂勒还回忆起一个让他处于一个有趣的境地的场景：在流行歌星面前表演。格雷格试图阻止亨利求婚的其中一个尝试是，他在全家人面前为他的岳父杰克唱小夜曲，唱约翰·传奇的《我的全部》——这首歌是亨利在求婚之前打算唱给奥利维亚听的。

paras.en: “She was on set watching the whole time and she was incredibly generous and sweet and very supportive. I knew if I tried my best, it probably would be good enough for the movie,” Stiller said with a laugh. “But it was interesting because I had to do it a lot in front of her. It was an interesting day.”
paras.zh: “她一直在片场观看，她非常慷慨、可爱，而且非常支持我。我知道如果我尽力而为，这对这部电影来说可能就足够了，”斯蒂勒笑着说。 “但这很有趣，因为我必须在她面前做很多事情。这是有趣的一天。”

paras.en: Beanie Feldstein, who plays Henry’s sister Samantha, also had high praise for Grande. “Ari is the most incredible person on planet Earth. I love her more than life itself, and she’s a tour de force in this movie,” she said.
paras.zh: 饰演亨利妹妹萨曼莎的比妮·费尔德斯坦也对格兰德给予了很高的评价。 “阿里是地球上最不可思议的人。我爱她胜过爱生命本身，她是这部电影中的杰作，”她说。

paras.en: As the Fockerverse has spanned 26 years, Stiller isn’t convinced that John Hamburg’s Focker-in-Law will be the end of the franchise, though he’s leaving that decision up to audiences. “I think if the audience wants one, there is probably another story there,” he said.
paras.zh: 由于《福克宇宙》已经跨越了 26 年，斯蒂勒并不相信约翰·汉堡的《福克岳父》将成为该系列的终结，尽管他将这一决定留给了观众。 “我认为如果观众想要一个，那里可能还有另一个故事，”他说。

paras.en: And it were up to Stiller? “I would do it for sure,” he quipped.
paras.zh: 这取决于斯蒂勒？ “我肯定会这么做，”他打趣道。

paras.en: Focker-in-Law is now playing in theaters.
paras.zh: 《Focker-in-Law》现在正在剧院上映。

articles.title: Budget airline Norse Atlantic files for bankruptcy in Europe after failing to secure funding

paras.en: Budget carrier Norse Atlantic filed for bankruptcy Friday, saying it failed to secure funding after soaring fuel costs strained the company's operations throughout the year.
paras.zh: 廉价航空公司挪威大西洋航空公司周五申请破产，称由于燃料成本飙升导致该公司全年运营紧张，该公司未能获得融资。

paras.en: Its parent company, Norse Atlantic ASA, concluded that the Norwegian carrier no longer has a basis to continue operations.
paras.zh: 其母公司 Norse Atlantic ASA 得出的结论是，这家挪威航空公司不再具备继续运营的基础。

paras.en: "Despite extensive efforts, the Company has so far not been able to secure sufficient funding to meet its short-term liquidity needs," the firm said in a statement Friday.
paras.zh: 该公司在周五的一份声明中表示：“尽管做出了广泛的努力，但该公司迄今为止仍无法获得足够的资金来满足其短期流动性需求。”

paras.en: It comes days after Norse said it's facing a "critical financial situation" and was considering its options from a strategic takeover to ACMI contracts, which refer to short-term capacity leasing. The company's shares closed 85% lower on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 几天前，Norse 表示其面临“严峻的财务状况”，并正在考虑从战略收购到 ACMI 合同（指短期产能租赁）的选择。该公司股价周三收盘下跌 85%。

paras.en: The board has now filed a bankruptcy petition with the Agder District Court, where a trustee will be appointed to manage the process further.
paras.zh: 该董事会现已向阿格德尔地方法院提交破产申请，该法院将任命一名受托人进一步管理该流程。

paras.en: "The Board of Norse Atlantic Airways AS has made the difficult decision to file for bankruptcy despite extensive efforts from the Company and the Group to find a solution," Norse Atlantic CEO Eivind Roald said.
paras.zh: Norse Atlantic 首席执行官 Eivind Roald 表示：“尽管公司和集团为寻找解决方案付出了巨大努力，但 Norse Atlantic Airways AS 董事会还是做出了申请破产的艰难决定。”

paras.en: "We are deeply sorry for the impact this has on our passengers, employees and partners. The Board, management and advisers of the listed entity Norse Atlantic ASA and the UK subsidiary are working to find a solution for the remaining part of the business to continue operations," Roald added.
paras.zh: “我们对这对我们的乘客、员工和合作伙伴造成的影响深表歉意。上市实体 Norse Atlantic ASA 和英国子公司的董事会、管理层和顾问正在努力寻找解决方案，让剩余部分的业务继续运​​营，”罗尔德补充道。

paras.en: The company has canceled all flights, and ticket sales have been discontinued.
paras.zh: 该公司已取消所有航班，并停止售票。

paras.en: Norse was founded in March 2021 and offered cheap flights between Europe, North America, Africa and Asia.
paras.zh: Norse 成立于 2021 年 3 月，提供欧洲、北美、非洲和亚洲之间的廉价航班。

paras.en: The Iran war began on Feb. 28 and caused jet fuel prices to skyrocket, forcing airlines around the world to grapple with higher costs. Prices are now up nearly 72% to $155 per barrel year-on-year as of the week ending Nov. 20, according to the International Air Transport Association's Jet Fuel Price Monitor.
paras.zh: 2月28日爆发的伊朗战争导致航空燃油价格飙升，迫使世界各地的航空公司应对成本上升的问题。根据国际航空运输协会的航空燃油价格监测，截至 11 月 20 日当周，油价目前已同比上涨近 72%，达到每桶 155 美元。

paras.en: Norse Atlantic's Roald told CNBC in May that he wasn't "overly concerned" about access to fuel but flagged that the company had canceled over 700 flights, which impacted more than 240,000 passengers.
paras.zh: Norse Atlantic 的 Roald 今年 5 月向 CNBC 表示，他并不“过度担心”燃油供应问题，但表示该公司已经取消了 700 多个航班，影响了超过 24 万名乘客。

paras.en: Ryanair's CEO Michael O'Leary warned in April that if jet fuel prices continued to stay elevated throughout the year, then other European airlines were likely to face "financial difficulties" during the winter season.
paras.zh: 瑞安航空首席执行官迈克尔·奥利里（Michael O'Leary）四月份警告说，如果航空燃油价格全年继续保持高位，那么其他欧洲航空公司可能会在冬季面临“财务困难”。

paras.en: In fact, several European airlines have stopped operating this winter, including Slovakia's AirExplore, Spain's AlbaStar, Ireland's Fly4 and Spain's Plus Ultra, which has canceled all flights but hasn't permanently closed.
paras.zh: 事实上，多家欧洲航空公司今年冬天已经停止运营，包括斯洛伐克的AirExplore、西班牙的AlbaStar、爱尔兰的Fly4和西班牙的Plus Ultra，后者取消了所有航班，但并未永久关闭。

articles.title: Hackers breach U.S. Air Force flagship Cloud One computing platform

paras.en: Hackers have breached the U.S. Air Force's flagship cloud computing platform, three people familiar with the matter told Reuters, in a development that could jeopardize a vast swathe of sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data.
paras.zh: 三名知情人士告诉路透社，黑客已经攻破了美国空军的旗舰云计算平台，这一进展可能会危及大量敏感的战术、人员和后勤数据。

paras.en: The intrusion at Cloud One was discovered within the past month or so during work to upgrade the system, two of the people said, adding that the discovery has led to disruption across the platform. Reuters could not establish the identity of the hackers, the full scope of the intrusion or whether any data had been stolen.
paras.zh: 两名知情人士表示，Cloud One 的入侵是在过去一个月左右的系统升级工作中发现的，并补充说这一发现导致了整个平台的中断。路透社无法确定黑客的身份、入侵的全部范围或是否有任何数据被盗。

paras.en: In a statement to Reuters, the Air Force said it "does not comment on the security posture, vulnerabilities or operational status of specific networks and systems. We continuously take prudent measures to protect Department (of the Air Force) information, systems and mission capabilities."
paras.zh: 美国空军在给路透社的一份声明中表示，“不会对特定网络和系统的安全态势、漏洞或运行状态发表评论。我们不断采取审慎措施来保护（空军）部门的信息、系统和任务能力。”

paras.en: Initiated in 2017, Cloud One was meant to serve as a one-stop shop for the Air Force's IT needs, combining the resources of four operators — Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle and Alphabet — to power scores of applications including ones that manage personnel data and pay or logistics and maintenance.
paras.zh: Cloud One 于 2017 年启动，旨在成为满足空军 IT 需求的一站式商店，结合了微软、亚马逊、甲骨文和 Alphabet 四大运营商的资源，为数十种应用程序提供支持，包括管理人员数据和薪酬或后勤和维护的应用程序。

paras.en: Among them are the Air Force's Cloud-Based Command and Control, which collates air defense radar and other data feeds from across North America, and the Theater Integrated Combat Munitions System, which tracks bombs and missiles across more than 200 US Air Force locations around the world.
paras.zh: 其中包括空军的基于云的指挥与控制系统，该系统会整理来自北美各地的防空雷达和其他数据源，以及战区综合作战弹药系统，该系统会跟踪全球 200 多个美国空军基地的炸弹和导弹。

paras.en: SAIC was the prime contractor for Cloud One until 2026, when Leidos took over. SAIC did not respond to a request seeking comment. Leidos referred questions to the Air Force.
paras.zh: SAIC 一直是 Cloud One 的主承包商，直到 2026 年 Leidos 接手。国家工商总局没有回应置评请求。莱多斯将问题转交给空军。

paras.en: Cloud One is among the US military's biggest cloud platforms, according to two of the sources.
paras.zh: 据两位消息人士称，Cloud One 是美国军方最大的云平台之一。

paras.en: "A breach here is a big deal," one of the sources said.
paras.zh: “这里的违规行为是一件大事，”一位消息人士说。

paras.en: Investigators have called in Cyber Command, the US military's cyber force, to assess the damage, one of the sources said.
paras.zh: 其中一位消息人士称，调查人员已召集美国军方网络部队网络司令部来评估损失。

paras.en: Cyber Command did not respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 网络司令部没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: The discovery of the hack led to a range of disruption. Two of the sources, along with a fourth person familiar with the matter, said that efforts to migrate back-office applications to Cloud One, a longstanding military priority, have been paused.
paras.zh: 黑客事件的发现导致了一系列的破坏。其中两名消息人士和第四名知情人士表示，将后台应用程序迁移到云一的努力已经暂停，这是一项长期的军事优先事项。

paras.en: Updates to applications already running on Cloud One were blocked, leaving Air Force personnel unable to apply fixes just as a new batch of serious software vulnerabilities has been disclosed across the technology industry. A fifth source said that some users had their administrator rights revoked.
paras.zh: 就在科技行业披露了新一批严重软件漏洞之际，云一号上已经运行的应用程序的更新被阻止，导致空军人员无法应用修复程序。第五位消息人士称，一些用户的管理员权限被撤销。

paras.en: All five sources spoke on condition of anonymity.
paras.zh: 所有五位消息人士均要求匿名。

paras.en: One source said that the cyber intruders exploited a software vulnerability to reach the control plane. That person likened the control plane to a universal remote, as intruders in theory could leverage their access to check the operational status of military aircraft or the movement of spare parts, though it was unclear whether the hackers did so in this case.
paras.zh: 一位消息人士称，网络入侵者利用软件漏洞到达控制平面。该人士将控制飞机比作通用遥控器，因为理论上入侵者可以利用其访问权限来检查军用飞机的运行状态或备件的移动情况，尽管目前尚不清楚黑客在这种情况下是否这样做。

paras.en: Reuters could not identify the specific vulnerability exploited by the hackers.
paras.zh: 路透社无法识别黑客利用的具体漏洞。

paras.en: News of the breach comes amid heightened anxiety over AI-powered intrusions, a particularly serious problem for cloud-based networks because of the ability of AI models to swiftly detect weaknesses across wide surface areas.
paras.zh: 此次泄露的消息传出之际，人们对人工智能入侵的担忧加剧，这对于基于云的网络来说是一个特别严重的问题，因为人工智能模型能够快速检测广泛表面区域的弱点。

paras.en: The US government already has been dealing with the fallout from at least six other recently disclosed cyber incidents, including two at the FBI, a previous hack of Pentagon data, a recent leak of Department of Homeland Security personnel information, a breach affecting at least two spy agencies and a hack at the Treasury Department.
paras.zh: 美国政府已经在处理至少另外六起最近披露的网络事件的后果，其中包括联邦调查局的两起、之前五角大楼数据遭到黑客攻击、最近国土安全部人员信息泄露、影响至少两个间谍机构的一次泄露事件以及财政部遭受的一次黑客攻击。

paras.en: Cloud One has long been in the crosshairs of hackers.
paras.zh: Cloud One 长期以来一直是黑客的攻击目标。

paras.en: In a 2023 commentary carried by the online publication FedScoop, Cloud One's leadership touted what they called a "100% success rate" in beating back what they said was a "staggering" number of attempts to penetrate the platform.
paras.zh: 在在线出版物 FedScoop 发表的 2023 年评论中，Cloud One 的领导层吹捧他们所谓的“100% 成功率”，击退了他们所说的“数量惊人”的渗透该平台的尝试。

paras.en: "There is no room for error when it comes to security," Cloud One's leadership wrote.
paras.zh: Cloud One 的领导层写道：“在安全方面没有犯错的余地。”

paras.en: Correction: Reuters corrected this story to fix the year until which SAIC was the prime contractor for Cloud One.
paras.zh: 更正：路透社更正了这篇报道，以修正上汽集团作为 Cloud One 的主承包商的年份。

articles.title: OpenAI countersues Apple for stealing trade secrets

paras.en: OpenAI sued Apple on Friday, accusing the Big Tech giant of stealing its trade secrets and discouraging hardware suppliers from working on future OpenAI devices, after Apple sued OpenAI for allegedly poaching its employees to gain access to its technology.
paras.zh: 周五，OpenAI 起诉苹果，指控这家科技巨头窃取其商业机密，并阻止硬件供应商开发未来的 OpenAI 设备，此前苹果起诉 OpenAI 涉嫌挖走其员工以获得其技术。

paras.en: The ChatGPT maker filed counterclaims in California federal court on Friday, saying that Apple's employment practices were designed to "trap" employees and prevent them from working on competitors' technology.
paras.zh: ChatGPT 制造商周五向加州联邦法院提起反诉，称苹果的雇佣做法旨在“困住”员工，阻止他们从事竞争对手的技术工作。

paras.en: OpenAI is developing AI-enabled personal electronic devices that threaten to "outcompete Apple on what Apple views as its own turf," the company said in its Friday court filing.
paras.zh: 该公司在周五提交给法庭的文件中表示，OpenAI 正在开发支持人工智能的个人电子设备，这些设备有可能“在苹果视为自己的地盘上击败苹果”。

paras.en: OpenAI said in the filing that Apple gained confidential information by re-hiring a former employee who worked at OpenAI for six months. In that time, the employee gained access to specific information on a new device as well as OpenAI's roadmap for future hardware products.
paras.zh: OpenAI 在文件中表示，苹果通过重新雇用一名在 OpenAI 工作了六个月的前员工来获取机密信息。在此期间，该员工获得了有关新设备的具体信息以及 OpenAI 未来硬件产品的路线图。

paras.en: "Given the timing, it now appears that stealing those documents may have been his reason for joining OpenAI in the first place," OpenAI said.
paras.zh: OpenAI 表示：“鉴于时机，现在看来窃取这些文件可能是他加入 OpenAI 的首要原因。”

paras.en: Apple and OpenAI did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment.
paras.zh: 苹果和 OpenAI 没有立即回应路透社的置评请求。

paras.en: Tensions between the two tech companies have escalated as the intensifying race to develop AI products fuels competition for talent and proprietary technology.
paras.zh: 随着开发人工智能产品的激烈竞争加剧了人才和专有技术的竞争，两家科技公司之间的紧张关系不断升级。

paras.en: Earlier this year, Apple sued OpenAI and former Apple employees Tang Tan and Chang Liu in July, alleging misappropriation of its trade secrets to benefit the ChatGPT owner's foray into consumer hardware. Tan, a 24-year Apple employee who was a vice president of product design for iPhone and Apple Watch, was part of the group that launched io Products before it was acquired by OpenAI in 2025.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，苹果公司于 7 月起诉 OpenAI 以及前苹果员工 Tang Tan 和 Chang Liu，指控其盗用其商业机密，以利于 ChatGPT 所有者进军消费硬件领域。 Tan 是一名在 Apple 工作了 24 年的员工，曾担任 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 产品设计副总裁，是 io Products 推出团队的一员，该团队于 2025 年被 OpenAI 收购。

paras.en: OpenAI and the employees have denied those allegations, and said that Apple's lawsuit depended on its unauthorized monitoring of Liu's personal messages after he stopped working for Apple. Attorneys for Tan and Liu did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: OpenAI 和员工否认了这些指控，并表示苹果的诉讼是因为在刘停止为苹果工作后，苹果对他的个人信息进行了未经授权的监控。谭和刘的律师没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: In Friday's filing, OpenAI criticized Apple for encouraging employees to do work on their personal Apple devices and accounts, then preventing those employees from an orderly separation of work and personal accounts when they leave for new jobs.
paras.zh: 在周五提交的文件中，OpenAI 批评苹果公司鼓励员工在个人苹果设备和账户上工作，然后阻止这些员工在离开新工作岗位时有序分离工作和个人账户。

paras.en: OpenAI said that Apple continues to access former employees' personal devices and accounts after they leave the company, enabling Apple to "monitor and ensnare departing employees" when they leave for competitors.
paras.zh: OpenAI 表示，苹果在前员工离开公司后继续访问他们的个人设备和账户，这使得苹果能够在离职员工跳槽到竞争对手时“监控和诱骗”他们。

paras.en: OpenAI said that 400 employees have left Apple for OpenAI so far, and Apple wants to intimidate other employees from leaving to find other tech companies.
paras.zh: OpenAI表示，到目前为止已有400名员工离开苹果加入OpenAI，苹果希望恐吓其他员工离开苹果去寻找其他科技公司。

articles.title: Lightning strikes could more than double by 2100 thanks to climate change

paras.en: Lightning strikes could soon become so commonplace that we’ll need a new metaphor for rarity. In a new study published in Earth’s Future on Tuesday, researchers find “cloud-to-ground” lightning strikes—bolts that hit Earth’s surface—could more than double by 2100 compared with historical levels. And the reason is our warming world.
paras.zh: 闪电袭击可能很快就会变得如此普遍，以至于我们需要一个新的比喻来形容稀有性。在周二《地球未来》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，研究人员发现，到 2100 年，“云对地”雷击（击中地球表面的闪电）可能比历史水平增加一倍以上。原因是我们的世界正在变暖。

paras.en: Lightning is already becoming more common: between 1995 and 2014, the researchers found, lightning across the world increased by 11 percent compared with the early 20th century. In the coming years, it could jump by between 76 percent and 140 percent over the 1995–2014 period, much more than previous estimates suggest.
paras.zh: 闪电已经变得越来越普遍：研究人员发现，从 1995 年到 2014 年，全世界的闪电比 20 世纪初增加了 11%。未来几年，1995 年至 2014 年期间这一数字可能会跃升 76% 至 140%，远高于之前的估计。

paras.en: “I was quite surprised that the projections were so high,” said the study’s lead author Andreas Krause, who studies Earth sciences modeling at the Technical University of Munich, in a statement. “I expected smaller changes.”
paras.zh: 该研究的主要作者、慕尼黑工业大学研究地球科学模型的安德烈亚斯·克劳斯（Andreas Krause）在一份声明中表示：“我对预测如此之高感到非常惊讶。” “我预计会有较小的变化。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The reason has to do with how lightning forms: as thunderstorm clouds develop, positively charged particles collect near the top of the cloud while negatively charged particles amass near the bottom. According to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, most lightning occurs inside these clouds. But sometimes negatively charged particles in the cloud can connect with positively charged particles on the ground, generating a thunderbolt—or “cloud-to-ground” lightning.
paras.zh: 原因与闪电的形成方式有关：随着雷暴云的形成，带正电的粒子聚集在云的顶部附近，而带负电的粒子则聚集在云的底部附近。根据国家海洋和大气管理局的说法，大多数闪电发生在这些云层内。但有时云中的带负电的粒子可以与地面上的带正电的粒子连接，产生雷电或“云对地”闪电。

paras.en: How dangerous lightning is depends somewhat on where you live. In the U.S. lightning strikes kill an average of 21 people per year and cause an estimated 24,600 fires per year. Countries such as India see a disproportionately high number of lightning strikes each year.
paras.zh: 闪电的危险程度在一定程度上取决于您居住的地方。在美国，雷击每年平均造成 21 人死亡，估计每年会引发 24,600 起火灾。印度等国家每年遭受雷击的次数异常多。

paras.en: As the climate warms, the study authors found, heat rising from Earth’s surface is more prone to shake up the atmosphere, creating more potential for electric fields—and cloud-to-ground lightning—to form.
paras.zh: 研究作者发现，随着气候变暖，从地球表面升起的热量更容易震动大气，从而为形成电场和云对地闪电创造更多可能性。

paras.en: Places with cooler climates, such as Alaska, stand to see the greatest rate of increase in lightning from previous levels. Other research suggests that lightning in the Arctic has tripled in recent years.
paras.zh: 气候较凉爽的地方，例如阿拉斯加，闪电的增幅将比之前的水平最高。其他研究表明，近年来北极的闪电数量增加了两倍。

articles.title: Where are all the Milky Way’s black holes?

paras.en: Astronomers can’t seem to find hundreds of millions of black holes in our galaxy. Given these objects’ reputation, you may find that a little troubling.
paras.zh: 天文学家似乎无法在我们的银河系中找到数亿个黑洞。考虑到这些对象的声誉，您可能会发现这有点令人不安。

paras.en: But don’t panic! These black holes aren’t dangerous to us, though the situation is somewhat irritating to astronomers.
paras.zh: 但不要惊慌！这些黑洞对我们来说并不危险，尽管这种情况让天文学家有些恼火。

paras.en: Stellar-mass black holes—ones that range from about three to 100 times the mass of the Sun—litter the Milky Way. They form when a massive star runs out of fuel; the core collapses and releases truly colossal amounts of energy. This causes the outer layers to explode away as a fiercely energetic supernova. And if the core is massive enough, it will form a black hole when it collapses.
paras.zh: 恒星质量的黑洞——质量约为太阳质量的三到一百倍——遍布银河系。当一颗大质量恒星耗​​尽燃料时，它们就会形成。核心崩溃并释放出真正巨大的能量。这导致外层爆炸，成为一颗能量极高的超新星。如果核心足够大，它坍缩时就会形成黑洞。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: We can estimate how many stellar-mass black holes there should be in the galaxy. One method is to calculate how many stars our galaxy has produced in its lifetime that have been more than eight solar masses, the critical limit needed to form a black hole. Research published in Astronomy and Astrophysics in 2020 estimated there are about 130 million such black holes in the Milky Way. A different study, posted as a preprint in 2026, got about 170 million, which is pretty similar.
paras.zh: 我们可以估计银河系中应该有多少个恒星质量的黑洞。一种方法是计算我们的星系在其一生中产生了多少颗质量超过八个太阳质量的恒星，这是形成黑洞所需的临界极限。 2020 年发表在《天文学和天体物理学》上的研究估计，银河系中约有 1.3 亿个这样的黑洞。另一项研究于 2026 年作为预印本发布，获得了约 1.7 亿次阅读，这非常相似。

paras.en: Another way is to look at the gravitational waves emitted as black holes merge with each other and use that to extrapolate their overall population in our galaxy. Research published in the January 2018 issue of Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society used this method and also found there should be some hundreds of millions in our galaxy. Close enough: we can safely conclude there are at least 100 million of these beasts in the Milky Way and possibly many times that number.
paras.zh: 另一种方法是观察黑洞彼此合并时发出的引力波，并用它来推断它们在我们银河系中的总体数量。 2018 年 1 月出版的《英国皇家天文学会月刊》上发表的研究使用了这种方法，还发现我们的银河系中应该有数亿颗。足够接近了：我们可以有把握地得出结论，银河系中至少有 1 亿只这样的野兽，而且数量可能是这个数字的许多倍。

paras.en: How many have we actually found? Well, this is the part that’s a bit irritating: fewer than 100. That’s not 100 million, just “one hundred.” And most of them aren’t confirmed yet.
paras.zh: 我们实际上找到了多少？嗯，这是有点令人恼火的部分：不到 100。这不是 1 亿，只是“100”。其中大多数尚未得到证实。

paras.en: This isn’t embarrassing—far from it; black holes make themselves pretty hard to find. For one thing the problem is right in their name: they’re black. They don’t emit light. In fact, they’re quite famous for exactly the opposite: absorbing everything, including light, that falls on them.
paras.zh: 这并不令人尴尬——远非如此。黑洞使得它们很难被发现。一方面，问题就在他们的名字上：他们是黑人。它们不发光。事实上，它们因恰恰相反而闻名：吸收落在它们身上的一切，包括光线。

paras.en: Single black holes that are just minding their own business in space are practically invisible. If they aren’t gobbling down matter—that is, if they’re quiescent—they are extremely difficult to detect. It’s possible, though, for a scant few to reveal themselves in various ways. For example, if one happens to pass directly between a star and Earth, our telescopes will detect the star brightening as the gravity of the black hole acts like a lens, distorting space and magnifying the light from the background star. There have been many surveys looking for such lensing events, but to date, only a single isolated Milky Way black hole has been found this way.
paras.zh: 在太空中只顾自己的事的单个黑洞实际上是看不见的。如果它们不吞噬物质，也就是说，如果它们处于静止状态，那么它们就很难被发现。不过，极少数人有可能以各种方式展现自己。例如，如果一颗恰好直接经过一颗恒星和地球之间，我们的望远镜将检测到恒星变亮，因为黑洞的引力就像透镜一样，扭曲了空间并放大了背景恒星的光。已有许多调查寻找此类透镜事件，但迄今为止，仅以这种方式发现了一个孤立的银河系黑洞。

paras.en: Sometimes, though, they make it a bit easier on astronomers. If a black hole is in a binary system, orbiting a normal star, its intense gravity can siphon material off the other star and draw it in. That matter piles up in a disk just above the event horizon. Friction and other forces inside the disk can heat it to extraordinarily high temperatures, millions of degrees, so the disk becomes incredibly luminous. Such a black hole can pour out high-energy X- and gamma rays which can be seen by our space telescopes, making it almost a cinch to locate in the sky. Most black holes we’ve detected in the Milky Way are in these types of systems, but they are vastly outnumbered by quiescent ones, which still makes a census of galactic black holes elusive.
paras.zh: 不过，有时它们会让天文学家变得更容易一些。如果黑洞位于双星系统中，绕着一颗普通恒星运行，它的强大引力可以从另一颗恒星上吸走物质并将其吸进去。这些物质堆积在事件视界上方的圆盘中。圆盘内部的摩擦力和其他力会将其加热到极高的温度，数百万度，因此圆盘变得异常明亮。这样的黑洞可以喷出高能X射线和伽马射线，我们的太空望远镜可以看到这些射线，因此在天空中定位几乎是轻而易举的事情。我们在银河系中检测到的大多数黑洞都位于这些类型的系统中，但它们的数量远远超过静止黑洞，这仍然使得银河系黑洞的普查变得难以捉摸。

paras.en: Recently, though, a new method has been available to look for these hidden lurkers. Gaia was an ESA mission that measured the positions, velocities, brightness and colors of well over a billion stars in our galaxy. The measurements were so precise that it’s possible to actually see the change in position a star undergoes as it and a black hole companion orbit each other. It takes exacting measurements and analysis to tease these black holes out of the data, but so far three such systems have been found, named (somewhat prosaically) Gaia BH1, 2 and 3. In fact, Gaia BH1 is the closest black hole known to the Sun, about 1,560 light-years away. The three Gaia black holes have masses of 9.6, 8.9 and 33 times that of the Sun, respectively.
