paras.zh: 不过，最近出现了一种新方法来寻找这些隐藏的潜伏者。盖亚是欧空局的一项任务，测量了银河系中超过十亿颗恒星的位置、速度、亮度和颜色。这些测量非常精确，以至于可以实际看到恒星与黑洞伴星绕轨道运行时所经历的位置变化。需要精确的测量和分析才能从数据中梳理出这些黑洞，但迄今为止已经发现了三个这样的系统，分别命名为（有点平淡）盖亚 BH1、2 和 3。事实上，盖亚 BH1 是已知距离太阳最近的黑洞，距离太阳约 1,560 光年。三个盖亚黑洞的质量分别是太阳的9.6、8.9和33倍。

paras.en: These represent the tip of the iceberg; there are probably a few tens of millions of black holes orbiting another object (such as a star or another black hole) in the galaxy. Still, it’s a promising method. Even better, a new data release from Gaia (its final one, alas) will have observations spanning a longer time baseline, which will make the telltale stellar motions easier to spot.
paras.zh: 这些只是冰山一角；银河系中可能有数千万个黑洞围绕另一个物体（例如恒星或另一个黑洞）运行。尽管如此，这仍然是一种有前途的方法。更好的是，盖亚发布的新数据（唉，这是最后一个数据）将在更长的时间基线上进行观测，这将使隐藏的恒星运动更容易被发现。

paras.en: That isn’t to say that we understand the ones we have seen. Two of the Gaia black holes—BH1 and BH2—orbit normal stars at moderate distances, and this presents a problem. The stars that formed these two black holes were quite massive, and as they died, they would have expanded into red supergiants. In both cases, the companion stars should have been engulfed by the more massive star, which would either result in a complete merger of the two or, once the massive star exploded, the second star being on a very tight orbit around the newly formed black hole.
paras.zh: 这并不是说我们理解我们所看到的。盖亚黑洞中的两个——BH1 和 BH2——以中等距离绕着正常恒星运行，这就带来了一个问题。形成这两个黑洞的恒星质量相当大，当它们死亡时，它们会膨胀成红超巨星。在这两种情况下，伴星都应该被更大质量的恒星吞没，这要么导致两者完全合并，要么一旦大质量恒星爆炸，第二颗恒星就处于围绕新形成的黑洞的非常紧密的轨道上。

paras.en: Yet in both systems, the stars appear intact, orbiting farther away than models predict. A paper published in July 10, 2026 in the Astrophysical Journal may have found a solution to this conundrum. Typically the supergiant star loses mass rapidly, and this blows it out into space. In a binary system, however, this process is aided by centrifugal force, which helps fling material away, and the physical dynamics of the system dictate that it occurs closer to the companion star. Thie process removes orbital energy, causing the orbits to shrink and, potentially, the two stars to merge.
paras.zh: 然而，在这两个系统中，恒星看起来都完好无损，其轨道运行距离比模型预测的要远。 2026 年 7 月 10 日发表在《天体物理学杂志》上的一篇论文可能已经找到了这个难题的解决方案。通常情况下，超巨星会迅速失去质量，并将其吹入太空。然而，在双星系统中，这个过程得到了离心力的帮助，这有助于将物质甩开，并且系统的物理动力学表明它发生在离伴星更近的地方。这个过程消除了轨道能量，导致轨道缩小，并有可能使两颗恒星合并。

paras.en: In the new research, the astronomers found that if the mass is instead lost close to the more massive star, the material doesn’t take as much energy away, leaving the two stars separate. It’s not clear how this might happen, though they posited a few ideas. Perhaps violent internal eruptions in the massive star can blast matter away directly from the surface into space. It’s also possible that the huge mass difference between the stars prevents the more gently blown material from transferring to the smaller companion star, so, again, it essentially leaves directly from the larger star.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，天文学家发现，如果质量在质量更大的恒星附近消失，那么物质就不会带走那么多的能量，从而使两颗恒星分开。尽管他们提出了一些想法，但尚不清楚这是如何发生的。也许大质量恒星剧烈的内部喷发可以将物质从表面直接喷射到太空中。也有可能恒星之间巨大的质量差异阻止了更轻柔地吹动的物质转移到较小的伴星，因此，它基本上直接从较大的恒星离开。

paras.en: Astronomers found a candidate fourth quiescent black hole system in 2024 with a very low mass and unusually circular orbit around its companion star. This system, too, is difficult to explain, and may involve a third star that was engulfed when the black hole progenitor turned into a red supergiant, merging with the other star to form the binary we see today.
paras.zh: 天文学家于 2024 年发现了第四个候选黑洞系统，其质量非常低，并且围绕其伴星运行的轨道异常圆形。这个系统也很难解释，并且可能涉及第三颗恒星，当黑洞的前身变成红超巨星时，第三颗恒星被吞没，与另一颗恒星合并形成我们今天看到的双星。

paras.en: Clearly, some black holes are weird, even for black holes. It’s interesting that, of the four quiescent binary black holes we’ve seen, three of them thumb their noses at our initial hypotheses of how they form. This is a pretty good indication that there is still a lot to figure out about these systems. With, oh, 100 million more still left to find, we’ll have plenty of opportunities to learn.
paras.zh: 显然，有些黑洞很奇怪，即使对于黑洞来说也是如此。有趣的是，在我们看到的四个静止双黑洞中，其中三个对我们最初关于它们如何形成的假设嗤之以鼻。这是一个很好的迹象，表明这些系统还有很多东西需要弄清楚。哦，还有 1 亿个待找到的东西，我们将有很多学习的机会。

articles.title: The scientific quest to understand alpha-gal, a tick-borne allergy to red meat

paras.en: Sandra Tiguila, an adventurous eater, enjoyed a bison sausage breakfast sandwich while dining out in August of 2025. On the drive home, she noticed a rash appearing on her wrist. The burning sensation spread to her arms and legs, making it nearly impossible to sleep. In the days to come, she tried creams, pills, injections; nothing helped.
paras.zh: 2025 年 8 月，爱冒险的桑德拉·蒂吉拉 (Sandra Tiguila) 在外出就餐时享用了野牛香肠早餐三明治。在开车回家的路上，她注意到手腕上出现了皮疹。灼热的感觉蔓延到她的手臂和腿上，让她几乎无法入睡。接下来的日子里，她尝试过药膏、药丸、打针；没有任何帮助。

paras.en: Ten days later, Tiguila ate out again, ordering a steak. When her face swelled up, her boyfriend drove her to the emergency room. A doctor tested her for diseases carried by ticks. Tiguila, who lives in Carbondale, Illinois, had been bitten twice that June.
paras.zh: 十天后，蒂吉拉再次外出就餐，点了一份牛排。当她的脸肿起来时，她的男朋友开车送她去急诊室。医生对她进行了检查，看是否有蜱虫携带的疾病。蒂吉拉住在伊利诺伊州卡本代尔，那年六月被咬了两次。

paras.en: Tiguila went home and the next morning, as she was drinking coffee with her usual supplement of bovine collagen for joint, hair and nail health, the test results came in. She had developed a red meat allergy that’s activated by tick bites. “I immediately dumped that coffee down the sink,” says Tiguila. She started avoiding all mammal products — the main way to manage this rising and occasionally life-threatening allergy.
paras.zh: 蒂吉拉回到家，第二天早上，当她喝咖啡时，她通常补充牛胶原蛋白以维持关节、头发和指甲的健康，测试结果出来了。她对红肉过敏，蜱虫叮咬会引起这种过敏。 “我立即把咖啡倒进水槽里，”蒂吉拉说。她开始避免使用所有哺乳动物产品——这是控制这种不断上升、有时甚至危及生命的过敏症的主要方法。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Known as alpha-gal syndrome, the condition arises when the immune system reacts to a certain sugar molecule, called alpha-gal, that’s found in red meat. Symptoms range from a mild rash or stomach upset to anaphylactic shock; in 2025, alpha-gal syndrome was blamed for the death of an otherwise healthy 47-year-old man. The syndrome has only recently been characterized and is still not fully understood. Though Tiguila, who is a nurse, was aware of the allergy, she says she still failed to connect her rash to her meaty meals and earlier tick bites.
paras.zh: 这种疾病被称为α-半乳糖综合症，当免疫系统对红肉中的某种糖分子（称为α-半乳糖）发生反应时就会出现这种情况。症状范围从轻微皮疹或胃部不适到过敏性休克； 2025 年，一名原本健康的 47 岁男子的死亡被归咎于 alpha-gal 综合症。该综合征最近才被定性，但仍未完全了解。尽管蒂吉拉是一名护士，她知道自己过敏，但她说，她仍然无法将皮疹与她吃的肉和之前被蜱虫叮咬联系起来。

paras.en: As ticks have spread northward, so too have alpha-gal diagnoses. Up to 450,000 people in the United States may have been affected since 2010, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention estimates.
paras.zh: 随着蜱虫向北传播，α-gal 诊断也随之向北传播。据美国疾病控制与预防中心估计，自 2010 年以来，美国可能有多达 45 万人受到影响。

paras.en: “It’s emerging as one of the top adult-onset food allergies,” says Onyinye Iweala, an allergist and immunologist at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
paras.zh: “它正在成为最常见的成人食物过敏之一，”北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校的过敏症专家和免疫学家 Onyinye Iweala 说。

paras.en: Allergies are often mysterious, but this one is extra weird. “Alpha-gal follows none of the rules that I was taught in training about how a food allergy behaves,” says Maya Jerath, an allergist and immunologist at Washington University in St. Louis and one of Tiguila’s physicians. For example, unlike with other food allergies, where reactions are immediate, alpha-gal symptoms often show up hours after eating meat.
paras.zh: 过敏往往很神秘，但这一种更奇怪。 “Alpha-gal 没有遵循我在培训中学到的有关食物过敏行为的任何规则，”圣路易斯华盛顿大学的过敏症专家和免疫学家、蒂吉拉的医生之一玛雅·杰拉斯 (Maya Jerath) 说。例如，与其他立即反应的食物过敏不同，α-半乳糖过敏症状通常在吃肉数小时后出现。

paras.en: And, strangely, the allergy often arises after a tick bite. In the early 2000s, Jerath recalls, Australian allergist and clinician Sheryl van Nunen first shared tales on the scientific-conference circuit of patients with a delayed allergic reaction to red meat after tick bites. “Nobody believed her,” Jerath says.
paras.zh: 而且，奇怪的是，过敏通常是在蜱虫叮咬后出现的。 Jerath 回忆道，2000 年代初，澳大利亚过敏症专家兼临床医生 Sheryl van Nunen 首次在科学会议上分享了一些患者在被蜱虫叮咬后对红肉出现迟发性过敏反应的故事。 “没有人相信她，”杰拉斯说。

paras.en: The eventual unraveling of the mystery would happen on the other side of the world, where immunologist Thomas Platts-Mills, unaware of van Nunen’s findings, was pursuing two parallel projects in his lab at the University of Virginia in Charlottesville. In one, his group was collecting blood samples from people claiming weird meat sensitivities. In the other, they were investigating patients’ strange reactions to the cancer drug cetuximab. It would take both projects to crack the case, recalls Scott Commins, an allergist who was then part of the lab and now works at the University of North Carolina.
paras.zh: 这个谜团的最终揭开将发生在世界的另一边，在那里，免疫学家托马斯·普拉茨·米尔斯（Thomas Platts-Mills）不知道范·努南的发现，正在他位于夏洛茨维尔的弗吉尼亚大学的实验室里进行两个并行的项目。在其中一项研究中，他的团队正在从那些声称对肉类过敏的人身上采集血液样本。另一方面，他们正在调查患者对癌症药物西妥昔单抗的奇怪反应。斯科特·康明斯 (Scott Commins) 回忆道，需要两个项目才能破案。斯科特·康明斯当时是该实验室的一员，现在在北卡罗来纳大学工作。

paras.en: First, the cancer strand. Cetuximab is a drug designed to stick to cancer cells and block their overzealous growth. It was first approved to treat colorectal cancer in 2004, but as its testing and use spread, an odd pattern appeared. In the Southeastern United States, more than one in five patients had allergic reactions to the drug — hives, difficulty breathing and even anaphylaxis.
paras.zh: 首先，癌症链。西妥昔单抗是一种旨在粘附癌细胞并阻止其过度生长的药物。它于 2004 年首次被批准用于治疗结直肠癌，但随着其测试和使用的扩展，出现了一种奇怪的模式。在美国东南部，超过五分之一的患者对该药物有过敏反应——荨麻疹、呼吸困难甚至过敏反应。

paras.en: It took about a year and a half, Commins recalls, but Platts-Mills’ group found the culprit. People who reacted badly to cetuximab, they discovered, had blood loaded with proteins called IgE antibodies. When activated inappropriately, IgE causes allergies. The cancer patients with the allergic reactions to cetuximab had IgE antibodies that were reacting specifically to the sugar alpha-gal, the researchers reported in 2008.
paras.zh: 康明斯回忆说，花了大约一年半的时间，但普拉茨-米尔斯的团队找到了罪魁祸首。他们发现，对西妥昔单抗反应严重的人的血液中含有称为 IgE 抗体的蛋白质。当 IgE 激活不当时，会引起过敏。研究人员于 2008 年报道，对西妥昔单抗过敏的癌症患者体内存在对糖 α-gal 产生特异性反应的 IgE 抗体。

paras.en: Now, humans (and many other primates) don’t make alpha-gal. But most mammals do. It’s one of several sugars that cells attach to proteins to regulate their final structure and function. And cetuximab, like many drugs, is manufactured in lab-grown mouse cells. These cells had attached alpha-gal molecules to the cetuximab. That’s what triggered the allergic reactions in the cancer patients.
paras.zh: 现在，人类（和许多其他灵长类动物）不产生α-gal。但大多数哺乳动物都是如此。它是细胞附着在蛋白质上以调节其最终结构和功能的几种糖之一。与许多药物一样，西妥昔单抗是在实验室培养的小鼠细胞中制造的。这些细胞已将 α-gal 分子附着到西妥昔单抗上。这就是引发癌症患者过敏反应的原因。

paras.en: But it only happened in some of the people taking the drug. Why them? And why only in the Southeastern United States?
paras.zh: 但这种情况只发生在一些服用药物的人身上。为什么是他们？为什么只发生在美国东南部？

paras.en: The next clues came from the lab’s other work, on meat sensitivities. This puzzle, of course, also involved exposure to tissues from non-primate mammals—so the researchers hypothesized that this allergy had the same cause as the drug reactions. Sure enough, they found that people with meat sensitivity also had elevated IgE antibodies to alpha-gal, causing a “novel and severe food allergy,” the team reported in 2009.
paras.zh: 接下来的线索来自该实验室关于肉类敏感性的其他工作。当然，这个谜题还涉及接触非灵长类哺乳动物的组织，因此研究人员假设这种过敏与药物反应的原因相同。果然，他们发现对肉类敏感的人的 α-半乳糖 IgE 抗体也升高，导致“新奇且严重的食物过敏”，该团队在 2009 年报告说。

paras.en: The allergy is bizarre for several reasons. There’s the delay that van Nunen had noticed. And food allergies are typically triggered by protein: egg protein, nut protein, etc. While some carbohydrates have been linked to mild allergies, a sugar causing such severe reactions was unheard of, says Jeffrey Wilson, an allergist and immunologist at UVA Health in Charlottesville, Virginia.
paras.zh: 这种过敏现象很奇怪，有几个原因。范努南注意到了延迟。食物过敏通常是由蛋白质引发的：鸡蛋蛋白、坚果蛋白等。弗吉尼亚州夏洛茨维尔 UVA Health 的过敏症专家和免疫学家杰弗里·威尔逊 (Jeffrey Wilson) 表示，虽然某些碳水化合物与轻度过敏有关，但引起如此严重反应的糖却闻所未闻。

paras.en: Plus, food allergies were supposed to be all-or-nothing: A person allergic to peanuts will always react to peanuts. Not so with alpha-gal. For example, some people react to meat alone; others might be bothered by dairy or other mammal products, such as gelatin in cosmetics or medications.
paras.zh: 另外，食物过敏被认为是要么全有要么全无：对花生过敏的人总是会对花生产生反应。 α-gal 则不然。例如，有些人只对肉有反应；有些人只对肉有反应。其他人可能会受到乳制品或其他哺乳动物产品的困扰，例如化妆品或药物中的明胶。

paras.en: Because those products are common, people are exposed to alpha-gal all the time. The sugar can even be made by natural gut bacteria. In other words, most people have no problem with alpha-gal. Platts-Mills, Commins and colleagues were still missing an explanation for why only some people developed this odd sensitivity.
paras.zh: 由于这些产品很常见，人们一直都接触到α-半乳糖。这种糖甚至可以由天然肠道细菌产生。换句话说，大多数人对α-gal没有任何问题。普拉茨-米尔斯、康明斯和同事仍然没有解释为什么只有一些人会产生这种奇怪的敏感性。

paras.en: So Commins led a study of people with and without meat allergy to see what the allergic ones had in common. Might they have been exposed to some kind of fungus, or maybe a worm? No, and no.
paras.zh: 因此，康明斯领导了一项针对肉类过敏者和非肉类过敏者的研究，以了解过敏者的共同点。他们可能接触过某种真菌，或者蠕虫吗？不，也不。

paras.en: Then, a key clue emerged from a colleague down the hall. He’d had the meat allergy and joined the study, but had been doing well, so he dared to eat a sausage. Big mistake: He had a bad reaction. Testing showed his alpha-gal IgE had risen to “freakishly high levels,” Commins recalls.
paras.zh: 然后，一条关键线索从大厅另一头的同事那里透露出来。他对肉类过敏并参加了这项研究，但一直表现良好，所以他敢于吃香肠。大错误：他的反应很糟糕。康明斯回忆道，测试显示他的 alpha-gal IgE 已升至“异常高的水平”。

paras.en: The colleague also had itchy spots—from recent tick bites. That got the team thinking. Commins went back to his meat-sensitive subjects to ask if they’d had tick bites. Most of the nearly 200 people answered yes. The team then learned of van Nunen’s work, published in 2009, bolstering confidence that they were on the right track. Everything pointed to a tick link: The regions where people had alpha-gal antibodies overlapped with the range of the lone star tick; people who got bitten developed more alpha-gal antibodies, and people with those antibodies often also had antibodies to other lone star tick proteins, the team reported in 2011.
paras.zh: 这位同事最近还被蜱虫叮咬，身上也出现了一些发痒的地方。这引起了团队的思考。康明斯回到对肉类敏感的受试者身上，询问他们是否被蜱虫叮咬。近200人中，大多数人的回答是肯定的。随后，团队了解到了 van Nunen 于 2009 年发表的研究成果，这增强了他们的信心：他们走在正确的道路上。一切都指向蜱虫的联系：人们拥有α-半乳糖抗体的区域与孤星蜱虫的范围重叠；研究小组在 2011 年报告说，被咬伤的人会产生更多的 α-gal 抗体，而拥有这些抗体的人通常也有针对其他孤星蜱蛋白的抗体。

paras.en: Later, biologist Shahid Karim of the University of Southern Mississippi in Hattiesburg and colleagues found alpha-gal in lone star tick salivary glands. The final clincher implicating ticks came in 2023: Commins and collaborators at the CDC reported that people with alpha-gal syndrome were more than 11 times more likely to recall finding a tick on their body than those who didn’t have the allergy.
paras.zh: 后来，哈蒂斯堡南密西西比大学的生物学家沙希德·卡里姆（Shahid Karim）及其同事在孤星蜱的唾液腺中发现了α-gal。涉及蜱虫的最终结论出现在 2023 年：康明斯和 CDC 的合作者报告称，患有 α-gal 综合征的人回忆起自己身上有蜱虫的可能性是那些没有过敏症的人的 11 倍以上。

paras.en: Around the world, about a dozen tick species are now associated with alpha-gal allergy. In the United States, the lone star tick is the major player, and it’s spreading northward, helped by warmer temperatures and exploding populations of deer that the tick feeds on.
paras.zh: 在世界各地，大约有十几种蜱虫与α-半乳糖过敏有关。在美国，孤星蜱是主要参与者，在气温升高和蜱以蜱为食的鹿数量激增的帮助下，它正在向北传播。

paras.en: Given the expanding health concerns, the CDC has pledged $10 million to support alpha-gal surveillance and awareness among health providers and the public. Scientists, meanwhile, have lingering questions about how the mysterious allergy works.
paras.zh: 鉴于日益严重的健康问题，疾病预防控制中心已承诺投入 1000 万美元来支持 alpha-gal 监测和提高卫生服务提供者和公众的认识。与此同时，科学家们对于这种神秘的过敏是如何发生的仍然存在疑问。

paras.en: The pathway from tick bite to meat allergy remains murky. Commins, who hosts a podcast about alpha-gal syndrome, speculates that the body can treat alpha-gal as either something to tolerate or something to react to. The route of exposure seems to be key: Alpha-gal in the gut, from food or bacteria, seems to promote tolerance. But exposure via the skin is a great way to trigger an allergic reaction. That reaction can overshadow the tolerance, often temporarily, Commins says. This hypothesis fits some of the allergy’s features: A strong reaction to the initial bite, or getting lots of bites, boosts risk. Fresh tick bites can also exacerbate or reactivate the sensitivity.
paras.zh: 从蜱虫叮咬到肉类过敏的途径仍然不明朗。康明斯主持了一个有关α-半乳糖综合症的播客，他推测身体可以将α-半乳糖视为可以耐受的东西或可以对其做出反应的东西。暴露途径似乎是关键：肠道中来自食物或细菌的α-半乳糖似乎可以促进耐受性。但通过皮肤接触是引发过敏反应的好方法。康明斯说，这种反应可能会掩盖耐受性，而且通常是暂时的。这一假设符合过敏的一些特征：对最初的叮咬或多次叮咬的强烈反应会增加风险。新鲜的蜱虫叮咬也会加剧或重新激活敏感性。

paras.en: Researchers don’t really know why certain ticks cause the allergy and others don’t. One possibility: Perhaps the lone star tick’s taste for human blood, combined with, as Commins notes, its wickedly long skin-piercing mouthparts, underlie this species’ proclivity to incite allergy.
paras.zh: 研究人员并不真正知道为什么某些蜱虫会引起过敏，而另一些蜱虫却不会。一种可能性是：正如康明斯指出的那样，也许孤星蜱对人类血液的嗜好，再加上其邪恶的长刺穿皮肤的口器，是该物种煽动过敏的倾向的基础。

paras.en: Also puzzling: Some people get tick bites and don’t develop the allergy, and some alpha-gal patients don’t report any history of tick bites. Some people have high levels of IgE antibodies to alpha-gal but can enjoy cheeseburgers freely. Others are sensitive to meats but have low concentrations of the allergic IgE.
paras.zh: 同样令人费解的是：有些人被蜱虫叮咬后并没有产生过敏，而一些 alpha-gal 患者也没有报告任何蜱虫叮咬史。有些人的 alpha-gal IgE 抗体水平很高，但可以随意享用芝士汉堡。其他人对肉类敏感，但过敏性 IgE 浓度较低。

paras.en: Karim, for his part, is trying to figure out what causes some tick victims’ immune reactions to flip from alpha-gal tolerance to allergy. Some research suggests that blood type is a risk factor. Type B blood proteins contain a structure similar to the alpha-gal sugar, and this could promote tolerance, making people with type B or AB blood less likely to develop IgE antibodies to alpha-gal.
paras.zh: 卡里姆则试图找出是什么原因导致一些蜱虫受害者的免疫反应从α-半乳糖耐受性转变为过敏。一些研究表明血型是一个危险因素。 B 型血蛋白含有与 α-gal 糖相似的结构，这可以促进耐受性，使 B 型或 AB 型血的人不太可能产生针对 α-gal 的 IgE 抗体。

paras.en: Another unresolved question is the odd symptom delay. Wilson speculates that it could be explained if the alpha-gal sugar is hooked to meat fats, rather than meat proteins. Fats take longer for the body to digest and transmit into the bloodstream, so only then would the alpha-gal sugar gain the notice of immune cells.
paras.zh: 另一个未解决的问题是奇怪的症状延迟。威尔逊推测，如果α-半乳糖与肉脂肪而不是肉蛋白结合，就可以解释这一点。脂肪需要更长的时间才能被身体消化并传输到血液中，因此只有这样，α-半乳糖才会引起免疫细胞的注意。

paras.en: For some people, their elevated IgE levels will drop and the allergy will go away. In others, it lingers. And sometimes it seems to morph into a generalized disorder where people have allergy-like symptoms even when they avoid meat, says Iweala.
paras.zh: 对于某些人来说，升高的 IgE 水平会下降，过敏也会消失。在其他方面，它却挥之不去。伊韦拉说，有时它似乎会演变成一种全身性疾病，即使人们不吃肉，也会出现类似过敏的症状。

paras.en: For now, there are no specific therapies for alpha-gal. Allergists can suggest antihistamines and offer EpiPens to thwart a reaction. Some prescribe Xolair (omalizumab), a general allergy treatment that can minimize symptoms if a person encounters alpha-gal. To avoid activating or exacerbating alpha-gal syndrome, the best approach is to avoid tick-ridden areas or use insect repellents like picaridin on skin and permethrin on clothing.
paras.zh: 目前，还没有针对 alpha-gal 的具体疗法。过敏症专家可以建议使用抗组胺药并提供 EpiPens 来阻止反应。有些人会开 Xolair（奥马珠单抗），这是一种一般过敏治疗方法，可以在一个人遇到 α-gal 时最大程度地减轻症状。为了避免激活或加剧α-半乳糖综合症，最好的方法是避开蜱虫出没的地方或在皮肤上使用派卡瑞丁和在衣服上使用氯菊酯等驱虫剂。

paras.en: And Commins hopes to create a better treatment. It’s known that an immune signaling molecule called IL-4 is key to the allergic response. He’s in discussions with pharmaceutical companies to test a treatment that would interrupt this IL-4 messaging.
paras.zh: 康明斯希望创造出更好的治疗方法。众所周知，一种称为 IL-4 的免疫信号分子是过敏反应的关键。他正在与制药公司讨论测试一种可以中断 IL-4 信息传递的治疗方法。

paras.en: Better therapeutics would certainly be welcome. Alpha-gal syndrome can cause anxiety, since mammal-derived products are ubiquitous and hard to avoid. Tiguila, when she was first diagnosed, went into a label-checking frenzy; she almost threw a bag of prunes across the room because it contained a possibly mammal-derived additive.
paras.zh: 更好的治疗方法肯定会受到欢迎。 Alpha-gal 综合症会引起焦虑，因为哺乳动物衍生产品无处不在且难以避免。当蒂吉拉第一次被确诊时，她陷入了疯狂的标签检查之中。她差点把一袋李子扔到房间另一边，因为里面含有可能来自哺乳动物的添加剂。

paras.en: After visiting the Washington University clinic and being advised to relax around foods that didn’t bother her, Tiguila calmed down. She still enjoys the great outdoors but is careful to slather on insect repellent first.
paras.zh: 在参观了华盛顿大学诊所并被建议在不困扰她的食物周围放松后，蒂吉拉平静了下来。她仍然喜欢户外活动，但会先小心地涂上厚厚的驱虫剂。

paras.en: She recently received more good news: In August of 2026, her blood tested negative for IgE antibodies against alpha-gal, suggesting that her allergy might be gone. Her physicians prescribed a reintroduction protocol they had developed for patients who hit this milestone. She started with an ounce of filet mignon, a low-fat cut, and amped up the exposure from there. “I’ve successfully returned many people to eating meat again,” Jerath says. In one study, her protocol worked for all 19 participants.
paras.zh: 她最近收到了更多好消息：2026年8月，她的血液检测发现针对α-gal的IgE抗体呈阴性，这表明她的过敏可能已经消失了。她的医生为达到这一里程碑的患者制定了重新引入方案。她从一盎司菲力牛排（低脂切块）开始，然后增加了曝光度。 “我成功地让很多人重新吃肉，”杰拉斯说。在一项研究中，她的方案对所有 19 名参与者都有效。

paras.en: Add Tiguila to that total: As of late September, she is back to her usual diet. “I’m very grateful to be cleared and not have to be so cautious,” she says.
paras.zh: 将 Tiguila 添加到这个总数中：截至 9 月下旬，她已恢复正常饮食。 “我很高兴能够获得许可，不必那么谨慎，”她说。

articles.title: How do tumors talk to nerves? This scientist is finding out
articles.author: Anna Mattson

paras.en: This is a human-written story voiced by AI. Got feedback?
paras.zh: 这是一个由人工智能配音的人类书写的故事。有反馈吗？

paras.en: Sebnem Ece Eksi did a double take. Proteins typically studied in the brain were turning up in prostate cancer cells from high-risk patients. These proteins, called neuronal adhesion molecules, play a key role in the circuitry associated with memory.
paras.zh: Sebnem Ece Eksi 愣了一下。通常在大脑中研究的蛋白质出现在高危患者的前列腺癌细胞中。这些蛋白质被称为神经元粘附分子，在与记忆相关的电路中发挥着关键作用。

paras.en: The finding, made during her Ph.D. days at the University of Illinois Chicago, raised so many questions to which Eksi is still seeking answers. Now at the Oregon Health & Science University in Portland, Eksi has made it her lab’s goal to find out how nervous systems communicate with cancer. What were once two separate fields might be connected more closely than previously thought.
paras.zh: 这一发现是她在攻读博士学位期间做出的。在伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校的几天里，提出了很多问题，而 Eksi 仍在寻找答案。现在，在波特兰的俄勒冈健康与科学大学，埃克西的实验室目标是找出神经系统如何与癌症沟通。曾经两个独立的领域之间的联系可能比之前想象的更加紧密。

paras.en: “What we’re learning is that tumors are actively communicating with the nervous system,” Eksi says. “In a way, it makes sense to me that a growing tumor in our bodies, in an organ, would be immediately sensed and detected by the nervous system.”
paras.zh: “我们了解到，肿瘤正在与神经系统积极沟通，”埃克西说。 “在某种程度上，对我来说，神经系统会立即感知和检测到我们体内某个器官中不断生长的肿瘤，这是有道理的。”

paras.en: Eksi now plans to test an AI image-based recognition algorithm to identify nerve fibers in human patients. This is exciting, she says, because these nerves aren’t normally visible in patient tumors. But through biopsies, she hopes to map out and observe how the nervous system — which impacts sleep, cognition and pain — changes as cancer progresses. The implications are significant, she says. Could experts use the nervous system to detect cancer early? Can they improve patients’ quality of life?
paras.zh: Eksi 现在计划测试一种基于人工智能图像的识别算法，以识别人类患者的神经纤维。她说，这很令人兴奋，因为这些神经在患者肿瘤中通常不可见。但通过活检，她希望了解并观察影响睡眠、认知和疼痛的神经系统如何随着癌症的进展而变化。她说，其影响是重大的。专家能否利用神经系统早期发现癌症？它们能改善患者的生活质量吗？

paras.en: “This field of cancer neuroscience can change all different stages of cancer diagnosis and treatments,” Eksi says. “It’s growing so quickly, the field itself.”
paras.zh: “癌症神经科学这一领域可以改变癌症诊断和治疗的所有不同阶段，”埃克西说。 “这个领域本身发展得非常快。”

articles.title: Motion under the ocean explains the depth of the world’s deepest spot
articles.author: Carolyn Gramling

paras.en: Challenger Deep is the deepest valley in the deepest trench in the ocean, plunging to roughly 11,000 meters below sea level.
paras.zh: 挑战者深渊 (Challenger Deep) 是海洋最深海沟中最深的山谷，深度约低于海平面 11,000 米。

paras.en: Now, scientists have a new clue about how it got to be so … well, deep.
paras.zh: 现在，科学家们找到了关于它如何变得如此……嗯，深的新线索。

paras.en: Challenger Deep is found within the Mariana Trench, a crescent-shaped gouge in the seafloor east of the Philippines in the Pacific Ocean. The trench is the scene of a slo-mo tectonic collision called a subduction zone: The Pacific plate is diving beneath the Mariana plate, bending downward as it sinks into the mantle, forming a steep trench on the ocean floor.
paras.zh: 挑战者深渊位于马里亚纳海沟内，马里亚纳海沟是菲律宾东部太平洋海底的一个新月形凿痕。海沟是慢速构造碰撞的场景，称为俯冲带：太平洋板块潜入马里亚纳板块下方，在沉入地幔时向下弯曲，在海底形成陡峭的海沟。

paras.en: All subduction zones are deep, but “it’s interesting why this is the deepest spot in the Earth’s ocean,” says geoscientist Robert Stern, an emeritus professor at the University of Texas at Dallas and a visiting researcher at the University of California, Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 所有俯冲带都很深，但“有趣的是，为什么这里是地球海洋最深的地方”，德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校名誉教授、加州大学洛杉矶分校客座研究员地球科学家罗伯特·斯特恩说。

paras.en: He and colleagues employed a remotely operated robot called ROV Jason/Medea to descend to more than 6,000 meters and explore the Mariana Trench seafloor around the edges of Challenger Deep. The rocks turned out to contain pyroclastic deposits, evidence of an erstwhile explosive volcanic eruption. Those deposits included platelike blocks that could indicate eruption pulses, and lobe-shaped rocks where the volcanic flows ended and quickly cooled.
paras.zh: 他和同事使用名为 ROV Jason/Medea 的远程操作机器人下降到 6,000 多米深处，探索挑战者深渊边缘的马里亚纳海沟海底。事实证明，这些岩石中含有火山碎屑沉积物，这是昔日火山喷发的证据。这些沉积物包括可以指示喷发脉冲的板状块体，以及火山流结束并迅速冷却的叶状岩石。

paras.en: These are the deepest pyroclastic deposits found on Earth, the scientists report November 23 in Frontiers in Earth Science.
paras.zh: 科学家们于 11 月 23 日在《地球科学前沿》上报告称，这些是地球上发现的最深的火山碎屑沉积物。

paras.en: How explosive an eruption is at Earth’s surface depends on the chemical makeup of the magma. When the molten rock contains a high proportion of volatile gases, including water vapor, those gases suddenly expand when the magma reaches the surface, producing a violent explosion.
paras.zh: 地球表面喷发的爆炸性取决于岩浆的化学成分。当熔岩含有高比例的挥发性气体（包括水蒸气）时，当岩浆到达地表时，这些气体会突然膨胀，产生剧烈的爆炸。

paras.en: Such explosive volcanism shouldn’t be possible in the deep sea; the pressure is too high for any escaping gases to expand, Stern says. Along with that mystery, the volcanic deposits were found unusually close to the trench, compared with what would be expected for a subduction zone.
paras.zh: 这种爆发性的火山活动在深海中是不可能发生的；斯特恩说，压力太高，任何逸出的气体都无法膨胀。除了这个谜团之外，与预期的俯冲带相比，火山沉积物的发现异常靠近海沟。

paras.en: Stern and his colleagues developed a hypothesis that incorporates these disparate pieces of evidence: The extreme depth of Challenger Deep, they say, may be at least partially due to an especially sharp bend in the Pacific Plate as it sinks into the mantle.
paras.zh: 斯特恩和他的同事提出了一个包含这些不同证据的假设：他们说，挑战者深渊的极端深度可能至少部分归因于太平洋板块在沉入地幔时发生的特别急剧的弯曲。

paras.en: That tighter bend would explain why volcanism is happening closer to the subduction zone than usual. The classic subduction zone scenario is that the sinking plate heats up and melts partially as it descends; the magma rises through the overhanging plate and erupts, forming volcanic island arcs several hundred kilometers from the collision zone. Here, the volcanic deposits were just a hundred kilometers or so from the trench — which makes sense if the plate is dipping more steeply.
paras.zh: 这种更紧的弯曲可以解释为什么火山活动发生在比平常更靠近俯冲带的地方。典型的俯冲带情景是下沉板块在下降时升温并部分熔化；岩浆穿过悬垂的板块上升并喷发，形成距碰撞区数百公里的火山岛弧。这里的火山沉积物距离海沟仅一百公里左右——如果板块倾斜得更陡的话，这是有道理的。

paras.en: As for the pyroclastics, “we can’t answer if the eruptions were really explosive,” Stern says. But at those pressures, any gases such as water vapor contained in the magma wouldn’t be able to explosively expand as they would at the surface.
paras.zh: 至于火山碎屑，“我们无法回答火山喷发是否真的具有爆炸性，”斯特恩说。但在这些压力下，岩浆中含有的任何气体（例如水蒸气）都无法像在地表那样爆炸性膨胀。

paras.en: Instead, the pyroclastic rocks might have formed through a new version of deep-sea eruption, one in which water emerging from the magma is initially in a supercritical fluid state. That would minimize any explosive expansion during the eruption and could also produce fragmented, dense deposits like those seen by Jason/Medea.
paras.zh: 相反，火山碎屑岩可能是通过一种新的深海喷发形成的，其中从岩浆中喷出的水最初处于超临界流体状态。这将最大限度地减少火山喷发期间的爆炸性扩张，并且还可能产生像杰森/美狄亚所看到的那样碎片化、致密的沉积物。

paras.en: The discovery of deep-sea pyroclastics is “surprising and unprecedented,” says William Chadwick, a geologist at Oregon State University in Newport. Challenger Deep may be the only place on Earth “with the ingredients to produce explosive volcanism in the super-deep ocean,” he says. “Imagining this happening is … pretty mind-boggling.”
paras.zh: 俄勒冈州立大学纽波特分校的地质学家威廉·查德威克表示，深海火山碎屑岩的发现“令人惊讶且前所未有”。他说，挑战者深渊可能是地球上唯一一个“拥有在超深海中产生爆炸性火山活动的成分”的地方。 “想象这种情况发生……真是令人难以置信。”

paras.en: A lot more work remains to be done to evaluate all of these new ideas, Stern says. “But a lot of things are now coming together.”
paras.zh: 斯特恩说，评估所有这些新想法还有很多工作要做。 “但现在很多事情都融合在一起了。”

articles.title: Extinct, long-legged grasshoppers walked on water alongside dinosaurs
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: Nearly 100 million years ago, spindly legged grasshoppers may have scooted across water like modern day water striders. The clues are in the fossilized insects’ legs and feet.
paras.zh: 近一亿年前，细长腿的蚱蜢可能像现代水黾一样在水面上快速移动。线索就在昆虫化石的腿和脚上。

paras.en: Special hairs and leaf-shaped leg adornments, exquisitely preserved in amber, suggest the insects — members of a newfound family of insects — could balance and slide around on surface tension, researchers report November 24 in Proceedings of the Royal Society B. The discovery suggests at least three insect groups evolved independently to move across water.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 11 月 24 日在《英国皇家学会学报 B》上报道称，琥珀中精美保存的特殊毛发和叶形腿部装饰表明，这些昆虫（新发现的昆虫家族的成员）可以在表面张力的作用下保持平衡和滑动。这一发现表明，至少三个昆虫群体独立进化以在水中移动。

paras.en: Paleontologist Chunpeng Xu and his colleagues first encountered the strange insects while studying a collection of 99-million-year-old amber. Frozen in time were three pieces of amber containing wingless grasshoppers with short bodies and incredibly long, skinny legs. Due to their unorthodox body shape, Xu didn’t recognize them as grasshoppers at first and thought they might be harvestmen or stick insects.
paras.zh: 古生物学家徐春鹏和他的同事在研究一批 9900 万年前的琥珀时首次遇到了这种奇怪的昆虫。三块琥珀被及时冻结，里面有无翼的蚱蜢，它们的身体很短，腿又长又瘦。由于体型奇特，徐一开始并没有认出它们是蝗虫，还以为它们可能是收割者或竹节虫。

paras.en: “I was genuinely amazed,” says Xu, of the Nanjing Institute of Geology and Paleontology in China. “They are among the most bizarre insects.”
paras.zh: “我真的很惊讶，”中国南京地质古生物研究所的徐说。 “它们是最奇怪的昆虫之一。”

paras.en: Under the microscope, two details stood out: Front legs with water repellant hairs and rear lower legs with leaf-shaped paddlelike structures. Estimates of the insects’ weight show they could have ridden on the water’s surface tension, with help from the repellant hairs on their legs and their spread-out footprint across the surface of the water. And the paddlelike lower legs would have propelled them forward.
paras.zh: 在显微镜下，有两个细节引人注目：前腿有防水毛，后小腿有叶状桨状结构。对昆虫重量的估计表明，在腿部的驱虫毛和遍布水面的足迹的帮助下，它们可以依靠水的表面张力来行走。桨状的小腿会推动它们前进。

paras.en: The researchers named the insects Hydrelcana zhangi, placing them in the new family Hydrelcanidae.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这种昆虫命名为“Hydrelcana zhangi”，将它们归入新的Hydrelcanidae科。

paras.en: “Walking on water is a pretty rare skill in nature,” Xu says. Until now, only two insect groups were known to have evolved to live on the water’s surface: water striders and their kin, and a similar looking but unrelated, long extinct family called Chresmodidae.
paras.zh: “在水上行走是自然界中一项非常罕见的技能，”徐说。到目前为止，已知只有两个昆虫类群进化为生活在水面上：水黾及其亲属，以及一个外表相似但无关的、早已灭绝的科，称为水黾科。

paras.en: The grasshoppers had a different gait from other water-walking insects. The common pond skater (Gerris lacustris), by comparison, rows with its middle limbs.
paras.zh: 蚱蜢的步态与其他水上行走昆虫不同。相比之下，普通的池塘溜冰者（Gerris lacustris）则用中肢划船。

paras.en: And whereas modern water-walking insects are predators and scavengers, the ancient grasshoppers were also probably herbivorous, given their mouthparts and lack of claws. The researchers found nine of them preserved in the same amber chunk, suggesting the insects may have gathered in large numbers to feed. It’s possibly the earliest record of such swarming behavior in grasshoppers or crickets, the team says.
paras.zh: 现代水中行走的昆虫是捕食者和食腐动物，而古代蚱蜢也可能是草食性的，因为它们有口器且没有爪子。研究人员发现其中九只保存在同一块琥珀中，这表明这些昆虫可能大量聚集在一起取食。研究小组表示，这可能是蚱蜢或蟋蟀此类集群行为的最早记录。

articles.title: 'Bad Omen': Ancient Pyramid in Mexico Collapsed Into A Heap of Rubble
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: The world's climate system is growing increasingly unstable, and it's toppling precious ancient pyramids around the world.
paras.zh: 世界气候系统变得越来越不稳定，世界各地珍贵的古代金字塔正在倒塌。

paras.en: In 2024, on the night of July 29, one of the best-preserved pyramids of the Michoacán Kingdom civilization in Mexico crumbled into a pile of rubble.
paras.zh: 2024年，7月29日夜间，墨西哥保存最完好的米却肯王国文明金字塔之一化为废墟。

paras.en: After weeks of heavy rainfall, the south wall of the 15-meter-high (roughly 50-foot-high) square monument had finally and suddenly succumbed to the extreme weather.
paras.zh: 经过数周的强降雨，这座15米高（约50英尺高）的方形纪念碑的南墙终于突然屈服于极端天气。

paras.en: The pyramid is located at a remarkably preserved archaeological site that was first occupied more than 1,100 years ago by Indigenous Nahuatl-speaking groups.
paras.zh: 金字塔位于一处保存完好的考古遗址，该遗址于 1,100 多年前首次被讲纳瓦特尔语的土著群体占据。

paras.en: Later, it became the headquarters of the P'urhépechas people, the empire the Aztecs failed to conquer.
paras.zh: 后来，它成为阿兹特克人未能征服的帝国普赫佩查人的总部。

paras.en: Thankfully, only one of the pyramids at the site was damaged, but officials at Mexico's National Institute of Anthropology and History (INAH) said that at least six of its 'stepped bodies' are in disrepair.
paras.zh: 值得庆幸的是，现场只有一座金字塔遭到损坏，但墨西哥国家人类学和历史研究所（INAH）的官员表示，至少有六座“阶梯式金字塔”年久失修。

paras.en: This includes the outer wall, the core, and the retaining wall.
paras.zh: 这包括外墙、核心筒和挡土墙。

paras.en: The destruction, according to INAH, is due to extreme weather.
paras.zh: 据 INAH 称，这次破坏是由于极端天气造成的。

paras.en: INAH added that earlier work at the site, done with techniques and materials no longer used because of their negative effects, had also affected the structure's condition.
paras.zh: INAH 补充说，该地点的早期工作使用了由于负面影响而不再使用的技术和材料，也影响了结构的状况。

paras.en: Tariakuiri Alvarez, who identifies as a living member of the P'urhépecha tribe, says his ancestors would have interpreted the crumbling of the pyramid at Ihuatzio as a "bad omen".
paras.zh: 塔里亚奎里·阿尔瓦雷斯 (Tariakuiri Alvarez) 是普赫佩查部落的一名在世成员，他说，他的祖先会将伊瓦齐奥金字塔的倒塌解读为“不祥之兆”。

paras.en: It would have been a sign that the gods were "displeased".
paras.zh: 这将是众神“不高兴”的迹象。

paras.en: For modern scientists, it's also a warning.
paras.zh: 对于现代科学家来说，这也是一个警告。

paras.en: Extreme weather events and rising seas are increasingly putting precious heritage sites like this one in harm's way.
paras.zh: 极端天气事件和海平面上升正日益使像这样的珍贵遗产受到损害。

paras.en: In recent years, heavy rainfall, flooding, and hurricanes have damaged or destroyed parts of several pyramids around the world.
paras.zh: 近年来，强降雨、洪水和飓风损坏或摧毁了世界各地多座金字塔的部分区域。

paras.en: Central America has been hit more than once.
paras.zh: 中美洲不止一次受到袭击。

paras.en: In 2010, for instance, Hurricane Karl, the most destructive tropical cyclone on record to strike the Mexican state of Veracruz, took down part of another pyramid.
paras.zh: 例如，2010 年，卡尔飓风袭击了墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯州，是有记录以来最具破坏性的热带气旋，摧毁了另一座金字塔的一部分。

paras.en: On September 17, the Category 3 hurricane struck an archaeological site called La Joya on the tropical coastal plains of Central Veracruz, Mexico.
paras.zh: 9 月 17 日，三级飓风袭击了墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯中部热带沿海平原上一个名为拉霍亚 (La Joya) 的考古遗址。

paras.en: The site's pyramid is made mostly of Earth, and when high-speed winds ripped off its tarp, it was exposed to torrential rain. Weeds that had grown over the site had also weakened the structure.
paras.zh: 该遗址的金字塔主要由地球构成，当高速风吹掉其防水布时，它就暴露在倾盆大雨中。场地上长满的杂草也削弱了结构。

paras.en: A severe drying period following the hurricane merely added to the site's destruction.
paras.zh: 飓风过后的严重干旱期只会加剧该地区的破坏。

paras.en: In 2022, climatologist Jørgen Hollesen warned in an article for Antiquity that "increased rainfall, more frequent extreme weather events, higher temperatures and rising seas not only create new risks" for archaeological sites, "but also exacerbate existing vulnerabilities and threats."
paras.zh: 2022 年，气候学家 Jørgen Hollesen 在《古代》杂志上发表的一篇文章中警告说，“降雨量增加、极端天气事件更加频繁、气温升高和海平面上升不仅给考古遗址带来了新的风险”，“而且还加剧了现有的脆弱性和威胁。”

paras.en: And that's a warning not just for Central or South America, where ancient pyramid structures are common.
paras.zh: 这不仅是对中美洲或南美洲的警告，那里古代金字塔结构很常见。

paras.en: Sudan is home to more than 200 pyramids, called the Pyramids of Meroë, which were built by the kingdom of Kush between 1070 BCE and 550 CE.
paras.zh: 苏丹拥有 200 多座金字塔，称为麦罗埃金字塔，由库什王国于公元前 1070 年至公元 550 年建造。

paras.en: Their future is threatened by sand, winds, heavy rains, and flooding events.
paras.zh: 他们的未来受到沙尘、大风、暴雨和洪水的威胁。

paras.en: Studies suggest that in the last three decades alone, natural forces have increased the deterioration of these pyramids.
paras.zh: 研究表明，仅在过去三十年里，自然力量就加剧了这些金字塔的恶化。

paras.en: In 2021, the nation experienced heavy rains and flooding.
paras.zh: 2021年，全国遭遇暴雨洪涝灾害。

paras.en: That year, researchers found that 15 of the 19 pyramids they assessed were severely damaged, compared with 12 just seven years earlier.
paras.zh: 那一年，研究人员发现，他们评估的 19 座金字塔中有 15 座遭到严重损坏，而七年前只有 12 座金字塔遭到严重损坏。

paras.en: For pyramids, one of the most destructive qualities of climate change is how quickly modern weather events can swing from one extreme to another.
paras.zh: 对于金字塔来说，气候变化最具破坏性的品质之一是现代天气事件从一个极端转向另一个极端的速度有多快。

paras.en: The building materials used to construct ancient pyramids often contain clay, which can shrink and swell with changes in moisture. If rain or drought occurs too quickly or dramatically, it can lead to cracking in the material.
paras.zh: 用于建造古代金字塔的建筑材料通常含有粘土，它会随着湿度的变化而收缩和膨胀。如果降雨或干旱发生得太快或太剧烈，可能会导致材料破裂。

paras.en: Not long before the collapse of the Michoacán pyramid in 2024, for instance, Mexico had been gripped by its worst drought in 30 years.
paras.zh: 例如，在 2024 年米却肯金字塔倒塌前不久，墨西哥遭遇了 30 年来最严重的干旱。

paras.en: It was so dry that several local lakes had dried up.
paras.zh: 由于天气非常干旱，当地的几个湖泊都干涸了。

paras.en: For weeks before the pyramid's collapse, thunderstorms battered the nation.
paras.zh: 在金字塔倒塌前几周，雷暴袭击了全国。

paras.en: "The rains that have fallen in the Lake Pátzcuaro basin affected the south facade of a pre-Hispanic building," said an INAH statement at the time.
paras.zh: INAH 当时的一份声明称：“帕茨夸罗湖盆地的降雨影响了一座前西班牙建筑的南立面。”

paras.en: "High temperatures previously recorded in the area, combined with the resulting drought, caused cracks that allowed water to seep into the pre-Hispanic structure."
paras.zh: “该地区之前记录的高温，加上由此产生的干旱，导致裂缝，使水渗入前西班牙时期的结构中。”

paras.en: In June 2025, more than 10 months after the pyramid's collapse, INAH announced that it was working to restore the site.
paras.zh: 2025 年 6 月，即金字塔倒塌 10 个多月后，INAH 宣布正在努力修复该遗址。

paras.en: Three million pesos have reportedly been put aside for the project, but it's unknown what the conservation will entail.
paras.zh: 据报道，该项目已预留 300 万比索，但尚不清楚保护工作将涉及什么。

paras.en: In 2004, after drenching rains, an entire flank of a pyramid at the Maya site of Tazumal in western El Salvador also collapsed.
paras.zh: 2004年，一场大雨过后，萨尔瓦多西部塔祖马尔玛雅遗址的一座金字塔的整个侧面也倒塌了。

paras.en: Interestingly enough, however, the part that was destroyed was the new bit: the concrete reinforcements added during conservation.
paras.zh: 然而有趣的是，被破坏的部分是新的部分：在保护过程中添加的混凝土钢筋。

paras.en: The event suggests that if we want these pyramids to last, we have to be careful about how we reconstruct them.
paras.zh: 这一事件表明，如果我们希望这些金字塔能够长久存在，我们就必须谨慎对待如何重建它们。

paras.en: Otherwise, they might fall apart faster than we can fix them.
paras.zh: 否则，它们可能会比我们修复它们更快地崩溃。

articles.title: Major Study Links 99% of Heart Attacks And Strokes With Just 4 Risk Factors
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: The onset of a heart attack or stroke can take many by surprise – but most cases do not appear out of nowhere.
paras.zh: 心脏病发作或中风的发作可能会让许多人感到惊讶，但大多数病例并不是凭空出现的。

paras.en: Nearly everyone who suffers a major cardiovascular event has at least one of four risk factors in the lead-up, according to recent research.
paras.zh: 根据最近的研究，几乎每个遭受重大心血管事件的人都至少有四种危险因素之一。

paras.en: In a 2025 study of 9 million people from the US and South Korea, 99 percent of all cardiovascular events were preceded by either above-optimal blood pressure, cholesterol, or blood sugar levels, or tobacco smoking.
paras.zh: 在 2025 年对美国和韩国 900 万人进行的一项研究中，99% 的心血管事件发生之前要么是血压、胆固醇或血糖水平高于最佳水平，要么是吸烟。

paras.en: Raised blood pressure was the leading culprit.
paras.zh: 血压升高是罪魁祸首。

paras.en: It was present before 93 percent of heart attacks, strokes, or heart failure events.
paras.zh: 93% 的心脏病发作、中风或心力衰竭事件之前就存在这种情况。

paras.en: The findings suggest that staying on top of certain health risks, like blood pressure, can help patients avoid serious, potentially fatal outcomes later in life.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，控制血压等某些健康风险可以帮助患者避免在以后的生活中出现严重的、可能致命的后果。

paras.en: This year, we got more evidence of just that.
paras.zh: 今年，我们得到了更多证据证明这一点。

paras.en: A new meta-analysis of 51 trials has shown that treating hypertension can lead to rapid and lasting cardiovascular benefits.
paras.zh: 一项针对 51 项试验的新荟萃分析表明，治疗高血压可以带来快速而持久的心血管益处。

paras.en: Across more than 350,000 participants, every 5 mmHg reduction in systolic blood pressure was associated with a roughly 12 percent lower risk of stroke, ischemic heart disease, or heart failure during the first year of treatment.
paras.zh: 在超过 350,000 名参与者中，在治疗的第一年中，收缩压每降低 5 mmHg，中风、缺血性心脏病或心力衰竭的风险就会降低约 12%。

paras.en: What's more, this pattern was broadly consistent across five major classes of blood pressure drugs: ACE inhibitors, angiotensin II receptor blockers, beta-blockers, calcium channel blockers, and diuretics.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，这种模式在五类主要的降压药物中大体一致：ACE抑制剂、血管紧张素II受体阻滞剂、β-阻滞剂、钙通道阻滞剂和利尿剂。

paras.en: All of these medications seemed to help.
paras.zh: 所有这些药物似乎都有帮助。

paras.en: "Our findings show that antihypertensive therapy provides substantial cardiovascular benefits early, which are maintained over time without progressive amplification," the authors of the meta-analysis conclude.
paras.zh: 荟萃分析的作者总结道：“我们的研究结果表明，抗高血压治疗可以在早期提供显着的心血管益处，并且随着时间的推移，这种益处会得到维持，而不会逐渐放大。”

paras.en: "These findings have potentially major implications for cardiovascular prevention and clinical decision-making."
paras.zh: “这些发现对心血管预防和临床决策具有潜在的重大影响。”

paras.en: Historically, many heart attacks are blamed on clogged arteries, but the reality is more complicated, especially for younger people and women.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，许多心脏病发作都被归咎于动脉堵塞，但现实更为复杂，尤其是对于年轻人和女性而言。

paras.en: Recent evidence, for example, has found that more than half of heart attacks in women aged 65 or younger are triggered by causes other than clogged arteries.
paras.zh: 例如，最近的证据发现，65 岁或以下的女性中，一半以上的心脏病发作是由动脉阻塞以外的原因引发的。

paras.en: If doctors and patients had a clearer idea of which health factors to monitor, some risks to the heart might be managed, potentially preventing future cardiovascular events.
paras.zh: 如果医生和患者更清楚地了解要监测哪些健康因素，则可能会控制一些心脏风险，从而有可能预防未来的心血管事件。

paras.en: Decades of randomized trials show, for instance, that cholesterol-lowering medications, like statins, can significantly reduce the relative risk of a future cardiovascular event.
paras.zh: 例如，数十年的随机试验表明，他汀类药物等降胆固醇药物可以显着降低未来心血管事件的相对风险。

paras.en: According to a 2022 analysis, genetic studies suggest that for every single mmol/l decrease in 'bad cholesterol' levels sustained over a lifetime, the risk of cardiovascular disease drops by more than 50 percent.
paras.zh: 根据 2022 年的一项分析，遗传学研究表明，一生中“坏胆固醇”水平每降低一毫摩尔/升，患心血管疾病的风险就会降低 50% 以上。

paras.en: What's more, a recent randomized trial from Australia, including nearly 10,000 older adults, found that after roughly six years, those taking statins were 30 percent less likely to suffer a cardiovascular event.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，澳大利亚最近一项纳入近 10,000 名老年人的随机试验发现，大约六年后，服用他汀类药物的人发生心血管事件的可能性降低了 30%。

paras.en: Treating hypertension and cholesterol levels seems to improve cardiovascular outcomes, but improving blood glucose control also shows promise as a potential preventive target.
paras.zh: 治疗高血压和胆固醇水平似乎可以改善心血管结局，但改善血糖控制也有望成为潜在的预防目标。

paras.en: Large randomized trials consistently show that GLP-1 mimics, like Ozempic, are associated with reduced major cardiovascular events, including myocardial infarction, stroke, cardiovascular death, and heart failure.
paras.zh: 大型随机试验一致表明，GLP-1 模拟物（如 Ozempic）与减少主要心血管事件有关，包括心肌梗塞、中风、心血管死亡和心力衰竭。

paras.en: Earlier this year, an analysis of data from a randomized trial found that among people with type 2 diabetes and a history of heart failure, those taking a daily semaglutide pill were 22 percent less likely than those on a placebo to be hospitalized or need urgent care for heart failure, or to die of cardiovascular causes.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，对一项随机试验数据的分析发现，在患有心力衰竭病史的 2 型糖尿病患者中，每天服用索马鲁肽药片的患者住院或因心力衰竭需要紧急护理或死于心血管原因的可能性比服用安慰剂的患者低 22%。

paras.en: That benefit wasn't seen in those without a history of heart failure, though.
paras.zh: 不过，对于那些没有心力衰竭病史的人来说，并没有看到这种好处。

paras.en: "Collectively," the authors of a 2026 review in Circulation conclude, "these findings suggest that GLP-1 RAs influence multiple cardiometabolic pathways and may shift the underlying metabolic milieu toward a more favorable physiological state."
paras.zh: 《Circulation》2026 年综述的作者总结道：“总的来说，这些发现表明 GLP-1 RA 影响多种心脏代谢途径，并可能将潜在的代谢环境转向更有利的生理状态。”

paras.en: More studies are needed to confirm how drugs for blood glucose, hypertension, and cholesterol might work to protect the heart, but evidence increasingly suggests that they are doing something positive.
paras.zh: 需要更多的研究来证实治疗血糖、高血压和胆固醇的药物如何发挥保护心脏的作用，但越来越多的证据表明它们正在发挥积极作用。

paras.en: It's possible that the sooner health factors like hypertension, cholesterol, and glucose levels are managed or treated, the less likely poor cardiovascular outcomes might be.
paras.zh: 高血压、胆固醇和血糖水平等健康因素越早得到控制或治疗，不良心血管结局的可能性就越小。

paras.en: For tobacco smoking, that is particularly apparent.
paras.zh: 对于吸烟来说，这一点尤其明显。

paras.en: This one lifestyle factor is linked to numerous negative health outcomes, like heart failure, and quitting this addictive substance, while notoriously difficult for some, can add years to a person's life expectancy.
paras.zh: 这一生活方式因素与许多负面健康结果有关，例如心力衰竭，戒掉这种成瘾物质虽然对某些人来说非常困难，但可以延长一个人的预期寿命。

paras.en: Some recent studies suggest that if a smoker can stay away from cigarettes for a decade, they can hope to live nearly as long as someone who has never picked up a cigarette in their life.
paras.zh: 最近的一些研究表明，如果吸烟者能够远离香烟十年，他们就有希望和那些一生中从未吸过烟的人一样长寿。

paras.en: Even at the age of 75, quitting is tied to better health outcomes.
paras.zh: 即使在 75 岁时，戒烟也与更好的健康结果相关。

paras.en: Earlier this year, the former president of the American College of Cardiology, Edward Fry, argued that the US healthcare system needs to treat health concerns like tobacco smoking or hypertension before they become more serious.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，美国心脏病学会前院长爱德华·弗莱 (Edward Fry) 认为，美国医疗保健系统需要在吸烟或高血压等健康问题变得更加严重之前对其进行治疗。

paras.en: "We spend twice as much as other industrialized countries and achieve worse outcomes because we focus on fixing the car after it's broken down rather than providing preventive maintenance," Fry said.
paras.zh: 弗莱说：“我们的支出是其他工业化国家的两倍，但取得的成果却更差，因为我们专注于在汽车发生故障后修理汽车，而不是提供预防性维护。”

paras.en: If patients and doctors know which health factors raise the risk of cardiovascular events, they can take preventive action before a serious health event occurs.
paras.zh: 如果患者和医生知道哪些健康因素会增加心血管事件的风险，他们就可以在严重的健康事件发生之前采取预防措施。

paras.en: Related: US Cardiologists Issued New Guidelines For How to Manage Cholesterol
paras.zh: 相关：美国心脏病专家发布了如何管理胆固醇的新指南

paras.en: According to the American Heart Association (AHA), a 10 percent reduction in health factors, such as high blood pressure, high cholesterol, diabetes, and obesity – combined with a 20 percent improvement in the control of blood pressure, blood sugar, and cholesterol – could reduce cardiovascular and stroke events among women by up to 23 percent.
paras.zh: 根据美国心脏协会 (AHA) 的数据，高血压、高胆固醇、糖尿病和肥胖等健康因素减少 10%，再加上血压、血糖和胆固醇的控制改善 20%，可以将女性心血管和中风事件减少高达 23%。

paras.en: "These projections emphasize how critical it is that we start focusing on how to help all people stay healthy," said cardiologist Karen Joynt Maddox earlier this year.
paras.zh: 心脏病专家凯伦·乔伊特·马多克斯今年早些时候表示：“这些预测强调了我们开始关注如何帮助所有人保持健康是多么重要。”

paras.en: "Know your numbers, listen to your body, and be an advocate for your health."
paras.zh: “了解你的数字，倾听你的身体，并成为你健康的倡导者。”

paras.en: You are more in control than you might think.
paras.zh: 你比你想象的更有控制力。

paras.en: The study on the four risk factors preceding cardiovascular events was published in the Journal of the American College of Cardiology.
paras.zh: 这项关于心血管事件四个危险因素的研究发表在《美国心脏病学会杂志》上。

articles.title: Scientists Discover a Quantum Twist on a 367-Year-Old Physics Problem
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: Imagine you have a ramp, curved in a specific way.
paras.zh: 想象一下您有一个以特定方式弯曲的坡道。

paras.en: No matter from what height you release a ball on this ramp, it will always take exactly the same amount of time to reach the bottom – assuming there's no friction.
paras.zh: 无论你从什么高度在这个斜坡上释放球，它总是需要完全相同的时间到达底部——假设没有摩擦。

paras.en: Balls dropped from a greater height initially accelerate faster than those released from a lower height, which means that ultimately, they travel just fast enough to catch up at the end.
paras.zh: 从较高高度落下的球最初比从较低高度落下的球加速得更快，这意味着最终它们的移动速度足以在最后追上。

paras.en: This is the tautochrone, a mathematical problem first solved by astronomer Christiaan Huygens in 1659. The question was: what is the shape of this curve?
paras.zh: 这就是等时线，这是一个由天文学家克里斯蒂安·惠更斯 (Christiaan Huygens) 于 1659 年首次解决的数学问题。问题是：这条曲线的形状是什么？

paras.en: His answer was a cycloid – the curve traced by a point on a circle as it rolls along a straight line.
paras.zh: 他的答案是摆线——圆上一点沿着直线滚动时所描绘的曲线。

paras.en: But outside of classical physics, it doesn't have to be. A new study has solved the tautochrone for quantum mechanics – and the solution involves no cycloids, no gravity, nor even any balls.
paras.zh: 但在经典物理学之外，情况不一定如此。一项新研究解决了量子力学的等时线问题，并且该解决方案不涉及摆线、重力，甚至也不涉及任何球。

paras.en: Instead, physicist Georgios K. Simopoulos of the University of Crete and colleagues mathematically describe how various quantum particles hop around various sites in photonic and atomic lattices – and find that, under some conditions, they obey tautochrone rules.
paras.zh: 相反，克里特岛大学的物理学家 Georgios K. Simopoulos 及其同事用数学方法描述了各种量子粒子如何在光子和原子晶格中的各个位置跳跃，并发现在某些条件下，它们遵循等时线规则。

paras.en: "This quantum tautochrone effect holds for both bosons and fermions," they write in a preprint uploaded to arXiv.
paras.zh: 他们在上传到 arXiv 的预印本中写道：“这种量子等时线效应适用于玻色子和费米子。”

paras.en: In Huygens's tautochrone, gravity is the driving force. But earlier this year, some of the same researchers showed mathematically that the tautochrone effect could be reproduced without gravity, using beams of light.
paras.zh: 在惠更斯的等时线中，重力是驱动力。但今年早些时候，一些研究人员在数学上证明了等时线效应可以在没有重力的情况下使用光束重现。

paras.en: This raised an intriguing question. At the quantum scale, particles obey a different set of rules from those that govern classical physics, including the Newtonian and Einsteinian descriptions of gravity. Could a tautochrone be constructed that accommodates quantum rules, too?
paras.zh: 这提出了一个有趣的问题。在量子尺度上，粒子遵循一组与经典物理学不同的规则，包括牛顿和爱因斯坦对引力的描述。是否也可以构建一个适应量子规则的等时线？

paras.en: In both the classical light and quantum versions of the tautochrone, the trick lies in controlling how easily light or quantum particles can move between neighboring locations.
paras.zh: 在等时线的经典光和量子版本中，技巧在于控制光或量子粒子在相邻位置之间移动的容易程度。

paras.en: For both beams of light (classical) and individual photons (quantum), this can be achieved using an array of parallel channels called waveguides, between which light can pass.
paras.zh: 对于光束（经典）和单个光子（量子），这可以使用称为波导的平行通道阵列来实现，光可以在波导之间通过。

paras.en: For atoms, a similar arrangement can be created using laser light to generate a row of tiny traps, between which the atoms can move via quantum tunneling.
paras.zh: 对于原子来说，可以使用激光创建类似的排列，以生成一排微小的陷阱，原子可以通过量子隧道在陷阱之间移动。

paras.en: By varying how strongly neighboring sites are linked, the researchers could mathematically tailor the movement of quantum particles, much as the shape of Huygens's cycloid guides the movement of a ball.
paras.zh: 通过改变相邻位点的连接强度，研究人员可以在数学上调整量子粒子的运动，就像惠更斯摆线的形状引导球的运动一样。

paras.en: In their simulations, Simopoulos and his colleagues found that quantum particles starting at different locations along the lattice converged at its center simultaneously, just as balls released from different heights on a cycloid reach the bottom together.
paras.zh: 在他们的模拟中，西莫普洛斯和他的同事发现，沿着晶格从不同位置开始的量子粒子同时会聚在其中心，就像从摆线上不同高度释放的球一起到达底部一样。

paras.en: But what happened when they got there depended on the type of particle they were.
paras.zh: 但当它们到达那里时发生的情况取决于它们的粒子类型。

paras.en: Quantum particles fall into two broad categories: bosons and fermions. Multiple bosons can occupy the same quantum state at the same time. Identical fermions, on the other hand, cannot – a rule known as the Pauli exclusion principle.
paras.zh: 量子粒子分为两大类：玻色子和费米子。多个玻色子可以同时占据相同的量子态。另一方面，相同的费米子则不能——这一规则被称为泡利不相容原理。

paras.en: This difference between the two manifested quite marvelously on the tautochrone. Bosons could converge on the same lattice site – but while fermions arrived in the same region at the same time, they occupied separate sites.
paras.zh: 两者之间的这种差异在等时线上表现得非常奇妙。玻色子可以聚集在同一个晶格位置上，但是虽然费米子同时到达同一区域，但它们占据了不同的位置。

paras.en: The researchers also investigated what happens when bosonic atoms interact with each other. A weak attraction between the atoms brought them together slightly ahead of schedule, while a weak repulsion delayed their arrival.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了玻色子原子相互作用时会发生什么。原子之间的微弱吸引力使它们稍微提前聚集在一起，而微弱的排斥力则延迟了它们的到达。

paras.en: Curiously, though, strong interactions – whether attractive or repulsive – suppressed the convergence of the atoms onto the same site.
paras.zh: 但奇怪的是，强相互作用——无论是吸引还是排斥——抑制了原子聚集到同一位置。

paras.en: You'd think at least strong attraction would bring them together. The fact that it doesn't comes down to the conservation of energy.
paras.zh: 你可能会认为至少强大的吸引力会让他们走到一起。事实上，这并不取决于能量守恒。

paras.en: When two atoms occupy the same site, their interaction changes their energy – lowering it if they attract, and raising it if they repel.
paras.zh: 当两个原子占据同一位置时，它们的相互作用会改变它们的能量——如果它们相互吸引，能量就会降低；如果它们相互排斥，能量就会升高。

paras.en: To conserve energy, this change must be balanced by a corresponding change in the energy associated with their movement through the lattice, a bit like Huygens's falling ball losing potential energy but gaining kinetic energy, maintaining the same total energy.
paras.zh: 为了守恒能量，这种变化必须通过与它们在晶格中运动相关的能量的相应变化来平衡，这有点像惠更斯的落球失去势能但获得动能，从而保持相同的总能量。

paras.en: But the atoms aren't moving freely through space. The connections between the traps impose a limit on the range of energies available to them.
paras.zh: 但原子并不能在太空中自由移动。陷阱之间的连接对其可用的能量范围施加了限制。

paras.en: If the attraction or repulsion is too strong, the atoms cannot compensate for the energy gained or lost through their interactions – so, instead, they tend to gather on separate sites near the center.
paras.zh: 如果吸引力或排斥力太强，原子就无法补偿通过相互作用获得或损失的能量——因此，它们往往会聚集在中心附近的不同位置。

paras.en: Unlike Huygens's tautochrone, which he used to improve the accuracy of pendulum clocks, the quantum tautochrone so far exists only on paper.
paras.zh: 与惠更斯用来提高摆钟精度的等时线不同，量子等时线迄今为止只存在于纸面上。

paras.en: But the ability to precisely control where and when quantum particles converge could have applications in quantum technologies, particularly those that use light to process information.
paras.zh: 但精确控制量子粒子汇聚的地点和时间的能力可以在量子技术中得到应用，特别是那些使用光处理信息的技术。

paras.en: The work has also opened up new questions, such as whether the tautochrone effect persists in more complex quantum systems involving large numbers of interacting particles – and about where else the quantum tautochrone might emerge.
paras.zh: 这项工作还提出了新的问题，例如等时线效应是否持续存在于涉及大量相互作用粒子的更复杂的量子系统中，以及量子等时线可能出现在哪里。

paras.en: "Beyond engineered lattices, signatures of the quantum tautochrone may also be accessible in many-body dynamics in optical traps without an underlying lattice and in slow-light propagation through elongated atomic ensembles," the researchers write.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“除了工程晶格之外，量子等时线的特征也可以在没有底层晶格的光陷阱的多体动力学中以及通过细长原子系综的慢光传播中获得。”

paras.en: Their paper is not yet peer-reviewed, but a preprint is available on arXiv.
paras.zh: 他们的论文尚未经过同行评审，但 arXiv 上提供了预印本。

articles.title: Breathing less oxygen tripled lifespan in mice with a deadly brain disorder

paras.en: Breathing less oxygen tripled lifespan in mice with a deadly brain disorder
paras.zh: 呼吸较少的氧气可使患有致命脑部疾病的小鼠寿命延长三倍

paras.en: Oxygen is essential for life, but too much of it can become dangerously toxic, particularly in people with certain neurological and mitochondrial disorders. Scientists at Gladstone Institutes have discovered that defective proteins can disrupt the ability of mitochondria to consume oxygen, allowing harmful levels to accumulate in tissues. Remarkably, mice with a genetic disorder that causes motor neuron degeneration lived three times longer when they breathed air containing less oxygen.
paras.zh: 氧气对于生命至关重要，但过多可能会产生危险的毒性，特别是对于患有某些神经系统和线粒体疾病的人来说。格拉德斯通研究所的科学家发现，有缺陷的蛋白质会破坏线粒体消耗氧气的能力，使有害水平在组织中积聚。值得注意的是，患有导致运动神经元变性的遗传性疾病的小鼠，当呼吸含氧量较少的空气时，寿命会延长三倍。

paras.en: Oxygen is essential for human survival and for most forms of life. Yet under certain conditions, it can become dangerously toxic, causing serious damage to the body.
paras.zh: 氧气对于人类生存和大多数生命形式至关重要。但在某些条件下，它可能会产生危险的毒性，对身体造成严重损害。

paras.en: In the brain, excessive oxygen levels have been linked to a rare and often fatal childhood disorder called 3-MGA, as well as Leigh syndrome (the most common pediatric mitochondrial disease), Parkinson's disease, and premature aging. Researchers at Gladstone Institutes are now investigating a promising approach that could potentially help treat these conditions by reducing the amount of oxygen available to the body, a strategy known as hypoxia therapy.
paras.zh: 在大脑中，过量的氧气水平与一种罕见且通常致命的儿童疾病（称为 3-MGA）以及 Leigh 综合征（最常见的儿科线粒体疾病）、帕金森病和过早衰老有关。格拉德斯通研究所的研究人员现在正在研究一种有前途的方法，该方法可能通过减少身体可用的氧气量来帮助治疗这些疾病，这种策略称为缺氧疗法。

paras.en: For the past decade, Gladstone Investigator Isha Jain, PhD, has studied how oxygen levels influence health and disease. Her research has explored how the reduced oxygen availability at high altitudes can produce beneficial effects in conditions ranging from Leigh syndrome and diabetes to solid tumors.
paras.zh: 在过去的十年中，格莱斯顿研究员 Isha Jain 博士研究了氧气水平如何影响健康和疾病。她的研究探索了高海拔地区氧气供应量的减少如何对利氏综合征、糖尿病和实体瘤等疾病产生有益的影响。

paras.en: Expanding the Potential of Hypoxia Therapy
paras.zh: 扩大缺氧治疗的潜力

paras.en: Jain and her colleagues wanted to determine whether lowering oxygen levels could also benefit people with other rare and common conditions involving mitochondrial dysfunction and neurological damage.
paras.zh: Jain 和她的同事想要确定降低氧气水平是否也能让患有其他罕见和常见疾病（涉及线粒体功能障碍和神经损伤）的人受益。

paras.en: For a new study published in Nature Metabolism, the team partnered with James Shorter, PhD, professor of biochemistry and biophysics at the University of Pennsylvania, and Daniel Southworth, PhD, professor of biochemistry and biophysics at UC San Francisco.
paras.zh: 在《自然代谢》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，该团队与宾夕法尼亚大学生物化学和生物物理学教授 James Shorter 博士以及加州大学旧金山分校生物化学和生物物理学教授 Daniel Southworth 博士合作。

paras.en: The researchers discovered that a malfunctioning protein known as HTRA2 can cause oxygen to accumulate to dangerous levels in tissues. Remarkably, reducing the oxygen concentration in the air dramatically extended lifespan and improved brain function in mice experiencing motor neuron degeneration caused by defective HTRA2.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，一种名为 HTRA2 的故障蛋白质会导致组织中的氧气积聚到危险水平。值得注意的是，降低空气中的氧气浓度可以显着延长因 HTRA2 缺陷导致的运动神经元变性小鼠的寿命并改善其大脑功能。

paras.en: "This protein is linked to many other conditions, so our findings suggest that hypoxia therapy could be transformative for treating many neurological diseases," says Jain, who is also a core investigator at Arc Institute.
paras.zh: “这种蛋白质与许多其他疾病有关，因此我们的研究结果表明，缺氧疗法可能对许多神经系统疾病的治疗具有革命性的意义，”Arc 研究所的核心研究员 Jain 说。

paras.en: How Excess Oxygen Becomes Toxic to the Brain
paras.zh: 过量的氧气如何对大脑产生毒性

paras.en: Most cells contain tiny structures called mitochondria, which use oxygen to generate the energy the body needs to function. One of the most important components of this energy production system is Complex 1, the largest molecular machine within the mitochondria's respiratory machinery.
paras.zh: 大多数细胞都含有称为线粒体的微小结构，它利用氧气产生身体运作所需的能量。这个能量生产系统最重要的组成部分之一是 Complex 1，它是线粒体呼吸机制中最大的分子机器。

paras.en: "Every time we breathe, 90 percent of the oxygen we consume goes to our mitochondria," says Ankur Garg, PhD, postdoctoral fellow in Jain's lab and first author of the study. "But if Complex 1 malfunctions, the mitochondria can no longer burn off oxygen at normal rates."
paras.zh: “每次我们呼吸时，我们消耗的 90% 的氧气都会进入线粒体，”Jain 实验室的博士后研究员、该研究的第一作者 Ankur Garg 博士说。 “但如果复合体 1 发生故障，线粒体就无法再以正常速率燃烧氧气。”

paras.en: When mitochondria lose their ability to consume oxygen efficiently, the unused oxygen can accumulate in surrounding tissues and eventually reach toxic levels. This process can contribute to the brain damage associated with certain mitochondrial and neurological disorders. The researchers suspected that reducing oxygen availability might help prevent some of this damage.
paras.zh: 当线粒体失去有效消耗氧气的能力时，未使用的氧气会在周围组织中积聚并最终达到有毒水平。这一过程可能会导致与某些线粒体和神经系统疾病相关的脑损伤。研究人员怀疑，减少氧气供应可能有助于防止这种损害。

paras.en: Identifying Genetic Causes of Oxygen Toxicity
paras.zh: 确定氧中毒的遗传原因

paras.en: To identify diseases that might respond to hypoxia therapy, the team revisited data from an earlier large experiment. They searched for genes whose absence impaired cell growth under normal oxygen conditions but allowed cells to grow normally when oxygen levels were reduced.
paras.zh: 为了确定可能对缺氧治疗有反应的疾病，研究小组重新审视了早期大型实验的数据。他们寻找那些在正常氧气条件下缺失会损害细胞生长但在氧气水平降低时允许细胞正常生长的基因。

paras.en: By comparing these results with a database of known genetic disorders, the researchers identified 75 genes directly associated with diseases that could potentially benefit from hypoxia therapy.
paras.zh: 通过将这些结果与已知遗传性疾病的数据库进行比较，研究人员确定了 75 个与可能受益于缺氧治疗的疾病直接相关的基因。

paras.en: Among the most promising candidates was the gene encoding HTRA2. Further investigation revealed that HTRA2 works alongside another protein (CLPB) to maintain the structural integrity of Complex 1.
paras.zh: 最有希望的候选基因是编码 HTRA2 的基因。进一步的研究表明，HTRA2 与另一种蛋白质 (CLPB) 一起发挥作用，维持复合物 1 的结构完整性。

paras.en: "Together, these two proteins act like a clean-up crew inside mitochondria, preventing the machinery from becoming clogged with clumps of misfolded proteins," says Jain.
paras.zh: Jain 说：“这两种蛋白质一起发挥作用，就像线粒体内的清理人员一样，防止机器被错误折叠的蛋白质团块堵塞。”

paras.en: The team found that when HTRA2 and CLPB are absent or malfunctioning, this cellular maintenance system breaks down. As a result, a critical component of Complex 1 stops functioning properly.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，当 HTRA2 和 CLPB 缺失或出现故障时，这种细胞维护系统就会崩溃。结果，复合物 1 的一个关键组件停止正常运作。

paras.en: Breathing Less Oxygen Triples Lifespan in Mice
paras.zh: 呼吸较少的氧气可使小鼠的寿命延长三倍

paras.en: To determine whether reducing oxygen levels could provide therapeutic benefits in a living organism, the researchers conducted experiments on mice deficient in HTRA2.
paras.zh: 为了确定降低氧气水平是否可以为生物体带来治疗效果，研究人员对缺乏 HTRA2 的小鼠进行了实验。

paras.en: Mice that breathed air containing less oxygen lived three times as long as those breathing normal atmospheric air, which contains approximately 21 percent oxygen. The treatment also reduced inflammation in the striatum, a region of the brain.
paras.zh: 呼吸含氧量较低空气的小鼠的寿命是呼吸正常大气空气（含氧量约为 21%）的小鼠的三倍。这种治疗还减少了纹状体（大脑的一个区域）的炎症。

paras.en: "By showing these mice could be successfully treated with low oxygen, our study expands the potential of hypoxia therapy to a wide range of conditions that affect mitochondrial Complex 1, either directly or indirectly as in the case of HTRA2 deficiency," Garg says. "This will motivate a broader application of 'turning the oxygen dial' to conditions ranging from rare genetic diseases to common neurological conditions and beyond."
paras.zh: Garg 说：“通过证明这些小鼠可以成功地接受低氧治疗，我们的研究将缺氧疗法的潜力扩展到了直接或间接影响线粒体复合物 1 的多种疾病，例如 HTRA2 缺乏症。” “这将推动‘转动氧气旋钮’更广泛地应用于从罕见遗传疾病到常见神经系统疾病等疾病。”

paras.en: Developing a Drug That Mimics Low Oxygen
paras.zh: 开发模拟低氧的药物

paras.en: Although the experiments involved having mice breathe air with reduced oxygen concentrations, Jain and her colleagues are working toward a more practical approach. They are developing a drug called HypoxyStat that could potentially reproduce the therapeutic benefits of low oxygen through a pill or injection.
paras.zh: 尽管实验涉及让小鼠呼吸氧气浓度较低的空气，但贾恩和她的同事正在研究一种更实用的方法。他们正在开发一种名为 HypoxyStat 的药物，该药物有可能通过药丸或注射来重现低氧的治疗效果。

paras.en: "Right now, no treatments are uniformly available for mitochondrial diseases, and hypoxia therapy offers the hope that we could treat not just one, but many of these genetic conditions," Jain says. "We're working hard to make it a practical treatment for human patients in the clinic."
paras.zh: “目前，对于线粒体疾病还没有统一的治疗方法，缺氧疗法为我们带来了希望，即我们不仅可以治疗一种遗传疾病，而且可以治疗许多遗传疾病，”杰恩说。 “我们正在努力使其成为临床上对人类患者的实用治疗方法。”

paras.en: Materials provided by Gladstone Institutes. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由格拉德斯通研究所提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Ankur Garg, Brandon R. Desousa, Raju Roy, Amy Flis, Skyler Y. Blume, Yohei Abe, Arthur A. Melo, Ryan R. Cupo, Gabriela Grigorean, Daniel R. Southworth, James Shorter, Isha H. Jain. Hypoxia rescues complex 1-associated disease caused by proteostatic defects. Nature Metabolism, 2026; 8 (8): 1791 DOI: 10.1038/s42255-026-01566-0
paras.zh: - Ankur Garg、Brandon R. Desousa、Raju Roy、Amy Flis、Skyler Y. Blume、Yohei Abe、Arthur A. Melo、Ryan R. Cupo、Gabriela Grigorean、Daniel R. Southworth、James Shorter、Isha H. Jain。缺氧可挽救由蛋白缺陷引起的复杂 1 相关疾病。自然新陈代谢，2026； 8 (8): 1791 DOI: 10.1038/s42255-026-01566-0

articles.title: Scientists turn one of the world’s hardest-to-recycle plastics into high-performance lubricating oil

paras.en: Scientists turn one of the worldâs hardest-to-recycle plastics into high-performance lubricating oil
paras.zh: 科学家将世界上最难回收的塑料之一转化为高性能润滑油

paras.en: Virginia Tech scientists have discovered how to transform one of the world's hardest-to-recycle plastics into a valuable ingredient for high-performance engine oil. Their innovative process converts discarded PVC into a useful lubricant material in just three hours. The breakthrough could turn a major source of plastic pollution into a valuable industrial resource while making lubricant production more sustainable.
paras.zh: 弗吉尼亚理工大学的科学家们发现了如何将世界上最难回收的塑料之一转化为高性能发动机油的宝贵成分。他们的创新工艺在短短三个小时内将废弃的 PVC 转化为有用的润滑剂材料。这一突破可以将塑料污染的主要来源转变为宝贵的工业资源，同时使润滑油生产更加可持续。

paras.en: Old plumbing pipes, discarded window frames, and expired credit cards could one day become valuable ingredients in engine oil. Researchers at Virginia Tech have developed a new chemical process that transforms one of the world's most difficult plastics to recycle into a high-performance lubricant material.
paras.zh: 旧的水管、废弃的窗框和过期的信用卡有一天可能会成为发动机油中的宝贵成分。弗吉尼亚理工大学的研究人员开发了一种新的化学工艺，可将世界上最难回收的塑料之一转化为高性能润滑材料。

paras.en: Led by chemist and chemical engineer Guoliang "Greg" Liu, the research team discovered how to convert polyvinyl chloride (PVC) into polyalphaolefin, a key ingredient in synthetic lubricants such as engine oil.
paras.zh: 由化学家和化学工程师Guoliang“Greg”Liu领导的研究小组发现了如何将聚氯乙烯（PVC）转化为聚α-烯烃，这是合成润滑油（如发动机油）的关键成分。

paras.en: Published in the journal Nature, the research offers a potential solution to two environmental challenges: reducing the accumulation of stubborn plastic waste and finding more sustainable ways to manufacture valuable industrial lubricants.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《自然》杂志上，为解决两个环境挑战提供了潜在的解决方案：减少顽固塑料废物的积累，并寻找更可持续的方法来制造有价值的工业润滑油。

paras.en: PVC is particularly difficult to recycle because of its chlorine content and the wide range of chemical additives manufacturers incorporate into their products. These additives can give PVC different properties, such as flexibility, rigidity, and resistance to heat. However, they also complicate conventional recycling methods. Consequently, much of the world's discarded PVC ends up in landfills.
paras.zh: PVC 特别难以回收，因为它含有氯，而且制造商在其产品中加入了多种化学添加剂。这些添加剂可以赋予PVC不同的性能，如柔韧性、刚性和耐热性。然而，它们也使传统的回收方法变得复杂。因此，世界上大部分废弃的聚氯乙烯最终都被填埋。

paras.en: Turning Plastic Waste Into High-Performance Lubricants
paras.zh: 将塑料废物转化为高性能润滑剂

paras.en: Meanwhile, global demand for lubricants continues to grow, and producing these materials can come with significant environmental costs. Transforming discarded PVC into a valuable lubricant ingredient could help address both problems.
paras.zh: 与此同时，全球对润滑剂的需求持续增长，生产这些材料可能会带来巨大的环境成本。将废弃的 PVC 转化为有价值的润滑剂成分有助于解决这两个问题。

paras.en: Although lubricants rarely attract much attention, they are essential to modern machinery. They reduce friction and wear between moving components, helping engines operate efficiently and extending the lifespan of mechanical equipment. Everything from lawn mowers and passenger vehicles to jet engines depends on reliable lubricants.
paras.zh: 尽管润滑剂很少引起太多关注，但它们对于现代机械至关重要。它们减少运动部件之间的摩擦和磨损，帮助发动机高效运行并延长机械设备的使用寿命。从割草机、乘用车到喷气发动机，一切都依赖于可靠的润滑油。

paras.en: The Virginia Tech team's process could provide an alternative source of these important materials while helping address the growing problem of plastic pollution.
paras.zh: 弗吉尼亚理工大学团队的工艺可以提供这些重要材料的替代来源，同时帮助解决日益严重的塑料污染问题。

paras.en: To make the lubricant, researchers place PVC of the kind commonly used in household plumbing, window frames, and credit cards into a solvent. They then introduce aluminum trichloride and alpha-olefins, a class of hydrocarbons used in the manufacture of synthetic lubricants. The mixture is heated to 158 degrees Fahrenheit for three hours, after which the researchers extract a relatively thick lubricating oil.
paras.zh: 为了制造润滑剂，研究人员将家用管道、窗框和信用卡中常用的 PVC 放入溶剂中。然后他们引入了三氯化铝和α-烯烃，这是一类用于制造合成润滑剂的碳氢化合物。将混合物加热至 158 华氏度并保持三个小时，之后研究人员提取出相对稠厚的润滑油。

paras.en: The resulting polyalphaolefin belongs to a family of synthetic base oils valued for their stability, lubricating properties, and ability to perform across a wide range of temperatures. These materials are commonly used as the foundation for high-performance synthetic engine oils.
paras.zh: 由此产生的聚 α 烯烃属于合成基础油家族，因其稳定性、润滑性能和在宽温度范围内运行的能力而受到重视。这些材料通常用作高性能合成发动机油的基础。

paras.en: "Number one, we have proved that it is feasible to use plastic waste to make high-performance lubricants. Number two, these lubricants are green, and they can meet the emerging needs for sustainability by the market," Liu said.
paras.zh: “第一，我们已经证明利用塑料废料制造高性能润滑油是可行的。第二，这些润滑油是绿色的，可以满足市场对可持续发展的新兴需求，”刘说。

paras.en: Building on Earlier Plastic Recycling Breakthroughs
paras.zh: 以早期塑料回收突破为基础

paras.en: The discovery grew out of previous research by Liu's laboratory, published in Science and Nature Sustainability. In those studies, the researchers demonstrated how other types of plastic waste could be transformed into surfactants, substances that help water interact with oils and grease and are widely used in soaps and detergents.
paras.zh: 这一发现源于刘实验室之前的研究，发表在《科学》和《自然可持续发展》杂志上。在这些研究中，研究人员展示了如何将其他类型的塑料废物转化为表面活性剂，表面活性剂有助于水与油和油脂相互作用，并广泛用于肥皂和洗涤剂中。

paras.en: Encouraged by those successes, the researchers decided to tackle the more challenging problem of PVC waste.
paras.zh: 在这些成功的鼓舞下，研究人员决定着手解决更具挑战性的PVC废弃物问题。

paras.en: "We want to help improve the recycling and upcycling of PVC," Liu said.
paras.zh: “我们希望帮助改善 PVC 的回收和升级回收，”刘说。

paras.en: Unlike conventional recycling, which typically aims to recover materials for reuse, upcycling seeks to transform discarded materials into products with greater value or usefulness.
paras.zh: 与通常旨在回收​​材料以供再利用的传统回收不同，升级回收旨在将废弃材料转化为具有更大价值或有用性的产品。

paras.en: Liu recruited a group of graduate researchers to investigate this possibility. Eric Munyaneza Nuwayo, who was completing the final year of his doctoral program, was selected to lead the project. Connor S. Thompson, a chemistry graduate student who had been pursuing a different research topic, joined the effort after Liu suggested changing direction.
paras.zh: 刘招募了一组研究生研究人员来研究这种可能性。即将完成博士课程最后一年的 Eric Munyaneza Nuwayo 被选为该项目的负责人。化学研究生康纳·S·汤普森(Connor S. Thompson)一直在从事不同的研究课题，在刘建议改变方向后加入了这一努力。

paras.en: Abby Civiello, a graduate student in her first year, also joined the team and quickly became an important contributor to the research.
paras.zh: 第一年的研究生 Abby Civiello 也加入了该团队，并很快成为该研究的重要贡献者。

paras.en: "I often called them the three musketeers," Liu said.
paras.zh: “我经常称他们为三个火枪手，”刘说。

paras.en: An Unexpected Discovery in Polymer Chemistry
paras.zh: 高分子化学的意外发现

paras.en: The researchers initially experimented with ways to modify the molecular structure of PVC and convert it into more useful substances.
paras.zh: 研究人员最初尝试了修改PVC分子结构并将其转化为更有用的物质的方法。

paras.en: Like other plastics, PVC is a polymer, meaning it consists of long molecular chains made up of repeating chemical units. The researchers initially hoped that changing the chemical groups attached to these chains would produce a material with desirable properties.
paras.zh: 与其他塑料一样，PVC 是一种聚合物，这意味着它由重复化学单元组成的长分子链组成。研究人员最初希望通过改变这些链上的化学基团来生产具有所需性能的材料。

paras.en: "The idea was simple. PVC, as one of the most activated forms of polyethylene, ought to be easily converted into some other molecules by replacing the chlorine atoms with other groups," Liu said.
paras.zh: “这个想法很简单。PVC作为聚乙烯最活跃的形式之一，应该可以通过用其他基团取代氯原子来轻松转化为其他一些分子，”刘说。

paras.en: However, the early experiments consistently produced disappointing results. Instead of creating a functional material with the desired performance characteristics, the team ended up with soft, sticky substances that had little practical value.
paras.zh: 然而，早期的实验始终产生令人失望的结果。该团队最终没有创造出具有所需性能特征的功能材料，而是得到了几乎没有实用价值的柔软、粘性物质。

paras.en: Those frustrating results eventually inspired Liu to approach the problem differently. Rather than continuing to modify the long molecular chains, he wondered whether breaking them into smaller pieces might produce something more useful.
paras.zh: 这些令人沮丧的结果最终激励刘以不同的方式解决这个问题。他没有继续修改长分子链，而是想知道将它们分解成更小的片段是否会产生更有用的东西。

paras.en: "One day I realized -- if this polymer is so gooey and so soft, why don't I just keep breaking the polymer chains down to smaller segments?" said Liu.
paras.zh: “有一天我意识到——如果这种聚合物如此粘稠且如此柔软，我为什么不继续将聚合物链分解成更小的片段呢？”刘说。

paras.en: As the researchers refined their chemical process and evaluated the properties of the materials it produced, Liu began to recognize that the team had discovered something with implications extending well beyond plastic recycling.
paras.zh: 随着研究人员改进化学工艺并评估其生产的材料的特性，刘开始认识到该团队发现了一些影响远远超出塑料回收范围的东西。

paras.en: They had found a potential new route for manufacturing valuable industrial lubricants.
paras.zh: 他们找到了一条生产有价值的工业润滑油的潜在新途径。

paras.en: Bringing Recycled Plastic Lubricants to the Market
paras.zh: 将再生塑料润滑剂推向市场

paras.en: To better understand the properties and commercial potential of the new oil, Liu enlisted the expertise of researchers at several institutions.
paras.zh: 为了更好地了解这种新石油的特性和商业潜力，刘聘请了多家机构研究人员的专业知识。

paras.en: He provided samples to Ali Erdemir at Texas A&M University, where researchers evaluated the performance of the finished materials. William Goddard at the California Institute of Technology, or Caltech, contributed chemical computations to help investigate the underlying chemistry.
paras.zh: 他向德克萨斯农工大学的 Ali Erdemir 提供了样品，该大学的研究人员评估了成品材料的性能。加州理工学院 (Caltech) 的威廉·戈达德 (William Goddard) 贡献了化学计算，以帮助研究基础化学。

paras.en: At Virginia Tech, Xi Chen examined the economic and manufacturing aspects of the technology, developing models to explore how the oil could be produced on a larger scale.
paras.zh: 在弗吉尼亚理工大学，陈曦研究了该技术的经济和制造方面，开发了模型来探索如何大规模生产石油。

paras.en: The research establishes that discarded PVC can serve as a starting material for producing high-performance lubricants. However, expanding the process beyond the laboratory remains an important next step.
paras.zh: 研究表明，废弃的 PVC 可以作为生产高性能润滑剂的原材料。然而，将这一过程扩展到实验室之外仍然是重要的下一步。

paras.en: Liu hopes to further improve the environmental sustainability of the technology while making the resulting lubricants more widely available. Ultimately, the approach could give one of the world's most problematic plastics a valuable second life and provide industries with an alternative source of essential lubricating materials.
paras.zh: 刘希望进一步提高该技术的环境可持续性，同时使由此产生的润滑油得到更广泛的使用。最终，该方法可以使世界上问题最严重的塑料之一获得宝贵的第二次生命，并为各行业提供基本润滑材料的替代来源。

paras.en: "Lubricants are the silent hero out there. We often don't recognize they exist, but they are out there working quietly. We want to be able to produce the oil on a larger scale to reach more people in the world," Liu said.
paras.zh: “润滑油是沉默的英雄。我们常常没有意识到它们的存在，但它们却在默默地工作。我们希望能够更大规模地生产润滑油，以惠及世界上更多的人，”刘说。

paras.en: Materials provided by Virginia Tech. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由弗吉尼亚理工大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Eric Munyaneza Nuwayo, Connor Thompson, Abby Civiello, Adrian DiMarco, Jingtao Zhang, Seungjoo Lee, Gugyeong Sung, Tridip Das, Yue Zhang, Clark Vu, Shelby Koshak, John B.
