articles.title: The narwhal’s legendary “unicorn horn” holds a remarkable engineering secret

paras.en: The narwhalâs legendary âunicorn hornâ holds a remarkable engineering secret
paras.zh: 独角鲸的传奇“独角兽角”拥有非凡的工程秘密

paras.en: The narwhalâs iconic spiral tusk, once prized in Europe as the horn of a mythical unicorn, conceals an extraordinary feat of natural engineering. Using advanced X-ray technology, an international team of scientists discovered that the tusk contains two intertwined microscopic spirals that twist in opposite directions.
paras.zh: 独角鲸标志性的螺旋獠牙曾在欧洲被视为神话独角兽的角而备受推崇，它隐藏着自然工程的非凡壮举。利用先进的 X 射线技术，一个国际科学家团队发现象牙包含两个相互缠绕的微观螺旋，它们以相反的方向扭曲。

paras.en: In the 17th century, Danish King Frederik III already knew that the legendary unicorn horn came from a real animal. However, this creature had fins instead of hooves and inhabited the icy waters of the Arctic. The king dispatched an expedition to Greenland to investigate the source of these highly prized objects. The successful mission earned him a throne fashioned entirely from "unicorn horns," enhancing his power and prestige across Europe. Yet the treasured horn was not actually a horn, but "merely" a tooth.
paras.zh: 17世纪，丹麦国王腓特烈三世就已经知道传说中的独角兽角来自于真实的动物。然而，这种生物有鳍而不是蹄，居住在北极冰冷的水域。国王派遣了一支探险队前往格陵兰岛调查这些珍贵物品的来源。这次成功的任务为他赢得了完全由“独角兽角”制成的王座，增强了他在欧洲的权力和威望。然而，这珍贵的角实际上并不是角，而“仅仅是”一颗牙齿。

paras.en: The narwhal's tusk is unlike almost any other tooth in nature. Whereas elongated teeth, including elephant and walrus tusks and beaver incisors, grow in curved shapes, the male narwhal develops a remarkable corkscrew-shaped tooth. Typically, the upper left canine grows forward through the upper lip, twisting counterclockwise as it extends. It can reach two meters (6.6 feet) in length, equivalent to as much as half the animal's body length.
paras.zh: 独角鲸的象牙与自然界中几乎任何其他牙齿都不同。细长的牙齿，包括大象、海象的象牙和海狸的门牙，都是弯曲形状的，而雄性独角鲸却长出了引人注目的螺旋形牙齿。通常，左上尖牙通过上唇向前生长，并在延伸时逆时针扭转。它的长度可达两米（6.6英尺），相当于动物身体长度的一半。

paras.en: This unusual biological structure caught the attention of an international team of researchers from several scientific disciplines. Using advanced X-ray imaging techniques, they set out to determine whether the arrangement of the tusk's microscopic building blocks could explain the direction of its visible spiral.
paras.zh: 这种不寻常的生物结构引起了来自多个科学学科的国际研究团队的注意。他们利用先进的 X 射线成像技术，着手确定象牙微观构件的排列是否可以解释其可见螺旋的方向。

paras.en: What they discovered was even more remarkable than expected. Rather than forming a single spiral, the tusk's tiny structural components create two intertwined helices that twist in opposite directions. Together, they produce an exceptionally stable structure.
paras.zh: 他们的发现比预想的更加引人注目。象牙的微小结构部件不是形成单个螺旋，而是形成两个相互缠绕的螺旋，并以相反的方向扭曲。它们共同产生了异常稳定的结构。

paras.en: The research was conducted at three major European synchrotron facilities: the Swiss Light Source SLS at the Paul Scherrer Institute in Villigen, the MAX IV Laboratory in Lund (Sweden), and the European Synchrotron Radiation Facility ESRF in Grenoble (France). The findings were published in Nature Communications.
paras.zh: 这项研究是在欧洲三个主要同步加速器设施中进行的：维利根 Paul Scherrer 研究所的瑞士光源 SLS、隆德（瑞典）的 MAX IV 实验室和格勒诺布尔（法国）的欧洲同步辐射设施 ESRF。研究结果发表在《自然通讯》上。

paras.en: A Giant Tooth Built Like Reinforced Concrete
paras.zh: 像钢筋混凝土一样建造的巨齿

paras.en: Narwhal tusks continue growing throughout the animals' lives and can easily reach 70 years of age. Despite their striking appearance, the precise purpose of these enormous teeth remains uncertain. Evidence suggests they are primarily involved in mate selection. Narwhals have also been observed crossing their tusks in playful "duels," supporting the idea that the structures are important for reproduction and social interactions.
paras.zh: 独角鲸的象牙在动物的一生中不断生长，很容易活到 70 岁。尽管它们的外观引人注目，但这些巨大牙齿的确切用途仍然不确定。有证据表明它们主要参与择偶。人们还观察到独角鲸在有趣的“决斗”中交叉獠牙，这支持了这种结构对于繁殖和社会互动很重要的观点。

paras.en: Although questions remain about how narwhals use their tusks, scientists now have a much clearer picture of how they are constructed.
paras.zh: 尽管独角鲸如何使用象牙仍存在疑问，但科学家们现在对它们的构造有了更清晰的了解。

paras.en: "Like bones or other teeth in the animal kingdom, the narwhal tusk is a complex composite material whose structure extends from tiny nanoscale building blocks to the visible form of the entire tooth," says Marianne Liebi, a PSI researcher and co-author of the study.
paras.zh: PSI 研究员、该研究的合著者玛丽安·利比 (Marianne Liebi) 表示：“就像动物王国中的骨头或其他牙齿一样，独角鲸的长牙是一种复杂的复合材料，其结构从微小的纳米级构件延伸到整个牙齿的可见形式。”

paras.en: Composite materials combine different substances to achieve properties that the individual components cannot provide alone. Reinforced concrete is a familiar example. Concrete made from cement and sand can withstand considerable pressure, while an internal steel framework helps resist pulling forces and provides additional stability.
paras.zh: 复合材料将不同的物质结合起来，以实现单个组件无法单独提供的性能。钢筋混凝土是一个常见的例子。由水泥和沙子制成的混凝土可以承受相当大的压力，而内部钢框架有助于抵抗拉力并提供额外的稳定性。

paras.en: "The narwhal tusk, too, must be both hard and flexible," Liebi explains. "Only then can it withstand the strong hydrodynamic forces that swimming generates."
paras.zh: “独角鲸的象牙也必须既坚硬又灵活，”利比解释道。 “只有这样，它才能承受游泳产生的强大水动力。”

paras.en: The Remarkable Microscopic Structure of Narwhal Tusks
paras.zh: 独角鲸象牙的显着微观结构

paras.en: Most of the narwhal's tusk consists of dentin, the same hard tissue that makes up much of the interior of human teeth. A thinner layer of cementum covers its exterior. In other mammals, cementum is typically confined to the roots of teeth.
paras.zh: 独角鲸的象牙大部分由牙本质组成，牙本质与构成人类牙齿内部大部分的硬组织相同。其外部覆盖有一层较薄的牙骨质。在其他哺乳动物中，牙骨质通常局限于牙根。

paras.en: Both materials contain extremely fine collagen fibers strengthened by tiny mineral crystals. Much like the steel framework inside reinforced concrete, the collagen fibers provide internal reinforcement, while the mineral crystals supply hardness. This combination allows the tusk to possess both strength and flexibility.
paras.zh: 这两种材料都含有极细的胶原纤维，并通过微小的矿物晶体强化。就像钢筋混凝土内的钢框架一样，胶原纤维提供内部加固，而矿物晶体则提供硬度。这种组合使得象牙兼具强度和灵活性。

paras.en: Understanding how this microscopic arrangement produces the much larger spiral presented a significant scientific challenge.
paras.zh: 了解这种微观排列如何产生更大的螺旋是一项重大的科学挑战。

paras.en: "The collagen fibers and mineral crystals are on the nanometer scale, while the spiral of the tooth only becomes visible at centimeter and meter lengths," Marianne Liebi explains.
paras.zh: “胶原纤维和矿物晶体是纳米级的，而牙齿的螺旋只有在厘米和米长时才可见，”玛丽安·利比解释道。

paras.en: A nanometer is one billionth of a meter. To investigate how structures at this incredibly small scale relate to the shape of an entire tusk, the researchers turned to a sophisticated X-ray imaging method known as tensor tomography.
paras.zh: 一纳米是十亿分之一米。为了研究这种令人难以置信的小尺度结构与整个象牙形状的关系，研究人员转向了一种称为张量断层扫描的复杂 X 射线成像方法。

paras.en: Advanced X-Rays Reveal the Tusk's Hidden Architecture
paras.zh: 先进的 X 射线揭示了象牙的隐藏结构

paras.en: Conventional dental X-rays produce images because teeth absorb more radiation than the softer tissues around them. The resulting image is essentially a shadow that reveals the shape and density of the tooth.
paras.zh: 传统牙科 X 射线会产生图像，因为牙齿比周围的软组织吸收更多的辐射。生成的图像本质上是一个阴影，显示了牙齿的形状和密度。

paras.en: However, the powerful X-rays generated at synchrotron research facilities can provide far more detailed information. When these beams encounter regularly organized structures inside a material, the X-rays scatter in distinctive patterns. Scientists can analyze those patterns to determine how microscopic components are arranged.
paras.zh: 然而，同步加速器研究设施产生的强大 X 射线可以提供更详细的信息。当这些光束遇到材料内部规则组织的结构时，X 射线会以独特的模式散射。科学家可以分析这些模式以确定微观成分的排列方式。

paras.en: "From these patterns, we can calculate how the nanometer-sized mineralized collagen fibers inside the material are oriented," explains first author Adrian Rodriguez-Palomo.
paras.zh: “根据这些图案，我们可以计算出材料内部纳米级矿化胶原纤维的取向，”第一作者 Adrian Rodriguez-Palomo 解释道。

paras.en: Rodriguez-Palomo began working on the project while pursuing his PhD at Chalmers University of Technology in Sweden. He subsequently continued the research as a postdoctoral researcher at Aarhus University in Denmark.
paras.zh: 罗德里格斯-帕洛莫在瑞典查尔姆斯理工大学攻读博士学位期间开始从事该项目。随后，他在丹麦奥胡斯大学担任博士后研究员继续研究。

paras.en: During tensor tomography, researchers rotate the tooth within the synchrotron's X-ray beam while collecting measurements at individual locations. Millions of these measurements are then combined to reconstruct a three-dimensional representation of the tusk's internal organization, connecting its microscopic components with the much larger structure.
paras.zh: 在张量断层扫描过程中，研究人员在同步加速器的 X 射线束内旋转牙齿，同时收集各个位置的测量结果。然后将数百万个测量结果组合起来，重建象牙内部组织的三维表示，将其微观组件与更大的结构连接起来。

paras.en: An Unexpected Discovery Hidden in the Data
paras.zh: 数据中隐藏的意外发现

paras.en: When the researchers first examined their extensive imaging data, they could not find the spiral structure they had anticipated.
paras.zh: 当研究人员第一次检查大量的成像数据时，他们找不到他们预期的螺旋结构。

paras.en: "That puzzled us quite a bit," recalls Marianne Liebi.
paras.zh: “这让我们很困惑，”玛丽安·利比回忆道。

paras.en: Earlier mechanical experiments had indicated that the tusk's characteristic twist should be reflected in the orientation of its collagen fibers and mineral crystals.
paras.zh: 早期的机械实验表明，象牙的特征扭曲应该反映在其胶原纤维和矿物晶体的方向上。

paras.en: "But instead of a helix, all we saw was a regular pattern."
paras.zh: “但我们看到的不是螺旋，而是规则的图案。”

paras.en: The breakthrough came when the scientists changed their approach. Rather than examining individual points in the three-dimensional images in isolation, they investigated how the orientation of each point related to its neighbors.
paras.zh: 当科学家改变方法时，突破出现了。他们没有单独检查三维图像中的各个点，而是研究每个点的方向与其相邻点的关系。

paras.en: "When we compared how these points were oriented relative to each other, a directional trend began to appear," recalls Palomo. "All we had to do then was connect the dots - as in a children's paint-by-numbers kit - and suddenly the structure became visible: two intertwined spirals."
paras.zh: “当我们比较这些点相对于彼此的方向时，方向趋势开始出现，”帕洛莫回忆道。 “然后我们所要做的就是将这些点连接起来 - 就像在儿童数字绘画套件中一样 - 突然间结构变得可见：两个交织在一起的螺旋。”

paras.en: Two Opposing Spirals Give Narwhal Tusks Their Strength
paras.zh: 两个相对的螺旋赋予独角鲸獠牙力量

paras.en: Further examination revealed that the two spirals occupy different regions of the tooth. The thin outer cementum layer forms a left-handed helix, whereas the mineralized collagen structures within the underlying dentin spiral in the opposite direction.
paras.zh: 进一步检查发现，这两个螺旋占据了牙齿的不同区域。薄的外牙骨质层形成左手螺旋，而下面的牙本质内的矿化胶原蛋白结构则沿相反方向螺旋。

paras.en: This sophisticated natural design provides substantial mechanical advantages. Much like the intertwined strands of a rope, the two opposing helices work together to create an exceptionally stable structure. Their arrangement helps the tusk resist twisting forces, known as torsion, as well as other forms of mechanical stress.
paras.zh: 这种复杂的自然设计提供了显着的机械优势。就像缠绕在一起的绳子一样，两个相对的螺旋共同作用，形成一个异常稳定的结构。它们的排列有助于象牙抵抗扭转力（称为扭转）以及其他形式的机械应力。

paras.en: The same microscopic architecture also produces the narwhal's recognizable corkscrew shape, linking the extraordinary appearance of the legendary unicorn horn to structures far too small to see with the naked eye.
paras.zh: 同样的微观结构还产生了独角鲸可识别的螺旋形形状，将传奇独角兽角的非凡外观与小到无法用肉眼看到的结构联系起来。

paras.en: Narwhal Tusks Preserve Decades of Arctic History
paras.zh: 独角鲸的獠牙保存了数十年的北极历史

paras.en: The study forms part of a research project funded by NordForsk called "Narwhal tusks - a tale with a twist." It also received support from the European Union's Horizon 2020 research and innovation program under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie program.
paras.zh: 这项研究是 NordForsk 资助的一个研究项目的一部分，该项目名为“独角鲸的象牙——一个扭曲的故事”。它还获得了欧盟 Marie Skłodowska-Curie 计划下的 Horizo​​n 2020 研究和创新计划的支持。

paras.en: Under the leadership of Henrik Birkedal of Aarhus University in Denmark, the international and interdisciplinary research team is exploring both the internal architecture of narwhal tusks and the relationship between tusk growth, environmental conditions, and climate.
paras.zh: 在丹麦奥胡斯大学 Henrik Birkedal 的领导下，国际跨学科研究小组正在探索独角鲸象牙的内部结构以及象牙生长、环境条件和气候之间的关系。

paras.en: As a narwhal's tusk grows, it develops successive layers that function much like the annual growth rings of a tree. Scientists can examine these structures to reconstruct past Arctic environmental conditions, including changes in climate and food availability.
paras.zh: 随着独角鲸的象牙生长，它会形成连续的层，其功能很像树的年轮。科学家可以通过检查这些结构来重建过去的北极环境条件，包括气候和食物供应的变化。

paras.en: During a lifespan that can approach a century, a male narwhal effectively builds its own environmental archive within its remarkable spiral tooth.
paras.zh: 在接近一个世纪的寿命中，雄性独角鲸在其非凡的螺旋齿中有效地建立了自己的环境档案。

articles.title: Dropping missiles from orbit? 2 European companies sign agreement to study the idea
articles.author: Julian Dossett

paras.en: A pair of companies in Europe have signed an agreement to study the feasibility of developing weapons that can be dropped from orbit.
paras.zh: 欧洲两家公司签署了一项协议，研究开发可从轨道上投放的武器的可行性。

paras.en: Atmos, a space company known for its Phoenix reusable reentry vehicle, will work with MBDA, Europe's largest missile manufacturer, on the new project.
paras.zh: Atmos 是一家以凤凰号可重复使用再入飞行器而闻名的航天公司，将与欧洲最大的导弹制造商 MBDA 合作开展这个新项目。

paras.en: "We are assessing how proven defense systems and new orbital technologies can be combined to strengthen Europe's conventional deterrence and enable future defense capabilities," Sebastian Klaus, the CEO of Atmos Space Cargo, said in a statement on Nov. 18.
paras.zh: Atmos Space Cargo 首席执行官塞巴斯蒂安·克劳斯 (Sebastian Klaus) 在 11 月 18 日的一份声明中表示：“我们正在评估如何将经过验证的防御系统和新的轨道技术结合起来，以加强欧洲的常规威慑并实现未来的防御能力。”

paras.en: The system that the companies are investigating is called Precision Orbital Deep Strike, or PODS. The companies said that their initial scope will center on design and feasibility, as well as technology integration.
paras.zh: 两家公司正在研究的系统称为精确轨道深度打击（PODS）。两家公司表示，他们的初步范围将集中在设计和可行性以及技术集成上。

paras.en: Atmos and MBDA also said this work could lead to demonstrations, but the companies' announcement makes it clear that any deployment or use would be subject to the approval of governmental and military authorities.
paras.zh: Atmos 和 MBDA 还表示，这项工作可能会引发示威活动，但两家公司的声明明确表示，任何部署或使用都必须得到政府和军事当局的批准。

paras.en: "The initiative also directly supports MBDA's broader strategic vision in the space domain, reinforcing both space for defense and the defense of space," Thomas Gottschild, MBDA Deutschland managing director, said in the same statement.
paras.zh: MBDA 德国公司董事总经理托马斯·戈茨柴尔德 (Thomas Gottschild) 在同一份声明中表示：“该倡议还直接支持 MBDA 在太空领域更广泛的战略愿景，加强太空防御和太空防御。”

paras.en: This news comes a few months after Chief of Space Operations Gen. Douglas Schiess said that the U.S. Space Force operates orbital weapons.
paras.zh: 这一消息是在太空作战部长道格拉斯·席斯将军表示美国太空部队正在使用轨道武器几个月后发布的。

paras.en: "Let me be crystal clear: Today, Guardians operate on-orbit weapons that can defend the joint force against space-enabled attacks," Schiess said during a conferenace presentation on Sept. 15 ("Guardians" refers to Space Force personnel.)
paras.zh: 希斯在 9 月 15 日的会议演讲中表示：“让我说得很清楚：今天，守护者操作的在轨武器可以保护联合部队免受太空攻击。”（“守护者”指的是太空军人员。）

paras.en: Last year, Atmos' Phoenix capsule got its first test run in space. The cargo-return technology launched aboard a Space X Falcon 9 rocket during a rideshare mission in February 2025.
paras.zh: 去年，Atmos 的凤凰号太空舱进行了首次太空试运行。 2025 年 2 月，在一次拼车任务中，Space X 猎鹰 9 号火箭发射了这项货物返回技术。

paras.en: Atmos tested out the inflatable heat shields it has been working on to help future space-manufactured cargo make it through Earth's atmosphere in one piece.
paras.zh: Atmos 测试了其一直在研发的充气隔热罩，以帮助未来太空制造的货物完整地穿过地球大气层。

paras.en: "Orbital transportation and return form a new layer of strategic infrastructure, and infrastructure determines what Europe can achieve on its own terms," Klaus said in the Nov 18 statement.
paras.zh: 克劳斯在 11 月 18 日的声明中表示：“轨道运输和返回形成了新的战略基础设施层，而基础设施决定了欧洲能够按照自己的条件实现什么目标。”

paras.en: Julian Dossett is a freelance writer living in Santa Fe, New Mexico. He primarily covers the rocket industry and space exploration and, in addition to science writing, contributes travel stories to New Mexico Magazine. In 2022 and 2024, his travel writing earned IRMA Awards. Previously, he worked as a staff writer at CNET. He graduated from Texas State University in San Marcos in 2011 with a B.A. in philosophy. He owns a large collection of sci-fi pulp magazines from the 1960s.
paras.zh: 朱利安·多塞特是一位住在新墨西哥州圣达菲的自由作家。他主要报道火箭工业和太空探索，除了科学写作外，还为《新墨西哥杂志》撰写旅行故事。 2022 年和 2024 年，他的旅行写作荣获 IRMA 奖。此前，他曾担任 CNET 的特约撰稿人。他于 2011 年毕业于圣马科斯德克萨斯州立大学，获得学士学位。在哲学中。他拥有大量 20 世纪 60 年代的科幻通俗杂志。

articles.author: Harry Bennett

paras.en: Camera deals have been a bit harder to find this Black Friday but we have found these great reductions on models we gave some of our highest ratings to. If you are in the market for a new camera, whether for astrophotography, general shooting or another particular style, one of these might fit the bill for your needs.
paras.zh: 这个黑色星期五的相机优惠有点难找到，但我们发现我们给予一些最高评价的型号有这些大幅折扣。如果您正在市场上购买一台新相机，无论是用于天文摄影、一般拍摄还是其他特定风格，其中一款可能适合您的需求。

paras.en: High-resolution models like the Sony A7R V and the Canon EOS R5 are great for those who need the most detail from their shots and a strong amount of pro-functionality. One of our low-light favorites has dropped to its lowest-ever price on Walmart thanks to this year's release of a new version. We loved the Canon EOS R6 II for its amazing high ISO noise handling and impressive -6.5 EV low-light autofocus, so despite the release of the EOS R6 III, this is still one of the best mirrorless cameras you can get for astrophotography.
paras.zh: 索尼 A7R V 和佳能 EOS R5 等高分辨率型号非常适合那些需要从拍摄中获得最多细节和强大的专业功能的用户。由于今年新版本的发布，我们最喜欢的低光产品之一在沃尔玛的价格已跌至历史最低价。我们喜欢佳能 EOS R6 II，因为它具有令人惊叹的高 ISO 噪点处理能力和令人印象深刻的 -6.5 EV 低光自动对焦功能，因此尽管发布了 EOS R6 III，它仍然是天文摄影中最好的无反光镜相机之一。

paras.en: Best Black Friday camera deals live right now
paras.zh: 黑色星期五相机最佳优惠现已上线

paras.en: Canon's low light beast is now at its cheapest price ever. It has a 24MP resolution sensor, 100-102,400 ISO and eight stops of in-body image stabilization.
paras.zh: 佳能的低光野兽现在处于有史以来最便宜的价格。它具有 24MP 分辨率传感器、100-102,400 ISO 和八档体内图像稳定功能。

paras.en: We gave it 4/5 stars in our Canon EOS R6 II review.
paras.zh: 我们在佳能 EOS R6 II 评测中给了它 4/5 星。

paras.en: Even though aimed at producting video, this camera is still quite capable for astrophotography. It has a 24MP sensor, an ISO of ISO 100-32,000 and great autofocus.
paras.zh: 尽管这款相机的目标是制作视频，但它仍然非常适合天文摄影。它具有 24MP 传感器、ISO 100-32,000 的 ISO 和出色的自动对焦功能。

paras.en: We thought it deserved four stars in our full Canon EOS R50 V review.
paras.zh: 在我们对佳能 EOS R50 V 的完整评测中，我们认为它值得四颗星。

paras.en: The Nikon D850 is our best DSLR camera for its host of pro features like a 45MP sensor, Native ISO range of 64–25,600 and weather sealing.
paras.zh: 尼康 D850 是我们最好的 DSLR 相机，具有 45MP 传感器、64-25,600 的原生 ISO 范围和防风雨密封等众多专业功能。

paras.en: We gave it four and a half stars out of five in our full Nikon D850 review.
paras.zh: 在尼康 D850 的完整评测中，我们给它的是四星半（满分五星）。

paras.en: The Canon EOS R5 is a powerful camera, boasting a huge 45MP sensor, eight stop of in-body image stabilization (IBIS), 20FPS shooting and 8K video capability.
paras.zh: 佳能 EOS R5 是一款功能强大的相机，拥有巨大的 45MP 传感器、八级机身图像稳定 (IBIS)、20FPS 拍摄和 8K 视频功能。

paras.en: We gave it four and a half stars out of five in our full Canon EOS R5 review.
paras.zh: 在完整的佳能 EOS R5 评测中，我们给了它四颗半星（满分五颗星）。

paras.zh: 突发太空新闻、火箭发射的最新动态、天空观测活动等等！

paras.en: Harry joined Space.com in December 2024 as an e-commerce staff writer covering cameras, optics, and skywatching content. Based in the UK, Harry graduated in 2019 with a Bachelor's degree in American Literature with Creative Writing from the University of East Anglia. A keen photographer, Harry has strong experience with astrophotography and has captured celestial objects with a range of cameras. As a lifelong skywatcher, Harry remembers watching the Perseid meteor shower every summer in his hometown and being amazed by the wonders of the night sky.

paras.zh: 詹戈·费特 (Jango Fett) 的标志性太空飞船，以及后来波巴·费特 (Boba Fett) 的太空飞船，这艘飞船可能看起来不太像，但它会让其他星球大战小人仔的心中感到恐惧。与更大的 Ultimate Collector 系列型号不同，它适合在房子周围晃动。

articles.title: Governments Invest $71.8B in Space Defense as Militarization of Space Accelerates
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | November 2026 — Novaspace’s Space Defense & Security, 2nd Edition finds that governments invested approximately $71.8 billion in space defense and security activities globally in 2025, reflecting the growing importance of space as a military domain and a critical component of modern multi-domain operations.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 11 月 — Novaspace 的《太空防御与安全》第二版发现，到 2025 年，各国政府在全球太空防御与安全活动上的投资约为 718 亿美元，这反映出太空作为军事领域和现代多域行动的关键组成部分的重要性日益增加。

paras.en: Despite 49 countries having invested at least $10 million in space defense and security capabilities, global spending remains highly concentrated. The United States, China, Russia, Japan, and France accounted for approximately 90% of space defense and security expenditure in 2025, highlighting both the strategic importance and increasing competitiveness of the sector.
paras.zh: 尽管有 49 个国家在太空防御和安全能力方面投资了至少 1000 万美元，但全球支出仍然高度集中。到2025年，美国、中国、俄罗斯、日本和法国约占太空防御和安全支出的90%，凸显了该领域的战略重要性和日益增强的竞争力。

paras.en: As geopolitical competition intensifies, governments are accelerating investments in capabilities that support sensing, communications, navigation, intelligence, decision-making, and military operations across land, air, sea, cyber, and space domains.
paras.zh: 随着地缘政治竞争的加剧，各国政府正在加快对支持陆地、空中、海上、网络和太空领域的传感、通信、导航、情报、决策和军事行动的能力的投资。

paras.en: “Governments no longer view space solely as supporting operations on Earth. Space itself is becoming operationally contested,” notes Rachel Hughes, Novaspace Senior Consultant. “From Secure SatCom and Space Domain Awareness to Counterspace and Missile Defense, investments increasingly reflect the reality that future military advantage will depend on freedom of action in space.”
paras.zh: Novaspace 高级顾问雷切尔·休斯 (Rachel Hughes) 指出：“各国政府不再将太空仅仅视为支持地球上的行动。太空本身在运营上正变得充满争议。” “从安全卫星通信和太空领域意识到反太空和导弹防御，投资日益反映出这样一个现实：未来的军事优势将取决于太空行动的自由。”

paras.en: Of the $71.8B invested globally in 2025, approximately $33.6B was contracted to industry. Secure SatCom, Counterspace, and Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance represented the largest areas of government procurement, reflecting demand for resilient communications and intelligence-driven military operations.
paras.zh: 2025 年全球投资额为 71.8B 美元，其中约 33.6B 美元已签约给工业界。安全卫星通信、反太空以及情报、监视和侦察是政府采购的最大领域，反映了对弹性通信和情报驱动的军事行动的需求。

paras.en: The shift toward hybrid sovereign-commercial architectures continues as governments combine national and commercial capabilities to enhance resilience, accelerate deployment, and strengthen flexibility. Strategic advantage increasingly depends on securing reliable access to capabilities, rather than ownership alone.
paras.zh: 随着政府将国家和商业能力结合起来以增强弹性、加速部署和增强灵活性，向混合主权-商业架构的转变仍在继续。战略优势越来越依赖于确保可靠地获得能力，而不仅仅是所有权。

paras.en: “The most successful defense organizations will be those that can combine commercial innovation with sovereign capabilities to deliver space-enabled military advantage at speed,” adds Hughes.
paras.zh: 休斯补充道：“最成功的国防组织将是那些能够将商业创新与主权能力结合起来，以快速提供太空军事优势的组织。”

paras.en: Space Defense & Security, 2nd Edition delivers a comprehensive assessment of government expenditures, industry revenues, policy developments, and capability trends across the global space defense ecosystem.
paras.zh: 《太空防御与安全》第二版对全球太空防御生态系统的政府支出、行业收入、政策发展和能力趋势进行了全面评估。

paras.en: The report examines five major market shifts shaping the sector: the militarization of space, the rise of hybrid sovereign-commercial architectures, increasing supplier diversity, growing emphasis on resilience and Space Domain Awareness, and rising demand for counterspace and sovereign defense capabilities.
paras.zh: 该报告研究了塑造该行业的五个主要市场变化：太空军事化、混合主权商业架构的兴起、供应商多样性的增加、对弹性和太空领域意识的日益重视，以及对太空对抗和主权防御能力的需求不断增长。

paras.en: The study includes analysis of seven capability domains, spending forecasts, industry revenue assessments, country profiles, multinational stakeholder coverage, and supporting datasets, providing strategic insight into one of the fastest-evolving segments of the global space economy.
paras.zh: 该研究包括对七个能力领域、支出预测、行业收入评估、国家概况、跨国利益相关者覆盖范围和支持数据集的分析，为全球太空经济发展最快的领域之一提供战略洞察。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球范围内开展业务，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。

articles.title: NASA Enhances Supplier Program, Announces Mentor-Protégé Agreement
articles.author: Jennifer M. Dooren

paras.en: How NASA works with small businesses is evolving, and as a result, the agency is strengthening the domestic aerospace industrial base to support future exploration missions through its recently renamed Small Business Supplier Development Program. As part of the program, NASA announced its latest Mentor-Protégé Agreement, this one signed between The Boeing Company and GRACE Aerospace.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局与小企业的合作方式正在不断发展，因此，该机构正在通过最近更名为“小企业供应商发展计划”来加强国内航空航天工业基础，以支持未来的探索任务。作为该计划的一部分，美国宇航局宣布了最新的导师-门生协议，该协议是由波音公司和 GRACE Aerospace 签署的。

paras.en: NASA is streamlining the application process for the Small Business Supplier Development Program, as well as reducing administrative requirements, accelerating review and approval timelines, and enhancing incentives for prime contractor participation. These improvements are aimed at making supplier development more accessible, efficient, and closely aligned with NASA’s mission needs.
paras.zh: NASA 正在简化小型企业供应商发展计划的申请流程，减少管理要求，加快审查和批准时间表，并增强对主承包商参与的激励。这些改进旨在使供应商开发更容易、更高效，并与 NASA 的任务需求紧密结合。

paras.en: “We have intentionally redesigned the program as a mission-focused tool for strengthening industrial base readiness and mission success,” said Dwight Deneal, assistant administrator, Office of Small Business Programs, NASA Headquarters in Washington. “By simplifying participation and focusing developmental assistance on the capabilities NASA needs most, we are helping build a stronger, more resilient supplier base that can support the agency’s highest-priority missions.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局华盛顿总部小企业项目办公室助理管理员德怀特·德内尔表示：“我们有意重新设计该项目，作为以任务为中心的工具，以加强工业基础准备和任务成功。” “通过简化参与并将发展援助重点放在 NASA 最需要的能力上，我们正在帮助建立一个更强大、更有弹性的供应商基础，以支持该机构的最高优先级任务。”

paras.en: Under the new Mentor-Protégé Agreement, Boeing will provide structured assistance to help GRACE expand its capabilities as a supplier of mission-critical aerospace hardware. Boeing will fund the agreement, valued at nearly $500,000.
paras.zh: 根据新的导师-门生协议，波音公司将提供结构化援助，帮助 GRACE 扩大其作为关键任务航空航天硬件供应商的能力。波音将为该协议提供资金，价值近 50 万美元。

paras.en: “Boeing is proud to continue its longstanding relationship with NASA in support of its mission and the opportunities this agreement creates for Boeing, GRACE, and the broader aerospace industrial base,” said Christian Diamond, Mentor-Protégé Program manager and small business liaison officer for Boeing. “Through this partnership, Boeing looks forward to sharing our expertise to support the continued growth and long-term success of a small business while strengthening our supplier base.”
paras.zh: “波音很自豪能够继续与 NASA 保持长期合作关系，以支持其使命以及该协议为波音、GRACE 和更广泛的航空航天工业基础创造的机会，”波音导师门徒项目经理兼小企业联络官克里斯蒂安·戴蒙德 (Christian Diamond) 表示。 “通过这种合作伙伴关系，波音期待分享我们的专业知识，以支持小型企业的持续增长和长期成功，同时加强我们的供应商基础。”

paras.en: Building on two decades of experience supporting defense and aerospace customers, GRACE will use the partnership to prepare for increasingly complex aerospace and spaceflight programs.
paras.zh: 凭借二十年为国防和航空航天客户提供支持的经验，GRACE 将利用这一合作伙伴关系为日益复杂的航空航天和航天项目做好准备。

paras.en: “GRACE Aerospace is thankful and honored to participate in the program,” said Pauline Sevigny, president and owner of GRACE Aerospace. “We look forward to growing and learning from industry experts and supporting the mission of resilience and space superiority.”
paras.zh: GRACE Aerospace 总裁兼所有者 Pauline Sevigny 表示：“GRACE Aerospace 非常感谢也很荣幸参与该计划。 “我们期待与行业专家一起成长和学习，并支持弹性和空间优势的使命。”

paras.en: NASA’s enhanced supplier program is part of the agency’s broader Office of Small Business Programs.
paras.zh: NASA 的增强型供应商计划是该机构更广泛的小企业计划办公室的一部分。

articles.title: Shivelyuch Socked In

paras.en: In the same way that Shivelyuch (also called Shiveluch) frequently displays volcanic activity, it is also chronically obscured by clouds. When the OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 9 captured this image on November 8, 2026, clouds encroached on the snowy mountain on Russia’s Kamchatka Peninsula. But they hovered beneath the volcano’s 3,283-meter (10,771-foot) peak, leaving a clear opening over its caldera and northern upper slopes.
paras.zh: 就像希韦卢奇（也称为 Shiveluch）经常出现火山活动一样，它也长期被云层遮盖。当 Landsat 9 上的 OLI（操作陆地成像仪）于 2026 年 11 月 8 日拍摄到这张图像时，云层侵蚀了俄罗斯堪察加半岛的雪山。但它们盘旋在火山 3,283 米（10,771 英尺）的山峰下方，在火山口和北部上坡上留下了一个明显的开口。

paras.en: The upper reaches of Shivelyuch feature a caldera 9 kilometers (5.6 miles) wide that is open to the south. A lava dome, formed by vents extruding viscous magma, appears as a dark area within it. Lava domes on Shivelyuch go through cycles of growth and collapse, with collapses sometimes setting off fast-moving avalanches of hot ash and rock called pyroclastic flows.
paras.zh: 什夫利奇上游有一个 9 公里（5.6 英里）宽、向南开放的火山口。熔岩穹顶由喷口挤出粘性岩浆形成，内部呈现为黑暗区域。希夫利奇的熔岩穹丘会经历生长和塌陷的循环，塌陷有时会引发快速移动的热火山灰和岩石雪崩，称为火山碎屑流。

paras.en: In November 2026, effusive eruptions of lava and explosive activity at Shivelyuch had been ongoing for months, according to reports from the Kamchatka Volcanic Eruption Response Team (KVERT). And despite frequent cloudiness, satellites regularly detect thermal anomalies from the volcano.
paras.zh: 根据堪察加火山喷发响应小组 (KVERT) 的报告，2026 年 11 月，什维利奇的熔岩喷发和爆炸活动已持续数月。尽管经常出现多云天气，卫星仍定期检测到火山的热异常情况。

paras.en: On the day of this image, KVERT reported that a plume of resuspended ash drifted 120 kilometers (75 miles) to the east. That kind of activity is relatively tame for the mountain. Explosions from Shivelyuch periodically send ash several kilometers up into the atmosphere, where it can travel great distances and pose risks to aircraft. In July 2026, an ash plume rode the jet stream over the Bering Sea into Alaskan airspace, according to news reports, prompting the cancellation of multiple flights.
paras.zh: 在拍摄这张照片的当天，KVERT 报告称，一股重新悬浮的火山灰向东漂流了 120 公里（75 英里）。对于山上来说，这种活动相对温和。希夫尤奇的爆炸会定期将火山灰喷射到数公里高的大气层中，火山灰可以传播很远的距离，对飞机造成风险。据新闻报道，2026 年 7 月，一股火山灰羽流乘着急流飞越白令海进入阿拉斯加领空，导致多个航班取消。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory image by Lauren Dauphin, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey. Story by Lindsey Doermann.
paras.zh: NASA 地球观测站图像，由 Lauren Dauphin 拍摄，使用美国地质调查局的陆地卫星数据。林赛·杜尔曼的故事。

paras.en: - Global Volcanism Program (2026) Sheveluch. Accessed November 25, 2026.
paras.zh: - 全球火山计划 (2026) Sheveluch。访问日期：2026 年 11 月 25 日。

paras.en: - Gorbach, N., et al. (2013) Volcanic structure and composition of Old Shiveluch volcano, Kamchatka. Journal of Volcanology and Geothermal Research, 263, 193-208.
paras.zh: - Gorbach, N. 等人。 (2013)堪察加半岛老希韦鲁奇火山的火山结构和成分。火山学与地热研究杂志，263, 193-208。

articles.title: NASA’s NG-25 Mission to Launch Pioneering Space Crops Research

paras.en: NASA experiments, including a first-of-its-kind space crop production system, will travel to the International Space Station aboard Northrop Grumman’s 25th Commercial Resupply Services mission for the agency.
paras.zh: NASA 的实验，包括首个同类太空作物生产系统，将搭乘诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司为该机构执行的第 25 次商业补给服务任务前往国际空间站。

paras.en: Investigations from NASA’s Biological and Physical Sciences Division will advance research that benefits life on Earth and future exploration, expanding knowledge of space crops and human health.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局生物和物理科学部门的调查将推进有益于地球生命和未来探索的研究，扩大对太空作物和人类健康的了解。

paras.en: Astronauts will need sustainable sources of food to travel farther and stay longer in space. To help understand how crop production works in microgravity, NASA is launching a novel space crops experiment.
paras.zh: 宇航员需要可持续的食物来源才能走得更远并在太空停留更长时间。为了帮助了解作物生产在微重力下的运作方式，美国宇航局正在启动一项新颖的太空作物实验。

paras.en: The new prototype growth chamber will provide critical insights for developing safe, nutritious, and reliable crop production systems for future Moon Base habitats and Mars missions. Knowledge gained from the space crop production system also could help inform agricultural practices such as vertical farming and indoor growing systems.
paras.zh: 新的原型生长室将为未来月球基地栖息地和火星任务开发安全、营养和可靠的农作物生产系统提供重要的见解。从太空作物生产系统中获得的知识也可以帮助了解垂直农业和室内种植系统等农业实践。

paras.en: Researchers will use this investigation to validate the system’s water delivery and volume optimization technology aboard the space station.
paras.zh: 研究人员将利用这项研究来验证空间站上系统的供水和体积优化技术。

paras.en: A precision health investigation is the next step toward enabling long-duration studies of human brain tissues in space.
paras.zh: 精确的健康调查是实现对太空中人类脑组织进行长期研究的下一步。

paras.en: The research builds on a previous investigation that sent small, lab-grown models of the human brain, called miBrains, to the space station. This experiment will validate a miniature fluid-handling system designed to mix, deliver, and maintain the nutrient-rich liquid needed to keep the tissues alive.
paras.zh: 这项研究建立在之前的一项调查基础上，该调查将实验室培育的小型人类大脑模型（称为 miBrains）发送到空间站。该实验将验证微型流体处理系统，该系统旨在混合、输送和维持保持组织存活所需的营养丰富的液体。

paras.en: Researchers could use the findings to help identify potential neurological risks associated with spaceflight and develop strategies to protect astronaut health. It also may advance human tissue research and neurological disease modeling on Earth.
paras.zh: 研究人员可以利用这些发现来帮助识别与航天相关的潜在神经风险，并制定保护宇航员健康的策略。它还可能推进地球上的人体组织研究和神经疾病建模。

articles.title: ‘Come right now’: How a crisis centre in Samarkand helps women escape violence

paras.en: ‘Come right now’: How a crisis centre in Samarkand helps women escape violence
paras.zh: “现在就来”：撒马尔罕的危机中心如何帮助妇女摆脱暴力

paras.en: Pregnant, with two young children and no close relatives in Samarkand, she called a familiar number with trembling hands: the Rahmdillik (“Compassion”) crisis centre, where she had sheltered before. “Come right now,” came the reply.
paras.zh: 她怀孕了，带着两个年幼的孩子，在撒马尔罕没有近亲，她用颤抖的双手拨通了一个熟悉的号码：Rahmdillik（“同情”）危机中心，她以前曾在那里避难。 “现在就过来，”回答道。

paras.en: Behind a heavy iron gate of an old mansion in central Samarkand lies a small courtyard, where a huge, spreading persimmon tree hangs laden with ripe fruit.
paras.zh: 撒马尔罕市中心一座古老宅邸的一扇厚重的铁门后面有一个小庭院，院子里悬挂着一棵巨大的柿子树，上面结满了成熟的果实。

paras.en: Women of all ages – some in traditional Uzbek dress and headscarves, others in robes or tracksuits – smile warmly at visitors. Each has her own story, but all have fled violence or been left without shelter or any means of support.
paras.zh: 各个年龄段的妇女——有的穿着传统的乌兹别克服装和头巾，有的穿着长袍或运动服——对游客热情微笑。每个人都有自己的故事，但所有人都逃离了暴力，或者失去了庇护所或任何支持手段。

paras.en: A small UN delegation led by Sabine Machl, the UN Resident Coordinator in Uzbekistan, is welcomed by the centre’s founder, Bibisora Oripova, who points out the latest improvements: a large new television, another renovated room and a sewing workshop.
paras.zh: 由联合国驻乌兹别克斯坦驻地协调员 Sabine Machl 率领的一个小型联合国代表团受到了该中心创始人 Bibisora Oripova 的欢迎，他指出了最新的改进：一台大型新电视、另一个翻新的房间和一个缝纫车间。

paras.en: Dr. Oripova, a surgeon with many years of experience, opened Rahmdillik in 1996. The idea had come to her earlier, while she was working in the burns unit of a local hospital.
paras.zh: Oripova 医生是一位拥有多年经验的外科医生，于 1996 年开设了 Rahmdillik。这个想法是她早些时候在当地一家医院烧伤科工作时产生的。

paras.en: “Our unit had many women and children who had suffered burns, were disfigured and had become disabled. Often, their husbands refused to take them back. Where could they go?
paras.zh: “我们单位有很多妇女儿童被烧伤、毁容、致残。她们的丈夫往往不肯接她们回去，她们能去哪里呢？

paras.en: “In the Soviet Union, treatment was free, so they stayed in hospital – practically living there. But eventually that was no longer possible,” she says. “I went to the hokim [local official] and asked for a dormitory or some other building where I could shelter women who had nowhere to live.”
paras.zh: “在苏联，治疗是免费的，所以他们留在医院——实际上就住在那里。但最终这不再可能了，”她说。 “我去找当地官员，要求提供一间宿舍或其他建筑物，可以为那些无处可住的妇女提供庇护。”

paras.en: As demand grew, the centre expanded, with support from the government and external donors, including UN agencies. Over the years, hundreds of women have passed through its doors.
paras.zh: 随着需求的增长，该中心在政府和包括联合国机构在内的外部捐助者的支持下不断扩大。多年来，已有数百名女性走进该店。

paras.en: “We are a traditional society. Some families still do not want women to study or work; they marry them off young. Women have children and do the housework. They are entirely dependent on their husbands’ families,” Dr. Oripova says.
paras.zh: “我们是一个传统社会。一些家庭仍然不希望妇女学习或工作；他们把她们早嫁出去。妇女生孩子并做家务。她们完全依赖丈夫的家庭，”奥里波娃博士说。

paras.en: The centre can house up to 50 women at a time. Today, it offers them more than a roof over their heads: legal and psychological support, vocational training and help finding a job, all tailored to each woman.
paras.zh: 该中心一次最多可容纳 50 名女性。如今，它为她们提供的不仅仅是一个栖身之所：法律和心理支持、职业培训和帮助找工作，所有这些都是为每位女性量身定制的。

paras.en: If she decides to go to the police, staff help her prepare a complaint and accompany her through the process.
paras.zh: 如果她决定报警，工作人员会帮助她准备投诉并陪伴她完成整个过程。

paras.en: “When a woman has to leave home in a hurry, documents are the last thing on her mind. The priority is to get to safety,” says Ms. Machl. “That is why these facilities are essential: they give women someone to turn to during the most difficult period.”
paras.zh: “当一名女性必须匆忙离开家时，文件是她最不需要考虑的事情。首要任务是到达安全地带，”Machl 女士说。 “这就是为什么这些设施至关重要：它们为女性在最困难的时期提供了可以求助的对象。”

paras.en: Together with the UN Population Fund (UNFPA) in Uzbekistan and other partners, centre staff also monitor whether the rights of women who have experienced violence are respected.
paras.zh: 该中心的工作人员还与乌兹别克斯坦的联合国人口基金（人口基金）和其他合作伙伴一起监测遭受暴力的妇女的权利是否得到尊重。

paras.en: Most women choose not to go to the police, hoping to wait things out and keep their families together. “They often say they do not want their children to be left without a father,” Dr. Oripova explains.
paras.zh: 大多数女性选择不报警，希望等待事情结束并让家人团聚。 “他们经常说，他们不希望自己的孩子失去父亲，”奥里波娃博士解释道。

paras.en: If a woman decides to leave her husband, staff appeal to the authorities on her behalf for housing and an allowance to support her children.
paras.zh: 如果一名妇女决定离开丈夫，工作人员会代表她向当局请求住房和补贴来抚养她的孩子。

paras.en: Babies are placed in nurseries, while older children go to school.
paras.zh: 婴儿被安置在托儿所，而年龄较大的孩子则去学校。

paras.en: “Would you like to come and see our children’s room?” Dr. Oripova asks. The spacious, bright room is carpeted, and its walls are hung with educational materials. The furniture is new, and small children sit at tables making crafts under the watchful eye of a young woman.
paras.zh: “你愿意来看看我们的儿童房吗？”奥里波娃博士问道。宽敞明亮的房间铺着地毯，墙壁上挂满了教材。家具是新的，小孩子们坐在桌子旁，在一位年轻女士的注视下制作工艺品。

paras.en: In 2023, the authorities in Uzbekistan reported to the UN that 40,055 cases of violence and harassment against women had been identified, and that 39,263 women had received protection orders.
paras.zh: 2023年，乌兹别克斯坦当局向联合国报告称，已查明40,055起针对妇女的暴力和骚扰案件，并有39,263名妇女收到了保护令。

paras.en: These figures reflect reported and identified cases rather than the true scale of violence, which is likely far greater: many women do not seek help because of pressure, shame and financial dependence.
paras.zh: 这些数字反映的是报告和查明的案件，而不是真实的暴力规模，后者的规模可能要大得多：许多妇女由于压力、羞耻和经济依赖而不会寻求帮助。

paras.en: In Uzbekistan, as in many countries, violence against women most often takes place at home. The perpetrators are usually husbands, but violence also occurs between female relatives – between a mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, for example.
paras.zh: 在乌兹别克斯坦，与许多国家一样，针对妇女的暴力行为最常发生在家庭中。施暴者通常是丈夫，但暴力行为也发生在女性亲属之间，例如婆婆和儿媳之间。

paras.en: Psychological and physical violence, along with harassment, are the most commonly reported forms. A UN study found that around 40 per cent of women believe a husband may be justified in beating his wife in certain situations.
paras.zh: 心理和身体暴力以及骚扰是最常报告的形式。联合国的一项研究发现，大约 40% 的女性认为丈夫在某些情况下殴打妻子是合理的。

paras.en: “The government is doing a great deal through its specialized Inson centres, which now operate throughout Uzbekistan and help women, including through shelters,” Ms. Machl told UN News. “The priority should be to support women urgently, without blaming them or putting them through lengthy procedures that traumatize them again.”
paras.zh: “政府正在通过专门的因森中心做大量工作，这些中心目前在乌兹别克斯坦各地开展业务，为妇女提供帮助，包括通过庇护所，”马歇尔女士告诉《联合国新闻》。 “当务之急应该是紧急支持女性，而不是指责她们或让她们经历冗长的程序，从而再次给她们带来创伤。”

paras.en: At Inson centres, specialists use updated UNFPA guidance to assess risks and identify different forms of violence. It helps them recognise that complaints about arguments or restrictions may point to psychological control, financial restrictions, physical threats or sexual coercion.
paras.zh: 在英森中心，专家使用最新的人口基金指南来评估风险并识别不同形式的暴力。它帮助他们认识到，对争论或限制的投诉可能指向心理控制、经济限制、身体威胁或性胁迫。

paras.en: If a woman is forbidden to see her friends, for example, a specialist will ask whether her access to money for phone calls and transport is also restricted, and whether the prohibitions come with threats. This helps reveal a broader pattern of control and identify the right protective measures.
paras.zh: 例如，如果一名妇女被禁止见朋友，专家会询问她获得电话费和交通费是否也受到限制，以及这些禁令是否会带来威胁。这有助于揭示更广泛的控制模式并确定正确的保护措施。

paras.en: Irina has lived at the shelter with her three children for more than two years, and her youngest was born there. She has no plans to return to her husband, is waiting for an apartment from the state and is looking for a permanent job. Her older children attend a nearby school.
paras.zh: 伊琳娜和她的三个孩子在收容所生活了两年多，她最小的孩子就在那里出生。她没有计划回到丈夫身边，正在等待州政府提供的公寓，并正在寻找一份长期工作。她的大孩子在附近的一所学校上学。

paras.en: “You know, they once filmed us here and then showed us as homeless. But we are not homeless: today, we have this home, and each of us is trying to get back on her feet and find her own path. Many of us succeed,” Irina says.
paras.zh: “你知道，他们曾经在这里拍摄我们，然后把我们展示为无家可归的人。但我们不是无家可归的：今天，我们有了这个家，我们每个人都在努力重新站起来，找到自己的道路。我们很多人都成功了，”伊琳娜说。

articles.title: Putting survivors at the centre of gender-based violence services

paras.en: Putting survivors at the centre of gender-based violence services
paras.zh: 将幸存者置于基于性别的暴力服务的中心

paras.en: Reaching out for help can be an enormous step for survivors of gender-based violence (GBV), and what happens after walking through the doors of a support service can shape the path towards recovery and safety
paras.zh: 对于性别暴力 (GBV) 的幸存者来说，寻求帮助可能是迈出的一大步，而走进支持服务机构后所发生的事情可以塑造康复和安全的道路

paras.en: “More than anything, they want to be believed,” said Erin Gerber, a GBV response specialist with the UN reproductive and sexual health agency, UNFPA, based in Nairobi.
paras.zh: “最重要的是，他们希望被相信，”位于内罗毕的联合国生殖和性健康机构人口基金的 GBV 应对专家艾琳·格伯 (Erin Gerber) 说。

paras.en: “That was something that came up over and over again.”
paras.zh: “这是一次又一次出现的事情。”

paras.en: Acknowledging survivors’ experiences and ensuring they receive safe and quality support is at the heart of Women at the Centre, UNFPA’s first global GBV case management programme.
paras.zh: 承认幸存者的经历并确保他们获得安全和优质的支持是妇女中心的核心，这是人口基金的第一个全球性性别暴力案件管理项目。

paras.en: Currently implemented in Azerbaijan, El Salvador, Indonesia, Madagascar and Zimbabwe, it aims to strengthen the services survivors receive while building a consistent and professional social service workforce.
paras.zh: 该计划目前在阿塞拜疆、萨尔瓦多、印度尼西亚、马达加斯加和津巴布韦实施，旨在加强幸存者获得的服务，同时建立一支稳定、专业的社会服务队伍。

paras.en: The programme began by examining existing services and identifying barriers to accessing them.
paras.zh: 该计划首先检查现有服务并找出获取这些服务的障碍。

paras.en: Assessments pointed to seven marginalized groups that have historically faced discrimination or exclusion, including adolescent girls, older women, LGBTIQ+ survivors, persons with disabilities, people of African descent, Indigenous People, and sex workers.
paras.zh: 评估指出，七个历史上曾面临歧视或排斥的边缘群体，包括少女、老年妇女、LGBTIQ+幸存者、残疾人、非洲人后裔、原住民和性工作者。

paras.en: Across those groups, accessibility, institutional violence, and not being believed were repeated concerns.
paras.zh: 在这些群体中，可及性、机构暴力和不被相信是反复出现的问题。

paras.en: For survivors who do reach services, Ms. Gerber explained that quality care begins with seemingly simple things: being welcomed, communicating in their own language, and knowing their information will remain confidential.
paras.zh: 对于确实获得服务的幸存者，格伯女士解释说，优质护理始于看似简单的事情：受到欢迎、用自己的语言进行交流以及知道他们的信息将得到保密。

paras.en: Survivors also need to feel physically and emotionally safe, have their decisions respected and, crucially, be genuinely listened to.
paras.zh: 幸存者还需要感到身体和情感上的安全，他们的决定得到尊重，最重要的是，他们的决定得到真诚的倾听。

paras.en: Building a workforce survivors can rely on
paras.zh: 建立幸存者可以信赖的劳动力队伍

paras.en: A central part of Women at the Centre is strengthening and professionalizing the people providing this support. Investment in GBV response has traditionally focused on health and legal services, while the social service workforce has received less recognition, Ms. Gerber said.
paras.zh: 妇女中心的一个核心部分是加强提供这种支持的人员并使之专业化。格伯女士说，针对性别暴力应对措施的投资传统上集中在健康和法律服务上，而社会服务人员受到的认可较少。

paras.en: The programme is strengthening training and developing accreditation pathways for caseworkers, helping to build a workforce equipped to provide consistent support and connect survivors with the services they need.
paras.zh: 该计划正在加强对社会工作者的培训和开发认证途径，帮助建立一支能够提供持续支持并将幸存者与他们所需的服务联系起来的劳动力队伍。

paras.en: For Ms. Gerber, strengthening the workforce ultimately means ensuring survivors can rely on the care they receive.
paras.zh: 对于格伯女士来说，加强劳动力队伍最终意味着确保幸存者能够依赖他们所接受的护理。

paras.en: “A survivor can get the same quality of care at any time, at any location, whenever they need it. That’s what our goal is,” she said.
paras.zh: “幸存者可以在任何时间、任何地点、只要需要时获得相同质量的护理。这就是我们的目标，”她说。

paras.en: While the principles of quality case management remain the same, support must also reflect the communities being served.
paras.zh: 虽然高质量案例管理的原则保持不变，但支持也必须反映所服务的社区。

paras.en: In rural Zimbabwe, Ms. Gerber saw how mobile one-stop crisis centres are bringing services closer to women who previously struggled to reach them. Moving between communities, the centres provide information about available support while also helping people identify forms of gender-based violence that may have become normalized or gone unrecognized.
paras.zh: 在津巴布韦农村地区，格伯女士看到移动一站式危机中心如何让以前难以接触到服务的妇女更接近服务。这些中心在社区之间流动，提供有关可用支持的信息，同时帮助人们识别可能已成为常态或未被认识到的基于性别的暴力形式。

paras.en: In El Salvador, Women at the Centre works with older women to reflect on their own experiences of violence and how these shape their responses to others. They are then trained to raise awareness, respond to disclosures and connect survivors with support, linking prevention and response within their communities.
paras.zh: 在萨尔瓦多，妇女中心与老年妇女合作，反思她们自己的暴力经历以及这些经历如何影响她们对他人的反应。然后，他们接受培训，以提高认识，对披露的信息做出反应，并将幸存者与支持联系起来，将社区内的预防和应对联系起来。

paras.en: The approach differs in each context, but the goal remains the same: making quality support more accessible to survivors.
paras.zh: 不同情况下的方法有所不同，但目标保持不变：让幸存者更容易获得高质量的支持。

paras.en: For Ms. Gerber, success ultimately comes down to what happens when a survivor seeks help.
paras.zh: 对于格伯女士来说，成功最终取决于幸存者寻求帮助时会发生什么。

paras.en: “My hope would be that you're walking into a facility and you are seeing an accurate representation of case workers reflected in the survivors and communities who need the services most.”
paras.zh: “我希望当你走进一个设施时，你会看到最需要服务的幸存者和社区中反映的案例工作者的准确代表。”

paras.en: Where a survivor lives or who they are should not determine the quality of care available to them. It is an ambitious vision, Ms. Gerber acknowledged, but one with a simple goal of “more services for more people who haven’t had them before.”
paras.zh: 幸存者居住的地方或他们的身份不应决定他们可获得的护理质量。格伯女士承认，这是一个雄心勃勃的愿景，但目标很简单，就是“为更多以前没有获得过服务的人提供更多服务”。

articles.title: 16 Days of Activism: UNHCR warns over deep funding cuts to vital protection work

paras.en: 16 Days of Activism: UNHCR warns over deep funding cuts to vital protection work
paras.zh: 16 天的行动：联合国难民署警告重要保护工作的资金大幅削减

paras.en: Serious funding cuts are severely weakening protection for refugee and stateless women and girls and others at risk of gender-based violence (GBV), like Mariam, who survived a decade of captivity and rape at the hands of Boko Haram militia.
paras.zh: 资金的严重削减正在严重削弱对难民和无国籍妇女和女童以及其他面临性别暴力风险的人的保护，例如玛丽亚姆，她在博科圣地民兵手中度过了十年的囚禁和强奸。

paras.en: “They come and pick girls,” Ms. Wosornu, UNHCR Assistant High Commissioner for Protection, told journalists in Geneva on Friday, repeating what Mariam had told her in Nigeria. After escaping her ordeal which had involved attacks by multiple men, she “felt like she was taken out of a fire”, the UNHCR official added.
paras.zh: “他们来挑选女孩，”联合国难民署负责保护事务的助理高级专员沃索尔努女士周五在日内瓦对记者说，重复了玛丽亚姆在尼日利亚告诉她的话。难民署官员补充说，在逃离了多名男子袭击的痛苦后，她“感觉自己像是从火中被救了出来”。

paras.en: Last year, 171 UNHCR-supported “safe spaces” for women and girls were forced to close and today, 203 remain open.
paras.zh: 去年，联合国难民署支持的 171 个妇女和女童“安全空间”被迫关闭，如今，仍有 203 个仍然开放。

paras.en: When safe spaces shut, specialist services for survivors of attacks and abuse are cut and medical and legal referral options narrow, Ms. Wosornu explained.
paras.zh: 沃索尔努女士解释说，当安全空间关闭时，为袭击和虐待幸存者提供的专业服务就会被削减，医疗和法律转诊选择也会缩小。

paras.en: The closures are part of a recent erosion of GBV services which left the agency’s programmes to counter the issue less than one-third funded in 2025. In all, 5.6 million forcibly displaced and stateless people have been left without lifesaving prevention and response services, according to UNHCR’s 2025 GBV Impact Report.
paras.zh: 这些关闭是最近 GBV 服务受到侵蚀的一部分，这使得该机构应对这一问题的计划在 2025 年获得的资金不足三分之一。根据联合国难民署的 2025 年 GBV 影响报告，总共有 560 万被迫流离失所和无国籍人士无法获得挽救生命的预防和应对服务。

paras.en: The development comes alongside this year’s 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence campaign, ending 10 December.
paras.zh: 这一进展与今年 12 月 10 日结束的反对性别暴力 16 天行动活动同时进行。

paras.en: “Gender-based violence is one of the most pervasive human rights violations, hence the need for 16 Days (of Activism) and 16 days is certainly not enough,” Ms. Wosornu insisted. “Nearly one in three women globally has experienced some physical and sexual violence. More than 60 million forcibly displaced and stateless women and girls face heightened risks. So, these funding cuts are slashing the very services that are needed to support them. We must not mistake silence for safety.”
paras.zh: “基于性别的暴力是最普遍的侵犯人权行为之一，因此需要 16 天（激进主义），16 天肯定是不够的，”沃索尔努女士坚称。 “全球近三分之一的女性遭受过身体暴力和性暴力。超过 6000 万被迫流离失所和无国籍的妇女和女孩面临着更高的风险。因此，这些资金削减正在削减支持她们所需的服务。我们绝不能误认为沉默是安全。”

paras.en: She recalled working in Goma, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where survivors recounted their harrowing stories and asking them what they wanted most. “They said, ‘For our perpetrators to face justice.’ And yet, access to justice is one of the serious challenges that we face. Only nine per cent of survivors referred to legal services, due to documentation and language barriers.”
paras.zh: 她回忆起在刚果民主共和国戈马工作的经历，幸存者讲述了他们的悲惨故事，并询问他们最想要的是什么。 “他们说，‘让我们的肇事者接受法律制裁。’然而，诉诸司法是我们面临的严峻挑战之一。由于文件和语言障碍，只有 9% 的幸存者寻求法律服务。”

paras.en: It is often very difficult for many young women survivors to recover from their ordeals, especially since they can face rejection and stigma in their own families and communities. Today, though, Mariam and other survivors receive support and vocational training through a government-run initiative supported by UNHCR and partners.
paras.zh: 对于许多年轻女性幸存者来说，从苦难中恢复过来往往非常困难，特别是因为她们可能在自己的家庭和社区中面临拒绝和耻辱。然而如今，玛丽雅姆和其他幸存者通过联合国难民署及其合作伙伴支持的一项政府倡议获得了支持和职业培训。

paras.en: Despite severe underfunding, the agency’s specialized GBV programmes reached 2.2 million people in 77 countries worldwide in 2025 and the first half of 2026.
paras.zh: 尽管资金严重不足，该机构的 GBV 专门项目在 2025 年和 2026 年上半年惠及了全球 77 个国家的 220 万人。

paras.en: This reflects the agency’s unique protection mandate, critical role and expertise in preventing GBV, identifying the specific risks faced by refugees, displaced and stateless people, and supporting survivors with access to registration, documentation, asylum, and the specialized care needed for recovery.
paras.zh: 这反映了该机构在预防性别暴力、确定难民、流离失所者和无国籍人面临的具体风险以及支持幸存者获得登记、文件、庇护和康复所需的专门护理方面的独特保护任务、关键作用和专业知识。

paras.en: In all, 63 per cent of UNHCR operations reported delays in survivors accessing specialized GBV case management services due to staffing reductions among partners.
paras.zh: 总体而言，难民署 63% 的行动报告称，由于合作伙伴人员配置减少，幸存者获得专门的基于性别暴力案件管理服务的时间出现延误。

paras.en: UNHCR-led analysis from Bangladesh, Jordan, Lebanon, South Sudan and Tanzania, compiled in the GBV Trends Report, showed that women and girls accounted for 98 per cent of recorded survivors, while nearly 88 per cent of incidents occurred in private residential settings.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署牵头对孟加拉国、约旦、黎巴嫩、南苏丹和坦桑尼亚进行的分析（编入 GBV 趋势报告）显示，妇女和女童占记录幸存者的 98%，而近 88% 的事件发生在私人住宅环境中。

articles.title: Don't sleep on the NFL 'uncs' - can they finally win a Super Bowl?

paras.en: NFL: Why Kyle Shanahan, Brock Purdy and San Francisco 49ers 'uncs' deserve Super Bowl moment, plus Kirk Cousins' revenge game and Sam Darnold pressure
paras.zh: NFL：为什么凯尔·沙纳汉、布洛克·珀迪和旧金山 49 人队“UNCs”值得获得超级碗时刻，加上柯克·考辛斯的复仇比赛和萨姆·达诺德的压力

paras.en: We preview Sunday in Week 12 of the 2026 NFL season as the San Francisco 49ers face the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks live on Sky Sports from 9.25pm; also watch New York Giants vs Indianapolis Colts and Atlanta Falcons against Minnesota Vikings
paras.zh: 我们将在 2026 年 NFL 赛季第 12 周周日晚上 9 点 25 分通过天空体育直播直播旧金山 49 人队迎战超级碗卫冕冠军西雅图海鹰队；还观看纽约巨人队对阵印第安纳波利斯小马队以及亚特兰大猎鹰队对阵明尼苏达维京队的比赛

paras.en: Kyle Shanahan's San Francisco 49ers are the best team in football. Is this finally the season they win a Lombardi Trophy? Their next test is against the champions.
paras.zh: 凯尔·沙纳汉 (Kyle Shanahan) 的旧金山 49 人队是足球界最好的球队。这是他们最终赢得隆巴迪奖杯的赛季吗？他们的下一个考验是对阵冠军。

paras.en: Most offenses in the NFL look and function the way they do because of the Shanahan. His fingerprints, and still that of his father, have long been ingrained in trends, wrinkles and schematic interpretations dominant across the league as fans know it.
paras.zh: NFL 中的大多数进攻看起来和运作方式都是因为沙纳汉。正如球迷所知，他的指纹，以及他父亲的指纹，早已根深蒂固地存在于整个联盟的流行趋势、皱纹和图式解释中。

paras.en: He tops the tree that has shaped modern football. And he is beating them all at his own game. He has done so for some time, minus the shiny reward at the end.
paras.zh: 他是塑造现代足球的树顶人物。他正在用自己的方式击败他们。他这样做已经有一段时间了，减去最后的闪亮奖励。

paras.en: In that sense he sits alongside Josh Allen, even Joe Burrow and Lamar Jackson, in likely believing he would have a ring were it not for Patrick Mahomes, Andy Reid and the Kansas City Chiefs' Super Bowl dynasty, which twice have taken down Shanahan's 49ers in the season finale.
paras.zh: 从这个意义上说，他与乔什·艾伦（Josh Allen）甚至乔·布罗（Joe Burrow）和拉马尔·杰克逊（Lamar Jackson）坐在一起，很可能相信，如果没有帕特里克·马霍姆斯（Patrick Mahomes）、安迪·里德（Andy Reid）和堪萨斯城酋长队的超级碗王朝（该王朝曾两次在赛季决赛中击败沙纳汉的49人队），他将获得一枚戒指。

paras.en: But the Niners look good for another Championship run. And few deserve it quite like Shanahan.
paras.zh: 但九人队看起来有望再次夺得冠军。很少有人能像沙纳汉那样值得这一荣誉。

paras.en: - Bills beat Chiefs with field goal in final seconds
paras.zh: - 比尔队在最后几秒射门击败酋长队

paras.en: - Eagles sink Cowboys with historic Thanksgiving NFL comeback
paras.zh: - 老鹰队在 NFL 感恩节历史性逆转中击败牛仔队

paras.en: - Get latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: It would be a staggering case study were he not to win a Super Bowl at some stage in San Francisco, bearing in mind not only the number of close calls for a team he has led to four NFC Championship Games - two of which he won - in nine seasons, but also the genius football brain that has governed sidelines and film rooms across the nation.
paras.zh: 如果他没有在旧金山的某个阶段赢得超级碗，那将是一个令人震惊的案例研究，不仅要考虑到他在九个赛季中带领球队四次夺得国联冠军赛（其中两次他获胜）的千钧一发次数，还要考虑到管理全国场边和电影室的天才足球大脑。

paras.en: His 49ers sit 9-1 in pole position for the No 1 seed in the NFC heading into Sunday night's matchup with the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks. They do so having just dismantled the Minnesota Vikings and their league-leading scoring defense 35-10 in Mexico City; only twice this season had teams put up more than 20 points against Brian Flores' defense. Shanahan torched them with ease.
paras.zh: 他率领的 49 人队以 9 胜 1 负的战绩，作为国联一号种子队在周日晚上与卫冕超级碗冠军西雅图海鹰队的比赛中占据杆位。他们刚刚在墨西哥城以 35-10 瓦解了明尼苏达维京人队及其联盟领先的得分防守；本赛季只有两次球队在布莱恩·弗洛雷斯的防守下得分超过 20 分。沙纳汉轻松地点燃了它们。

paras.en: It was a message to teams across the league, many of which had been foiled by Flores, his blitz bombardments and camouflaged coverages. It, too, was further evidence of an expertly drilled operation that stormed past the Los Angeles Rams in Melbourne, Australia in kickoff week before making Mexico home in famously tricky high-altitude conditions. Should they win a Super Bowl, the NFL's 'are they really world champions?' debate loses some substance; the Niners have gone global.
paras.zh: 这是向全联盟球队传达的信息，其中许多球队都被弗洛雷斯的闪电轰炸和伪装覆盖挫败了。这也进一步证明了一场经过专业训练的行动，在开赛周，他们在澳大利亚墨尔本猛烈地击败了洛杉矶公羊队，然后在极其棘手的高海拔条件下回到了墨西哥队。如果他们赢得超级碗，NFL 的“他们真的是世界冠军吗？”辩论失去了一些实质内容；九人队已经走向全球。

paras.en: Shanahan's offense entered Week 12 ranked second in yards per game, sixth in passing, fourth in rushing and No 1 in scoring while topping all teams in EPA/play and success rate as the most prolific attack in football.
paras.zh: 进入第12周后，沙纳汉的进攻在场均码数上排名第二，传球排名第六，冲球排名第四，得分排名第一，同时在EPA/上场次数和成功率方面高居所有球队之首，成为足球界最多产的进攻。

paras.en: At the heart of it is Brock Purdy, who Shanahan both identified and cultivated from Mr Irrelevant to undeniable MVP candidate. Non-Purdy believers had deemed him the product of the Shanahan system; to admit that could be partly true would be a deserved nod to what San Francisco's head coach does as one of football's masterminds. Nonetheless, Purdy has proven he is more than a mere puppet surrounded by stars.
paras.zh: 其核心人物是布洛克·珀迪 (Brock Purdy)，沙纳汉将他从“无关紧要先生”发掘并培养成无可否认的 MVP 候选人。非珀迪信徒认为他是沙纳汉体系的产物；承认这可能部分属实，这就是对旧金山主教练作为足球策划者之一的所作所为的认可。尽管如此，珀迪已经证明他不仅仅是一个被星星包围的傀儡。

paras.en: Purdy is 206 of 290 passing (71 per cent) for 2,624 yards and 23 touchdowns to just five interceptions with a league-high passer rating of 118.2. It should be noted he has missed practice this week due to an ankle issue. So stay tuned.
paras.zh: 普迪 290 次传球成功 206 次（71%），推进 2,624 码，取得 23 次达阵，仅 5 次被拦截，传球评分为联盟最高，为 118.2。值得注意的是，他由于脚踝问题缺席了本周的训练。所以请继续关注。

paras.en: He is wildly accurate, underrated as a creator outside of the pocket, clinical in decision-making, aggressive enough to attack downfield and an outstanding diagnostician. The win over Minnesota in Mexico was the newest addition to his MVP resume, behind which Shanahan has been phenomenal.
paras.zh: 他极其准确，被低估为口袋外的创造者，决策冷静，进攻前场足够积极，并且是一位出色的诊断专家。在墨西哥战胜明尼苏达队是他 MVP 履历中的最新一环，沙纳汉在这背后的表现非常出色。

paras.en: Purdy was 16 of 18 for 195 yards and two touchdowns when facing the blitz, while finishing eight of nine for 100 yards when pressured during blitzes, according to NextGen Stats. It would contribute to an offensive display that saw the Vikings managed an EPA per dropback of 0.613; no other team had surpassed 0.037 EPA per dropback against Minnesota entering Week 11, per Pro Football Focus. His head coach is putting him in positions for success, and Purdy is executing.
paras.zh: 根据 NextGen Stats 的数据，面对闪电战，普迪 18 投 16 分，推进 195 码，两次达阵，而在闪电战中受到压力时，他完成 9 投 8 分，推进 100 码。这将有助于维京人队在进攻端的表现，每次回落的 EPA 为 0.613；据 Pro Football Focus 报道，进入第 11 周对阵明尼苏达队的比赛中，没有其他球队每次回撤超过 0.037 EPA。他的主教练正在让他处于成功的位置，而普迪正在执行。

paras.en: "He's the best player in the game right now. He's super dialled in, the way he prepares, the way he competes," said wide receiver Mike Evans. "He's tough. I always thought he's been underrated, his precision. Super smart player."
paras.zh: “他是目前比赛中最好的球员。他的准备方式、比赛方式都非常出色，”外接手迈克·埃文斯说道。 “他很强硬。我一直认为他的精准度被低估了。超级聪明的球员。”

paras.en: Purdy may not win MVP with Joe Burrow around. And Shanahan probably will not win Coach of the Year. That doesn't mean he isn't the best coach in the NFL.
paras.zh: 如果乔·伯罗在身边，珀迪可能不会赢得 MVP。沙纳汉可能不会赢得年度最佳教练。这并不意味着他不是 NFL 中最好的教练。

paras.en: In many ways he and Purdy are a match made in heaven, perfectly suited to one another. They are also thriving together in the face of seemingly never-ending injury obstacles.
paras.zh: 从很多方面来说，他和珀迪都是天作之合，非常般配。面对看似永无休止的伤病障碍，他们也一起茁壮成长。

paras.en: They lead an old guard of veteran weapons, who sense another championship campaign.
paras.zh: 他们领导着一支经验丰富的老兵卫队，他们感受到了另一场冠军争夺战。

paras.en: George Kittle has been Purdy's most targeted pass catcher with 47 catches for a team-high 591 and seven touchdowns, while Christian McCaffrey has over 1,000 yards from scrimmage with a second-most 14 total touchdowns. Mike Evans is the big-bodied one-on-one target Purdy and Shanahan have been missing, but has missed time through injury, and Deebo Samuel is channelling his wide back days again, but has missed time through injury.
paras.zh: 乔治·基特尔（George Kittle）是珀迪最有针对性的传球接球手，他接球 47 次，完成全队最高的 591 次接球和 7 次达阵，而克里斯蒂安·麦卡弗里 (Christian McCaffrey) 距离混战超过 1,000 码，总共 14 次达阵，位居第二。迈克·埃文斯是身材魁梧的一对一目标，普迪和沙纳汉已经缺席，但因伤缺席了比赛，而迪博·塞缪尔再次利用他的宽背天，但因伤缺席了比赛。

paras.en: "You have to at some point put Purdy in the MVP conversation with what he's been able to do for this 49ers team," said Sky Sports NFL's Phoebe Schecter.
paras.zh: 天空体育 NFL 的菲比·谢克特 (Phoebe Schecter) 表示：“在某个时刻，你必须将 Purdy 纳入 MVP 的讨论中，看看他为 49 人队所做的贡献。”

paras.en: "I think it's hard not to look at what happened in Mexico City and not feel like this team is unstoppable, even with a litany of injuries that are going on."
paras.zh: “我认为很难不看看墨西哥城发生的事情，并且不觉得这支球队是不可阻挡的，即使正在发生一连串的伤病。”

paras.en: The next test comes against the champions, whose defense leads the NFL in yards allowed and passing while ranking fourth in scoring and second in pressure rate.
paras.zh: 下一个测试是对阵冠军球队，他们的防守在允许码数和传球数方面领先 NFL，同时在得分方面排名第四，在压力率方面排名第二。

paras.en: "This Seattle defense have been so fun to watch all season long, and I think you couldn't ask for someone better in terms of Mike Macdonald," said Schecter. "They are gonna come after Brock Purdy. I know we saw the Vikings come with what felt like 90 per cent blitz rate, but I think this Seahawks team will come with a different attitude because Purdy picked them apart."
paras.zh: “整个赛季西雅图的防守都很有趣，我想你找不到比迈克·麦克唐纳更好的人了，”谢克特说。 “他们会追随布洛克·珀迪。我知道我们看到维京人队的闪电战率高达 90%，但我认为这支海鹰队将会采取不同的态度，因为珀迪将他们分开了。”

paras.en: "This is a battle where the NFC West is kind of in the hands of Seattle and San Francisco."
paras.zh: “在这场战斗中，国联西区似乎掌握在西雅图和旧金山手中。”

paras.en: Is this finally Shanahan's time? With the Seahawks, Los Angeles Rams and Chiefs coming up over the next month, their Super Bowl credentials are about to be put to the test.
paras.zh: 这终于是沙纳汉的时代了吗？随着海鹰队、洛杉矶公羊队和酋长队在下个月的比赛中登场，他们的超级碗资格即将受到考验。

paras.en: Mike Evans is 33. Keenan Allen is 34. They are two of the NFL's greatest wide receivers, and now find themselves with instrumental roles to play in San Francisco's Super Bowl hunt. Evans arrived in the offseason and Allen more recently ahead of the trade deadline, playing 19 snaps together in the 49ers' 35-10 win over the Minnesota Vikings in Mexico City. Behold the "unc package".
paras.zh: 迈克·埃文斯 (Mike Evans) 33 岁，基南·艾伦 (Keenan Allen) 34 岁。他们是 NFL 两位最伟大的外接手，现在发现自己在旧金山的超级碗争夺战中发挥着重要作用。埃文斯在休赛期抵达，阿伦最近在交易截止日期前抵达，两人一起打了 19 场比赛，帮助 49 人队在墨西哥城以 35-10 战胜明尼苏达维京人队。看“unc 包”。

paras.en: "We mix in so many guys, and I know everybody's name, but when I'm thinking about football and stuff, I don't always just spit out names fast. So sometimes it's just easier for me to say unc," said head coach Shanahan. "Everyone knows who I'm talking about. "I hope they like it. I think it's cool. They're not, like, really uncles. They're in their 30s. They're still young."
paras.zh: “我们有很多人在一起，我知道每个人的名字，但当我思考足球之类的事情时，我并不总是快速说出名字。所以有时对我来说说‘unc’更容易，”主教练沙纳汉说。 “每个人都知道我在说谁。”我希望他们喜欢。我认为这很酷。他们并不是真正的叔叔。他们都30多岁了。他们还年轻。”

paras.en: The nickname stemmed from George Kittle as he declared the 49ers' veteran-heavy offense "Unc city", the criteria for which is being over the age of 30. Evans is in his 13th season and Allen his 14th, both still one-on-one headaches for defenders across the league and crucial pairs of hands for Purdy come January playoff football.
paras.zh: 这个绰号源于乔治·基特尔（George Kittle），当时他宣布 49 人队的老将进攻为“北卡罗来纳大学城”，其标准是年龄超过 30 岁。埃文斯已经是他的第 13 个赛季，艾伦也是第 14 个赛季，两人在一对一的对抗中仍然让全联盟的防守者头疼不已，而对于普迪来说，一月的季后赛是至关重要的双手。

paras.en: Sleep is a sensitive subject in the NFL this week. But don't sleep on those uncs. Kittle, for the record, insisted he is not part of 'Unc city', despite being 33.
paras.zh: 睡眠是本周 NFL 的一个敏感话题。但不要对这些 un​​cs 耿耿于怀。据记录，基特尔坚称自己不是“北卡罗来纳大学城”的一部分，尽管他已经 33 岁了。

paras.en: The state of things in the NFC East. No, quite literally - the state of things!
paras.zh: 国联东区的情况。不，从字面上看——事物的状态！

paras.en: The truly dreadful standard of the NFC South is letting the East off the hook a little, but the 'battle' for supremacy among four of the NFL's most storied franchises isn't much better.
paras.zh: 国联南区真正可怕的标准是让东区稍稍摆脱困境，但 NFL 四大传奇球队之间的霸主“争夺战”也好不了多少。

paras.en: The New York Giants (6-3-1) hold the advantage, having secured arguably the best win of their season over the Jacksonville Jaguars last week, but their schedule down the stretch - following a winnable trip to the Indianapolis Colts this Sunday - looks rough, and so they could conceivably still be caught.
paras.zh: 纽约巨人队（6-3-1）占据优势，上周对杰克逊维尔美洲虎队取得了可以说是他们赛季最好的胜利，但他们的赛程安排——在本周日客场对阵印第安纳波利斯小马队之后——看起来很艰难，所以可以想象他们仍然可能会被抓住。

paras.en: Whether the Dallas Cowboys (5-7), Washington Commanders (4-5-1) and Philadelphia Eagles (4-7) are capable of chasing the Giants down, though, is another matter entirely!
paras.zh: 不过，达拉斯牛仔队（5-7）、华盛顿指挥官队（4-5-1）和费城老鹰队（4-7）是否有能力追赶巨人队，则完全是另一回事！

paras.en: The Commanders could gain some ground with wins against the lowly Arizona Cardinals and Tennessee Titans over the next two weeks, plus they hold the head-to-head tiebreaker with New York.
paras.zh: 指挥官们可能会在接下来的两周内战胜实力较弱的亚利桑那红雀队和田纳西泰坦队，从而取得一些进展，而且他们还将与纽约队进行正面的决胜局。

paras.en: As for the Cowboys, a season already rich with embarrassing lows reached a new nadir when blowing a Thanksgiving-record 21-point lead (with little more than a quarter left) to the Eagles, who are surely already out of contention despite that stunning comeback.
paras.zh: 至于牛仔队，本已充满尴尬低点的赛季达到了新的最低点，他们将感恩节纪录的 21 分领先优势（仅剩四分之一多一点）输给了老鹰队，尽管他们取得了惊人的逆转，但他们肯定已经退出了竞争。

paras.en: Kirk Cousins doesn't exactly scream somebody who chases revenge, but how he would love to stick it to the franchise that cast him aside as he leads the Minnesota Vikings (7-3) out against the Atlanta Falcons (3-7) this weekend. Cousins signed a bumper four-year $180m deal with Atlanta in 2024 after six seasons in Minnesota, only to see the Falcons go and select another quarterback in Michael Penix Jr with the eighth overall pick in the Draft that same year. Cousins was benched ahead of Week 16 before beginning the 2025 season as backup and starting just eight games until he was released this past offseason. He has since prolonged his days as a starter in the NFL with the Las Vegas Raiders, and recently returned to the Vikings via a trade in a bid to ignite Kevin O'Connell's slumping offense. Once deemed something of a final piece route back to prominence for the Falcons, Cousins is now intent on plunging Kevin Stefanski's side further towards trouble.
paras.zh: 柯克·考辛斯并不是在尖叫一个追求复仇的人，但他多么想把它留在这支抛弃他的球队上，因为他本周末带领明尼苏达维京人队(7-3)对阵亚特兰大猎鹰队(3-7)。考辛斯在明尼苏达效力了六个赛季后，于 2024 年与亚特兰大签订了一份为期四年、价值 1.8 亿美元的丰厚合同，结果猎鹰队在同年的选秀中以第八顺位选中了另一位四分卫小迈克尔·佩尼克斯。考辛斯在第 16 周之前就被放在了替补席上，然后在 2025 赛季开始时作为替补，只首发了 8 场比赛，直到上个休赛期被裁掉。此后，他延长了在拉斯维加斯突袭者队担任 NFL 首发球员的时间，最近通过交易回到维京人队，以点燃凯文·奥康奈尔低迷的进攻。考辛斯一度被认为是猎鹰队重回巅峰的最后一步，但现在他却一心想让凯文·斯特凡斯基的球队陷入更深的麻烦。

paras.en: Sam Darnold has come a long way from "seeing ghosts" during his early struggles with the woeful New York Jets, returning a superb 28-6 record as a starter over the past two seasons which culminated in a Super Bowl ring with the Seattle Seahawks back in February.
paras.zh: 萨姆·达诺德（Sam Darnold）在早期与糟糕的纽约喷气机队的斗争中，已经从“见鬼”中走了很长一段路，在过去的两个赛季中，他作为先发球员取得了 28 胜 6 负的出色战绩，并在二月份与西雅图海鹰队一起夺得了超级碗冠军。

paras.en: As such, you'd have thought his expected return this week for a key NFC West divisional clash with the San Francisco 49ers would be greeted with great fanfare. Not quite…
paras.zh: 因此，你可能会认为他本周在 NFC 西区与旧金山 49 人队的关键比赛中回归将会受到热烈欢迎。不完全是……

paras.en: Darnold has struggled to replicate his championship-winning form of last season, and that of 2024 with the Minnesota Vikings, with his record 3-4 this year. Meanwhile, backup QB Drew Lock has won all three of his starts, in which he's thrown for 837 yards, seven TDs and zero interceptions, completing 73.1 per cent of his passes.
paras.zh: 达诺德一直在努力复制上赛季和 2024 年明尼苏达维京队夺冠的表现，今年他的战绩为 3 胜 4 负。与此同时，替补四分卫德鲁·洛克 (Drew Lock) 赢得了全部三场先发，其中他传球 837 码、7 次达阵、零拦截，传球完成率为 73.1%。

paras.en: Seattle's playoff hopes, and Darnold's job might both be on the line this Sunday.
paras.zh: 西雅图的季后赛希望和达诺德的工作可能都在本周日面临风险。

paras.en: He was the most athletically-gifted quarterback to ever test at the position coming into the NFL, but between persistent accuracy issues and injury setbacks, it has never quite happened for Anthony Richardson since being selected as the fourth pick of the 2023 Draft. He has an arm capable of the otherworldly throws some quarterbacks could only dream of making, and yet an arm prone to botching the most routine plays. At his best there is box office talent, but consistency has tripped him up. Richardson gets a chance to begin rebuilding his career as starter this weekend when he takes the reins for the Indianapolis Colts against the Giants - his first start since the 2024 season. It comes following the release of Daniel Jones amid an outright rebuild in Indianapolis. Awaiting him is a Giants defense ranked seventh in yards and fifth in passing.
paras.zh: 他是 NFL 有史以来最具运动天赋的四分卫，但由于持续存在的准确性问题和伤病挫折，安东尼·理查德森自 2023 年选秀第四顺位被选中以来从未发生过这种情况。他的手臂能够做出一些四分卫梦寐以求的超凡脱俗的投球，但他的手臂却很容易搞砸最常规的比赛。在他最好的时候，他有票房天赋，但一致性却让他陷入困境。理查森本周末将有机会开始重建自己的首发职业生涯，他将带领印第安纳波利斯小马队对阵巨人队，这是他自 2024 赛季以来的首次首发。在此之前，丹尼尔·琼斯在印第安纳波利斯彻底重建期间被释放。等待着他的是巨人队的防守，在码数上排名第七，在传球上排名第五。

paras.en: - The Pittsburgh Steelers released Aaron Rodgers following his stunning claims that head coach Mike McCarthy fell asleep in team meetings
paras.zh: - 匹兹堡钢人队解雇了亚伦·罗杰斯，因为他令人震惊地声称主教练迈克·麦卡锡在球队会议上睡着了

paras.en: - Jaguars wide receiver Parker Washington was ruled out of Sunday's game against the Titans with a shoulder injury
paras.zh: - 美洲虎队外接手帕克·华盛顿因肩伤被排除在周日对阵泰坦队的比赛之外

paras.en: - Former 49ers wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk signed with the Washington Commanders practice squad
paras.zh: - 前 49 人队外接手 Brandon Aiyuk 与华盛顿指挥官训练队签约

paras.en: - Packers edge rusher Micah Parsons made his season debut in a return from his knee injury in Wednesday's loss to the Rams
paras.zh: - 包装工队冲锋手米卡·帕森斯在周三输给公羊队的比赛中膝伤复出，完成了赛季首秀

paras.en: - Cowboys owner Jerry Jones said he would not fire Brian Schottenheimer as head coach after they blew a 21-point lead in a Thanksgiving loss to the Eagles
paras.zh: - 牛仔队老板杰里·琼斯表示，在感恩节输给老鹰队的比赛中，牛仔队失去了 21 分的领先优势后，他不会解雇主教练布莱恩·肖滕海默 (Brian Schottenheimer)

paras.en: - With a completion percentage of 70-or-higher against the Saints, Joe Burrow can become the first player in NFL history with a completion percentage of 70-or-higher in nine consecutive games (minimum 25 attempts per game)
paras.zh: - 在对阵圣徒队的比赛中，乔·伯罗的完成率达到 70 或更高，他可以成为 NFL 历史上第一位连续 9 场比赛完成率达到 70 或更高的球员（每场至少 25 次尝试）

paras.en: - With a passer rating of 110-or-higher against Seattle, Purdy can join Russell Wilson (34 games) and Patrick Mahomes (30) as the only quarterbacks with a passer rating of 110-or-higher in 30 games within their first five seasons in NFL history
paras.zh: - 在对阵西雅图的比赛中，普迪的传球评分达到 110 或更高，他可以与拉塞尔·威尔逊（34 场比赛）和帕特里克·马霍姆斯（30 场比赛）一起，成为 NFL 历史上唯一在 30 场比赛中传球评分达到 110 或更高的四分卫。

paras.en: - With 100 receiving yards at San Francisco, Seahawks wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba can become the first player in NFL history with at least eight receptions and 100 receiving yards in five consecutive road games
paras.zh: - 在旧金山，海鹰外接手 Jaxon Smith-Njigba 拥有 100 码的接球码数，他可以成为 NFL 历史上第一位在连续 5 场客场比赛中至少有 8 次接球和 100 接球码的球员

paras.en: - Cardinals tight end Trey McBride needs three receptions against Washington to become the fourth tight end in NFL history with at least 90 receptions in three career seasons, joining Travis Kelce (seven), Tony Gonzalez (five) and Jason Witten (four).
paras.zh: - 红雀队近端锋特雷·麦克布莱德在对阵华盛顿的比赛中需要 3 次接球，才能成为 NFL 历史上第四位在三个职业赛季中至少接球 90 次的近端锋，加入特拉维斯·凯尔斯（7 次）、托尼·冈萨雷斯（5 次）和杰森·维滕（4 次）的行列。

articles.title: Taylor says he is quitting darts for good after comeback

paras.en: Phil Taylor says he is quitting competitive darts for good as he and Adrian Lewis are knocked out of MODUS Super Series
paras.zh: 菲尔·泰勒 (Phil Taylor) 表示，由于他和阿德里安·刘易斯 (Adrian Lewis) 被 MODUS 超级系列赛淘汰，他将永远退出飞镖比赛

paras.en: Phil Taylor retired from professional darts in 2018; he came out of retirement for this week's MODUS Super Series International Pairs, teaming up with friend Adrian Lewis; the Pair finished second-bottom in group C and were knocked out of the event
paras.zh: 菲尔·泰勒 (Phil Taylor) 于 2018 年从职业飞镖界退役；他在本周的 MODUS 超级系列国际双人赛中复出，与朋友阿德里安·刘易斯 (Adrian Lewis) 搭档；两人在C组倒数第二并被淘汰出局

paras.en: Phil Taylor says he is quitting competitive darts for good and has no plans to come out of retirement again.
paras.zh: 菲尔·泰勒表示，他将永远退出飞镖竞技运动，并且没有计划再次复出。

paras.en: The 16-time world champion was lured back to the oche for this year's MODUS Super Series International Pairs Tournament in Portsmouth alongside his long-time friend Adrian Lewis.
paras.zh: 这位 16 届世界冠军与他的老朋友阿德里安·刘易斯 (Adrian Lewis) 一起参加了今年在朴茨茅斯举行的 MODUS 超级系列国际双人赛。

paras.en: The English duo lost all five of their matches on Thursday but rebounded on Friday, winning three and losing two matches, to finish second-bottom in the Group C standings.
paras.zh: 这对英格兰组合在周四输掉了所有五场比赛，但在周五反弹，赢了三场，输了两场，在 C 组积分榜上排名倒数第二。

paras.en: - Darts in 2026: Key dates, calendar, results, schedule
paras.zh: - 2026 年飞镖：关键日期、日历、结果、时间表

paras.en: - Luke Littler faces nightmare route at World Championship
paras.zh: - 卢克·利特勒在世界锦标赛中面临噩梦般的路线
