paras.zh: - 最新的天空体育交易或无合同直播

paras.en: Taylor, 67, retired from the competitive circuit in 2018, five years after winning his final world crown, and when asked if he would make another comeback, the 14-time PDC World Championship winner told Pluto TV: "[This is] proper retirement."
paras.zh: 现年 67 岁的泰勒于 2018 年退役，距赢得最后一个世界冠军五年后，当被问及是否会再次复出时，这位 14 届 PDC 世界冠军得主告诉冥王星电视台：“[这是]适当的退休。”

paras.en: A heartwarming moment unfolded after Taylor and Lewis were beaten 4-3 in their final group match against Scotland, as each of the other nations arrived to give Taylor a guard of honour, as he walked away from the oche.
paras.zh: 在泰勒和刘易斯在小组赛最后一场对阵苏格兰的比赛中以 4-3 惨败后，一个温暖人心的时刻出现了，当泰勒离开终点站时，其他国家都到场为他提供了仪仗队。

paras.en: "I mean I'm 67, I get my pension next February," Taylor said, when asked if this would be his last competitive appearance. "I'm a pensioner now, officially!"
paras.zh: 当被问及这是否是他最后一次参加比赛时，泰勒说道：“我的意思是，我已经 67 岁了，明年二月我就能领取养老金。” “我现在正式成为一名养老金领取者了！”

paras.en: "I'll still do personal appearances, more having a chat with people, talking about my career, that kind of thing."
paras.zh: “我仍然会进行个人露面，更多地与人们聊天，谈论我的职业生涯，诸如此类的事情。”

paras.en: Taylor and Lewis, who teamed up to win four World Cup of Darts titles between 2012 and 2016, finished Thursday at the bottom of Group C. Friday started poorly for the Englishmen, losing to Denmark's Ivan Springborg-Poulsen and Andreas Toft Jørgensen 4-2.
paras.zh: 泰勒和刘易斯在 2012 年至 2016 年期间联手四次夺得飞镖世界杯冠军，周四在 C 组垫底。周五，英国人开局不佳，以 4-2 输给了丹麦选手伊万·斯普林堡-波尔森和安德烈亚斯·托夫特·约根森。

paras.en: Speaking on his retirement U-turn this week, Taylor said: "I was dreading it to be honest with you because I know I wasn't playing like I can do, but now I've been here and it's all over, I've loved it."
paras.zh: 在谈到本周他退役的大转变时，泰勒说：“说实话，我很害怕，因为我知道我没有发挥出我能做到的水平，但现在我来到了这里，一切都结束了，我很喜欢它。”

paras.en: The pair hit back on Friday with a 4-3 win against Germany, then beat Switzerland and Sweden, both 4-2.
paras.zh: 周五，两人以 4-3 战胜德国队进行反击，随后又以 4-2 击败瑞士队和瑞典队。

paras.en: The Englishmen would tie Scotland at three legs apiece in his final competitive match, before Taylor missed a checkout for 48 for victory, in what would have been a fairy-tale finish.
paras.zh: 在他的最后一场比赛中，英格兰队将与苏格兰队各打三回合，但泰勒错过了48分的胜利，这本来是一个童话般的结局。

paras.en: "Looking back now, it's like it never happened," Taylor said, reflecting on his glittering career.
paras.zh: “现在回想起来，就像从来没有发生过一样，”泰勒在回顾自己辉煌的职业生涯时说道。

paras.en: "I've said to other people who have been on stage and retired: 'How do you feel now?'
paras.zh: “我对其他曾在舞台上退休的人说过：‘你现在感觉如何？’

paras.en: "'It's like you've never been there'. It's ever so weird. And you come up on YouTube and you just go: "No, I know. I know I was there, but I can't remember it."
paras.zh: “‘就好像你从来没有去过那里’。这太奇怪了。你出现在 YouTube 上，然后就说：“不，我知道。我知道我在那里，但我不记得了。”

paras.en: "It's very, very strange because, mentally-wise, you move on. That was your former life and now my life is different."
paras.zh: “这非常非常奇怪，因为从精神上来说，你会继续前进。那是你以前的生活，而现在我的生活不同了。”

paras.en: Instead of flying around the world competing, Taylor says retirement has allowed him to spend more time with his grandchildren.
paras.zh: 泰勒说，退休让他有更多时间陪伴孙辈，而不是飞往世界各地参加比赛。

paras.en: "I've got 11 grandchildren," Taylor said. "So I spend a lot of time with them now.
paras.zh: “我有 11 个孙子，”泰勒说。 “所以我现在花了很多时间和他们在一起。

paras.en: "[I do] things I've never done before. Go to bed when I want; I go to bed early. For me, 9pm would be like, I'd be asleep two hours before 9pm, and it's great.
paras.zh: “[我]做一些我以前从未做过的事情。想什么时候睡觉就什么时候睡觉；我很早就上床睡觉。对我来说，晚上 9 点就像是，我会在晚上 9 点之前睡两个小时，这很棒。

paras.en: "I love getting up early as well. We can do all the chores. We can go shopping and get everything done, and it isn't even 11am. It's great!
paras.zh: “我也喜欢早起。我们可以做所有的家务。我们可以去购物并完成所有事情，而且还不到上午 11 点。这太棒了！

paras.en: "People say I'm the GOAT [Greatest of All Time]-I'm an old goat now!"
paras.zh: “人们说我是有史以来最伟大的山羊——我现在是一只老山羊了！”

articles.title: 'A bit strange' - Leclerc seeking outlier to catch Mercedes in Qatar

paras.en: Charles Leclerc seeking outlier as Ferrari, McLaren, Red Bull try to catch Mercedes at Qatar Grand Prix
paras.zh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔寻求异类，法拉利、迈凯伦、红牛试图在卡塔尔大奖赛上追赶梅赛德斯

paras.en: Mercedes dominated Friday's practice sessions at the Qatar Grand Prix and Charles Leclerc suggested Ferrari, McLaren and Red Bull are missing something; watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead of Qualifying at 6pm on Saturday live on Sky Sports F1
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯在卡塔尔大奖赛周五的练习赛中占据主导地位，查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示法拉利、迈凯轮和红牛错过了一些东西；在周六下午 6 点排位赛之前，观看天空体育 F1 直播下午 2.30 点的最终练习赛

paras.en: Charles Leclerc believes an “outlier” has given Mercedes a “massive” advantage at the Qatar Grand Prix, after Kimi Antonelli and George Russell dominated Friday’s practice sessions.
paras.zh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔认为，基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔在周五的练习赛中占据主导地位后，“异常值”让梅赛德斯在卡塔尔大奖赛上获得了“巨大”优势。

paras.en: Mercedes were nearly half a second quicker than the rest of the field at the Lusail International Circuit as Antonelli topped both sessions from Russell.
paras.zh: 在卢塞尔国际赛车场，梅赛德斯比其他赛车快了近半秒，安东内利在两场比赛中都超越了拉塞尔。

paras.en: Their four-tenths advantage over closest challenger Lando Norris in second practice could have been even greater, with neither Antonelli nor Russell completing a full low-fuel lap on the soft tyres. It was an ominous sign for the rest of the field ahead of Saturday's qualifying, which gets under way at 6pm, with coverage live on Sky Sports F1 from 5.15pm.
paras.zh: 在第二次练习中，他们对最接近的挑战者兰多·诺里斯的十分之四的优势可能会更大，因为安东内利和拉塞尔都没有在软胎上完成完整的低燃料圈。对于周六下午 6 点开始的排位赛来说，这对赛场上的其他选手来说是一个不祥的征兆，天空体育 F1 从下午 5 点 15 分开始进行直播。

paras.en: - Qatar GP: UK schedule and how to watch on Sky Sports
paras.zh: - 卡塔尔大奖赛：英国赛程以及如何在天空体育上观看

paras.en: - F1 2026 Calendar | F1 2026 Standings | F1 Gossip Column
paras.zh: - F1 2026 日历 | F1 2026 积分榜 | F1八卦专栏

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Mercedes' dominance was similar to their pace advantage earlier in the season but the second half of 2026 has largely been very close between F1's top four teams - Mercedes, Ferrari, Red Bull and McLaren.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯的统治地位与本赛季早些时候的速度优势类似，但 2026 年下半年，F1 四大车队（梅赛德斯、法拉利、红牛和迈凯伦）之间的比分非常接近。

paras.en: Ferrari were over one second behind Antonelli on a dismal Friday as Leclerc spun in second practice and Lewis Hamilton suffered an engine problem which brought his Ferrari to a halt.
paras.zh: 在令人沮丧的周五，法拉利落后安东内利一秒多，勒克莱尔在第二次练习中打滑，刘易斯·汉密尔顿遭遇引擎问题，导致他的法拉利停了下来。

paras.en: "Honestly it's been a very difficult day. It's not that we didn't try on the softs, we couldn't improve our lap time on the mediums," said Leclerc.
paras.zh: “老实说，这是非常艰难的一天。并不是我们没有尝试软胎，而是我们无法提高中性胎的单圈时间，”勒克莱尔说道。

paras.en: "I lost the car and had some damage so we had to repair the car but that was the first lap of FP2 and I couldn't improve and even on the new soft later on I couldn't improve.
paras.zh: “我丢了车并且受到了一些损坏，所以我们必须修理车，但那是 FP2 的第一圈，我无法进步，甚至后来在新软胎上我也无法进步。

paras.en: "A very, very difficult day. The feeling is just very difficult to get right. Not even on high fuel we were strong, so for now, it looks like a very difficult weekend but we are working hard to try and understand something.
paras.zh: “非常非常困难的一天。这种感觉很难恢复。即使在高燃油的情况下我们也没有很强，所以现在看来​​这是一个非常困难的周末，但我们正在努力尝试并理解一些事情。

paras.en: "For some reason, Mercedes are so much faster than everybody expected, so the gaps are just a little bit strange, so there's something that's an outlier and we just need to find that."
paras.zh: “出于某种原因，梅赛德斯的速度比大家预期的要快得多，所以差距有点奇怪，所以有一些异常值，我们只需要找到它。”

paras.en: Ferrari were not expected to be strong at the Lusail International Circuit due to the long flat out zones and high-speed corners but Leclerc suggested his team, along with McLaren and Red Bull were missing a trick that will give them more pace.
paras.zh: 由于漫长的平坦区域和高速弯道，法拉利预计不会在卢塞尔国际赛车场表现强劲，但勒克莱尔表示，他的团队以及迈凯伦和红牛都错过了一个能让他们加快速度的技巧。

paras.en: "I don't think we know yet what's the outlier. I think other teams probably didn't find that because Mercedes still have a massive advantage," he said.
paras.zh: “我认为我们还不知道异常值是什么。我认为其他车队可能没有发现这一点，因为梅赛德斯仍然拥有巨大的优势，”他说。

paras.en: "We are going to work towards that and analyse the data to understand what's going on."
paras.zh: “我们将努力实现这一目标并分析数据以了解正在发生的事情。”

paras.en: Norris: Mercedes not even worth thinking about
paras.zh: 诺里斯：梅赛德斯根本不值得考虑

paras.en: McLaren were predicted to be very competitive in Qatar due to their strength in the high-speed corners but Norris and Piastri were never close to matching the pace of Mercedes.
paras.zh: 由于迈凯伦在高速弯道上的实力，预计他们在卡塔尔将非常有竞争力，但诺里斯和皮亚斯特里从未接近梅赛德斯的步伐。

paras.en: On Saturday, McLaren are expected to put the new floor they ran in Las Vegas on the car but Norris does not think it will make a big enouch difference to catch Mercedes who are in "a different category".
paras.zh: 周六，迈凯伦预计将在拉斯维加斯使用的新地板安装在赛车上，但诺里斯认为这不会对赶上“不同类别”的梅赛德斯产生太大影响。

paras.en: "I don't know how much that will help around here compared to Vegas," said last year's world champion.
paras.zh: “我不知道与维加斯相比，这对这里有多大帮助，”去年的世界冠军说道。

paras.en: "But obviously tonight [Friday] we will see how much we can gain from that. It's not going to be the gap we need.
paras.zh: “但显然今晚（周五）我们会看到我们能从中获得多少收益。这不会是我们需要的差距。

paras.en: "We are probably seven tenths off the Mercedes a lap so it's not even worth thinking about them. But relative to the rest we seem to be in a good place. The fact we can have the new floor on tomorrow will add a little bit and a little bit is better than nothing. We seem in a relatively decent place."
paras.zh: “我们可能落后梅赛德斯一圈十分之七，所以甚至不值得考虑他们。但相对于其他人，我们似乎处于一个很好的位置。事实上，我们明天可以使用新地板，这会增加一点点，一点点总比没有好。我们看起来处于一个相对不错的位置。”

paras.en: Both Antonelli and Russell pointed out that Verstappen will always be a threat and the four-time world champion is coy about his chances of challenging the Mercedes in qualifying.
paras.zh: 安东内利和拉塞尔都指出，维斯塔潘永远是一个威胁，而四届世界冠军对于他在排位赛中挑战梅赛德斯的机会却含糊其辞。

paras.en: "A bit of a difficult day. The balance of the car is a bit too disconnected at the moment to go fast, so that's what we need to fix," said the Red Bull driver.
paras.zh: “这是艰难的一天。目前赛车的平衡有点脱节，无法快速行驶，所以这就是我们需要解决的问题，”红牛车手说道。

paras.en: "The all-round balance is not there at the moment and is costing us quite a bit of lap time. We will keep trying and see how good we can get it."
paras.zh: “目前还没有实现全面的平衡，这让我们损失了相当多的单圈时间。我们将继续努力，看看我们能做到多好。”

paras.en: "Mercedes look quite far ahead on the short run and long run. Let's see how much we can close the gap."
paras.zh: “从短期和长期来看，梅赛德斯都具有相当远的前景。让我们看看我们能在多大程度上缩小差距。”

articles.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to kill Ukrainian American rapper on its soil
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: COPENHAGEN, Denmark — Authorities thwarted the attempted killing of a Ukrainian American citizen on Danish soil in a plot allegedly orchestrated by Russian intelligence services, the Danish prime minister’s office said Friday.
paras.zh: 丹麦哥本哈根——丹麦首相办公室周五表示，当局挫败了在丹麦领土上企图杀害一名乌克兰裔美国公民的事件，这起事件据称是由俄罗斯情报部门策划的。

paras.en: The Russian defense attaché has been expelled from Denmark in response, Danish Foreign Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen told a news conference. Two alleged members of the outlawed Danish gang “Loyal to Familia” have been arrested in connection with the attempted killing, police said.
paras.zh: 丹麦外交部长拉斯·洛克·拉斯穆森在新闻发布会上表示，作为回应，俄罗斯武官已被驱逐出丹麦。警方称，丹麦非法帮派“忠诚家族”的两名涉嫌成员因涉嫌谋杀未遂而被捕。

paras.en: Danish broadcaster DR, citing a court hearing, reported the men are suspected of having been recruited to assassinate a Ukrainian rapper ahead of a planned performance.
paras.zh: 丹麦广播公司 DR 援引法庭听证会报道称，这些人涉嫌被招募在计划演出前暗杀一名乌克兰说唱歌手。

paras.en: Police thwarted the alleged plot when they arrested the two men shortly before the rapper Kyivstoner’s Sept. 25 concert, which was later canceled.
paras.zh: 警方在说唱歌手 Kyivstoner 9 月 25 日的演唱会前不久逮捕了这两人，挫败了这一阴谋，演唱会后来被取消。

paras.en: It was unclear how police identified the two men, who were stopped in a vehicle carrying several weapons, or how the investigation expanded to include two other men who are not accused of participating in the alleged assassination plot targeting Kyivstoner.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚警方如何识别这两名男子，他们被拦在一辆携带多件武器的车辆中，也不清楚调查范围如何扩大到另外两名未被指控参与针对基辅斯通纳的暗杀阴谋的男子。

paras.en: However, all four men have been held in custody since September, according to the broadcaster.
paras.zh: 然而，据该广播公司报道，自 9 月以来，所有四名男子均已被拘留。

paras.en: It was also unclear how the Russian intelligence services allegedly recruited the two Danish suspects.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚俄罗斯情报部门是如何招募这两名丹麦嫌疑人的。

paras.en: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen said: “It is a clear illustration of the grave security situation Denmark and Europe find ourselves in. We are facing a Russia under pressure which is acting more aggressively and is more willing to take risks.”
paras.zh: 丹麦首相梅特·弗雷泽里克森表示：“这清楚地说明了丹麦和欧洲所处的严峻安全局势。我们面临着压力之下的俄罗斯，它的行动更加激进，更愿意承担风险。”

paras.en: The Danes’ announcement came as tensions between Europe and Russia heightened again Friday. Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone came down in Poland in what its prime minister said was likely a provocation timed to coincide with European military exercises in his country for a possible postwar mission in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 丹麦人宣布这一消息之际，欧洲和俄罗斯之间的紧张局势周五再次加剧。两枚俄罗斯导弹和一架疑似无人机在波兰坠落，波兰总理表示，这可能是一次挑衅，恰逢欧洲在波兰进行军事演习，以执行可能在乌克兰执行的战后任务。

paras.en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said on Saturday the E.U. stands in full solidarity with Denmark.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩周六表示，欧盟完全声援丹麦。

paras.en: “This was an attack on E.U. ‌soil. And it is unacceptable. We stand in full ‌solidarity with Denmark. ‌And with all Member States targeted by Russian hybrid attacks,” she said in an X post.
paras.zh: “这是对欧盟领土的攻击。这是不可接受的。我们完全声援丹麦。以及所有成为俄罗斯混合攻击目标的成员国，”她在 X 帖子中表示。

paras.en: European Council President António Costa said: “We will not be intimidated. Russia’s tactics and threats will not weaken the European Union’s resolve to continue supporting Ukraine.”
paras.zh: 欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔表示：“我们不会被吓倒。俄罗斯的策略和威胁不会削弱欧盟继续支持乌克兰的决心。”

paras.en: The Russian Embassy in Copenhagen said on Friday the accusations were not backed ‌with proof.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯驻哥本哈根大使馆周五表示，这些指控没有证据支持。

articles.title: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine war, new estimate suggests
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in Ukraine, according to a new projection based on leaked official data, an estimate that sheds new light on the staggering cost of President Vladimir Putin’s war.
paras.zh: 根据泄露的官方数据的最新预测，超过 70 万俄罗斯士兵在乌克兰丧生，这一估计让人们对弗拉基米尔·普京总统的战争造成的惊人成本有了新的认识。

paras.en: The grim assessment comes more than 4½ years after the Kremlin’s invasion of its neighbor, an all-out war that has consumed Russian society. The death toll has been mounting with each painstaking ground assault, with no end to the conflict in sight despite pressure from President Donald Trump for Kyiv to make a deal.
paras.zh: 这一严峻的评估是在克里姆林宫入侵其邻国超过 4.5 年之后做出的，这场全面战争吞噬了俄罗斯社会。每一次艰苦的地面袭击造成的死亡人数都在不断增加，尽管唐纳德·特朗普总统向基辅施压要求达成协议，但冲突看不到结束的迹象。

paras.en: The leak from Russia’s state statistics agency, Rosstat — released by Belarusian and Ukrainian hackers earlier this month — reveals that at least 490,000 Russian soldiers had been killed in Ukraine based on registered deaths as of the end of September. That’s according to breakdowns by a range of independent media, including the BBC and others, that were published this week. But one exiled Russian media outlet, Meduza, also used the leaked mortality data to project the total number of military deaths, including those that have not yet been recorded.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，白俄罗斯和乌克兰黑客发布了俄罗斯国家统计机构 Rosstat 的泄密信息，显示截至 9 月底，至少有 49 万名俄罗斯士兵在乌克兰被杀。这是根据包括 BBC 等在内的一系列独立媒体本周发布的细分数据得出的。但一家流亡的俄罗斯媒体 Meduza 也利用泄露的死亡率数据来预测军人死亡总数，包括尚未记录的死亡人数。

paras.en: Meduza estimates that number to be 720,000.
paras.zh: Meduza 估计这个数字为 720,000。

paras.en: NBC News did not have access to the leaked data and could not authenticate it or independently confirm these numbers.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻无法访问泄露的数据，也无法对其进行验证或独立确认这些数字。

paras.en: Neither Moscow nor Kyiv provide regular updates on their battlefield losses.
paras.zh: 莫斯科和基辅都没有定期更新其战场损失情况。

paras.en: Mediazona, along with the BBC Russian Service and a team of volunteers, has been compiling a separate named list of Russian war dead using open-source data for years, given the difficulty of gauging the true impact of the war on Russian society.
paras.zh: 鉴于难以衡量战争对俄罗斯社会的真正影响，Mediazona 与 BBC 俄罗斯台和一组志愿者多年来一直在使用开源数据编制一份单独的俄罗斯战争死难者名单。

paras.en: In its analysis, Mediazona said it arrived at the 490,000 war dead number from the 29.7 million records it obtained from the hackers that covered nearly all death registrations in Russia from early 2021 through September this year, based mainly on records with an “explicit military cause of death” and court rulings declaring people dead.
paras.zh: Mediazona 在分析中表示，它从黑客处获得的 2970 万条记录中得出了 49 万人的战争死亡人数，这些记录几乎涵盖了俄罗斯从 2021 年初到今年 9 月的所有死亡登记，主要依据的是“明确的军事死因”记录和宣布死亡的法院裁决。

paras.en: The leaked data was cross-checked against Mediazona’s own named list and matched 95% of the records, as well as the publicly accessible national Probate Registry, a database of inheritance cases, and Rosstat’s own official mortality statistics, the outlet said.
paras.zh: 该媒体称，泄露的数据与 Mediazona 自己的名单、可公开访问的国家遗嘱认证登记处、继承案件数据库以及 Rosstat 自己的官方死亡率统计数据进行了交叉核对，并与 95% 的记录相匹配。

paras.en: Mediazona said it also checked against possible data tempering and fake military death injections by cross-referencing a unique vital record number that every death registration carries, and court rulings, which often cite death record numbers.
paras.zh: Mediazona 表示，它还通过交叉引用每个死亡登记所携带的独特生命记录编号以及法院裁决（通常引用死亡记录编号）来检查可能的数据篡改和虚假的军事死亡注射。

paras.en: “We are confident that this data is genuine,” the outlet said, adding that fabricating a dataset of this scale from scratch would be “impossible” especially as it checks out against official registries.
paras.zh: 该媒体表示：“我们相信这些数据是真实的。”他补充说，从头开始制作如此规模的数据集是“不可能的”，尤其是在与官方登记处进行核对时。

paras.en: The hackers shared leaked data with a number of other exiled Russian media outlets and the BBC, who all arrived at a figure close to the 490,000 reported by Mediazona. A similar estimate of half a million Russian troops killed was also shared by a senior British defense official in September.
paras.zh: 黑客与其他一些流亡的俄罗斯媒体和 BBC 分享了泄露的数据，这些媒体得出的数据接近 Mediazona 报道的 49 万。 9月份，一位英国高级国防官员也做出了类似的估计，有50万俄罗斯士兵被杀。

paras.en: Before the new analysis of the data in the Rosstat leak, the verified named list of Russia’s war dead compiled by Mediazona and the BBC stood at just over 289,000. It was based on obituaries, local news and official registries, and was the only publicly available database containing the fallen soldiers’ names.
paras.zh: 在对 Rosstat 泄露的数据进行新分析之前，Mediazona 和 BBC 编制的经核实的俄罗斯战死者名单刚刚超过 289,000 人。它基于讣告、当地新闻和官方登记，是唯一包含阵亡士兵姓名的公开数据库。

paras.en: The Russian Defense Ministry has not officially updated its death toll in Ukraine since the early months of the war, when then-Defense Minister Sergei Shoigu said it stood at nearly 6,000.
paras.zh: 自战争爆发的最初几个月以来，俄罗斯国防部一直没有正式更新乌克兰境内的死亡人数，当时时任国防部长谢尔盖·绍伊古称乌克兰死亡人数接近 6,000 人。

paras.en: Mediazona warned that due to a considerable lag in military death registrations, Rosstat may not yet have finished capturing deaths from 2025. “That means the leaked records through late September — however authentic and reliable they are — still fall short of the true death toll,” it said.
paras.zh: Mediazona 警告说，由于军事死亡登记存在相当大的滞后性，Rosstat 可能尚未完成 2025 年以来的死亡人数统计。“这意味着截至 9 月底的泄露记录——无论它们多么真实可靠——仍然低于真实的死亡人数，”它说。

paras.en: It was this that prompted Meduza to try and calculate an estimate of total Russian losses to date — 720,000 people, a figure that includes deaths it predicts will be registered later.
paras.zh: 正是这一点促使 Meduza 尝试计算迄今为止俄罗斯总损失的估计数——72 万人，其中包括预计稍后登记的死亡人数。

paras.en: “Since 2024, the share of late registrations has grown dramatically, and it continues to rise,” the outlet said in its own analysis, adding that the 2026 data is extremely incomplete for both missing service members and other military deaths. It said it used epidemiology and tools like the “chain-ladder method” from actuarial science, which uses mathematics to help measure the probability and risk of future events, to arrive at the projected estimate. These methods allowed Meduza to calculate the number of military deaths that it estimates have happened but haven’t yet shown up in the data, the outlet said.
paras.zh: 该媒体在自己的分析中表示：“自 2024 年以来，延迟登记的比例急剧增加，而且还在继续上升。”并补充说，2026 年的数据对于失踪军人和其他军人死亡来说都极其不完整。该公司表示，它使用了流行病学和精算科学中的“链梯法”等工具，利用数学来帮助衡量未来事件的概率和风险，以得出预计的估计。该媒体称，这些方法使 Meduza 能够计算出其估计已发生但尚未显示在数据中的军人死亡人数。

paras.en: “Today, it’s simply impossible to leave this category out of an overall estimate of the dead,” it added.
paras.zh: 报告补充说：“今天，根本不可能将这一类别排除在对死亡人数的总体估计之外。”

paras.en: The Kremlin dismissed the analysis Wednesday.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫周三驳回了这一分析。

paras.en: “The only department authorized to officially release data on casualties is the Ministry of Defense of the Russian Federation,” spokesman Dmitry Peskov told NBC News during a call with reporters, when asked if the Kremlin was aware of the 700,000 projected estimate by Meduza.
paras.zh: 当被问及克里姆林宫是否知道 Meduza 预计的 70 万人伤亡时，发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫 (Dmitry Peskov) 在与记者通话时告诉 NBC 新闻：“唯一有权正式发布伤亡数据的部门是俄罗斯联邦国防部。”

paras.en: “I suggest disregarding any other data,” he added.
paras.zh: “我建议忽略任何其他数据，”他补充道。

paras.en: It is similarly difficult to ascertain the true number of Ukrainian soldiers killed fighting against Russia. Kyiv has been slightly more forthcoming, with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy volunteering some estimates of battlefield losses in recent years, the latest in July putting the total at around 50,000 killed.
paras.zh: 同样难以确定在与俄罗斯的战斗中阵亡的乌克兰士兵的真实人数。基辅的态度稍显坦诚，总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)自愿提供了对近年来战场损失的一些估计，最近一次是在7月，死亡总数约为5万人。

paras.en: But analysts say this is likely an undercount.
paras.zh: 但分析人士表示，这可能是低估的。

paras.en: An assessment by the Washington-based Center for Strategic and International Studies earlier this year said up to 150,000 Ukrainian soldiers have been killed, based on estimates from Britain’s military, Mediazona’s named war dead list, its own estimates and interviews with U.S., European, Ukrainian and other government officials.
paras.zh: 总部位于华盛顿的战略与国际研究中心今年早些时候的一项评估称，根据英国军方的估计、Mediazona 公布的战争死亡名单、该中心自己的估计以及对美国、欧洲、乌克兰和其他政府官员的采访，多达 15 万名乌克兰士兵被杀。

articles.title: A rising political star in China is the latest victim of Xi’s purge
articles.author: Max Burman

paras.en: He was on the rise among China’s political elite, hosting tech leaders and senior American officials. But now Shanghai party chief Chen Jining, a member of the country’s influential politburo, appears to be the latest senior official brought down by President Xi Jinping’s sweeping purge.
paras.zh: 他在中国政治精英中崭露头角，接待过科技领袖和美国高级官员。但现在，具有影响力的中国政治局委员、上海市委书记陈吉宁似乎是习近平主席全面清洗下台的最新一位高级官员。

paras.en: The hammer unexpectedly came down on Chen in the form of a two-line bulletin on the Xinhua news agency Tuesday: He is “suspected of serious violations of Party discipline and law and is currently under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation” — a common euphemism for corruption crackdowns on ruling Communist Party officials under Xi.
paras.zh: 新华社周二发布的两行公报出人意料地对陈进行了打击：他“涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查”——这是习近平领导下的反腐败行动的常见委婉说法。

paras.en: Public announcements such as these usually mark the end of a political career in China. Chen has made no public statement.
paras.zh: 诸如此类的公开声明通常标志着中国政治生涯的结束。陈没有发表公开声明。

paras.en: He is the fourth politburo member to be purged in less than two years, part of a broader crackdown that has swept aside top military leaders as Xi consolidates power. He is set to extend his rule next year, at a party congress that is held once every five years and looms over the preceding months.
paras.zh: 他是不到两年内第四位被清洗的政治局委员，这是习近平巩固权力之际，一场更广泛的镇压行动的一部分，该镇压行动扫除了高级军事领导人。他计划在明年召开的党代表大会上延长他的统治，党代表大会每五年举行一次，并在前几个月举行。

paras.en: But Chen’s abrupt downfall took many close observers of China by surprise, given his profile and career path would usually point to a bright future.
paras.zh: 但陈的突然垮台让许多密切关注中国的观察人士感到惊讶，因为他的个人资料和职业道路通常预示着光明的未来。

paras.en: “He was potentially going to the highest level, which would be the standing committee. And I think from a lot of Western observers, people thought he had even better prospects,” Damien Ma, the Singapore-based director of the Carnegie China think tank, told NBC News.
paras.zh: “他有可能晋升到最高级别，即常务委员会。我认为，从很多西方观察家的角度来看，人们认为他有更好的前景，”卡内基中国智囊团驻新加坡主任马达明告诉美国全国广播公司新闻。

paras.en: Some analysts have speculated that Xi, increasingly viewed as likely to rule for life, may have been purging a viable replacement. Steve Tsang, director of the SOAS China Institute in London, said however that Chen was “someone who could rise further but not as a successor.”
paras.zh: 一些分析人士猜测，越来越被认为有可能实现终身统治的习近平可能正在清除一个可行的替代者。然而，伦敦亚非学院中国研究所所长曾锐生表示，陈是“可以进一步晋升的人，但不是接班人”。

paras.en: Chen, a 62-year-old technocrat known as a friend of foreign business and an advocate for AI, was an environmental scientist who studied in London and swiftly rose through the party’s ranks. He served as China’s environmental minister, Beijing’s mayor and the party secretary in Shanghai — a post once held by Xi and widely considered a stepping stone to bigger things.
paras.zh: 陈是一位 62 岁的技术官僚，被誉为外国企业的朋友和人工智能的倡导者，他是一位环境科学家，曾在伦敦学习并迅速在党内晋升。他曾担任中国环境部部长、北京市市长和上海市委书记——习近平曾担任过这一职位，并被广泛认为是实现更大目标的垫脚石。

paras.en: Just last month, Chen hosted Apple Chairman Tim Cook, welcoming the U.S. tech giant to “make full use of Shanghai’s strengths” and bring more products to the city, a financial and cultural hub that has long served as a connection between China and the international community.
paras.zh: 就在上个月，陈云接待了苹果公司董事长蒂姆·库克，欢迎这家美国科技巨头“充分利用上海的优势”，为这座长期作为中国与国际社会联系的金融和文化中心的城市带来更多产品。

paras.en: In his last public appearance last week, during a tour of a shipping facility, Chen called for advancing the industry’s digital transformation.
paras.zh: 上周，陈在参观一家航运设施时最后一次公开露面，呼吁推进行业数字化转型。

paras.en: By Wednesday, Chen’s name has been removed from some official websites. A webpage on the Shanghai government site showing that meeting with Cook is now showing a 404 message, or not found.
paras.zh: 截至周三，陈的名字已从一些官方网站上删除。上海市政府网站上显示与库克会面的网页现在显示404消息，或者没有找到。

paras.en: Chen is just the latest senior official in the crosshairs of Xi’s long-running anti-corruption campaign and emphasis on party discipline, which analysts say is as much about loyalty as it is about reform.
paras.zh: 陈只是习近平长期反腐运动和强调党纪的最新一位高级官员，分析人士表示，这既关乎改革，也关乎忠诚。

paras.en: “It is a warning to all technocrats, as Chen was a rising star among technocrats and had no apparent failures in a technocratic way. So, message is: adhere to strict party discipline and demonstrate unquestionable loyalty to Xi or else,” Tsang said.
paras.zh: “这是对所有技术官僚的警告，因为陈是技术官僚中的后起之秀，在技术官僚方面没有明显的失败。因此，传达的信息是：遵守严格的党纪，并对习近平或其他人表现出毫无疑问的忠诚，”曾荫权说。

paras.en: The party’s Central Committee, which has about 200 mostly male leaders, vowed to “ensure more rigorous discipline enforcement, and make full use of discipline as a guide, restraint, guarantee, and incentive” at its closed-door gathering, the fifth plenum, last month.
paras.zh: 由约200名主要领导人组成的党中央在上个月举行的五中全会闭门会议上誓言要“更加严格执行纪律，充分发挥纪律的引领作用、约束作用、保障作用和激励作用”。

paras.en: “What they’ve been building as part of this discipline machine over the last 15 years is to kind of implement their sort of internal operating system of how they deal with, let’s say, bad eggs within the party,” Ma, of Carnegie China, said.
paras.zh: 卡内基中国的马云表示：“过去 15 年里，他们一直在建立一套纪律机制，以实施他们如何处理党内坏蛋的内部操作系统。”

paras.en: “The top leadership is normalizing this anti-corruption, this self-cleansing,” Ma said. “It is now a normal part of what the party expects, and they’re trying to embed that over time and down to every single level,” he added.
paras.zh: 马云表示：“最高领导层正在将这种反腐败、这种自我净化常态化。” “现在，这是党期望的正常部分，他们正试图随着时间的推移将其融入到各个层面，”他补充道。

paras.en: The Chinese government has not announced any charges against Chen, who was the youngest member of the country’s elite decision-making body. The 24-member Politburo was unveiled in 2022 but is now down to 21 members after the purges. Last month, top general Zhang Shengmin was elevated to the body in a rare addition.
paras.zh: 中国政府尚未宣布对陈提出任何指控，他是中国精英决策机构中最年轻的成员。由 24 名成员组成的政治局于 2022 年揭晓，但在清洗后目前已减少至 21 名。上个月，最高将领张胜民罕见地晋升为正职。

paras.en: Chen’s undoing comes a year before the party’s top leadership is reshuffled at the 21st Communist Party Congress, when Xi is expected to solidify control even further and cement another five-year term at the helm of the country.
paras.zh: 陈的下台发生在中共第二十一次全国代表大会上对党的最高领导层进行改组的一年前，届时习近平预计将进一步巩固控制权，并巩固国家的另一个五年任期。

paras.en: Born in 1964, Chen studied at the prestigious Tsinghua university, long a major pipeline for senior party officials and where he served as president from 2012 to 2015. His name has now been removed from Tsinghua’s online list of former presidents.
paras.zh: 陈出生于 1964 年，曾就读于著名的清华大学，清华大学长期以来一直是党的高级官员的主要培养人才，并于 2012 年至 2015 年担任校长。他的名字现已从清华大学的在线前校长名单中删除。

paras.en: After studying at Tsinghua in the 1980s, he moved for a decade to Britain, where he obtained a doctorate from Imperial College London in 1993.
paras.zh: 20世纪80年代在清华大学学习后，他移居英国十年，并于1993年在伦敦帝国理工学院获得博士学位。

paras.en: Chen returned to Tsinghua’s environmental science and engineering department in 1998 before being named the university’s president in 2012, according to an official biography.
paras.zh: 据官方传记称，陈于 1998 年回到清华大学环境科学与工程系，并于 2012 年被任命为清华大学校长。

paras.en: He’s authored dozens of papers, including on carbon emission reduction and water quality monitoring.
paras.zh: 他撰写了数十篇论文，包括有关碳减排和水质监测的论文。

paras.en: The relatively young Chen would ride around campus on his bike and built a reputation for pushing institutional reforms in his three years at the helm of the university, according to an article in People’s Digest, a magazine affiliated with the People’s Daily, the community party’s official newspaper.
paras.zh: 据共产党官方报纸《人民日报》旗下杂志《人民文摘》上的一篇文章称，相对年轻的陈经常骑着自行车在校园里骑车，并在执掌大学的三年里因推动体制改革而建立了声誉。

paras.en: The article, titled “From University President to Cabinet Minister,” was published in 2015, the same year he was picked to lead the Environmental Protection Ministry. In 2017, Chen became mayor of the capital, Beijing, where he oversaw the 2022 Winter Olympics during the Covid pandemic.
paras.zh: 这篇题为《从大学校长到内阁部长》的文章发表于 2015 年，同年他被选为环境保护部部长。 2017年，陈就任首都北京市市长，并在新冠病毒大流行期间监督了2022年冬季奥运会的举办。

paras.en: Later that year he was transferred to Shanghai and became the party chief, a coveted role that Xi took on himself in 2007 before becoming the country’s leader in 2013.
paras.zh: 同年晚些时候，他被调到上海，成为市委书记，这是习近平在 2013 年成为国家领导人之前于 2007 年亲自担任的令人垂涎的职位。

paras.en: There, he became heavily involved with the tech industry, regularly hosting CEOs and advocating for more investment into Shanghai, where the World AI Conference was hosted earlier this year.
paras.zh: 在那里，他积极参与科技行业，定期接待首席执行官，并倡导对今年早些时候举办世界人工智能大会的上海进行更多投资。

paras.en: Chen hosted Elon Musk in 2023 to discuss Tesla’s operations in the city. Last year, he accompanied Xi to an AI hub there. And last month, Chen met with several European tech leaders, in addition to hosting Cook.
paras.zh: 2023 年，陈接待了埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk)，讨论特斯拉在该市的运营情况。去年，他陪同习近平参观了那里的一个人工智能中心。上个月，陈除了接待库克外，还会见了几位欧洲科技领袖。

paras.en: Alongside the top post in Shanghai, Chen also was elected for a five-year term as a member of the Politburo, China’s elite decision-making body headed by Xi.
paras.zh: 除了上海的最高职位之外，陈还当选为中央政治局委员，任期五年，中央政治局是由习近平领导的中国精英决策机构。

paras.en: While the Politburo is not the absolute apex of power, he was seen as a contender the much-smaller Politburo’s Standing Committee, which is made up of the country’s highest ranking officials.
paras.zh: 虽然政治局并不是绝对的权力最高层，但他被视为规模小得多的政治局常务委员会的竞争者，该常务委员会由该国最高级别的官员组成。

paras.en: “If you’re party secretary of one of the four big municipalities, Beijing, Shanghai, Chongqing and Tianjin, you have pretty good prospects. That’s sort of an indication that you’re on your way up,” Ma said.
paras.zh: “如果你是北京、上海、重庆和天津四大直辖市之一的党委书记，你的前景相当不错。这在某种程度上表明你正在上升，”马云说。

paras.en: Whether or not Chen’s ousting deals a blow to the country’s technology ambitions and its race for dominance in artificial intelligence, remains to be seen, Ma said. But either way, his downfall will force a rethink among those seeking to predict the route to power in modern China.
paras.zh: 马云表示，陈的下台是否会打击该国的技术雄心及其在人工智能领域的主导地位之争，还有待观察。但无论怎样，他的垮台都将迫使那些试图预测现代中国权力之路的人重新思考。

paras.en: “Part of it is thinking through what is really the new criteria to get to the top, and they may not be what we thought just a few months ago,” Ma added.
paras.zh: 马云补充道：“其中一部分是思考登上顶峰的真正新标准是什么，它们可能与我们几个月前的想法不同。”

articles.title: Coastal village clings to remote charms amid surging popularity
articles.author: Emma Siossian

paras.en: For generations of families and surfers, a visit to Seal Rocks has included a stop at its much-loved general store, an enduring landmark in the remote coastal village.
paras.zh: 对于几代家庭和冲浪者来说，参观海豹岩时都会在其深受喜爱的杂货店停留，这是偏远沿海村庄的一个经久不衰的地标。

paras.en: The shop is on the only road into the town on the NSW Mid North Coast, perched at the top of a hill overlooking a crescent-shaped beach, fringed by bushland.
paras.zh: 这家商店位于新南威尔士州中北海岸通往城镇的唯一道路上，坐落在山顶上，俯瞰着新月形的海滩，周围是丛林。

paras.en: Owned by the Horgan family for more than 70 years, it is reminiscent of a different era captured in the faded photos that cover the walls.
paras.zh: 它由霍根家族拥有 70 多年，让人想起墙上褪色的照片中捕捉到的另一个时代。

paras.en: An old telephone exchange box remains inside, while outside there's a working public phone booth — a necessity rather than a novelty in a town where mobile reception remains notoriously unreliable.
paras.zh: 里面保留着一个旧的电话交换机，而外面有一个正在使用的公用电话亭——在这个移动信号接收仍然非常不可靠的小镇里，这是必需品，而不是新奇的东西。

paras.en: Kylie Galea helps run the store and post office.
paras.zh: 凯莉·加利亚 (Kylie Galea) 帮助经营商店和邮局。

paras.en: "Just about every day there's someone who comes in that says, 'I used to come here when I was a kid, I remember this store'.
paras.zh: “几乎每天都会有人进来说，‘我小时候曾经来过这里，我记得这家商店’。

paras.en: "It hasn't really changed much at all in appearance and the way it's run either… and I think a lot of people love that."
paras.zh: “它的外观和运行方式都没有发生太大变化……我认为很多人都喜欢这一点。”

paras.en: The store in many ways reflects the character of Seal Rocks, which is about a 40-minute drive south of Forster Tuncurry, flanked by the ocean on one side and the bushland of the Myall Lakes National Park on the other.
paras.zh: 这家商店在很多方面都体现了海豹岩的特色，该岩位于福斯特坦卡里以南约 40 分钟车程处，一侧是海洋，另一侧是迈奥尔湖国家公园的丛林。

paras.en: Its population was recorded as 56 in the 2021 census.
paras.zh: 2021 年人口普查显示其人口为 56 人。

paras.en: "The beaches are beautiful and the people are just as lovely. It gets very quiet during winter, but really winter is the best time of year to be here," Ms Galea said.
paras.zh: “海滩很美丽，人们也很可爱。冬天会变得非常安静，但实际上冬天是一年中来这里的最佳时间，”加莱女士说。

paras.en: Raymond Heath, from Tenambit in the Hunter region, first visited Seal Rocks on a surf trip in 1976, and has been snapping images of the area ever since.
paras.zh: 来自猎人地区特南比特的雷蒙德·希思 (Raymond Heath) 于 1976 年在一次冲浪之旅中首次来到海豹岩，从那时起，他就一直在拍摄该地区的照片。

paras.en: "That's the charm of the place; it's another time, another place," he said.
paras.zh: “这就是这个地方的魅力；这是另一个时间，另一个地方，”他说。

paras.en: That is part of what drew Katie Toney and her husband Daniel to the town in 2021.
paras.zh: 这也是 2021 年吸引 Katie Toney 和她的丈夫 Daniel 来到这座小镇的原因之一。

paras.en: Formerly a journalist and cameraman, they now run a holiday park in the village.
paras.zh: 他们以前是一名记者和摄影师，现在在村里经营一个假日公园。

paras.en: Ms Toney said it was a great place to raise children.
paras.zh: 托尼女士说这是一个抚养孩子的好地方。

paras.en: "Just that really no-tech kind of childhood they've been able to have and that really free-range lifestyle of being in just this tiny seaside town," she said.
paras.zh: “他们能够拥有真正没有科技的童年，以及在这个海边小镇上真正自由放养的生活方式，”她说。

paras.en: "We are quite off-grid in a lot of ways still…we have a big water treatment plant that comes off the bore, no one's on town water, no one's on town sewage, there's no phone reception.
paras.zh: “我们在很多方面仍然脱离电网……我们有一个大型水处理厂，没有人使用城镇用水，没有人使用城镇污水，没有电话信号。

paras.en: "So, I think just because of the lack of developmental things, we've been able to maintain that kind of country charm by the beach."
paras.zh: “所以，我认为正是因为缺乏发展的东西，我们才能够在海滩上保持那种乡村魅力。”

paras.en: But that "country charm by the beach" has put Seal Rocks on the tourism radar and, like many other small Australian coastal towns, it has been feeling the pressure.
paras.zh: 但“海滩边的乡村魅力”让海豹岩成为了旅游关注的焦点，并且像许多其他澳大利亚沿海小镇一样，它也一直感受到压力。

paras.en: The town's population increases significantly during peak holiday periods.
paras.zh: 假期高峰期间，该镇人口显着增加。

paras.en: Ms Toney said their holiday park alone could take up to 700 people when at capacity.
paras.zh: 托尼女士表示，在满负荷的情况下，仅他们的假日公园就可以容纳多达 700 人。

paras.en: It places significant pressure on infrastructure, especially the narrow single access road.
paras.zh: 它给基础设施带来了巨大的压力，特别是狭窄的单一通道。

paras.en: Ms Galea said the busy summer period was a difficult juggling act.
paras.zh: 加利亚女士表示，繁忙的夏季期间是一个艰难的杂耍表演。

paras.en: "It gets very stressful… but it's a kind of a necessary evil, I guess, because our town is built on tourism and we need that to keep us going,"
paras.zh: “压力很大……但我想这是一种必要的罪恶，因为我们的城镇是建立在旅游业之上的，我们需要旅游业来让我们继续前进，”

paras.en: "They need more public toilets, and they need better roads and access to the site.
paras.zh: “他们需要更多的公共厕所，他们需要更好的道路和通往该地点的通道。

paras.en: "We try and make sure that we have all our stock ordered in advance because it's difficult to get delivery vans, trucks, down the road during peak season… because of all the parking on the side of the road and they just can't get through."
paras.zh: “我们尽力确保提前订购所有库存，因为在旺季期间很难在路上找到送货车、卡车……因为所有停车场都停在路边，他们根本无法通过。”

paras.en: A few years ago, during the busy Christmas/New Year period, the MidCoast Council actively discouraged people from visiting Seal Rocks unless they already had accommodation booked, citing concerns about traffic gridlocks limiting emergency access.
paras.zh: 几年前，在繁忙的圣诞节/新年期间，中部海岸议会积极劝阻人们参观海豹岩，除非他们已经预订了住宿，理由是担心交通堵塞限制紧急通道。

paras.en: Since then, the council has taken steps to improve lined parking at the Seal Rocks Number One Beach parking area, and increased 'no parking' and 'no stopping' signage.
paras.zh: 从那时起，该委员会已采取措施改善海豹岩一号海滩停车场的排队停车，并增加了“禁止停车”和“禁止停车”的标牌。

paras.en: The MidCoast Council's executive manager of sustainable development, Rachel Pleasant, said ranger patrols also increased during peak holiday times, targeting illegal parking and overnight camping.
paras.zh: 中部海岸委员会可持续发展执行经理雷切尔·普莱森特(Rachel Pleasant)表示，在假期高峰期，护林员巡逻也有所增加，针对非法停车和过夜露营。

paras.en: "Since those measures have been put in place it's improved traffic flow and reduced parking on both sides of the roads and helped maintain access," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“自从这些措施实施以来，交通流量得到了改善，道路两侧的停车位也减少了，并有助于维持通行。”

paras.en: "After this holiday period, we'll review the arrangements…consider what worked, where problems remained, and whether further traffic signage or parking enforcement measures … could be needed."
paras.zh: “假期结束后，我们将审查这些安排……考虑哪些措施有效，哪些问题仍然存在，以及是否需要进一步的交通标志或停车执法措施……”

paras.en: Ms Pleasant said visitors were urged to respect the community and consider the area's "limited capacity".
paras.zh: 普莱森特女士表示，敦促游客尊重社区并考虑该地区的“容量有限”。

paras.en: "Seal Rocks is a much-loved and beautiful coastal village and we want visitors to come and enjoy it," she said.
paras.zh: “海豹岩是一个深受人们喜爱的美丽沿海村庄，我们希望游客能够前来享受它，”她说。

paras.en: "But… do plan ahead and use approved accommodation and follow the parking signs and consider visiting in a less busy time as well.
paras.zh: “但是……请务必提前计划并使用经批准的住宿并遵循停车标志，并考虑在不太繁忙的时间前往。

paras.en: "What we really get concerned about is if there's an incident and we need to get emergency services down to the beach, or indeed if we're really unlucky and there's a fire in the area… we need to make sure we can get access."
paras.zh: “我们真正担心的是，如果发生事故，我们需要将紧急服务送到海滩，或者如果我们真的很不幸，该地区发生火灾……我们需要确保我们能够进入。”

paras.en: Ms Toney said she has worked with other tourism operators to help regulate traffic flows.
paras.zh: 托尼女士表示，她已与其他旅游运营商合作，帮助调节交通流量。

paras.en: "For example, us and the other campground that have all the caravans come in, we time our check-in days," she said.
paras.zh: “例如，我们和其他所有大篷车都进来的露营地，我们会安排入住日期，”她说。

paras.en: "So instead of having everyone coming in on one day, they're the day before us this year… even our check-out and check-in times are staggered."
paras.zh: “因此，今年不是每个人都在某一天进来，而是我们的前一天……甚至我们的退房和入住时间也是错开的。”

paras.en: Ms Toney said despite the summer crowds, the town's remote location would help it maintain its special character.
paras.zh: 托尼女士表示，尽管夏季人潮汹涌，但该镇的偏远位置将有助于它保持其特殊性。

paras.en: "I think it's that infrastructure element and the lack of phone reception which keeps us in this really beautiful bubble," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为正是基础设施因素和缺乏电话信号使我们处于这个非常美丽的泡沫中，”她说。

paras.en: "I do feel like it is a bit of a town that time forgot at times and we really love it that way."
paras.zh: “我确实觉得这是一个有时被时间遗忘的小镇，我们真的很喜欢这样。”

articles.title: How a 'healthy' schoolies week ended with a 15yo on life support
articles.author: Charmayne Allison

paras.en: In the heart of a bustling Surfers Paradise, a 15-year-old boy lies almost motionless.
paras.zh: 在熙熙攘攘的冲浪者天堂的中心，一名 15 岁的男孩几乎一动不动地躺着。

paras.en: Blood pools around his head, faint breaths the only visible sign he is still alive.
paras.zh: 他的头周围流着血，微弱的呼吸是他还活着的唯一明显标志。

paras.en: A female police officer kneels by his side as a pack of teens runs into the night.
paras.zh: 一名女警官跪在他身边，一群青少年跑向夜色。

paras.en: The video captured by CCTV and released by the court during hearings this week for 12 teens charged over the assault, provided a confronting contrast to the images of schoolies just 24 hours earlier.
paras.zh: 本周，法庭在针对 12 名被指控袭击的青少年的听证会上发布了由闭路电视拍摄的视频，该视频与 24 小时前的学生形象形成鲜明对比。

paras.en: A day prior, police had praised this year's cohort for their behaviour at the annual end of school celebrations on Queensland's Gold Coast.
paras.zh: 一天前，警方赞扬了今年学生在昆士兰州黄金海岸一年一度的学校庆祝活动结束时的表现。

paras.en: "I walked the beat as a senior sergeant here 10 years ago, and you could guarantee at 2 o' clock near McDonalds, it was fight time," Superintendent Peter Miles told media on Monday.
paras.zh: 警长彼得·迈尔斯周一对媒体表示：“10年前，我作为一名高级警官来到这里，你可以保证，在麦当劳附近的两点钟，那是战斗时间。”

paras.en: In an instant, it all came crashing down, when an alleged act of "gratuitous violence" left a boy, a son, an aspiring barber, fighting for life.
paras.zh: 刹那间，一切都崩溃了，一次所谓的“无端暴力”行为让一个男孩、一个儿子、一个有抱负的理发师为生命而战。

paras.en: At 3am on Tuesday, a group of at least 12 teenagers allegedly bashed the 15-year-old Ipswich boy just metres from the official schoolies celebration area.
paras.zh: 周二凌晨 3 点，据称，一群至少 12 名青少年在距离官方学校庆祝活动区仅几米远的地方殴打了这名 15 岁的伊普斯威奇男孩。

paras.en: The attack left the victim with a broken jaw, at least 10 fractures, including one that extends to the base of his skull, and bleeding on the brain.
paras.zh: 这次袭击导致受害者下巴骨折，至少有 10 处骨折，其中一处骨折延伸至颅骨底部，脑部流血。

paras.en: He has been on life support at Gold Coast University Hospital since, with scans on Thursday showing no signs of brain activity.
paras.zh: 此后他一直在黄金海岸大学医院接受生命支持，周四的扫描显示没有大脑活动的迹象。

paras.en: The boy's family has requested he not be named.
paras.zh: 男孩的家人要求不透露他的姓名。

paras.en: It is still unclear what sparked the incident, but the Court has heard a network of cameras in Cavill Avenue captured the incident in horrifying detail.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚是什么引发了这起事件，但法院听说卡维尔大道的摄像头网络捕捉到了这一事件的可怕细节。

paras.en: Video released by the Court shows the boy standing among a crowd near the Gold Coast's iconic Surfers Paradise sign when a group of teens approaches and the violence begins.
paras.zh: 法院发布的视频显示，当一群青少年靠近时，男孩站在黄金海岸标志性的冲浪者天堂标志附近的人群中，暴力事件开始了。

paras.en: The boy escapes, sprinting down Cavill Avenue before his alleged attackers catch up and trip him to the ground.
paras.zh: 男孩逃跑了，沿着卡维尔大道冲刺，随后袭击者追上并将他绊倒在地。

paras.en: As he curls into the foetal position, shielding his face, the teens kick and stomp his head and body, continuing even when he falls limp.
paras.zh: 当他蜷缩成胎儿的姿势，护住他的脸时，青少年们踢踏他的头和身体，即使他瘫软了，他们仍然继续踢他。

paras.en: The footage shows crowds of revellers watching in shock, some filming the incident on their phones.
paras.zh: 视频显示，一群狂欢者震惊地观看，一些人用手机拍摄了这一事件。

paras.en: As police flood into view of the cameras, the teens scatter.
paras.zh: 当警察涌入摄像机视野时，青少年们四散开来。

paras.en: Twelve Brisbane teenagers — all aged between 17 and 19 — have each been charged with acts intended to cause grievous bodily harm over the alleged attack.
paras.zh: 12 名布里斯班青少年——年龄均在 17 岁至 19 岁之间——均被指控因涉嫌袭击而造成严重身体伤害。

paras.en: At least four of them were registered schoolies.
paras.zh: 其中至少有四人是注册学生。

paras.en: In courtrooms where the charges have been heard, the attack has been described as "vicious", "prolonged", "callous", and showing "zero human empathy".
paras.zh: 在审理指控的法庭上，这次袭击被描述为“恶毒”、“长期”、“冷酷无情”，并表现出“零人类同理心”。

paras.en: Police prosecutor Matt Gilles told a hearing for one of the adults charged that the "extreme gratuitous violence" could be described with two words: "pack mentality".
paras.zh: 警方检察官马特·吉尔斯在一名被指控成年人的听证会上表示，“极端无端暴力”可以用两个词来形容：“群体心态”。

paras.en: He told the court police would allege that at least some element of what happened on Tuesday morning was planned.
paras.zh: 他告诉法庭，警方声称周二早上发生的事情至少有一些是计划好的。

paras.en: "There is evidence to suggest that there was a level of organisation to attend [Surfers Paradise] and assault the victim," Mr Gilles said.
paras.zh: 吉尔斯先生说：“有证据表明，有一定程度的组织参加了[冲浪者天堂]并袭击了受害者。”

paras.en: The incident came days after schoolies organisers and volunteers praised an "amazing shift" in the event's culture.
paras.zh: 事件发生几天前，学生组织者和志愿者称赞活动文化发生了“惊人的转变”。

paras.en: "[Young people] are swapping out the night-time activities and the risk-taking behaviour in the early hours of the morning," Red Frogs' Chris George said last Friday.
paras.zh: “[年轻人]正在改变夜间活动和凌晨的冒险行为，”红蛙队的克里斯·乔治上周五表示。

paras.en: Detective Inspector Greg Aubort, who is leading the investigation, said it was a "sickening, violent assault".
paras.zh: 负责调查的侦探督察格雷格·奥博特表示，这是一次“令人作呕的暴力袭击”。

paras.en: "It mars what has otherwise been a very healthy [schoolies] event," he said.
paras.zh: “这破坏了原本非常健康的[学生]活动，”他说。

paras.en: "What's disappointing is the group mentality … this is a warning to those that roll around in groups and gangs: your lives can be irrevocably changed in minutes."
paras.zh: “令人失望的是群体心态……这是对那些在群体和帮派中活动的人的警告：你的生活可能在几分钟内发生不可逆转的改变。”

paras.en: In the immediate aftermath of the violence, school-leavers told the ABC the attack had left them on edge.
paras.zh: 暴力事件发生后，离校生告诉美国广播公司，这次袭击让他们感到紧张。

paras.en: "I'm less keen to go out later at night. Before 12 is fine, but just walking the streets … it's actually a bit scary," Toowoomba graduate Caleb Baker said.
paras.zh: “我不太愿意在晚上出去。12点之前还好，但只是走在街上……实际上有点害怕，”图文巴毕业生卡莱布·贝克(Caleb Baker)说。

paras.en: The parents of the 15-year-old victim this week released a statement, saying the incident had been "incredibly distressing" for everyone close to the boy.
paras.zh: 这名 15 岁受害者的父母本周发表了一份声明，称这起事件对所有与这名男孩关系密切的人来说都“令人难以置信的痛苦”。

paras.en: "This has been made more difficult by videos and commentary relating to the incident circulating on social media," the parents wrote.
paras.zh: 家长们写道：“社交媒体上流传的与该事件相关的视频和评论让事情变得更加困难。”

paras.en: They said they were "overwhelmed" by the kindness they had received from the community.
paras.zh: 他们表示，他们对社区的善意感到“不知所措”。

paras.en: But they requested privacy as they focus on their son's recovery and said they would not provide any further updates on his condition.
paras.zh: 但他们要求保密，因为他们专注于儿子的康复，并表示不会提供有关他病情的任何进一步更新。

paras.en: The Queensland government, which organises the official schoolies event, was today due to hold a press conference wrapping up the week-long celebration, but that has since been cancelled.
paras.zh: 组织官方学生活动的昆士兰州政府原定于今天举行新闻发布会，结束为期一周的庆祝活动，但后来被取消。

paras.en: As a devastated family holds on to hope their son will survive his injuries, the police investigation into his assault continues.
paras.zh: 当一个悲痛欲绝的家庭仍然希望他们的儿子能够幸免于难时，警方对他的袭击事件的调查仍在继续。

paras.en: "There are more people that we are looking for," Deputy Commissioner Cheryl Scanlon said on Thursday.
paras.zh: “我们正在寻找更多人，”副专员谢丽尔·斯坎伦周四表示。

paras.en: "Schoolies has in recent years been a very safe event for young people and that's how we'd like it to stay.
paras.zh: “近年来，学校活动对于年轻人来说是一项非常安全的活动，我们希望它能够保持下去。

articles.title: Hope for Christmas beetles after warm winter, wet spring
articles.author: Niki Burnside

paras.en: Christmas beetles are a beloved Australian insect, one that glows gold and heralds the arrival of the holiday season.
paras.zh: 圣诞甲虫是一种深受人们喜爱的澳大利亚昆虫，它会发出金色的光芒，预示着节日的到来。

paras.en: But many have noticed a reduced number of the insects in recent years, with fears they may be struggling to survive.
paras.zh: 但许多人注意到近年来昆虫数量减少，担心它们可能难以生存。

paras.en: There is even a thread on Reddit dedicated to discussing how much people miss the nostalgic creatures.
paras.zh: Reddit 上甚至有一个帖子专门讨论人们有多么怀念这些怀旧的生物。

paras.en: But there is renewed hope for the beetles, after a warmer winter and amid strong spring rainfall.
paras.zh: 但在经历了暖冬和春季强降雨之后，甲虫又迎来了新的希望。

paras.en: University of Sydney entomologist Tanya Latty said for many different types of insects, a warmer winter meant they were able to grow faster and would have a better chance of survival in adulthood.
paras.zh: 悉尼大学昆虫学家塔尼娅·拉蒂表示，对于许多不同类型的昆虫来说，温暖的冬天意味着它们能够生长得更快，并且在成年后有更好的生存机会。

paras.en: "So, fingers crossed," Associate Professor Latty said.
paras.zh: “所以，祈祷吧，”拉蒂副教授说。

paras.en: "We've already started to see Christmas beetles coming in — they're about a month early this year in some regions.
paras.zh: “我们已经开始看到圣诞甲虫的到来——今年在某些地区大约提前了一个月。

paras.en: "So it's exciting and I'm really hopeful we'll get a fair number."
paras.zh: “所以这很令人兴奋，我真的希望我们能得到一个公平的数字。”

paras.en: Christmas beetles belong to the Australian genus Anoplognathus, and there are about 36 species found almost exclusively in Australia.
paras.zh: 圣诞甲虫属于澳大利亚按颌甲虫属，大约有 36 种，几乎只在澳大利亚发现。

paras.en: The beetles typically are seen from October through February, and can be found mostly in the eastern states, although Western Australia is home to one type.
paras.zh: 这种甲虫通常在十月到二月期间出现，主要出现在东部各州，但西澳大利亚州是其中一种甲虫的故乡。

paras.en: Adults are usually about 20-30 millimetres long and can range in colour, sometimes brown and sometimes a metallic green or gold, appearing iridescent.
paras.zh: 成虫通常长约 20-30 毫米，颜色各异，有时是棕色，有时是金属绿色或金色，呈现虹彩。

paras.en: Christmas beetles are not currently listed as a threatened species.
paras.zh: 圣诞甲虫目前未被列为受威胁物种。

paras.en: This is due to insufficient population data, despite concerns about their decline, and that perception has prompted action among researchers.
paras.zh: 这是由于人口数据不足，尽管人们担心人口数量下降，这种看法促使研究人员采取行动。

paras.en: James Bickerstaff, an entomologist and evolutionary biologist at the CSIRO's Australian National Insect Collection, said rainfall was also a crucial element in the life cycle of the Christmas beetle.
paras.zh: 联邦科学与工业研究组织（CSIRO）澳大利亚国家昆虫收藏中心的昆虫学家和进化生物学家詹姆斯·比克斯塔夫（James Bickerstaff）表示，降雨也是圣诞甲虫生命周期的一个关键因素。

paras.en: "Christmas beetles are like other scarabs and they pupate underground and typically the late winter, early springtime rain can soften the soil,"
paras.zh: “圣诞甲虫就像其他圣甲虫一样，它们在地下化蛹，通常冬末、早春的雨水可以软化土壤，”

paras.en: "And so they can easily dig their way out of the soil and emerge as adults, so I think maybe a warm winter will help just keep ecosystems in check and keep their food sources available."
paras.zh: “所以它们可以很容易地从土壤中挖出一条路并成为成年人，所以我认为温暖的冬天可能有助于控制生态系统并保持它们的食物来源。”

paras.en: He said it had been a wet spring so far and that was a reason to be hopeful, but agreed that overall the lack of data around the beetles was a concern "for knowing whether or not they need to be listed for threatened species activities".
paras.zh: 他说，到目前为止，春天一直潮湿，这是一个充满希望的理由，但他也同意，总的来说，缺乏有关甲虫的数据是一个令人担忧的问题，“不知道它们是否需要被列入受威胁物种活动名单”。

paras.en: "And knowing and understanding what threats they're facing and what actions we can take to help them out once they make their way onto a threatened species list," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“了解并了解它们面临哪些威胁，以及一旦它们进入受威胁物种名单，我们可以采取哪些行动来帮助它们摆脱困境。”

paras.en: What is known is that the beetles are important detritivores.
paras.zh: 众所周知，甲虫是重要的食腐动物。

paras.en: "They live in the soil and in the leaf litter ... [and they] recycle those nutrients,"
paras.zh: “它们生活在土壤和落叶中......[并且它们]回收这些养分，”

paras.en: "And then also as adults, they are important foodstuffs for birds and other mammals and reptiles as well. So not only do they have a nutrient recycling role in the ecosystems, they're important food for bigger, larger animals."
paras.zh: “作为成年人，它们也是鸟类、其他哺乳动物和爬行动物的重要食物。因此，它们不仅在生态系统中具有营养循环作用，而且是越来越大的动物的重要食物。”

paras.en: At this stage, scientists are unsure what could be contributing to a decline in the species, but climate change and habitat loss are among the possibilities.
paras.zh: 现阶段，科学家们还不确定是什么导致了该物种的减少，但气候变化和栖息地丧失是可能的。

paras.en: "It's kind of really hard to say at the moment because we know they've declined and we have some evidence that quite a few species should be able to make it onto the IUCN threatened species list," Dr Bickerstaff said.
paras.zh: 比克斯塔夫博士说：“目前还很难说，因为我们知道它们的数量已经减少，而且我们有一些证据表明，相当多的物种应该能够进入世界自然保护联盟受威胁物种名单。”

paras.en: "We have evidence for their decline through time, but identifying what is causing that decline is still kind of tricky to disentangle at the moment."
paras.zh: “我们有证据表明它们随着时间的推移而下降，但目前确定导致下降的原因仍然很难解决。”

paras.en: These concerns led to the Christmas Beetle Project, now in its sixth year, which asks members of the public to take pictures of the insects and upload them to the global biodiversity repository iNaturalist.
paras.zh: 这些担忧催生了圣诞甲虫项目，该项目现已进入第六个年头，该项目要求公众拍摄这些昆虫的照片并将其上传到全球生物多样性存储库 iNaturalist。

paras.en: "Once it's uploaded to iNaturalist, we can see those sightings, we can make sure the identifications are correct, and that gives us the data we really need," Associate Professor Latty said.
paras.zh: “一旦上传到 iNaturalist，我们就可以看到这些目击事件，我们可以确保识别正确，从而为我们提供真正需要的数据，”拉蒂副教授说。

paras.en: But this year, the project has been amended.
paras.zh: 但今年，该项目进行了修改。

paras.en: "In the past we've been really good at getting lots and lots of sightings from people, which is exciting, but the problem is we don't know where Christmas beetles are not,"
paras.zh: “过去，我们非常擅长从人们那里获得大量的目击信息，这很令人兴奋，但问题是我们不知道圣诞甲虫不在哪里，”

paras.en: "Because of the way iNaturalist works, we only know when people see a Christmas beetle; we don't know if beetles are missing from some areas where they should be."
paras.zh: “由于 iNaturalist 的工作方式，我们只知道人们何时看到圣诞甲虫；我们不知道甲虫是否从它们应该出现的某些区域消失了。”

paras.en: For this reason, workshops are being run in which members of the public can be trained to use scientific sampling equipment, in this case a "light trap" which will attract Christmas beetles if they are nearby.
paras.zh: 因此，正在举办研讨会，培训公众使用科学采样设备，在这种情况下，这是一个“光陷阱”，如果圣诞甲虫在附近，就会吸引它们。

paras.en: The workshops are being held in various locations around Australia.
paras.zh: 这些研讨会在澳大利亚各地举行。

paras.en: "We'll be asking people to take those kits to monitor Christmas beetles a couple times a month for the next few years during the season," she said.
paras.zh: “在接下来的几年里，我们将要求人们在季节期间每月使用这些工具包监测圣诞甲虫几次，”她说。

paras.en: "By setting up that network, we'll finally be able to get some consistent population data, so I'm really excited about it, and I'd love for as many people as possible to come along to those workshops.
paras.zh: “通过建立这个网络，我们最终将能够获得一些一致的人口数据，所以我对此感到非常兴奋，并且我希望有尽可能多的人参加这些研讨会。

paras.en: "And I know it can sound a little bit like, 'oh, what if I set this up and I don't get any Christmas beetles?' That's super important data."
paras.zh: “我知道这听起来有点像，‘哦，如果我设置了这个但没有收到任何圣诞甲虫怎么办？’这是非常重要的数据。”

paras.en: Associate Professor Latty said it would be an opportunity to see a variety of creatures attracted to the traps.
paras.zh: 拉蒂副教授表示，这将是一个看到各种生物被陷阱吸引的机会。

paras.en: "Even if you don't get a Christmas beetle, you'll see some pretty cool animals."
paras.zh: “即使你没有得到圣诞甲虫，你也会看到一些非常酷的动物。”

articles.title: War, fuel costs and aid cuts raise famine risk across 16 hotspots, UN agencies warn

paras.en: War, fuel costs and aid cuts raise famine risk across 16 hotspots, UN agencies warn
paras.zh: 联合国机构警告称，战争、燃料成本和援助削减增加了 16 个热点地区的饥荒风险

paras.en: Number of hunger hotspots increased from 13 in last June report
paras.zh: 饥饿热点地区数量从去年 6 月报告中的 13 个增加

paras.en: United Nations' food agencies are warning that hunger is set to worsen across 16 countries over the next six months, as conflict, soaring fuel costs linked to the war in the Middle East and steep aid cuts threaten to push more people into crisis.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食机构警告称，由于冲突、与中东战争相关的燃料成本飙升以及援助大幅削减，有可能将更多人推入危机，未来六个月，16 个国家的饥饿状况将进一步恶化。

paras.en: In a report published on Friday, the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and World Food Programme (WFP) said Sudan, South Sudan, Somalia, northern Nigeria and Yemen faced the gravest threats, driven by conflict, displacement, economic hardship and extreme weather.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）和世界粮食计划署（WFP）在周五发布的一份报告中表示，由于冲突、流离失所、经济困难和极端天气，苏丹、南苏丹、索马里、尼日利亚北部和也门面临最严重的威胁。

paras.en: All five have appeared on the list repeatedly since 2022. The Palestinian territories meanwhile, were moved down one level following the October 2025 ceasefire in Gaza, though 67 per cent of Gaza's population still faces crisis-level hunger or worse, and the report warned that the gains were fragile.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年以来，这五个国家都多次出现在名单上。与此同时，巴勒斯坦领土在 2025 年 10 月加沙停火后下降了一级，尽管加沙 67% 的人口仍然面临危机级别的饥饿或更严重的情况，报告警告称，取得的进展很脆弱。

paras.en: The number of hunger hotspots has risen from 13 in the previous report released in June, with Chad, Uganda, and parts of both southern Africa and central America added to the list, while Lebanon was removed.
paras.zh: 饥饿热点地区的数量比6月份发布的上一份报告中的13个有所增加，乍得、乌干达以及南部非洲和中美洲的部分地区被列入名单，而黎巴嫩则被删除。

paras.en: In the latest joint report covering December 2026 to May 2027, the agencies warned that shrinking humanitarian funding was undermining efforts to avert catastrophe.
paras.zh: 在涵盖 2026 年 12 月至 2027 年 5 月的最新联合报告中，这些机构警告说，人道主义资金的减少正在破坏避免灾难的努力。

paras.en: Aid for the five countries facing the gravest hunger threats fell by two-thirds between 2022 and 2025, said Conor Elliott, a senior official in FAO's emergencies and resilience office.
paras.zh: 粮农组织紧急情况和复原力办公室高级官员康纳·埃利奥特表示，2022年至2025年间，对面临最严重饥饿威胁的五个国家的援助减少了三分之二。

paras.en: "These are huge changes in international support," he said, warning that the cuts were also undermining the collection of data needed to assess the scale of the crisis.
paras.zh: 他说：“这些都是国际支持方面的巨大变化。”他警告说，削减资金也破坏了评估危机规模所需的数据收集。

paras.en: - UN food program funding cuts force group to slash aid to Gazans already struggling to eat
paras.zh: - 联合国粮食计划署资金削减迫使该组织削减对已经面临吃饭困难的加沙人的援助

paras.en: - Somalia child hunger surges as aid drops, Doctors Without Borders says
paras.zh: - 无国界医生组织称，随着援助减少，索马里儿童饥饿现象激增

paras.en: The report said armed conflict and violence were driving hunger in 12 of the 16 hotspots, while soaring food, energy and transport costs were further eroding people's ability to feed themselves.
paras.zh: 报告称，武装冲突和暴力导致16个热点地区中的12个地区出现饥饿现象，而食品、能源和运输成本的飙升进一步削弱了人们养活自己的能力。

paras.en: The agencies said the developing El Niño weather pattern could aggravate the crisis, bringing drought and extreme temperatures to southern Africa and parts of central America, and potentially destructive flooding to parts of eastern Africa.
paras.zh: 这些机构表示，正在发展的厄尔尼诺天气模式可能会加剧危机，给南部非洲和中美洲部分地区带来干旱和极端气温，并可能给东非部分地区带来破坏性的洪水。

paras.en: "There's going to be a very, very strong El Niño effect," said Elliott, warning that some areas were likely to swing from drought conditions to heavy rains in the coming months.
paras.zh: 埃利奥特说：“将会出现非常非常强烈的厄尔尼诺效应。”他警告说，未来几个月，一些地区可能会从干旱转向暴雨。

paras.en: In Sudan, famine is a risk in 13 areas of North Darfur and South Kordofan through January 2027, with fighting disrupting food production, markets and aid deliveries.
paras.zh: 在苏丹，到 2027 年 1 月，北达尔富尔州和南科尔多凡州的 13 个地区都将面临饥荒风险，战斗会扰乱粮食生产、市场和援助运送。

paras.en: The agencies also identified famine risks among displaced people in Somalia's Baidoa region and in parts of South Sudan, where escalating violence has compounded an already desperate humanitarian situation.
paras.zh: 这些机构还发现索马里拜多阿地区和南苏丹部分地区的流离失所者面临饥荒风险，这些地区不断升级的暴力局势加剧了本已绝望的人道主义局势。

paras.en: In Sudan, a risk of famine is expected to persist through January in 13 areas of the states North Darfur and South Kordofan, the report said. Nearly 19.5 million people, or 41 per cent of the population, faced crisis-level hunger or worse in the latest nationwide analysis. In two displacement camps in the country's southwest, acute malnutrition rates exceeded the threshold for famine.
paras.zh: 报告称，在苏丹，北达尔富尔州和南科尔多凡州的 13 个地区预计将持续到 1 月份发生饥荒的风险。最新的全国分析显示，近 1950 万人（占总人口的 41%）面临危机级别的饥饿或更严重的情况。在该国西南部的两个流离失所者营地，严重营养不良率超过了饥荒的阈值。

paras.en: Sorghum prices in Sudan more than doubled in a year, driven by the fighting and by higher fuel costs tied to the Middle East conflict. Diesel prices have also more than doubled from a year earlier because of the Middle East conflict, according to the report.
paras.zh: 由于战争和中东冲突导致的燃料成本上涨，苏丹的高粱价格在一年内上涨了一倍多。报告称，由于中东冲突，柴油价格也比一年前上涨了一倍多。

paras.en: Drought linked to El Niño — a natural warming of Pacific Ocean water that disrupts weather worldwide — has added to the strain, affecting up to 55 per cent of cropland in Sennar and 70 per cent in Gedaref, two of Sudan's main farming states.
paras.zh: 与厄尔尼诺现象（太平洋海水自然变暖，扰乱全球天气）相关的干旱加剧了压力，影响了苏丹两个主要农业州森纳尔 55% 的农田和盖达里夫 70% 的农田。

paras.en: FAO deputy director-general Beth Bechdol told The Associated Press that El Niño-linked drought poses a major threat to Sudan on top of the war, compounding the conflict's toll on food production.
paras.zh: 粮农组织副总干事贝丝·贝克多尔告诉美联社，厄尔尼诺现象引发的干旱除了战争之外还对苏丹构成重大威胁，加剧了冲突对粮食生产的影响。

paras.en: In Yemen, the report says, hunger is likely to worsen as fighting which resumed in July spreads across multiple fronts.
paras.zh: 报告称，在也门，随着七月份重新爆发的战斗蔓延到多条战线，饥饿可能会进一步恶化。

paras.en: The country has been at war since 2014, when the Iran-backed Houthi rebels seized the capital, Sanaa, prompting a Saudi-led coalition to intervene the following year.
paras.zh: 自2014年伊朗支持的胡塞叛军占领首都萨那以来，该国一直处于战争状态，促使沙特领导的联盟于次年进行干预。

paras.en: The encirclement of the southwestern city of Taiz has created siege-like conditions there, and more than 300,000 people have been displaced since the escalation began, mostly in Taiz, Lahj and Aden provinces. In government-held areas, 1.8 million people face emergency levels of hunger, up from 1.6 million in the previous analysis.
paras.zh: 对西南部城市塔伊兹的包围造成了那里的围困状态，自冲突升级开始以来，已有超过30万人流离失所，其中大部分在塔伊兹省、拉赫吉省和亚丁省。在政府控制的地区，有 180 万人面临紧急饥饿水平，高于之前分析中的 160 万人。

paras.en: No recent assessment exists for areas held by the Houthis, which have become harder for aid groups to reach as the conflict has intensified. The last nationwide projection, which ran through February, found 18.3 million people, more than half the population, were in crisis or worse.
paras.zh: 最近没有对胡塞武装控制地区进行评估，随着冲突加剧，援助团体越来越难以到达这些地区。 2 月份进行的最新全国性预测发现，有 1,830 万人（占总人口的一半以上）处于危机或更严重的境地。

paras.en: Bechdol says the main obstacles to reaching Yemenis in need were political rather than geographic, noting that staff from other UN agencies had been detained. The Houthis still hold 73 UN staffers, including eight from the UN human rights office.
paras.zh: 贝克多尔表示，到达有需要的也门人的主要障碍是政治而非地理，并指出其他联合国机构的工作人员已被拘留。胡塞武装仍然拥有 73 名联合国工作人员，其中 8 名来自联合国人权办公室。

paras.en: Yemen relies heavily on imported food and fuel, and the report warned that attacks on Red Sea shipping threaten that lifeline.
paras.zh: 也门严重依赖进口食品和燃料，报告警告说，对红海航运的袭击威胁着这一生命线。

paras.en: Wars continue to disrupt shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, the Red Sea and the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 战争继续扰乱霍尔木兹海峡、红海和黑海的航运。

paras.en: Aid has also fallen sharply as major donors have pulled back funding. Food and nutrition assistance to the five countries at the highest level of concern dropped by about 62 per cent between 2022 and 2025, and by 79 per cent in Yemen. Shifts among donor governments in recent years have taken billions of dollars out of humanitarian and development funding, leaving agencies unable to reach as many people as before, Bechdol says.
paras.zh: 由于主要捐助者撤回资金，援助也大幅下降。 2022 年至 2025 年间，向最受关注的五个国家提供的粮食和营养援助下降了约 62%，也门下降了 79%。贝克多尔说，近年来捐助国政府之间的转变已经从人道主义和发展资金中抽走了数十亿美元，使各机构无法像以前那样帮助到那么多人。

paras.en: The predictability of funding matters as much as the amount because aid for farmers must arrive during the planting and harvest periods. With El Niño forecasts in hand, she says agencies should be prepositioning seeds and protecting livestock before disaster strikes, rather than responding to one crisis after another.
paras.zh: 资金的可预测性与金额一样重要，因为对农民的援助必须在种植和收获期间到达。她表示，有了厄尔尼诺现象的预测，各机构应该在灾难发生之前预先部署种子并保护牲畜，而不是应对一场又一场的危机。

paras.en: "When that window is lost, you don't get it back," she said. "We're funding losses and we're funding damage."
paras.zh: “当那个窗口丢失时，你就无法找回它，”她说。 “我们正在为损失和损害提供资金。”

paras.en: The agencies say Afghanistan, Haiti, the Democratic Republic of Congo and Gaza are also areas of very high concern, and that acute food insecurity is expected to worsen in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 这些机构表示，阿富汗、海地、刚果民主共和国和加沙也是令人高度关注的地区，预计西岸严重的粮食不安全状况将进一步恶化。

paras.en: With files from The Associated Press and Reuters
paras.zh: 来自美联社和路透社的文件

articles.title: Zelenskyy criticizes Trump for cozying up to Putin as EU kicks Ukraine funding down the road
articles.author: William Denselow

paras.en: Zelenskyy criticizes Trump for cozying up to Putin as EU kicks Ukraine funding down the road
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基批评特朗普在欧盟停止向乌克兰提供资金的情况下讨好普京

paras.en: EU budget summit exposed divisions within the bloc on how much to keep spending on war in Ukraine
paras.zh: 欧盟预算峰会暴露了欧盟内部对于继续在乌克兰战争上投入多少钱的分歧

paras.en: A summit of European leaders has collapsed without a budget deal — and caught up in the EU’s in-fighting is Ukraine, which was to get a $45 billion euro ($70 billion) loan in the package.
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人峰会在没有达成预算协议的情况下破裂，而卷入欧盟内讧的是乌克兰，该国原本将在该计划中获得 450 亿欧元（合 700 亿美元）的贷款。

paras.en: The president of the European Council, Antonio Costa, convened the gathering Thursday with the aim of reaching consensus on the European Union’s 2028-2034 budget.
paras.zh: 欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔周四召开会议，旨在就欧盟 2028-2034 年预算达成共识。

paras.en: The meeting was slated to last two days, but it ended in acrimony in the early hours of Friday and without an agreement in place.
paras.zh: 会议原定持续两天，但在周五凌晨以激烈的争吵结束，且没有达成任何协议。

paras.en: For months, the European Union’s 27 member states have been deeply divided on the issue and split between two groups, the so-called frugal nations and the "friends of cohesion."
paras.zh: 几个月来，欧盟27个成员国在这个问题上存在深刻分歧，并分裂为两个群体，即所谓的节俭国家和“凝聚之友”。

paras.en: Ahead of the meeting, Costa urged European leaders to come to Brussels with an open mind and find a compromise. To help achieve that, he had proposed a reduction of 204 billion euros ($318 billion) to the budget at current prices, from the nearly €2 trillion euros ($3.1 trillion) originally tabled by the European Commission.
paras.zh: 会议前，科斯塔敦促欧洲领导人以开放的心态来到布鲁塞尔并找到妥协方案。为了帮助实现这一目标，他提议按当前价格将预算削减 2040 亿欧元（3180 亿美元），而欧盟委员会最初提出的预算为近 2 万亿欧元（3.1 万亿美元）。

paras.en: European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen, left, speaks with European Council president Antonio Costa during a round table meeting at the EU summit Thursday. (Geert Vanden Wijngaert/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩（左）在周四欧盟峰会的圆桌会议上与欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔交谈。 （吉尔特·范登·韦恩加尔特/美联社）

paras.en: Ultimately, the efforts failed with the frugal group arguing that the cuts don’t go far enough and failed to address concerns over spending discipline and the burden of financing the budget.
paras.zh: 最终，这些努力失败了，节俭集团认为削减幅度还不够，也未能解决对支出纪律和预算融资负担的担忧。

paras.en: For nations such as Poland that are pushing for a bigger budget, greater spending is needed to bolster the bloc’s collective security and help the EU better compete economically with the likes of the United States and China.
paras.zh: 对于波兰等正在推动增加预算的国家来说，需要增加支出来加强欧盟的集体安全，并帮助欧盟更好地与美国和中国等国家进行经济竞争。

paras.en: “A cheap Europe could turn out to be a very expensive mistake,” Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk wrote in a social media post on Thursday.
paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克周四在社交媒体帖子中写道：“廉价的欧洲可能会成为一个代价高昂的错误。”

paras.en: "Security comes at a price. As simple as that."
paras.zh: “安全是有代价的。就这么简单。”

paras.en: Addressing the media at a press conference at the end of the summit, European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen said progress had been made on issues such as a digital services tax but urged greater action to reach a deal by the end of the year.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩在峰会结束时的新闻发布会上向媒体发表讲话表示，数字服务税等问题已取得进展，但敦促采取更大行动，在年底前达成协议。

paras.en: “Today's conversations were useful. But there is still a lot of work ahead of us," von der Leyen said. "Now, all the pieces of the puzzle must be put together. This will be a challenge. But we all know we need an agreement."
paras.zh: “今天的谈话很有用。但我们还有很多工作要做，”冯德莱恩说。 “现在，所有的拼图都必须拼凑起来。这将是一个挑战。但我们都知道我们需要达成协议。”

paras.en: Ukraine, meanwhile, is left wanting. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz is pushing for the $70 billion loan to be included in the bloc’s next long-term budget but faces opposition from several member states, including Slovakia and Hungary.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰仍处于劣势。德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨正在推动将这笔700亿美元的贷款纳入欧盟下一个长期预算，但面临斯洛伐克和匈牙利等多个成员国的反对。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Hungary's Prime Minister Peter Magyar shake hands before a meeting in Uzhhorod, Ukraine, earlier this week. Hungary is one of the EU countries advocating for a reduction in funding for the war. (Ukrainian Presidential Press Service/Reuters)
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，乌克兰总统泽伦斯基和匈牙利总理彼得·马扎尔在乌克兰乌日霍罗德举行会议之前握手。匈牙利是主张减少战争经费的欧盟国家之一。 （乌克兰总统新闻社/路透社）

paras.en: The debate comes as Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, told the BBC that a recent interaction between U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin was, "strange."
paras.zh: 这场辩论正值乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基告诉英国广播公司，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京最近的互动“很奇怪”。

paras.en: The two leaders met at a summit in China last week where Trump was heard calling Putin a "friend."
paras.zh: 两国领导人上周在中国举行的一次峰会上会面，特朗普称普京为“朋友”。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said in the BBC interview , which took place in Kyiv and was broadcast Friday, that Putin is "an aggressor and a killer." Calling him a friend would be like calling Adolf Hitler a friend in the Second World War, he said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在周五于基辅进行的英国广播公司采访中表示，普京是“侵略者和杀手”。他说，称他为朋友就像称阿道夫·希特勒为第二次世界大战中的朋友一样。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the U.S. president claimed on social media that, during that conversation with Putin, he told the Russian leader to, "pull back all military aggression against territories throughout Europe, in the hopes that a deal can be made between Russia and Ukraine."
paras.zh: 与此同时，美国总统在社交媒体上声称，在与普京的谈话中，他告诉俄罗斯领导人“撤回对整个欧洲领土的所有军事侵略，希望俄罗斯和乌克兰能够达成协议。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy accused the U.S. of not paying enough attention to the conflict and delaying delivery of the Patriot missiles it promised.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基指责美国对冲突不够重视，并推迟交付其承诺的爱国者导弹。

paras.en: "The deficit of these missiles, that is people's lives," he said.
paras.zh: “这些导弹的不足，就是人们的生命，”他说。

paras.en: Ukraine's needs 'cannot be postponed,' analyst says
paras.zh: 分析师称乌克兰的需求“不能推迟”

paras.en: The Nordic nations, as well as Germany and Netherlands, are on the frugal side of the EU’s budget debate and among Ukraine’s biggest supporters in Europe.
paras.zh: 北欧国家以及德国和荷兰在欧盟预算辩论中站在节俭的一边，也是乌克兰在欧洲最大的支持者之一。

paras.en: Jacob Funk Kirkegaard, senior fellow at the Brussels-based think tank Bruegel, says this, ironically, could help get a budget deal over the line.
paras.zh: 布鲁塞尔智库布鲁盖尔的高级研究员雅各布·冯克·柯克加德表示，具有讽刺意味的是，这可能有助于达成一项预算协议。

paras.en: "In general, as the frugals know, it will be far more expensive for them to support Ukraine on their own. In the end, they will agree to a budget compromise," he said.
paras.zh: “总的来说，节俭者知道，他们自己支持乌克兰的成本要高得多。最终，他们会同意预算妥协，”他说。

paras.en: "As such, the needs of Ukraine, which due to the war and upcoming European elections, cannot be postponed, will help seal a deal in mid-December."
paras.zh: “因此，乌克兰的需求（由于战争和即将到来的欧洲选举而无法推迟）将有助于在 12 月中旬达成协议。”

paras.en: European leaders will next convene in the Belgian capital on Dec. 17. It will be a last chance to get a budget deal done by the end of the year.
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人将于 12 月 17 日在比利时首都召开下次会议。这将是年底前达成预算协议的最后机会。

paras.en: French far-right leader Marine Le Pen and France's President Emmanuel Macron, seen at the presidential Elysee Palace, in Paris in June 2022, inserted their political rivalry into the EU budget debate. (Ludovic Marin/Reuters)
paras.zh: 2022 年 6 月，法国极右翼领导人马琳·勒庞和法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙出现在巴黎总统爱丽舍宫，将他们的政治竞争纳入欧盟预算辩论。 （卢多维克·马林/路透社）

paras.en: But even that deadline has been the subject of debate. Marine Le Pen, the far-right National Rally candidate and current frontrunner in the upcoming French elections, has accused the European Commission of seeking to get the multiannual financial framework (MFF) agreed before the French people head to the polls in April.
paras.zh: 但即使是这个最后期限也一直是争论的话题。极右翼全国集会候选人、即将到来的法国大选的领跑者马琳·勒庞 (Marine Le Pen) 指责欧盟委员会寻求在法国人民四月投票之前就多年期金融框架 (MFF) 达成一致。

paras.en: That’s a view French President Emmanuel Macron has firmly rejected.
paras.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙坚决反对这一观点。

paras.en: "It is a strange kind of arrogance to think that she is already in charge of France’s destiny because, until proven otherwise, she has not been elected, and yours truly is elected until May 13, 2027,” he said speaking to reporters on the sidelines of this week’s budget negotiations.
paras.zh: 他在本周预算谈判间隙对记者表示：“认为她已经掌控了法国的命运，这是一种奇怪的傲慢，因为除非事实证明并非如此，否则她还没有当选，而你们的真正当选要到 2027 年 5 月 13 日。”

articles.title: 'Breast bowl' from Marie-Antoinette's pleasure dairy sets new record at auction
articles.author: Jessica Wong

paras.en: 'Breast bowl' from Marie-Antoinette's pleasure dairy sets new record at auction
paras.zh: 玛丽·安托瓦内特快乐乳品店的“胸碗”创下拍卖新纪录

paras.en: Portion of proceeds to benefit breast cancer research
paras.zh: 部分收益将用于乳腺癌研究

paras.en: A rare porcelain "breast bowl" that France's Louis XVI commissioned for Marie-Antoinette back in the 18th century sold for about $4.5 million in Paris Thursday.
paras.zh: 法国路易十六在 18 世纪委托为玛丽·安托瓦内特 (Marie-Antoinette) 制作的罕见瓷器“胸碗”周四在巴黎以约 450 万美元的价格售出。

paras.en: The unconventionally shaped drinking vessel (known as a jatte-téton) is a delicate porcelain bowl that imitates the shape of a woman's breast, complete with rosy pink nipple, and sits atop a tripod decorated with scrolling foliage and a trio of goat heads.
paras.zh: 这种形状非常规的饮用器皿（称为“jatte-téton”）是一种精致的瓷碗，模仿女性乳房的形状，配有玫瑰粉色的乳头，位于饰有滚动树叶和三个山羊头的三脚架上。

paras.en: It sold for 2.925 million euros via the French auction house Coutau-Bégarie, marking a record high price achieved at auction for a piece by Sèvres — the famed porcelain manufacturer favoured by European royals in the latter half of the 18th century and early 19th century.
paras.zh: 这件作品在法国 Coutau-Bégarie 拍卖行以 292.5 万欧元的价格成交，创下了 18 世纪下半叶和 19 世纪初深受欧洲皇室青睐的著名瓷器制造商塞夫尔 (Sèvres) 的拍卖价格纪录。

paras.en: Long believed lost, the bowl turned up by chance in a crate at the Galerie Meyer in Paris, the auction venue l'Hôtel Drouot said in a social media post touting the record-setting sale.
paras.zh: 拍卖场 l'Hôtel Drouot 在社交媒体上发布的帖子中称，这只碗长期以来一直被认为丢失了，但在巴黎迈耶画廊 (Galerie Meyer) 的一个板条箱中偶然发现了这只碗，该拍卖场在社交媒体上发帖宣传此次创纪录的拍卖。

paras.en: Organizers had estimated it would sell for between one and two million euros (about $1.5 million to $3.1 million).
paras.zh: 组织者估计它的售价将在 1 至 200 万欧元（约合 150 万至 310 万美元）之间。

paras.en: French auction venue l'Hôtel Drouot touted the record-setting price online. Three other such bowls from the original set are on display in public collections. (Hôtel Drouot/Instagram)
paras.zh: 法国拍卖场 l'Hôtel Drouot 在网上宣传了这一创纪录的价格。原组中的另外三个此类碗在公共收藏中展出。 （德鲁奥酒店/Instagram）

paras.en: The identity of the buyer was not disclosed.
paras.zh: 买家的身份没有透露。

paras.en: Proceeds of Thursday's sale will benefit breast cancer research, with the seller, auctioneer and venue each earmarking a portion of the sale's revenue for the French non-profit l'Association Ruban Rose.
paras.zh: 周四拍卖的收益将有利于乳腺癌研究，卖家、拍卖师和场地均将拍卖收入的一部分专门用于法国非营利组织 l'Association Ruban Rose。

paras.en: Marie-Antoinette wasn't a fan of their Rambouillet estate, southwest of Paris, when Louis purchased it. So, to win her over, the king built her a luxurious "pleasure dairy" on the estate where she could entertain nobles and enjoy treats like fresh milk, cheeses and ice cream.
paras.zh: 当路易购买位于巴黎西南部的朗布依埃庄园时，玛丽·安托瓦内特并不喜欢它。因此，为了赢得她的支持，国王在庄园里为她建造了一座豪华的“欢乐乳品店”，在那里她可以招待贵族并享受新鲜牛奶、奶酪和冰淇淋等美食。

paras.en: As part of the lavish gift, he commissioned Sèvres artisans to create a sumptuous set of porcelain servingware — including a quartet of jatte-téton, which were inspired by mastos, Greek breast-shaped drinking cups used at banquets.
paras.zh: 作为这份奢华礼物的一部分，他委托塞夫尔工匠制作了一套华丽的瓷器餐具，其中包括一套四重奏的 jatte-téton，其灵感来自于宴会上使用的希腊胸形酒杯 Mastos。

paras.en: Though an urban legend purports the shape was moulded from Marie-Antoinette's own breast, Sèvres experts have dismissed the notion.
paras.zh: 尽管都市传说声称该形状是由玛丽·安托瓦内特自己的乳房塑造而成，但塞夫尔专家驳斥了这一说法。

paras.en: The three other Rambouillet breast bowls can be seen in the collections of France's National Ceramics Museum in Sèvres and Duca di Martina Museum in Naples.
paras.zh: 另外三件朗布依埃胸碗现藏于法国塞夫尔国家陶瓷博物馆和那不勒斯杜卡迪玛蒂娜博物馆的藏品中。

articles.title: Dutch authorities seize 26 critically endangered turtles from luggage of passenger bound for Hong Kong

paras.en: The Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) said on Friday that it had seized more than two dozen critically endangered turtles that customs officers found in a passenger's luggage at Amsterdam's Schiphol Airport.
paras.zh: 荷兰食品和消费品安全局（NVWA）周五表示，海关人员在阿姆斯特丹史基浦机场的一名乘客行李中发现了两打以上极度濒危海龟。

paras.en: The Vallarta mud turtles discovered in the luggage of a man flying to Hong Kong via Schiphol are endemic to Mexico. They were only formally discovered and catalogued in 2018 and are one of the smallest of all known species of turtle.
paras.zh: 在一名经史基浦飞往香港的男子的行李中发现的巴亚尔塔泥龟是墨西哥特有的。它们直到 2018 年才被正式发现和编目，是所有已知海龟物种中最小的一种。

paras.en: "These highly rare and protected turtles were presumably taken from the wild in Mexico, where an estimated population of only about 300 of these animals remain," the NVWA said in a press release.
paras.zh: NVWA 在一份新闻稿中表示：“这些高度稀有且受保护的海龟可能是从墨西哥的野外捕获的，据估计，那里的海龟数量仅剩约 300 只。”

paras.en: How were the turtles discovered and smuggled?
paras.zh: 海龟是如何被发现和走私的？

paras.en: Dutch customs agents discovered the animals on November 21 during a regular inspection and then alerted the NVWA, as the responsible agency for such cases, on realizing that they had uncovered live fauna.
paras.zh: 荷兰海关人员于 11 月 21 日在例行检查中发现了这些动物，并在意识到发现了活体动物群后向负责此类案件的 NVWA 发出了警报。

paras.en: Police then arrested the man at the NVWA's request, and the NVWA said in Friday's statement that he was still in custody, with federal prosecutors continuing their investigations.
paras.zh: 随后，警方应 NVWA 的要求逮捕了该男子，NVWA 在周五的声明中表示，该男子仍被拘留，联邦检察官仍在继续调查。

paras.en: "Most of the turtles were packed in a box alongside a toy car, while others were placed inside a sealed sock within a suitcase," the NVWA wrote. "The animals had been wrapped in duct tape, which prevented them from moving. All of the turtles survived the journey."
paras.zh: NVWA 写道：“大多数海龟都装在玩具车旁边的盒子里，而其他海龟则放在手提箱内的密封袜子里。” “这些动物被胶带包裹着，导致它们无法移动。所有的海龟都在旅途中幸存下来。”

paras.en: Authorities said the turtles were being housed at a specialized rescue facility, "where the duct tape was carefully removed," and where they were "receiving the care they require."
paras.zh: 当局表示，这些海龟被安置在一个专门的救援设施中，“那里的胶带被小心地撕掉了”，并且它们“在那里接受了所需的护理”。

paras.en: Vallarta mud turtles are exceptionally small freshwater turtles that only entered the taxonomical record in 2018, endemic to an area in western Mexico.
paras.zh: 巴亚尔塔泥龟是一种体型极小的淡水龟，2018 年才进入分类记录，是墨西哥西部地区的特有种。

paras.en: Relatively little is known about the creature owing both to its recent discovery and the damage to its habitat caused by urbanization and a growing tourist trade in the Mexican state of Jalisco.
paras.zh: 由于最近才发现这种生物，加上城市化和墨西哥哈利斯科州不断增长的旅游业对其栖息地造成的破坏，人们对这种生物知之甚少。
