paras.zh: 余额转账和购买均可享受 18 个月的 0% 年利率，您可以根据当前最需要的情况选择使用方式。

paras.en: You won’t even pay an annual fee to hold the card, and applying takes just a few minutes from your phone or computer.
paras.zh: 您甚至不需要支付年费来持有该卡，并且只需几分钟即可通过手机或计算机进行申请。

paras.en: But don’t wait too long — we often see 0% intro APR periods get cut without notice, so it’s smart to act while this one’s still available.
paras.zh: 但不要等待太久——我们经常看到 0% 的年利率优惠期在没有通知的情况下被削减，所以趁这个优惠仍然可用时采取行动是明智之举。

paras.en: We're firm believers in the Golden Rule, which is why editorial opinions are ours alone and have not been previously reviewed, approved, or endorsed by included advertisers. Motley Fool Money does not cover all offers on the market. Motley Fool Money is 100% owned and operated by The Motley Fool. Our knowledgeable team of personal finance editors and analysts are employed by The Motley Fool and held to the same set of publishing standards and editorial integrity while maintaining professional separation from the analysts and editors on other Motley Fool brands.
paras.zh: 我们是黄金法则的坚定信徒，这就是为什么编辑意见仅属于我们，并且之前没有经过所包含的广告商的审查、批准或认可。 Motley Fool Money 并不涵盖市场上的所有优惠。 Motley Fool Money 由 The Motley Fool 100% 拥有和经营。我们知识渊博的个人理财编辑和分析师团队受聘于 The Motley Fool，并遵守相同的出版标准和编辑诚信，同时与其他 Motley Fool 品牌的分析师和编辑保持专业分离。

articles.title: 0% intro APR until 2024 is 100% insane

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card (rates and fees) is one of the best cards you can get for paying down debt or financing a big purchase interest-free. It carries one of the longest 0% intro APR periods on the market, plus a $0 annual fee.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡（费率和费用）是您可以用来偿还债务或为大宗购物提供无息融资的最佳卡之一。它具有市场上最长的 0% 年利率之一，并且年费为 0 美元。

paras.en: The catch: once that intro APR window closes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards and hands you no ongoing perks. So it's not a great long-term keeper.
paras.zh: 问题是：一旦 APR 介绍窗口关闭，Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡将不会获得任何奖励，也不会为您提供持续的福利。所以它不是一个很好的长期保存者。

paras.en: If your only goal is to stop interest cold, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is hard to beat. Here's my honest review.
paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 初始年利率 0% 初始年利率，自购买账户开户和合格余额转账起 21 个月内

paras.en: Purchases: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases
paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：合格余额转账开户后 21 个月内年利率为 0%

paras.en: This no-frills card is a solid choice if your priority is to avoid credit card interest for as long as possible. It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特色是，自开户之日起 21 个月内，消费和符合条件的余额转移可享受 0% 的初始 APR。（此后将适用17.74%、24.24%或28.49%的浮动年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳整体信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，通常获得的信用额度也越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

paras.en: Wells Fargo is an advertising partner of Motley Fool Money. Joel O'Leary has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has a disclosure policy.
paras.zh: 富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。乔尔·奥利里 (Joel O'Leary) 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。

paras.en: The Motley Fool owns shares of and recommends Visa.
paras.zh: The Motley Fool 拥有 Visa 的股份并推荐该公司。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时机，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的美妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙女楼是司马台长城上最著名的楼之一，但由于其地处偏僻，交通不便，也是游客最少的楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。

articles.title: The Killers guitarist Dave Keuning went blind in one eye during life-threatening stroke

paras.en: The Killers guitarist Dave Keuning survived a major stroke after doctors gave him just a 40% chance to live.
paras.zh: Killers 吉他手 Dave Keuning 在一次严重中风后幸免于难，医生认为他的生存机会只有 40%。

paras.en: Keuning, 50, opened up about the medical emergency on Thanksgiving, using the holiday to share both his recovery and the recent birth of his daughter, Odette.
paras.zh: 50 岁的库宁在感恩节那天公开了自己的医疗紧急情况，并利用这个假期分享了他的康复情况以及他女儿奥黛特最近出生的消息。

paras.en: "Three months ago, we had our baby girl, Odette," he shared on Instagram. "Two weeks ago, I had a major stroke, and thanks to my wife acting fast, I went straight to the hospital and into surgery."
paras.zh: “三个月前，我们有了我们的女婴奥黛特，”他在 Instagram 上分享道。 “两周前，我得了一次严重中风，多亏了我妻子反应迅速，我直接去了医院并接受了手术。”

paras.en: "The first hour after a stroke is critical when it comes to getting to the hospital. I had a blood clot in my brain that cut off the blood supply to the entire right side of my brain," Keuning explained. "By the time I arrived at the hospital, I was blind in one eye and had lost function on my left side, but I still wasn’t able to realize I was having a stroke."
paras.zh: “中风后的第一个小时对于去医院来说至关重要。我的大脑中有一个血栓，切断了我整个右侧大脑的血液供应，”科宁解释道。 “当我到达医院时，我的一只眼睛失明了，左侧失去了功能，但我仍然没有意识到自己中风了。”

paras.en: Doctors warned Keuning he had only a 40% chance of survival and would face lasting disabilities, though the guitarist said he miraculously made a full recovery.
paras.zh: 医生警告 Keuning，他的生存机会只有 40%，并且将面临永久性残疾，尽管这位吉他手说他奇迹般地完全康复了。

paras.en: "And yes I can play guitar just as good as before," Keuning clarified. "It was the first thing I checked when I woke up from surgery."
paras.zh: “是的，我可以像以前一样弹吉他，”科宁澄清道。 “这是我从手术中醒来后检查的第一件事。”

paras.en: Beyond his ability to return to music, Keuning said the experience left him grateful for his overall recovery and his loved ones.
paras.zh: 科宁说，除了他有能力重返音乐之外，这次经历让他对自己的全面康复和他所爱的人感到感激。

paras.en: "I feel extremely fortunate that I am alive and well, and that I can use my hands and feet and talk just like before," he said. "I am thankful for my wife, my son, my daughter, and all of my bandmates, who I feel closer to than ever."
paras.zh: “我感到非常幸运，我还活着并且身体健康，我可以像以前一样用手和脚说话，”他说。 “我感谢我的妻子、我的儿子、我的女儿以及我所有的乐队成员，我感觉与他们比以往任何时候都更加亲密。”

paras.en: Keuning began playing guitar in high school before relocating to Las Vegas in 2000. While working at a retail store on the Las Vegas Strip, he placed a classified ad in a local newspaper seeking musicians to form a rock band. Singer Brandon Flowers answered the ad, and the pair teamed up with bassist Mark Stoermer and drummer Ronnie Vannucci Jr. to launch The Killers in 2001.
paras.zh: Keuning 在高中时开始弹吉他，然后于 2000 年搬到拉斯维加斯。在拉斯维加斯大道上的一家零售店工作时，他在当地报纸上刊登了一则分类广告，寻找音乐家组建一支摇滚乐队。歌手 Brandon Flowers 响应了这则广告，两人与贝斯手 Mark Stoermer 和鼓手 Ronnie Vannucci Jr. 于 2001 年合作推出了 The Killers。

paras.en: The group took its name from a fictional band featured on a bass drum in the music video for New Order's song "Crystal."
paras.zh: 该乐队的名字来源于 New Order 歌曲《Crystal》音乐视频中一支低音鼓上的虚构乐队。

paras.en: With the band, Keuning co-wrote and performed on their breakout hit "Mr. Brightside" plus their 2004 debut album "Hot Fuss." He is also featured on follow-ups "Sam's Town" along with "Day & Age."
paras.zh: Keuning 与乐队共同创作并表演了他们的热门歌曲《Mr. Brightside》以及他们 2004 年的首张专辑《Hot Fuss》。他还出现在后续的《山姆小镇》和《Day & Age》中。

paras.en: Their biggest hit singles include "Mr. Brightside," "Somebody Told Me," "All These Things That I've Done," "When You Were Young," and "Human." Across their career, The Killers have released seven studio albums, all of which reached No. 1 on the UK Albums Chart.
paras.zh: 他们最热门的单曲包括《Mr. Brightside》、《Somebody Told Me》、《AllThese Things That I've Done》、《When You Were Young》和《Human》。在他们的职业生涯中，杀手乐队发行了七张录音室专辑，所有专辑都在英国专辑排行榜上名列第一。

paras.en: After stepping back from touring in 2017, Keuning rejoined The Killers for their 2021 album "Pressure Machine."
paras.zh: 2017 年退出巡演后，科宁重新加入 The Killers 并推出了 2021 年专辑《Pressure Machine》。

articles.title: Cowboys' Jerry Jones makes statement on Brian Schottenheimer's future after embarrassing Thanksgiving loss

paras.en: While Dallas Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer may have had a rough Thanksgiving after his team's embarrassing loss on Thursday, he will at least be thankful for keeping his job for another week.
paras.zh: 虽然达拉斯牛仔队主教练布莱恩·肖滕海默在球队周四遭遇尴尬的失利后可能度过了一个艰难的感恩节，但他至少会感谢自己能再坚持一周的工作。

paras.en: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones said that despite blowing a 21-10 third-quarter lead in its 39-38 loss to the undermanned Philadelphia Eagles at AT&T Stadium, he doesn't anticipate making any coaching changes before the team's next game. However, the 84-year-old was asked what gives him confidence that Schottenheimer can still be a good head coach, and Jones didn't exactly give a ringing endorsement.
paras.zh: 牛仔队老板杰里·琼斯表示，尽管在 AT&T 体育场以 39-38 输给人手不足的费城老鹰队的比赛中，他们在第三节以 21-10 领先，但他预计球队在下一场比赛之前不会做出任何教练变动。然而，当这位84岁的老人被问到是什么让他有信心肖滕海默仍然可以成为一名优秀的主教练时，琼斯并没有给出明确的认可。

paras.en: "Nothing you've seen out here tonight. You have to look at everything," Jones told reporters postgame. "You can and should look at every person that’s had a hand in this, and you should do that."
paras.zh: “今晚你在这里什么都没有看到。你必须看看一切，”琼斯赛后告诉记者。 “你可以而且应该关注每一个参与此事的人，你应该这样做。”

paras.en: Despite the humiliating loss, Jones did say that he thinks Schottenheimer can lead the Cowboys to a Super Bowl.
paras.zh: 尽管惨败，琼斯确实表示他认为肖滕海默可以带领牛仔队进入超级碗。

paras.en: "I do," he said. "But on the other hand, these are setbacks and they’re damning setbacks, there's no question about it, especially when we feel like that we can look at parts of the game where it was ours to take and we didn’t. When you look at every bit of it, then you have to question everything."
paras.zh: “我愿意，”他说。 “但另一方面，这些都是挫折，而且是致命的挫折，这是毫无疑问的，尤其是当我们觉得我们可以审视比赛中本该由我们承担而我们却没有承担的部分时。当你审视其中的每一点时，你就必须质疑一切。”

paras.en: The Eagles started Joe Milton, who was on the Cowboys squad last month, at quarterback. The 26-year-old shredded the porous Cowboys defense in the second half, as he completed 21 of 31 passes for 331 yards with three touchdowns and one interception, along with 15 rushing yards and one touchdown.
paras.zh: 老鹰队让上个月牛仔队的乔·米尔顿担任四分卫。这位26岁的球员在下半场粉碎了牛仔队漏洞百出的防守，他31次传球完成21次，推进331码，取得3次达阵和1次拦截，同时冲球15码和1次达阵。

paras.en: During the Cowboys' collapse, they missed a 40-yard field goal that would have put them up two scores late in the fourth quarter and would have effectively sealed the game. They had a punt get blocked for a touchdown, breathing life back into the Eagles sideline at the beginning of the fourth quarter.
paras.zh: 在牛仔队溃败的过程中，他们错失了一个 40 码的射门，这本来可以让他们在第四节末段取得两分，并有效地锁定胜局。他们的一次弃踢达阵被挡，在第四节开始时为老鹰队的边线带来了生机。

paras.en: Jones said the entire organization is responsible for the loss.
paras.zh: 琼斯表示，整个组织应对损失负责。

paras.en: "It’s a bitter disappointment to have done some things early that we did and turn around every phase, every phase, that’s a part of a game like this," Jones said. "All three teams, ownership, coaching, everybody is responsible for what we saw at the end of this game."
paras.zh: 琼斯说：“我们很早就做了一些事情，并在每个阶段都扭转了局面，这是一种痛苦的失望，这是这样的比赛的一部分。” “所有三支球队，所有权，教练，每个人都对我们在这场比赛结束时所看到的负责。”

paras.en: The loss dropped the Cowboys to 5-7 on the season and was devastating to their playoff hopes. Compounding issues for Dallas is they have a very difficult schedule to end the season.
paras.zh: 这场失利使牛仔队本赛季战绩为 5 胜 7 负，季后赛希望彻底破灭。对于达拉斯来说，更复杂的问题是他们结束赛季的日程非常困难。

paras.en: - Week 18: Washington Commanders on the road
paras.zh: - 第 18 周：华盛顿指挥官在路上

paras.en: Jones said the team is focused on their upcoming schedule and not any coaching changes. Already this season, the Cowboys have stripped defensive coordinator Christian Parker of play-calling duties and given them to Mike Pettine. However, the early returns haven't been positive.
paras.zh: 琼斯表示球队专注于即将到来的赛程，而不是任何教练变动。本赛季，牛仔队已经剥夺了防守协调员克里斯蒂安·帕克的比赛指挥职责，并将其交给了迈克·佩廷。然而，早期的回报并不乐观。

paras.en: Missing the playoffs would be a major disappointment for the Cowboys, as the rest of the NFC East has been ravaged by injuries and underperformance. The Giants lost Jaxson Dart to injury in Week 2, Eagles star quarterback Jalen Hurts is out for the season with blood clots and the Commanders have been ravaged by injuries to key players on both sides of the ball.
paras.zh: 错过季后赛对于牛仔队来说将是一个巨大的失望，因为国联东区的其他球队都受到了伤病和表现不佳的困扰。巨人队在第二周失去了贾克森·达特（Jaxson Dart），老鹰队明星四分卫贾伦·赫茨（Jalen Hurts）因血栓缺席本赛季，指挥官队则因攻防两端关键球员的伤病而饱受摧残。

paras.en: Yet, despite the Cowboys being largely healthy, they have yet to win back-to-back games this season and gain any traction in the NFC playoff race. If the Cowboys fizzle down the stretch, the heat on Schottenheimer's job will only intensify.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管牛仔队基本健康，但他们本赛季尚未赢得背靠背比赛并在 NFC 季后赛中获得任何吸引力。如果牛仔队在最后阶段失败，肖滕海默的工作压力只会加剧。

articles.title: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged

paras.en: Since New York City officials postponed the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, a precaution ahead of a storm that brought heavy rain, wind and flooding, hundreds of touring performers who traveled from across the US to perform were thrust into chaos.
paras.zh: 由于纽约市官员推迟了梅西百货感恩节游行（这是一场暴风雨带来的大雨、大风和洪水的预防措施），数百名从美国各地赶来表演的巡回表演​​者陷入了混乱。

paras.en: "It was jarring," said Ryan Demkovich, director of a Texas high school marching band. After learning the news, he had to scramble to make new arrangements for over 500 people.
paras.zh: “这很刺耳，”德克萨斯州高中游行乐队的指挥瑞安德姆科维奇说。得知消息后，他不得不赶紧为500多人做出新的安排。

paras.en: Demkovich and his Pearland High School band made the quick decision to launch a fundraiser, reaching $350,000 (Â£267,000) in just a few hours.
paras.zh: 德姆科维奇和他的皮尔兰高中乐队迅速决定发起一场筹款活动，在短短几个小时内就筹集到了 350,000 美元（267,000 英镑）。

paras.en: Still, some performers reportedly had to skip the parade, a televised, traditional Thanksgiving event - now rescheduled for Saturday.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，据报道，一些表演者不得不跳过电视转播的传统感恩节活动游行，现已重新安排在周六。

paras.en: On Wednesday afternoon, a day before the event, organisers announced the postponement, in part due to concerns around the parade's giant balloons in strong winds.
paras.zh: 周三下午，即活动前一天，组织者宣布推迟，部分原因是担心强风中游行的巨型气球。

paras.en: The balloons, inflated on Wednesday, were then temporarily deflated - along with the spirits of those who journeyed to the city to watch the action.
paras.zh: 周三充气的气球随后暂时泄气，与前往城市观看这一活动的人们一起泄气。

paras.en: The move represented the first time the event had been postponed in its 100-year history, although it was suspended altogether during World War II.
paras.zh: 此举是该赛事在其 100 年历史上首次被推迟，尽管该赛事在二战期间曾被完全暂停。

paras.en: Each year, a number of marching bands travel from across the country, from high schools and colleges, to perform at the event. This is considered a huge opportunity, as the parade is watched by millions in person and on TV.
paras.zh: 每年，许多游行乐队从全国各地、高中和大学赶来参加活动。这被认为是一个巨大的机会，因为数百万人现场和电视上观看了游行。

paras.en: Demkovich described an emotional and exhausting experience, first learning that the parade would be postponed while watching a Broadway performance of Wicked with his band.
paras.zh: 德姆科维奇描述了一次激动人心且令人筋疲力尽的经历，他在和他的乐队一起观看百老汇演出《邪恶女巫》时第一次得知游行将被推迟。

paras.en: "My initial thought was like, 'Oh, crap. We're not going to be able to go'," he said.
paras.zh: “我最初的想法是，‘哦，糟糕。我们去不了’，”他说。

paras.en: "Where are we going to be able to get all the money for this?"
paras.zh: “我们从哪里才能得到所有的钱呢？”

paras.en: The delay meant unexpected expenses of additional nights in a hotel - and meals - for hundreds of people in the middle of New York City during the holidays.
paras.zh: 这次延误意味着纽约市中心的数百人在假期期间需要额外在酒店住宿和用餐，从而产生意外的费用。

paras.en: There were no vacancies to extend their stay at the New York Marriott Marquis in Times Square, so they booked the nearest hotel with availability - across the Hudson River - in New Jersey.
paras.zh: 由于时代广场的纽约马奎斯万豪酒店没有空房，所以他们预订了新泽西州哈德逊河对面最近的有空房的酒店。

paras.en: Demkovich said the Pride of Pearland Marching Band posted a fundraiser online and within hours met its fundraising goal.
paras.zh: 德姆科维奇表示，Pearland Pride Marching Band 在网上发布了筹款活动，并在数小时内实现了筹款目标。

paras.en: "The word just spread like wildfire, truly like wildfire," Demkovich said, adding that donations came from over 2,000 people and local businesses.
paras.zh: 德姆科维奇说：“这个消息像野火一样蔓延，真的像野火一样。”他补充说，捐款来自 2000 多人和当地企业。

paras.en: He called the outpouring of support "very, very overwhelming to think about and comprehend".
paras.zh: 他称大量的支持“令人难以想象和理解”。

paras.en: "We have a lot to be thankful for this Thanksgiving."
paras.zh: “这个感恩节我们有很多值得感恩的事情。”

paras.en: Some groups were not able to maneuver as easily. The University of Alabama's Million Dollar Band is one of those missing out, due to a schedule conflict on Saturday.
paras.zh: 有些团体无法轻松机动。由于周六的日程冲突，阿拉巴马大学的百万美元乐队就是其中之一。

paras.en: ââThis canât be happeningâ,â Rina Browder, mother of a snare drummer in the band, told local news, describing the bandâs reactions.
paras.zh: “这不可能发生”，乐队中军鼓手的母亲丽娜·布劳德 (Rina Browder) 向当地新闻描述了乐队的反应。

paras.en: "They were devastated. They've worked so hard for this. So many practices."
paras.zh: “他们被摧毁了。他们为此付出了如此多的努力。做了这么多的练习。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, a group from Hawaii, the NÄ Koa AliÊ»i HawaiÊ»i All-State Marching Band, said it too would still be able to participate in the parade, also because of emergency fundraising by families, friends and other supporters donating more than $500,000.
paras.zh: 与此同时，来自夏威夷的夏威夷全州游行乐队表示，他们仍然能够参加游行，这也是因为家人、朋友和其他支持者紧急筹款，捐赠了超过 50 万美元。

paras.en: Speaking to the BBC on Thursday, the group's director Rickey H Badua described the time pressures. "We are racing to get this done," he explained.
paras.zh: 该团体总监 Rickey H Badua 周四在接受 BBC 采访时描述了时间压力。 “我们正在竞相完成这项工作，”他解释道。

paras.en: The band is made up of hundreds of musicians from dozens of schools across the state. It travelled almost 5,000 miles (8,000km) to get to New York.
paras.zh: 该乐队由来自全州数十所学校的数百名音乐家组成。它行驶了近 5,000 英里（8,000 公里）到达纽约。

paras.en: "Getting the news that we got the parade postponed was not easy, and emotional for our students," Badua said.
paras.zh: 巴杜瓦说：“得知游行推迟的消息并不容易，我们的学生也很激动。”

paras.en: But the musicians sprang into action quickly, he said. "We come from a very far place," Badua said, adding that "to get so close to the finish line and not show up for it, we couldn't give up that easily".
paras.zh: 但他说，音乐家们很快就采取了行动。 “我们来自很远的地方，”巴杜瓦说，并补充道，“如此接近终点线却没有出现，我们不能轻易放弃”。

paras.en: The response from friends and family had been "incredible", he said.
paras.zh: 他说，朋友和家人的反应“令人难以置信”。

paras.en: Badua was hopeful his group would have the same experience he had when he first performed at the parade in 2003, as student drum major.
paras.zh: 巴杜瓦希望他的乐队能拥有与 2003 年他作为鼓专业学生首次在游行中表演时一样的经历。

paras.en: "The energy is palpable, people are just excited to see a band that is great."
paras.zh: “能量是显而易见的，人们很高兴看到一支伟大的乐队。”

paras.en: Another musical act, from Illinois, told the BBC on Thursday it needed to raise $175,000 to cover another night in a hotel, additional food, and bus costs back to the city of Champaign.
paras.zh: 另一位来自伊利诺伊州的音乐表演者周四告诉 BBC，他们需要筹集 175,000 美元来支付在酒店过夜的费用、额外的食物以及返回香槟市的巴士费用。

paras.en: "Things are going well due to the very generous support of so many amazing human beings," said Professor Barry Houser, director of the University of Illinois Marching Illini.
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊大学马奇伊利尼分校主任巴里·豪瑟教授表示：“由于许多杰出人士的慷慨支持，一切进展顺利。”

paras.en: By Friday, 3,500 donors had stepped up to help the 410 students and their travel party. "This is truly phenomenal," said Houser.
paras.zh: 截至周五，已有 3,500 名捐助者挺身而出，为 410 名学生及其旅行团提供帮助。 “这确实是惊人的，”豪瑟说。

paras.en: While awaiting the parade, musicians and punters alike have sheltered from the heavy wind and rain brought by the storm to eastern areas of the US.
paras.zh: 在等待游行的同时，音乐家和赌客们都躲避了风暴给美国东部地区带来的狂风大雨。

paras.en: Hundreds of thousands of homes were without power in the storm's aftermath Friday, and coastal areas had flooded. The National Weather Service (NWS) expects conditions to improve gradually on Friday.
paras.zh: 周五风暴过后，数十万户家庭断电，沿海地区发生洪水。国家气象局（NWS）预计周五情况将逐渐改善。

articles.title: Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza

paras.en: A tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes of diesel which capsized off the holiday island of Ibiza on Thursday will be towed to the port of Cartagena, officials in Spain say.
paras.zh: 西班牙官员表示，周四在伊维萨岛度假岛倾覆的一艘载有多达 7,000 吨柴油的油轮将被拖往卡塔赫纳港。

paras.en: All 17 of the Malta-registered Med Emre's crew members were rescued but the chief engineer later died in hospital. Six people were treated for minor injuries.
paras.zh: 在马耳他注册的 Med Emre 号船员全部获救，但总工程师后来在医院去世。六人受轻伤接受治疗。

paras.en: There had been concerns of a major oil spillage in the western Mediterranean but an inspection showed that the ship's fuel tanks are intact. An investigation is under way into what happened.
paras.zh: 人们担心地中海西部会发生重大石油泄漏，但检查显示该船的油箱完好无损。正在对所发生的事情进行调查。

paras.en: The vessel had been travelling from Algeciras near Gibraltar to Barcelona and is expected to arrive in Cartagena on Monday in what is being seen as a challenging rescue operation.
paras.zh: 该船当时正从直布罗陀附近的阿尔赫西拉斯前往巴塞罗那，预计将于周一抵达卡塔赫纳，此次救援行动被视为具有挑战性。

paras.en: In a statement on Friday, the Spanish transport ministry said the tanker would be towed to Cartagena "as it is the only one [port] that meets the technical requirements to carry out cargo extraction and repair work".
paras.zh: 西班牙交通部在周五的一份声明中表示，这艘油轮将被拖往卡塔赫纳，“因为它是唯一一个符合进行货物提取和维修工作技术要求的[港口]”。

paras.en: Prime Minister Pedro SÃ¡nchez told Cadena SER radio network he hoped the tanker could be taken to port "in the coming hours, in the coming days".
paras.zh: 总理佩德罗·桑切斯告诉卡德纳 SER 广播网，他希望这艘油轮能够“在未来几小时内、未来几天内”被带到港口。

paras.en: "The information suggests that, indeed... this leak is not happening", he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“信息表明，事实上……这次泄漏并没有发生。”

paras.en: The Spanish authorities provided no details about how the diesel would be extracted.
paras.zh: 西班牙当局没有提供有关如何提取柴油的详细信息。

paras.en: Meanwhile, pictures have emerged showing emergency workers inspecting the tanker's hull.
paras.zh: 与此同时，图片显示紧急救援人员正在检查油轮的船体。

paras.en: Any possible environmental damage is being assessed by air and pollution control vessel Clara Campoamor, which is owned by Spain's national maritime rescue service.
paras.zh: 西班牙国家海上救援机构拥有的空气和污染控制船 Clara Campoamor 正在评估任何可能的环境损害。

paras.en: Elena Delgado, maritime captain of the port of Valencia, earlier told news agency AFP that a small slick which had formed around the vessel had "disappeared".
paras.zh: 瓦伦西亚港船长埃琳娜·德尔加多(Elena Delgado)早些时候告诉法新社，船只周围形成的一小块浮油已经“消失”。

paras.en: "The situation is stabilised," she said, adding that further inspections would be carried out.
paras.zh: “情况已经稳定，”她说，并补充说将进行进一步检查。

paras.en: Regional emergencies director Pablo GÃ¡rriz said the tanker had not completely sunk as originally reported. The vessel remains partially submerged.
paras.zh: 地区紧急事务主管巴勃罗·加里兹（Pablo Gárriz）表示，这艘油轮并未像最初报道的那样完全沉没。该船仍部分淹没。

paras.en: The Med Emre capsized 25 nautical miles (46 km; 29 miles) from Ibiza's coastline and 57 nautical miles from Valencia.
paras.zh: Med Emre 号在距离伊维萨岛海岸线 25 海里（46 公里；29 英里）、距离巴伦西亚 57 海里处倾覆。

paras.en: Rescuers in Valencia received a distress call late on Wednesday, according to Spanish media.
paras.zh: 据西班牙媒体报道，巴伦西亚的救援人员周三晚间接到求救信号。

paras.en: Minutes later, the vessel reported a leak and the crew said it was leaning at a 90-degree angle. It capsized in the early hours on Thursday.
paras.zh: 几分钟后，该船报告发生泄漏，船员称该船已倾斜 90 度角。它于周四凌晨倾覆。

paras.en: Ibiza's marine environment was added to the Unesco World Heritage List in 1999. In particular, it is home to dense prairies of Posidonia oceanic seagrass, which is found only in the Mediterranean basin and plays a vital role in supporting local marine biodiversity.
paras.zh: 伊维萨岛的海洋环境于1999年被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录。特别是，这里有茂密的波西多尼亚海洋海草草原，这种海草仅见于地中海盆地，对支持当地海洋生物多样性发挥着至关重要的作用。

paras.en: In 2002, Spain experienced one of its worst environmental disasters when the Prestige oil tanker ran into trouble off Galicia's coastline, in the country's north-west.
paras.zh: 2002年，西班牙经历了最严重的环境灾难之一，当时Prestige油轮在该国西北部的加利西亚海岸线附近遇到了麻烦。

paras.en: More than 60,000 tonnes of heavy fuel oil spilled into the sea.
paras.zh: 超过6万吨重油泄漏入海。

articles.title: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes

paras.en: Spain's main party leaders have held their final rallies ahead of Sunday's election, with Socialist Prime Minister Pedro SÃ¡nchez saying he is confident of defying the polls.
paras.zh: 西班牙主要政党领导人在周日选举前举行了最后一次集会，社会党首相佩德罗·桑切斯表示，他有信心挑战民意调查。

paras.en: "I cannot imagine us losing," he said, posing for selfies with supporters in red T-shirts and accusing conservative rival Alberto NÃºÃ±ez FeijÃ³o of planning a coalition with the far right.
paras.zh: “我无法想象我们会失败，”他一边说，一边与身穿红色 T 恤的支持者合影留念，并指责保守派竞争对手阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费乔 (Alberto Nóñez Feijó) 计划与极右翼联盟。

paras.en: FeijÃ³o's People's Party (PP) is narrowly ahead in the polls, and in the final hours of the campaign he travelled first to Barcelona and then Seville, promising voters a new political era of "truth, decency and good governance".
paras.zh: 费乔领导的人民党在民意调查中以微弱优势领先，在竞选的最后几个小时，他首先前往巴塞罗那，然后前往塞维利亚，向选民承诺一个“真理、正派和善治”的新政治时代。

paras.en: He accused SÃ¡nchez of evading questions on key issues like corruption, rail disasters, immigration and the national debt.
paras.zh: 他指责桑切斯回避腐败、铁路灾难、移民和国债等关键问题。

paras.en: The Socialist leader heads one of Europe's few left-wing governments, and with the French presidential elections five months away, there is a real chance that two of the continent's biggest economies could move to the right in quick succession.
paras.zh: 这位社会党领导人领导着欧洲为数不多的左翼政府之一，距离法国总统选举还有五个月，欧洲大陆最大的两个经济体很有可能连续快速右转。

paras.en: Almost 39 million people have a vote in Spain and while commentators expect a high turnout, most polls have suggested a close finish. Under Spanish electoral law, no polls have been published since Monday.
paras.zh: 西班牙有近 3900 万人投票，虽然评论员预计投票率很高，但大多数民意调查显示投票结果很接近。根据西班牙选举法，自周一以来尚未公布任何民意调查。

paras.en: "This time, yes, we're going to do it," FeijÃ³o told PP supporters, in a nod to his failure to form a government three years ago despite winning most seats.
paras.zh: “这一次，是的，我们会这么做，”费乔对人民党的支持者说，这是对他三年前尽管赢得了大部分席位但未能组建政府的认可。

paras.en: If he gets to form a government this time, it will be with the support of anti-immigration party Vox, led by Santiago Abascal, whose final rally took place in front of thousands of people in a bull-ring in Valencia on Spain's east coast.
paras.zh: 如果他这次能组建政府，将得到圣地亚哥·阿巴斯卡领导的反移民政党 Vox 的支持，该党的最后一次集会是在西班牙东海岸巴伦西亚的一个斗牛场，在数千人面前举行的。

paras.en: The venue was filled with Spanish flags and green Vox banners, and one of the biggest cheers of the night came when the secretary general of the party called for "less burka and less halal".
paras.zh: 会场里挂满了西班牙国旗和绿色的 Vox 横幅，当晚最大的欢呼之一是当该党秘书长呼吁“少穿罩袍，少穿清真食品”时。

paras.en: Ignacio Garriga said he was not acting out of hatred but love for the homeland.
paras.zh: 伊格纳西奥·加里加表示，他的行为不是出于仇恨，而是出于对祖国的热爱。

paras.en: A small section of the crowd could be heard chanting "Viva Franco" in reference to the dictator, whose death in 1975 heralded the start of Spain's transition to democracy.
paras.zh: 可以听到一小部分人群高呼“佛朗哥万岁”，指的是这位独裁者，他于 1975 年去世，预示着西班牙开始向民主过渡。

paras.en: A number of first-time voters at the rally said they were supporting Vox because of its policies on immigration.
paras.zh: 一些首次参加集会的选民表示，他们支持 Vox 是因为其移民政策。

paras.en: LledÃ³, 18, said what had happened in Ceuta in the summer, when more than 70,000 migrants crossed into the Spanish territory from Morocco, showed SÃ¡nchez was not able to control the country's border.
paras.zh: 18 岁的莱多说，今年夏天休达发生的事情，当时有 7 万多名移民从摩洛哥越境进入西班牙领土，这表明桑切斯无法控制该国边境。

paras.en: She had come to the bullring with her mum and aunt, Carli Chilet, who argued that Vox "are the best for women's rights".
paras.zh: 她和妈妈以及姨妈卡莉·奇莱特 (Carli Chilet) 一起来到斗牛场，她们认为 Vox“最有利于妇女权利”。

paras.en: Vox is hoping to almost double its seats from the 33 it won three years ago. It backs policies such as "national priority" - putting Spanish citizens first for welfare - and "remigration" for foreigners not considered to be contributing to the economy.
paras.zh: Vox 希望将其席位从三年前的 33 个增加到近一倍。它支持诸如“国家优先”——将西班牙公民的福利放在首位——以及对不被认为对经济做出贡献的外国人进行“移民”等政策。

paras.en: The final day of campaigning was very much in the shadow of a four-way TV debate the night before that exposed Spain's sharply polarised politics.
paras.zh: 竞选活动的最后一天很大程度上处于前一天晚上四方电视辩论的阴影下，这场辩论暴露了西班牙严重两极分化的政治。

paras.en: All four leaders had solutions for the housing crisis. FeijÃ³o said the PP would build a million homes over four years, while SÃ¡nchez said housing should be a right not an object of speculation and profit.
paras.zh: 四位领导人都提出了住房危机的解决方案。费乔表示，人民党将在四年内建造一百万套住房，而桑切斯则表示，住房应该是一种权利，而不是投机和利润的对象。

paras.en: While the conservatives tried to turn the spotlight on the series of scandals that have overshadowed the Socialists' term in office, SÃ¡nchez and his left-wing ally Ada Colau, who heads Frente Amplio (The Broad Front), focused on women's rights.
paras.zh: 虽然保守派试图将焦点转向给社会党任期蒙上阴影的一系列丑闻，但桑切斯和他的左翼盟友、广泛阵线领导人阿达·科劳却把重点放在了妇女权利上。

paras.en: The two leaders seized on a moment in the debate when the PP leader accused Colau and the rest of the left of staying quiet during a flood disaster in Valencia, briefly moving his finger to his lips. The word he used "calladita" is a diminutive and can also be used to tell a woman to "keep quiet" in a condescending manner.
paras.zh: 两位领导人抓住了辩论中的一个时刻，当时人民党领导人指责科劳和其他左派在巴伦西亚洪水灾害期间保持沉默，并短暂地将手指移到嘴唇上。他使用的“calladita”这个词是一个贬义词，也可以用来居高临下地告诉女人“保持安静”。

paras.en: SÃ¡nchez reacted immediately and called on him to show "a little respect", accusing him of sexism.
paras.zh: 桑切斯立即做出反应，呼吁他表现出“一点尊重”，指责他存在性别歧视。

paras.en: FeijÃ³o sought to clarify what he meant on Friday, and accused Ada Colau of remaining silent during "these years of corruption". His decision to wind up his campaign in Seville was significant, because the wider southern region of Andalusia has 61 seats in Spain's 350-seat parliament, more than any other.
paras.zh: 费约周五试图澄清他的意思，并指责艾达·科劳在“这些年的腐败”中保持沉默。他决定在塞维利亚结束竞选活动意义重大，因为安达卢西亚南部地区在西班牙议会 350 个席位中拥有 61 个席位，比其他任何地区都多。

paras.en: Andalusia is also important because it is run by a coalition made up of the PP and Abascal's Vox, as are three other regions, Extremadura, AragÃ³n, and Castilla y LeÃ³n.
paras.zh: 安达卢西亚也很重要，因为它是由人民党和阿巴斯卡的 Vox 组成的联盟管理的，其他三个地区埃斯特雷马杜拉、阿拉贡和卡斯蒂利亚莱昂也是如此。

paras.en: FeijÃ³o has insisted he wants to govern with a majority, backed up by "parliamentary support agreements" with Vox and says he has never spoken to Abascal about giving Vox ministerial power.
paras.zh: 费约坚称，他希望以多数席位执政，并得到与 Vox 的“议会支持协议”的支持，并表示他从未与阿巴斯卡尔谈过授予 Vox 部长权力的问题。

paras.en: SÃ¡nchez took to the stage in Madrid with his wife BegoÃ±a GÃ³mez, and donned a red T-shirt that read "power of the people".
paras.zh: 桑切斯与妻子贝戈尼亚·戈麦斯一起登上马德里的舞台，并穿上了一件红色T恤，上面写着“人民的力量”。

paras.en: He then went on to praise Colau and her left-wing coalition's campaign. As he was speaking, Colau told a large audience in the south of Madrid that not only would they "not remain silent, we will win", vowing to form another "progressive government".
paras.zh: 然后他继续赞扬科劳和她的左翼联盟的竞选活动。科劳在讲话时对马德里南部的大批听众表示，他们不仅“不会保持沉默，我们会获胜”，并发誓要组建另一个“进步政府”。

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳（2025 年 1 月 6 日）——制动和摩擦技术领域的全球领导者、CentroMotion 品牌家族的成员之一 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF) 迎来了一个重要的里程碑——成立 100 周年。

paras.en: Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.
paras.zh: 自 1925 年成立以来，该公司一直践行其口号“开辟新天地”，不断开拓创新解决方案，推动行业向前发展。

paras.en: "For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
paras.zh: CentroMotion 首席商务官 (CCO) Tom Vanderlaan 表示：“100 年来，Carlisle 一直是制动行业突破性创新和坚定可靠性的代名词。” “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的奉献、客户的信任以及我们产品的持久实力。在庆祝我们百年华诞之际，我们重申我们对持续创新、强有力的合作伙伴关系以及回馈我们所服务的社区的承诺。”

paras.en: A Century of Innovation in Motion Control
paras.zh: 运动控制的一个世纪的创新

paras.en: For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
paras.zh: 一个世纪以来，CarlisleCBF 一直处于运动控制领域的前沿，凭借其行业领先的制动器和摩擦材料突破了性能界限。通过坚定不移地致力于研发，该公司赢得了全球客户的信任，奠定了其可靠性的基石。

paras.en: Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration
paras.zh: 庆祝开拓新天地 100 周年：数字庆典

paras.en: To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.
paras.zh: 为了纪念这一历史性里程碑，CarlisleCBF 推出了全面的数字庆祝活动。这种虚拟体验将使客户、员工和行业合作伙伴能够通过历史照片和故事深入了解公司丰富的历史、突破性的创新和对卓越的承诺。

paras.en: A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动的一个核心方面是培养社区意识。 CarlisleCBF 邀请客户、员工和行业合作伙伴通过访问其专门的周年纪念网页 www.CarlisleCBF.com 并在社交媒体上关注他们的故事来加入这一旅程。

paras.en: The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.
paras.zh: 网页和社交媒体渠道将充当虚拟时间胶囊，展示 CarlisleCBF 丰富的历史、突破性的里程碑和产品创新。

paras.en: To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
paras.zh: 为了鼓励参与并庆祝 CarlisleCBF 所产生的影响，一项社交媒体活动正在启动，主题标签为#CarlisleCBF100。我们鼓励参与者分享故事、照片和回忆，以说明 CarlisleCBF 产品如何影响他们的生活或业务。最具吸引力的提交内容将在公司的社交媒体渠道和网站上展示。

paras.en: By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.
paras.zh: 通过将数字故事讲述与互动社交媒体相结合，CarlisleCBF 旨在为其第一个世纪的服务创造持久的遗产，同时培养社区和欣赏精神。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，在开发和制造高度创新的制动和摩擦系统解决方案方面是全球公认的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。 CarlisleCBF 制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料，以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

paras.en: CentroMotion designs and delivers highly engineered products that enhance the safety, reliability and productivity of equipment used in transportation, agriculture, construction, mining and demanding industrial environments. Our innovative team works collaboratively with customers through our family of trusted, established brands, bringing deep subject-matter expertise in complementary technologies.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 设计并提供高度工程化的产品，可提高运输、农业、建筑、采矿和苛刻工业环境中使用的设备的安全性、可靠性和生产率。我们的创新团队通过值得信赖的知名品牌与客户合作，带来互补技术方面深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: This expertise, combined with our exceptional scale and geographic reach, makes us a reliable partner to help our customers achieve their goals, and provide end users with the best equipment possible. Our well-known brands include Power-Packer for hydraulic motion control and stabilization systems; CrossControl and maximatecc for operator information and human-machine interface systems; Elliott Manufacturing and Weasler Engineering for power and force transmission through flexible and rigid driveline systems; Gits Manufacturing for high-performance engine thermal and emission control solutions; and Carlisle Brake & Friction for materials and mechatronic solutions for off-highway brake and transmission products. Learn more about CentroMotion at www.centromotion.com.
paras.zh: 这种专业知识与我们卓越的规模和地理覆盖范围相结合，使我们成为可靠的合作伙伴，帮助我们的客户实现他们的目标，并为最终用户提供最好的设备。我们的知名品牌包括用于液压运动控制和稳定系统的 Power-Packer；用于操作员信息和人机界面系统的 CrossControl 和 maximatecc； Elliott Manufacturing 和 Weasler Engineering 通过柔性和刚性传动系统进行动力和力传输； Gits Manufacturing 提供高性能发动机热和排放控制解决方案；和 Carlisle Brake & Friction，为非公路制动和传动产品提供材料和机电一体化解决方案。如需了解有关 CentroMotion 的更多信息，请访问 www.centromotion.com。

articles.title: bauma 2025

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is one of five CentroMotion brands exhibiting at bauma, April 7–13 in Munich, booth A2, 402.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 4 月 7 日至 13 日在慕尼黑举行的 bauma 展会上参展的五个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位 A2, 402。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the construction market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于建筑市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing product highlights from their industry-leading brake, transmissions/clutch and motion control systems.
paras.zh: 分享其行业领先的制动、变速箱/离合器和运动控制系统的产品亮点。

paras.en: Showcasing display and on-board computing platforms.
paras.zh: 展示显示和机载计算平台。

paras.en: Featuring the latest solutions in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, exhaust recirculation valves and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas, and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用最新的热管理解决方案，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、排气再循环阀和排气背压阀。

paras.en: Demonstrating micro-controller-based platforms for instrumentation and HMI.
paras.zh: 演示基于微控制器的仪器仪表和 HMI 平台。

paras.en: Exhibiting new electro-hydraulic actuators with a design focus on efficiency, perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications.
paras.zh: 展示新型电动液压执行器，其设计注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。

articles.title: Visit Us @Agritechnica 2025

paras.en: CarlisleCBF is one of seven CentroMotion brands exhibiting at Agritechnica, November 9 - 15, 2025, in Hanover, Germany, stand No. B35, hall 17.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是参加 2025 年 11 月 9 日至 15 日在德国汉诺威举行的 Agritechnica 展会的七个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位号为 B35，展厅 17。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information, and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the agriculture market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于农业市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing a powerful lineup of brake system solutions engineered for the demands of modern agriculture equipment. Attendees can explore highlights from industry-leading brake assemblies, designed to deliver unmatched stopping power and durability in off-highway environments. The display will also feature both the EPD and N680 advanced friction technologies, built to optimize performance and reliability in high-torque applications. Together, these products represent a century of engineering excellence and a future-focused commitment to solving the toughest challenges in agricultural mobility.
paras.zh: 分享一系列强大的制动系统解决方案，专为满足现代农业设备的需求而设计。与会者可以探索行业领先的制动组件的亮点，这些组件旨在在非公路环境中提供无与伦比的制动力和耐用性。该显示器还将采用 EPD 和 N680 先进摩擦技术，旨在优化高扭矩应用中的性能和可靠性。这些产品共同代表了一个世纪以来的卓越工程技术和着眼于未来解决农业移动领域最严峻挑战的承诺。

paras.en: Showcasing the leading on-board computing platform for machine intelligence and HMI solutions. New products, designed specifically to meet the needs of agricultural machinery, include 10- and 12-inch smart terminals, central vehicle computing with monitors, and 5- and 7-inch displays featuring programmable soft keys for tactile control. The CCpilot V1090 and V1290 are the first displays with an integrated network switch that makes it easier to incorporate elements like camera systems, sensors and precision systems, into one display computer. The vehicle computer and monitors (CrossCore A100 with monitors from 10 to 12 inches) highlight the new centralized computing architecture. This approach provides a flexible, scalable platform for vehicle intelligence. It includes innovative component life cycle management and increased support for functional safety.
paras.zh: 展示用于机器智能和 HMI 解决方案的领先机载计算平台。专为满足农业机械需求而设计的新产品包括10英寸和12英寸智能终端、带显示器的中央车辆计算以及具有用于触觉控制的可编程软键的5英寸和7英寸显示器。 CCpilot V1090 和 V1290 是首款具有集成网络交换机的显示器，可以更轻松地将摄像头系统、传感器和精密系统等元素整合到一台显示计算机中。车载电脑和显示器（CrossCore A100，显示器尺寸从10英寸到12英寸）突出了新的集中式计算架构。这种方法为车辆智能提供了一个灵活、可扩展的平台。它包括创新的组件生命周期管理和增加对功能安全的支持。

paras.en: Highlighting how Elliott’s flexible planting products deliver precision performance, highly operational reliability and mechanical advantages without the need for additional power sources. The flexible drive and control shaft products bring enhanced performance to original equipment machinery, providing simple and dependable aftermarket upgrades for an ongoing return on your investment. Five different flexible drive shaft agricultural systems are available, and the assemblies fit most planters on the market today.
paras.zh: 重点介绍 Elliott 的灵活种植产品如何在无需额外电源的情况下提供精确的性能、高度的运行可靠性和机械优势。灵活的驱动和控制轴产品为原始设备机械带来了增强的性能，提供简单可靠的售后升级，为您带来持续的投资回报。有五种不同的柔性驱动轴农业系统可供选择，这些组件适合当今市场上的大多数播种机。

paras.en: Featuring the latest innovations in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, hot- and cold-side exhaust gas recirculation valves, and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用热管理解决方案的最新创新，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、热侧和冷侧废气再循环阀以及排气背压阀。

paras.en: Presenting the latest solutions to help operators sense, see and know more. Show attendees will find a broad portfolio of products, including displays, clusters and sensors for vehicle and equipment monitoring in demanding applications. The displays are built on a microcontroller architecture which offers lean performance with inherent support for key features including fast boot (typically around a second for instant access to machine data). Visitors to Agritechnica can get a hands-on look at the display range, from 1.3 to 4.3 inches, with demos to show general I/O, CAN channel support and application examples. The displays can share multiple screens of information, with intuitive navigation, including diagnostic codes and machine status. The platform offers devices with robust and compact housings suitable to withstand the toughest environments and designed to easily fit 52 or 86 mm SAE case sizes to make installation simple for new and existing cabins.
paras.zh: 呈现最新的解决方案，帮助操作员感知、看到和了解更多。展会与会者将发现广泛的产品组合，包括用于在要求苛刻的应用中监控车辆和设备的显示器、仪表组和传感器。这些显示器基于微控制器架构构建，可提供精益性能以及对快速启动（通常大约一秒即可即时访问机器数据）等关键功能的固有支持。 Agritechnica 的参观者可以亲身体验从 1.3 英寸到 4.3 英寸的显示屏范围，并通过演示展示通用 I/O、CAN 通道支持和应用示例。这些显示器可以共享多个信息屏幕，并具有直观的导航功能，包括诊断代码和机器状态。该平台提供的设备具有坚固而紧凑的外壳，适合承受最恶劣的环境，并可轻松安装 52 或 86 毫米 SAE 外壳尺寸，使新的和现有的驾驶室的安装变得简单。

paras.en: Showcasing the Power-Packer portfolio of manual and electric pumps and cylinders for hydraulic cab tilt and hood-lift applications, as well as the latest electro-hydraulic actuator. All products are designed with a focus on efficiency and perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications. Hydraulic solutions offer precise motion control and ensure reliable performance in the most demanding environments.
paras.zh: 展示用于液压驾驶室倾斜和发动机罩升降应用的手动和电动泵和油缸的 Power-Packer 产品组合，以及最新的电动液压执行器。所有产品的设计都注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。液压解决方案提供精确的运动控制，并确保在最苛刻的环境中提供可靠的性能。

paras.en: Learn about Weasler’s range of products, from drive shafts and torque limiters to dampers and other components, all designed using the best technology to solve our customers’ power transmission problems. Products are engineered for reliability and precision, ensuring the seamless operation and longevity of agricultural equipment.
paras.zh: 了解 Weasler 的产品系列，从传动轴和扭矩限制器到阻尼器和其他组件，所有产品均采用最佳技术设计，旨在解决客户的动力传输问题。产品的设计注重可靠性和精确性，确保农业设备的无缝运行和使用寿命。

articles.title: Dealers warn of further delays after FCA finds motor finance data errors
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Dealers warn of further delays after FCA finds motor finance data errors
paras.zh: FCA 发现汽车金融数据错误后，经销商警告可能会出现进一步延误

paras.en: The National Franchised Dealers Association (NFDA) has raised fresh concerns over prolonged delays to the motor finance redress scheme after the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) disclosed errors in the underlying compensation data.
paras.zh: 在金融行为监管局 (FCA) 披露基础补偿数据中的错误后，全国特许经销商协会 (NFDA) 对汽车金融补救计划的长期拖延提出了新的担忧。

paras.en: While the financial adjustment from the regulator’s error is expected to be minor, shifting the current 17 per cent APR benchmark by less than one percentage point, or an average of under £10 per agreement, industry leaders warn that the mistake compounds ongoing uncertainty for dealerships and consumers.
paras.zh: 虽然监管机构错误造成的财务调整预计很小，将当前 17% 的年利率基准调整不到 1 个百分点，即每份协议平均调整不到 10 英镑，但行业领袖警告称，这一错误加剧了经销商和消费者持续的不确定性。

paras.en: Despite lenders having already provisioned £7.5 billion to fund payouts, the NFDA noted that the sector still lacks a clear and credible timetable from the regulator to begin distributing funds.
paras.zh: 尽管贷款机构已经拨备了 75 亿英镑用于支付资金，但 NFDA 指出，该行业仍缺乏监管机构明确且可信的时间表来开始分配资金。

paras.en: Sue Robinson, chief executive of the NFDA, said: “Our members are on the front line, fielding customer questions about compensation they cannot yet answer.
paras.zh: NFDA 首席执行官苏·罗宾逊 (Sue Robinson) 表示：“我们的成员处于第一线，解答客户关于赔偿的问题，但他们还无法回答。

paras.en: “We urge the FCA to resolve this calculation issue quickly, confirm the litigation timetable and restore confidence in the scheme.”
paras.zh: “我们敦促FCA迅速解决这一计算问题，确认诉讼时间表并恢复对该计划的信心。”

paras.en: The association confirmed it will continue direct discussions with the FCA as dealerships await definitive guidance on when payouts will commence.
paras.zh: 该协会确认，将继续与 FCA 进行直接讨论，经销商正在等待有关何时开始付款的明确指导。

articles.title: Motorcycle dealers back new bill targeting illegal e-bikes and derestriction kits
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Motorcycle dealers back new bill targeting illegal e-bikes and derestriction kits
paras.zh: 摩托车经销商支持针对非法电动自行车和解除限制套件的新法案

paras.en: The National Motorcycle Dealers Association (NMDA) has welcomed the introduction of the Sale of Electric Personal Vehicles (Offences) Bill, which aims to curb the sale of non-compliant e-bikes and speed-limit removal kits.
paras.zh: 全国摩托车经销商协会 (NMDA) 对《电动个人车辆销售（违法行为）法案》的出台表示欢迎，该法案旨在遏制不合规电动自行车和限速清除套件的销售。

paras.en: Introduced in Parliament on 25 November ahead of its second reading on 5 February 2027, the legislation proposes making it an offence for retailers and online marketplaces to sell electric personal vehicles, such as e-bikes and electric dirt bikes, without taking reasonable steps to prevent illegal road use. It would also ban the sale and marketing of derestriction kits while empowering the Secretary of State to set clearer market standards.
paras.zh: 该立法于 11 月 25 日在议会于 2027 年 2 月 5 日二读之前提出，提议将零售商和在线市场在未采取合理措施防止非法道路使用的情况下销售电动个人车辆（例如电动自行车和电动越野车）的行为定为犯罪行为。它还将禁止销售和营销解除限制套件，同时授权国务卿制定更明确的市场标准。

paras.en: The NMDA noted that unregulated online imports continue to undercut franchised dealerships bearing full regulatory compliance costs. Meanwhile, industry data indicates moped registrations have dropped by roughly 40 per cent since 2022, a decline attributed to the cost and complexity of obtaining a licence, which has driven some riders toward illegal high-powered alternatives.
paras.zh: NMDA 指出，不受监管的在线进口继续削弱特许经销商承担全部监管合规成本的能力。与此同时，行业数据显示，自 2022 年以来，轻便摩托车的注册量下降了约 40%，下降的原因是获得许可证的成本和复杂性，这促使一些骑手转向非法的高性能替代品。

paras.en: Alongside the Motorcycle Industry Association (MCIA) and the National Motorcyclists Council (NMC), the NMDA previously urged ministers to reform training and licensing rules to boost legitimate two-wheeler uptake.
paras.zh: NMDA 此前与摩托车工业协会 (MCIA) 和国家摩托车手委员会 (NMC) 一起敦促部长们改革培训和许可规则，以促进合法两轮车的普及。

paras.en: Symon Cook, head of operations at NMDA, said: “It is encouraging to see parliamentary focus placed on legislation to supply safe, road-legal vehicles, and tackling non-compliant sales. It shows a positive step toward ensuring fairer competition across the market. NMDA urges the government to deliver practical licensing reforms that make legal riding more accessible for commuters and businesses. We will continue to liaise with government and industry partners on this issue as the Bill progresses.”
paras.zh: NMDA 运营主管西蒙·库克 (Symon Cook) 表示：“令人鼓舞的是，议会将重点放在供应安全、道路合法车辆和解决不合规销售的立法上。这表明朝着确保整个市场公平竞争迈出了积极的一步。NMDA 敦促政府进行切实可行的许可改革，使通勤者和企业更容易合法乘车。随着法案的进展，我们将继续就这一问题与政府和行业合作伙伴保持联系。”

articles.title: Autoglass appoints John Coombs as head of commercial B2B
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Autoglass appoints John Coombs as head of commercial B2B
paras.zh: Autoglass 任命 John Coombs 为商业 B2B 主管

paras.en: Autoglass has appointed John Coombs as its new head of commercial B2B as the vehicle glass repair and replacement specialist seeks to expand its footprint across the UK fleet, leasing, and rental markets.
paras.zh: Autoglass 任命约翰·库姆斯 (John Coombs) 为其新的商业 B2B 主管，这家汽车玻璃维修和更换专家寻求扩大其在英国车队、租赁和租赁市场的足迹。

paras.en: Coombs, who has spent more than 13 years with Autoglass and over two decades in the fleet and leasing industries, moves into the role from his previous position as head of commercial growth and innovation. He will oversee the company’s wider B2B strategy while continuing to spearhead the nationwide rollout of Mobile Recalibration Pro (MRP), a mobile advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) recalibration service he previously piloted.
paras.zh: 库姆斯在 Autoglass 工作了 13 年多，并在车队和租赁行业工作了 20 多年，他从之前的商业增长和创新主管职位调到了这一职位。他将监督公司更广泛的 B2B 战略，同时继续带头在全国范围内推出 Mobile Recalibration Pro (MRP)，这是他之前试点的移动高级驾驶员辅助系统 (ADAS) 重新校准服务。

paras.en: Ian Rowlands, sales and marketing director at Autoglass, commented: “Throughout his time with the business, John has consistently demonstrated an ability to identify new opportunities, build strong relationships and challenge us to think differently about how we support our customers. His passion for innovation and commitment to delivering for our clients are real strengths as he takes on this role.”
paras.zh: Autoglass 销售和营销总监伊恩·罗兰兹 (Ian Rowlands) 评论道：“约翰在公司任职期间，一直表现出发现新机会、建立牢固关系并挑战我们以不同方式思考如何支持客户的能力。他对创新的热情和为客户提供服务的承诺是他担任这一职位的真正优势。”

paras.en: Coombs said of his new role: “This is a tremendously exciting time to be taking on this new challenge. Autoglass has a clear reputation for delivering a premium service that ensures businesses can operate as efficiently as possible. We are also focused on innovation with a purpose, demonstrated by MRP, which is already making a significant difference to the operational efficiencies of a number of customers.
paras.zh: 库姆斯在谈到他的新角色时表示：“面对这一新挑战，这是一个非常激动人心的时刻。Autoglass 在提供优质服务方面享有盛誉，确保企业尽可能高效地运营。我们还专注于有目的的创新，MRP 就证明了这一点，它已经对许多客户的运营效率产生了重大影响。

paras.en: “I am very much looking forward to working with my colleagues across the Autoglass business to continue to develop fit-for-purpose service and solutions that go to the heart of our customers’ needs.”
paras.zh: “我非常期待与汽车玻璃业务部门的同事合作，继续开发适合客户需求的服务和解决方案。”

articles.title: Oklahoma’s New 70% Salvage Threshold Raises Concerns About Hail-Damage Total-Loss Settlements
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Oklahoma vehicle owners whose automobiles have been declared total losses may have more to consider than whether their vehicles can be safely repaired. Even when an insurance company’s decision to total a vehicle is justified, inaccurate valuations or excessive salvage deductions can leave consumers with less money than they deserve.
