paras.zh: “这有点像一个过滤器，”卡尔在描述他的旧视经历时说道。 “它决定了一种风格，然后这种风格适用于我现实中的每个人，包括我自己。”卡尔说，这些过滤器可能会在一天内或持续几周内发生变化。他甚至经历过眼睛特征与梦中所见面孔的互换。 “然后这也适用于我，照镜子，然后是其他人。”

paras.en: Karl also experiences echoes of environments, he says. For instance, if he has visited an area with lots of potholes in the roads, visual echoes of those potholes can appear in a newer road. A similar thing can happen with shapes, he says: Echoes of square hallways or stairwells can appear in new spots.
paras.zh: 卡尔还体验到了环境的回声，他说。例如，如果他访问过一个道路上有很多坑洼的地区，这些坑洼的视觉回声可能会出现在较新的道路上。他说，类似的事情也可能发生在形状上：方形走廊或楼梯间的回声可能会出现在新的地方。

paras.en: Using AI and collaboration to help re-create what Karl sees is an advance, Blom says. And this sort of collaboration between scientist and volunteer is crucial. “In my line of work, clinical psychiatry, we know that everything stands and falls with the descriptions that our patients give us,” he says. “In my opinion, this is patient participation at its best.”
paras.zh: 布洛姆说，利用人工智能和协作来帮助重建卡尔所看到的东西是一种进步。科学家和志愿者之间的这种合作至关重要。 “在我的临床精神病学工作中，我们知道一切的成败都取决于患者向我们提供的描述，”他说。 “在我看来，这是最好的患者参与。”

articles.title: A Billion Years of History Vanished Into Nothing. We Finally Know Why.
articles.author: Michael Irving

paras.en: Earth keeps a pretty detailed journal of its history, written in rock. But in some areas, up to a billion years of that story are missing.
paras.zh: 地球用岩石写下了一份非常详细的历史日记。但在某些地区，长达十亿年的故事却缺失了。

paras.en: The mystery, which has been dubbed the "Great Unconformity", has puzzled geologists for over a century, but a new study could help explain where those layers disappeared to.
paras.zh: 这个被称为“大不整合面”的谜团让地质学家困惑了一个多世纪，但一项新的研究可能有助于解释这些地层消失的位置。

paras.en: "Imagine a book where a huge section in the middle has been ripped out," says Santosh Dhungana, environmental futures scientist at the University of Wollongong (UOW) in Australia.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚卧龙岗大学 (UOW) 环境未来科学家桑托什·杜加纳 (Santosh Dhungana) 表示：“想象一下，一本书的中间很大一部分被撕掉了。”

paras.en: "The Great Unconformity is that gap in Earth's story, with the narrative jumping from the early chapters straight to a much later part of the story. Our research suggests these pages weren't lost by chance."
paras.zh: “大不整合是地球故事中的一个空白，叙述从早期章节直接跳到故事的后期部分。我们的研究表明这些页面并不是偶然丢失的。”

paras.en: The story of Earth is read from the inside out. New layers of rock are laid down on top of existing ones, so the deeper layers are generally older than those higher up in a vertical stack.
paras.zh: 地球的故事是从内到外阅读的。新的岩石层铺设在现有岩石层的顶部，因此较深层的岩石通常比垂直堆叠中较高的岩石层更古老。

paras.en: If you know what you're looking for, you can read almost the entire history of the planet from these layers.
paras.zh: 如果您知道自己在寻找什么，则可以从这些层中阅读几乎整个地球的历史。

paras.en: You can see when different forms of life emerged and died out. When a region was a desert or deep beneath the sea. When the climate was warm and humid, or cold and dry.
paras.zh: 你可以看到不同形式的生命何时出现和消亡。当一个地区是沙漠或深海时。当气候温暖潮湿或寒冷干燥时。

paras.en: The record is even punctuated by the occasional disaster, such as volcanic eruptions and asteroid impacts.
paras.zh: 这一记录甚至偶尔会出现一些灾难，例如火山爆发和小行星撞击。

paras.en: But sometimes the most intriguing part of a story is what's left out.
paras.zh: 但有时故事中最有趣的部分就是被遗漏的部分。

paras.en: The missing chapters were first noticed in the 1870s, when geologists exploring the Grand Canyon in the United States noticed that large sections didn't 'conform' to the expected order of layers.
paras.zh: 缺失的章节首次被注意到是在 1870 年代，当时地质学家在美国探索大峡谷时注意到大片区域不“符合”预期的层序。

paras.en: They noticed that vast swathes of rock, dating back a few hundred million years, were resting directly on top of layers that were roughly 2 billion years old. That means roughly 1.2 billion years of history was missing from the story.
paras.zh: 他们注意到，大片的岩石可以追溯到几亿年前，直接位于大约有 20 亿年历史的地层之上。这意味着这个故事缺失了大约 12 亿年的历史。

paras.en: Weirder still, those missing layers were indeed present in some parts of the canyon, which only made their absence more conspicuous in others.
paras.zh: 更奇怪的是，这些缺失的层确实存在于峡谷的某些部分，这只会让它们的缺失在其他部分更加明显。

paras.en: The 19th-century team named this abnormality the Great Unconformity, and similar gaps have since been discovered in the geological record around the world.
paras.zh: 19 世纪的研究小组将这种异常现象命名为“大不整合”，此后在世界各地的地质记录中都发现了类似的缺口。

paras.en: Erosion seemed to be at play, but exactly how it happened remained unclear.
paras.zh: 侵蚀似乎在起作用，但具体是如何发生的仍不清楚。

paras.en: Now, geologists at UOW in Australia have tested key theories with supercomputers, and come up with a model that helps explain those missing millions of years.
paras.zh: 现在，澳大利亚伍伦贡大学的地质学家已经用超级计算机测试了关键理论，并提出了一个模型来帮助解释那些失踪了数百万年的现象。

paras.en: The key, it seems, lies deep within the planet.
paras.zh: 钥匙似乎位于地球深处。

paras.en: Earth's crust is essentially floating on top of the much-squishier mantle. Not only does material in the mantle flow horizontally, but differences in temperature and texture cause bubbles of the stuff to move up and down like a giant lava lamp – which push and pull on the crust above.
paras.zh: 地壳本质上是漂浮在更加柔软的地幔之上。地幔中的物质不仅水平流动，温度和质地的差异也会导致物质的气泡像巨大的熔岩灯一样上下移动，从而推动和拉动上面的地壳。

paras.en: Using the supercomputer Gadi, the researchers modeled the convection of the mantle over eons, seeing how that affected continents on Earth's surface.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用超级计算机加迪（Gadi）模拟了亿万年来地幔的对流，看看它如何影响地球表面的大陆。

paras.en: The simulations suggested that during the Neoproterozoic Era – which lasted from 1 billion to around 540 million years ago – movements in the mantle raised several continents upwards. After that, mantle convection caused these continents to begin sinking again.
paras.zh: 模拟表明，在新元古代——从 10 亿年前持续到大约 5.4 亿年前——地幔的运动使几块大陆向上抬升。之后，地幔对流导致这些大陆再次开始下沉。

paras.en: That movement works to explain the Great Unconformity. The raised rock was exposed to the elements – and around 720 million years ago, the elements were working overtime to erode surfaces.
paras.zh: 该运动旨在解释大不整合现象。凸起的岩石暴露在自然环境中——大约 7.2 亿年前，这些自然元素加班加点地侵蚀着表面。

paras.en: "Importantly, the uplift predicted by our models coincided with the Snowball Earth period," the researchers write in an article in The Conversation.
paras.zh: 研究人员在《对话》杂志上的一篇文章中写道：“重要的是，我们的模型预测的隆起恰逢雪球地球时期。”

paras.en: "During this period, enormous ice sheets scraped over the surface of continents for tens of millions of years. Glaciers and ice sheets are more efficient than rivers at eroding continents, even on gentle slopes. The ice sheets would have slowly slid downhill across the uplifted continents, eroding away everything in their path."
paras.zh: “在此期间，巨大的冰盖在大陆表面刮擦了数千万年。冰川和冰盖比河流更有效地侵蚀大陆，即使是在缓坡上。冰盖会慢慢地滑下山坡，穿过隆起的大陆，侵蚀其路径上的一切。”

paras.en: After the glaciers had erased hundreds of millions of years from the rocky record, the continents began to sink, allowing new sediments to be laid over the top.
paras.zh: 在冰川从岩石记录中抹去数亿年之后，大陆开始下沉，使得新的沉积物沉积在顶部。

paras.en: The smoking gun, however, is that the model suggested three ancient continents – Laurentia, Baltica, and North China – would be most affected by this process. Tellingly, the Great Unconformity is clearly seen today in the geology of these regions: North America, northeastern Europe, and northern China.
paras.zh: 然而，确凿的证据是，该模型表明三个古代大陆——劳伦西亚、波罗的海和华北——将受到这一过程的影响最大。引人注目的是，今天在这些地区的地质中可以清楚地看到大不整合面：北美、东北欧和中国北部。

paras.en: The model predicted that other continents, like Australia and South America, went through this up-and-down motion twice, which isn't the right recipe for forming and preserving the Great Unconformity. And sure enough, there's little evidence of the Great Unconformity in these regions.
paras.zh: 该模型预测其他大陆，如澳大利亚和南美洲，会经历两次这种上下运动，这并不是形成和保存大不整合面的正确方法。果然，这些地区几乎没有大不整合的证据。

paras.en: "Sometimes what is missing can tell us more about the story of Earth than what we can see. A single, long period of uplift followed by a long period of sinking would have been the ideal recipe for removing the rock and preserving the worn surface," says Nicolas Flament, a geoscientist at UOW.
paras.zh: 伍伦贡大学地球科学家尼古拉斯·弗拉门特（Nicolas Flament）表示：“有时，缺失的东西可以告诉我们更多关于地球的故事，而不是我们所看到的。一次长期的隆起，然后是长期的下沉，可能是去除岩石和保留磨损表面的理想方法。”

paras.en: Erosion has been the favored explanation since the anomaly was first discovered in the 19th century, but now we may have a better understanding of the specifics.
paras.zh: 自 19 世纪首次发现这种异常现象以来，侵蚀一直是人们所青睐的解释，但现在我们可能对具体细节有了更好的了解。

paras.en: "Many explanations for the Great Unconformity had been proposed but few had been tested against how the Earth actually behaves over time," says Flament.
paras.zh: 弗拉门特说：“人们对大不整合提出了许多解释，但很少有人针对地球随时间的实际变化进行过检验。”

paras.en: "It is a thrill to be able to propose a solution to this geological puzzle."
paras.zh: “能够为这个地质难题提出解决方案真是令人兴奋。”

paras.en: The research was published in the journal Nature.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《自然》杂志上。

articles.title: DNA From Beethoven's Hair Has Revealed a Surprise 200 Years Later
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: In 1802, the famous German composer Ludwig van Beethoven wrote a desperate letter to his brothers that he never sent.
paras.zh: 1802年，德国著名作曲家路德维希·范·贝多芬给他的兄弟们写了一封绝望的信，但他从未寄出。

paras.en: In his short life, the famous musician suffered from chronic illness, hearing loss, and severe gastrointestinal and liver problems.
paras.zh: 在他短暂的一生中，这位著名音乐家患有慢性疾病、听力丧失以及严重的胃肠道和肝脏问题。

paras.en: His state of health, Beethoven wrote at the age of 31, was "hopeless" and he feared "the prospect of a lasting malady."
paras.zh: 贝多芬在 31 岁时写道，他的健康状况“毫无希望”，他担心“可能会患上持久的疾病”。

paras.en: "As soon as I am dead," he beseeched his brothers, "if Dr. Schmid is still alive ask him in my name to describe my malady and attach this document to the history of my illness so that so far as possible at least the world may become reconciled with me after my death."
paras.zh: “我死后，”他恳求他的兄弟们，“如果施密德医生还活着，请他以我的名义描述我的疾病，并将这份文件附在我的病史中，以便至少在我死后世界能够尽可能地与我和解。”

paras.en: Now, 200 years later, Beethoven is finally getting his wish.
paras.zh: 200年后的今天，贝多芬终于如愿以偿。

paras.en: The exact cause of his death in 1827 is still unknown, but scientists have now found evidence that hepatitis B and lead poisoning might have played a role in his afflictions.
paras.zh: 他于 1827 年去世的确切原因仍不得而知，但科学家现已发现证据表明乙型肝炎和铅中毒可能是导致他患病的原因之一。

paras.en: During his life, Beethoven gave some of his friends cuts of his hair, and after his death, many more samples were collected from his head and preserved by acquaintances, scholars, collectors, and museums.
paras.zh: 贝多芬生前曾给他的一些朋友剪过自己的头发，在他去世后，人们从他的头上收集了更多的样本，并由熟人、学者、收藏家和博物馆保存下来。

paras.en: Several of these precious locks are now being analyzed by researchers to better understand the composer's health way back in the 19th century.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在正在对其中几把珍贵的锁进行分析，以更好地了解这位作曲家早在 19 世纪时的健康状况。

paras.en: In 2023, genomic sequencing revealed that some of these locks did not come from Beethoven's head after all.
paras.zh: 2023年，基因组测序显示，其中一些锁根本不是来自贝多芬的头部。

paras.en: But others likely did, and those samples suggest that the composer's death may have been partly caused by a hepatitis B infection.
paras.zh: 但其他人可能也这么做了，这些样本表明作曲家的死亡可能部分是由乙型肝炎感染引起的。

paras.en: Heavy alcohol consumption may have also exacerbated damage to his liver.
paras.zh: 大量饮酒也可能加剧了他的肝脏损伤。

paras.en: "We cannot say definitely what killed Beethoven," biochemist Johannes Krause from the Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology explained in a press statement in 2023.
paras.zh: 马克斯·普朗克进化人类学研究所的生物化学家约翰内斯·克劳斯在 2023 年的一份新闻声明中解释说：“我们无法确切地说是什么杀死了贝多芬。”

paras.en: "But we can now at least confirm the presence of significant heritable risk, and an infection with hepatitis B virus.
paras.zh: “但我们现在至少可以确认存在重大遗传风险以及乙型肝炎病毒感染。

paras.en: "We can also eliminate several other less plausible genetic causes."
paras.zh: “我们还可以消除其他几种不太合理的遗传原因。”

paras.en: These findings, published in Current Biology, were enlightening.
paras.zh: 这些发表在《当代生物学》上的研究结果具有启发性。

paras.en: But they still could not explain the causes of Beethoven's hearing loss or his gastrointestinal issues.
paras.zh: 但他们仍然无法解释贝多芬听力损失或肠胃问题的原因。

paras.en: The next year, in 2024, another team of researchers found a second explanation.
paras.zh: 第二年，即 2024 年，另一组研究人员发现了第二种解释。

paras.en: They discovered signs of lead poisoning in two bundles of Beethoven's hair, one of which is historically determined to have come straight from the musician's head.
paras.zh: 他们在贝多芬的两束头发中发现了铅中毒的迹象，历史上确定其中一束头发直接来自这位音乐家的头部。

paras.en: That sample contained a lead concentration 95 times greater than the reference range. It also had high levels of arsenic and mercury.
paras.zh: 该样品的铅浓度比参考范围高出 95 倍。它还含有大量的砷和汞。

paras.en: The study was led by Nader Rifai of Harvard Medical School, with researchers from the Mayo Clinic and Beethoven specialists, and the findings were published in Clinical Chemistry in 2024.
paras.zh: 该研究由哈佛医学院的 Nader Rifai 领导，与梅奥诊所的研究人员和贝多芬专家一起，研究结果发表在 2024 年的《临床化学》杂志上。

paras.en: The lead levels found in Beethoven's hair equate to a blood concentration of up to 71 micrograms per deciliter (µg/dL), the researchers say.
paras.zh: 研究人员称，贝多芬头发中的铅含量相当于血液浓度高达 71 微克每分升 (μg/dL)。

paras.en: That isn't enough to cause death, but it may have contributed to several of Beethoven's ailments.
paras.zh: 这还不足以导致死亡，但它可能导致了贝多芬的几种疾病。

paras.en: "Such lead levels are commonly associated with gastrointestinal and renal ailments and decreased hearing but are not considered high enough to be the sole cause of death," Rifai and colleagues wrote in a short letter to the editor.
paras.zh: “这样的铅水平通常与胃肠道和肾脏疾病以及听力下降有关，但并不被认为高到足以成为死亡的唯一原因，”里法伊和同事在给编辑的一封简短信中写道。

paras.en: The idea that Beethoven might have been exposed to dangerous levels of lead was first put forward at the turn of the century.
paras.zh: 贝多芬可能接触过危险水平的铅的想法最早是在世纪之交提出的。

paras.en: At the time, drinking vessels were often made of lead, and several medical treatments depended on this metal, without experts realizing its toxic effects.
paras.zh: 当时，饮水器皿通常由铅制成，多种医疗方法都依赖于这种金属，但专家们并没有意识到它的毒性作用。

paras.en: Decades later, however, researchers would find that the locks of Beethoven's hair that first revealed high levels of lead actually belonged to a woman – not the musician after all.
paras.zh: 然而几十年后，研究人员发现，贝多芬的头发中最先发现铅含量很高的一绺头发实际上属于一位女性，而不是这位音乐家。

paras.en: Now, we have better techniques to ensure the hairs we are examining actually belong to Beethoven.
paras.zh: 现在，我们有了更好的技术来确保我们正在检查的头发确实属于贝多芬。

paras.en: Using this evidence, a 2025 study hypothesized what would happen if Beethoven lived today, "with comparable health complaints, clinical symptoms, or test results".
paras.zh: 利用这一证据，一项 2025 年的研究假设了如果贝多芬生活在今天，“具有类似的健康主诉、临床症状或测试结果”，将会发生什么。

paras.en: What would a doctor say to this modern Mr B? And how would he be treated?
paras.zh: 医生会对这位现代的 B 先生说什么？他会受到怎样的待遇？

paras.en: If the physician ordered blood tests, researchers say that Beethoven's blood lead concentration would be roughly 17 times higher than that of 95 percent of adult men in Germany in 2019.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，如果医生要求进行血液检查，贝多芬的血铅浓度将比 2019 年德国 95% 成年男性的血铅浓度高出约 17 倍。

paras.en: To put those concentrations into clinical perspective, a modern physician might compare Beethoven's results to the German Human Biomonitoring Commission's values.
paras.zh: 为了将这些浓度纳入临床角度，现代医生可能会将贝多芬的结果与德国人类生物监测委员会的值进行比较。

paras.en: "This provides a medical orientation," the authors of the study explain.
paras.zh: “这提供了医学方向，”该研究的作者解释道。

paras.en: "In the case of Mr. B, his blood lead concentration would be 2.8 times the HBM-value II."
paras.zh: “就 B 先生而言，他的血铅浓度是 HBM 值 II 的 2.8 倍。”

paras.en: That means his risk of adverse health outcomes from lead is very high.
paras.zh: 这意味着铅对他的健康造成不良影响的风险非常高。

paras.en: "Empirically, exposure to lead at this level may contribute to or cause health problems," the authors conclude.
paras.zh: “根据经验，接触这个水平的铅可能会导致或导致健康问题，”作者总结道。

paras.en: They compare Beethoven's multiple diagnoses to the saying "a patient who has fleas may also have lice."
paras.zh: 他们将贝多芬的多次诊断与“有跳蚤的病人也可能有虱子”的说法进行了比较。

paras.en: His hearing loss and abdominal pain are not necessarily caused by one exposure alone.
paras.zh: 他的听力损失和腹痛不一定是单独一次接触造成的。

paras.en: Related: DNA From The Shroud of Turin Reveals a Surprise Centuries Later
paras.zh: 相关报道：几个世纪后，都灵裹尸布的 DNA 揭示了一个令人惊讶的事实

paras.en: While Beethoven might have been blessed with musical skill, he was cursed by poor health.
paras.zh: 虽然贝多芬可能拥有音乐天赋，但他却因健康状况不佳而受到诅咒。

paras.en: What he managed to achieve despite his maladies is truly impressive.
paras.zh: 尽管身患疾病，他所取得的成就确实令人印象深刻。

paras.en: In his 45 years of composing, Beethoven created more than 700 works.
paras.zh: 贝多芬在45年的作曲生涯中创作了700多部作品。

paras.en: "… to my art I owe the fact that I did not end my life with suicide," Beethoven wrote to his brothers.
paras.zh: “……由于我的艺术，我没有以自杀结束自己的生命，”贝多芬在给他的兄弟们的信中写道。

paras.en: "It seemed impossible to leave the world until I had produced all that I felt called upon me to produce, and so I endured this wretched existence…"
paras.zh: “在我完成所有我觉得需要我完成的事情之前，似乎不可能离开这个世界，所以我忍受了这种悲惨的存在……”

articles.title: Driving a Car May Exert a Hidden Effect on Your Heart, Study Reveals
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: Driving a car seems like the ultimate free ride.
paras.zh: 驾驶汽车似乎是终极的免费乘车。

paras.en: You sit in a stationary position while the vehicle does all the work, transporting your body at speeds your legs could never hope to reach.
paras.zh: 当车辆完成所有工作时，您坐在静止位置，以您的双腿永远无法达到的速度运送您的身体。

paras.en: What if driving demands more of us than we realized, and the inevitable stresses of driving exert a hidden strain on the body that we never knew about?
paras.zh: 如果驾驶对我们的要求超出了我们的想象，并且驾驶过程中不可避免的压力对我们的身体产生了一种我们从未意识到的隐藏压力，该怎么办？

paras.en: According to a new study in npj Digital Public Health, that might actually be happening.
paras.zh: 根据 npj Digital Public Health 的一项新研究，这种情况可能确实正在发生。

paras.en: "Driving requires continuous attention, decisions, and readiness to react," says computer scientist Ioannis Pavlidis from the University of Houston.
paras.zh: 休斯顿大学的计算机科学家 Ioannis Pavlidis 表示：“驾驶需要持续的注意力、决策和反应准备。”

paras.en: "The body may be sitting, but the mind is working – and the heart reflects those demands."
paras.zh: “身体可能是坐着的，但头脑却在工作——而内心反映了这些需求。”

paras.en: In the study, Pavlidis and fellow researchers monitored 57 adult participants – 30 men and 27 women, with an average age of 26.2 years – over the course of one week.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，Pavlidis 和其他研究人员在一周的时间里对 57 名成年参与者进行了监测，其中包括 30 名男性和 27 名女性，平均年龄为 26.2 岁。

paras.en: During the week, each of the participants wore an Apple Watch, which recorded their heart rate, while their smartphones and a device installed in their car captured other information about their daily movements and activities from morning to evening.
paras.zh: 在这一周中，每个参与者都佩戴了一块 Apple Watch，记录他们的心率，而他们的智能手机和安装在汽车上的设备则捕获有关他们从早到晚的日常运动和活动的其他信息。

paras.en: All up, across almost 3,000 hours of observations, the participants racked up over 300 hours of driving in nearly 1,000 separate trips.
paras.zh: 总而言之，在近 3,000 小时的观察中，参与者在近 1,000 次单独的行程中累计了 300 多个小时的驾驶时间。

paras.en: In total, the participants spent 10.4 percent of the monitored time driving, and a small amount of time doing physical activity (3.2 percent). The majority of the recorded time was taken up by various forms of non-driving sedentary activity (86.4 percent).
paras.zh: 总体而言，参与者在监测时间中花费了 10.4% 的时间用于驾驶，还有少量时间用于体育活动 (3.2%)。记录的大部分时间被各种形式的非驾驶久坐活动占用（86.4%）。

paras.en: But while their activity time can be neatly drawn up and categorized, their heart data told a different story.
paras.zh: 但是，虽然他们的活动时间可以被整齐地绘制和分类，但他们的心脏数据却讲述了一个不同的故事。

paras.en: While participants' average heart rates were similar during driving and other sedentary activities, one pattern of their cardiac activity was markedly different.
paras.zh: 虽然参与者在驾驶和其他久坐活动期间的平均心率相似，但他们的一种心脏活动模式明显不同。

paras.en: During other sedentary activities, participants' heart rates remained above their resting baseline heart rate (an estimate of the participants' lowest heart rate during periods of rest) for 81 percent of the observed activity time.
paras.zh: 在其他久坐活动期间，参与者的心率在观察到的活动时间的 81% 内保持在其静息基线心率（参与者在休息期间的最低心率的估计值）之上。

paras.en: But during driving, that increased to 94 percent of the observed driving time.
paras.zh: 但在驾驶过程中，这一时间增加到观察到的驾驶时间的 94%。

paras.en: In other words, their heart rates remained elevated more consistently, with fewer instances of the heart slowing down to its resting rate.
paras.zh: 换句话说，他们的心率更加持续地保持在较高水平，心脏减慢至静息心率的情况较少。

paras.en: Participants' heart rates also fluctuated within a narrower range while they were driving, and returned to baseline roughly half as frequently, compared to other sedentary activities.
paras.zh: 与其他久坐活动相比，参与者在开车时心率波动范围也更窄，并且返回基线的频率大约是其他久坐活动的一半。

paras.en: These differences were observed on both weekdays and weekends, suggesting the phenomenon wasn't simply attributable to the different mix of activities people engage in during the working week.
paras.zh: 这些差异在工作日和周末都观察到，这表明这种现象不仅仅归因于人们在工作周期间从事的不同活动组合。

paras.en: "Driving occupies a distinct and persistent baseline-referenced cardiac operating regime," the researchers explain in their paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中解释说：“驾驶占据了一种独特且持久的基线参考心脏操作模式。”

paras.en: "The principal difference from non-driving sedentary behavior lies not in average activation magnitude, but in its temporal organization: driving-associated activation remains above baseline more continuously, fluctuates within a narrower range, and returns to baseline less often."
paras.zh: “与非驾驶久坐行为的主要区别不在于平均激活幅度，而在于其时间组织：与驾驶相关的激活更连续地保持在基线以上，在更窄的范围内波动，并且返回基线的频率更少。”

paras.en: But why do our heartbeats adopt this pattern when we're driving, and not at other times when we're sitting down?
paras.zh: 但为什么我们在开车时心跳会采用这种模式，而在其他时候坐下时却不会呢？

paras.en: It could be because the unique circumstances of driving necessitate a certain, constant level of awareness and control, and maintaining that effort and focus triggers physiological effects, which can be identified in our pulse.
paras.zh: 这可能是因为独特的驾驶环境需要一定的、持续的意识和控制水平，而保持这种努力和专注会引发生理效应，这可以在我们的脉搏中识别出来。

paras.en: "One plausible interpretation is that driving represents a more constrained behavioral regime, involving a comparatively coherent set of attentional, perceptual, and motor requirements and, in the present observational data, a more stable cardiac operating level once baseline was taken into account," the study authors write.
paras.zh: 研究作者写道：“一种合理的解释是，驾驶代表了一种更受限制的行为模式，涉及一组相对一致的注意力、知觉和运动要求，并且在目前的观察数据中，一旦考虑到基线，心脏运行水平就会更加稳定。”

paras.en: "Non-driving sedentary behavior, in contrast, aggregates a wider range of low-motion situations and therefore leaves more room for person-level and temporal factors to shape residual variation."
paras.zh: “相比之下，非驾驶久坐行为聚集了更广泛的低运动情况，因此为个人水平和时间因素留下了更多空间来塑造残余变化。”

paras.en: While there's no evidence in the research to suggest the consistently elevated heartbeats seen during driving are necessarily harmful, it remains a possibility that they are, the researchers say.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，虽然研究中没有证据表明驾驶过程中持续升高的心跳一定有害，但仍有可能有害。

paras.en: In ordinary circumstances – physical activity, for instance – an elevated heart rate is usually considered a positive sign, spurring a range of physiological adaptations that promote cardiorespiratory fitness.
paras.zh: 在普通情况下（例如体力活动），心率升高通常被认为是一个积极信号，会刺激一系列生理适应，促进心肺健康。

paras.en: But unless you're Fred Flintstone, driving is very different to going for a run.
paras.zh: 但除非你是弗莱德·弗林特斯通，否则开车和跑步是非常不同的。

paras.en: "When the heart works harder during exercise, that is generally a good thing," Pavlidis says.
paras.zh: “当心脏在运动过程中更加努力地工作时，这通常是一件好事，”帕夫利迪斯说。

paras.en: "But when it works harder while we are sitting behind the wheel, we get none of the benefits of exercise. And when this happens for prolonged periods, day after day, we must wonder about the long-term health consequences."
paras.zh: “但是，当我们坐在方向盘后面更努力地工作时，我们就无法享受到锻炼的好处。当这种情况日复一日地长时间发生时，我们必须考虑长期的健康后果。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in npj Digital Public Health.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《npj Digital Public Health》上。

articles.title: Harvard’s tiny UV light chip could help shrink quantum computers

paras.en: Harvardâs tiny UV light chip could help shrink quantum computers
paras.zh: 哈佛大学的微型紫外线芯片可以帮助缩小量子计算机的尺寸

paras.en: Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences
paras.zh: 哈佛大学约翰·A·保尔森工程与应用科学学院

paras.en: Harvard-led researchers have developed a microscopic device that generates 120 times more ultraviolet light than previous comparable approaches by efficiently converting red light into UV. The breakthrough could unlock smaller quantum computers, ultra-precise atomic clocks, and compact environmental sensors.
paras.zh: 哈佛大学领导的研究人员开发了一种微型装置，通过有效地将红光转换为紫外线，产生的紫外线比以前的同类方法多 120 倍。这一突破可以解锁更小的量子计算机、超精密原子钟和紧凑的环境传感器。

paras.en: Ultraviolet (UV) light is already essential to a wide range of modern technologies. Beyond its natural presence in sunlight, it is used to disinfect surfaces, make biological materials fluoresce, and manufacture computer chips through a process called photolithography. In the future, microscopic sources of UV light built directly into photonic chips could enable smaller quantum computers, ultra-precise atomic clocks, and other advanced technologies.
paras.zh: 紫外线 (UV) 光对于许多现代技术来说已经是必不可少的。除了在阳光下自然存在之外，它还用于消毒表面、使生物材料发出荧光，以及通过光刻工艺制造计算机芯片。未来，直接内置于光子芯片中的微观紫外光源可以实现更小的量子计算机、超精密原子钟和其他先进技术。

paras.en: However, shrinking UV light sources to fit on a chip has presented a significant engineering challenge. Ultraviolet light rapidly loses power as it travels through optical waveguides, the tiny channels that carry light across a chip. This limitation has made it extremely difficult to develop compact UV sources with enough power for practical applications.
paras.zh: 然而，缩小紫外光源以适应芯片已经提出了重大的工程挑战。紫外线在穿过光波导（携带光穿过芯片的微小通道）时会迅速失去能量。这种限制使得开发具有足够功率用于实际应用的紧凑型紫外线源变得极其困难。

paras.en: Now, a Harvard-led research team has demonstrated a microscopic photonic device that produces approximately 120 times more UV power than previous comparable devices. The researchers, working in the laboratory of Marko Lončar, the Tiantsai Lin Professor of Electrical Engineering, achieved the breakthrough using a widely studied material called thin-film lithium niobate.
paras.zh: 现在，哈佛大学领导的研究小组展示了一种微型光子装置，其产生的紫外线功率比以前的同类装置高出约 120 倍。在林天赛电气工程教授 Marko Lončar 实验室工作的研究人员利用一种被广泛研究的薄膜铌酸锂材料实现了这一突破。

paras.en: Published in Nature Communications, the findings establish lithium niobate as a promising platform for generating powerful ultraviolet light in compact devices while minimizing optical losses.
paras.zh: 该研究结果发表在《自然通讯》上，表明铌酸锂是一种有前途的平台，可以在紧凑型设备中产生强大的紫外线，同时最大限度地减少光学损失。

paras.en: Turning Red Light Into Ultraviolet Light
paras.zh: 将红光变成紫外线

paras.en: Rather than trying to deliver ultraviolet light directly through microscopic channels, the researchers designed a device that generates UV light from red light within the chip itself.
paras.zh: 研究人员并没有尝试直接通过微观通道传递紫外线，而是设计了一种可以从芯片本身内部的红光产生紫外线的装置。

paras.en: The approach relies on a process known as frequency upconversion. Inside the lithium niobate crystal, two photons of red light combine to produce a single ultraviolet photon with higher energy. Lithium niobate is particularly well suited to this process because of its exceptional ability to convert light from one frequency to another.
paras.zh: 该方法依赖于称为上变频的过程。在铌酸锂晶体内部，两个红光光子结合产生一个具有更高能量的紫外光子。铌酸锂特别适合这一过程，因为它具有将光从一种频率转换为另一种频率的卓越能力。

paras.en: "Our group is perhaps best known for utilizing lithium niobate for photonic devices that operate at longer, infrared wavelengths -- closer to the realm of telecommunications signals," Lončar said.
paras.zh: “我们的团队最出名的可能是利用铌酸锂制造在更长的红外波长下运行的光子器件——更接近电信信号领域，”Lončar 说。

paras.en: However, the team found that this transparent crystalline material, which has become increasingly important in integrated photonics, can also support light sources and guide light at much shorter wavelengths, including those in the ultraviolet range.
paras.zh: 然而，研究小组发现，这种在集成光子学中变得越来越重要的透明晶体材料还可以支持光源并引导更短波长的光，包括紫外线范围内的光。

paras.en: "When people think about [thin-film lithium niobate], they don't think of it as a UV material, but we show that it is," said co-first author Kees Franken, former research fellow in the Lončar lab. "We also show that there are some other nonlinear effects happening that we don't fully understand yet."
paras.zh: “当人们想到[薄膜铌酸锂]时，他们并不认为它是一种紫外线材料，但我们证明它是，”共同第一作者、Lončar 实验室前研究员 Kees Franken 说。 “我们还表明，还存在一些我们尚未完全理解的其他非线性效应。”

paras.en: A New Technique Overcomes a Major Engineering Barrier
paras.zh: 新技术克服了主要的工程障碍

paras.en: The device uses optical waveguides, microscopic channels etched into the lithium niobate film that direct light through the chip in much the same way electrical wires carry current.
paras.zh: 该设备使用光波导，即蚀刻在铌酸锂薄膜中的微观通道，引导光线穿过芯片，就像电线传输电流一样。

paras.en: For red light to be efficiently converted into ultraviolet light, the orientation of regions within the crystal must be repeatedly reversed at precisely controlled intervals along the waveguide. This manufacturing process, called poling, is a specialized technique used in nonlinear optics.
paras.zh: 为了将红光有效地转换为紫外光，晶体内区域的方向必须沿着波导以精确控制的间隔重复反转。这种制造过程称为极化，是非线性光学中使用的一种专门技术。

paras.en: One of the biggest challenges has been creating these patterns with accuracy at scales smaller than a micrometer across devices that extend for centimeters.
paras.zh: 最大的挑战之一是在延伸至厘米的设备上以小于微米的精度创建这些图案。

paras.en: Previous manufacturing methods required researchers to make an undesirable compromise. Poling the entire film before forming the waveguides made it difficult to correct manufacturing imperfections. Alternatively, creating the waveguides first reduced conversion efficiency because the electrodes were positioned too far away, allowing only part of the film to be successfully poled.
paras.zh: 以前的制造方法需要研究人员做出不受欢迎的妥协。在形成波导之前对整个薄膜进行极化使得纠正制造缺陷变得困难。另外，创建波导首先会降低转换效率，因为电极的位置太远，仅允许部分薄膜成功极化。

paras.en: To eliminate this tradeoff, the Harvard team developed a technique they call "sidewall poling."
paras.zh: 为了消除这种权衡，哈佛团队开发了一种他们称之为“侧壁极化”的技术。

paras.en: Precision Engineering Dramatically Improves Light Conversion
paras.zh: 精密工程极大地提高了光转换

paras.en: Instead of positioning the electrodes exclusively above the lithium niobate film, the researchers placed precisely patterned metal structures resembling tiny fingers directly alongside the etched waveguide. During fabrication, they applied a small voltage to permanently reverse the orientation of the crystal domains in a carefully controlled pattern.
paras.zh: 研究人员没有将电极专门放置在铌酸锂薄膜上方，而是将类似小手指的精确图案金属结构直接放置在蚀刻波导旁边。在制造过程中，他们施加了一个小电压，以仔细控制的模式永久反转晶域的方向。

paras.en: "The key idea was: could we just put the electrodes directly on the waveguide?" said co-first author and former graduate student Soumya Ghosh. "It's a high-precision fabrication process to position the electrodes but requiring about 50-nanometer accuracy."
paras.zh: “关键想法是：我们可以将电极直接放在波导上吗？”共同第一作者、前研究生 Soumya Ghosh 说。 “这是一种定位电极的高精度制造工艺，但需要大约 50 纳米的精度。”

paras.en: This arrangement enabled the researchers to reverse the crystal domains throughout the entire cross section of the waveguide, allowing light traveling through the material to undergo much more efficient frequency conversion.
paras.zh: 这种布置使研究人员能够反转波导整个横截面的晶域，从而使穿过材料的光能够进行更有效的频率转换。

paras.en: The team could also fine-tune the spacing of the reversed crystal regions along the device. By incorporating existing "adapted poling" techniques previously developed in Lončar's laboratory and elsewhere, the researchers compensated for variations in the thickness of the lithium niobate film and the shape of the waveguide.
paras.zh: 该团队还可以微调器件上反向晶体区域的间距。通过结合先前在 Lončar 实验室和其他地方开发的现有“自适应极化”技术，研究人员补偿了铌酸锂薄膜厚度和波导形状的变化。

paras.en: A 120-Fold Increase in Ultraviolet Power
paras.zh: 紫外线功率增加 120 倍

paras.en: The resulting device generated 4.2 milliwatts of ultraviolet power directly on the chip at a wavelength of 390 nanometers. That represents approximately 120 times the output power achieved by the best previous thin-film lithium niobate devices operating in this wavelength range.
paras.zh: 由此产生的设备直接在芯片上产生 4.2 毫瓦波长为 390 纳米的紫外线功率。这相当于之前在此波长范围内工作的最佳薄膜铌酸锂器件所实现的输出功率的大约 120 倍。

paras.en: Earlier experiments using the material generated only tens of microwatts of UV power. Although those results demonstrated that the approach was scientifically feasible, the output was too low to support practical applications.
paras.zh: 早期使用该材料的实验仅产生数十微瓦的紫外线功率。尽管这些结果表明该方法在科学上是可行的，但产出太低，无法支持实际应用。

paras.en: The substantial increase in power could be particularly valuable for trapped-ion quantum computers. These machines use electrically charged atoms to store and process quantum information. Many of the specific atomic energy transitions required to operate them involve light in the near-ultraviolet portion of the spectrum.
paras.zh: 功率的大幅增加对于俘获离子量子计算机尤其有价值。这些机器使用带电原子来存储和处理量子信息。操作它们所需的许多特定原子能量跃迁涉及光谱近紫外部分的光。

paras.en: "If you want a scalable quantum computer that isn't the size of a truck, you need to scale everything down to the chip level, and this includes the light sources," Franken said.
paras.zh: 弗兰肯说：“如果你想要一台不是卡车大小的可扩展量子计算机，你需要将所有东西缩小到芯片级别，这包括光源。”

paras.en: The technology could also benefit ultra-precise atomic clocks and environmental monitoring systems. According to the researchers, the same range of ultraviolet wavelengths is well suited to compact sensors designed to closely monitor greenhouse gases and other atmospheric pollutants.
paras.zh: 该技术还可以使超精密原子钟和环境监测系统受益。研究人员表示，相同范围的紫外线波长非常适合用于密切监测温室气体和其他大气污染物的紧凑型传感器。

paras.en: Franken and Ghosh attribute the breakthrough partly to the collaborative structure of Lončar's laboratory, where researchers carry out every stage of device development in one place, including theoretical research, engineering design, cleanroom fabrication, and optical testing.
paras.zh: Franken 和 Ghosh 将这一突破部分归功于 Lončar 实验室的协作结构，研究人员在一个地方进行器件开发的每个阶段，包括理论研究、工程设计、洁净室制造和光学测试。

paras.en: "The hands-on intuition that we gained for how to make a device, while also keeping the zoomed-out view of what this device is for, and how we were going to characterize it -- that's a big part of what enabled this project for us," Ghosh said.
paras.zh: “我们在如何制造设备方面获得了亲身实践的直觉，同时也保持了对该设备用途的放大视图，以及我们将如何描述它的特征——这是我们促成这个项目的一个重要部分，”戈什说。

paras.en: "Milliwatt-level UV generation using sidewall poled lithium niobate" was further co-authored by C.C. Rodrigues, J. Yang, C.J. Xin, S. Lu, D. Witt, G. Joe, G.S. Wiederhecker, and K.-J. Boller.
paras.zh: “使用侧壁极化铌酸锂产生毫瓦级紫外线”进一步由 C.C. 共同撰写。 Rodrigues、J. Yang、C.J. Xin、S. Lu、D. Witt、G. Joe、G.S. Wiederhecker 和 K.-J.博勒。

paras.en: U.S. federal funding for the project came from the following sources: Department of the Air Force grant No. FA9453-23-C-A039; Office of Naval Research grant No. N00014-22-C-1041/VAS-21-0001; NASA grant No. 80NSSC22K0262 and 80NSSC23PB442; and National Science Foundation grants ERC EEC-1941583 and OMA-2137723.

articles.title: Scientists identify two ages when children may be most vulnerable to screen time

paras.en: Scientists identify two ages when children may be most vulnerable to screen time
paras.zh: 科学家确定了孩子最容易受到屏幕时间影响的两个年龄段

paras.en: Scientists have identified two potentially critical periods when screen time may be especially detrimental to children's learning and memory: infancy and the start of formal schooling. Greater screen exposure during these developmental windows was linked to poorer academic performance and weaker working memory years later.
paras.zh: 科学家们发现了两个潜在的关键时期：婴儿期和正规学校教育的开始，屏幕时间可能对儿童的学习和记忆特别不利。在这些发育窗口期间接触更多的屏幕与几年后较差的学习成绩和较弱的工作记忆有关。

paras.en: Screen time at certain ages may be more closely tied to children's future learning and memory than previously recognized. A new study tracking children from age 1 to 8 found that those who spent more time watching screens during infancy and around the start of elementary school tended to perform worse academically at age 9 and have weaker working memory at age 10.5.
paras.zh: 某些年龄段的屏幕时间可能与儿童未来的学习和记忆的关系比以前认识的更为密切。一项跟踪 1 至 8 岁儿童的新研究发现，那些在婴儿期和小学开始时花更多时间看屏幕的儿童往往在 9 岁时学业表现较差，并且在 10.5 岁时工作记忆力较弱。

paras.en: The findings suggest that when children use screens may be just as important as how much time they spend in front of them. Two ages in particular, 1 and 6, emerged as potentially sensitive periods in childhood development.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，孩子何时使用屏幕可能与他们在屏幕前花费的时间一样重要。尤其是 1 岁和 6 岁这两个年龄阶段，是儿童发展的潜在敏感期。

paras.en: As digital devices become an increasingly common part of childhood, understanding their potential long-term effects has become a growing priority. Recommendations from the World Health Organization (WHO) and the American Academy of Pediatrics generally emphasize avoiding screen exposure during the first 18 to 24 months of life and limiting it to less than one hour a day for children ages 2 to 5. However, many young children spend considerably more time using screens.
paras.zh: 随着数字设备成为儿童生活中越来越常见的一部分，了解其潜在的长期影响已成为越来越重要的优先事项。世界卫生组织 (WHO) 和美国儿科学会的建议普遍强调，在生命的前 18 至 24 个月内避免接触屏幕，并将 2 至 5 岁的儿童每天接触屏幕的时间限制在不到一小时。然而，许多幼儿使用屏幕的时间要多得多。

paras.en: Tracking Screen Time Throughout Childhood
paras.zh: 追踪整个童年的屏幕时间

paras.en: Despite growing concerns about children's digital habits, previous research has produced mixed findings about the relationship between screen time and cognitive development. Many earlier studies examined children at a single point in time, concentrated on children already attending school, or did not regularly track screen habits throughout early childhood.
paras.zh: 尽管人们越来越担心儿童的数字习惯，但之前的研究对屏幕时间与认知发展之间的关系得出了不同的结论。许多早期的研究在单个时间点对儿童进行了检查，集中于已经上学的儿童，或者没有定期跟踪整个幼儿期的屏幕习惯。

paras.en: Following the same children over several years allows researchers to investigate whether screen exposure at particular ages is more strongly associated with later outcomes. This approach can also help researchers better account for the influence of family circumstances and environmental factors.
paras.zh: 研究人员对同一个孩子进行了数年的追踪，以调查特定年龄的屏幕暴露是否与以后的结果有更密切的相关性。这种方法还可以帮助研究人员更好地解释家庭情况和环境因素的影响。

paras.en: Scientists from Inserm and the National University of Singapore addressed these gaps in a study published in the World Journal of Pediatrics. The researchers examined data from 502 children participating in the Growing Up in Singapore Towards healthy Outcomes (GUSTO) birth cohort.
paras.zh: 来自 Inserm 和新加坡国立大学的科学家在《世界儿科杂志》上发表的一项研究中解决了这些差距。研究人员检查了参与新加坡健康成长 (GUSTO) 出生队列的 502 名儿童的数据。

paras.en: Parents reported their children's screen viewing habits at six different points between infancy and middle childhood. The researchers then evaluated the children's academic achievement and working memory several years later.
paras.zh: 父母报告了孩子在婴儿期和童年中期六个不同时期的屏幕观看习惯。几年后，研究人员评估了孩子们的学业成绩和工作记忆。

paras.en: Working memory is the brain's ability to temporarily hold and manipulate information. It plays an essential role in everyday learning, allowing children to follow instructions, solve math problems, understand sentences, and keep track of information while completing tasks.
paras.zh: 工作记忆是大脑暂时保存和操纵信息的能力。它在日常学习中发挥着重要作用，让孩子们能够在完成任务的同时遵循指示、解决数学问题、理解句子并跟踪信息。

paras.en: Two Ages Stand Out for Screen Time Risks
paras.zh: 两个年龄段的屏幕时间风险最为突出

paras.en: The researchers found that greater screen exposure at certain stages of childhood was associated with lower academic achievement and poorer working memory later in life. These relationships were particularly consistent among children who spent more time watching screens at age 1 and around age 6, when formal schooling typically begins.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，在童年的某些阶段接触更多的屏幕与以后的学业成绩和工作记忆较差有关。这些关系在 1 岁和 6 岁左右花更多时间看屏幕的孩子中尤其一致，这段时间通常是正规学校开始的时间。

paras.en: Children who accumulated more screen time throughout childhood also tended to achieve lower academic scores. However, the strength of the associations varied depending on when the exposure occurred, suggesting that some developmental stages may be more sensitive than others.
paras.zh: 在整个童年时期积累更多屏幕时间的孩子的学业成绩也往往较低。然而，关联的强度根据暴露发生的时间而变化，这表明某些发育阶段可能比其他阶段更敏感。

paras.en: One possible explanation is that screen viewing can take time away from activities that support cognitive development, including conversations with caregivers, imaginative play, and hands-on exploration of the physical world. These experiences provide opportunities for children to develop language, attention, memory, and problem-solving skills.
paras.zh: 一种可能的解释是，观看屏幕会占用支持认知发展的活动的时间，包括与护理人员的对话、富有想象力的游戏以及对物理世界的实践探索。这些经历为孩子们提供了发展语言、注意力、记忆力和解决问题能力的机会。

paras.en: "The effect sizes we saw at age 1 were the largest among all time points we examined," the authors said. "That suggests early infancy may be a window of heightened sensitivity, when the developing brain is particularly vulnerable to the displacement of learning interactions by screen time. We were also surprised to see that while screen use at age 2 and 3 did not show significant links, the associations re-emerged at age 6 -- when children enter formal schooling. So it is not just about early years; screen use later in childhood still matters."
paras.zh: 作者说：“我们在 1 岁时看到的效应大小是我们检查的所有时间点中最大的。” “这表明婴儿早期可能是敏感度提高的一个窗口，此时正在发育的大脑特别容易受到屏幕时间取代学习互动的影响。我们还惊讶地发现，虽然2岁和3岁的屏幕使用没有显示出显着的联系，但这种关联在6岁时重新出现——当孩子们进入正规学校时。所以这不仅仅是早年的问题；童年后期的屏幕使用仍然很重要。”

paras.en: Although the study identifies associations rather than proving that screen time directly causes poorer cognitive or academic outcomes, the results highlight the potential importance of managing children's screen habits at different ages.
paras.zh: 尽管该研究确定了关联，而不是证明屏幕时间直接导致较差的认知或学业成绩，但结果强调了管理不同年龄段儿童的屏幕习惯的潜在重要性。

paras.en: Why Even Small Differences in Screen Time Matter
paras.zh: 为什么屏幕时间的微小差异也很重要

paras.en: According to the researchers, the results reinforce the principle that "less is better" when it comes to children's screen time.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，研究结果强化了儿童看电视时间“越少越好”的原则。

paras.en: An additional hour of daily screen viewing may not produce a noticeable difference in an individual child's academic abilities. However, when similar patterns occur across a large population, even relatively small differences in average performance could increase the number of children who experience academic difficulties.
paras.zh: 每天多看一小时的屏幕可能不会对个别孩子的学业能力产生明显的影响。然而，当大量人口中出现类似模式时，即使平均表现相对较小的差异也可能会增加遇到学业困难的儿童数量。

paras.en: The researchers suggest that efforts to encourage healthier screen habits could begin during infancy, with renewed emphasis around the transition to elementary school. This approach recognizes that children's developmental needs continue to change well beyond their toddler years.
paras.zh: 研究人员建议，鼓励更健康的屏幕习惯的努力可以从婴儿期开始，并重新强调向小学的过渡。这种方法认识到儿童的发展需求在幼儿期之后仍会持续发生变化。

paras.en: The authors also stress that the amount of time children spend in front of screens is only one part of a much larger picture. Future studies should investigate whether the quality of digital content, the types of devices children use, and whether parents watch and interact with their children during screen time influence developmental outcomes.
paras.zh: 作者还强调，孩子们在屏幕前花费的时间只是更大图景的一部分。未来的研究应该调查数字内容的质量、儿童使用的设备类型以及父母在屏幕时间观看孩子并与孩子互动是否会影响发育结果。

paras.en: Understanding these differences could eventually help researchers develop more targeted recommendations that consider not only how much screen time children get, but also when and how they engage with digital technology.
paras.zh: 了解这些差异最终可以帮助研究人员制定更有针对性的建议，不仅考虑儿童获得多少屏幕时间，还考虑他们何时以及如何接触数字技术。

paras.en: The GUSTO study was supported by the Singapore National Research Foundation and the Singapore Ministry of Health's National Medical Research Council (NMRC/TCR/004-NUS/2008 and NMRC/TCR/012-NUHS/2014). Additional funding came from the Agence Nationale de la Recherche (ANR) in France (iSCAN project, ANR-20-CE36-0001).
paras.zh: GUSTO 研究得到了新加坡国家研究基金会和新加坡卫生部国家医学研究理事会的支持（NMRC/TCR/004-NUS/2008 和 NMRC/TCR/012-NUHS/2014）。额外的资金来自法国国家研究机构 (ANR)（iSCAN 项目，ANR-20-CE36-0001）。

articles.title: A fat-burning molecule has an unexpected benefit for your muscles

paras.en: A fat-burning molecule has an unexpected benefit for your muscles
paras.zh: 脂肪燃烧分子对您的肌肉有意想不到的好处

paras.en: Researchers have discovered that a naturally occurring molecule released during exercise helps muscles become stronger, resist fatigue, and withstand damage. The molecule, already available as a dietary supplement, could open new avenues for treating muscle deterioration associated with type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，运动过程中释放的一种自然产生的分子有助于肌肉变得更强壮、抵抗疲劳和承受损伤。该分子已经作为膳食补充剂上市，可以为治疗与 2 型糖尿病相关的肌肉退化开辟新途径。

paras.en: Researchers have identified a naturally occurring molecule that plays a crucial role in building muscle strength and improving physical performance. Released during exercise, the molecule could also provide the basis for future treatments to protect against muscle damage associated with type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现了一种天然存在的分子，它在增强肌肉力量和提高身体表现方面发挥着至关重要的作用。该分子在运动过程中释放，还可以为未来预防与 2 型糖尿病相关的肌肉损伤的治疗提供基础。

paras.en: The molecule, known as L-β-aminoisobutyric acid (L-BAIBA), is essential for muscles to adapt to physical activity. It helps muscles become stronger, improves their resistance to fatigue, and protects against damage and weakness.
paras.zh: 这种分子被称为 L-β-氨基异丁酸 (L-BAIBA)，对于肌肉适应身体活动至关重要。它可以帮助肌肉变得更强壮，提高抗疲劳能力，并防止损伤和虚弱。

paras.en: The study, published in Nature Communications and funded by Diabetes UK and the Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC), reveals that L-BAIBA is a central regulator of the biological changes that allow muscles to improve their strength, structure, and endurance in response to exercise training.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《自然通讯》上，由英国糖尿病协会和生物技术和生物科学研究委员会 (BBSRC) 资助，表明 L-BAIBA 是生物变化的中央调节剂，使肌肉能够改善其力量、结构和耐力以应对运动训练。

paras.en: How Exercise Triggers a Natural Muscle Booster
paras.zh: 运动如何触发天然肌肉增强剂

paras.en: Although the health benefits of exercise are well established, scientists still do not fully understand the biological processes that allow the body to adapt to physical demands. A research team led by Professor Lee Roberts at the University of Leeds investigated whether these processes could reveal new ways to treat chronic conditions such as type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 尽管运动对健康的益处已得到充分证实，但科学家们仍然没有完全了解让身体适应身体需求的生物过程。利兹大学李·罗伯茨教授领导的一个研究小组调查了这些过程是否可以揭示治疗 2 型糖尿病等慢性疾病的新方法。

paras.en: L-BAIBA has attracted scientific interest for more than a decade. In research published in 2014, Roberts demonstrated that the molecule has beneficial effects on metabolism, helping to enhance the body's ability to burn fat in response to exercise. L-BAIBA is now commercially available as a dietary supplement.
paras.zh: 十多年来，L-BAIBA 引起了科学界的兴趣。在 2014 年发表的研究中，罗伯茨证明该分子对新陈代谢具有有益的影响，有助于增强身体因运动而燃烧脂肪的能力。 L-BAIBA 现已作为膳食补充剂上市销售。

paras.en: The latest findings reveal another important function of the molecule. L-BAIBA acts as a chemical messenger that connects physical activity with beneficial changes in muscle structure and metabolism, helping muscles adapt to the demands placed on them.
paras.zh: 最新发现揭示了该分子的另一个重要功能。 L-BAIBA 作为一种化学信使，将身体活动与肌肉结构和新陈代谢的有益变化联系起来，帮助肌肉适应对它们的需求。

paras.en: Lee Roberts, Professor of Molecular Physiology and Metabolism at the University of Leeds, said: "Our research identifies L-BAIBA as an exercise-induced signal that helps muscles adapt, improve their metabolic capacity and ability to contract, and ultimately enhances physical performance.
paras.zh: 利兹大学分子生理学和代谢学教授 Lee Roberts 表示：“我们的研究确定 L-BAIBA 是一种运动诱发信号，可以帮助肌肉适应、提高代谢能力和收缩能力，并最终增强身体表现。

paras.en: "This gives us exciting new insight into how exercise benefits the body and highlights a promising target for future therapies aimed at preserving muscle function in chronic conditions such as diabetes."
paras.zh: “这让我们对运动如何有益于身体有了令人兴奋的新见解，并强调了未来旨在保持糖尿病等慢性疾病肌肉功能的疗法的一个有希望的目标。”

paras.en: Protecting Muscles Against Damage From Type 2 Diabetes
paras.zh: 保护肌肉免受 2 型糖尿病损伤

paras.en: The researchers also discovered that L-BAIBA protects muscles against damage associated with type 2 diabetes. The condition can negatively affect muscle health, leading to a decline in muscle mass and strength, as well as disruptions in the way muscles process and use energy. These complications can significantly reduce a person's quality of life.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，L-BAIBA 可以保护肌肉免受 2 型糖尿病相关的损伤。这种情况会对肌肉健康产生负面影响，导致肌肉质量和力量下降，以及肌肉处理和使用能量的方式中断。这些并发症会显着降低一个人的生活质量。

paras.en: Because regular physical activity is an important part of managing type 2 diabetes, finding ways to improve muscle function and reduce fatigue could make a substantial difference for people who struggle to exercise.
paras.zh: 由于定期体育活动是控制 2 型糖尿病的重要组成部分，因此寻找改善肌肉功能和减少疲劳的方法可能会对运动困难的人产生重大影响。

paras.en: Type 2 diabetes is a serious chronic condition that increases the risk of potentially life-threatening complications, including heart attacks and strokes. Its development is influenced by a complex combination of factors, including age, ethnicity, genetics, and living with overweight or obesity.
paras.zh: 2 型糖尿病是一种严重的慢性疾病，会增加潜在危及生命的并发症的风险，包括心脏病和中风。其发展受到多种复杂因素的影响，包括年龄、种族、遗传以及超重或肥胖。

paras.en: Although type 2 diabetes has traditionally been more common among older adults, diagnoses in people younger than 40 have been rising in recent years. Cases in this younger age group are now increasing more rapidly than among adults over 40.
paras.zh: 尽管传统上 2 型糖尿病在老年人中更为常见，但近年来 40 岁以下人群的诊断率一直在上升。目前，这个年轻年龄组的病例增长速度比 40 岁以上的成年人还要快。

paras.en: A Promising Target for Future Diabetes Treatments
paras.zh: 未来糖尿病治疗的有希望的目标

paras.en: Anna Morris, Assistant Director of Research Strategy and Partnership at Diabetes UK, said: "Exercise plays an important role in managing type 2 diabetes, but for many people muscle weakness and fatigue can make staying active a real challenge. This research helps us better understand how muscles adapt to exercise and identifies a potential new target for improving muscle health. While these findings are still at an early stage, they could help shape future approaches that support people with type 2 diabetes to remain active and live healthier, longer lives."
paras.zh: 英国糖尿病研究战略和合作伙伴关系助理主任安娜·莫里斯（Anna Morris）表示：“运动在控制 2 型糖尿病方面发挥着重要作用，但对于许多人来说，肌肉无力和疲劳会使保持活跃成为真正的挑战。这项研究帮助我们更好地了解肌肉如何适应运动，并确定改善肌肉健康的潜在新目标。虽然这些发现仍处于早期阶段，但它们可能有助于制定未来的方法，支持 2 型糖尿病患者保持活跃并过上更健康、更长寿的生活。”

paras.en: Although the discovery opens promising avenues for future treatments, further research is needed to determine whether L-BAIBA supplementation can produce meaningful therapeutic benefits in people with type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 尽管这一发现为未来的治疗开辟了有希望的途径，但还需要进一步的研究来确定 L-BAIBA 补充剂是否可以对 2 型糖尿病患者产生有意义的治疗益处。

paras.zh: 该研究由英国糖尿病协会和 BBSRC 资助。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 26, 2011: NASA's 2-ton nuclear-powered Curiosity rover launches to Mars
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On November 26, 2011, the NASA Curiosity rover launched to Mars.
paras.zh: 2011 年 11 月 26 日，美国宇航局好奇号火星车发射到火星。

paras.en: The Mars rover Curiosity was the biggest and most powerful rover anyone had ever sent to the Red Planet. The 2-ton science laboratory is about the size of a small SUV. The mission's goal was to search for habitable environments on Mars, or evidence that the planet could have been habitable in the past.
paras.zh: 好奇号火星车是有史以来发送到这颗红色星球的最大、最强大的火星车。这个2吨重的科学实验室大约有一辆小型SUV那么大。该任务的目标是寻找火星上的宜居环境，或者寻找火星过去可能适宜居住的证据。

paras.en: It launched on an Atlas V rocket from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida. About nine months later, Curiosity made a challenging landing on Mars. It successfully used a new landing technology called a sky crane to gently lower it to the surface.
paras.zh: 它由阿特拉斯五号火箭从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角空军基地发射升空。大约九个月后，好奇号在火星上进行了一次充满挑战的着陆。它成功地使用了一种称为天空起重机的新着陆技术，将其轻轻地降低到地面。

paras.en: It may be hard to imagine now, but 15 years ago, the idea of a nuclear-powered rover on Mars was just a concept. When the Curiosity rover launched in 2011, it made that idea a reality the car-size probe (using a plutonium-based radioisotope thermoelectric generator that converts heat from radioactive decay into power) as it headed to the Red Planet.
paras.zh: 现在可能很难想象，但15年前，在火星上建造核动力漫游车的想法还只是一个概念。当好奇号火星车于 2011 年发射升空时，它在前往红色星球时通过汽车大小的探测器（使用基于钚的放射性同位素热电发电机，将放射性衰变产生的热量转化为电能）将这一想法变为现实。

paras.en: Curiosity was the largest rover ever launched to Mars, following up on the success of the tiny Sojourner rover in 1997 and the larger twin rovers Spirit and Opportunity in 2004. Its sky crane landing system was novel at the time, and fully automated. Once it began its descent in August 2012, NASA could only wait through "seven minutes of terror" to see how it turned out. It ended being a huge success.
paras.zh: 继 1997 年小型 Sojourner 漫游车和 2004 年较大的双胞胎漫游车 Spirit 和 Opportunity 的成功之后，好奇号是有史以来发射到火星的最大漫游车。它的空中起重机着陆系统在当时是新颖的，并且是完全自动化的。 2012年8月它开始下降后，NASA只能等待“恐怖七分钟”，看看结果如何。它最终取得了巨大的成功。

paras.en: After its smooth landing, Curiosity lived up to its original name: the Mars Science Laboratory. Within weeks, Curiosity fulfilled its primary mission. It found evidence of ancient running water on Mars. It later found organic molecules on Mars as well.
paras.zh: 顺利着陆后，好奇号名副其实：火星科学实验室。几周之内，好奇号就完成了它的主要任务。它在火星上发现了古代自来水的证据。后来它也在火星上发现了有机分子。

paras.en: Curiosity's primary mission was expected to last just about one Martian year (687 Earth days, or about two Earth years), as the rover explored its Gale Crater landing site. But NASA has extended the mission as the rover continues to operate in good health.
paras.zh: 好奇号的主要任务预计将持续大约一个火星年（687 个地球日，或大约两个地球年），因为好奇号将探索其盖尔陨石坑着陆点。但随着火星车继续健康运行，美国宇航局延长了任务期限。

paras.en: In fact, Curiosity has survived long enough to welcome its successor to Mars, the Perseverance rover, which landed in February 2021 on a mission to collect the first samples for later retrieval. Perseverance used the same basic 2-ton design, plutonium power system and sky crane landing system to reach Mars.
paras.zh: 事实上，“好奇号”已经存活了足够长的时间，可以迎接它的继任者“毅力”号火星车，该火星车于 2021 年 2 月着陆，其任务是收集第一批样本以供日后回收。毅力号使用相同的基本 2 吨设计、钚动力系统和空中起重机着陆系统到达火星。

paras.en: And today, a ground-based twin of the Curiosity rover, called Promise, is being outfitted for an upcoming mission to the moon.
paras.zh: 如今，好奇号火星车的地面双胞胎“承诺号”正在为即将到来的月球任务进行装备。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: Venus shines at its brightest in the predawn sky this week. Here's where to look
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: Venus is at its most dazzling in the predawn sky this week as it shines close to the bright star Spica in the southeast. Here's what you need to know.
paras.zh: 本周，金星在黎明前的天空中最为耀眼，因为它靠近东南方的明亮恒星角宿一。这是您需要了解的内容。

paras.en: As an inner planet, Venus never strays far from the horizon, at least compared to outer planets like Jupiter and Mars which can be visible all night long during opposition, when they shine opposite the sun in Earth's sky.
paras.zh: 作为一颗内行星，金星永远不会远离地平线，至少与木星和火星等外行星相比，金星在冲日期间整夜可见，当它们在地球天空中与太阳相对时发光。

paras.en: Instead, Venus alternates between morning and evening appearances. All the while, its shifting moon-like phases and ever-changing proximity to Earth causes its brightness to wax and wane.
paras.zh: 相反，金星在早上和晚上交替出现。一直以来，它像月球一样不断变化的相位以及与地球的距离不断变化导致它的亮度时强时弱。

paras.en: Venus will reach peak brightness during its current morning apparition at 1:37 p.m. EST (1837 GMT) on Nov. 27 according to the astronomy website In-The-Sky. Stargazers in the U.S. could get an incredible view of Venus in the predawn hours of the coming week, as the planet climbs into the southeastern sky ahead of the rising sun, with Mercury clinging close to the horizon below.
paras.zh: 金星将在当前早晨的下午 1:37 出现时达到峰值亮度。据天文学网站 In-The-Sky 报道，美国东部时间 (1837 GMT) 11 月 27 日。美国的观星者可能会在未来一周的黎明前看到金星的令人难以置信的景象，因为金星在太阳升起之前爬升到东南天空，而水星紧贴着下面的地平线。

paras.en: This is a fantastic go-to telescope with a 4-inch aperture and can help you quickly find a steady view of the moon. For a closer look at craters and the terminator, make sure to grab a 9mm or 12mm eyepiece and get stronger magnification.
paras.zh: 这是一款出色的首选望远镜，孔径为 4 英寸，可以帮助您快速稳定地观察月球。要仔细观察陨石坑和明暗界线，请务必使用 9 毫米或 12 毫米目镜并获得更强的放大倍率。

paras.en: The bright star Spica will glow less than five degrees away from Venus before dawn on Nov. 27 — roughly the width of your three middle fingers held at arm's length against the night sky.
paras.zh: 11 月 27 日黎明前，明亮的角宿一恒星将在距离金星不到 5 度的地方发出光芒——大约是你在夜空中举起的三个中指的宽度。

paras.en: Spica is a double system of two stars that orbit one another once every four days. Its stars are separated by just approximately 11 million miles (less than 18 million kilometers), making them far too close to split visually with even the most powerful amateur equipment. However, the system still makes for a dazzling target, appearing as a magnificent blue-white star when viewed through the eyepiece of a 4-inch telescope.
paras.zh: 角宿一是一个由两颗恒星组成的双系统，每四天绕行一圈。它的恒星之间的距离仅为约 1100 万英里（不到 1800 万公里），因此即使是最强大的业余设备也无法在视觉上将它们分开。然而，该系统仍然是一个令人眼花缭乱的目标，当通过 4 英寸望远镜的目镜观察时，它看起来就像一颗宏伟的蓝白色星星。

paras.en: Check that the sun is safely below the horizon before turning your telescope on Venus to observe a crescent of light playing across the planet's dense atmosphere. Over the coming weeks and months, Venus will appear increasingly illuminated as it moves farther away from Earth in its orbit, while its apparent size through a telescope will gradually decrease.
paras.zh: 检查太阳是否安全地位于地平线以下，然后将望远镜转向金星，观察金星稠密大气中的新月光。在接下来的几周和几个月里，随着金星在轨道上远离地球，金星将显得越来越明亮，而通过望远镜观察到的金星尺寸将逐渐缩小。

paras.en: Want to get a closer look at the planets of the solar system and the stars beyond? Then be sure to check out our roundups of the best telescopes and smart telescopes for observing the night sky.
paras.zh: 想近距离观察太阳系的行星和更远的恒星吗？那么请务必查看我们对观察夜空的最佳望远镜和智能望远镜的综述。

articles.title: Cosmo Bee to flight-test Honeybee Hall thruster with D-Orbit in 2027
articles.author: Cosmo Bee

paras.en: Daejeon, Republic of Korea – October 14, 2026: South Korean space electric propulsion startup Cosmo Bee plans to conduct an in-orbit flight test of its 10 mN-class Honeybee Hall thruster system in October 2027 through a service agreement with D-Orbit.
paras.zh: 韩国大田 – 2026 年 10 月 14 日：韩国太空电力推进初创公司 Cosmo Bee 计划通过与 D-Orbit 签订的服务协议，于 2027 年 10 月对其 10 mN 级 Honeybee Hall 推进器系统进行在轨飞行测试。

paras.en: Honeybee is a 10 mN-class Hall thruster system under development by Cosmo Bee for small satellites operating in LEO constellations.
paras.zh: Honeybee 是 Cosmo Bee 正在为在 LEO 星座运行的小型卫星开发的 10 mN 级霍尔推进器系统。

paras.en: “In-orbit validation is an essential step as we prepare to bring Honeybee to the commercial market,” said Dongha Park, co-founder and CEO of Cosmo Bee. “D-Orbit is an ideal partner to help us achieve that goal.”
paras.zh: Cosmo Bee 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Dongha Park 表示：“在轨验证是我们准备将 Honeybee 推向商业市场的重要一步。” “D-Orbit 是帮助我们实现这一目标的理想合作伙伴。”

paras.en: “Hosting in-orbit demonstrations is one of the core services we offer aboard ION,” said Matteo Lorenzoni, Director of the Orbital Access Business Unit at D-Orbit. “Honeybee will operate in the real space environment, with our mission operations team supporting the test throughout, so Cosmo Bee comes away with the performance data it needs to take the thruster to market.” This test will evaluate Honeybee’s key performance parameters, including thrust and specific impulse, under various operating conditions.
paras.zh: “举办在轨演示是我们在 ION 上提供的核心服务之一，”D-Orbit 轨道接入业务部总监 Matteo Lorenzoni 说道。 “Honeybee 将在真实的太空环境中运行，我们的任务运营团队全程支持测试，因此 Cosmo Bee 可以获得将推进器推向市场所需的性能数据。”该测试将评估 Honeybee 在各种操作条件下的关键性能参数，包括推力和比冲量。

paras.en: “For satellite operators choosing a propulsion system, flight heritage is often what decides the purchase”, commented Matteo Zeni, Head of Sales of D-Orbit’s Orbital Access Business Unit. “Our in-orbit demonstration service gives technology developers like Cosmo Bee a direct route to space and the data they need to move from qualification to a commercial product. We look forward to flying Honeybee next year.”
paras.zh: “对于选择推进系统的卫星运营商来说，飞行传统往往是决定购买的因素”，D-Orbit 轨道接入业务部销售主管 Matteo Zeni 评论道。 “我们的在轨演示服务为 Cosmo Bee 等技术开发人员提供了直接进入太空的途径，以及他们从资格认证转向商业产品所需的数据。我们期待明年让 Honeybee 飞行。”

paras.en: Through the partnership, Cosmo Bee plans to establish flight heritage for Honeybee while preparing for the system’s commercial introduction in 2027. The company intends to make Honeybee available to satellite operators and mission developers seeking electric propulsion systems for small spacecraft.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Cosmo Bee 计划为 Honeybee 建立飞行遗产，同时为 2027 年该系统的商业推出做准备。该公司打算将 Honeybee 提供给卫星运营商和寻求小型航天器电力推进系统的任务开发商。

paras.en: Cosmo Bee was founded in July 2023 as a spin-off from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), building on electric propulsion research conducted by Professor Wonho Choe’s team since 2003.
paras.zh: Cosmo Bee 成立于 2023 年 7 月，是韩国科学技术院 (KAIST) 的一个衍生公司，其基础是 Wonho Choe 教授团队自 2003 年以来进行的电力推进研究。

paras.en: In November 2025, the company launched its first space mission, K-HERO, a 3U CubeSat designed to demonstrate the operation of a 150 W-class Hall thruster in orbit. The spacecraft was launched aboard South Korea’s KSLV-2 launch vehicle.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月，该公司发射了其首次太空任务 K-HERO，这是一颗 3U 立方体卫星，旨在演示 150 W 级霍尔推进器在轨道上的运行。该航天器是由韩国的 KSLV-2 运载火箭发射升空的。

paras.en: In June 2026, the Korea AeroSpace Administration (KASA) designated Cosmo Bee’s 10 mN-class Hall thruster and hollow cathode technologies as “New Space Technologies.” The company also raised $5 million in a Series A funding round that month.
paras.zh: 2026 年 6 月，韩国宇宙航空管理局 (KASA) 将 Cosmo Bee 的 10 mN 级霍尔推进器和空心阴极技术指定为“新空间技术”。该公司还在当月的 A 轮融资中筹集了 500 万美元。

paras.en: “Cosmo Bee is growing alongside the rapidly expanding demand for LEO satellite constellations in South Korea,” Park said. “We hope Honeybee can support customers developing the next generation of small satellite constellations.”
paras.zh: Park 表示：“随着韩国对 LEO 卫星星座需求的快速增长，Cosmo Bee 也在不断发展。” “我们希望 Honeybee 能够支持客户开发下一代小型卫星星座。”

articles.title: Flexell Space and ALATYR Sign MoU to Explore Solar Power Solutions for Orbital Data Centers
articles.author: Flexell Space

paras.en: – Collaboration to assess next-generation ultralight solar cells for space-based computing infrastructure
paras.zh: – 合作评估用于天基计算基础设施的下一代超轻太阳能电池

paras.en: – Partnership brings together Korean space energy technology and French orbital infrastructure expertise
paras.zh: – 合作伙伴关系汇集了韩国空间能源技术和法国轨道基础设施专业知识

paras.en: Bremen, Germany – Flexell Space, a space energy company, announced that it has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with ALATYR, a French company developing orbital data centers, to explore solar power solutions for space-based computing infrastructure.
paras.zh: 德国不来梅 – 空间能源公司 Flexell Space 宣布与开发轨道数据中心的法国公司 ALATYR 签署了一份谅解备忘录 (MoU)，共同探索用于天基计算基础设施的太阳能解决方案。

paras.en: The collaboration will assess the potential application of Flexell Space’s next-generation solar cell technology to orbital infrastructure designed for large-scale computing and data storage. The companies intend to exchange technical requirements relating to power demand and operating conditions and explore opportunities for future joint development and validation.
paras.zh: 此次合作将评估 Flexell Space 的下一代太阳能电池技术在专为大规模计算和数据存储而设计的轨道基础设施中的潜在应用。两家公司打算交换有关电力需求和运行条件的技术要求，并探索未来联合开发和验证的机会。

paras.en: ALATYR develops orbital data centers designed to support artificial intelligence (AI) computing and mission-critical workloads. Its CITADEL modular infrastructure architecture and BYLD robotic system are designed to enable assembly, maintenance, and upgrades in orbit. The architecture separates the service life of the supporting infrastructure from the replacement cycle of computing hardware, enabling computing modules to be renewed in orbit while retaining the infrastructure that powers, cools, and supports them.
paras.zh: ALATYR 开发轨道数据中心，旨在支持人工智能 (AI) 计算和关键任务工作负载。其 CITADEL 模块化基础设施架构和 BYLD 机器人系统旨在实现在轨组装、维护和升级。该架构将支持基础设施的使用寿命与计算硬件的更换周期分开，使计算模块能够在轨道上更新，同时保留为其供电、冷却和支持的基础设施。

paras.en: Reliable power generation is essential to making orbital data centers viable. As these facilities grow, solar power systems must address not only electrical performance but also mass, launch and deployment efficiency, manufacturing costs, and long-term reliability.
paras.zh: 可靠的发电对于轨道数据中心的可行性至关重要。随着这些设施的发展，太阳能系统不仅必须解决电气性能问题，还必须解决质量、发射和部署效率、制造成本和长期可靠性问题。

paras.en: Flexell Space is developing next-generation space solar cells based on CIGS (copper indium gallium selenide) and perovskite technologies. With a focus on lightweight, flexible designs and large-area manufacturing, the company aims to provide power solutions for satellites and larger space infrastructure. Through the collaboration, Flexell Space intends to gain a clearer understanding of orbital data center requirements and assess how its technology could support this emerging application.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 正在开发基于 CIGS（铜铟镓硒）和钙钛矿技术的下一代太空太阳能电池。该公司专注于轻量化、灵活设计和大面积制造，旨在为卫星和更大的空间基础设施提供电源解决方案。通过此次合作，Flexell Space 打算更清楚地了解轨道数据中心的要求，并评估其技术如何支持这一新兴应用。

paras.en: “This MoU marks an important milestone in strengthening cooperation between Korea and Europe, particularly France, in space energy and infrastructure,” said Kyumin Lee, Business Development Manager at Flexell Space. “By combining our next-generation solar cell technology with ALATYR’s orbital infrastructure expertise, we aim to build a lasting partnership and lay the groundwork for joint development and validation of power solutions for future orbital data centers.”
paras.zh: Flexell Space 业务开发经理 Kyumin Lee 表示：“这份谅解备忘录标志着韩国与欧洲（特别是法国）在空间能源和基础设施领域加强合作的一个重要里程碑。” “通过将我们的下一代太阳能电池技术与 ALATYR 的轨道基础设施专业知识相结合，我们的目标是建立持久的合作伙伴关系，并为未来轨道数据中心电力解决方案的联合开发和验证奠定基础。”

paras.en: He added, “By bringing together our complementary capabilities, we aim to establish a practical foundation for future development and validation.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“通过整合我们的互补能力，我们的目标是为未来的开发和验证奠定实用的基础。”

paras.en: “Our orbital infrastructure is designed to serve successive generations of computing hardware,” said Emeric Lhomme, Chief Executive Officer of ALATYR. “That makes solar cell efficiency and longevity central to our approach: our power systems must continue to deliver reliable performance as computing modules are replaced and upgraded. With Flexell Space, we will explore how next-generation lightweight solar technologies could meet the demands of that extended service life.”
paras.zh: ALATYR 首席执行官埃默里克·洛姆 (Emeric Lhomme) 表示：“我们的轨道基础设施旨在为连续几代的计算硬件提供服务。” “这使得太阳能电池的效率和寿命成为我们方法的核心：随着计算模块的更换和升级，我们的电力系统必须继续提供可靠的性能。通过 Flexell Space，我们将探索下一代轻型太阳能技术如何满足延长使用寿命的需求。”

paras.en: The companies plan to begin by exchanging information on their technologies and development priorities, followed by a phased assessment of solar cell and power system compatibility. Specific development activities and validation approaches will be discussed through subsequent technical consultations.
paras.zh: 两家公司计划首先交换有关技术和开发优先事项的信息，然后对太阳能电池和电力系统的兼容性进行分阶段评估。具体的开发活动和验证方法将通过后续技术磋商进行讨论。

paras.en: Flexell Space is a space energy company that originated as an internal venture at Hanwha Systems. The company develops next-generation space solar cells and power solutions based on CIGS and perovskite technologies, with a focus on low-cost, large-area, ultralight products. Through collaboration with global partners, Flexell Space is advancing the commercialization of solar cell technologies for satellites and a broad range of space infrastructure.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 是一家空间能源公司，最初是韩华系统公司的内部合资企业。该公司开发基于CIGS和钙钛矿技术的下一代空间太阳能电池和电源解决方案，重点是低成本、大面积、超轻产品。通过与全球合作伙伴的合作，Flexell Space 正在推进卫星太阳能电池技术和广泛的空间基础设施的商业化。

paras.en: ALATYR is a French company developing a new layer of critical digital infrastructure in space. The company designs orbital data centers that evolve with computing technology, rather than being replaced with each hardware generation. Its infrastructure is designed to remain productive over the long term and expand with demand, creating a lasting extension of the cloud in orbit to increase computing capacity and strengthen the resilience of essential digital services worldwide.
paras.zh: ALATYR 是一家法国公司，正在开发太空关键数字基础设施的新层。该公司设计的轨道数据中心随着计算技术的发展而发展，而不是随着每一代硬件的发展而更换。其基础设施旨在长期保持生产力并根据需求进行扩展，在轨道上创建云的持久扩展，以提高计算能力并增强全球基本数字服务的弹性。

articles.title: Hull should be in League One, says xG - so how do they keep winning?

paras.en: Hull City should be in League One this season according to Expected Goals - so how do the Tigers keep winning in the Premier League?
paras.zh: 根据预期进球，赫尔城本赛季应该进入甲级联赛 - 那么老虎队如何在英超联赛中保持胜利呢？

paras.en: Hull City are sitting comfortably in the middle of the Premier League table - when the Expected Goals underlying data says they should be two divisions below; watch Crystal Palace vs Hull live on Sky Sports this Sunday from 1pm, kick-off 2pm
paras.zh: 赫尔城稳居英超积分榜中游位置——而预期进球基础数据显示，他们应该比英超联赛低两个级别；本周日下午 1 点开始在天空体育观看水晶宫对阵赫尔城的直播，下午 2 点开球

paras.en: Hull aren't doing much wrong as a newly promoted club so far. A great start to the campaign has them middle of the Premier League table, clear of the relegation zone and unbeaten at home all season.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，赫尔城作为升班马俱乐部并没有做太多错事。本赛季开局良好，他们在英超积分榜上排名中游，远离降级区，并且整个赛季主场保持不败。

paras.en: These are all the right ingredients for survival. But the underlying data says otherwise.
paras.zh: 这些都是生存的正确要素。但基础数据却表明事实并非如此。

paras.en: If Expected Goals (xG) decided football matches - yes, yes, we know they don't - then Hull would be bottom of the Premier League, with a similar record to the actual bottom club Crystal Palace, who they play live on Sky Sports this Sunday.
paras.zh: 如果预期进球（xG）决定了足球比赛——是的，是的，我们知道他们不会——那么赫尔城将在英超联赛中垫底，其战绩与实际垫底的水晶宫俱乐部相似，他们本周日将在天空体育上直播对阵水晶宫。

paras.en: The reason? Hull have only won one game this season on xG since their promotion to the top flight.On its own, this underlying data should be taken with a pinch of salt. xG numbers in a match require context.
paras.zh: 原因是什么？自从升级到顶级联赛以来，赫尔城本赛季在 xG 上只赢了一场比赛。就其本身而言，这一基本数据应该持保留态度。比赛中的 xG 数字需要上下文。

paras.en: For example, a team that loses a game can often end up having a higher xG than the opponent, as they were chasing the game and attacking for longer periods.
paras.zh: 例如，输掉一场比赛的球队通常会比对手拥有更高的预期目标，因为他们追逐比赛和进攻的时间更长。

paras.en: The same xG table also has Chelsea in 14th place at the moment. Bournemouth should be third and Nottingham Forest should be sixth. After 11 games, there is a lot of differentiation between the Expected Table and the actual table across the board.
paras.zh: 同一张 xG 表格中，切尔西目前也排名第 14 位。伯恩茅斯应该排名第三，诺丁汉森林应该排名第六。 11 场比赛结束后，预期积分榜与实际积分榜之间存在很大差异。

paras.en: But this isn't a new phenomenon when it comes to Hull. The fascinating thing about the Tigers is that this has been happening for 18 months.
paras.zh: 但这对于赫尔来说并不是什么新现象。老虎队的迷人之处在于，这种情况已经持续了 18 个月。

paras.en: The same xG data says Hull should also be playing in League One this season. That's because last term, they should have finished second-bottom of the Championship after 46 games, according to xG. Instead, they were promoted to the Premier League via the play-offs.
paras.zh: 同样的 xG 数据表明赫尔城本赛季也应该参加甲级联赛。这是因为，根据 xG 的数据，上个赛季，他们应该在 46 场比赛后排名联赛倒数第二。相反，他们通过附加赛晋级英超。

paras.en: As Aston Villa showed last season, you can get away with overperforming this way for some time but things eventually regress to the mean. To do this over a long period of time is extraordinary.
paras.zh: 正如阿斯顿维拉上赛季所展示的那样，你可以在一段时间内以这种方式表现出色，但最终情况会回归平均水平。能够在很长一段时间内做到这一点是非常了不起的。

paras.en: So why are Hull where they are? Style has something to do with it.
paras.zh: 那么为什么赫尔城会在这个位置呢？风格与此有关。

paras.en: Set up in a 5-4-1 formation, Hull have the lowest possession in the Premier League this season by an absolute country mile. The same applies for the number of shots they have and how high they start pressing up the pitch.
paras.zh: 赫尔城采用 5-4-1 阵型，本赛季控球率是英超联赛中最低的，相差绝对乡村英里数。这同样适用于他们的射门次数以及他们开始压迫球场的高度。

paras.en: "It is not about possession, it is what you do with it," said manager Sergej Jakirovic told Sky Sports in an interview last month. Hull are comfortable in a low block, which ultimately leads to losing the 'stats side' of games.
paras.zh: 主教练谢尔盖·雅基罗维奇上个月在接受天空体育采访时表示：“这不是控球问题，而是你如何处理控球问题。”赫尔城在低位防守中表现得很舒服，这最终导致失去了比赛的“数据方面”。

paras.en: So how do Hull actually win games? As their manager says, in the little time Hull get hold of the ball, they use it to good effect - the Tigers move the ball up the pitch quicker than any other team.
paras.zh: 那么赫尔城如何真正赢得比赛呢？正如他们的主教练所说，在赫尔城控球的短时间内，他们利用球取得了良好的效果——老虎队将球移向球场的速度比任何其他球队都要快。

paras.en: There is also an efficiency in attack. In the Championship last season, Hull had two of the most clinical forwards in Ollie McBurnie and Joe Gelhardt. They were given few opportunities, but when they got them, they took them.
paras.zh: 进攻上也有效率。在上赛季的英冠联赛中，赫尔城拥有两位最冷静的前锋：奥利·麦克伯尼和乔·格尔哈特。他们获得的机会很少，但当他们得到机会时，他们就抓住了。

paras.en: The same culture applies here. "No matter who is the opponent, we will have our chances," added Jakirovic.
paras.zh: 同样的文化也适用于此。 “无论对手是谁，我们都会有机会，”雅基罗维奇补充道。

paras.en: The aim of the game is not only to progress the ball as quickly as possible, but also choosing the right battles. That can be seen in Hull's pressing.
paras.zh: 游戏的目的不仅是尽可能快地推进球，而且还要选择正确的战斗。这可以从赫尔的逼抢中看出。

paras.en: Hull barely press - they have the lowest number of high turnovers in the Premier League this season. However, they have the second-most goals from high turnovers this season and rank fourth for high pressures that end up in a shot. It's a selective, patient press.
paras.zh: 赫尔城几乎没有施加压力——他们是本赛季英超联赛中高失误数最少的。然而，他们本赛季的高失误进球数排名第二，而高压射门的进球数排名第四。这是一个有选择性、耐心的媒体。

paras.en: Take their recent draw with Brentford as an example. Their only chance of the first half came from Hull pressing out-of-position midfielder Aaron Hickey to win a penalty which they scored from. Then they relied on the defence to hold out for a result. They conceded late, but got what many would say is a good point.
paras.zh: 以他们最近战平布伦特福德为例。他们上半场唯一的机会来自赫尔城，他们对失位的中场球员亚伦·希基进行了施压，赢得了点球。然后他们依靠防守坚持了一个结果。他们承认晚了，但得到了很多人认为很好的一分。

paras.en: But this game plan of little possession and reliance on taking advantage of the few attacks that come their way is risky. You need a lot of luck to go your way, and Hull have had their fair share of that.
paras.zh: 但这种几乎没有控球权并依赖于利用少数进攻的比赛计划是有风险的。你需要很大的运气才能走自己的路，而赫尔城就拥有了相当多的运气。

paras.en: In the Championship last season, Hull had the most let-offs out of any second-tier team in terms of big chances missed by their opponents. A similar theme has continued in the Premier League.
paras.zh: 在上赛季的英冠联赛中，赫尔城是所有二线球队中被对手错失良机最多的球队。英超联赛也延续了类似的主题。

paras.en: In Hull's first two home games of the season, Man Utd and Aston Villa should have scored around two goals each, according to xG. Neither of those teams found the net, as the Tigers picked up four points instead.
paras.zh: 根据 xG 的数据，在赫尔本赛季的前两场主场比赛中，曼联和阿斯顿维拉应该各进两球左右。这两支球队都没有进球，老虎队反而拿到了四分。

paras.en: But it is not just luck. In their most recent home game against Brighton, the performance of Konstantinos Tzolakis caught the eye, which confirms skills matters as well.
paras.zh: 但这不仅仅是运气。在最近主场对阵布莱顿的比赛中，康斯坦丁诺斯·佐拉基斯的表现引人注目，这也证实了技术的重要性。

paras.en: The Greek goalkeeper - or 'Greek God' as many Hull fans were claiming last weekend - has the best save record out of any Premier League goalkeeper this season. He alone has prevented nearly 2.0 worth of xG going in.
paras.zh: 这位希腊门将——或者被许多赫尔城球迷上周末称为“希腊之神”——拥有本赛季英超联赛门将中最好的扑救记录。他一个人就阻止了近 2.0 的 xG 进入。

paras.en: Without him, and without the game plan from their experienced manager, Hull would be closer to the bottom of the table. Instead, they go to the Premier League's basement club knowing they can still get a result.
paras.zh: 没有他，也没有经验丰富的主教练的比赛计划，赫尔城将更接近积分榜的垫底。相反，他们去了英超联赛的地下室俱乐部，知道他们仍然可以获得结果。
