articles.title: Nearly 6 decades after teen was killed while leaving job, Canada authorities know who did it
articles.author: Tim Stelloh

paras.en: Authorities in Canada have identified a man accused of killing a Canadian teen nearly six decades ago, police said Monday.
paras.zh: 警方周一表示，加拿大当局已确认一名男子被控在近六十年前杀害一名加拿大青少年。

paras.en: Michael Joseph Moore, who died in 2018, was responsible for the 1968 death of Jacqueline “Jacky” Dunleavy, 16, according to the London Police Service in Ontario.
paras.zh: 据安大略省伦敦警察局称，2018 年去世的迈克尔·约瑟夫·摩尔 (Michael Joseph Moore) 对 1968 年 16 岁的杰奎琳·“杰基”·邓利维 (Jacqueline “Jacky” Dunleavy) 的死亡负有责任。

paras.en: Moore, who worked as a firefighter for nearly three decades, was identified through genetic genealogy, officials said at a news conference Monday. The forensic technique combines modern DNA analysis with traditional genealogical research.
paras.zh: 官员们在周一的新闻发布会上表示，摩尔是一名消防员，工作了近三十年，他的身份是通过基因谱系确定的。法医技术将现代 DNA 分析与传统家谱研究相结合。

paras.en: If Moore was alive today, the agency said in a statement, he would have been arrested and charged in connection with the teen’s death.
paras.zh: 该机构在一份声明中表示，如果摩尔今天还活着，他就会因与这名青少年的死亡有关而被捕并受到指控。

paras.en: “Publicly identifying Moore provides an accurate historical record and answers that Jackie’s family and the community have sought for decades,” the agency said.
paras.zh: 该机构表示：“公开确认摩尔的身份提供了准确的历史记录，以及杰基的家人和社区几十年来一直在寻求的答案。”

paras.en: In a statement read at the news conference, Dunleavy’s family thanked law enforcement and said they hope the techniques used to solve her death can be used with other cold cases.
paras.zh: 在新闻发布会上宣读的一份声明中，邓利维的家人感谢执法部门，并表示他们希望用于解决她死亡的技术可以用于其他悬案。

paras.en: Authorities did not identify a possible motive, and a possible connection between Moore and Dunleavy remained unclear.
paras.zh: 当局没有确定可能的动机，摩尔和邓利维之间可能存在的联系仍不清楚。

paras.en: The high school sophomore was last seen on the evening of Jan. 9, 1968, leaving her job at a variety store in London, roughly 120 miles northeast of Detroit. Dunleavy was found dead at a school 90 minutes later, the police service said.
paras.zh: 这位高中二年级学生最后一次出现是在 1968 年 1 月 9 日晚上，她离开了位于底特律东北约 120 英里的伦敦一家杂货店的工作。警方称，90 分钟后，邓利维被发现死在一所学校。

paras.en: She had a head injury, according to the authorities, and her cause of death was determined to be strangulation.
paras.zh: 据当局称，她头部受伤，死因确定为勒死。

paras.en: - A dead homeless man was known as ‘Box Mike’ — until a global search revealed his true identity
paras.zh: - 一名死去的无家可归者被称为“盒子迈克”——直到全球搜索揭示了他的真实身份

paras.en: - Chicago police find killer in 65-year-old cold case murder of little girl — one of their own
paras.zh: - 芝加哥警方在 65 岁小女孩谋杀悬案中找到凶手——其中一名是他们自己

paras.en: - Arrest made in cold case of Iowa real estate agent killed during an open house
paras.zh: - 爱荷华州房地产经纪人在开放参观期间被杀的悬案被捕

paras.en: - After 40 years and 3 overturned convictions, arrest made in murder case thanks to smoothie straw
paras.zh: - 40年后，3次推翻定罪，因冰沙吸管谋杀案被捕

paras.en: - Slaying suspect in San Diego charged with 3 more murders, including 2 cold cases
paras.zh: - 圣地亚哥凶杀案嫌疑人被控另外 3 起谋杀案，其中包括 2 起悬案

paras.en: Despite what the agency described as an extensive investigation, the case remained unsolved, and efforts in the decades that followed did not reveal her killer.
paras.zh: 尽管该机构称进行了广泛的调查，但该案仍未侦破，随后几十年的努力也没有揭露凶手。

paras.en: “The investigators who worked on Jackie’s homicide in 1968 did everything they could with the investigative and forensic tools available to them at the time,” Det. Sgt. Micah Bourdeau of the London Police Service said in a statement. “The evidence they carefully collected and preserved ultimately allowed investigators decades later to continue that work.”
paras.zh: “1968 年杰基凶杀案的调查人员利用当时可用的调查和法医工具竭尽全力，”侦探说。中士。伦敦警察局的米卡·布尔多（Micah Bourdeau）在一份声明中说道。 “他们精心收集和保存的证据最终使调查人员能够在几十年后继续开展这项工作。”

paras.en: Recently, a Texas-based DNA lab conducted specialized testing using that evidence and investigators were able to develop a family tree that helped identify Moore, the police service said.
paras.zh: 警方表示，最近，德克萨斯州的一家 DNA 实验室利用这些证据进行了专门测试，调查人员能够开发出有助于识别摩尔身份的家谱。

paras.en: After conducting additional interviews, gathering new evidence and obtaining comparison DNA samples, Moore was identified as the man responsible for the teen’s killing, the agency said.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，在进行更多采访、收集新证据并获取 DNA 样本对比后，摩尔被确定为杀害这名青少年的凶手。

paras.en: Moore, who was 25 at the time, had moved to Canada from Ireland in 1967, authorities said. He worked as a firefighter for 28 years but did not have that job until after Dunleavy’s death, Det. Mike Budzyn of the London Police Service told reporters.
paras.zh: 当局称，摩尔当时 25 岁，于 1967 年从爱尔兰移居加拿大。他作为一名消防员工作了 28 年，但直到邓利维去世后才得到这份工作。伦敦警察局的迈克·布津 (Mike Budzyn) 告诉记者。

paras.en: At the time he retired, Moore was a captain.
paras.zh: 摩尔退役时是一名队长。

paras.en: His family was shocked by the revelation, Budzyn said, and “expressed their hope that these findings will provide long-awaited answers for Jackie’s family.”
paras.zh: 布津说，他的家人对这一消息感到震惊，并“表示希望这些发现能为杰基的家人提供期待已久的答案。”

articles.title: Man found 'likely involved' in cold-case murder
articles.author: Abbey Halter

paras.en: Inquest findings into deaths of three people in outback Queensland revealed
paras.zh: 昆士兰内陆三人死亡调查结果公布

paras.en: A coronial inquest into the deaths of three people in outback Queensland almost 50 years ago has concluded today.
paras.zh: 对近 50 年前昆士兰内陆三人死亡事件的验尸调查今天结束。

paras.en: The findings were handed down in a Brisbane court after evidence was heard in October last year.
paras.zh: 去年十月听取证据后，布里斯班一家法院宣布了调查结果。

paras.en: Coroner David O'Connell concluded a man previously charged with their homicide was reasonably suspected of being directly involved in their deaths.
paras.zh: 验尸官大卫·奥康奈尔得出的结论是，一名先前被指控犯有杀人罪的男子有理由怀疑直接参与了他们的死亡。

articles.title: International child abuse investigations lead to Far North Queensland arrests
articles.author: Conor Byrne

paras.en: Three international child exploitation investigations lead to arrests in Far North Queensland
paras.zh: 三项国际儿童剥削调查导致昆士兰远北地区逮捕

paras.en: The AFP has arrested three men in three days in Far North Queensland as part of three separate international child exploitation investigations.
paras.zh: 作为三项独立的国际儿童剥削调查的一部分，法新社三天内在昆士兰州远北地区逮捕了三名男子。

paras.en: The investigations are spread across alleged child abuse in Ukraine, the Philippines, and the USA.
paras.zh: 调查涉及乌克兰、菲律宾和美国涉嫌虐待儿童的案件。

paras.en: Two men have been bailed to appear in local magistrates courts in December and a third remains under investigation.
paras.zh: 两名男子已获保释，将于 12 月在地方地方法院出庭，第三名男子仍在接受调查。

articles.title: Sony's dog robot rehomed to hospitals

paras.en: Robotic dogs made by Sony have been rehomed in hospitals as pets in Japan.
paras.zh: 索尼制造的机器狗在日本被重新安置在医院作为宠物。

paras.en: The robot barks, cocks its head, moves its ears, waddles toward you, acts happy when petted, and goes to "sleep".
paras.zh: 机器人会叫，歪着头，移动耳朵，摇摇晃晃地向你走来，在被抚摸时表现得很高兴，然后进入“睡眠”状态。

paras.en: Aibo robots, which first went on sale in 1999, are all sold out and no longer in production.
paras.zh: 1999年首次上市的Aibo机器人现已全部售空，不再生产。

paras.en: The people at Sony don't use words like "product" when they talk about Aibo, the Japanese electronics company's robotic dog.
paras.zh: 索尼的员工在谈论日本电子公司的机器狗 Aibo 时不会使用“产品”之类的词。

paras.en: Aibo robots, which first went on sale in 1999, are all sold out and no longer in production.
paras.zh: 1999年首次上市的Aibo机器人现已全部售空，不再生产。

paras.en: But some owners who had to part with their Aibo have donated the robots to Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation for an "adoption program", where they get treated to repairs and upgrades.
paras.zh: 但一些不得不放弃 Aibo 的主人已将这些机器人捐赠给总部位于东京的索尼集团公司，用于“领养计划”，在那里他们可以得到维修和升级。

paras.en: Those robot pets now have new homes in hospitals and other facilities.
paras.zh: 这些机器宠物现在在医院和其他设施中拥有了新家。

paras.en: Sony does not disclose the pricing or the number of Aibo robots that have been sold.
paras.zh: 索尼没有透露 Aibo 机器人的定价或已售数量。

paras.en: Packed with sensors and digital cameras, Aibo has been programmed to remember its name, the owner's face and its surroundings.
paras.zh: Aibo 配备了传感器和数码相机，经过编程可以记住它的名字、主人的脸和周围的环境。

paras.en: The robot barks, cocks its head, moves its ears, waddles toward you, acts happy when petted, and goes to "sleep".
paras.zh: 机器人会叫，歪着头，移动耳朵，摇摇晃晃地向你走来，在被抚摸时表现得很高兴，然后进入“睡眠”状态。

paras.en: "The owners feel as though they are sending off what has become to them like their own child," said Sony official Yoshiyuki Katsuno, who oversaw the program.
paras.zh: 负责该项目的索尼官员 Yoshiyuki Katsuno 表示：“业主们觉得他们正在送走对他们来说就像是自己的孩子一样的东西。”

paras.en: Aibo gets people talking to each other, and can offer tired souls a perk to pick themselves up and keep going, according to Mr Katsuno.
paras.zh: 胜野先生表示，Aibo 可以让人们互相交谈，并且可以为疲惫的灵魂提供一种额外的福利，让他们振作起来并继续前进。

paras.en: "We hope to spread the emotional healing and human interaction that Aibo has to offer,"
paras.zh: “我们希望传播 Aibo 所提供的情感治愈和人际互动，”

paras.en: Cuteness is seen as desirable in Japanese culture, where being "kawaii", or "cute", is not a sign of weakness or inferiority, but an endearing trait that encourages harmony and communication.
paras.zh: 在日本文化中，可爱被认为是令人向往的，“卡哇伊”或“可爱”并不是软弱或自卑的标志，而是一种鼓励和谐与沟通的可爱特质。

paras.en: And so, if the need is for a soulmate, it's better to have that cute look, said Jerry Wang, executive chairman of FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem.
paras.zh: “所以，如果需要灵魂伴侣，最好有可爱的外表。”FF EAI机器人生态系统执行主席王杰瑞说。

paras.en: "If you want some emotional attachment, you want a cute shape," he said.
paras.zh: “如果你想要一些情感依恋，你就想要一个可爱的形状，”他说。

paras.en: At a University on the outskirts of Tokyo, a nurse had to do some looking to find a wandering Aibo during a recent visit.
paras.zh: 在东京郊区的一所大学，一名护士在最近一次访问期间不得不做一些寻找流浪爱宝的工作。

paras.en: But Aibo has helped with the long waits for visiting patients and succeeded in persuading reluctant children to get examined, says doctor Manabu Komori.
paras.zh: 但小森学医生表示，Aibo 帮助缓解了就诊患者的漫长等待，并成功说服了不愿意接受检查的儿童。

paras.en: That field involves diagnosing and treating sicknesses related to the ear, nose and throat, with many child patients.
paras.zh: 该领域涉及诊断和治疗与耳鼻喉有关的疾病，其中有许多儿童患者。

paras.en: "It helps motivate the kids," Dr Komori said.
paras.zh: “这有助于激励孩子们，”小森博士说。

paras.en: "Going to a hospital is basically not very pleasant."
paras.zh: “去医院基本上不太愉快。”

paras.en: The hospital also uses real dogs to help patients feel better, though the animals require care and food and can be temperamental.
paras.zh: 医院还使用真正的狗来帮助病人感觉更好，尽管这些动物需要照顾和食物，而且可能脾气暴躁。

paras.en: That means a robot dog offers some advantages, although Dr Komori was careful not to say they were better than real dogs.
paras.zh: 这意味着机器狗具有一些优势，尽管小森博士小心翼翼地没有说它们比真正的狗更好。

articles.title: Ebola cases reach 12,000 in Congo as second-largest outbreak on record grows

paras.en: Ebola cases reach 12,000 in Congo as second-largest outbreak on record grows
paras.zh: 刚果埃博拉病例达到 12,000 例，为有记录以来第二大疫情爆发

paras.en: Government data says 5,904 people have died in the outbreak so far
paras.zh: 政府数据显示，迄今为止已有 5,904 人在疫情中死亡

paras.en: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo now exceeds 12,000, government data showed on Thursday, as responders continue to struggle to bring the second-largest outbreak on record under control.
paras.zh: 政府周四的数据显示，刚果民主共和国的埃博拉确诊病例目前已超过 12,000 例，应对人员仍在努力控制有记录以来第二大疫情。

paras.en: Confirmed infections total 12,021, and 5,904 people have died, the data showed.
paras.zh: 数据显示，确诊病例总数为12,021例，死亡5,904例。

paras.en: The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo species of the Ebola virus, officially began in mid-May in the northeastern province Ituri, and has since spread to eight of the country's 26 provinces.
paras.zh: 此次疫情由罕见的本迪布焦埃博拉病毒物种引起，于 5 月中旬在东北部伊图里省正式爆发，此后已蔓延到该国 26 个省中的 8 个省。

paras.en: There are no approved treatments or vaccines for this strain of Ebola, complicating efforts to combat the disease.
paras.zh: 目前还没有针对这种埃博拉病毒株的批准治疗方法或疫苗，这使得抗击这种疾病的工作变得更加复杂。

paras.en: Delayed detection, armed conflicts in the region and strained health services have also led to rapid spread, with mistrust and misinformation keeping some residents from seeking medical care.
paras.zh: 延迟检测、该地区的武装冲突和紧张的卫生服务也导致了病毒的迅速传播，不信任和错误信息使一些居民无法寻求医疗护理。

paras.en: The current epidemic is the second-largest and deadliest on record behind only the 2014-16 West African outbreak, which infected more than 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000. But this outbreak is spreading much faster, having reached 12,000 cases in a fraction of the time, leaving officials worried that it could surpass the West African outbreak if it’s not brought under control soon.
paras.zh: 目前的疫情是有记录以来规模第二大、死亡人数最多的疫情，仅次于 2014-16 年西非疫情，该疫情导致 28,600 多人感染，11,000 多人死亡。但这次疫情的传播速度要快得多，短时间内就达到了 12,000 例，这让官员们担心，如果不尽快得到控制，疫情可能会超过西非的疫情。

paras.en: Currently, only 15 per cent of new cases come from contacts known to health authorities, according to data presented by Africa CDC earlier this month. That means many chains of transmission continue to be missed.
paras.zh: 根据非洲疾病预防控制中心本月早些时候提供的数据，目前，只有 15% 的新病例来自卫生当局已知的接触者。这意味着许多传播链仍然被遗漏。

paras.en: A Reuters analysis of satellite imagery found the official death toll may be largely underestimated in two of the country's hardest-hit areas. Fields of new graves that widely outstrip previous years indicates that many deaths connected to the virus may not be included in the official count, the investigation found.
paras.zh: 路透社对卫星图像的分析发现，该国两个受灾最严重的地区的官方死亡人数可能在很大程度上被低估了。调查发现，新墓地数量大大超过前几年，这表明许多与该病毒有关的死亡可能没有被纳入官方统计。

paras.en: - UN hails progress in Ebola response, cites insecurity as biggest challenge
paras.zh: - 联合国赞扬埃博拉应对工作取得进展，称不安全是最大挑战

paras.en: - Exclusive 'No one is safe' as Ebola outbreak surges to more than 10,000 cases, Africa's top doctor warns Canada
paras.zh: - 非洲顶级医生警告加拿大，随着埃博拉疫情激增至一万多例，“没有人是安全的”

paras.en: - Fears of a pan-African Ebola crisis growing as fourth country reports first case
paras.zh: - 随着第四个国家报告首例埃博拉病例，对泛非埃博拉危机的担忧日益加剧

paras.en: Ebola cases have been detected in five countries, but the only active cases right now are in the D.R.C. Uganda reported 21 cases and three deaths, but has had no new reported cases since June, while Kenya has had nine confirmed Ebola cases and two deaths. Kenya is two weeks into a 42-day countdown to declare the country Ebola-free after discharging its final patient earlier this month.
paras.zh: 已在五个国家发现埃博拉病例，但目前唯一活跃的病例在刚果民主共和国。乌干达报告了 21 例埃博拉病例和 3 例死亡，但自 6 月以来没有新报告病例，而肯尼亚则有 9 例埃博拉确诊病例和 2 例死亡。肯尼亚在本月初最后一名患者出院后，进入宣布该国消除埃博拉病毒的 42 天倒计时两周。

paras.en: The spread includes one imported case each for Nigeria and France, but further cases have not been reported in these countries.
paras.zh: 此次传播包括尼日利亚和法国各一例输入病例，但这些国家尚未报告更多病例。

paras.en: Red Cross workers carry the coffin of a man who died of Ebola virus before his burial in Bunia, Ituri, on June 10. (Gradel Muyisa Mumbere/Reuters)
paras.zh: 6 月 10 日，红十字会工作人员在伊图里布尼亚的埋葬前抬着一名死于埃博拉病毒的男子的棺材。（Gradel Muyisa Mumbere/路透社）

articles.title: Iran denies involvement after 2 Italian technicians killed in attack on Kuwait site

paras.en: Iran denies involvement after 2 Italian technicians killed in attack on Kuwait site
paras.zh: 两名意大利技术人员在科威特工地遇袭身亡后，伊朗否认参与其中

paras.en: Workers were at air defence surveillance station when it was targeted, Italy foreign minister says
paras.zh: 意大利外交部长称，遭到攻击时，防空监视站的工作人员正在现场

paras.en: Two Italians were killed in a drone attack in Kuwait on Thursday that Italy and Kuwait blamed on Iran, although Tehran has denied any involvement.
paras.zh: 周四，科威特发生无人机袭击，造成两名意大利人死亡，意大利和科威特将此次袭击归咎于伊朗，但德黑兰否认与此事有关。

paras.en: The two were technicians working for Rheinmetall Italia, the Italian unit of German defence group Rheinmetall, and were at an air defence surveillance station in Kuwait when it was targeted by Iranian drones, Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani told the Senate in Rome.
paras.zh: 外交部长安东尼奥·塔亚尼在罗马参议院告诉参议院，这两人是德国莱茵金属防务集团意大利分公司莱茵金属意大利公司的技术人员，当伊朗无人机袭击科威特的一个防空监视站时，他们正在该站工作。

paras.en: "Following a powerful explosion, both of our compatriots, according to information coming from Kuwait, have died. Two other people were injured: a Pakistani national and a captain in the Kuwaiti army," Tajani said.
paras.zh: 塔贾尼说：“根据来自科威特的消息，发生强烈爆炸后，我们的两名同胞均已死亡。另有两人受伤：一名巴基斯坦国民和一名科威特军队上尉。”

paras.en: Kuwait's Defence Ministry confirmed that the two Italians had died of their injuries, after initially reporting that four people had been wounded by falling debris when a "vital facility" was targeted in what it said was an Iranian attack. It said the other two injured were Kuwaiti and Pakistani nationals and that the attack had caused material damage.
paras.zh: 科威特国防部最初报告说，伊朗袭击了一个“重要设施”，导致四人被坠落的碎片炸伤，随后证实两名意大利人因伤势过重而死亡。报道称，另外两名受伤者分别是科威特和巴基斯坦国民，袭击造成了物质损失。

paras.en: Iran's senior armed forces spokesperson Abolfazl Shekarchi denied that Iran had attacked a "vital" site in Kuwait, saying no offensive or military operations by Iranian forces had taken place in the region, Iranian state media reported on Thursday.
paras.zh: 伊朗官方媒体周四报道，伊朗高级武装部队发言人阿博法兹尔·谢卡奇否认伊朗袭击了科威特的一个“重要”地点，称伊朗军队没有在该地区发动进攻或军事行动。

paras.en: Iran's embassy in Rome also categorically denied the claims of an Iranian drone attack on a military site in Kuwait in a post on X.
paras.zh: 伊朗驻罗马大使馆也在X网站上发帖，断然否认伊朗无人机袭击科威特军事基地的说法。

paras.en: - Yemen's Houthis claim attack on major Saudi oil refinery
paras.zh: - 也门胡塞武装声称袭击了沙特主要炼油厂

paras.en: - Iran and U.S. trade fire as Iran denies reports of planned dirty bomb attack in D.C.
paras.zh: - 伊朗和美国交火，伊朗否认有关计划在华盛顿发动脏弹袭击的报道

paras.en: Tajani told Italian news agency AGI that Italy would lodge a complaint with the Iranian embassy over the incident, urging caution and saying there was no need to attack Arab countries bordering Iran that were not involved in the war.
paras.zh: 塔亚尼告诉意大利新闻社AGI，意大利将就这一事件向伊朗大使馆提出投诉，敦促谨慎行事，并表示没有必要攻击与伊朗接壤但未卷入战争的阿拉伯国家。

paras.en: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Aragchi denied any Iranian involvement in the attack and said Tehran was prepared to undertake joint investigations with Kuwait "to identify the origin of the incident and parties involved in it," according to a post on his Telegram channel.
paras.zh: 伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇否认伊朗参与了此次袭击，并表示德黑兰准备与科威特进行联合调查，“以确定事件的起源和参与方”，根据其 Telegram 频道上的帖子。

paras.en: The regional conflict erupted on Feb. 28 when the U.S. and Israel launched attacks on Iran, and it has since widened to include Iranian strikes on Israel and Gulf Arab states hosting U.S. military bases.
paras.zh: 地区冲突于2月28日爆发，当时美国和以色列对伊朗发动袭击，此后冲突扩大到伊朗对以色列和拥有美国军事基地的海湾阿拉伯国家发动袭击。

paras.en: "During the European Council meeting, I learned of the tragic deaths of two Italian citizens in the attack in Kuwait," Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said in a post on X on Thursday.
paras.zh: “在欧洲理事会会议期间，我获悉两名意大利公民在科威特袭击事件中惨死，”意大利总理乔治亚·梅洛尼周四在 X 上发帖称。

paras.en: "On behalf of myself and the Government, I express my deepest sorrow and extend my heartfelt condolences to the victims' families."
paras.zh: “我谨代表我个人和政府表达最深切的悲痛，并向遇难者家属表示诚挚的慰问。”

paras.en: Earlier in November, Iran said it had targeted U.S. drone and missile sites in Kuwait after the United States struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 11月初，伊朗表示，在美国袭击霍尔木兹海峡的格什姆岛后，伊朗已将美国在科威特的无人机和导弹基地作为目标。

articles.title: Thousands march during International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women
articles.author: John Mazerolle

paras.en: Thousands march during International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women
paras.zh: 数千人在消除对妇女的暴力行为国际日游行

paras.en: Marches, protests and other events took place worldwide, including in Canada, Europe and South America
paras.zh: 世界各地都发生了游行、抗议和其他活动，包括加拿大、欧洲和南美洲

paras.en: Thousands of people marched at events worldwide on Wednesday to mark the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women.
paras.zh: 周三，数千人在世界各地举行活动，纪念消除对妇女的暴力行为国际日。

paras.en: "Everyone deserves to feel safe in their home, in their community and in their relationships," Rechie Valdez, Canada's federal minister of women and gender equality, said in a statement. "Yet for too many women, girls and 2SLGBTQI+ people, that safety is still not guaranteed."
paras.zh: 加拿大联邦妇女和性别平等部长雷奇·瓦尔迪兹在一份声明中表示：“每个人都应该在自己的家、社区和人际关系中感到安全。” “然而，对于太多女性、女孩和 2SLGBTQI+ 人群来说，安全仍然得不到保证。”

paras.en: Here's a visual tour of some of the protests and marches worldwide. All photos are from Wednesday and commemorated the international day.
paras.zh: 这是世界各地一些抗议和游行的视觉之旅。所有照片均来自星期三并纪念国际日。

paras.en: A man walks past a large mural bearing the inscription 'No More Femicide' on the side of a building to mark the day, also known as Orange Day, in Gelsenkirchen, Germany. (Martin Meissner/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 在德国盖尔森基兴，一名男子走过一栋大楼一侧的大型壁画，上面刻有“不再杀戮女性”的字样，以纪念这一天，也被称为“橙色日”。 （马丁·迈斯纳/美联社）

paras.en: Activists from the Not One Less feminist group protest outside a conference hall in Rome where Catholic groups were holding a conference on birth rates. (Alessandra Tarantino/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 来自“一个不差”女权主义团体的活动人士在罗马的一个会议厅外抗议，天主教团体正在该会议厅举行出生率会议。 （亚历山德拉·塔伦蒂诺/美联社）

paras.en: A woman dressed as a bride marches in Quito, Ecuador. (Dolores Ochoa/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 一名打扮成新娘的妇女在厄瓜多尔基多游行。 （多洛雷斯·奥乔亚/美联社）

paras.en: A woman holds a flare as she takes part in a protest in Bogota, Colombia. (Luisa Gonzalez/Reuters)
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚波哥大，一名妇女手持照明弹参加抗议活动。 （路易莎·冈萨雷斯/路透社）

paras.en: Women stage a street performance dressed in traditional dress and displaying the names of victims on their skirts, during a march against gender-based violence in El Alto, Bolivia. (Claudia Morales/Reuters)
paras.zh: 在玻利维亚埃尔阿尔托反对性别暴力的游行中，妇女们身着传统服装进行街头表演，裙子上写着受害者的名字。 （克劳迪娅·莫拉莱斯/路透社）

paras.en: A woman performs a traditional dance from northern Chile during a march in Barcelona, Spain. (Nacho Doce/Reuters)
paras.zh: 一名妇女在西班牙巴塞罗那的游行中表演来自智利北部的传统舞蹈。 （纳乔·多西/路透社）

paras.en: Protesters scuffle with Turkish police officers during a demonstration in Istanbul. (Berk Ozkan/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 在伊斯坦布尔的一次示威活动中，抗议者与土耳其警察发生扭打。 （伯克·奥兹坎/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Protesters dressed in black carry a mock coffin reading 'not one more' next to a mock tombstone reading '1,352 women killed since 2017, start of [Emmanuel] Macron's presidency,' during a demonstration in Bordeaux, France. (Philippe Lopez/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 在法国波尔多举行的示威活动中，身着黑衣的抗议者抬着一个假棺材，上面写着“不再有一个”，旁边还有一个假墓碑，上面写着“自 2017 年马克龙总统任期以来，有 1,352 名女性被杀”。 （菲利普·洛佩兹/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: People take part in a ceremony at Niagara's regional headquarters in Thorold, Ont., near a flag calling for an end to gender-based violence. Similar ceremonies were held in 11 of the Niagara region's 12 cities and towns. (Paul Forsyth/CBC)
paras.zh: 人们参加在安大略省索罗尔德的尼亚加拉地区总部举行的仪式，旁边悬挂着呼吁结束性别暴力的旗帜。尼亚加拉地区 12 个城镇中的 11 个也举行了类似的仪式。 （保罗·福赛思/CBC）

articles.title: FIFA says a cyberattack against it targeted a 'limited set of personal and business information'

paras.en: FIFA told news agencies on Thursday that it had been targeted by a person or group seeking access to its data.
paras.zh: 国际足联周四告诉新闻机构，它已成为寻求获取其数据的个人或团体的目标。

paras.en: "FIFA can confirm that it has been the victim of a criminal cyberattack resulting in unauthorized access to a limited set of personal and business information," a FIFA spokesperson told the Reuters news agency, issuing similar comments to other outlets.
paras.zh: 国际足联发言人对路透社表示：“国际足联可以确认，它是犯罪网络攻击的受害者，该攻击导致未经授权的访问一组有限的个人和商业信息。”并向其他媒体发表了类似的评论。

paras.en: Reuters cited a person "with direct knowledge of the matter" as saying that less than 0.1% of FIFA's total data had been compromised.
paras.zh: 路透社援引一位“直接了解此事”的人士的话称，国际足联总数据中不到 0.1% 的数据被泄露。

paras.en: This person also said that no files from the controversial, abandoned FIFA Forward Enterprise project that looked to sell a stake in the World Cup to private investors had been accessed.
paras.zh: 这位人士还表示，尚未获得有争议的、被放弃的 FIFA Forward Enterprise 项目的任何文件，该项目旨在向私人投资者出售世界杯的股份。

paras.en: What else did FIFA say about the cyberattack?
paras.zh: 国际足联关于网络攻击还说了些什么？

paras.en: FIFA said that it was working closely with the relevant authorities, including law enforcement, in the aftermath of the event.
paras.zh: 国际足联表示，事件发生后，它正在与包括执法部门在内的有关当局密切合作。

paras.en: It did not say when the attack took place, list the precise nature of the compromised data or specify how unauthorized access to FIFA data had been sought, amid reports of people having posed as FIFA officials rather than actually hacking the organization or otherwise compromising its cybersecurity systems.
paras.zh: 它没有说明攻击发生的时间，没有列出受损数据的确切性质，也没有具体说明如何寻求对国际足联数据的未经授权的访问，有报道称，有人冒充国际足联官员，而不是实际入侵该组织或以其他方式损害其网络安全系统。

paras.en: "FIFA condemns in the strongest possible terms the unlawful acquisition and publication of information, particularly personal data," the Zurich-based organization said. "Such actions constitute a serious and unacceptable violation of privacy and can have significant consequences for the individuals concerned."
paras.zh: 这家总部位于苏黎世的组织表示：“国际足联以最强烈的措辞谴责非法获取和发布信息，特别是个人数据的行为。” “此类行为构成了严重且不可接受的侵犯隐私行为，可能会给相关个人带来重大后果。”

paras.en: Last week, a group calling itself the Handsome Boy Hacking Club posted a screenshot of what it said were FIFA files. Three days later, it appeared to take credit for the cyberattack when responding to a post saying that more than 12 gigabytes of internal documents had been posted.
paras.zh: 上周，一个自称“帅哥黑客俱乐部”的组织发布了一张自称是 FIFA 文件的屏幕截图。三天后，该公司在回复称超过 12 GB 的内部文件已被发布的帖子时，似乎将网络攻击归功于自己。

paras.en: FIFA did not explicitly state whether it was talking about the same supposed incident.
paras.zh: 国际足联没有明确说明是否在谈论同一事件。

paras.en: The breach comes at a sensitive time for the organization. Still reeling from the scandal following this summer's World Cup of its now-aborted plans to sell off World Cup commercial rights shares, it's now trying to secure another term for its embattled president, Gianni Infantino.
paras.zh: 这次违规事件发生在该组织的敏感时刻。今年夏天的世界杯后，该公司出售世界杯商业版权股份的计划已中止，但仍饱受丑闻的困扰，目前正试图为其陷入困境的总裁詹尼·因凡蒂诺(Gianni Infantino)争取连任。

paras.en: Infantino is the favorite for an election on March 18, when he is expected toface challenges from Kohzo Tashima of Japan and Philippe Diallo of France. But until the turbulence of the last six months, it seemed most likely he would simply stand unopposed and extend his 11-year tenure without a fight.
paras.zh: 因凡蒂诺是 3 月 18 日大选的热门人选，届时他预计将面临来自日本的田岛晃三和法国的菲利普·迪亚洛的挑战。但在经历了过去六个月的动荡之前，他似乎很可能会毫无抵抗地坚持下去，不战而屈人之兵地延长他 11 年的任期。

articles.title: Africa's opposition voices face growing pressure

paras.en: From Cameroon and Tanzania to Mozambique, Nigeria and Zambia, opposition leaders have accused authorities of limiting political freedoms through legal action and restrictions on public activity.
paras.zh: 从喀麦隆和坦桑尼亚到莫桑比克、尼日利亚和赞比亚，反对派领导人指责当局通过法律行动和限制公共活动来限制政治自由。

paras.en: In each case, officials have said the measures are justified under national laws and security provisions.
paras.zh: 在每一起案件中，官员们都表示，根据国家法律和安全规定，这些措施都是合理的。

paras.en: "Cameroon is very sensitive, and it is important that we know when to criticize the government and when not to criticize the government openly," said Ngam Glory Ani Mbom, a citizen of the central African country.
paras.zh: “喀麦隆非常敏感，重要的是我们知道何时批评政府、何时不公开批评政府，”中非国家公民恩加姆·格洛里·阿尼·姆博姆说。

paras.en: She said fear of arrest and violence discourage political participation. "You cannot talk about democracy when opposition supporters cannot freely express their minds to the public," she told DW.
paras.zh: 她说，对逮捕和暴力的恐惧阻碍了政治参与。她告诉德国之声：“当反对派支持者无法自由地向公众表达自己的想法时，你就无法谈论民主。”

paras.en: For Ndah Grimbald, deputy secretary-general of Cameroon's opposition Social Democratic Front, one of the biggest obstacles is organizing public meetings.
paras.zh: 对于喀麦隆反对党社会民主阵线副秘书长恩达·格里姆巴尔德来说，最大的障碍之一是组织公开集会。

paras.en: "The first major challenge we face as members of the opposition is the non-authorization of public rallies, public meetings," he said, noting that opposition proposals receive little attention in parliament. "Private members' bills are not even listened to."
paras.zh: 他说：“作为反对派成员，我们面临的第一个主要挑战是未经授权举行公开集会和公开会议。”他指出，反对派的提案在议会中很少受到关注。 “私人议员的法案甚至没有被听取。”

paras.en: Cameroonian law guarantees freedom of assembly but allows authorities to restrict gatherings on grounds of public order or national security. Organizers are also required to notify officials in advance.
paras.zh: 喀麦隆法律保障集会自由，但允许当局以公共秩序或国家安全为由限制集会。组织者还必须提前通知官员。

paras.en: In Tanzania, opposition leader Tundu Lissu was arrested in April 2025 and charged with treason. In November 2026, the High Court acquitted Lissu of treason but convicted him of incitement and sentenced him to four years in prison.
paras.zh: 在坦桑尼亚，反对派领导人通杜·利苏 (Tundu Lissu) 于 2025 年 4 月被捕，并被指控犯有叛国罪。 2026年11月，高等法院宣判利苏叛国罪不成立，但判处他煽动罪并判处四年监禁。

paras.en: Prosecutors argued that Lissu's remarks were intended to disrupt Tanzania's 2025 general election. In its ruling, the court said it was satisfied that his statements were intended to "disrupt elections and instigate violence."
paras.zh: 检察官辩称，Lissu 的言论旨在扰乱坦桑尼亚 2025 年大选。法院在裁决中表示，对他的言论旨在“扰乱选举并煽动暴力”感到满意。

paras.en: Lissu rejected the verdict, calling the case "political persecution." He told the judges: "I was not charged with incitement but you judges are convicting me with it just to impress the person who gives you the titles." He added: "Excuses were created to imprison me."
paras.zh: 利苏拒绝了这一判决，称此案为“政治迫害”。他告诉法官：“我没有被指控煽动罪，但你们法官判定我有罪，只是为了给授予你们头衔的人留下深刻印象。”他补充道：“有人编造借口来监禁我。”

paras.en: Gerson Msigwa, Tanzania's chief government spokesperson, directly rejected allegations of political repression and human rights violations.
paras.zh: 坦桑尼亚首席政府发言人格尔森·姆西格瓦直接否认了政治镇压和侵犯人权的指控。

paras.en: "Concerns of diminishing civic space and restrictions on political parties to engage in political processes in the lead-up to the general election are unfounded and misleading," Msigwa said in response to Amnesty International's accusations of a "wave of terror" sweeping Tanzania ahead of the 2025 vote.
paras.zh: 姆西格瓦在回应国际特赦组织关于 2025 年大选前席卷坦桑尼亚的“恐怖浪潮”的指控时表示，“对公民空间缩小以及大选前政党参与政治进程受到限制的担忧是毫无根据的，而且具有误导性。”

paras.en: In Mozambique, opposition figure Venancio Mondlane faces five charges linked to protests after the disputed 2024 election, including incitement to terrorism and public advocacy of crime. Prosecutors have accused him of encouraging violence and civil disobedience. Mondlane has denied the allegations.
paras.zh: 在莫桑比克，反对派人物 Venancio Mondlane 面临五​​项与有争议的 2024 年选举后抗议活动有关的指控，包括煽动恐怖主义和公开宣传犯罪。检察官指控他鼓励暴力和公民不服从。蒙德兰否认了这些指控。

paras.en: "I have more than enough evidence. There's plenty to go around. Many of my statements were precisely in the opposite direction," he told DW, adding that the protests were intended to prevent violence.
paras.zh: 他对德国之声表示：“我有足够的证据。有很多证据可供参考。我的许多言论恰恰相反。”他补充说，抗议活动的目的是为了防止暴力。

paras.en: Pedro Sinai Nhatitima, a judge counselor and spokesperson for Mozambique's Supreme Court, defended the court's decision not to allow live broadcasts of Mondlane's trial. He denied that the proceedings are politically influenced, saying the court will decide the case according to the law.
paras.zh: 莫桑比克最高法院法官顾问兼发言人佩德罗·西奈·纳蒂蒂玛(Pedro Sinai Nhatitima)为法院不允许现场直播蒙德拉内审判的决定进行了辩护。他否认诉讼程序受到政治影响，并表示法院将依法判决此案。

paras.en: In Nigeria, police in Borno State recently arrested five men wearing T-shirts bearing the slogan "Tinubu Must Go!"
paras.zh: 在尼日利亚，博尔诺州警方最近逮捕了五名身穿印有“蒂努布必须走！”T恤的男子。

paras.en: The police said the men were not arrested for their political views, but were found with suspected drugs and other items. The men face allegations including public disturbance and thuggery.
paras.zh: 警方表示，这些人并不是因为政治观点而被捕，而是被发现携带可疑毒品和其他物品。这些人面临包括公共骚乱和谋杀在内的指控。

paras.en: In Kano, police blocked access to a venue for a planned meeting, citing public safety concerns.
paras.zh: 在卡诺，警方以公共安全为由，封锁了计划举行会议的地点。

paras.en: In Zambia, opposition leader Brian Mundubile has criticized what he describes as a retreat from democratic rights. The courts were closed on August 24, the final day for filing a presidential election petition. The judiciary cited security reasons, while police said intelligence-led security assessments were underway at several government institutions.
paras.zh: 在赞比亚，反对派领袖布赖恩·蒙杜比莱(Brian Mundubile)批评了他所说的民主权利的倒退。 8 月 24 日是提交总统选举请愿书的最后一天，法院休庭。司法部门援引了安全原因，而警方则表示，多个政府机构正在进行情报主导的安全评估。

paras.en: State House presidential aide Clayson Hamasaka denied that President Hakainde Hichilema had ordered the closure to prevent an election challenge.
paras.zh: 州议会大厦总统助理克莱森·滨坂否认总统哈凯恩德·希奇莱马下令关闭该设施以防止选举挑战。

paras.en: The same month, former opposition lawmaker and cabinet minister Mutotwe Kafwaya was shot dead during a security operation at Mundubile's residence. Authorities said the operation followed intelligence about individuals considered a national security threat, and that officers came under gunfire and returned fire.
paras.zh: 同月，前反对派议员兼内阁部长穆托维·卡夫瓦亚在蒙杜比莱官邸的一次安全行动中被枪杀。当局表示，此次行动是根据有关被视为国家安全威胁的个人的情报进行的，警察遭到枪击并还击。

paras.en: Mundubile, who faces treason and sedition charges with other opposition figures, has called for fairness in the proceedings. "We expect an open court process. We are innocent of all the charges against us," he said.
paras.zh: 蒙杜比勒与其他反对派人士一起面临叛国和煽动叛乱指控，他呼吁诉讼程序公平。 “我们期待公开的法庭程序。我们对所有针对我们的指控都是无辜的，”他说。

paras.en: Zambian constitutional lawyer Linda Kasonde has warned: "As you can see, our public institutions are on trial. Democracy in Zambia is on trial."
paras.zh: 赞比亚宪法律师琳达·卡松德警告说：“如你所见，我们的公共机构正在接受审判。赞比亚的民主正在接受审判。”

paras.en: Cameroonian political analyst Kinang Derick Fai said that despite the setbacks, democratic development across the continent remains a work in progress.
paras.zh: 喀麦隆政治分析家基南·德里克·费伊表示，尽管遇到了挫折，整个非洲大陆的民主发展仍在进行中。

paras.en: "We are far from getting to the best level," he said. "It is a democracy still struggling to find its way."
paras.zh: “我们还远未达到最佳水平，”他说。 “这是一个仍在努力寻找出路的民主国家。”

paras.en: DW correspondent Moki Edwin Kindzeka contributed reporting.
paras.zh: 德国之声通讯员莫基·埃德温·金泽卡 (Moki Edwin Kindzeka) 提供了报道。

articles.title: Is authoritarian Vietnam ready to phase out the death penalty?

paras.en: Vietnam, a country once considered one of the world's most prolific executioners, is steadily reducing the number of crimes punishable by death.
paras.zh: 越南曾被认为是世界上刽子手最多的国家之一，目前正在稳步减少可判处死刑的犯罪数量。

paras.en: On November 20, the country's National Assembly approved a revised penal code that abolishes capital punishment for six offenses, including drug trafficking, rape of a person under the age of 16 and crimes against humanity.
paras.zh: 11月20日，该国国民议会批准了修订后的刑法，废除了对六种罪行的死刑，包括贩毒、强奸16岁以下儿童和危害人类罪。

paras.en: When the legislation takes effect next March, just four offenses — treason, murder, terrorism and illegal drug production — will remain punishable by death, down from 44 in 1997.
paras.zh: 当这项立法明年 3 月生效时，只有四种罪行——叛国罪、谋杀罪、恐怖主义罪和非法毒品生产罪——仍然会被判处死刑，这一数字比 1997 年的 44 种有所减少。

paras.en: Although Hanoi has given little indication that it intends to do away with capital punishment entirely, few countries that still regularly execute prisoners have narrowed its legal application so considerably.
paras.zh: 尽管河内几乎没有表示打算完全废除死刑，但很少有仍然定期处决囚犯的国家如此大幅度地缩小了死刑的法律适用范围。

paras.en: The reforms are particularly striking given that they come as Vietnam's ruling Communist Party has intensified its crackdown on political dissent and independent civil society.
paras.zh: 鉴于越南执政的共产党加强了对政治异见和独立公民社会的镇压，这些改革尤其引人注目。

paras.en: General Luong Tam Quang, the minister of public security, said the changes reflect humanitarian considerations, the need for more proportionate sentencing and Vietnam's international integration, while maintaining a tough approach to crime, according to the state-run Vietnam News Agency.
paras.zh: 据国营越南通讯社报道，公安部部长梁谭光将军表示，这些变化反映了人道主义考虑、更加相称的量刑和越南融入国际的需要，同时保持对犯罪的强硬态度。

paras.en: Vietnam's gradual reduction in the number of offenses punishable by death reflects an evolution in its criminal justice philosophy, said Tran Dai Lam, a lawyer at the ANVI law firm in Hanoi.
paras.zh: 河内 ANVI 律师事务所的律师 Tran Dai Lam 表示，越南逐渐减少可判处死刑的犯罪数量，反映出其刑事司法理念的演变。

paras.en: "There is a growing recognition that the effectiveness of criminal law depends not necessarily on the severity of punishment, but on the certainty that criminal offenses are detected, prosecuted and punished," he told DW.
paras.zh: “人们越来越认识到，刑法的有效性不一定取决于惩罚的严厉程度，而是取决于刑事犯罪被发现、起诉和惩罚的确定性，”他告诉德国之声。

paras.en: Moving toward abolishing the death penalty?
paras.zh: 朝着废除死刑迈进？

paras.en: Vietnam's latest reforms come barely a year after the National Assembly abolished the death penalty for eight other offenses, including embezzlement, bribery, espionage and the illegal transportation of drugs.
paras.zh: 越南的最新改革是在国民议会废除对其他八项罪行（包括贪污、贿赂、间谍活动和非法运输毒品）的死刑仅一年后进行的。

paras.en: The removal of capital punishment for drug trafficking is particularly significant given the prominence of narcotics-related offenses in Vietnam's criminal justice system and the country's proximity to the Golden Triangle, one of the world's largest illicit drug-producing regions.
paras.zh: 鉴于越南刑事司法系统中毒品相关犯罪的突出地位，以及该国靠近世界上最大的非法毒品产区之一金三角，取消对贩毒的死刑尤为重要。

paras.en: The new legislation also provides for existing death sentences to be commuted to life imprisonment for offenses that will no longer carry the death penalty.
paras.zh: 新立法还规定，对于不再适用死刑的罪行，现有死刑可减为无期徒刑。

paras.en: Hai Luong, a lecturer in criminology at Griffith University in Australia, told DW that Vietnam has been taking a "retentionist-but-reductionist" approach.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚格里菲斯大学犯罪学讲师海良告诉德国之声，越南一直采取“保留主义但还原主义”的做法。

paras.en: "Vietnam is reforming the death penalty rather than abolishing it," he said. "The trend is towards a more limited and selective use of capital punishment, but not yet towards its complete removal."
paras.zh: “越南正在改革而不是废除死刑，”他说。 “趋势是更加有限和有选择性地使用死刑，但尚未完全废除。”

paras.en: According to Luong, the gradual reduction in capital offenses reflects Hanoi's efforts to modernize its legal system without relinquishing its authority to severely punish what it considers the most serious crimes.
paras.zh: 梁说，死刑罪名的逐渐减少反映了河内在不放弃严厉惩罚其认为最严重犯罪的权力的情况下，努力实现法律制度现代化。

paras.en: Vietnam's integration into international norms
paras.zh: 越南融入国际规范

paras.en: Growing international recognition that capital punishment has little additional deterrent effect is also informing Vietnam's approach, he explained.
paras.zh: 他解释说，国际社会越来越认识到死刑几乎没有额外的威慑作用，这也为越南的做法提供了信息。

paras.en: Decades of harsh penalties for drug-related offenses have done little to stem the international narcotics trade, while the continued expansion of drug trafficking networks in Southeast Asia has raised questions about the effectiveness of executions as a crime prevention measure.
paras.zh: 几十年来对毒品相关犯罪的严厉处罚对阻止国际毒品贸易收效甚微，而东南亚贩毒网络的持续扩张引发了人们对处决作为预防犯罪措施的有效性的质疑。

paras.en: Vietnam's growing integration into the international community, including its participation in international drug control conventions and closer diplomatic ties with Western countries, has also given Hanoi greater incentives to align its criminal justice system with international standards, Luong added.
paras.zh: 梁补充说，越南日益融入国际社会，包括参加国际禁毒公约以及与西方国家建立更密切的外交关系，也使河内更有动力使其刑事司法制度与国际标准接轨。

paras.en: Vietnam's gradual retreat from capital punishment could also bring it closer to the European Union on human rights.
paras.zh: 越南逐步退出死刑也可能使其在人权问题上与欧盟更加接近。

paras.en: Brussels has repeatedly called on Hanoi to abolish capital punishment, a subject regularly raised during bilateral human rights discussions. The EU, one of the world's most vocal advocates of abolition, has long opposed capital punishment as part of its foreign policy.
paras.zh: 布鲁塞尔多次呼吁河内废除死刑，这是双边人权讨论中经常提出的话题。欧盟是世界上最强烈主张废除死刑的国家之一，长期以来一直反对将死刑作为其外交政策的一部分。

paras.en: An EU spokesperson told DW that Brussels welcomes "Vietnam's latest reduction in crimes punishable by capital punishment. This is a positive step and shows a disposition to consider gradual reform, leading towards a moratorium first and finally to the abolition of the death penalty."
paras.zh: 一位欧盟发言人告诉德国之声，布鲁塞尔欢迎“越南最近减少了可判处死刑的犯罪行为。这是积极的一步，表明了考虑逐步改革的倾向，首先是暂停死刑，最后是废除死刑。”

paras.en: "Any concrete step towards this ultimate goal would be very much welcomed by the EU," they added.
paras.zh: 他们补充说：“实现这一最终目标的任何具体步骤都将受到欧盟的欢迎。”

paras.en: However, Vietnam's reforms still fall short of international human rights standards, particularly since the death penalty remains available for drug-related offenses that do not involve intentional killing.
paras.zh: 然而，越南的改革仍然没有达到国际人权标准，特别是因为不涉及故意杀人的毒品相关犯罪仍然可以判处死刑。

paras.en: Nor is there much evidence that progress on capital punishment is accompanied by improvements in other areas of Vietnam's human rights record, notably freedom of expression and association.
paras.zh: 也没有太多证据表明，死刑方面的进展伴随着越南人权记录其他领域的改善，特别是言论和结社自由。

paras.en: How often is the death penalty used in Vietnam?
paras.zh: 越南多久使用一次死刑？

paras.en: It is also difficult to establish whether Vietnam's legislative reforms have resulted in fewer executions.
paras.zh: 也很难确定越南的立法改革是否导致了处决人数减少。

paras.en: The authorities classify execution statistics as state secrets. Amnesty International believes Vietnam continues to make extensive use of capital punishment, but it cannot provide reliable annual figures.
paras.zh: 当局将执行统计数据列为国家机密。国际特赦组织认为，越南继续广泛使用死刑，但无法提供可靠的年度数据。

paras.en: Vietnam's capital punishment reform allows the state to continue executing people to fulfil its political and public security goals, "while also managing, or massaging, its international reputation through highly publicized 'reductionist' reforms," Daniel Pascoe, an associate professor of law at the City University of Hong Kong and an expert on capital punishment, told DW
paras.zh: 香港城市大学法学副教授、死刑问题专家丹尼尔·帕斯科（Daniel Pascoe）告诉德国之声，越南的死刑改革允许国家继续处决人员，以实现其政治和公共安全目标，“同时通过广为人知的‘还原论’改革来管理或按摩其国际声誉”

paras.en: For example, he added, although the recent abolition of the death penalty for drug trafficking is welcome, "it doesn't tell us whether the Vietnamese authorities will now simply charge a higher number of suspects with the drug production offense, which remains death-eligible."
paras.zh: 例如，他补充说，尽管最近废除贩毒死刑值得欢迎，但“这并没有告诉我们越南当局现在是否会简单地以毒品生产罪指控更多的嫌疑人，而该罪名仍然符合死刑资格。”

paras.en: Southeast Asia shifts away from capital punishment
paras.zh: 东南亚放弃死刑

paras.en: Vietnam's reforms are part of a broader, if uneven, shift away from capital punishment in Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: 越南的改革是东南亚更广泛（尽管不均衡）的废除死刑的一部分。

paras.en: Cambodia, the Philippines and East Timor have abolished the death penalty altogether. Malaysia abolished mandatory death sentences in 2023, while Indonesia's new penal code, which took effect this year, allows for death sentences to be commuted under certain conditions following a 10-year probationary period.
paras.zh: 柬埔寨、菲律宾和东帝汶已完全废除死刑。马来西亚于 2023 年废除了强制性死刑，而印度尼西亚今年生效的新刑法允许死刑判决在 10 年缓刑期后在某些条件下可以减刑。

paras.en: However, Singapore has increased its use of capital punishment in recent years, particularly for drug-related offenses, while Myanmar's military authorities resumed executions in 2022 after a hiatus of more than three decades.
paras.zh: 然而，新加坡近年来增加了死刑的使用，特别是针对毒品相关犯罪，而缅甸军事当局在中断三十多年后于 2022 年恢复了死刑。

paras.en: Pascoe told DW that although the impact of Vietnam's reforms on execution numbers remains unclear, there is symbolic significance in one of Southeast Asia's most authoritarian governments visibly restricting the death penalty.
paras.zh: 帕斯科告诉德国之声，尽管越南的改革对处决数量的影响尚不清楚，但东南亚最专制的政府之一明显限制死刑具有象征意义。

paras.en: "If a one-party state like Vietnam can reduce the scope of capital punishment, why shouldn't Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, Laos, Brunei and Myanmar also do so?" Pascoe added.
paras.zh: “如果像越南这样的一党制国家可以减少死刑的范围，为什么新加坡、印度尼西亚、泰国、马来西亚、老挝、文莱和缅甸不应该这样做呢？”帕斯科补充道。

paras.en: The number of countries actively executing people is close to being at an all-time low, but those that are actively executing, such as Iran and Singapore, seem to be increasing their use, Sara Kowal, co-director of Eleos Justice, a research and advocacy initiative against the death penalty at Australia's Monash University, told DW.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚莫纳什大学反死刑研究和倡导项目 Eleos Justice 联合主任萨拉·科瓦尔 (Sara Kowal) 向德国之声表示，积极执行死刑的国家数量接近历史最低水平，但伊朗和新加坡等积极执行死刑的国家似乎正在增加死刑的使用。

paras.en: "Vietnam's dramatic reduction of death-eligible offenses is another really positive sign that the global trend towards abolishing the death penalty is continuing," Kowal said.
paras.zh: 科瓦尔说：“越南大幅减少死刑罪名，这是另一个真正积极的迹象，表明全球废除死刑的趋势仍在继续。”

paras.en: "It would be great to see Vietnam take the next step to establish an official moratorium on all executions," she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“很高兴看到越南采取下一步行动，正式暂停所有处决。”

paras.en: According to Amnesty International, 17 countries carried out executions in 2025, among them China, Saudi Arabia, Yemen and the US.
paras.zh: 据国际特赦组织称，2025年有17个国家执行了死刑，其中包括中国、沙特阿拉伯、也门和美国。

articles.title: New Zealand election results set up tricky talks for conservative incumbent

paras.en: The final results of New Zealand’s November 7 election offer no clear path to forming a government, suggesting tricky political wrangling is likely in the weeks ahead.
paras.zh: 新西兰 11 月 7 日选举的最终结果没有提供组建政府的明确途径，这表明未来几周可能会出现棘手的政治角力。

paras.en: The results, released on Friday, showed that the ruling centre-right coalition led by Prime Minister Christopher Luxon’s conservative National Party has fallen one seat short of a parliamentary majority.
paras.zh: 周五公布的结果显示，总理克里斯托弗·卢克森(Christopher Luxon)领导的保守派国家党领导的执政的中右翼联盟距离议会多数席位仅差一个席位。

paras.en: Luxon has led New Zealand since 2023, but National and its junior partners – the populist New Zealand First and libertarian ACT – won just 65 seats between them. National secured 40 seats while ACT and New Zealand First won 13 seats and 12 seats, respectively.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年以来，Luxon 一直领先新西兰，但国家党及其初级合作伙伴——民粹主义的新西兰优先党和自由主义的行动党——只赢得了 65 个席位。国家党获得40个席位，行动党和新西兰优先党分别赢得13个和12个席位。

paras.en: The result reflects a loss of support for Luxon driven by a stagnant economy, and leaves the former businessman and his coalition partners to seek additional help to secure a majority.
paras.zh: 这一结果反映出卢克森因经济停滞而失去了支持，使得这位前商人和他的联盟伙伴必须寻求额外的帮助才能获得多数席位。

paras.en: “New Zealanders need a government that is stable, that works together and will last for the full term,” Luxon told a news conference on Friday.
paras.zh: 卢克森在周五的新闻发布会上表示：“新西兰人需要一个稳定、团结合作、能够持续整个任期的政府。”

paras.en: Labour, the largest opposition party, won 36 seats, leaving it far below the 66-seat threshold in the 130-member parliament.
paras.zh: 最大反对党工党赢得了36个席位，远低于在130名议员的议会中获得66个席位的门槛。

paras.en: The results appear to position Qiulae Wong’s centrist Opportunity Party, which clinched 7 seats, as kingmaker. However, talks with the conservative and populist incumbents are likely to prove tricky.
paras.zh: 结果似乎将黄秋来领导的中间派机会党定位为拥王者，该党赢得了 7 个席位。然而，与保守派和民粹主义现任者的谈判可能会很棘手。

paras.en: The former consultant has promised a universal basic income of up to NZ$370 (US$208) a week, greater action on climate change, a ban on bottom-trawling fishing, and healthcare reforms.
paras.zh: 这位前顾问承诺每周提供高达 370 新西兰元（208 美元）的全民基本收入、针对气候变化采取更大行动、禁止底拖网捕鱼以及医疗改革。

paras.en: She has also campaigned for a kinder approach to politics. Wong has pledged to do “everything we can” to ensure a stable government.
paras.zh: 她还致力于以更友善的方式对待政治。黄先生承诺将“尽我们所能”确保政府稳定。

paras.en: Her style contrasts with that of potential suitors such as Winston Peters of New Zealand First. The controversial foreign minister has called opponents “morons” and drew shock earlier this year when he told a Chinese-born lawmaker to “go back to your country”. His party promises to tighten immigration flows and withdraw from the Paris Climate Accord.
paras.zh: 她的风格与新西兰优先党的温斯顿·彼得斯等潜在追求者的风格形成鲜明对比。这位备受争议的外交部长称对手为“白痴”，并在今年早些时候告诉一名中国出生的议员“滚回你的国家去”，这引起了人们的震惊。他的政党承诺收紧移民流动并退出《巴黎气候协议》。

paras.en: Deputy Prime Minister David Seymour of ACT campaigned against a greater governance role for the Indigenous Maori minority and has promised massive cuts to state spending.
paras.zh: 首都领地副总理大卫·西摩反对让土著毛利少数民族发挥更大的治理作用，并承诺大幅削减国家支出。

paras.en: Failure to meet an agreement could see Kiwis return to the polls next year.
paras.zh: 如果未能达成协议，新西兰人可能会在明年重返投票站。

paras.en: Luke Oldfield, a political scientist at Victoria University of Wellington, told Reuters news agency a deal was likely, although it could be challenging.
paras.zh: 惠灵顿维多利亚大学政治学家卢克·奥德菲尔德（Luke Oldfield）告诉路透社，尽管可能具有挑战性，但达成协议是有可能的。

paras.en: “I don’t know exactly what kind of shape that will be yet, but it’ll be highly likely that there will be a right bloc formed and not a second election,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我还不知道具体会是什么样的形式，但很可能会形成一个正确的集团，而不是举行第二次选举。”

articles.title: ‘Will I get taller?’: Gaza’s children suffer stunting amid war, blockade

paras.en: Khan Younis, Gaza – Every time seven-year-old Nabigha al-Zaqzouq stands beside children her age, she notices the difference in their heights and asks her mother, Alia: “Will I ever get taller?”
paras.zh: 加沙汗尤尼斯 - 每当七岁的纳比哈·扎克祖克 (Nabigha al-Zaqzouq) 站在与她同龄的孩子旁边时，她都会注意到他们身高的差异，并问她的母亲阿莉亚：“我会长高吗？”

paras.en: Nabigha is 99cm (3.2ft) tall and weighs just 10kg (22lb), making her appear several years younger than she actually is.
paras.zh: Nabigha 身高 99 厘米（3.2 英尺），体重仅为 10 公斤（22 磅），使她看起来比实际年龄年轻好几岁。

paras.en: At home, the family’s dining table reflects part of her struggle. Bread and canned food are among the few options available, while meat, fruit and vegetables are beyond the family’s means. Alia tries to provide her daughter with a varied diet but struggles to afford food, as well as the medicines and medical tests needed to monitor her growth.
paras.zh: 在家里，家里的餐桌反映了她奋斗的一部分。面包和罐头食品是为数不多的选择，而肉类、水果和蔬菜则超出了家庭的承受能力。阿莉亚试图为女儿提供多样化的饮食，但难以负担食物以及监测她生长所需的药物和医学检查。

paras.en: “We lived through extremely harsh days during the war, and after the ceasefire, we are living under a suffocating blockade. Let them allow medicines and treatments in,” she says. During medical visits, Alia has also started noticing other children with similar growth problems.
paras.zh: “我们在战争期间度过了极其艰难的日子，停火后，我们生活在令人窒息的封锁之下。让他们允许药品和治疗进入，”她说。在就诊期间，阿莉亚也开始注意到其他有类似成长问题的孩子。

paras.en: Five-year-old Tala Zidan faces a similar struggle. She is 94cm (3ft) tall, about 15-16cm shorter than the average for children her age.
paras.zh: 五岁的塔拉·齐丹也面临着类似的困境。她身高 94 厘米（3 英尺），比同龄儿童的平均身高约矮 15-16 厘米。

paras.en: Her father, Tahrir Zidan, says her height has remained almost unchanged over the past two years, while she has lost some weight. Since the family was displaced from Khuza’a to al-Mawasi amid Israel’s genocide, he has lost his job, making food a daily challenge. The family now relies on meals provided by charitable community kitchens.
paras.zh: 她的父亲塔里尔·齐丹说，她的身高在过去两年里几乎没有变化，但体重却减轻了一些。由于以色列的种族灭绝，全家从库扎阿流离失所到马瓦西，他失去了工作，使食物成为每天的挑战。这个家庭现在依靠慈善社区厨房提供的膳食。

paras.en: “I have not been able to buy even one kilogramme (2.2lb) of meat, a chicken or a kilogramme of fruit,” he says. “The meal I get from the community kitchen is usually finished while most of us are still hungry.”
paras.zh: “我连一公斤（2.2磅）肉、一只鸡肉或一公斤水果都买不到，”他说。 “我从社区厨房得到的饭菜通常在我们大多数人还饿着的时候就吃完了。”

paras.en: Tala and her brother Mohammed suffer from malnutrition and growth difficulties, as their family cannot afford a healthy diet. Their father fears the deprivation will have lasting consequences for their health.
paras.zh: 塔拉和她的兄弟穆罕默德患有营养不良和生长困难，因为他们的家人无法负担健康的饮食。他们的父亲担心这种剥夺会对他们的健康产生持久的影响。

paras.en: The experiences of Nabigha and Tala reflect a wider challenge eating away at the future of Gaza’s children. The war has deprived families of adequate food and essential nutrients at a time when healthcare services have been severely disrupted, making access to diagnosis and treatment increasingly difficult.
paras.zh: 纳比加和塔拉的经历反映了侵蚀加沙儿童未来的更广泛挑战。战争剥夺了家庭充足的食物和必需的营养，同时医疗保健服务受到严重干扰，使获得诊断和治疗变得越来越困难。

paras.en: A nutritional survey by UNICEF and its partners in accessible areas of the Gaza Strip between May 31 and June 15, 2026 found that 12.2 percent of children below five were stunted. Only 22.4 percent of children aged six to 23 months received a minimum acceptable diet.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会及其合作伙伴于 2026 年 5 月 31 日至 6 月 15 日期间在加沙地带无障碍地区进行的一项营养调查发现，12.2% 的五岁以下儿童发育迟缓。只有 22.4% 的 6 至 23 个月大的儿童接受了最低可接受的饮食。

paras.en: Nutritionist Nada Abu al-Nada says the crisis concerns not only the quantity of food available, but also its quality and diversity. As purchasing power has declined and prices have risen, many families have reduced their consumption of meat, chicken, fish, eggs, milk, vegetables and fruit, relying increasingly on bread, rice and pasta.
paras.zh: 营养学家纳达·阿布·纳达表示，这场危机不仅关系到可用食物的数量，还关系到食物的质量和多样性。随着购买力下降和物价上涨，许多家庭减少了肉、鸡、鱼、蛋、奶、蔬菜和水果的消费，越来越依赖面包、大米和面食。

paras.en: Children need balanced diets containing proteins and essential nutrients, including iron, zinc and calcium, to support bone and muscle development. When they do not receive enough energy and nutrients, the body prioritises vital functions over growth. Prolonged deficiencies can slow height gain and affect muscles, tissues and bone formation.
paras.zh: 儿童需要含有蛋白质和铁、锌和钙等必需营养素的均衡饮食，以支持骨骼和肌肉发育。当他们没有获得足够的能量和营养时，身体会优先考虑重要功能而不是生长。长期缺乏会减缓身高增长并影响肌肉、组织和骨骼形成。

paras.en: “Before the war, average food availability was about 2,580 calories per person per day, while estimated average consumption has fallen to approximately 1,000 calories. This is not enough,” Abu al-Nada says.
paras.zh: “战前，每人每天的平均食物供应量约为 2,580 卡路里，而估计平均消费量已降至约 1,000 卡路里。这还不够，”阿布·阿尔-纳达说。

paras.en: She explains that the first 1,000 days from conception until a child turns two are particularly critical for development. However, older children are also vulnerable to prolonged deprivation. Diarrhoea, gastrointestinal illnesses and contaminated water can further reduce the body’s ability to absorb nutrients, worsening malnutrition.
paras.zh: 她解释说，从受孕到孩子两岁的前 1000 天对于发育尤为关键。然而，年龄较大的儿童也容易遭受长期剥夺。腹泻、胃肠道疾病和受污染的水会进一步降低人体吸收营养的能力，从而加剧营养不良。

paras.en: Delayed growth and unavailable treatment
paras.zh: 生长迟缓且无法治疗

paras.en: At Nasser Hospital, endocrinologist and diabetes specialist Hani Sayed Zuhair has noticed an increase in children seeking medical attention for growth problems. The number of cases during a single clinic session has risen from about 15 to 20 before the war to between 30 and 40 now, sometimes more.
paras.zh: 在纳赛尔医院，内分泌学家和糖尿病专家哈尼·赛义德·祖海尔注意到，因生长问题寻求医疗救助的儿童数量有所增加。单次门诊的病例数已从战前的约 15 至 20 例增加到现在的 30 至 40 例，有时甚至更多。

paras.en: He says the cases indicate an increase in growth disorders and stunting, particularly following periods of hunger and shortages of food, vitamins and medicines.
paras.zh: 他说，这些病例表明生长障碍和发育迟缓的情况有所增加，特别是在饥饿和食物、维生素和药品短缺时期之后。

paras.en: The consequences extend beyond nutritional deprivation to disrupted diagnosis and treatment, including hormonal therapies required by some children. The effects of malnutrition may not appear immediately but can emerge months or years later.
paras.zh: 其后果不仅限于营养缺乏，还导致诊断和治疗中断，包括一些儿童所需的激素疗法。营养不良的影响可能不会立即显现，但可能会在数月或数年后显现。

paras.en: Zuhair cites cases of eight-year-old children whose bones are at the stage of development normally seen in those half their age, indicating a significant delay in skeletal maturation.
paras.zh: 祖海尔引用了八岁儿童的案例，这些儿童的骨骼发育阶段通常只有其年龄的一半，这表明骨骼成熟明显延迟。

paras.en: However, he stresses that short stature is not necessarily caused by malnutrition alone. It may also result from hormonal disorders or chronic illnesses, which can be exacerbated by nutritional deprivation, or from a combination of factors.
paras.zh: 然而，他强调，身材矮小不一定是由营养不良引起的。它也可能是由荷尔蒙失调或慢性疾病引起的，这些疾病可能因营养缺乏或多种因素的组合而加剧。

paras.en: “We have noticed that many children suffering from malnutrition and short stature also have hormonal deficiencies, but in a number of these cases, the primary problem was nutritional deprivation,” he says.
paras.zh: “我们注意到，许多患有营养不良和身材矮小的儿童也存在荷尔蒙缺乏，但在许多情况下，主要问题是营养不足，”他说。

paras.en: Diagnosing delayed growth requires monitoring children’s height and weight against growth charts, alongside the necessary medical tests.
paras.zh: 诊断生长迟缓需要根据生长图表监测儿童的身高和体重，以及必要的医学检查。

paras.en: But access to diagnosis and treatment is increasingly difficult. Growth hormone stimulation tests are unavailable in Ministry of Health laboratories, while some private laboratories offer them only on a limited basis because of shortages of supplies. According to Zuhair, the tests cost between 350 ($106) and 400 shekels ($120).
paras.zh: 但获得诊断和治疗变得越来越困难。卫生部实验室不提供生长激素刺激测试，而一些私人实验室由于供应短缺，仅提供有限的测试。 Zuhair 表示，检测费用在 350 谢克尔（106 美元）到 400 谢克尔（120 美元）之间。

paras.en: Growth hormone injections cost between 80 ($24) and 120 shekels ($36) per dose, depending on availability. Children may require repeated injections according to their weight and prescribed treatment plans, placing an additional financial burden on families that have lost their sources of income.
paras.zh: 每剂生长激素注射费用在 80 谢克尔（24 美元）至 120 谢克尔（36 美元）之间，具体取决于供应情况。儿童可能需要根据体重和规定的治疗计划重复注射，这给失去收入来源的家庭带来额外的经济负担。

paras.en: The injections must also be stored at appropriate temperatures, with regular medical follow-up and adherence to prescribed doses – conditions that are difficult to maintain amid a war and blockade.
paras.zh: 注射剂还必须储存在适当的温度下，定期进行医疗随访并遵守规定的剂量——在战争和封锁期间很难维持这样的条件。

paras.en: Consequences that may extend into the future
paras.zh: 可能延续到未来的后果

paras.en: Abu al-Nada says a number of children may be able to catch up in their growth if their nutrition improves and intervention comes early enough. However, recovery depends on age, the duration and severity of deprivation, and other health factors. Regaining lost growth becomes more difficult once the bone growth plates close.
paras.zh: 阿布·纳达表示，如果一些儿童的营养得到改善并且干预措施足够早，他们也许能够赶上他们的成长。然而，康复取决于年龄、剥夺的持续时间和严重程度以及其他健康因素。一旦骨生长板闭合，恢复失去的生长就变得更加困难。

paras.en: The risks extend beyond height. Protein and micronutrient deficiencies can reduce muscle mass, cause anaemia and weaken immunity, while also affecting concentration, learning and cognitive development. These consequences are compounded by psychological stress, sleep deprivation, recurrent illnesses and displacement.
paras.zh: 风险不仅仅限于身高。蛋白质和微量营养素缺乏会减少肌肉质量，导致贫血并削弱免疫力，同时还会影响注意力、学习和认知发展。心理压力、睡眠不足、疾病反复发作和流离失所加剧了这些后果。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Alia al-Zaqzouq remains unable to answer her daughter’s question about when she might grow taller, while access to treatment is far from guaranteed. And Tahrir Zidan is still struggling to secure enough food for his children, let alone the balanced diet they need to grow.
paras.zh: 与此同时，阿莉亚·扎克祖克仍然无法回答女儿关于她什么时候可以长高的问题，而获得治疗的机会也远未得到保证。塔里尔·齐丹仍在努力为他的孩子们确保足够的食物，更不用说他们成长所需的均衡饮食了。

articles.title: Costa Rica denies entry to UN’s Albanese over ‘links to terrorist acts’

paras.en: Costa Rica has barred United Nations Special Rapporteur on the Occupied Palestinian Territories Francesca Albanese from entering the country, citing “national security” concerns.
paras.zh: 哥斯达黎加以“国家安全”为由，禁止联合国巴勒斯坦被占领土问题特别报告员弗朗西斯卡·阿尔巴内塞入境。

paras.en: Albanese slammed her detention on Friday, branding it a “disgrace”. She was halted and held at Juan Santamaria International Airport the previous day, according to local authorities.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内斯周五猛烈抨击了她的拘留，称其为“耻辱”。据地方当局称，前一天她在胡安圣玛丽亚国际机场被拦截并被拘留。

paras.en: The director-general of Costa Rica’s immigration authority, Omer Badilla, said in a video posted on social media that Albanese “was refused entry to the country because she is the subject of an international alert due to links to terrorist acts”. He did not specify which country put out the alert.
paras.zh: 哥斯达黎加移民局局长奥马尔·巴迪利亚在社交媒体上发布的一段视频中表示，阿尔巴尼斯“被拒绝入境该国，因为她因与恐怖行为有关而受到国际警惕”。他没有具体说明是哪个国家发出了警报。

paras.en: “It is important to note that when national security is at risk, as is the case here, our police authorities strictly enforce the provisions of our legal system,” Badilla said.
paras.zh: 巴迪拉说：“值得注意的是，当国家安全面临风险时，就像这里的情况一样，我们的警察当局会严格执行我们法律制度的规定。”

paras.en: Albanese was appointed by the UN Human Rights Council in 2022 and, like other independent experts, does not speak on behalf of the UN. She was travelling to Costa Rica to receive an honorary doctorate from the University of Costa Rica in recognition of academic and human rights work.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞于 2022 年由联合国人权理事会任命，与其他独立专家一样，他并不代表联合国发言。她正前往哥斯达黎加接受哥斯达黎加大学的荣誉博士学位，以表彰她在学术和人权方面的工作。

paras.en: She has faced harsh pushback from Israel and its allies, including the United States, over her advocacy for Palestinians in Gaza and the occupied West Bank and accusations that Israel has committed genocide and other war crimes.
paras.zh: 由于她对加沙和被占领的约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦人的倡导以及对以色列犯有种族灭绝和其他战争罪行的指控，她面临以色列及其包括美国在内的盟友的严厉抵制。

paras.en: Speaking while held at the airport, Albanese told local media that her detention was “a disgrace” and “appalling”.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯在机场被拘留时对当地媒体表示，她的拘留是“耻辱”和“令人震惊”。

paras.en: “You see the face of the empire the day you touch a nerve or cross its boundaries,” she wrote on social media.
paras.zh: 她在社交媒体上写道：“当你触及神经或跨越帝国边界的那一天，你就会看到帝国的面孔。”

paras.en: The US imposed sanctions on Albanese after she criticised Washington’s policy on Gaza.
paras.zh: 在阿尔巴尼斯批评华盛顿对加沙的政策后，美国对她实施了制裁。

paras.en: Costa Rican President Laura Fernandez is a close ally of US President Donald Trump and has pursued closer trade ties with Israel since she took office in May.
paras.zh: 哥斯达黎加总统劳拉·费尔南德斯是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的亲密盟友，自五月上任以来一直寻求与以色列建立更密切的贸易关系。

paras.en: Albanese told the student outlet Semanario Universidad that while she understood her name was on the US sanctions list, that did not explain why Costa Rica had detained her.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞告诉学生媒体 Semanario Universidad，虽然她知道自己的名字在美国制裁名单上，但这并不能解释哥斯达黎加拘留她的原因。

paras.en: “We are not in the United States. We are in Costa Rica,” she stated. “Is Costa Rica a sovereign country?”
paras.zh: “我们不在美国。我们在哥斯达黎加，”她说。 “哥斯达黎加是一个主权国家吗？”

paras.en: She noted that the only country she knew she could not enter was Israel, which had declared her “persona non grata” in 2024.
paras.zh: 她指出，她知道自己不能进入的唯一国家是以色列，该国已于 2024 年宣布她为“不受欢迎的人”。

paras.en: Danny Danon, Israel’s ambassador to the UN, praised Costa Rica on social media.
paras.zh: 以色列驻联合国大使丹尼·达农在社交媒体上赞扬了哥斯达黎加。

paras.en: “Those who exploit their UN mandate to spread vile propaganda, legitimize terrorist organizations, desecrate the memory of the six million Jews murdered in the Holocaust, and relentlessly vilify the US and Israel should face consequences,” he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“那些利用联合国授权散布邪恶宣传、使恐怖组织合法化、亵渎在大屠杀中被杀害的六百万犹太人的记忆以及无情诽谤美国和以色列的人应该面临后果。”

articles.title: Africa Cup title given back to Senegal after sports court rules against Morocco
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Africa Cup title given back to Senegal after sports court rules against Morocco
paras.zh: 塞内加尔在体育法庭裁定对阵摩洛哥后重获非洲杯冠军

paras.en: More than 10 months on from a chaotic, controversial final, Senegal is Africa's soccer champion once again.
paras.zh: 经历了一场混乱且充满争议的决赛十个多月后，塞内加尔再次成为非洲足球冠军。

paras.en: Senegal won back the Africa Cup of Nations title in a legal fight on Tuesday after the Court of Arbitration for Sport overturned an earlier ruling which handed the trophy to Morocco.
paras.zh: 塞内加尔在周二的一场法律斗争中重新赢得了非洲国家杯冠军，此前体育仲裁法院推翻了先前将奖杯交给摩洛哥的裁决。

paras.en: Senegal won the Africa Cup on the field in Morocco in January and then lost it in a legal case in March because its players walked off the field in protest in second-half stoppage time.
paras.zh: 塞内加尔在一月份在摩洛哥赢得了非洲杯冠军，但在三月份因一场法律诉讼而输掉了冠军，原因是其球员在下半场伤停补时阶段离场抗议。

paras.en: CAS has now rejected that earlier ruling, based on referee Jean-Jacques Ndala's decision to let the game resume after the protest.
paras.zh: 基于裁判让-雅克·恩达拉 (Jean-Jacques Ndala) 在抗议后决定让比赛恢复，CAS 现在驳回了先前的裁决。

paras.en: "The Court of Arbitration for Sport has delivered justice to sport," Senegalese soccer federation president Abdoulaye Fall said in a statement.
paras.zh: 塞内加尔足协主席阿卜杜拉耶·法尔在一份声明中表示：“体育仲裁法院为体育伸张了正义。”

paras.en: The legal battle may not be over yet after Morocco announced plans to appeal, likely to Switzerland's supreme court, in a challenge to the integrity of a senior CAS judge.
paras.zh: 在摩洛哥宣布计划上诉（可能向瑞士最高法院）对国际体育仲裁法庭（CAS）高级法官的廉洁提出质疑后，这场法律斗争可能尚未结束。

paras.en: Tournament regulations said a team which refuses to play should be considered to have lost the game, but CAS said those rules were meant only for cases "when a team's conduct leads the referee to call off the game permanently."
paras.zh: 赛事规则规定，拒绝参加比赛的球队应被视为输掉比赛，但CAS表示，这些规则仅适用于“球队的行为导致裁判永久取消比赛”的情况。

paras.en: Ndala "did not err in law" when he resumed the game and had "sole authority" to make that call, CAS said, adding its three judges were unanimous.
paras.zh: CAS 表示，恩达拉在恢复比赛时“并没有犯法”，并且拥有“唯一权力”做出这一决定，并补充说，三位法官的意见一致。

paras.en: "The panel acknowledged that the referee had to make a decision in an atmosphere of extreme tension," CAS said. "However, these circumstances do not justify describing the decision as 'arbitrary.' On the contrary, the referee's judgment did not appear to have been affected by factors external to the game."
paras.zh: CAS 表示：“仲裁组承认，裁判必须在极度紧张的气氛下做出决定。” “然而，这些情况并不能证明该决定是‘任意’的。相反，裁判的判断似乎并没有受到比赛外部因素的影响。”

paras.en: Morocco raises concerns over CAS process
paras.zh: 摩洛哥对 CAS 程序表示担忧

paras.en: Morocco's soccer federation detailed plans for an appeal that targets one of the three judges on the CAS panel.
paras.zh: 摩洛哥足协详细制定了​​针对 CAS 小组三名法官之一的上诉计划。

paras.en: In a statement, the Moroccan federation protested what it described as the court's failure to address potential integrity concerns, alleging "confirmed communication" between German arbitrator Ulrich Haas and Fall, the Senegalese soccer president, 48 hours before the decision was issued.
paras.zh: 摩洛哥足协在一份声明中抗议法院未能解决潜在的诚信问题，声称德国仲裁员乌尔里希·哈斯和塞内加尔足球主席法尔在裁决发布前 48 小时进行了“确认的沟通”。

paras.en: The CAS director general, Matthieu Reeb, acknowledged to reporters at the court in Lausanne that a Moroccan protest was received just minutes before the verdict was announced.
paras.zh: CAS 总干事马蒂厄·里布 (Matthieu Reeb) 在洛桑法院向记者承认，在判决宣布前几分钟就收到了摩洛哥的抗议。

paras.en: Reeb said the court's panel "in charge of petitions for challenge has conceded that there was not enough elements at this stage to postpone the notification of the award."
paras.zh: 里布表示，法院“负责质疑申请的小组承认，现阶段没有足够的因素来推迟裁决通知”。

paras.en: CAS verdicts can be challenged at Switzerland's supreme court, also in Lausanne, though only on limited procedural grounds of which a judge's integrity could be one.
paras.zh: CAS 的裁决可以在同样位于洛桑的瑞士最高法院受到质疑，尽管只是基于有限的程序理由，而法官的诚信可能是其中之一。

paras.en: Haas has been among the most respected and in-demand CAS judges in the past 20 years, selected by parties in storied cases involving Manchester City's beating a Champions League ban by UEFA, tennis star Simona Halep's doping case and Africa's Champions League final in 2019.
paras.zh: 哈斯是过去 20 年来最受尊敬和最受欢迎的 CAS 法官之一，他是由处理曼城打破欧足联欧冠禁令、网球明星西蒙娜·哈勒普兴奋剂案以及 2019 年非洲冠军联赛决赛等传奇案件的当事人选出的。

paras.en: Patrick Kabou, a lawyer for the Senegalese Soccer Federation, called the alleged communication between Fall and Haas "unreal."
paras.zh: 塞内加尔足球联合会的律师帕特里克·卡布称法尔和哈斯之间所谓的沟通“不真实”。

paras.en: Senegal won the final 1-0 after extra time with chaos on the field and violent clashes in the stands. Even the ball boys were involved in scuffles as they tried to snatch towels that Senegal goalkeeper Edouard Mendy was using to keep his gloves dry.
paras.zh: 经过加时赛，塞内加尔队以1-0获胜，场上一片混乱，看台上发生了暴力冲突。就连球童也卷入了混战，因为他们试图抢夺塞内加尔门将爱德华·门迪用来保持手套干燥的毛巾。

paras.en: The result was overturned two months later as a 3-0 default win for Morocco by an appeals panel appointed by the Confederation of African Football (CAF).
paras.zh: 两个月后，非洲足球联合会(CAF)任命的上诉小组推翻了摩洛哥以3-0默认获胜的结果。

paras.en: Senegal beat AFCON host nation Morocco after a 15-minute delay in play. At 0-0, Senegal's team walked off the field to protest Morocco being awarded a penalty kick in the last minute of regulation time.
paras.zh: 塞内加尔在比赛延迟15分钟后击败非洲杯东道主摩洛哥。 0-0的比赛中，塞内加尔队在规定时间最后一分钟退场，抗议摩洛哥队获得点球。

paras.en: Match referee Ndala of Congo eventually allowed the game to restart, Morocco's penalty by Real Madrid forward Brahim Diaz — a slow chip shot known as a "Panenka" — was saved, and Senegal won in extra time.
paras.zh: 刚果队主裁恩达拉最终允许比赛重新开始，摩洛哥队皇马前锋布拉希姆·迪亚兹的点球——被称为“帕年卡”的缓慢射门——被扑出，塞内加尔在加时赛中获胜。

paras.en: The drama continued through the months of legal tussles. Senegal's players paraded with the trophy ahead of a game in March against Peru, even though Morocco was recognized as the champion at that point.
paras.zh: 这场闹剧在长达数月的法律纠纷中持续上演。塞内加尔的球员在三月份对阵秘鲁的比赛前举起奖杯游行，尽管当时摩洛哥被认为是冠军。

paras.en: Both teams played at the World Cup believing themselves to be the rightful champion of Africa.
paras.zh: 参加世界杯的两支球队都相信自己是非洲合法的冠军。

paras.en: Senegal had the laws of the game on its side, and Morocco had the tournament regulations.
paras.zh: 塞内加尔有自己的比赛规则，摩洛哥有比赛规则。

paras.en: The laws of soccer state that referee decisions are final. CAS backed that position with its own "field of play" doctrine, that on-field calls by a referee generally can't be taken to the sports court.
paras.zh: 足球法规定裁判的决定是最终决定。 CAS 用自己的“比赛场地”原则支持这一立场，即裁判员的现场判罚通常不能带到运动场。

paras.en: "By blowing his whistle to restart play, the referee considered that the conditions for resuming the match had been met — both teams were on the pitch again, and both expressed their willingness to resume," CAS said.
paras.zh: CAS表示：“裁判吹响重新开始比赛的哨子，认为恢复比赛的条件已经满足——两支球队都重新回到了球场上，并且都表达了恢复比赛的意愿。”

paras.en: In the first legal case in March, CAF appeal judges cited AFCON tournament regulations that if a team "refuses to play or leaves the ground before the regular end of the match without the authorization of the referee, it shall be considered loser and shall be eliminated for good from the current competition."
paras.zh: 在3月份的第一起法律案件中，非洲足联上诉法官引用了非洲足联的赛事规定，如果一支球队“未经裁判授权拒绝比赛或在常规比赛结束前离开场地，则该球队将被视为失败者，并从当前比赛中永久淘汰”。

paras.en: The CAS judges heard evidence at a one-day hearing last month and the court promised a verdict by the end of November with a full written ruling of its judges setting out reasons for their decision.
paras.zh: CAS 法官在上个月举行的为期一天的听证会上听取了证据，法院承诺在 11 月底之前做出裁决，并附上法官的完整书面裁决，阐明其决定的理由。

paras.en: The next men's AFCON starts in June co-hosted by Kenya, Uganda, and Tanzania. Morocco will aim to end a wait for the title which now stands at 50 years.
paras.zh: 下一届男子非洲杯将于六月开始，由肯尼亚、乌干达和坦桑尼亚共同主办。摩洛哥的目标是结束长达 50 年的夺冠等待。

paras.en: "Senegal won on the pitch, and the court simply confirmed what we all already knew: We are the real champions of Africa," said Mariama Sidibé, 35, an accountant in the capital, Dakar.
paras.zh: “塞内加尔在球场上获胜，法庭证实了我们都知道的事情：我们是非洲真正的冠军，”首都达喀尔 35 岁的会计师玛丽亚玛·西迪贝 (Mariama Sidibé) 说。

paras.en: Sidibé said the dispute between Morocco and Senegal should now be left in the past.
paras.zh: 西迪贝表示，摩洛哥和塞内加尔之间的争端现在应该成为过去。

paras.en: "With all of this behind us, we should focus on what unites us now, and who knows, maybe Morocco can have its revenge on the field during the next AFCON this summer," she said.
paras.zh: “所有这些都已经过去了，我们应该专注于现在让我们团结起来的事情，谁知道呢，也许摩洛哥可以在今年夏天的下一届非洲杯期间在球场上复仇，”她说。

paras.en: "At the end of the day Morocco and Senegal are brothers," Sidibé added, referring to the countries' long shared close ties built on religion, trade and culture.
paras.zh: “归根结底，摩洛哥和塞内加尔是兄弟，”西迪贝补充道，他指的是两国在宗教、贸易和文化上长期建立的密切关系。

paras.en: Sidi Sylla, a philosophy student at Dakar's main university, said the court's ruling was "not just a win for Senegal but for football in general."
paras.zh: 达喀尔主要大学的哲学系学生西迪·西拉表示，法院的裁决“不仅是塞内加尔的胜利，也是整个足球界的胜利”。

paras.en: CAS rulings have stripped many athletes of Olympic medals for doping, but it's rare to overturn the result of a major soccer competition.
paras.zh: 国际体育仲裁法庭（CAS）的裁决已经剥夺了许多因兴奋剂问题而获得的奥运会奖牌，但推翻重大足球比赛结果的情况却很少见。

paras.en: CAS refused to change the results of the 2019 Asian Cup, dismissing an appeal that the star striker on winning team Qatar shouldn't have been eligible for the tournament.
paras.zh: CAS 拒绝改变 2019 年亚洲杯的结果，驳回了关于获胜队卡塔尔队的明星前锋不应该获得比赛资格的上诉。

paras.en: A lengthy legal battle over the same year's African Champions League final also ended with the original winner, Esperance of Tunisia, taking the title after its opponent Wydad from Morocco refused to play on.
paras.zh: 同年非洲冠军联赛决赛的一场漫长的法律斗争也以最初的获胜者突尼斯队的埃斯佩兰斯结束，因为对手来自摩洛哥的维达德拒绝参加比赛，最终获胜者突尼斯队获得了冠军。

paras.en: One notable CAS ruling on a team sport title came at the Winter Olympics in 2022. A doping case involving then-15-year-old Russian figure skater Kamila Valieva ended up with her disqualification, and the Russian team being dropped from gold to bronze in the team event.
paras.zh: 2022 年冬季奥运会上，国际体育仲裁法庭 (CAS) 对团体运动冠军做出了一项著名裁决。当时 15 岁的俄罗斯花样滑冰运动员卡米拉·瓦利耶娃 (Kamila Valieva) 因服用兴奋剂而被取消资格，俄罗斯队在团体项目中从金牌跌至铜牌。

articles.title: Strobe Talbott, former Time magazine reporter and deputy secretary of state, has died
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Strobe Talbott, former Time magazine reporter and deputy secretary of state, has died
paras.zh: 前《时代》杂志记者、副国务卿斯特罗布·塔尔博特去世

paras.en: Strobe Talbott, a former Time magazine reporter who later served as deputy secretary of state under President Bill Clinton and then headed the Brookings Institution, died Thursday. He was 80.
paras.zh: 斯特罗布·塔尔博特（Strobe Talbott）周四去世，他是《时代》杂志的前记者，后来担任比尔·克林顿总统的副国务卿，后来又担任布鲁金斯学会的负责人。他80岁了。

paras.en: His son, Devin Talbott, confirmed he passed away peacefully after a long illness in his East Hampton, New York, home.
paras.zh: 他的儿子德文·塔尔博特证实，他​​在长期患病后在纽约东汉普顿的家中平静地去世。

paras.en: The elder Talbott was educated at Yale and Oxford, where he bunked with Clinton. While at the British university, after interning for Time in Moscow, the magazine asked Talbott to help translate the leaked memoirs of Nikita Khrushchev, the former first secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union who was ousted in 1964.
paras.zh: 老塔尔博特曾在耶鲁大学和牛津大学接受教育，并在那里与克林顿同住。在英国大学期间，在莫斯科《时代》杂志实习后，该杂志要求塔尔博特帮助翻译 1964 年被赶下台的前苏联共产党第一书记尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫 (Nikita Khrushchev) 被泄露的回忆录。

paras.en: Talbott did, and it gave him some notoriety as a young man and a job at the magazine.
paras.zh: 塔尔博特做到了，这给他年轻时带来了一些恶名，并在杂志社找到了一份工作。

paras.en: After 21 years at Time, where he focused on Soviet-American relations and held positions including Washington bureau chief and a foreign-affairs columnist, according to his U.S. State Department biography, he received a call from the newly elected Clinton.
paras.zh: 根据他的美国国务院传记，他在《时代》杂志工作了 21 年，专注于苏美关系，并担任过华盛顿分社社长和外交专栏作家等职务，之后他接到了新当选的克林顿的电话。

paras.en: Talbott joined the U.S. State Department in 1994, swiftly becoming deputy secretary of state. In that role, he was the architect of the Clinton administration's approach to Russia and other formerly Soviet countries and conducted negotiations between the U.S. and India after the latter's nuclear tests in 1998.
paras.zh: 塔尔博特于 1994 年加入美国国务院，很快成为副国务卿。在此期间，他是克林顿政府对俄罗斯和其他前苏联国家采取的政策的设计者，并在 1998 年印度核试验后主持了美国和印度之间的谈判。

paras.en: "Strobe was a good and brilliant man who made our world more peaceful and secure," said Clinton in a statement after Talbott's death. When Talbott was translating Khrushchev's memoirs while at Oxford, it was Clinton's job to make him breakfast every day, he said, adding, "somehow, I got the better end of the deal."
paras.zh: 塔尔博特去世后，克林顿在一份声明中表示：“斯特罗布是一位优秀而优秀的人，他让我们的世界变得更加和平和安全。”当塔尔博特在牛津大学翻译赫鲁晓夫的回忆录时，克林顿的工作就是每天给他做早餐，他说，并补充道，“不知何故，我得到了更好的结果。”

paras.en: Both he and Hillary were "deeply saddened" by the passing of "a wonderful friend, and a world-class human being," he said.
paras.zh: 他说，他和希拉里都对“一位好朋友、一位世界级人物”的去世感到“深感悲痛”。

paras.en: Afterward, he served as the president of Brookings from 2002 to 2017. In that time, he also chaired the U.S. State Department's Foreign Affairs Policy Board.
paras.zh: 此后，他于2002年至2017年担任布鲁金斯学会主席。期间，他还担任美国国务院外交政策委员会主席。

paras.en: Talbott also authored over a dozen books. His last book was titled "Our Founders' Warning: The Age of Reason Meets the Age of Trump," which was published in 2020.
paras.zh: 塔尔博特还撰写了十几本书。他的上一本书名为《我们的创始人的警告：理性时代遇见特朗普时代》，于 2020 年出版。

paras.en: He was born in Dayton, Ohio, in 1946, and is survived by two sons, Devin and Adrian, and six grandchildren.
paras.zh: 他于 1946 年出生于俄亥俄州代顿，身后有两个儿子德文 (Devin) 和阿德里安 (Adrian)，以及六个孙子。

paras.en: His first wife, Brook Shearer, died in 2009, and he later married author Barbara Lazear Ascher.
paras.zh: 他的第一任妻子布鲁克·希勒 (Brook Shearer) 于 2009 年去世，后来他与作家芭芭拉·拉泽尔·阿舍尔 (Barbara Lazear Ascher) 结婚。

articles.title: Buffalo Bills outlast Kansas City Chiefs in defensive struggle to maintain top seed status in AFC

paras.en: When NFL fans peeked at the Thanksgiving Day slate, their eyes likely focused on the night game between the Kansas City Chiefs and Buffalo Bills.
paras.zh: 当 NFL 球迷浏览感恩节名单时，他们的目光很可能集中在堪萨斯城酋长队和布法罗比尔队之间的夜间比赛上。

paras.en: Two of the NFL's best passers going head-to-head with AFC bragging rights on the line.
paras.zh: 两名 NFL 最好的传球手将与 AFC 正面交锋，争夺吹嘘的权利。

paras.en: Many probably assumed this would be where all the offensive fireworks would be, but who knew the Turkey Day nightcap would be such a defensive struggle?
paras.zh: 许多人可能认为这将是所有进攻性烟火的所在，但谁知道土耳其日睡前会是一场如此激烈的防守斗争？

paras.en: The Bills outlasted the Chiefs 13-10 in what was by far the lowest scoring game of the three Thanksgiving showdowns on tap, keeping the top spot in the AFC and holding Kansas City at bay in the process.
paras.zh: 比尔队以 13-10 战胜了酋长队，这是感恩节三场对决中迄今为止得分最低的一场比赛，保持了亚足联的榜首位置，并在此过程中将堪萨斯城队逼入绝境。

paras.en: All of the storylines heading into this game were fixated on the quarterback duel between Patrick Mahomes and Josh Allen, but it was the defenses that grabbed the headlines in primetime (though the inclement weather deserves some of the credit).
paras.zh: 这场比赛的所有故事情节都集中在帕特里克·马霍姆斯和乔什·艾伦之间的四分卫对决上，但在黄金时段占据头条的是防守（尽管恶劣的天气也值得部分赞扬）。

paras.en: In particular, the Kansas City D was able to harass Allen, holding him to just 81 yards passing and forcing two interceptions.
paras.zh: 特别是，堪萨斯城 D 队能够骚扰艾伦，将他限制在 81 码处传球并迫使他两次拦截。

paras.en: Most of Buffalo's damage came on the ground, though, as Allen and running back James Cook combined for 160 rushing yards, with the latter scoring the Bills' only touchdown of the game.
paras.zh: 不过，布法罗队的大部分伤害都来自地面，阿伦和跑卫詹姆斯·库克合计冲球 160 码，后者取得了比尔队本场比赛的唯一达阵。

paras.en: The yardage numbers were rather paltry for both teams, with neither cracking the 250 yard mark, a far cry from the scoreboard light show viewers were treated to in the 1 o'clock and 4:30 games.
paras.zh: 两支球队的码数都相当微不足道，都没有突破 250 码大关，这与观众在 1 点和 4 点 30 分的比赛中看到的记分牌灯光秀相去甚远。

paras.en: The Chiefs won the turnover battle, forcing the two aforementioned Allen picks while keeping a clean sheet themselves.
paras.zh: 酋长队赢得了这场失误之战，迫使前面提到的两个艾伦选秀权同时保持不失球。

paras.en: However, the Bills' defense and special teams each deserve their own set of flowers.
paras.zh: 不过，比尔的防守组和特勤组各有各的一套鲜花。

paras.en: The Buffalo D held the Chiefs and Mahomes to empty possessions twice in the final few minutes of the game, which in turn led to a nice punt return by Greg Dortch that would set up a short field for Tyler Bass's game-winning 57-yard field goal as time expired.
paras.zh: 布法罗D队在比赛最后几分钟让酋长队和马霍姆斯两次空出控球权，这反过来又导致格雷格·多奇(Greg Dortch)漂亮的弃踢回攻，为泰勒·巴斯(Tyler Bass)在比赛结束时的57码射门致胜创造了一个短场地。

paras.en: For the Bills, this won't mean much in terms of their division standing.
paras.zh: 对于比尔队来说，这对于他们的分区排名来说意义不大。

paras.en: Buffalo is still running away with the AFC East and will likely face little resistance from the New England Patriots, who sit in a distant second at 4.5 games back as of Thursday evening.
paras.zh: 布法罗仍然在亚足联东区遥遥领先，并且很可能不会遇到来自新英格兰爱国者队的抵抗，截至周四晚上，新英格兰爱国者队以 4.5 场的差距位居第二。

paras.en: What this means for playoff seeding is a different ball game altogether.
paras.zh: 这对于季后赛种子队来说意味着完全不同的比赛。

paras.en: Buffalo just took a huge step forward in locking up home-field advantage throughout the postseason, which also means they will get to face their playoff boogeymen in the friendly confines of Highmark Stadium.
paras.zh: 布法罗在整个季后赛中在锁定主场优势方面向前迈出了一大步，这也意味着他们将在海马克体育场的友好场地内面对季后赛的恶魔。

paras.en: The Josh Allen era of the Buffalo Bills has been marred by an 0-3 record against the Chiefs in postseason play, with two of those losses coming in Kansas City.
paras.zh: 乔什·艾伦时代的布法罗比尔队在季后赛中对阵酋长队的战绩为 0 胜 3 负，其中两场失利发生在堪萨斯城。

paras.en: Getting a crack at their nemeses in their own backyard could be the difference between a trip to Southern California for the Super Bowl and sitting at home once again in late January,
paras.zh: 在自己的后院击败他们的敌人可能是前往南加州观看超级碗和一月下旬再次坐在家里之间的区别，

paras.en: Thursday's win just made home cooking in the playoffs a possibility.
paras.zh: 周四的胜利让在家做饭成为了季后赛的可能。

paras.en: Whether Allen and the Bills will finally be able to exorcise their AFC playoff demons remains to be seen, but the latest chapter in their rivalry with KC may have just given Buffalo fans the glimmer of hope they needed this coming postseason.
paras.zh: 艾伦和比尔队是否最终能够驱除他们的亚冠季后赛恶魔还有待观察，但他们与 KC 竞争的最新篇章可能刚刚给布法罗球迷带来了他们在即将到来的季后赛中所需要的一线希望。
