Like WIRED's favorite affordable recliner, the lower-cost Vari Align, the Intuition allows you to halt the recline anywhere along the path from 90 to 45 degrees—with an added tension control knob to adjust the speed and ease of your descent. The height of the lumbar support is adjustable up and down, and otherwise tilts and flexes to meet your back. The headrest is adjustable by both height and angle, and can also be removed entirely. But note that while the curved lower section of the chair's back offers strong lumbar support, it's also pretty aggressive and takes some getting used to. So is the durable nylon mesh, which will feel scratchy in your summer clothes, especially as you're reclining. But the strong ergonomic support will be a big sell for many, especially with the chair's near-infinite adjustability. Just note that taller people might not find that the armrests or the seat go high enough. At 6'1", former reviewer Matthew Korfhage felt he was right on the edge. Construction is solid, with mostly chrome and aluminum on the lower frame. The warranty is a lovely 15 years.
paras.zh: Uplift Desk Intuition 带头枕的人体工学椅售价 649 美元：价格略高，符合人体工学设计的透气网状 Intuition 是最受欢迎的躺椅的有力竞争者。总的来说，它也是一个强有力的竞争者，椅背的三个重叠的网状面板使其看起来明显具有科技感。就像《连线》杂志最受欢迎的价格实惠的躺椅、成本较低的 Vari Align 一样，Intuition 允许您在 90 到 45 度的路径上的任何地方停止倾斜，并附加张力控制旋钮来调节下降的速度和轻松程度。腰部支撑的高度可上下调节，也可倾斜和弯曲以贴合您的背部。头枕的高度和角度均可调节，也可以完全拆卸。但请注意，虽然椅背的弯曲下部提供了强大的腰部支撑，但它也相当具有攻击性，需要一些时间来适应。耐用的尼龙网布也是如此，穿在你的夏季衣服上会感觉发痒，尤其是当你斜倚时。但强大的人体工学支撑对许多人来说将是一大卖点，尤其是椅子近乎无限的可调节性。请注意，较高的人可能找不到 扶手或座椅足够高。身高 6 英尺 1 英寸，前评论员 Matthew Korfhage 觉得自己正处于边缘。结构坚固，下框架主要采用铬和铝。保修期为 15 年。

paras.en: Uplift Desk Clarksville Ergonomic Chair for $399: The Clarksville is a mid-budget chair model from Uplift. It's a type of chair I generally quite like: breathable, soft-fabric mesh back and a comfortable foam bottom, which tends to settle in over the course of a couple weeks. The overall look is boxy, utilitarian, and respectable. Like the Intuition from Uplift, the chair offers deep reclining ability that can be halted anywhere en route to 45 degrees. But the suspension doesn't offer quite the same level of lumbar support on the way down, nor is there a headrest. Which is to say the Clarksville is best at merely a slight leanback, versus a deep recline. But in the end, the Clarksville is the sort of chair you won't think about much after you buy it, which in its own way is a virtue. A 15-year warranty on a chair below $400 makes this even more virtuous.
paras.zh: Uplift Desk Clarksville 人体工学椅售价 399 美元：Clarksville 是 Uplift 的一款中等预算椅子型号。这是我非常喜欢的一种椅子：透气、柔软的织物网背和舒适的泡沫底部，几周后就会稳定下来。整体外观四四方方、实用且受人尊敬。与 Uplift 的 Intuition 一样，该椅子具有深度倾斜功能，可以在 45 度角的任意位置停止。但悬架在下降过程中不能提供完全相同水平的腰部支撑，也没有头枕。这就是说，Clarksville 最好只是稍微向后倾斜，而不是深度倾斜。但最终，Clarksville 是那种你买了之后就不会多想的椅子，这本身就是一种美德。价格低于 400 美元的椅子享有 15 年保修，这使得这一点更加良性。

paras.en: Haworth Zody Bouclé Office Chair for $1,207: Haworth's Zody is an attractive and elegant chair, especially in the bouclé version Julian Chokkattu tried. His test unit sadly didn't come with a lumbar adjustment, but he still felt quite comfortable sitting in it for long hours. It does run a little warm with this material, though the same will be true if you opt for leather or upholstered. (If that's an issue, you can also go with the standard mesh Zody for around $300 less.) It's very easy to lightly recline in it, and you can even tilt the chair into a more forward sitting position if you're doing a more active task. Julian didn't care much for the seat arms—they felt a little rattly—but found little else to complain about the chair. You get a 12-year warranty, and you can try it for 30 days to see if it's for you.
paras.zh: Haworth Zody Bouclé 办公椅售价 1,207 美元：Haworth 的 Zody 是一款迷人而优雅的椅子，尤其是 Julian Chokkattu 尝试过的 Bouclé 版本。遗憾的是，他的测试装置没有配备腰部调节装置，但长时间坐在里面他仍然感觉很舒服。使用这种材料确实会有点温暖，但如果您选择皮革或软垫，情况也会如此。 （如果这是一个问题，您也可以选择标准的网状 Zody，价格便宜约 300 美元。）可以轻松地轻轻倾斜，如果您正在执行更活跃的任务，您甚至可以将椅子倾斜到更靠前的坐姿。朱利安不太关心座椅扶手——感觉有点摇晃——但对这把椅子没有什么可抱怨的。您可以获得 12 年保修，并且可以试用 30 天，看看它是否适合您。

paras.en: ProtoArc Flexer Pro for $130: This is a surprisingly decent office chair for the money. There are several adjustable points, including seat pan depth and four-way adjustable armrests, as well as multiple recline angles. The build quality is solid considering the price, and it looks nice. After two weeks of sitting on it, it feels relatively supportive, though the seat foam is a bit too firm, noted tester Julian Chokkattu. The main issue is that the lumbar support pops off the chair way too easily when he shifted in his seat. (It has happened three times now.) He wished it were integrated with the backrest.
paras.zh: ProtoArc Flexer Pro 售价 130 美元：这是一款物有所值的办公椅。有多个可调点，包括座板深度和四向可调扶手，以及多个倾斜角度。考虑到价格，构建质量很可靠，而且看起来不错。测试员朱利安·乔卡图 (Julian Chokkattu) 指出，坐上两周后，虽然座椅泡沫有点太硬，但感觉相对有支撑性。主要问题是当他在座位上移动时，腰部支撑太容易从椅子上弹出。 （现在已经发生过三次了。）他希望它能与靠背融为一体。

paras.en: Hon Nucleus Drafting Chair for $605: A drafting chair is designed to accommodate high work surfaces, and you'll usually see a ring underneath the seat to rest your feet on if they don't hit the floor. I'll admit I haven't tested many drafting chairs, but I found the Nucleus completely fine. It looks a bit dull, but the seat is medium firm, there's adjustable lumbar support, and the arms can move up or down and in or out. The version of the chair I tried did not have a recline function, but I was able to adjust the seat depth and seat height. I didn't find it offensive after several weeks of testing, but I also didn't fall in love. I don't think it's worth the MSRP. I also tried the standard Nucleus chair, which is available for a slightly lower price. This one did have the Synchro-Tilt mechanism, and it was easy to set the recline and lock it into place. It does the job, but I think Branch's Ergonomic Chair Pro is still the better buy.
paras.zh: Hon Nucleus 绘图椅售价 605 美元：绘图椅专为适应高工作表面而设计，您通常会在座椅下方看到一个环，如果双脚不接触地板，您可以将其放在上面。我承认我没有测试过很多绘图椅，但我发现 Nucleus 完全没问题。看起来有点沉闷，但是座椅硬度适中，腰部支撑可调节，手臂可以上下左右移动。我尝试的椅子版本没有倾斜功能，但我可以调节座椅深度和座椅高度。经过几周的测试，我并没有觉得它令人反感，但我也没有爱上它。我认为这不值得建议零售价。我还尝试了标准的 Nucleus 椅子，其价格略低。这个确实有同步倾斜机制，很容易设置倾斜并将其锁定到位。它可以完成这项工作，但我认为 Branch 的人体工学椅 Pro 仍然是更好的选择。

paras.en: Hon Altern Chair for $282: It's hard to find a good office chair in this price range. Most people will be better served with the Branch Ergonomic Chair pick above, which has dipped close to $300 during sale events, but the Hon Altern is a decent alternative. The best part about it is that the seat is wide and soft, so your butt will feel fairly comfortable, and the seat depth adjustment accommodates a larger group of people. However, the back support is lackluster. I want to be more upright, but the chair forces me to lean backward. The armrests can only move up and down—I wish I could move them inward a bit more. Its design is also generic. Still, I sat on the Altern for a month, and it does the job. If your budget is tight, it's far and away better than many of the options you'll find at this price on Amazon. It includes a headrest, too, which is typically an extra add-on for many chairs.
paras.zh: Hon Altern 椅子售价 282 美元：在这个价格范围内很难找到一把好的办公椅。大多数人会更好地选择上面的 Branch 人体工学椅，该椅在促销活动期间已下跌近 300 美元，但 Hon Altern 是一个不错的选择。最好的一点是座椅宽大柔软，屁股会感觉相当舒服，而且座椅深度调节可以容纳更多的人。然而，背部支撑却乏善可陈。我想站得更直，但椅子迫使我向后倾斜。扶手只能上下移动——我希望能再向内移动一点。它的设计也是通用的。尽管如此，我还是在 Altern 上坐了一个月，它确实起到了作用。如果您的预算紧张，它比您在亚马逊上以这个价格找到的许多选择要好得多。它还包括一个头枕，这通常是许多椅子的额外附加组件。

paras.en: Autonomous ErgoChair Ultra 2 for $429: Julian Chokkattu sat on Autonomous’s 3D-printed ErgoChair Ultra 2 for over a month and was pleasantly surprised. It’s a big improvement over the original Chair Ultra, which had a flat and hard seat. The Ultra V2’s seat is still not as cushy as some chairs, but it doesn't feel like sitting on concrete. It has all of the adjustments you’d want, from seat depth to a recline lock, and Chokkattu didn't encounter any back pain. The all-mesh design offered good airflow, and the backrest was wide enough that it didn't dig into his shoulders. The only flaw? Sometimes when he put too much pressure on the armrest (like when getting up or shifting his weight), it moved down with a loud crack despite being locked in place. Also, Autonomous has a pretty lackluster two-year warranty despite the high price, and its customer service doesn't seem to be great. A reader provided feedback of a poor experience with the company, and that seems to track with other reports around the web.
paras.zh: Autonomous ErgoChair Ultra 2 售价 429 美元：Julian Chokkattu 在 Autonomous 的 3D 打印 ErgoChair Ultra 2 上坐了一个多月，感到惊喜。与原来的 Chair Ultra 相比，这是一个很大的改进，它有一个平坦的硬座。 Ultra V2 的座椅仍然不像某些椅子那么舒适，但感觉不像坐在混凝土上。它具有您想要的所有调节功能，从座椅深度到倾斜锁定，而且 Chokkattu 没有遇到任何背部疼痛。全网状设计提供了良好的气流，靠背足够宽，不会陷进他的肩膀。唯一的缺陷？有时，当他对扶手施加太大压力时（例如起身或转移体重时），尽管扶手已锁定到位，但扶手仍会发出很大的咔嗒声。此外，尽管价格高昂，但 Autonomous 的两年保修期却相当乏善可陈，而且其客户服务似乎也不是很好。一位读者提供了有关该公司糟糕体验的反馈，这似乎与网络上的其他报道相符。

paras.en: Haworth Fern for $997: I think the Haworth Fern is best for shorter people (aka anyone not above 6 feet, like me). It's adjustable to the nth degree—you can even tilt the seat for a more upright sitting position—but the seat itself was just wide enough for me, though it's plenty soft and pillowy. When I pulled out the seat depth to the max, it created a gap between the seat and the backrest, and I didn't love this feeling. The backrest is nice and soft, but I'd argue the lumbar support is quite aggressive. My back just felt like something was there all the time, and it felt distracting. I don't think you'd have these issues if you were shorter and narrower, and it's otherwise one of the softest office chairs I've sat on.
paras.zh: Haworth Fern 售价 997 美元：我认为 Haworth Fern 最适合矮个子（也就是身高不超过 6 英尺的人，比如我）。它可以调节到第 n 度——你甚至可以倾斜座椅以获得更直立的坐姿——但座椅本身对我来说足够宽，尽管它非常柔软和有枕头感。当我将座椅深度拉到最大时，座椅和靠背之间产生了间隙，我不喜欢这种感觉。靠背又好又软，但我认为腰部支撑相当激进。我的后背总感觉有什么东西在那里，让人分心。我认为如果你又矮又窄，就不会有这些问题，而且它是我坐过的最柔软的办公椅之一。

paras.en: Autonomous ErgoChair Pro for $469: Our top pick, the Branch Ergonomic Chair Pro, is a better buy, but if you need a headrest and want a wider seat, consider the Autonomous ErgoChair Pro. I sat on it for a month with no major problems, except that the box it came in was massive and barely fit through my front door. The levers also aren't super intuitive—I highly recommend checking out this video from the company when you first set it up to dial in your preferences. All the standard adjustments are present, from seat depth and lumbar support to fine-tuning the recline. What surprised me most was the ability to tilt the seat so it's angled down—you don't see that in many chairs. The overall build quality is solid, and I even enjoyed the headrest when kicking back to watch House reruns during lunch. The only woes? I wish the arms stayed locked, as they can slide back and forth. While the foam seat is quite comfy, it can get warm in a toasty room (though the mesh back helps keep things cool). It's a shame this company has an abysmal warranty period, and see my note above on its customer service record.
paras.zh: Autonomous ErgoChair Pro 售价 469 美元：我们的首选 Branch Ergonomic Chair Pro 是更好的选择，但如果您需要头枕并想要更宽的座椅，请考虑 Autonomous ErgoChair Pro。我在上面坐了一个月，没有出现什么大问题，只是它的盒子很大，几乎无法穿过我的前门。这些控制杆也不是超级直观——我强烈建议您在第一次设置它以拨入您的偏好时查看该公司的这段视频。所有标准调整都存在，从座椅深度和腰部支撑到微调倾斜度。最让我惊讶的是能够倾斜座椅，使其向下倾斜——这在很多椅子上都看不到。整体构建质量非常可靠，我什至在午餐时放松地观看《House》重播时还很喜欢它的头枕。唯一的麻烦是什么？我希望手臂保持锁定状态，因为它们可以前后滑动。虽然泡沫座椅非常舒适，但在温暖的房间里它会变热（尽管网状靠背有助于保持凉爽）。遗憾的是这家公司的保修期很糟糕，请参阅我上面关于其客户服务记录的注释。

paras.en: Staples Hyken for $126: The humble Hyken is frequently available for around $150 during big sale events, making it one of the most affordable good chairs out there. It reclines, has a breathable mesh fabric on the back and seat, and it's sturdy. You even get a headrest and lumbar support. After five years of continuous sitting, WIRED reviewers say the Hyken's mesh has compressed a bit, but it's still comfy. The Staples Dexley is slightly wider, so get it if you need a wider seat.
paras.zh: Staples Hyken 售价 126 美元：在大促销活动期间，不起眼的 Hyken 经常以 150 美元左右的价格出售，使其成为市场上最实惠的好椅子之一。它可以倾斜，靠背和座椅上有透气的网眼织物，而且很坚固。您甚至可以获得头枕和腰部支撑。经过五年的连续坐着，《连线》评论家表示，Hyken 的网布已经压缩了一点，但仍然很舒适。 Staples Dexley 稍宽，因此如果您需要更宽的座位，请选择它。

paras.en: Nouhaus Ergo3D for $280: This is another all-mesh chair. The ElastoMesh seat isn't as comfy as the Steelcase Karman (it'll feel worse on the skin if you, uh, tend to sit at your desk without pants), but it's otherwise quite adjustable and roomy, plus it even comes with two sets of wheels (casters or rollerblades) so you can choose which works best for you and your flooring. If you're in a particularly hot environment, it won't trap heat and will keep your whole body cool for a fraction of the price of the Karman.
paras.zh: Nouhaus Ergo3D 售价 280 美元：这是另一款全网状椅子。 ElastoMesh 座椅不像 Steelcase Karman 那样舒适（如果你，呃，不穿裤子坐在办公桌前，皮肤会感觉更糟糕），但它在其他方面相当可调节且宽敞，而且它甚至配备了两组轮子（脚轮或旱冰鞋），因此你可以选择最适合你和你的地板的轮子。如果您处于特别炎热的环境中，它不会积聚热量，并且可以让您的整个身体保持凉爽，而价格仅为卡门的一小部分。

paras.en: Haworth Breck for $382: Haworth's Breck office chair is likely best-suited for shorter people (roughly under 5'8"), though 6'4" tester Julian Chokkattu experienced no back pain when sitting in it for a month. That's because the Breck's seat is short, and the seat depth only extends an extra 2 inches. The weight-activated recline also requires some push on your end, more than you might expect—it wasn't too difficult, but lighter-weight people may find it problematic. The seat padding is thin, though this caused no issues even after hours of sitting. The best part is how amazingly simple it is to set up—no tools required! But the main gripe? Simply getting up from the seat causes the gas spring cylinder to loudly lift. This, and the fact that it tends to make some noises when one fidgets around, makes it feel a little cheap.
paras.zh: Haworth Breck 售价 382 美元：Haworth 的 Breck 办公椅可能最适合身材矮小的人（大约在 5 英尺 8 英寸以下），尽管身高 6 英尺 4 英寸的测试者 Julian Chokkattu 坐了一个月后没有感到背部疼痛。这是因为 Breck 的座椅很短，而且座椅深度仅额外延伸了 2 英寸。重量驱动的倾斜还需要你用力推动，比你想象的要多——这并不是太困难，但体重较轻的人可能会觉得有问题。座椅衬垫很薄，但即使坐了几个小时也没有造成任何问题。最棒的是它的设置非常简单——无需任何工具！但主要的抱怨是什么？只需从座椅上站起来，气弹簧气缸就会发出很大的升起声。这一点，以及当人们坐立不安时它往往会发出一些噪音这一事实，让人感觉有点廉价。

paras.en: Branch Verve for $539: The Verve used to be a top pick, but the Ergonomic Chair Pro is likely a better value considering they're similar in price. It is elegant (especially in the lovely Coral and Cobalt colors), it keeps your back straight, and tester Julian Chokkattu found it quite comfy. It can make nearly the same adjustments as our top pick, but there's no seat tilt, and the armrests are much more limited. Taller or bigger people would probably prefer if the seat were a smidge wider. Note also that a colleague who owns the Verve has said that after more than two years, the seat started to sink whenever he sat on it. Thankfully, he says, Branch's customer service was very responsive and promptly sent him a new cylinder.
paras.zh: Branch Verve 售价 539 美元：Verve 曾经是首选，但考虑到它们的价格相似，Ergonomic Chair Pro 可能更有价值。它很优雅（尤其是可爱的珊瑚色和钴色），它可以让你的背部挺直，测试者 Julian Chokkattu 发现它非常舒适。它可以进行与我们的首选几乎相同的调整，但没有座椅倾斜，并且扶手受到更多限制。如果座位稍微宽一点，更高或更大的人可能会更喜欢。另请注意，一位拥有 Verve 的同事表示，两年多后，每当他坐在上面时，座椅就开始下沉。他说，值得庆幸的是，Branch 的客户服务反应非常迅速，并立即给他发送了一个新的气瓶。

paras.en: Eureka Ergonomic Royal Chair for $499: Some folks chase that executive aesthetic—you know, plush leather and a high back so you can swivel around and reveal a cat in your lap as you laugh maniacally? This chair from Eureka fits the bill without costing a fortune, and it was an OK chair for the month Julian Chokkattu sat in it. The setup was quick, and the seat and back are soft and a little bouncy. He nonetheless found his back sweaty after a few hours of sitting because there was just nowhere for body heat to go. The lumbar support isn't great, and prolonged sitting left Julian with some sensations in his lower back. Not pain, just his back telling him he ought to get up. There's not much to adjust, but the recline and headrest. Also, if you need a wide seat, this is not the chair for you, as the armrests will feel like they're boxing you in (it just fits Julian, who is 6'4"). The chair is easy to clean with a damp cloth, and the fake leather has held up. Too bad about the two-year warranty.
paras.zh: Eureka 人体工学皇家椅售价 499 美元：有些人追求行政美学——你知道，豪华皮革和高靠背，这样你就可以旋转，当你疯狂大笑时，可以露出腿上的一只猫？这把来自尤里卡的椅子符合要求，而且不需要花费太多钱，而且对于朱利安·乔卡图 (Julian Chokkattu) 坐的那个月来说，这把椅子还不错。设置很快，座椅和靠背很软，有一点弹性。尽管如此，坐了几个小时后，他还是发现背部出汗，因为身体的热量无处可去。腰部支撑不是很好，长时间坐着让朱利安的下背部有些感觉。不是疼痛，只是他的背在告诉他应该站起来。没有太多需要调整的地方，但斜倚和头枕。另外，如果你需要一个宽阔的座位，这把椅子不适合你，因为扶手会感觉像是在把你围起来（它正好适合身高 6 英尺 4 英寸的朱利安）。这把椅子很容易用湿布清洁，而且人造皮革也经得起考验。两年保修太糟糕了。

paras.en: Secretlab Titan Evo for $529: The Secretlab Titan Evo is unique among gaming chairs in that it's classy enough for the home office. It sets itself apart from similarly priced competitors with its durability and flexibility. It’s comfortable for marathon gaming sessions, thanks to the adjustability it offers (particularly the lumbar support). The headrest pillow is magnetic and stays attached to the chair, which is a nice touch. But the firm, cold-cure foam molds to your body and may not suit everyone. It will also make you feel sweaty.
paras.zh: Secretlab Titan Evo 售价 529 美元：Secretlab Titan Evo 在游戏椅中是独一无二的，因为它足够优雅，适合家庭办公室。它凭借其耐用性和灵活性在同价位的竞争对手中脱颖而出。由于它提供的可调节性（特别是腰部支撑），它对于马拉松游戏来说非常舒适。头枕是磁性的，可以固定在椅子上，触感很好。但坚固的冷固化泡沫适合您的身体，可能并不适合所有人。它还会让你感到出汗。

paras.en: Hinomi X1 for $699: Hinomi's X1 mesh chair has a trick up its sleeve—a built-in footrest! Just extend and flip out the footrest; voilà, your feet are now propped up. This might not be very practical for tall people whose legs hit the wall behind their desks, but it's quite comfy. Tester Julian Chokkattu found the chair well-built, but said he didn't end up using the footrest as much as he thought he would. There are a good number of adjustments, and the seat itself is a bit firm, which Julian got used to after some time. Hinomi offers a 10-year warranty.
paras.zh: Hinomi X1 售价 699 美元：Hinomi 的 X1 网椅有一个妙招——内置脚踏板！只需伸出并翻转脚踏板即可；瞧，你的脚现在已经支撑起来了。对于双腿撞到办公桌后面墙壁的高个子来说，这可能不太实用，但相当舒服。测试员朱利安·乔卡图 (Julian Chokkattu) 发现这把椅子制作精良，但他表示，他最终并没有像他想象的那样经常使用脚踏板。有很多调整，而且座椅本身有点硬，朱利安过了一段时间就习惯了。 Hinomi 提供 10 年保修。

paras.en: OdinLake Ergo Max747 for $899: The Ergo Max747 is, all around, a great seat to sit in. The three-piece back provides great support and comfort, and the easy-access paddles on either side of the seat make most adjustments quick and simple. Even sitting for hours, I never felt uncomfortable, whether I was sitting up or reclining (this chair reclines incredibly far, from 90 to 135 degrees). The bag holder in the back (which I typically used to hold a hat or small backpack) was a surprisingly nice touch, and the mesh backing and seat are breathable, preventing overheating during prolonged use. I still don’t know how I feel about the polished metal frame, and the inclusion of gloves for assembly makes me worry about how easily this seat will pick up smudges over the years, but the polished finish itself is spotless and well-executed. At 6' 3", I had to max out the back height to comfortably sit in the chair. The secondary adjustments (back height, lumbar support, and headrest height) were awkward to adjust due to complicated ratcheting mechanisms keeping them in place. However, the comfort and breathability of this chair make it a compelling choice. —Henri Robbins
paras.zh: OdinLake Ergo Max747 售价 899 美元：Ergo Max747 是一款非常适合坐的座椅。三件式靠背提供了出色的支撑和舒适度，座椅两侧易于操作的拨片使大多数调整变得快速而简单。即使坐了几个小时，无论是坐着还是躺着（这把椅子倾斜得非常远，从 90 到 135 度），我都没有感到不舒服。后面的包架（我通常用来放帽子或小背包）的触感非常好，网状背衬和座椅透气，可以防止长时间使用时过热。我仍然不知道我对抛光金属框架的感觉如何，而且组装时戴上手套让我担心这个座椅多年来很容易沾上污迹，但抛光表面本身一尘不染且做工精良。身高 6 英尺 3 英寸的我必须最大限度地调高靠背高度才能舒适地坐在椅子上。由于复杂的棘轮机构将其固定在适当的位置，辅助调整（靠背高度、腰部支撑和头枕高度）很难调整。然而，这把椅子的舒适性和透气性使其成为一个令人信服的选择。-Henri Robbins

paras.en: Vari Task Chair for $202: Vari’s Task Chair is surprisingly comfy given its relatively simple construction. Former WIRED reviewer Medea Giordano tested it and asked her husband to use it during his long gaming sessions. They agreed that the angled back provides ample lumbar support to make those sessions comfortable. It also takes very little time to construct. You can recline a bit, but even at the lowest tension, it pushes you back up, and there’s no head support. It’s more for rocking than actually leaning. Her biggest gripe is that the armrests are quite hard. A little more padding would be a huge improvement.
paras.zh: Vari 工作椅售价 202 美元：鉴于其结构相对简单，Vari 的工作椅出人意料地舒适。前《连线》评论员 Medea Giordano 对它进行了测试，并要求她的丈夫在长时间的游戏过程中使用它。他们一致认为，倾斜的靠背提供了充足的腰部支撑，使这些训练变得舒适。建造时间也很短。你可以稍微倾斜一点，但即使在最低的张力下，它也会把你推回去，而且没有头部支撑。它更多的是用于摇摆而不是实际倾斜。她最大的抱怨是扶手很硬。多一点填充将是一个巨大的改进。

paras.en: Branch Softside for $239: Julian Chokkattu tested the high-back version of the Softside and liked it a lot. It's different from all the other chairs in this guide, a bit comfy and cushiony. If you need a wider seat, this might not be the option for you, as the armrests do box you in. There's not much to adjust, but Julian's back didn't have any issues after weeks of sitting for full workdays. The build quality overall is OK. Considering it starts at $299, the overall seating experience, and the lovely design in fun colors, this is a pretty good value if you are after a deep-cushioned experience.
paras.zh: Branch Softside 售价 239 美元：Julian Chokkattu 测试了 Softside 的高背版本，并且非常喜欢它。它与本指南中的所有其他椅子不同，有点舒适且有软垫。如果您需要更宽的座椅，这可能不适合您，因为扶手确实会把您限制住。没有太多需要调整的地方，但朱利安的背部在连续几个工作日坐着后没有任何问题。整体构建质量还可以。考虑到它的起价为 299 美元，整体座椅体验以及可爱的设计和有趣的颜色，如果您追求的是深层坐垫体验，这是一个相当不错的价值。

paras.en: BodyBilt Midcelli for $949: BodyBilt’s chair looks quite average, but the seat pad is plush and soft, and it contours to your butt and legs, which tester Julian Chokkattu liked more than he expected. The mesh back has some give to it, so it doesn't feel rigid, and there are all the usual points of adjustment, including moving the seat forward and back. Julian wished the arms could lock in position, though. It has a lifetime warranty on select parts, while other chair areas are covered for three to 12 years. There are more customization options on BodyBilt's website—with the option to get a consultation. These are all nice sells. But it's a hefty price compared to some of our top picks.
paras.zh: BodyBilt Midcelli 售价 949 美元：BodyBilt 的椅子看起来相当普通，但座垫毛绒且柔软，而且它的轮廓贴合你的臀部和腿部，测试者 Julian Chokkattu 比他想象的更喜欢这一点。网状靠背有一定的弹性，因此不会感觉僵硬，并且有所有常见的调节点，包括向前和向后移动座椅。不过，朱利安希望手臂能够锁定到位。它对特定部件提供终身保修，而其他椅子区域则享有 3 至 12 年保修。 BodyBilt 网站上有更多定制选项 - 还可以选择获取咨询。这些都是很好卖的。但与我们的一些首选产品相比，这是一个高昂的价格。

paras.en: Tempur-Pedic Tempur-Lumbar Support Office Chair for $352: This is a nice alternative to the Branch Ergonomic Chair, and the Tempur seat cushion is, perhaps unsurprisingly, wonderfully comfy to sit on for hours at a time. Most chairs that have a thick lumbar cushion end up causing me back pain, but not here—tester Julian Chokkattu had no issues sitting on it for a month. The mesh back is nice for airflow, too. The arms tend to move around a bit, though, and the mechanism to adjust them is not elegant. Installation wasn't too hard, but the instructions weren't as simple as Branch's, and the overall build quality feels cheap.
paras.zh: Tempur-Pedic Tempur-腰部支撑办公椅售价 352 美元：这是 Branch 人体工学椅的不错替代品，而且 Tempur 座垫一次坐上几个小时也非常舒适，这或许并不令人意外。大多数带有厚腰垫的椅子最终都会导致我背痛，但这里不是这样——测试者 Julian Chokkattu 坐了一个月没有任何问题。网状背面也有利于空气流通。不过，手臂往往会稍微移动，而且调整它们的机制并不优雅。安装并不太难，但说明并不像 Branch 那样简单，而且整体构建质量感觉很便宜。

paras.en: Etta Avenue Doreen Velvet Task Chair for $158: There's absolutely nothing you can adjust on this chair except its height, but it's cute, and the seat is comfy. The velvet polyester was surprisingly durable and looked nice even after several weeks of sitting on this chair. The gold finish on the frame and legs chipped off in one area when tester Julian Chokkattu was unboxing it—it's frequently under $200, OK? But the biggest issue is that it is not compatible with tall or larger people. Julian's wide shoulders caused his arms to stick out of this chair, making it difficult to type, but it suited his 5' 1" wife's narrower frame well. With a 30-day warranty, you get what you pay for, but this chair is more about aesthetics than anything else.
paras.zh: Etta Avenue Doreen 天鹅绒工作椅售价 158 美元：除了高度之外，这把椅子绝对没有什么可以调整的，但它很可爱，而且座位很舒服。天鹅绒聚酯纤维非常耐用，即使在这把椅子上坐了几周后看起来也很漂亮。当测试员 Julian Chokkattu 拆箱时，框架和腿上的金色饰面在一个区域脱落——它的价格通常低于 200 美元，好吗？但最大的问题是它不适合身材高大的人。朱利安的肩膀很宽，导致他的手臂伸出这把椅子，这使得打字很困难，但这很适合他 5 英尺 1 英寸的妻子较窄的身材。有了 30 天的保修期，一分钱一分货，但这把椅子更注重美观。

paras.en: X-Chair X2 K-Sport Management Chair for $659: This used to be our top mesh chair pick, but it has been supplanted by the Steelcase Karman. Sitting in the X-Chair feels like lounging in a hammock. Every part of the body feels well supported, and you can adjust nearly everything on the chair. Pull the seat up and push the armrests up, down, and side to side, or angle them in or out. The lumbar support feels like a cushion, and it adjusts as you move in your seat. If you want to rest your head, you can pay extra for the headrest. It has held up extremely well after three years of near-continuous sitting, but it's also a bit bulky. X-Chair has several models to choose from. Julian tested the X-2 K-Sport with the wide seat, and it fits his 6'4" frame well, but it was too wide for his partner, who is 5' 1". Most people should be fine with the standard X1.
paras.zh: X-Chair X2 K-Sport 管理椅售价 659 美元：这曾经是我们首选的网状椅子，但它已被 Steelcase Karman 取代。坐在 X-Chair 上感觉就像躺在吊床上一样。身体的每个部位都感觉得到了良好的支撑，并且您几乎可以调整椅子上的所有部分。向上拉起座椅，向上、向下、左右推动扶手，或将其向内或向外倾斜。腰部支撑感觉就像一个垫子，它会随着您在座椅上的移动而进行调整。如果您想休息一下，可以额外付费购买头枕。经过三年的近乎连续坐着后，它的表现非常好，但它也有点笨重。 X-Chair 有多种型号可供选择。 Julian 测试了带有宽座椅的 X-2 K-Sport，它非常适合他 6 英尺 4 英寸的身材，但对于他身高 5 英尺 1 英寸的伴侣来说太宽了。大多数人应该对标准 X1 感到满意。

paras.en: X-Chair X-Tech Executive Chair for $1,292: Functionally, the X-Tech is similar to the X-Chair above. In this version, the M-Foam cooling gel seat is indeed wonderful to sit on, though it's not as heat-wicking as the all-mesh versions. It’s the Brisa Soft Touch material that's most impressive—it’s ridiculously soft. Stick with the standard armrests instead of the FS 360 armrests, which tend to move about too much. I just can't figure out why on earth it costs this much.
paras.zh: X-Chair X-Tech 执行椅售价 1,292 美元：从功能上讲，X-Tech 与上面的 X-Chair 类似。在这个版本中，M-Foam 冷却凝胶座椅确实坐起来很舒服，尽管它不如全网状版本那么吸热。最令人印象深刻的是 Brisa Soft Touch 材料，它非常柔软。坚持使用标准扶手，而不是 FS 360 扶手，因为后者往往会移动太多。我只是不明白为什么要花这么多钱。

paras.en: Mavix M7 for $583: If this looks strangely similar to the X-Chair (see above), that's because both are owned by the same company. The M7 has similarly adjustable armrests and seat angles, but you get wheels that lock. The mesh back and wide seat construction keep you cool and comfortable during sweaty League of Legends sessions, and the lumbar support does the job. WIRED gaming chair reviewer Louryn Strampe ran into some issues with assembly, but customer service was able to exchange the model without much effort. If you're short, contact customer support while ordering—Mavix offers shorter cylinders so your feet can touch the ground.
paras.zh: Mavix M7 售价 583 美元：如果它看起来与 X-Chair（见上文）奇怪地相似，那是因为两者都属于同一家公司。 M7 具有类似的可调节扶手和座椅角度，但车轮可以锁定。网状靠背和宽大的座椅结构让您在出汗的英雄联盟比赛中保持凉爽和舒适，腰部支撑也能起到作用。 《连线》游戏椅评论员 Louryn Strampe 在组装时遇到了一些问题，但客户服务部毫不费力地更换了模型。如果您身材矮小，请在订购时联系客户支持 — Mavix 提供较短的气瓶，以便您的脚可以接触地面。

paras.en: Ikea Markus for $300: The Markus is a perfectly fine office chair. It’s not the most comfortable, but it’s far from the worst. The mesh design keeps you cool, and the tall back lets you fully lean into it. It’s rather thin and isn’t obtrusive in a small home office or bedroom. It was annoying to put together (see: Ikea), and you might need someone to hold up the back of the chair while you properly attach the seat. Unfortunately, if you often sit with at least one leg up or with your legs crossed, the width between the arms will make you uncomfortable.
paras.zh: 宜家 Markus 售价 300 美元：Markus 是一把非常精致的办公椅。这不是最舒服的，但也远非最糟糕的。网布设计让您保持凉爽，高靠背让您可以完全倾斜。它相当薄，在小型家庭办公室或卧室中并不显得突兀。组装起来很烦人（参见：宜家），并且在正确安装座椅时可能需要有人支撑椅背。不幸的是，如果你经常至少一条腿抬起或双腿交叉坐着，那么手臂之间的宽度会让你感到不舒服。

paras.en: Hon Ignition 2.0 for $481: The Ignition 2.0 is easy to set up and looks great, but it's had mixed results among WIRED testers, despite positive reviews around the web. 6' 4" tester Julian Chokkattu experienced some back pain, but a 5' 4" friend tried it for a few weeks, and she had zero issues. This seems to be the answer. It's possible the Ignition is just better suited for smaller folks.
paras.zh: Hon Ignition 2.0 售价 481 美元：Ignition 2.0 易于设置，而且看起来很棒，但《连线》测试人员的结果好坏参半，尽管网络上的评价很高。 6 英尺 4 英寸的测试员 Julian Chokkattu 经历了一些背部疼痛，但一位 5 英尺 4 英寸的朋友尝试了几周，结果为零。这似乎就是答案。 Ignition 可能更适合身材较小的人。

paras.en: Pipersong Meditation Chair for $299: Have a problem sitting in a traditional chair? If your legs need to be bent and twisted for you to be comfortable, you'll want to check this seat out. It has a 360-degree swiveling footstool that can accommodate pretty much any sitting position you want. I can go from kneeling to cross-legged to one leg up, one leg down. It’s possible to sit normally too, with the footstool behind you and your feet flat on the floor. It's the most prominent chair designed for odd sitting habits. There are no armrests, which I didn’t mind because that’s what makes it possible to sit in many of these positions. The actual stool and chair back could stand to be bigger and taller, respectively. I had to use a pillow to keep my back comfy. —Medea Giordano
paras.zh: Pipersong 冥想椅售价 299 美元：坐在传统椅子上有问题吗？如果您的双腿需要弯曲和扭转才能感到舒适，那么您需要检查一下这个座椅。它有一个 360 度旋转脚凳，几乎可以适应您想要的任何坐姿。我可以从跪着到盘腿，再到一腿向上，一腿向下。也可以正常坐着，将脚凳放在身后，双脚平放在地板上。这是最著名的椅子，专为奇怪的坐姿习惯而设计。没有扶手，我并不介意，因为这使得可以坐在许多这样的位置上。实际的凳子和椅背可以分别更大和更高。我不得不使用枕头来保持背部舒适。 ——美狄亚·佐丹奴

paras.en: If you come across these models, we recommend you save your cash and go for one of the picks above.
paras.zh: 如果您遇到这些型号，我们建议您省钱并选择上述选择之一。

paras.en: Sihoo Doro C300 Pro V2: The Pro edition of the Doro C300 is priced more approachably than the S300 WIRED had tested previously from Sihoo. It likewise looks like a Space Age command chair built from a layer cake of shaped mesh panels. Its back is quite comfortable, with lumbar support that can be adjusted both inward and up and down. Like all mesh, it's quite breathable, and the chair is built to allow a lot of lateral movement, aligning with your body as you move side to side. This is all nice. But the chair's a bit squeaky, and its noodly, 8D-adjustable armrests are a bit of a deal-breaker for me. On the one hand, the armrests are shockingly adjustable, to seemingly any position. On the other, they move seemingly everywhere except where you want them, pushing out or tilting at the lightest touch, which can give the chair an oddly flimsy feeling. Also, the recline function is precipitous and unbalanced: I actually yelped in fear when leaning back for the first time, which bounced the chair slightly off its front wheels. Assembly takes more than an hour and involves 17 parts and 30 ill-labeled screws.
paras.zh: 西虎Doro C300 Pro V2：Doro C300 Pro版的价格比西虎之前测试过的S300 WIRED更平易近人。它看起来也像一把太空时代的指挥椅，由成型网状面板的层蛋糕制成。它的靠背相当舒服，腰部支撑可以向内和上下调节。与所有网布一样，它非常透气，并且椅子的设计允许大量横向运动，当您从一侧移动到另一侧时，与您的身体保持一致。这一切都很好。但椅子有点吱吱作响，而且它的 8D 可调扶手对我来说有点破坏性。一方面，扶手的调节能力令人震惊，几乎可以调节到任何位置。另一方面，它们似乎到处移动，除了你想要的地方，最轻微的触摸就会推出或倾斜，这会给椅子一种奇怪的脆弱的感觉。此外，倾斜功能非常陡峭且不平衡：当我第一次向后倾斜时，我实际上吓得大叫起来，这使椅子从前轮上轻微弹起。组装需要一个多小时，涉及 17 个零件和 30 个标签错误的螺丝。

paras.en: Eureka Ergonomic Serene Nox: This chair is easy to set up; however, after tester Julian Chokkattu sat on it for more than a week, two of the screws at the bottom of the frame came undone, and the left half of the seat suddenly dropped low. That's not something you should deal with for an $800 chair, and even after he tightened the screws, it happened again a few days later. It's a shame, because it's a fairly attractive leather office chair with a nice silhouette, and it's decently comfy. The construction just needs work.
paras.zh: Eureka Ergonomic Serene Nox：这把椅子很容易安装；然而，测试者朱利安·乔卡图(Julian Chokkattu)在上面坐了一个多星期后，框架底部的两颗螺丝松开了，座椅的左半部分突然下降了。对于一把 800 美元的椅子来说，这不是你应该处理的事情，即使他拧紧了螺丝，几天后这种情况又发生了。遗憾的是，因为它是一把相当有吸引力的皮革办公椅，轮廓优美，而且非常舒适。施工只需要工作。

paras.en: Razer Iskur V2 X: Multiple WIRED reviewers recommend Razer's Iskur V2 Pro as the best gaming chair if you're after the racing car seat aesthetic, but the cheaper V2 X isn't as impressive. It's dramatically cheaper, but it's worth keeping in mind that the Iskur V2 has dipped to $400 during major sale events, so the V2 X isn't that much more affordable. The seat is actually OK; the built-in lumbar support helped keep back pain away even after long hours at the computer. The fabric upholstery keeps your body warm (and a little sweaty), but it's comfy to sit on. But the biggest issue for tester Julian Chokkattu? It creaked so dang much. After just a week or so of sitting on the V2 X, almost every part of the chair started creaking. You're going to have to WD-40 this thing every few weeks to keep it quiet. Or save your cash and go for the V2.
paras.zh: Razer Iskur V2 X：如果您追求赛车座椅的美观，多位《连线》评论者推荐 Razer 的 Iskur V2 Pro 作为最好的游戏椅，但更便宜的 V2 X 就不那么令人印象深刻了。它的价格要便宜得多，但值得注意的是，Iskur V2 在重大促销活动期间已降至 400 美元，因此 V2 X 的价格并没有那么便宜。座位其实还可以；即使长时间坐在电脑前，内置的腰部支撑也能帮助缓解背部疼痛。织物内饰可以让您的身体保持温暖（并且有点出汗），但坐起来很舒服。但测试员 Julian Chokkattu 面临的最大问题是什么？它吱吱作响。在 V2 X 上坐了大约一周后，椅子的几乎每个部分都开始吱吱作响。你必须每隔几周对这个东西进行一次 WD-40 以保持安静。或者省点钱买 V2。

paras.en: TopJob Napa: The Napa should be $200 or $250 at best, notes tester Julian Chokkattu, nowhere near its $450 to $550 asking price. It's not comfy, he notes, there's not much plush to the seat and backrest, but it's not too uncomfortable. Julian's back surprisingly didn't complain after more than a week of sitting in it for several hours a day. It doesn't have many points of adjustment—you can adjust the armrest height, lock the recline at a few degrees, and adjust tilt tension. That's it. Technically, you can adjust the headrest, but mine would not stay put at a specific height. You can pull out a footrest, but in practice this is more gimmicky than useful. It looks attractive, especially in the amber vegan leather, but the overall quality is a little cheap. You can do better at this price.
paras.zh: TopJob Napa：测试员 Julian Chokkattu 指出，Napa 的价格最多应该为 200 美元或 250 美元，远低于其 450 至 550 美元的要价。他指出，这并不舒服，座椅和靠背没有太多毛绒，但也不算太不舒服。令人惊讶的是，朱利安每天坐几个小时后，背部并没有出现任何不适。它没有太多的调节点——你可以调节扶手高度，将倾斜锁定在几度，并调节倾斜张力。就是这样。从技术上讲，您可以调整头枕，但我的头枕不会保持在特定高度。您可以拉出脚踏板，但实际上这只是噱头而不是有用的。它看起来很吸引人，尤其是琥珀色的纯素皮革，但整体质量有点便宜。以这个价格你可以做得更好。

paras.en: Humanscale World One: Despite hailing from the well-renowned Humanscale, this chair looks quite bland, noted tester Julian Chokkattu. The setup was fairly quick, and … interesting. You have to hammer two pegs to affix the backrest to the seat, which Julian had never had to do before, after testing dozens of office chairs. It just feels cheap and a little too plasticky. Like other Humanscale offerings, there are no adjustments to make, as the chair will handle it all for you (you can adjust the seat and armrest height). Julian loved this on the pricier Humanscale Freedom, which felt like someone was cradling his body. But in the all-mesh World One, he found his body constantly shifting, trying to find a comfy way to recline. The mesh material also feels like it digs in a bit. This could all be because he's 6' 4", as the chair feels like it's better suited for less lofty people. But at $700, it's worth demanding more.
paras.zh: Humanscale World One：测试员 Julian Chokkattu 指出，尽管这款椅子出自著名的 Humanscale，但它看起来相当平淡。设置相当快，而且……很有趣。你必须敲击两个钉子才能将靠背固定在座椅上，朱利安在测试了几十把办公椅后以前从未这样做过。它只是感觉很便宜而且有点太塑料了。与其他 Humanscale 产品一样，无需进行任何调整，因为椅子将为您处理这一切（您可以调整座椅和扶手的高度）。朱利安很喜欢价格更高的 Humanscale Freedom 上的这一点，感觉就像有人抱着他的身体。但在全网状的第一世界中，他发现自己的身体在不断地移动，试图找到一种舒适的倾斜方式。网状材料也感觉有点凹陷。这可能都是因为他身高 6 英尺 4 英寸，因为这把椅子感觉更适合身材矮小的人。但 700 美元的价格，要求更高还是值得的。

paras.en: Herman Miller Vantum: Initially, tester Julian Chokkattu liked the Vantum. He liked how it could keep him in a super upright position, which made him feel more engaged in what he was doing. The mesh backrest also disperses heat quite well. However, the overall build quality feels cheap and doesn’t scream Herman Miller (nor does the asking price, which has since dropped just below four figures). The headrest isn't great either—Julian nearly broke it trying to move it up and down. As he kept sitting, it was the back support that disappointed him the most. You can feel the lumbar support on your lower back, and not in a good way, almost like it’s digging in. At least it didn’t cause back pain.
paras.zh: Herman Miller Vantum：最初，测试员 Julian Chokkattu 喜欢 Vantum。他喜欢它能让他保持超级直立的姿势，这让他感觉更专注于他正在做的事情。网状靠背的散热效果也很好。然而，整体制造质量感觉很便宜，并且没有让 Herman Miller 尖叫（要价也没有，此后价格已降至略低于四位数）。头枕也不是很好——朱利安在上下移动时差点把它弄坏了。当他继续坐着时，最令他失望的是靠背。你可以感觉到腰部支撑在你的下背部，但不是很好，几乎就像是在凹陷。至少它没有引起背部疼痛。

paras.en: Vilno Nobel Kneeling Chair: This kneeling chair is what's known as an active chair, meant to keep your body moving and keep your posture straight. It was easy to put all the wood pieces together, and the seat cushion was surprisingly plump. It feels effective for the first few hours, but unfortunately, rocking in the seat tends to cause it to move around on the floor, so I frequently had to fix my position. Worse yet, my shins and knees grew fatigued, and I started feeling some pain after a few days. You can't adjust its height, so it needs to be paired with a standing desk so that your palms don't rest on your desk. —Julian Chokkattu
paras.zh: Vilno Nobel 跪椅：这款跪椅被称为活动椅，旨在让您的身体保持活动并保持姿势笔直。很容易将所有的木块拼凑在一起，座垫也出奇的丰满。在最初的几个小时里感觉很有效，但不幸的是，座位上的摇晃往往会导致它在地板上移动，所以我经常不得不调整我的位置。更糟糕的是，我的小腿和膝盖变得疲劳，几天后我开始感到一些疼痛。你无法调节它的高度，所以它需要与站立式办公桌搭配使用，这样你的手掌就不会放在桌子上。 ——朱利安·乔卡图

paras.en: Flexispot C7: While this chair is simple to assemble and looks good, it feels flimsy. The entire back flexes and warps whenever you move, and the lumbar support is barely connected to the rest of the chair, meaning it audibly scratches against the main section of the back every time you adjust and hardly feels like it provides any actual support. The footrest bends whenever weight is put on it, and the foam seat cushion collects crazy amounts of pet hair. It feels like just a few extra screws and supports would have made this a good product, but in its current state, there isn’t enough material to make it feel sturdy. —Henri Robbins
paras.zh: Flexispot C7：虽然这把椅子组装简单且看起来不错，但感觉很脆弱。当你移动时，整个靠背都会弯曲和扭曲，腰部支撑几乎与椅子的其余部分几乎没有连接，这意味着每次你调整时，它都会在靠背的主要部分上发出刮擦声，而且几乎感觉不到它提供任何实际的支撑。当重量施加在脚踏板上时，脚踏板就会弯曲，泡沫座垫会收集大量的宠物毛发。感觉只要几个额外的螺丝和支撑就可以使它成为一个很好的产品，但在目前的状态下，没有足够的材料使它感觉坚固。 ——亨利·罗宾斯

paras.en: Steelcase Series 1: WIRED reviewer Louryn Strampe says her biggest issue with the Series 1 is with the armrests—the tops slide back and forth and side to side, which could be a good thing, except she managed to pinch her arm every time she moved. There's no way to lock them in place, so while she felt supported, her arms weren't. The seat is also pretty curved, which can feel like you're trapped in one position as you work throughout the day.
paras.zh: Steelcase 系列 1：《连线》评论员 Louryn Strampe 表示，她对 Series 1 最大的问题是扶手——顶部来回滑动、左右滑动，这可能是一件好事，只是她每次移动时都会夹住手臂。没有办法将它们锁定到位，所以虽然她感到有支撑，但她的手臂却没有。座椅也相当弯曲，当你一整天工作时，你会感觉自己被困在一个位置。

paras.en: Sihoo Doro S300: Former WIRED reviewer Medea Giordano tested the Doro S300, which, in white, looks like it came straight out of the Space Force situation room. She found it comfortable. There are several adjustments you can personalize, like seat depth and recline angle. You can recline quite far, but she says she wishes there were a footrest to enjoy the lowest recline position. She typically prefers a cushy gaming chair, but she says she had no trouble sitting on this seat all day—the dual lumbar support helps too. However, the headrest is too low for her to lean against, even at its maximum height, and the arms move too easily. Simply placing her arms down pushes them out of position. It's also squeaky and overpriced.
paras.zh: Sihoo Doro S300：前《连线》评论员 Medea Giordano 测试了 Doro S300，它是白色的，看起来像是直接从太空军战情室拿出来的。她觉得很舒服。您可以进行多项个性化调整，例如座椅深度和倾斜角度。你可以倾斜很远，但她说她希望有一个脚踏板来享受最低的倾斜位置。她通常更喜欢舒适的游戏椅，但她说她整天坐在这个座位上没有任何问题——双腰部支撑也有帮助。然而，头枕太低，即使在最大高度，她也无法靠在上面，而且手臂也太容易移动。只要将手臂放下，就会将它们推离原来的位置。它也吱吱作响并且价格过高。

articles.title: 10 Best Meal Delivery Services, Tested by an Ex-Restaurant Critic
articles.author: Matthew Korfhage, Louryn Strampe

paras.en: The best meal delivery services and meal kits make your home life easier—and maybe make dinner something to look forward to rather than dread. Our lead tester for this guide, former WIRED Reviews writer Matthew Korfhage, didn’t expect to appreciate meal kits as much as he did, especially since he likes to cook and worked as a food critic on both coasts for more than a decade.
paras.zh: 最好的送餐服务和餐包让您的家庭生活更加轻松，也许还能让晚餐变得令人期待而不是恐惧。我们本指南的首席测试员、前《连线》评论作家 Matthew Korfhage 没想到会像他一样欣赏餐包，特别是因为他喜欢烹饪，并在美国和美国两岸担任美食评论家十多年。

paras.en: The best meal kits help you climb out of a cooking rut of turning to the same dishes—and the same flavors—over and over. After testing every major meal delivery service over the past two years, we’ve narrowed the field to just a few of the best options for each family and diet. Quite simply, the best meals our testers have eaten from a meal kit come from Marley Spoon, which offers a path to genuinely good home-cooked meals on nights when you might otherwise feel uninspired.
paras.zh: 最好的膳食套装可以帮助您摆脱一遍又一遍地吃同样的菜肴和同样的口味的烹饪惯例。在测试了过去两年中所有主要的送餐服务后，我们将范围缩小到只针对每个家庭和饮食的一些最佳选择。很简单，我们的测试人员从餐包中吃过的最好的饭菜来自 Marley Spoon，它为您提供了一条途径，让您在晚上可能会感到没有灵感时享用真正美味的家常饭菜。

paras.en: But depending on your priorities, other meal delivery services might be a better option. Home Chef offers the greatest flexibility for busy families while keeping prices affordable. EveryPlate is the best meal kit for people on a tight budget. For a healthful, tailored diet (including an option for true gluten-free meals), we recommend Green Chef. If you’d rather not cook at all, CookUnity is the best prepared-meal delivery service we’ve ever had the pleasure to warm up.
paras.zh: 但根据您的优先事项，其他送餐服务可能是更好的选择。 Home Chef 为忙碌的家庭提供最大的灵活性，同时保持价格实惠。 EveryPlate 是适合预算紧张的人的最佳餐盒。对于健康、定制的饮食（包括真正的无麸质膳食的选择），我们推荐 Green Chef。如果您根本不想做饭，CookUnity 是我们有幸提供的最好的预制餐食配送服务。

paras.en: We assessed each meal plan’s recipes, variety, sourcing, ease of preparation, convenience, organization, packaging, ingredient quality, and suitability for different dietary restrictions and needs. We also tested the best new and innovative meal kits for those looking for alternatives to Blue Apron's or HelloFresh’s long-standing meal delivery services. And not for nothing, we sorted out some often maddeningly nontransparent pricing.
paras.zh: 我们评估了每个膳食计划的食谱、品种、来源、准备难易程度、便利性、组织、包装、成分质量以及对不同饮食限制和需求的适用性。我们还为那些寻找 Blue Apron 或 HelloFresh 长期送餐服务替代品的人测试了最佳的新型创新餐包。我们并非无缘无故地整理出了一些经常令人抓狂的不透明定价。

paras.en: Be sure to check out our investigation into whether meal kits are sometimes cheaper than groceries when trying out new recipes, and WIRED's related guides, including Best Plant-Based Meal Kits, Best Food Gifts You Can Buy Online, Best Coffee Subscriptions, and Best Delivery Chocolate Boxes.
paras.zh: 请务必查看我们关于在尝试新食谱时餐包有时是否比杂货更便宜的调查，以及《连线》的相关指南，包括最佳植物性餐包、您可以在线购买的最佳食品礼品、最佳咖啡订阅和最佳送货巧克力盒。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: We’re retesting the kits in this guide, including special holiday offerings from meal kit makers like Marley Spoon. We’ve added some notes reflecting this in relevant sections and checked for accuracy throughout.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：我们正在重新测试本指南中的套件，包括 Marley Spoon 等膳食套件制造商提供的特别节日产品。我们在相关部分添加了一些反映这一点的注释，并检查了整个过程的准确性。

paras.en: These meal kits former WIRED reviewer and lead tester Matthew Korhage tried didn’t make his final cut, but he still recommends them. Here are his thoughts on what he liked and what held them back.
paras.zh: 前《连线》评论员兼首席测试员 Matthew Korhage 尝试过的这些餐包并未进入最终筛选，但他仍然推荐它们。以下是他对自己喜欢什么以及阻碍什么的想法。

paras.en: Sunbasket (~$16 per serving): Sunbasket focuses heavily on fresh, organic ingredients and offers a whole lot of variety in its menus. Its recipes are attentive to saucing and to basic good cooking techniques such as deglazing. Like Hungryroot, it also offers breakfasts and snacks to supplement meal options with little extras such as coconut yogurt and sous-vide egg bites. The meal kit also lets you filter out allergen-containing items. WIRED reviewer Louryn Strampe loved the flexibility and add-ons. During a recent test, I enjoyed an excellent Greek chicken and orzo salad dish—and, wonder of wonders, the advertised prep time was actually the actual prep time (about 30 minutes). The focus on organic ingredients does make Sunbasket one of the more expensive meal kit options, and the annual Thanksgiving meal kit has remained a lovely and welcome extravagance at $200.
paras.zh: Sunbasket（每份约 16 美元）：Sunbasket 非常注重新鲜有机食材，菜单种类繁多。它的食谱注重酱料和基本的良好烹饪技术，例如脱釉。与 Hungryroot 一样，它也提供早餐和小吃，以补充膳食选择，并提供一些额外的食物，例如椰子酸奶和真空低温烹调鸡蛋片。餐盒还可以让您过滤掉含有过敏原的物品。 《连线》评论员 Louryn Strampe 非常喜欢它的灵活性和附加功能。在最近的一次测试中，我很喜欢一道美味的希腊鸡肉和米粒沙拉——而且，奇迹中的奇迹，广告上的准备时间实际上是实际的准备时间（大约 30 分钟）。对有机成分的关注确实使 Sunbasket 成为较昂贵的餐包选择之一，而一年一度的感恩节餐包仍然是一种可爱且受欢迎的奢侈套餐，价格为 200 美元。

paras.en: Gardencup ($11 to $15 a serving): Gardencup is a little like having the whole menu of Sweetgreen sent to your house or office, except in cylindrical form. Basically, you pick out premade salads, soups, and snacks, and they come in little cups—fresh, lovely, crisp, and ready to eat. I found it to be a great way to keep myself eating healthy when there’s no time to cook at the office (or the home office), which is typically when DoorDash or freezer-meal temptations run wild. It remains among the healthiest prepared food delivery options I know. I even tested Gardencup as a salad option during a cyclospora parasite scare, in part because I missed salad and because Gardencup could attest that it did not use lettuce from any of the suspected sources of the outbreak. The salads remained delicious and delivered a shocking amount of protein in the meat options. But variety of options is not a strong suit. A slackened focus on local sourcing, plus limited transparency on sourcing—Gardencup will disclose only that it sources its greens in the salad belt from Salinas, California, to Yuma, Arizona—has kept Gardencup in my honorable mentions.
paras.zh: Gardencup（每份 11 至 15 美元）：Gardencup 有点像将 Sweetgreen 的整个菜单发送到您的家中或办公室，只不过是圆柱形的。基本上，你挑选预制的沙拉、汤和小吃，它们装在小杯子里——新鲜、可爱、酥脆，可即食。我发现，当没有时间在办公室（或家庭办公室）做饭时（通常是 DoorDash 或冷冻餐诱惑疯狂时），这是保持自己饮食健康的好方法。它仍然是我所知道的最健康的预制食品配送选择之一。我什至在环孢子虫寄生虫恐慌期间测试了 Gardencup 作为沙拉的选择，部分原因是我错过了沙拉，而且因为 Gardencup 可以证明它没有使用来自任何可疑爆发源的生菜。沙拉仍然很美味，并且在肉类选择中提供了惊人数量的蛋白质。但多样化的选择并不是强项。对本地采购的关注度有所减弱，加上采购透明度有限——Gardencup 只会透露其蔬菜来源是从加利福尼亚州萨利纳斯到亚利桑那州尤马的沙拉带——这使得 Gardencup 一直处于我的荣誉提名中。

paras.en: Factor ($13 to $17 a serving): Factor is a prepared-meal delivery plan run by HelloFresh, with ready-to-eat meals that look a lot like TV dinners. But there’s a twist: The trays have never been frozen. They were made fresh in a commissary kitchen and shipped with cold packs, so they taste kind of like restaurant leftovers. Consistently, Factor ranks among the best-tasting prepared meal plans I’ve tested, especially when I shrug off the directions and reheat my meals in an air fryer instead of a microwave. Proteins and high-protein meals are a strong suit. Proteins maintain their texture quite well, especially a truffled filet mignon I couldn’t believe I microwaved. Still, some meals, especially carb-avoidant or keto meals, are oddly mushy, while meals centered on proteins and whole starches, like potatoes or rice, alongside veggies like green beans or Brussels sprouts, tended to fare quite well. So did stir-fry-style meals. My gluten-free colleague, Scott Gilbertson, wrote that he had the best luck with Factor’s Mexican fare. I do wish Factor would shed its reliance on the microwave: When I went off-script and used a Ninja Crispi air fryer or convection oven, I had much better results than with the nuker. But non-air-fryer ovens do not seem to offer the same improvement. Like many ready-to-eat meals, it’s a bit more expensive than the kits you cook yourself. Oh, and as a bonus? Factor has a really, truly delicious selection of nutrient-amped juice bottles and elderberry “shots.” I could pretty much subsist on their probiotic cucumber-pineapple green juice.
paras.zh: Factor（每份 13 至 17 美元）：Factor 是 HelloFresh 运营的预制餐点配送计划，提供看起来很像电视晚餐的即食餐点。但有一个问题：托盘从未被冷冻过。它们是在小卖部的厨房里新鲜制作的，并用冷包装运输，所以它们的味道有点像餐馆的剩菜。一直以来，Factor 都是我测试过的味道最好的预制餐计划之一，尤其是当我不顾说明并用空气炸锅而不是微波炉重新加热食物时。蛋白质和高蛋白膳食是强项。蛋白质很好地保持了它们的质地，尤其是松露菲力牛排，我简直不敢相信我用微波炉加热过。尽管如此，一些膳食，尤其是避免碳水化合物或酮类的膳食，却是​​奇怪的糊状，而以蛋白质和全淀粉为主的膳食，如土豆或大米，以及青豆或球芽甘蓝等蔬菜，往往表现得相当不错。炒菜也是如此。我的无麸质同事斯科特·吉尔伯特森 (Scott Gilbertson) 写道，他在 Factor 的墨西哥美食上运气最好。我确实希望 Factor 能够摆脱对微波炉的依赖：当我不按剧本使用 Ninja Crispi 空气炸锅或对流烤箱时，我吃得更好 结果比核弹还要好。但非空气炸锅烤箱似乎没有提供同样的改进。和许多即食食品一样，它比你自己做饭的套件贵一点。哦，作为奖励？ Factor 提供真正美味的营养丰富的果汁瓶和接骨木“饮料”。我几乎可以靠他们的益生菌黄瓜菠萝绿汁维持生计。

paras.en: Fuel Meals ($14 to $15 a serving): Fuel Meals are a no-nonsense, no-fluff, no-added-ingredients, pure-protein-packed nutritive meal plan, with many meals paleo-friendly. Some of Fuel’s meals had as few as five ingredients, essentially the macronutrients plus a modicum of oil and salt. A large percentage of meals are marked gluten-free or dairy-free. Does all this mean less flavor? It can. The meals are also often not beautiful, dominated by a large and no-fuss serving of protein. But Fuel’s meal service offers an admirable focus, especially for those bulking up or watching carbs. Meals are substantive, usually topping 600 calories and 40 grams of protein, with no added sugar, fatty dairy, or carb-heavy filler. As a baby gym rat, I appreciate how clear the macros are, but some meals are high in sodium and often aren’t deficit-friendly.
paras.zh: 燃料餐（每份 14 至 15 美元）：燃料餐是一种严肃、无绒毛、无添加成分、富含纯蛋白质的营养餐计划，其中许多餐点都适合原始人饮食。 Fuel 的一些餐食只有五种成分，主要是大量营养素加上少量的油和盐。很大一部分餐食都标记为无麸质或不含乳制品。这一切是否意味着味道变少了？可以。饭菜也常常不那么美味，主要是大量的、简单的蛋白质。但 Fuel 的餐饮服务提供了令人钦佩的焦点，特别是对于那些增重或注意碳水化合物的人来说。膳食是丰盛的，通常含有 600 卡路里热量和 40 克蛋白质，不添加糖、高脂乳制品或高碳水化合物填充物。作为一只健身小老鼠，我很欣赏宏指令的清晰性，但有些食物钠含量很高，而且通常不利于赤字。

paras.en: Wildgrain ($13 to $17 per loaf or box of pastries): This is less a meal delivery service than a way to step up a home meal. Wildgrain is a monthly bread-box delivery: You receive par-baked bread and pastries from small bakeries across the country. This is pretty much the same process that likely happens at local restaurants when your warm bread basket comes out: It’s not quite as high-quality as you’d get directly from an artisan bakery, if you live in places with artisan bakeries. But it’s also as fresh as it gets, and I had a great experience testing the box in October 2025, especially the sourdough breads, which are perfect for large meals with houseguests. You finish baking at home, so you end up with ultra-fresh bread, biscuits, doughnuts, or scones that are still warm and crisp from the oven. A Wildgrain subscription arrives as a monthly box filled with four, six, or 12 items, ranging from a full sourdough loaf or fresh-made pasta to a pack of six doughnuts or four large croissants. Basically, you build your own box each month, choosing from healthy sourdough or pasta and decadent pastries.
paras.zh: Wildgrain（每条面包或每盒糕点 13 至 17 美元）：与其说这是一种送餐服务，不如说这是一种增强家庭膳食的方式。 Wildgrain 是每月一次的面包盒配送：您会收到来自全国各地小面包店的半烤面包和糕点。当你的热面包篮出来时，这与当地餐馆可能发生的过程几乎相同：如果你住在有手工面包店的地方，它的质量不如直接从手工面包店买到的那么高。但它也非常新鲜，我在 2025 年 10 月测试这个盒子时获得了很好的体验，尤其是酵母面包，它非常适合与客人一起享用大餐。您在家中完成烘焙，因此您最终会得到超新鲜的面包、饼干、甜甜圈或烤饼，它们从烤箱中出来仍然温暖而酥脆。 Wildgrain 订阅以每月一盒的形式提供，里面装有 4 种、6 种或 12 种物品，从完整的酵母面包或新鲜制作的意大利面到一包 6 个甜甜圈或 4 个大羊角面包。基本上，你每个月都会建造自己的盒子，从健康的酵母或面食和颓废的糕点中进行选择。

paras.en: Thistle ($12 to $15 per meal): A prior top pick for solo diners with individually prepared dishes that require little to no prep, Thistle is mostly a plant-based meal kit—but you can add sustainable meats to any otherwise vegan meal for $3. It’s also so local and seasonal that the West and East Coasts have different menus, and the whole middle of the country, except Chicago, gets none. (You can check your zip code here to see if you can get delivery.) Former WIRED reviewer Adrienne So used Thistle to get herself to eat more vegetables and thus avoid a life of rickets and/or scurvy. Portions are generous enough to split among meals, and in a nice turn for those who hate disposing of boxes, Thistle's drivers will pick up the cooler bag that held last week’s meal and replace it with a new one full of food. WIRED reviewer Molly Higgins’s favorite meals from Thistle were a whirlwind of textures, including a Mexican-inspired corn and poblano chile salad with adobo pinto beans and a chilled, lemongrass-accented rice noodle bowl that mixed spice, tang, crisp veggies, and deep umami from mushrooms and seaweed. She still dreams about it sometimes. Breakfasts are available at a lower cost, as low as $9.
paras.zh: Thistle（每餐 12 至 15 美元）：Thistle 是单独准备菜肴的单独食客的首选，几乎不需要任何准备，Thistle 主要是植物性餐包，但您可以花 3 美元将可持续肉类添加到任何纯素餐中。它也是如此本地化和季节性，以至于西海岸和东海岸有不同的菜单，而整个国家中部，除了芝加哥，没有菜单。 （您可以在这里检查您的邮政编码，看看是否可以送货。）前《连线》评论员 Adrienne So 使用 Thistle 来让自己多吃蔬菜，从而避免患佝偻病和/或坏血病。份量足够大，可以分餐，对于那些讨厌处理盒子的人来说，这是一个很好的转变，Thistle 的司机会拿起装上周餐的冷藏袋，并用一个装满食物的新袋子代替。 《连线》杂志评论员莫莉·希金斯 (Molly Higgins) 最喜欢的 Thistle 餐厅的食物口感如旋风般，包括墨西哥风味的玉米和波布拉诺智利沙拉配阿多波斑豆，以及柠檬草味的冰镇米粉碗，混合了香料、味道、清脆的蔬菜以及来自蘑菇和海藻的浓郁鲜味。她有时仍然会梦见它。早餐价格较低，低至 9 美元。

paras.en: Tovala (~$9 to $15 a serving): It’s not every day you get to try something that feels super new. Tovala offers perhaps the most ambitious ready-to-heat and prepared-meal delivery solution I’ve seen: the meal kits come with an oven! Unlike the sogginess of many prepared meals, Tovala's recipes come in little foil pans with recipes custom-designed for a small steam oven. The results are often delicious—as was the case during my testing with a sweet chili–glazed salmon with pickled veg and noodles—and the QR code scanning function makes each recipe seamless to cook. Stick with the meal plan for six weeks, and you get a quite affordable and powerful little convection oven, toaster, and steamer. A previous flaw was that Tovala only offered single-serve meals. But as of early 2026, at least four or five meals a week offer two to four servings, making the meal delivery service much more useful to families and couples—and much more economical per serving. But note that it’s also one of the most sodium-filled meal services I’ve tested.
paras.zh: Tovala（每份约 9 至 15 美元）：并不是每天都能尝试一些感觉超级新鲜的东西。 Tovala 提供的也许是我所见过的最雄心勃勃的即热和预制餐食交付解决方案：餐包配有烤箱！与许多湿漉漉的预制饭菜不同，Tovala 的食谱装在小铝箔锅中，其中的食谱是为小型蒸汽炉定制的。结果通常很美味——就像我测试甜辣酱三文鱼配腌菜和面条时的情况一样——而且二维码扫描功能使每个食谱都可以无缝烹饪。坚持六周的饮食计划，你就会得到一个相当实惠且功能强大的小型对流烤箱、烤面包机和蒸锅。之前的一个缺陷是托瓦拉只提供单份餐食。但截至 2026 年初，每周至少四到五顿饭可提供两到四份，这使得送餐服务对家庭和夫妇来说更加有用，而且每份饭菜更加经济。但请注意，它也是我测试过的含钠最多的餐饮服务之一。

paras.en: Gobble ($17 a serving): Formerly the top pick for fast-cooked meals, Gobble previously wowed with speed-demon dishes that also offered interesting and worldly flavors. Indeed, the most recent test included Caribbean rondon, an Indonesian peanut curry stir-fry, and steak vierge. But while the flavors have stayed interesting, the focus on fast cooking appears to have waned since my colleague Louryn Strampe tested Gobble. Cook time estimates aren’t printed on the recipe cards, but meals took as long as 30 minutes. For now, Hungryroot has taken the fast-cooking crown. For small households, Gobble is also among the most expensive kits. At most portions, prices approach $17 a serving plus shipping.
paras.zh: Gobble（每份 17 美元）：Gobble 以前是快煮餐点的首选，之前以快速恶魔菜肴而闻名，同时还提供有趣和世俗的风味。事实上，最近的测试包括加勒比海龙登（Caribbean rondon）、印尼花生咖喱炒菜和牛排 vierge。虽然口味仍然很有趣，但自从我的同事 Louryn Strampe 测试了 Gobble 以来，对快速烹饪的关注似乎已经减弱。菜谱卡上没有标注烹饪时间估计值，但一顿饭需要长达 30 分钟的时间。目前，Hungryroot 已经夺得了快速烹饪的桂冠。对于小家庭来说，Gobble 也是最昂贵的套件之一。大多数份量的价格接近每份 17 美元（含运费）。

paras.en: Nurture Life ($6 to $7 per serving): Nurture Life is like a restaurant kids’ menu in ready-to-eat meal-kit form. We loved the idea behind this fresh-made, never-frozen delivery meal plan when we tested it a few years back: toddler- and slightly bigger kid-friendly meals, from mac and cheese to spaghetti and meatballs to myriad variations on the chicken nugget. Meal prices have dipped to reasonable levels lately, so it's likely due for a retest—and each plate includes vegetables alongside the greatest hits.
paras.zh: Nurture Life（每份 6 至 7 美元）：Nurture Life 就像是即食餐盒形式的餐厅儿童菜单。几年前，当我们测试这个新鲜制作的、永不冷冻的送餐计划时，我们很喜欢这个计划背后的想法：适合幼儿和稍大一点的孩子的餐食，从通心粉和奶酪到意大利面和肉丸，再到各种不同的鸡块。膳食价格最近已降至合理水平，因此可能需要重新测试，并且每个盘子都包含蔬菜和最受欢迎的食物。

paras.en: Veestro ($7 to $14 per serving): WIRED reviewer Louryn Strampe enjoyed Veestro as a ready-to-eat vegan option, with premade meals delivered fresh and freezable for extra meals on hand in a pinch. The service offers a number of filters for other dietary requirements, and satisfying taste and texture—which is not always a guarantee on ready-to-eat meals. Veestro has updated its menu and offerings since the last time WIRED tested, including several snacky soup offerings. The online menu interface, which lets you sort by ingredients and filter out unwanted ones, is among the best I’ve seen.
paras.zh: Veestro（每份 7 至 14 美元）：《连线》评论员 Louryn Strampe 很喜欢 Veestro 作为即食纯素选择，它提供新鲜的预制餐点，并且可以冷冻，以便在紧要关头可以提供额外的餐点。该服务提供了许多满足其他饮食要求的过滤器，并满足口味和质地——这并不总是保证即食食品。自上次《连线》测试以来，Vestro 更新了其菜单和产品，包括几种小吃汤产品。在线菜单界面是我见过的最好的菜单界面之一，它可以让你按成分排序并过滤掉不需要的成分。

paras.en: Splendid Spoon ($9 to $13 per serving): Splendid Spoon is a nutrition delivery kit that offers plant-based smoothies, soups, bowls, noodles, and shots. Everything here is natural and free of gluten or GMOs, including spaghetti and plant-based “meatballs.” WIRED reviewer Louryn Strampe has a big yen for the smoothies in particular ($10 apiece), but wasn’t quite prepared for the intensity of a lemon juice shot that comes as part of a five-pack of dense 3-ounce superfoods.
paras.zh: Splendid Spoon（每份 9 至 13 美元）：Splendid Spoon 是一种营养输送套件，提供植物性冰沙、汤、碗、面条和饮料。这里的一切都是天然的，不含麸质或转基因生物，包括意大利面和植物性“肉丸”。 《连线》杂志评论员 Louryn Strampe 对冰沙特别钟爱（每份 10 美元），但对 5 包 3 盎司浓密超级食品中的柠檬汁浓度并没有做好准备。

paras.en: ModifyHealth ($10 to $13 per serving): The idea behind ModifyHealth is that food can be medicine. Sometimes, I’ll admit, it tasted like it was designed purely for nutrition rather than flavor. ModifyHealth is a prepared meal delivery service tailored to people who need a heart-healthy, low-carb, or low-FODMAP diet to avoid dire digestive or health consequences. GLP-1 weight-loss plans are also available for people with diabetes or others. Gluten-free meals are attested to be made in an entirely gluten-free facility. The meals were simple, benign, and low-sodium but also sometimes a little soggy—a common problem with prepared meals. The plastic top of the packaging was also difficult to disengage from the base of each meal tray—a problem when the plastic is hot after a turn in the microwave. But here’s what I do like: The meals are carefully tailored with consultation from dietitians to help people for whom food can be a source of fear or pain. Many insurance plans cover an additional service: one-on-one dietitian consultation. ModifyHealth also offers a free consultation for those just trying to figure out which diet plan is right for them. For those with IBS in particular, this remains the most focused food plan I’ve seen.
paras.zh: ModifyHealth（每份 10 至 13 美元）：ModifyHealth 背后的理念是食物可以成为药物。有时，我承认，它尝起来像是纯粹为了营养而不是为了风味而设计的。 ModifyHealth 是一项预制餐配送服务，专为需要心脏健康、低碳水化合物或低 FODMAP 饮食以避免严重消化或健康后果的人们量身定制。 GLP-1 减肥计划也适用于糖尿病患者或其他患者。无麸质餐点经证明是在完全无麸质设施中制作的。饭菜简单、温和、低钠，但有时有点湿——这是预制饭菜的常见问题。包装的塑料顶部也很难从每个餐盘的底部脱离——当塑料在微波炉中转一圈后很热时，就会出现问题。但这就是我喜欢的：这些膳食是在营养师的咨询下精心定制的，以帮助那些因食物而感到恐惧或疼痛的人。许多保险计划涵盖一项附加服务：一对一营养师咨询。 ModifyHealth 还为那些只是想找出适合自己的饮食计划的人提供免费咨询。特别是对于患有肠易激综合症的人来说，这仍然是我见过的最有针对性的饮食计划。

paras.en: Daily Harvest (prices vary): Daily Harvest is another ready-to-eat meal delivery service specializing in dietary restrictions: plant-based, plus gluten- and dairy-free. Smoothies are a highlight, as are harvest bowls, pastas, and grains. Calories are low. Ingredients are often inventive. The meal’s a lifesaver for the solo vegan eater without time to prep a meal, and WIRED’s Molly Higgins appreciated that the meals mostly relied on the natural flavors of the vegetables themselves, accented with flavors like curry and lemongrass. As with many frozen meals, however, texture wasn't a strong suit. The ready-to-blend smoothies are great, though.
paras.zh: Daily Harvest（价格有所不同）：Daily Harvest 是另一家专门针对饮食限制的即食送餐服务：以植物为基础，不含麸质和乳制品。冰沙是一大亮点，还有收获碗、意大利面和谷物。卡路里很低。成分往往很有创意。对于没有时间准备饭菜的单独素食者来说，这顿饭是他们的救星，《连线》杂志的莫莉·希金斯（Molly Higgins）表示，这些饭菜主要依赖于蔬菜本身的天然风味，并以咖喱和柠檬草等口味为重点。然而，与许多冷冻食品一样，质地并不是很适合。不过，即用型冰沙很棒。

paras.en: Sakara Life ($30+ per serving): Sakara Life offers plant-based weekly menus in fresh, prepared portions, with greens, flavorful sauces, all-organic ingredients, and textural add-ons like seeds or berries. But it’s among the most expensive meal plans we’ve tested, and neither WIRED reviewer who tried it really cottoned to it. Louryn Strampe questioned the science behind detox and cleanse health claims, calling Sakara “egregiously expensive” and full of “bitter veggies and tart fruits.” Molly Higgins, meanwhile, said Sakara Life’s tinctures and metabolism supplements didn’t agree with her system, and that the mostly raw-food plan made her long for “human food.”
paras.zh: Sakara Life（每份 30 美元以上）：Sakara Life 每周提供以植物为基础的新鲜菜单，包括蔬菜、美味酱汁、全有机成分以及种子或浆果等质地附加物。但这是我们测试过的最昂贵的膳食计划之一，而尝试过的《连线》评论家都没有真正理解它。洛琳·斯特朗普 (Louryn Strampe) 质疑排毒和净化健康声称背后的科学依据，称萨卡拉“极其昂贵”，而且充满“苦蔬菜和酸水果”。与此同时，莫莉·希金斯 (Molly Higgins) 表示，Sakara Life 的酊剂和新陈代谢补充剂不适合她的身体系统，而且大部分生食计划让她渴望“人类食物”。

paras.en: If you're talking raw materials by the pound—meat, zucchini, rice, noodles—meal kits will, of course, cost more than buying food at grocery stores. It's a service, after all, with added value above simple ingredient cost. Unless you've got quite expensive taste, you'll easily be able to make delicious meals at home for less than the $7 to $14 a serving that a meal kit will cost. That said, this doesn't necessarily mean that meal kits are expensive for what they offer. We conducted an experiment, trying to re-create four different meal-kit meals by going to my local grocery store—buying every ingredient provided by the meal kit. Turns out, if you don't have the right sauces and spices at home already, it's very difficult to re-create these tasty meals at grocery stores for less than they cost from a meal kit, in part because you'll most likely have to buy full containers of sauces and spices instead of preportioned ingredients,
paras.zh: 如果你谈论的是按磅计算的原材料——肉、西葫芦、大米、面条——套餐当然比在杂货店购买食物要贵。毕竟，这是一项附加值高于简单成分成本的服务。除非您的口味相当昂贵，否则您可以轻松地在家中制作美味佳肴，而每份餐食的价格则低于 7 至 14 美元。也就是说，这并不一定意味着餐包的价格昂贵。我们进行了一项实验，试图通过去当地的杂货店购买餐包提供的所有成分来重新制作四种不同的餐包餐食。事实证明，如果你家里没有合适的酱汁和香料，就很难在杂货店以低于膳食套件的价格重新制作这些美味的饭菜，部分原因是你很可能必须购买整盒酱汁和香料，而不是预先分配的原料，

paras.en: So, is HelloFresh worth it compared to a grocery store? Caveats are in order: For staple ingredients and spices you'll use in multiple recipes, the grocery store is, of course, cheaper. Once you buy a container of paprika for an individual recipe, it will also be there for future recipes, whereas meal-kit spices are portioned for the meal. So the real answer is that meal kits can be a quite economical way of trying out a new recipe, or a new style of cooking, without larding up your fridge with condiments you won't use again. For ingredients you'd use less commonly, a meal kit can reduce waste and spoilage, and maybe even compete on price for an individual meal.
paras.zh: 那么，与杂货店相比，HelloFresh 值得吗？需要注意的是：对于您将在多种食谱中使用的主要成分和香料，杂货店当然更便宜。一旦您为个人食谱购买了一容器辣椒粉，它也将用于未来的食谱，而餐包香料则按餐份分配。所以真正的答案是，餐包可以是一种非常经济的方式来尝试新食谱或新的烹饪方式，而无需在冰箱里放上不再使用的调味品。对于您不常用的食材，膳食套件可以减少浪费和腐败，甚至可能在单餐的价格上竞争。

paras.en: If your comparison point is takeout, well, the best meal delivery services on this list will almost certainly be cheaper and more nutritious. We've found that a meal kit in the fridge tends to be a good motivator to cook a nutritious meal—and thus can save both the money and the cholesterol.
paras.zh: 如果您的比较点是外卖，那么，此列表中最好的送餐服务几乎肯定会更便宜且更有营养。我们发现冰箱里的餐包往往会成为烹饪营养餐的良好动力，因此既可以节省金钱，又可以降低胆固醇。

paras.en: To really save on cost, some people like to keep testing out the trial offers and discounts. Much like mattress-in-a-box companies, meal kit companies usually have a running promotion. Usually this takes the form of a trial discount price that'll drop your cost by half or more on the first box, in hopes you'll like the service enough to keep it on at full price.
paras.zh: 为了真正节省成本，有些人喜欢不断测试试用优惠和折扣。就像盒装床垫公司一样，餐包公司通常也会进行促销活动。通常，这会采取试用折扣价的形式，这将使您购买第一个盒子的成本降低一半或更多，希望您足够喜欢这项服务，从而以全价继续使用。

paras.en: A meal kit a few times a week ends up balancing out well: It's a motivating factor to eat better, and it means that when you do go to the grocery store, you can do so less mindlessly and more purposefully, given that you've got a few meals' worth of ingredients in the fridge. It's also had the side effect of broadening your culinary toolkit, keeping you from getting stuck in the same ruts.
paras.zh: 每周几次的膳食套装最终会达到很好的平衡：这是吃得更好的一个激励因素，这意味着当你去杂货店时，你可以不那么漫不经心，更有目的地去，因为你的冰箱里有几顿饭的食材。它还具有扩大您的烹饪工具箱的副作用，防止您陷入同样的​​困境。

paras.en: That said, it's a set grocery expense and not necessarily a small one. Tossing or recycling cold packs and boxes gets tiring. And depending on the time of year, you may prefer shopping in person for what's seasonal and local, when produce is at its peak—an experience you don't get from a meal kit, or from grocery delivery, for that matter. If you're cooking for a bigger household, meal kits can also lose their utility quite quickly. A convenient option for two can become a much larger expense for a family of four or six.
paras.zh: 也就是说，这是一笔固定的杂货开支，而且不一定是一笔小开支。扔掉或回收冷袋和盒子会让人很累。根据一年中的不同时间，当农产品达到高峰时，您可能更喜欢亲自购买季节性和当地的商品，而就这一点而言，这是您无法从餐包或杂货配送中获得的体验。如果您要为更大的家庭做饭，餐包也会很快失去其效用。对于两个人来说，一个方便的选择可能会成为一个四人或六人家庭的更大开支。

paras.en: Can I Pause a Meal Kit Service When I Go on Vacation?
paras.zh: 我去度假时可以暂停膳食包服务吗？

paras.en: For those with more variable schedules, the service we'd probably recommend is Blue Apron, which changed its model last year and no longer locks in delivery each week. You'll have to remember to order a box each week, which can be done where I am with four days' notice.
paras.zh: 对于那些日程安排较多的人，我们可能推荐的服务是 Blue Apron，它去年改变了模式，不再锁定每周的送货。你必须记住每周订购一盒，在我这里可以提前四天通知来完成。

paras.en: Don't order too many meals per week: You know the old John Lennon line: Life is what happens when you're busy, out eating a random burrito, then thinking guiltily about the meal kit at home in your fridge. Aspirations are great, but don't order more meals than you're likely to make, or you'll be sad. Err on the side of caution. Order just enough meals per week that making yourself a recipe from your HelloFresh or Home Chef box is still a delight and a convenience and an overall boon to your life—not an obligation. If you're somewhat improvisational and impulsive, three meals a week is the sweet spot. The prospect of a few easy meals usually saves me from an impulse weeknight DoorDash.
paras.zh: 每周不要点太多餐：你知道约翰·列侬的那句老话：生活就是当你很忙时，出去随便吃一个墨西哥卷饼，然后内疚地想着家里冰箱里的饭盒。愿望是伟大的，但不要点比你可能做的更多的饭菜，否则你会感到难过。宁可谨慎。每周订购足够的饭菜，用 HelloFresh 或 Home Chef 盒子为自己制作食谱仍然是一种乐趣、一种便利，并且对您的生活有整体的好处，而不是一种义务。如果您有点即兴和冲动，那么每周三餐是最佳选择。一顿简单的饭菜的前景通常会让我免于周末晚上的冲动。

paras.en: Make room in your fridge: Meal kits take the place of a lot of grocery shopping. But they're also a lot of food, and a lot to keep organized. Clear a tall enough space in the fridge to put the whole meal kit box in, after pulling out the cold packs: This way, you're not left worrying about which groceries belong to the meal kit, and you won't lose any ingredients. You can just pull the whole box out when you want to make a meal. That said, some plans like Home Chef, HelloFresh, and Green Chef are very good at organizing each meal into its own separate bag. An added bonus from these more organized plans is that you'll be able to use less space in your fridge. Over time, this will matter.
paras.zh: 为冰箱腾出空间：膳食套件取代了许多杂货购物。但它们也有很多食物，而且有很多东西需要整理。取出冷袋后，在冰箱中腾出足够高的空间，将整个餐盒放入其中：这样，您就不必担心哪些杂货属于餐盒，也不会丢失任何成分。当你想做饭时，只需将整个盒子拉出来即可。也就是说，像 Home Chef、HelloFresh 和 Green Chef 这样的一些计划非常擅长将每顿饭放入单独的袋子中。这些更有条理的计划的另一个好处是，您将能够使用更少的冰箱空间。随着时间的推移，这将变得很重要。

paras.en: Check the recipe cards to make sure you have everything you need to make a recipe: Most meal kits expect that you'll have certain staple ingredients in your home, usually including oil and butter. Recipes also have requirements for cookware. Check this before you start a recipe. Nothing worse than realizing you need a stick of butter on step 5, with carrots already browning in the oven.
paras.zh: 检查食谱卡，确保您拥有制作食谱所需的一切：大多数餐包都希望您家里有某些主食成分，通常包括油和黄油。食谱对炊具也有要求。在开始食谱之前检查一下。没有什么比在第五步中意识到你需要一块黄油更糟糕的了，而胡萝卜已经在烤箱里变成褐色了。

paras.en: Remember, you owe nothing to the recipe: Meal kit services hire recipe developers, and on the best meal kits, these chefs have spent a lot of time optimizing each recipe. But you owe them nothing—nothing! Add spices, change steps, season food when you want to season it. Meal kits can teach you a lot about how to make a good meal and shake you out of tired culinary routines. But it's your meal. Make it how you like. Have fun.
paras.zh: 请记住，您对食谱不负任何责任：膳食套件服务雇用食谱开发人员，在最好的膳食套件上，这些厨师花费了大量时间优化每个食谱。但你不欠他们什么——什么也不欠！当你想给食物调味时，添加香料、改变步骤、调味。餐包可以教你很多关于如何做一顿美餐的知识，让你摆脱疲惫的烹饪习惯。但这是你的饭。做你喜欢的样子。玩得开心。

paras.en: Chances are, whatever time of the year, a WIRED reviewer is testing a meal kit. We constantly cycle through various meal kits, testing and retesting each of our top picks at least once a year—and often multiple times, especially when each meal delivery service changes its format or expands to new offerings.
paras.zh: 一年中的任何时候，《连线》杂志的评论员都有可能正在测试一套餐包。我们不断地循环使用各种餐食套件，每年至少测试和重新测试我们的每一种首选产品，并且经常多次，特别是当每项送餐服务改变其格式或扩展到新产品时。

paras.en: When possible, we order at least four meals a week from each meal delivery service. We prepare meals according to instructions and see how well they go. If we deviate from instructions out of horror or curiosity or a simple sense of culinary propriety, we note this and tell you why.
paras.zh: 如果可能，我们每周至少从每个送餐服务处订购四餐。我们按照说明准备饭菜，然后看看效果如何。如果我们出于恐惧或好奇或简单的烹饪礼仪而偏离说明，我们会注意到这一点并告诉您原因。

paras.en: We check prep times against what's advertised (rarely an exercise in honesty!) and take note of any inconsistencies, vagueness, or frustration in the recipe card instructions. Convenience matters: If a meal kit needlessly recommends a nonstick pan, we like it less—especially if the recipe says to heat that pan before adding food, or later mentions browned fond. Nonstick isn’t cast iron or carbon; there’s no fond. If rice portions are too small, we'll flag that.
paras.zh: 我们根据广告中的内容检查准备时间（很少是诚实的练习！），并注意食谱卡说明中的任何不一致、模糊或令人沮丧的地方。便利性很重要：如果餐包不必要地推荐不粘锅，我们就会不太喜欢它——尤其是如果食谱上说在添加食物之前先加热锅，或者稍后提到棕色喜欢的东西。不粘锅不是铸铁或碳；没有喜欢的。如果米饭份量太小，我们会予以标记。

paras.en: The quality and freshness of the produce are important, and the same goes for the meat. Where possible, we look into where the meat was sourced, and check on the reputation, safety, and standards of the meat suppliers. If a meal kit swears it's gluten-free, we verify this—calling certifying organizations where relevant.
paras.zh: 产品的质量和新鲜度很重要，肉类也是如此。在可能的情况下，我们会调查肉类的来源，并检查肉类供应商的声誉、安全性和标准。如果餐盒宣誓不含麸质，我们会致电相关认证组织进行验证。

paras.en: We usually try to order as varied a menu as possible. We might check in on gluten-free meals, a seafood item, a vegetarian item, and white and dark meat items. We might also test a Midwestern-style hot dish or Southern meat-and-two alongside meals that draw (or attempt to draw) from global inspirations. Sometimes we test the same meal kit multiple times for different dietary needs, or call in multiple testers to do so. WIRED's vegan tester, Molly Higgins, often tests the same meal kit as lead tester Matthew Korfhate does, but with a different focus.
paras.zh: 我们通常会尝试点尽可能多样化的菜单。我们可能会检查无麸质餐、海鲜、素食以及白肉和黑肉。我们还可能会尝试中西部风格的热菜或南方肉类和两个菜肴，以及从全球灵感中汲取（或试图汲取）的餐点。有时，我们会针对不同的饮食需求多次测试同一个膳食套件，或者召集多个测试人员进行测试。 《连线》的素食测试员莫莉·希金斯 (Molly Higgins) 经常与首席测试员马修·科尔夫特 (Matthew Korfhate) 测试相同的餐盒，但重点不同。

paras.en: - Rest Easy: A good night’s sleep is a gift for life. Our favorite hybrid mattress topper is 25% off. I also grabbed some new towels and bedding from Parachute.
paras.zh: - 轻松休息：良好的睡眠是生命的礼物。我们最喜欢的混合床垫罩有 25% 折扣。我还从降落伞那里买了一些新毛巾和床上用品。

paras.en: - Top Deals: What do you get the guy with too many chore coats? A Harrington jacket—like this excellent one from Todd Snyder, which is 30% off an already half-off ticket.
paras.zh: - 超值优惠：对于穿了太多家务外套的人来说，你会买什么？一件 Harrington 夹克——比如 Todd Snyder 的这件出色的夹克，已经半价的门票可享受 30% 的折扣。

paras.en: - Travel Lighter: Away’s The Everywhere Bag is 25% off and pairs with your new luggage.
paras.zh: - 旅行更轻便：Away 的 The Everywhere Bag 享有 25% 折扣，可与您的新行李箱搭配。

paras.en: Curated by Cooper Fleishman, Executive Commerce Director
paras.zh: 由执行商务总监 Cooper Fleishman 策划

paras.en: The best trackers for anyone with an iPhone; you can use them to keep tabs on your keys, luggage, bike, or whatever else you worry might go missing. Each AirTag location is marked clearly in the Find My app. The battery should last a year, and we have a guide on how to replace your AirTag battery. Just please don’t use them to track people. This is the lowest price we have seen on the single tag, but it drops this low pretty frequently.
paras.zh: 适合任何 iPhone 使用者的最佳追踪器；您可以用它们来监视您的钥匙、行李、自行车或您担心可能丢失的任何其他物品。每个 AirTag 位置都在“查找我的”应用程序中清晰标记。电池应可持续使用一年，我们提供了有关如何更换 AirTag 电池的指南。只是请不要使用它们来跟踪人们。这是我们在单个标签上看到的最低价格，但它经常下降到这个低位。

paras.en: If you want to pair wireless earbuds with your iPhone and enjoy a seamless, feature-rich experience, you should snag the AirPods Pro 3. They are comfy, boast top-notch active noise cancellation, and can even translate some languages in real time. This is the lowest price we've ever seen, but act fast because there's no telling when this discount will disappear.
paras.zh: 如果您想将无线耳机与 iPhone 配对并享受无缝、功能丰富的体验，您应该购买 AirPods Pro 3。它们佩戴舒适，拥有一流的主动降噪功能，甚至可以实时翻译某些语言。这是我们见过的最低价格，但行动要快，因为不知道折扣何时会消失。

paras.en: For Apple fans with an iPhone or MacBook, the Apple AirPods Max 2 are the best over-ear headphones. They offer great sound quality, effective noise cancellation, and good transparency modes. They are usually a little too pricey for our tastes compared to Sony and Bose options, but at $130 off, they look more tempting.
paras.zh: 对于拥有 iPhone 或 MacBook 的苹果粉丝来说，Apple AirPods Max 2 是最好的耳罩式耳机。它们提供出色的音质、有效的噪音消除和良好的透明度模式。与索尼和 Bose 相比，它们的价格通常有点太贵了，不符合我们的口味，但 130 美元的折扣，它们看起来更诱人。

paras.en: The latest iPad Mini is thinner than its predecessor and has a slightly larger screen, and the front-facing camera has been moved to a landscape orientation for better video calls. You also get the A20 Pro chip and an OLED screen, making this perhaps the best small tablet in town. The price is a bit steep, but at $100 off, it's more tempting.
paras.zh: 最新的 iPad Mini 比其前身更薄，屏幕稍大，前置摄像头已移至横向，以实现更好的视频通话效果。您还可以获得 A20 Pro 芯片和 OLED 屏幕，使其成为城里最好的小型平板电脑。价格有点贵，但是100美元的折扣，还是比较诱人的。

paras.en: With excellent noise canceling, 30-hour battery life, and loads of customization options, the Sony WH-1000XM6 are a great pair of headphones. They’re also stylish and comfy with a mix of easy-to-use touch controls and physical buttons. This is the lowest price we’ve ever seen them go on sale for.
paras.zh: 索尼 WH-1000XM6 具有出色的降噪功能、30 小时的电池续航时间和大量定制选项，是一款出色的耳机。它们还时尚舒适，结合了易于使用的触摸控制和物理按钮。这是我们见过的最低价格。

paras.en: The QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) are super comfy to wear, even for long periods, with absolutely top-notch ANC (active noise cancellation). We felt they were a bit pricey on release, but these Bose headphones are easy to recommend with this tasty discount.
paras.zh: QuietComfort 耳机（第二代）即使长时间佩戴也非常舒适，具有绝对一流的 ANC（主动降噪）功能。我们觉得它们发布时有点贵，但这些 Bose 耳机凭借如此优惠的折扣很容易推荐。
