paras.en: The best Android phones for most folks are Google's Pixels. They have excellent cameras, genuinely useful AI-enhanced features, and the slickest software around. You can also expect decent performance, with all three sporting Google's Tensor G6 chipset. The base Google Pixel 11 will be enough for most people, but the 11 Pro or 11 Pro XL have the deepest discounts and represent the very best Google has to offer this year.
paras.zh: 对于大多数人来说，最好的 Android 手机是 Google 的 Pixel。它们拥有出色的相机、真正有用的人工智能增强功能以​​及最流畅的软件。您还可以期待不错的性能，这三款产品都配备了 Google 的 Tensor G6 芯片组。基本款 Google Pixel 11 对于大多数人来说已经足够了，但 11 Pro 或 11 Pro XL 的折扣力度最大，代表了 Google 今年提供的最好产品。

paras.en: No one knows foldables like Samsung, and the Z Fold8 draws on all of its experience to create our top pick for the best folding phones. The passport-sized form factor combines a 5.5-inch cover screen with a 7.7-inch inner screen that's perfect for side-by-side apps. It's a powerful phone with a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and has plenty of stamina thanks to the 4,800-mAh silicon-carbon battery. This $350 discount brings it to the lowest price we’ve seen so far.
paras.zh: 没有人像三星一样了解可折叠手机，Z Fold8 借鉴了三星的所有经验，打造了我们最佳折叠手机的首选。护照大小的外形结合了 5.5 英寸覆盖屏幕和 7.7 英寸内屏幕，非常适合并排应用程序。这是一款功能强大的手机，配备 Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 芯片组，并配备 4,800mAh 硅碳电池，具有充足的耐力。 350 美元的折扣使其达到我们迄今为止见过的最低价格。

paras.en: This is the first discount I’ve seen on the repairable, ethically made, relatively environmentally friendly Fairphone (Gen 6+). It has a bright screen, solid performance and battery life, a decent camera system, and long software support, not to mention fun modular accessories. Built in Europe, but now available in the US, this is the smartphone for folks seeking something that’s made responsibly and designed to last.
paras.zh: 这是我在可修复、合乎道德制造、相对环保的 Fairphone（第 6+ 代）上看到的第一个折扣。它拥有明亮的屏幕、稳定的性能和电池寿命、不错的摄像系统和长期的软件支持，更不用说有趣的模块化配件了。这款智能手机在欧洲制造，现已在美国上市，适合那些寻求负责任制造且经久耐用的产品的人们。

paras.en: This excellent MagSafe wallet holds two cards securely. The reason we like it so much is due to the clever pop-out mechanism that lets you take out your cards quickly without needing to fight for them. Some MagSafe wallets make the process of paying or grabbing your ID more cumbersome than they’re worth. This one makes it easy, and it looks good doing it.
paras.zh: 这款出色的 MagSafe 钱包可以安全地容纳两张卡。我们之所以如此喜欢它，是因为它巧妙的弹出机制可以让你快速取出卡片，而无需为它们而战。一些 MagSafe 钱包使支付或获取您的 ID 的过程变得比它们的价值更加繁琐。这个很容易做到，而且看起来不错。

paras.en: Moft does a lovely line of origami-style folding stands and wallets for iPhones and other magnetic Qi2 phones. The accessory maker has an early Black Friday sale on now with up to 30 percent off this and other accessories.
paras.zh: Moft 为 iPhone 和其他磁性 Qi2 手机设计了一系列可爱的折纸式折叠支架和钱包。该配件制造商现在开始提前进行黑色星期五促销活动，这款配件和其他配件可享受高达 30% 的折扣。

paras.en: Whether you’re looking to fast charge your phone, juice up your tablet, or even refill your laptop, this power bank can do it all. A generous 25,000-mAh capacity stops just shy of the carry-on air travel limit. The maximum output is 165 watts for two devices, but 100 watts for a single device. It has lovely rounded edges, a retractable, flat, 2.3-foot USB-C cable on the top, and a snazzy, durable, braided 1-foot USB-C cable that doubles as a carry loop.
paras.zh: 无论您是想为手机快速充电、为平板电脑充电，还是为笔记本电脑充电，这款移动电源都可以满足您的需求。 25,000 mAh 的超大容量仅略低于随身携带航空旅行的限制。两台设备的最大输出为 165 瓦，单台设备的最大输出为 100 瓦。它有可爱的圆形边缘，顶部有一条可伸缩的扁平 2.3 英尺 USB-C 电缆，还有一条时尚、耐用的编织 1 英尺 USB-C 电缆，可兼作提环。

paras.en: Looking for a power bank that can keep your laptop, phone, and other gadgets powered up on the go? Look no further. The EcoFlow Rapid Pro is my top power bank for laptops because of the 27,650-mAh capacity (allowed on flights), three USB-C ports (rated at 140 watts, 65 watts, and 65 watts), and retractable 2-foot USB-C cable (rated at 140 watts).
paras.zh: 正在寻找一款可以让您的笔记本电脑、手机和其他小工具在旅途中保持供电的移动电源？别再看了。 EcoFlow Rapid Pro 是我最喜欢的笔记本电脑移动电源，因为其容量为 27,650 mAh（航班上允许）、三个 USB-C 端口（额定功率为 140 瓦、65 瓦和 65 瓦）以及可伸缩 2 英尺 USB-C 电缆（额定功率为 140 瓦）。

paras.en: If you have Apple's trio of gadgets (iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods), a 3-in-1 travel charger is a handy thing to own. This is the smallest option you'll find that's still usable, and it can squeeze into any overstuffed bag or case. Unfolded, there's a magnetic pad to charge your iPhone at up to 15 watts, a middle pad for your AirPods, and an Apple Watch charger on the right.
paras.zh: 如果您拥有 Apple 的三件套设备（iPhone、Apple Watch 和 AirPods），那么拥有一个三合一旅行充电器会很方便。这是您会发现仍然可用的最小选项，它可以挤进任何塞满的袋子或箱子中。展开后，有一个磁性垫可以为您的 iPhone 充电，最大功率为 15 瓦，中间有一个垫可以为您的 AirPods 充电，右侧有一个 Apple Watch 充电器。

paras.en: Gadgets are too boring. I want more anthropomorphized devices in my life. Ugreen simply added a wee robot face to this wireless charger that changes its expression based on the charging status. I immediately like it more than all my old faceless chargers. The charging pad supports Qi2/MagSafe and tilts up to 70 degrees to reveal a second pad to charge AirPods or other wireless earbuds. It even has a USB-C port for a third gadget. At 40 percent off, this is the lowest price I’ve seen.
paras.zh: 小工具太无聊了。我希望生活中有更多拟人化的设备。 Ugreen 简单地在这款无线充电器上添加了一个小机器人脸，它会根据充电状态改变表情。我立刻就喜欢它胜过我所有的旧无脸充电器。充电板支持 Qi2/MagSafe，最多可倾斜 70 度，露出第二个充电板，为 AirPods 或其他无线耳机充电。它甚至还有一个用于第三个小工具的 USB-C 端口。 40％的折扣，这是我见过的最低价格。

paras.en: Why be bored sitting on the bus, train, or plane when you could be gaming on a giant virtual screen? These glasses plug directly into many phones, tablets, gaming handhelds, and laptops to give you the equivalent of a 174-inch screen. They’re bright (1,250 nits), with a wide field of view (58 degrees) and three DoF (degrees of freedom), so you can fix your screen as you turn and rotate your head. The Viture Beast is our pick of the best smart glasses for folks seeking a wearable display.
paras.zh: 当您可以在巨大的虚拟屏幕上玩游戏时，为什么还要无聊地坐在公共汽车、火车或飞机上呢？这些眼镜可直接插入许多手机、平板电脑、游戏手持设备和笔记本电脑，为您提供相当于 174 英寸的屏幕。它们很明亮（1,250 尼特），具有宽阔的视野（58 度）和三个 DoF（自由度），因此您可以在转动头部时固定屏幕。 Viture Beast 是我们为寻求可穿戴显示器的人们精选的最佳智能眼镜。

paras.en: This an excellent OLED TV that's brighter and more refined than its predecessors, with much improved sound, and the kind of gaming chops you want if you're about to embark on crime spree in GTA VI. At half price, the 65-inch model is a steal, and a far better option than the entry-level LG B6 we just reviewed. Just make sure you pair it with a streaming device and disable the tracking.
paras.zh: 这是一款出色的 OLED 电视，比前代产品更明亮、更精致，声音也得到了很大改善，如果您即将在 GTA VI 中开始犯罪狂潮，那么它就是您想要的游戏体验。 65 英寸型号的半价价格非常实惠，而且比我们刚刚评测的入门级 LG B6 更好。只需确保将其与流媒体设备配对并禁用跟踪即可。

paras.en: I always associate Black Friday with footage of excited shoppers struggling to carry huge TVs out of big box stores. The reality is that most Black Friday TV deals are on terrible models you should never buy. But the Samsung S95H OLED TV is a great performer that promises accurate color with deep and rich blacks and an AI Optimized picture mode. The recessed silver bezel sits behind the main OLED panel and is designed to resemble a metal picture frame. This is the lowest price we've seen on this TV.
paras.zh: 我总是将黑色星期五与兴奋的购物者奋力将巨大的电视从大型卖场搬出的镜头联系在一起。现实情况是，大多数黑色星期五电视优惠都是您永远不应该购买的糟糕型号。但三星 S95H OLED 电视性能出色，能够提供准确的色彩、深邃而丰富的黑色以及人工智能优化的图像模式。凹陷的银色边框位于主 OLED 面板后面，设计类似于金属相框。这是我们在这款电视上见过的最低价格。

paras.en: Quite simply the best soundbar you can buy, the Arc Ultra delivers an incredible room-filling sound from a single speaker designed to sit under your TV. It has Dolby Atmos and DTS:X surround sound to create cinema-quality audio in your living room. If you crave a real surround setup, the Sonos Ultimate Immersive Set with Arc Ultra is also on sale and includes a subwoofer and two additional speakers.
paras.zh: Arc Ultra 是您能买到的最好的条形音箱，它通过安装在电视下方的单个扬声器提供令人难以置信的充满整个房间的声音。它具有杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 和 DTS:X 环绕声，可在您的客厅中营造影院品质的音频。如果您渴望真正的环绕声设置，带有 Arc Ultra 的 Sonos Ultimate Immersive Set 也正在发售，其中包括一个低音炮和两个额外的扬声器。

paras.en: - Amazon’s Ember Artline, a competitor to the Samsung Frame, is down to $499 for the 55" and $699 for the 65", a cheery 29% and 36% off.
paras.zh: - 亚马逊的 Ember Artline 是三星 Frame 的竞争对手，55 英寸的售价降至 499 美元，65 英寸的售价降至 699 美元，分别有 29% 和 36% 的折扣。

paras.en: The Dell XPS 13 boasts a gorgeous display, an excellent touchpad, and a backlit keyboard. It also has decent battery life and performance. It is compact, with a very premium feel to the chassis, and it can be charged from both sides. A bargain at the regular price, this discount makes it irresistible if you prefer a smaller laptop.
paras.zh: 戴尔 XPS 13 拥有华丽的显示屏、出色的触摸板和背光键盘。它还具有不错的电池寿命和性能。它结构紧凑，底盘给人一种非常高级的感觉，并且可以从两侧充电。正常价格很便宜，如果您喜欢较小的笔记本电脑，此折扣将是不可抗拒的。

paras.en: My pick for the best budget Wi-Fi router dips down to this price fairly often, but it’s a great deal for a Wi-Fi 7 router with four antennas, a 2.5-Gbps WAN, a 2.5-Gbps LAN, and three gigabit LAN ports. It’s only dual-band (2.4 GHz and 5 GHz), so there’s no 6-GHz option, and performance is limited, but for a small home with modest demands, this is a tough price to beat.
paras.zh: 我选择的最佳预算 Wi-Fi 路由器经常会降到这个价格，但对于具有四个天线、一个 2.5 Gbps WAN、一个 2.5 Gbps LAN 和三个千兆 LAN 端口的 Wi-Fi 7 路由器来说，这是一个很划算的选择。它只有双频（2.4 GHz 和 5 GHz），因此没有 6 GHz 选项，并且性能有限，但对于需求不大的小型家庭来说，这是一个难以击败的价格。

paras.en: A good laptop docking station lets you convert your laptop into a desktop for a comfier experience when you’re working from home, and this compact beauty from Belkin is one of our top picks. GaN technology (gallium nitride semiconductors, a faster, more compact alternative to silicon) lets Belkin pack more ports than you can shake a USB-C cable at, including 96-watt power delivery, three 4K display ports, a gigabit Ethernet port, and more. This deal equals the lowest price we’ve seen.
paras.zh: 一个好的笔记本电脑扩展坞可以让您将笔记本电脑转变为台式机，以便在您在家工作时获得更舒适的体验，贝尔金的这款紧凑美观的产品是我们的首选之一。 GaN 技术（氮化镓半导体，一种更快、更紧凑的硅替代品）让贝尔金能够容纳比 USB-C 电缆更多的端口，包括 96 瓦电力传输、三个 4K 显示端口、一个千兆位以太网端口等。这笔交易相当于我们见过的最低价格。

paras.en: It may not be the easiest to assemble, but the EN1 from FlexiSpot offers everything you need from a motorized standing desk at a reasonable price (especially with the Black Friday discount). The single motor can go from a height of 28 to 48 inches, and it doesn't wobble too much when fully extended. The desktop is made from environmentally friendly chipboard, but doesn't feel too cheap. You can also save three presets for quick switching to your preferred heights. If you work from home, a standing desk can really help you avoid sitting all day.
paras.zh: 它可能不是最容易组装的，但 FlexiSpot 的 EN1 以合理的价格（尤其是黑色星期五折扣）提供了您所需的电动站立式办公桌的一切。单个电机的高度可以从 28 英寸到 48 英寸，并且完全伸展时不会摇晃太多。桌面采用环保刨花板制成，但并没有太廉价的感觉。您还可以保存三个预设，以便快速切换到您喜欢的高度。如果您在家工作，站立式办公桌确实可以帮助您避免整天坐着。

paras.en: This is the best subscription-free camera for most people. It’s a self-contained triple-lens powerhouse, combining a 4K fixed main lens that has a 130-degree field of view with dual 2K lenses that pan through 360 degrees and tilt through 70 degrees. You can track and zoom in on subjects or license plates more than 150 feet away. The 10,000-mAh battery is topped off by the included solar panel. Plus, it has local AI features and 32 GB of storage.
paras.zh: 对于大多数人来说，这是最好的免订阅相机。它是一个独立的三镜头强大装置，结合了具有 130 度视野的 4K 固定主镜头和可平移 360 度和倾斜 70 度的双 2K 镜头。您可以跟踪和放大 150 英尺以外的主体或车牌。 10,000mAh 电池由附带的太阳能电池板补充。此外，它还具有本地 AI 功能和 32 GB 存储空间。

paras.en: This security camera records video at up to 2K at 30 frames per second, offers a 150-degree field of view, and connects directly to your Wi-Fi network. The Tapo app can detect motion (person, pet, vehicle) and enables you to set activity zones and privacy zones. The two-way audio is okay, and there’s a built-in alarm function. You can also slip a microSD card in for local recording. It lacks HDR, but it still earns a spot in our best outdoor security cameras guide. It has bounced between $90 and $65 for the last year, but it’s now down to $60.
paras.zh: 这款安全摄像机以每秒 30 帧的速度录制高达 2K 的视频，提供 150 度的视野，并直接连接到您的 Wi-Fi 网络。 Tapo 应用程序可以检测运动（人、宠物、车辆），并允许您设置活动区域和隐私区域。两路音频还可以，还有内置报警功能。您还可以插入 microSD 卡进行本地录制。它缺乏 HDR，但仍然在我们的最佳户外安全摄像机指南中占有一席之地。去年它的价格在 90 美元到 65 美元之间波动，但现在已降至 60 美元。

paras.en: Folks who receive loads of packages will appreciate Eufy’s dual-camera doorbell because it provides a tall view of your porch floor and front step, alongside whoever is calling. This is the best subscription-free option in our best video doorbells guide because there’s 8 GB of built-in storage for local recording and it can connect to a HomeBase 3 hub for more. The 2K footage is crisp and clear, and there’s on-device people, package, and even face detection.
paras.zh: 收到大量包裹的人们会喜欢 Eufy 的双摄像头门铃，因为它可以提供门廊地板和前台阶的高视图，以及呼叫者的旁边。这是我们最佳视频门铃指南中最好的免订阅选项，因为它有 8 GB 内置存储空间用于本地录制，并且可以连接到 HomeBase 3 集线器以获取更多信息。 2K 镜头清晰锐利，并且有设备上的人物、包裹，甚至人脸检测。

paras.en: The Echo Spot is a lovely wee speaker with a handy display to show basics like the time, weather, music track, or the audiobook you are listening to. It has Alexa onboard, ready for your queries or to set an alarm for the morning. The sound quality is limited, but it works well as a bedside clock– the screen dims at night and shows you the time and when your alarm is set.
paras.zh: Echo Spot 是一款可爱的小型扬声器，配有方便的显示屏，可以显示时间、天气、音乐曲目或您正在收听的有声读物等基本信息。它配备了 Alexa，随时可以解答您的疑问或设置早上的闹钟。音质有限，但它作为床头时钟效果很好——屏幕在晚上变暗，向您显示时间和闹钟设置时间。

paras.en: Permanent outdoor lights are a great way to avoid having to get up the ladder every holiday season. They offer simple white lighting, different colors, and also holiday-themed lighting effects. Eufy’s lights aren’t the brightest, but they hold up well against the competition and support Matter, so you can tie them into any smart home ecosystem. All lengths are on sale, but the 200-foot string has the best discount and is at its lowest price ever.
paras.zh: 永久性户外灯是避免每个假期都必须爬上梯子的好方法。它们提供简单的白色照明、不同的颜色以及节日主题的灯光效果。 Eufy 的灯不是最亮的，但它们在竞争中表现出色并支持 Matter，因此您可以将它们与任何智能家居生态系统结合起来。所有长度都在打折，但 200 英尺长的绳子有最好的折扣，并且是有史以来的最低价格。

paras.en: If you like to run an organized household, the best digital wall calendars are sure to appeal. You can use them to sync your digital calendars, create lists of chores, and plan your family meals. The Everblog HomeCal is our pick for folks who can’t stomach another subscription. It also works like a digital photo frame if you upload your snaps, and you can log into apps like Netflix and Spotify on it. This is the lowest we’ve seen it drop so far. Clip the coupon for an extra $50 off.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢管理一个井然有序的家庭，那么最好的数字挂历一定会吸引您。您可以使用它们同步您的数字日历、创建家务列表并计划您的家庭膳食。 Everblog HomeCal 是我们为那些无法忍受再次订阅的人选择的。如果您上传快照，它也可以像数码相框一样工作，并且可以在上面登录 Netflix 和 Spotify 等应用程序。这是迄今为止我们看到的最低跌幅。夹住优惠券即可额外立减 50 美元。

paras.en: Learning about the wildlife in your garden can be a lot of fun, and the best smart bird feeders are an ideal way to see which feathered friends are in the area. The thoughtfully designed Kiwibit Bird Feeder 2 has a removable 1.5-liter dual-hopper seed reservoir, is easy to clean, and boasts a solar roof to keep the camera charged up. It snaps 8-megapixel photos, captures 4K video, and includes a nifty AI bird-identification feature. We’ve seen it on sale before, but never this low.
paras.zh: 了解花园里的野生动物可能会很有趣，而最好的智能喂鸟器是了解该地区有哪些羽毛朋友的理想方式。精心设计的 Kiwibit Bird Feeder 2 具有可拆卸的 1.5 升双料斗种子储存器，易于清洁，并配有太阳能屋顶，可为相机充电。它可以拍摄 8 兆像素的照片、捕捉 4K 视频，并包括一个漂亮的人工智能鸟类识别功能。我们以前见过它打折，但从来没有这么低。

paras.en: Mowing the lawn is boring—you get covered in grass, and it just grows again. You can banish this tedious, unpleasant task by snagging one of the best robot mowers. Forget about cheap mowers that require you to run wire around your garden or even mowers that need satellite navigation antennas. The TerraMow V1000 is perfect for most gardens, comes with a covered charging station, and automatically maps your lawn.
paras.zh: 修剪草坪很无聊——你会被草覆盖，但它又会重新生长。您可以通过购买最好的机器人割草机之一来消除这项乏味、不愉快的任务。忘记那些需要你在花园周围布线的廉价割草机，甚至是需要卫星导航天线的割草机。 TerraMow V1000 非常适合大多数花园，配有带顶棚的充电站，并自动绘制草坪地图。

paras.en: Jump to a section: Apple Deals, Headphone Deals, Mobile Deals, TV and Speaker Deals, Laptop and Home Office Deals, Smart Home Deals, Home and Kitchen Deals, Health and Fitness Deals
paras.zh: 跳转至部分： Apple 优惠、耳机优惠、移动优惠、电视和音箱优惠、笔记本电脑和家庭办公优惠、智能家居优惠、家居和厨房优惠、健康和健身优惠

paras.en: The Hatch Sleep clock is an excellent all-in-one bedside companion. It's rare that every Reviews Team member agrees on a gadget, but every one of us who has tested it loves it. It's especially nice to have this time of year when waking up and getting to bed can feel extra difficult. The Hatch's lighting routines can help your circadian rhythm feel a bit more regulated compared to waking up in total darkness. It also has sleep tracking through the app—a great option if you hate wearing a sleep tracker on your body. There's an optional subscription ($6 per month) that gets you full access to the library of sleep sounds, but we don't think it's necessary. This doesn't go on sale often, so if you've been deliberating, now is a great time to get in.
paras.zh: Hatch 睡眠时钟是一款出色的一体式床边伴侣。很少有评论团队的每个成员都同意某个小工具，但我们每个测试过它的人都喜欢它。每年的这个时候，起床和上床都会感觉格外困难，这真是太好了。与在完全黑暗中醒来相比，Hatch 的照明程序可以帮助您感觉昼夜节律更加规律。它还通过应用程序进行睡眠跟踪——如果您讨厌在身上佩戴睡眠跟踪器，这是一个不错的选择。有一个可选订阅（每月 6 美元）可以让您完全访问睡眠声音库，但我们认为没有必要。该产品不经常打折，因此，如果您一直在深思熟虑，那么现在是入手的好时机。

paras.en: This is one of the best deals we've tracked on our top air fryer. The Typhur Dome 2 is powerful and fast, with even crisping and 15 different cooking modes that range from baking to special settings for pizza and steak. It's pricey, but this deal makes it much more attainable than usual.
paras.zh: 这是我们追踪到的顶级空气炸锅最优惠的价格之一。 Typhur Dome 2 功能强大且快速，具有均匀的脆度和 15 种不同的烹饪模式，从烘焙到披萨和牛排的特殊设置。虽然价格昂贵，但这笔交易比平常更容易实现。

paras.en: This recently released designer minifridge from Rocco is being tested by WIRED editor Kat Merck, but so far, she likes it. It has a minimalist design, a dark glass door, and sliding drawers for smooth organization of all your must-have snacks and drinks. Some might use it for wine or beer, but I dream of this bedside for a crisp Diet Coke and some midnight charcuterie. Every color is discounted for Black Friday.
paras.zh: 这款 Rocco 最近发布的设计师迷你冰箱正在接受《连线》编辑 Kat Merck 的测试，但到目前为止，她很喜欢它。它采用简约设计、深色玻璃门和滑动抽屉，可顺利整理您所有必备零食和饮料。有些人可能会用它来盛葡萄酒或啤酒，但我梦想着在床边放一杯清脆的健怡可乐和一些午夜熟食。黑色星期五每种颜色都有折扣。

paras.en: The Technivorm Moccamaster KBGT Coffee Machine is drip-coffee perfection. Pair it with good-quality, freshly ground beans, and you’ll have a perfect pot in precisely six minutes. This classic design has been handmade in the Netherlands since 1968, with a steel construction, a copper heating element, and a glass-lined thermal carafe. It brews at between 92 and 96 degrees Celsius, the ideal temperature to unlock those flavors. One of the best coffee makers around, and the personal pick for many of us on Reviews, it is built to last, so snag one on sale and tick coffee off your list forever. (Editor’s note: I like the glass carafe option too. —CF)
paras.zh: Technivorm Moccamaster KBGT 咖啡机是滴滤式咖啡的完美选择。将其与优质的新鲜研磨的豆子搭配，您将在六分钟内得到一锅完美的锅。这一经典设计自 1968 年以来一直在荷兰手工制作，采用钢结构、铜加热元件和玻璃衬里保温瓶。它的酿造温度为 92 至 96 摄氏度，这是释放这些风味的理想温度。它是周围最好的咖啡机之一，也是我们许多人在评论中的个人选择，它经久耐用，所以在打折的时候买一台，把咖啡永远从你的清单上划掉。 （编者注：我也喜欢玻璃水瓶选项。-CF）

paras.en: This affordable espresso machine is even more affordable than usual right now. It's got a shiny chrome finish, with buttons for steam and single or double shots, plus a pressure gauge, a 15-bar pump, an effective steam wand, and fast heating. We've seen it dip lower ($120), but it's still a bargain at $150.
paras.zh: 这款经济实惠的浓缩咖啡机现在比平时更实惠。它具有闪亮的镀铬表面，配有蒸汽和单次或双次喷射的按钮，还有压力表、15 巴泵、有效的蒸汽棒和快速加热功能。我们已经看到它下跌了（120 美元），但 150 美元仍然很便宜。

paras.en: This cordless vacuum boasts three cleaning modes, a HEPA filter, and a newly designed cleaner head. It can handle hard floors and soft carpet, with dual rotating conical brush bars that prevent tangled hair. It's our top pick of the more affordable Dyson vacuum cleaners, and it’s cheaper than we've ever seen it right now.
paras.zh: 这款无绳吸尘器拥有三种清洁模式、HEPA 过滤器和新设计的清洁头。它可以处理硬地板和软地毯，配有双旋转锥形刷条，可防止头发缠结。这是我们在更实惠的戴森吸尘器中的首选，而且它比我们现在见过的更便宜。

paras.en: With the ability to mop and vacuum your floors, map multiple floors, and self-clean, the Eufy Omni C28 is a decent option for most homes. This is the budget pick in our best robot vacuums guide. Despite the $800 MSRP, it often drops to $500, but it's even less than that right now, a better deal than usual.
paras.zh: Eufy Omni C28 能够拖地和吸尘、绘制多个楼层地图以及自我清洁功能，是大多数家庭的不错选择。这是我们最佳机器人吸尘器指南中的预算选择。尽管建议零售价为 800 美元，但经常会降至 500 美元，但现在甚至比这个还要低，比平时更划算。

paras.en: - Our Place’s Wonder Oven Pro is 15% off. We like these sage oven mats, too.
paras.zh: - 我们家的 Wonder Oven Pro 享有 15% 折扣。我们也喜欢这些鼠尾草烤箱垫。

paras.en: With a lovely round design featuring a bright display, the Pixel Watch 5 does a solid job of tracking your activity, sleep, and health. Battery life is good, and it works beautifully with Pixel phones. It's your best smartwatch option if you use an Android phone and both sizes are on sale at their lowest prices yet.
paras.zh: Pixel Watch 5 采用可爱的圆形设计和明亮的显示屏，在跟踪您的活动、睡眠和健康状况方面表现出色。电池续航时间长，与 Pixel 手机配合得很好。如果您使用 Android 手机，那么这将是您最好的智能手表选择，并且两种尺寸都以迄今为止最低的价格出售。

paras.en: If you're unfamiliar, rucking is walking or hiking with a weighted vest or backpack, and it's an easy way to up your cardio game and build strength. I just started using this weighted vest, and it's far more comfortable than a backpack. If you get joint pain when you run, this is a great alternative way to turn your walks into workouts.
paras.zh: 如果您不熟悉，rucking 是穿着加重背心或背包行走或徒步旅行，这是提高有氧运动和增强力量的简单方法。我刚刚开始使用这款加重背心，它比背包舒服得多。如果您在跑步时感到关节疼痛，这是将步行转变为锻炼的绝佳替代方法。

articles.title: Feid and Snoop Dogg Drop Thanksgiving Collaboration ‘Gracias x Todo’
articles.author: Mitchell Peters

paras.en: Feid and Snoop Dogg are spreading a message of gratitude this Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 今年感恩节，费德和史努比狗狗正在传播感恩的信息。

paras.en: On Thursday (Nov. 26), the Latin music star and hip-hop icon released their new collaboration “Gracias x Todo.”
paras.zh: 周四（11 月 26 日），这位拉丁音乐明星兼嘻哈偶像发布了他们的新合作作品“Gracias x Todo”。

paras.en: “Happy thanksgiving for you all!!” Feid wrote on Instagram alongside the song’s music video.
paras.zh: “祝大家感恩节快乐！！”费德在 Instagram 上与歌曲的音乐视频一起写道。

paras.en: The new single celebrates “gratitude, perseverance, and the importance of appreciating life’s journey,” according to a press release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，新单曲颂扬了“感恩、坚持和欣赏人生旅程的重要性”。

paras.en: In the song, Feid and Snoop Dogg trade verses about life’s ups and downs, reflecting on how the toughest moments can lead to something better. Directed by Diego Patiño, the video pays tribute to the people and experiences that have shaped Feid’s life, including his family. The Fundación Good Kidz children’s choir also joins Feid toward the end of the clip.
paras.zh: 在这首歌中，费德和史努比狗狗交换了有关生活起起落落的诗句，反思最艰难的时刻如何能带来更好的结果。该视频由迭戈·帕蒂诺 (Diego Patiño) 执导，向塑造费德生活的人和经历致敬，包括他的家人。好孩子基金会儿童合唱团也在剪辑的结尾加入了费德的行列。

paras.en: Feid first previewed “Gracias x Todo” at the 2026 Latin Grammy Awards on Nov. 12, where Snoop Dogg made a surprise appearance alongside Divino, Lil Supa, Baby Ranks and DJ Premier.
paras.zh: Feid 于 11 月 12 日在 2026 年拉丁格莱美颁奖典礼上首次预演了《Gracias x Todo》，其中 Snoop Dogg 与 Divino、Lil Supa、Baby Ranks 和 DJ Premier 一起惊喜亮相。

paras.en: During the ceremony, Feid won best reggaeton performance for “Verano Rosa,” his collaboration with Karol G.
paras.zh: 在颁奖典礼上，Feid 凭借与 Karol G. 合作的《Verano Rosa》获得了最佳雷鬼表演奖。

paras.en: The Colombian star has plenty more on his schedule. On Saturday (Nov. 28), he is set to participate in the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, bringing Latin music to the centennial celebration.
paras.zh: 这位哥伦比亚球星的日程安排还有很多。周六（11 月 28 日），他将参加第 100 届梅西百货感恩节游行，为百年庆典带来拉丁音乐。

paras.en: Early next year, Feid will take his Ferxxo experience to arenas across North America with the Ferxxo – The Green Star Tour 2027. The Live Nation-promoted tour launches Feb. 5 at Orlando’s Kia Center, with stops in major cities including Miami, New York, Toronto, Chicago, Dallas and Los Angeles before heading to Mexico. The tour is scheduled to wrap up in Mexico City in late May.
paras.zh: 明年初，Feid 将通过 Ferxxo – The Green Star Tour 2027 将他的 Ferxxo 经验带到北美各地的舞台。这场由 Live Nation 推广的巡演将于 2 月 5 日在奥兰多起亚中心启动，在前往墨西哥之前会在迈阿密、纽约、多伦多、芝加哥、达拉斯和洛杉矶等主要城市停留。巡演计划于五月下旬在墨西哥城结束。

paras.en: Watch the music video for Feid and Snoop Dogg’s “Gracias x Todo” below.
paras.zh: 请观看下面 Feid 和 Snoop Dogg 的“Gracias x Todo”的音乐视频。

articles.title: Where to Watch Jennifer Lopez’s Vegas Concert Film ‘The JLO Show’ Free Online
articles.author: Sophie Dunne

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: The film captures the spectacular finale of Lopez’s sold-out Jennifer Lopez: Up All Night Live in Las Vegas residency at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace, which ran from Dec. 30, 2025, through March 28, 2026. The official trailer, published in September, previews a narration from Lopez as she reflects on growing up watching musicals and how they inspired her career as a singer, actor and dancer. The concert itself showcases the grand finale of her Vegas run, with four acts packed with her most famous hits, musical numbers from Gypsy, West Side Story and Funny Girl, plus covers like Lana Del Rey’s “Young and Beautiful.”
paras.zh: 这部电影捕捉了洛佩兹在凯撒宫斗兽场的拉斯维加斯驻场表演《詹妮弗·洛佩兹：整夜现场》的精彩结局，该剧已售罄，演出时间为 2025 年 12 月 30 日至 2026 年 3 月 28 日。官方预告片于 9 月发布，预览了洛佩兹的旁白，讲述了她观看音乐剧的成长过程，以及这些音乐如何激发了她作为歌手、演员和舞者的职业生涯。音乐会本身展示了她维加斯之旅的压轴戏，四场演出包括她最著名的热门歌曲、《吉普赛》、《西区故事》和《滑稽女孩》的音乐曲目，以及拉娜·德雷 (Lana Del Rey) 的《年轻而美丽》等翻唱歌曲。

paras.en: At a Glance: Where to Watch The JLO Show Free Online
paras.zh: 概览：哪里可以免费在线观看 JLO Show

paras.en: - Date & Time: Thursday, Nov. 26 from 8:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. ET/PT
paras.zh: - 日期和时间：11 月 26 日星期四晚上 8:00至晚上 10:00 ET/PT

paras.zh: - 流媒体：Paramount+ Premium（无免费试用）或 Fubo、Hulu + Live TV 和 DirecTV（免费试用）

paras.en: For those who have cable, you can catch the concert film on CBS on Nov. 26 at 8:00 p.m. ET/PT.
paras.zh: 如果您有有线电视，您可以在 CBS 观看 11 月 26 日晚上 8:00 的音乐会影片。 ET/PT。

paras.en: Where to Watch The JLO Show for Free Online
paras.zh: 哪里可以免费在线观看 JLO Show

paras.en: For cable cutters, The JLO Show is streaming on Paramount+ Premium, which doesn’t offer a free trial but is running its Black Friday offer of Paramount+ plans for only $2.99 per month for two months. However, if you want to watch for free, we’ve found a workaround for getting access to Paramount+ Premium and CBS via streaming platforms that do offer free trials.
paras.zh: 对于有线电视用户来说，《JLO Show》在 Paramount+ Premium 上进行流媒体播放，Paramount+ Premium 不提供免费试用，但提供黑色星期五的 Paramount+ 套餐，每月仅需 2.99 美元，为期两个月。但是，如果您想免费观看，我们找到了一种解决方法，可以通过提供免费试用的流媒体平台访问 Paramount+ Premium 和 CBS。

paras.en: Below are more details on each streaming platform that includes both CBS and Paramount+ Premium and that also offers a free trial.
paras.zh: 以下是有关每个流媒体平台的更多详细信息，其中包括 CBS 和 Paramount+ Premium，并且还提供免费试用。

articles.title: Goo Goo Dolls’ Halftime Show at the Chiefs vs. Bills Thanksgiving Game: Watch Online for Free
articles.author: Sophie Dunne

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: The Kansas City Chiefs will face the Buffalo Bills for the Thanksgiving Night game on Thursday, Nov. 26, at Highmark Stadium in Orchard Park, New York. The 5:20 p.m. PT/8:20 p.m. ET kickoff is the final game of the NFL‘s Thanksgiving tripleheader, following the Chicago Bears vs. the Detroit Lions and the Philadelphia Eagles vs. the Dallas Cowboys earlier in the day.
paras.zh: 堪萨斯城酋长队将于 11 月 26 日星期四在纽约果园公园的海马克体育场迎战布法罗比尔队的感恩节之夜比赛。下午 5:20太平洋时间/晚上 8:20东部时间开赛是 NFL 感恩节三连赛的最后一场比赛，此前芝加哥熊队对阵底特律雄狮队，费城老鹰队对阵达拉斯牛仔队。

paras.en: Local rock band Goo Goo Dolls, who hail from Buffalo, will provide the musical entertainment during halftime. Fans may also be watching for possible appearances by Taylor Swift, wife of Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce, and Hailee Steinfeld, wife of Bills quarterback Josh Allen. The NFL game and music performance will air live on NBC and stream on Peacock.
paras.zh: 来自布法罗的当地摇滚乐队 Goo Goo Dolls 将在中场休息时提供音乐娱乐。球迷们可能还会关注酋长队近端锋特拉维斯·凯尔斯的妻子泰勒·斯威夫特和比尔队四分卫乔什·艾伦的妻子海莉·斯坦菲尔德的可能亮相。 NFL 比赛和音乐表演将在 NBC 和 Peacock 上直播。

paras.en: Since Peacock doesn’t offer a free trial of its own, we found several streaming services that do and include access to Peacock for free in their plans. That means you’ll be able to catch the NFL matchup and halftime performance at no cost. Alternatively, though, Peacock is running a Black Friday deal offering up to 66% off on plans for new customers, which could justify not getting a free trial. Customers can get Peacock’s Select plan for $2.99 per month for three months (66% off) or Peacock’s Premium plan for $8.99 per month for three months (30% off), which includes movies, Peacock Originals and live sports.
paras.zh: 由于 Peacock 本身不提供免费试用，因此我们发现有几家流媒体服务提供免费试用，并且在其计划中包含免费试用 Peacock。这意味着您将能够免费观看 NFL 比赛和半场表演。不过，Peacock 正在开展黑色星期五促销活动，为新客户提供高达 66% 的计划折扣，这可能是不获得免费试用的理由。客户可以获得 Peacock’s Select 计划，每月 2.99 美元，为期三个月（66% 折扣），或 Peacock’s Premium 计划，每月 8.99 美元，为期三个月（30% 折扣），其中包括电影、Peacock Originals 和现场体育赛事。

paras.en: Otherwise, here’s a breakdown of where to watch Peacock and NBC for free.
paras.zh: 除此之外，这里还有免费观看 Peacock 和 NBC 节目的详细信息。

paras.en: At a Glance: Where to Watch Kansas City Chiefs vs. Buffalo Bills & Goo Goo Dolls’ Halftime Show
paras.zh: 概览：在哪里观看堪萨斯城酋长队对阵布法罗比尔队和 Goo Goo Dolls 的中场秀

paras.en: - Date & Time: Thursday, Nov. 26, at 5:20 p.m. PT/8:20 p.m. ET.
paras.zh: - 日期和时间：11 月 26 日星期四下午 5:20太平洋时间/晚上 8:20等。

paras.zh: - 电视频道：NBC 和 Telemundo 提供西班牙语广播（在 Peacock、Fubo 或 DirecTV 上观看 Telemundo）。

paras.en: - Streaming: Peacock (no free trial), Prime Video, DirecTV, Fubo and Hulu + Live TV (free trials).

Simply add Peacock Premium Plus as a channel subscription through your Prime Video account and activate the trial. After seven days, the subscription automatically renews at the regular rate unless canceled. Peacock Premium Plus is currently listed at $19.99 per month or $199.99 per year.
paras.zh: 由于 Peacock 不提供直接免费试用，符合条件的观众可以通过 Amazon Prime Video 免费获得 7 天的 Peacock Premium Plus 作为附加服务。只需通过您的 Prime Video 帐户添加 Peacock Premium Plus 作为频道订阅并激活试用即可。 7 天后，订阅将按正常费率自动续订，除非取消。 Peacock Premium Plus 目前的定价为每月 19.99 美元或每年 199.99 美元。

paras.en: If you already have a DirecTV Signature package, you can add Peacock for free for two months.
paras.zh: 如果您已经拥有 DirecTV Signature 套餐，则可以免费添加 Peacock 两个月。

paras.en: After the promotional period, the Peacock add-on automatically renews at the rate of $9.99 per month unless canceled.

paras.en: Everything You Need to Know About Goo Goo Dolls’ NFL Thanksgiving Night Halftime Show
paras.zh: 关于 Goo Goo Dolls 的 NFL 感恩节中场秀您需要了解的一切

paras.en: Goo Goo Dolls are bringing their hometown sound to the national stage this Thanksgiving as they headline the Buffalo Bills‘ halftime show against the Kansas City Chiefs on Nov. 26, 2026. The Buffalo-born rock band will perform at Highmark Stadium in Orchard Park, New York, giving local fans a special holiday treat. Presented by M&T Bank, the performance will feature synchronized light-up bracelets throughout the stadium, creating an interactive concert experience.
paras.zh: 今年感恩节，Goo Goo Dolls 将把家乡的声音带到全国舞台，他们将在 2026 年 11 月 26 日布法罗比尔队对阵堪萨斯城酋长队的中场秀中担任主角。这支出生于布法罗的摇滚乐队将在纽约果园公园的海马克体育场演出，为当地球迷带来特别的节日盛宴。这场表演由 M&T Bank 主办，整个体育场内的手环将同步发光，营造互动音乐会体验。

paras.en: Led by John Rzeznik and Robby Takac, the Goo Goo Dolls formed in Buffalo, New York, in the mid-1980s. Known for Billboard Hot 100 hits such as “Iris,” “Slide,” “Name” and “Black Balloon,” the band has sold more than 15 million records worldwide. Although an official Thanksgiving setlist has not been announced, fans can reasonably hope to hear popular favorites like “Iris” and “Slide.” Their performance is expected to last approximately six to eight minutes, consistent with recent NFL Thanksgiving halftime shows. This is not their first Thanksgiving NFL appearance either. The band previously performed during the Detroit Lions’ game against the Green Bay Packers 19 years ago in 2007.
paras.zh: 在 John Rzeznik 和 Robby Takac 的带领下，Goo Goo Dolls 于 20 世纪 80 年代中期在纽约州布法罗成立。该乐队因《Iris》、《Slide》、《Name》和《Black Balloon》等 Billboard Hot 100 热门单曲而闻名，在全球已售出超过 1500 万张唱片。尽管官方的感恩节歌单尚未公布，但歌迷们有理由希望听到“Iris”和“Slide”等受欢迎的歌曲。他们的表演预计将持续约六到八分钟，与最近的 NFL 感恩节中场表演一致。这也不是他们第一次参加感恩节 NFL 比赛。 19 年前的 2007 年，该乐队曾在底特律雄狮队对阵绿湾包装工队的比赛中表演过。

paras.en: Will Taylor Swift and Hailee Steinfeld Be at the Chiefs vs. Bills Thanksgiving Night Game?
paras.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特和海莉·斯坦菲尔德会参加酋长队与比尔队的感恩节之夜比赛吗？

paras.en: The NFL and Hollywood always collide, especially during Thanksgiving games when celebrity spotting becomes almost as much of a sport as football itself. This year, fans may get the chance to spot two famous faces as Taylor Swift and Hailee Steinfeld could attend the Chiefs vs. Bills matchup to support their husbands. Neither attendance has been confirmed, but based on their past appearances at games, a visit is certainly possible. Swift’s husband, Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce, is expected to take the field while Steinfeld’s husband, Bills quarterback Josh Allen, will be starting.
paras.zh: NFL 和好莱坞总是发生冲突，尤其是在感恩节比赛期间，寻找名人几乎和橄榄球本身一样成为一项运动。今年，球迷们可能有机会看到两位著名面孔，泰勒·斯威夫特和海莉·斯坦菲尔德可能会参加酋长队与比尔队的比赛来支持他们的丈夫。两人的出席尚未得到证实，但根据他们过去在比赛中的表现，访问肯定是可能的。斯威夫特的丈夫、酋长队近端锋特拉维斯·凯尔斯预计将上场，而斯坦菲尔德的丈夫、比尔队四分卫乔什·艾伦将首发。

paras.en: Steinfeld, who’s currently promoting Disney’s Hexed, was last spotted supporting Allen at the Bills’ Oct. 12 game against the Los Angeles Rams, while Swift’s most recent Chiefs appearance was Nov. 22 when Kansas City faced the Arizona Cardinals. If the “Reputation” singer shows up in Buffalo, it could mark her first public appearance since the controversial Nov. 23 Vanity Fair article about her sparked widespread attention. Considering Swift has yet to attend a Chiefs Thanksgiving game (she didn’t attend the Chiefs’ game in 2025), an appearance at the 2026 matchup would mark a first for the singer and add another high-profile moment to the mix of football and celebrity culture.
paras.zh: 斯坦菲尔德目前正在宣传迪士尼的 Hexed，他最后一次被发现支持艾伦是在 10 月 12 日比尔队对阵洛杉矶公羊队的比赛中，而斯威夫特最近一次出现在酋长队比赛是在 11 月 22 日堪萨斯城对阵亚利桑那红雀队时。如果这位《Reputation》歌手出现在布法罗，这可能是她自 11 月 23 日《名利场》杂志关于她的争议性文章引发广泛关注以来首次公开露面。考虑到斯威夫特尚未参加酋长队的感恩节比赛（她没有参加 2025 年酋长队的比赛），出现在 2026 年的比赛中将标志着这位歌手的首次亮相，并为足球和名人文化的融合增添了另一个备受瞩目的时刻。

articles.title: ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Devouring $85M Over Thanksgiving Weekend as ‘Focker-in-Law,’ ‘Hexed’ Launch
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is claiming the head of the table at the Thanksgiving weekend box office as Focker-in-Law and Hexed enter the arena.
paras.zh: 《饥饿游戏：收割日出》在感恩节周末票房榜上名列前茅，《福克法》和《海克斯德》登场。

paras.en: Lionsgate’s sixth film in the dystopian Hunger Games franchise screens in 4,018 North American theaters for its sophomore frame, as it grossed around $15.1 million on Wednesday. Director Francis Lawrence’s adaptation of author Suzanne Collins’ 2025 prequel novel is looking at a five-day sum around $85 million to take its domestic cume to roughly $233 million through Sunday. The movie stars Joseph Zada as a young Haymitch Abernathy, played by Woody Harrelson in the first four Jennifer Lawrence-led films.
paras.zh: 狮门影业反乌托邦反乌托邦《饥饿游戏》系列中的第六部电影第二季在北美 4,018 家影院上映，周三票房收入约为 1,510 万美元。导演弗朗西斯·劳伦斯 (Francis Lawrence) 改编自作家苏珊·柯林斯 (Suzanne Collins) 2025 年的前传小说，预计五天票房约为 8,500 万美元，到周日，国内票房将达到约 2.33 亿美元。影片由约瑟夫·扎达饰演年轻的黑密斯·阿伯内西，由伍迪·哈里森在詹妮弗·劳伦斯主演的前四部电影中饰演。

paras.en: After opening to the fifth-biggest launch in Lionsgate history last weekend with $119 million domestically and $225 million worldwide, The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping has continued its momentum. The $150 million-budgeted film, which earned an A- CinemaScore, grossed $15.98 million domestically on Tuesday to notch the franchise’s biggest first Tuesday, narrowly topping the $15.96 million for 2013’s Catching Fire. Sunrise’s Monday sum of $12.8 million also bested the series’ previous top opening Monday of $12.3 million for Catching Fire.
paras.zh: 上周末，《饥饿游戏：收割日出》以 1.19 亿美元的国内票房和 2.25 亿美元的全球票房成为狮门影业历史上第五大上映影片，之后继续保持着强劲势头。这部预算 1.5 亿美元的电影获得了 A-CinemaScore 评分，周二国内票房收入为 1,598 万美元，创下该系列首周二票房最高纪录，略高于 2013 年《星火燎原》的 1,596 万美元票房。 《日出》周一的票房收入为 1,280 万美元，也超过了该系列剧《星火燎原》周一首映票房收入的 1,230 万美元。

paras.en: The East Coast has been impacted by a major storm stretching from the Midwest to the Eastern seaboard, leading the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York to be moved to Saturday for the first postponement in its 100-year history. The inclement weather could slow down moviegoing throughout the weekend, including on Black Friday, which tends to be the biggest day for the box office over the Thanksgiving frame.
paras.zh: 东海岸受到从中西部一直延伸到东海岸的大风暴的影响，纽约梅西百货感恩节游行被推迟到周六，这是其 100 年来的首次推迟。恶劣的天气可能会减慢整个周末的观影速度，包括黑色星期五，这往往是感恩节期间票房最高的一天。

paras.en: Disney released Hexed in 3,725 North American theaters on Wednesday, with the animated fantasy film collecting an estimated $7.6 million on opening day, including $2.1 million in Tuesday previews. Directors Jason Hand and Fawn Veerasunthorn’s movie, which carries a budget north of $200 million, could be heading for a five-day launch around $35 million. This looks to be down a bit from the $45 million opening that the studio had initially been projecting.
paras.zh: 周三，迪士尼在北美 3,725 家影院上映了《Hexed》，这部动画奇幻电影首映当天票房估计为 760 万美元，其中周二预映的 210 万美元。导演 Jason Hand 和 Fawn Veerasunthorn 的电影预算超过 2 亿美元，上映五天的时间可能约为 3500 万美元。这看起来比工作室最初预计的 4500 万美元的首映票房略有下降。

paras.en: Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones and Jodie Foster lead the voice cast for Hexed, which centers on a mother and her teenage daughter grappling with the girl’s magical powers. The studio has been hopeful that it will continue to run throughout the holiday corridor and follow the lead of this year’s original animated features with pleasing performances, including Goat and Hoppers, although other recent originals like Forgotten Island have struggled.
paras.zh: 海莉·斯坦菲尔德、拉什达·琼斯和朱迪·福斯特为《Hexed》配音，该剧以一位母亲和她十几岁的女儿与女孩的魔法力量作斗争为中心。该工作室一直希望它能继续在整个节日走廊上运行，并追随今年原创动画长片的领先地位，以令人愉悦的表演，包括《山羊》和《霍普斯》，尽管其他最近的原创动画，如《遗忘岛》，却表现不佳。

paras.en: Earning an A- CinemaScore, Hexed holds a 66 percent critics score on Rotten Tomatoes. The Hollywood Reporter critic Angie Han wrote in her review that it offers “more than enough to make for a pleasurably transportive trip to the theater.”
paras.zh: Hexed 获得了 A- CinemaScore 的烂番茄评分 66%。 《好莱坞报道》评论家安吉·汉 (Angie Han) 在她的评论中写道，它“足以让您享受一次愉快的剧院之旅”。

paras.en: Universal Pictures’ Meet the Parents sequel Focker-in-Law launched in 3,382 North American theaters on Wednesday, grossing $5.3 million on its opening day. Director John Hamburg’s film appears to be in line for a $36.3 million opening over the five-day frame, also a bit below the initial projection in the $45 million range. Ariana Grande joins franchise returnees Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro, as she plays a woman set to marry the son of Stiller’s Greg Focker.
paras.zh: 周三，环球影业的《拜见父母》续集《福克法》在北美 3,382 家影院上映，首映当天票房收入 530 万美元。导演约翰·汉堡的这部影片五天首映票房预计为 3,630 万美元，也略低于最初预计的 4,500 万美元。阿丽亚娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 与回归的本·斯蒂勒 (Ben Stiller) 和罗伯特·德尼罗 (Robert De Niro) 一起饰演一名即将嫁给斯蒂勒饰演的格雷格·福克 (Greg Focker) 儿子的女人。

paras.en: Meet the Parents opened to $28.6 million domestically in 2000 (en route to its $166.2 million domestic cume). Sequel Meet the Fockers launched even bigger with $70.5 million over the five-day Christmas frame in 2004, while 2010’s Little Fockers dropped to $45 million for its five-day opening frame.
paras.zh: 2000 年，《拜见父母》在国内首映票房为 2,860 万美元（目前国内票房为 1.662 亿美元）。 2004 年，《遇见福克一家》的续集在圣诞节上映的五天票房收入甚至高达 7050 万美元，而 2010 年的《小福克一家》开场五天票房则跌至 4500 万美元。

paras.en: Focker-in-Law earned a B+ CinemaScore from audiences and holds a rough 29 percent critical score on Rotten Tomatoes. In his review for THR, critic Frank Scheck wrote that the sequel “feels like the nadir in a series that recycles the same tired jokes in increasingly desperate manner.”
paras.zh: 《福克洛夫》获得了观众的 B+ CinemaScore 评分，并在烂番茄上获得了大约 29% 的好评率。影评人弗兰克·谢克（Frank Scheck）在《THR》的评论中写道，续集“感觉像是系列中的最低点，以越来越绝望的方式循环使用相同的无聊笑话。”

paras.en: Disney animated features are known for debuting over Thanksgiving, as Moana 2 opened to a massive $225 million over the five-day weekend in 2024 to help that year’s holiday frame set the all-time record with $423 million across all titles. Last year, Zootopia 2 launched on the Wednesday before Thanksgiving and collected $158 million over the five days to help lead the frame to a combined sum of $290 million. The total for this year’s holiday frame is expected to rank below both of those.
paras.zh: 迪士尼动画长片因在感恩节首映而闻名，《海洋奇缘 2》在 2024 年的五天周末首映票房就达到了 2.25 亿美元，帮助当年的节日框架创下了所有影片 4.23 亿美元的历史纪录。去年，《疯狂动物城 2》于感恩节前的周三推出，并在五天内筹集了 1.58 亿美元，使总票房达到 2.9 亿美元。今年假期的总金额预计将低于这两个数字。

paras.en: In limited release, Netflix launched director David Fincher’s The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth on 252 Imax screens in North America. The Brad Pitt-led follow-up to 2019’s Once Upon a Time in Hollywood appears headed for around $5 million domestically over the five days before it begins streaming Dec. 23.
paras.zh: Netflix 在北美 252 块 Imax 银幕上限量上映了大卫·芬奇导演的《克里夫·布斯的进一步不幸冒险》。由布拉德·皮特 (Brad Pitt) 领衔主演的 2019 年《好莱坞往事》续集在 12 月 23 日开播前的五天内，国内票房预计将达到 500 万美元左右。

articles.title: ‘A Paw Patrol Christmas’: When and Where to Stream the Animated Holiday Special Online Free
articles.author: Erin Lassner

articles.title: Gerald R. Molen, Oscar-Winning Producer on ‘Schindler’s List,’ Dies at 91
articles.author: Mike Barnes

paras.en: Gerald R. Molen, the Oscar-winning producer who teamed with Steven Spielberg on films including Schindler’s List, Jurassic Park and Minority Report, has died. He was 91.
paras.zh: 曾与史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格合作制作过《辛德勒名单》、《侏罗纪公园》和《少数派报告》等电影的奥斯卡获奖制片人杰拉德·R·莫伦去世。他91岁了。

paras.en: A longtime resident of Bigfork, Montana, Molen died Monday, his great-niece Rachel Lorraine Pullan announced.
paras.zh: 莫伦是蒙大拿州比格福克市的长期居民，他的侄孙女雷切尔·洛林·普兰宣布，他于周一去世。

paras.en: Molen first worked with Spielberg as a unit production manager on The Color Purple (1985), after which the filmmaker offered him his first producing gig, as an associate producer on *batteries not included (1987).
paras.zh: 莫伦首次与斯皮尔伯格合作，担任《紫色》(1985) 的单元制作经理，此后，斯皮尔伯格为他提供了他的第一份制作工作，担任《*不包括电池》(1987) 的副制片人。

paras.en: After serving as a producer on the Spielberg-directed Hook (1991), Molen was named head of production at Spielberg’s Amblin Entertainment, where he shepherded such films as The Flintstones (1994), The Little Rascals (1994), Little Giants (1994), Casper (1995), Twister (1996) and the Spielberg-directed sequel The Lost World: Jurassic Park (1997).
paras.zh: 在担任斯皮尔伯格执导的《虎克》（1991）的制片人后，莫伦被任命为斯皮尔伯格旗下安培林娱乐公司的制作主管，负责执导《摩登原始人》（1994）、《小小流氓》（1994）、《小巨人》（1994）、《卡斯帕》（1995）、《龙卷风》（1996）和斯皮尔伯格执导的续集《失落的世界》等电影：侏罗纪公园 (1997)。

paras.en: “It was the best job in Hollywood,” he said in a 2023 interview, “because any movie [Spielberg] directed I got to produce, and any movie the company did I got to oversee.”
paras.zh: “这是好莱坞最好的工作，”他在 2023 年接受采访时说道，“因为我必须制作 [斯皮尔伯格] 执导的任何电影，并且我必须监督该公司制作的任何电影。”

paras.en: He shared the best picture Oscar for Schindler’s List (1993) with Spielberg and Branko Lustig.
paras.zh: 他凭借《辛德勒的名单》（1993）与斯皮尔伯格和布兰科·勒斯蒂格共同获得奥斯卡最佳影片奖。

paras.en: Molen’s producing credits outside of Spielberg and Amblin included the best picture winner Rain Man (1988), Days of Thunder (1990), The Other Side of Heaven (2001), Just Like Heaven (2005), The Meg (2018) and Meg 2: The Trench (2023).
paras.zh: 莫伦在斯皮尔伯格和安培林之外的制作作品包括最佳影片奖得主《雨人》(1988)、《雷霆壮志》(1990)、《天堂的另一面》(2001)、《就像天堂》(2005)、《巨齿鲨》(2018) 和《巨齿鲨 2：战壕》(2023)。

paras.en: Gerald Robert Molen was born on Jan. 6, 1935, in Great Falls, Montana. He and his family moved to North Hollywood in 1947, and his parents, Gerald Sr. and Edith, built a cafe across the street from Republic Pictures in Studio City.
paras.zh: 杰拉尔德·罗伯特·莫伦 (Gerald Robert Molen) 1935 年 1 月 6 日出生于蒙大拿州大瀑布市。 1947 年，他和家人搬到了北好莱坞，他的父母老杰拉尔德 (Gerald Sr.) 和伊迪丝 (Edith) 在斯蒂迪奥城共和影业 (Republic Pictures) 对面开设了一家咖啡馆。

paras.en: “I got to make friends with the studio guards,” he said in 2014. “They used to take me on the studio lot and take me to a soundstage or the backlot where they were maybe shooting a Western and stuff me down behind a bale of hay or under a wagon. I got it in my blood.”
paras.zh: “我和工作室的保安交上了朋友，”他在 2014 年说道，“他们常常带我去工作室，带我去摄影棚或外景场地，他们可能在那里拍摄西部片，然后把我塞到一捆干草后面或一辆马车下面。我的血液里就有这种感觉。”

paras.en: After high school, Molen enlisted in the U.S. Marine Corps; after 10 months in the service, he landed a job as a truck driver hauling furniture at Republic in 1957.
paras.zh: 高中毕业后，莫伦加入了美国海军陆战队；服役 10 个月后，他于 1957 年在 Republic 找到了一份运输家具的卡车司机的工作。

paras.en: He moved to Universal in 1959, and on Psycho (1960), he doubled for Anthony Perkins as the driver of a car heading to the Bates Motel (director Alfred Hitchcock was in the back seat giving directions).
paras.zh: 1959 年，他转投环球影业，在《惊魂记》（1960）中，他为安东尼·博金斯饰演一辆前往贝茨汽车旅馆的汽车司机（导演阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克坐在后座上指路）。

paras.en: Molen rose to head of transportation at the studio, and as a transportation coordinator/captain/supervisor, he worked on Escape to Witch Mountain (1975), Bound for Glory (1976), Coming Home (1978), Being There (1979), Ordinary People (1980) and Absence of Malice (1981).
paras.zh: 莫伦升任工作室的交通主管，作为交通协调员/队长/主管，他参与了《逃往魔女山》(1975)、《奔向荣耀》(1976)、《回家》(1978)、《在那里》(1979)、《普通人》(1980)和《无恶意》(1981)。

paras.en: He graduated to unit production manager on such movies as The Postman Always Rings Twice (1981), Tootsie (1982), A Soldier’s Story (1984) and the Spielberg-helmed The Color Purple before embarking on his career as a producer.
paras.zh: 他毕业于《邮递员总是按两次铃》（1981 年）、《Tootsie》（1982 年）、《士兵的故事》（1984 年）和斯皮尔伯格执导的《紫色》等电影的单元制作经理，然后开始担任制片人。

paras.en: Molen also had cameos in films including Rain Man, Days of Thunder, Jurassic Park and two other Spielberg-directed features, Amistad (1997) and Catch Me If You Can (2002).
paras.zh: 莫伦还在《雨人》、《雷霆之日》、《侏罗纪公园》和另外两部斯皮尔伯格执导的影片《Amistad》（1997 年）和《Catch Me If You Can》（2002 年）中客串。

paras.en: He produced 2016: Obama’s America (2012) and Hillary’s America: The Secret History of the Democratic Party (2016), two documentaries written and directed by Dinesh D’Souza that were critical of Barack Obama and Hilary Clinton. He wrote about the Obama doc in an opinion piece for THR.
paras.zh: 他制作了《2016：奥巴马的美国》（2012）和《希拉里的美国：民主党秘史》（2016），这两部纪录片由迪内什·迪索萨编剧和导演，批评巴拉克·奥巴马和希拉里·克林顿。他在《好莱坞报道》的一篇评论文章中写到了奥巴马的文件。

paras.en: In 2014, he sent a letter to 866 Christian and conservative leaders that accused Hollywood of “depravity” and causing “much damage to America.”
paras.zh: 2014年，他致信866名基督教和保守派领导人，指责好莱坞“堕落”并“给美国造成了巨大损害”。

paras.en: “Throughout my years in Hollywood, I tried to live my life differently and be a part of projects that I would be proud to have my grandchildren watch,” he wrote. “It hasn’t been easy, but I’ve at least tried to stand against the tide of depravity that has too often flourished there.”
paras.zh: 他写道：“在好莱坞的这些年里，我试图以不同的方式过自己的生活，并成为我为让我的孙子们观看而感到自豪的项目的一部分。” “这并不容易，但我至少试图抵制那里经常盛行的堕落潮流。”

paras.en: Pat, his wife of nearly 70 years, died in January 2024 at age 86.
paras.zh: 与他结婚近 70 年的妻子帕特于 2024 年 1 月去世，享年 86 岁。

articles.title: Semiconductor chips are the new oil. Here's why

paras.en: The artificial intelligence boom has pushed semiconductors past oil and gas in global export value for the first time, according to a Deutsche Bank analysis of International Trade Centre data.
paras.zh: 根据德意志银行对国际贸易中心数据的分析，人工智能的繁荣使半导体在全球出口价值中首次超过石油和天然气。

paras.en: Yet the milestone arrives at an awkward moment, just as investors reassess the outlook for artificial intelligence spending and drive down the price of semiconductor stocks. Last week, before Monday's breathtaking reversal, semiconductor stocks suffered their worst weekly loss in a quarter century, with the PHLX Semiconductor Index (SOX) plunging nearly 11% last Friday alone, capping a more than 17% weekly decline.
paras.zh: 然而，就在投资者重新评估人工智能支出前景并压低半导体股票价格之际，这一里程碑出现在一个尴尬的时刻。上周，在周一出现惊人逆转之前，半导体股票遭遇了四分之一个世纪以来最严重的周跌幅，PHLX 半导体指数 (SOX) 仅上周五就暴跌近 11%，周跌幅超过 17%。

paras.en: Nvidia soared more than 31% Monday after the leading maker of artificial intelligence chips had fallen for a seventh straight week, plunging 46% during that stretch. Then it fell again, dropping almost 10% on Tuesday and Wednesday. Advanced Micro Devices tumbled 20% in two days last Thursday and Friday. Micron Technology sank 27% over the seven days ended last Friday.
paras.zh: 领先的人工智能芯片制造商英伟达(Nvidia)周一股价飙升逾31%，此前这家领先的人工智能芯片制造商连续第七周下跌，期间暴跌46%。随后再次下跌，周二和周三下跌近 10%。 Advanced Micro Devices 在上周四和周五的两天内下跌了 20%。美光科技 (Micron Technology) 在截至上周五的 7 天里下跌了 27%。

paras.en: "For decades we've talked about the petrodollar. Perhaps increasingly we need to think about the chip dollar," Jim Reid, global head of macro and thematic research at Deutsche Bank wrote in a report this month.
paras.zh: “几十年来，我们一直在谈论石油美元。也许我们越来越需要考虑芯片美元，”德意志银行宏观和主题研究全球主管吉姆·里德在本月的一份报告中写道。

paras.en: Semiconductor exports overtook oil and gas for the first time during the January-March quarter of 2026, reaching about $1.61 trillion, compared with $1.53 trillion for oil and gas, the report said, using four-quarter rolling totals.
paras.zh: 报告称，2026 年 1 月至 3 月季度半导体出口首次超过石油和天然气，达到约 1.61 万亿美元，而石油和天然气的出口额为 1.53 万亿美元。

paras.en: The gap widened in the second quarter, when semiconductor exports totaled about $1.60 trillion and oil and gas exports reached about $1.47 trillion. Disruptions to oil supplies through the Strait of Hormuz after the Iran war helped widen the gap. Daily oil flows through the Strait collapsed nearly 77%, to 4.9 million barrels in the second quarter of 2026 from 21.6 million barrels in the fourth quarter of 2025, according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration.
paras.zh: 第二季度差距扩大，半导体出口总额约为1.60万亿美元，石油和天然气出口总额约为1.47万亿美元。伊朗战争后，霍尔木兹海峡石油供应中断，进一步扩大了差距。根据美国能源情报署的数据，通过海峡的每日石油流量从 2025 年第四季度的 2160 万桶降至 2026 年第二季度的 490 万桶，下降了近 77%。

paras.en: Yet the demand for semiconductors has proven insatiable in the face of soaring data center construction, boosting global trade in the increasingly scarce AI component. Hundreds of billions of dollars of orders for graphics processing units and data centers aim at providing AI computing power, Rothschild & Co. Redburn wrote in a report last Thursday.
paras.zh: 然而，面对数据中心建设的飙升，对半导体的需求已被证明是无法满足的，从而促进了日益稀缺的人工智能组件的全球贸易。 Rothschild & Co. Redburn 在上周四的一份报告中写道，数千亿美元的图形处理单元和数据中心订单旨在提供人工智能计算能力。

paras.en: "Compute will be the new commodity fueling this transformation on a global scale," Rothschild analyst Cara Thomson said.
paras.zh: 罗斯柴尔德分析师卡拉·汤姆森表示：“计算将成为推动全球范围内这一转型的新商品。”

paras.en: The shift toward chips has macroeconomic implications just as the explosion in oil trade did in the 1970s.
paras.zh: 正如 20 世纪 70 年代石油贸易的爆炸式增长一样，向芯片的转变对宏观经济产生了影响。

paras.en: Oil-exporting countries historically recycled much of their surpluses into the purchase of U.S. Treasuries and other bonds, helping finance U.S. deficits and underpin demand for other government debt.
paras.zh: 历史上，石油出口国将大部分盈余用于购买美国国债和其他债券，帮助美国赤字融资并支撑对其他政府债务的需求。

paras.en: Reid at Deutsche Bank said that since semiconductor-surplus countries in Asia are more closely tied to U.S. tech companies, some chip-export earnings could flow back into U.S. technology stocks, startups and data centers, further helping to finance the AI investment cycle.
paras.zh: 德意志银行的里德表示，由于亚洲半导体过剩国家与美国科技公司的联系更加紧密，一些芯片出口收入可能会回流到美国科技股、初创公司和数据中心，进一步帮助为人工智能投资周期提供资金。

paras.en: The changing dynamics in global trade could also tilt the mix of global financial flows, Reid said. "So welcome to the chip-dollar era: potentially more growth, more excitement, more volatility, and structurally higher yields" in corporate and government debt.
paras.zh: 里德表示，全球贸易动态的变化也可能导致全球金融流动的结构发生倾斜。 “欢迎来到芯片美元时代：企业和政府债务可能会出现更多增长、更多兴奋、更多波动以及结构性更高的收益率”。

articles.title: Microdrama apps chase profits as Hollywood moves into short-form, vertical video

paras.en: Bogdan Nesvit says his mission is simple: "We are essentially building Disney for the 21st century."
paras.zh: 博格丹·内斯维特 (Bogdan Nesvit) 表示，他的使命很简单：“我们本质上是在建设 21 世纪的迪士尼。”

paras.en: Nesvit is the co-founder of microseries app My Drama, built around the latest, bite-sized form of storytelling. Short, serialized "microdrama" videos are created specifically for mobile devices and have generated billions of views this year. They often feature romantic tropes and typically end in cliffhangers to keep viewers hooked.
paras.zh: Nesvit 是微剧应用程序 My Drama 的联合创始人，该应用程序围绕最新的小型故事讲述形式而构建。专门为移动设备创建的连载“微剧”短视频今年已产生数十亿次观看次数。它们通常以浪漫的比喻为特色，并通常以悬念结尾，以吸引观众。

paras.en: The category has exploded at a time when traditional media faces waning interest and YouTube now claims more viewing hours than individual streaming platforms.
paras.zh: 在传统媒体兴趣减弱、YouTube 目前声称观看时间比个别流媒体平台更多的情况下，该类别出现了爆炸式增长。

paras.en: The microdrama industry is projected to reach $1.5 billion in revenue in the U.S. in 2026, according to research firm Media Partners Asia. In China, where the format originally gained popularity, microdrama revenue surpassed what was made at the box office in 2024.
paras.zh: 据研究公司 Media Partners Asia 称，预计 2026 年美国微剧行业的收入将达到 15 亿美元。在这种形式最初流行的中国，微剧收入在 2024 年超过了票房收入。

paras.en: "It has the potential to evolve into mainstream entertainment and basically become mobile-first video streaming of the size of Netflix," Nesvit said.
paras.zh: 内斯维特说：“它有潜力发展成为主流娱乐，基本上成为 Netflix 规模的移动优先视频流。”

paras.en: Tech companies and startups such as My Drama currently lead the category in metrics like downloads and time spent on the apps.
paras.zh: 目前，My Drama 等科技公司和初创公司在下载量和应用时间等指标上处于领先地位。

paras.en: TikTok's PineDrama is the most popular microdrama app of 2026 so far with 13.2 million U.S. downloads through September, according to Sensor Tower data.
paras.zh: Sensor Tower 数据显示，TikTok 的 PineDrama 是 2026 年迄今为止最受欢迎的微剧应用，截至 9 月份美国下载量为 1320 万次。

paras.en: Startups DramaBox and ReelShort beat out entertainment giants Netflix and Disney in average mobile usage time in the U.S. in the third quarter, according to Sensor Tower.
paras.zh: 根据 Sensor Tower 的数据，第三季度美国初创公司 DramaBox 和 ReelShort 在平均移动使用时间方面击败了娱乐巨头 Netflix 和 Disney。

paras.en: As they see microdramas win over viewers, legacy media companies, Hollywood executives and actors increasingly want in.
paras.zh: 随着微剧赢得了观众的青睐，传统媒体公司、好莱坞高管和演员越来越想加入其中。

paras.en: Fox Entertainment was one of the earliest Hollywood investors in microdramas. The entertainment studio acquired an equity stake in Holywater Tech, the company behind My Drama, in October 2025.
paras.zh: 福克斯娱乐公司是好莱坞最早投资微剧的公司之一。该娱乐工作室于 2025 年 10 月收购了 My Drama 背后的公司 Holywater Tech 的股权。

paras.en: Fox agreed to produce at least 200 vertical video titles over two years that would be available on the Holywater app. Thus far, hits include dark academia series "Secret Society: Till Blood Do Us Part" and "Kiss of the Pirate King." Individual series have reached tens of millions of views, according to the company.
paras.zh: Fox 同意在两年内制作至少 200 个垂直视频节目，并在 Holywater 应用程序上提供。迄今为止，热门作品包括黑暗学院系列《秘密结社：直到血腥将我们分开》和《海贼王之吻》。据该公司称，单个系列的观看次数已达到数千万次。

paras.en: Nesvit told CNBC in an interview that partnerships like the one between Fox and Holywater benefit studios by providing the infrastructure to publish their short-form videos and get them in front of an audience.
paras.zh: 内斯维特在接受 CNBC 采访时表示，福克斯和霍利沃特之间的合作关系可以为电影公司提供基础设施来发布短片并将其呈现在观众面前，从而使电影公司受益。

paras.en: Beyond distributing the videos, Holywater offers advice for what types of content perform best in a short, mobile-first format, according to Nesvit.
paras.zh: 内斯维特表示，除了分发视频之外，霍利沃特还就哪些类型的内容在简短的、移动优先的格式中效果最好提供了建议。

paras.en: "One of the exciting things that we learned when we started talking to studios in Hollywood around two years ago is that all of them are super hungry for consumer data," Nesvit said. "They really want to see how people are interacting with each second of the content."
paras.zh: “大约两年前，当我们开始与好莱坞的电影公司交谈时，我们了解到的令人兴奋的事情之一是，他们都非常渴望消费者数据，”内斯维特说。 “他们真的想看看人们如何与每一秒的内容互动。”

paras.en: Nesvit said the company will provide studios with feedback on everything from the length of a camera shot to what color dress a character should wear.
paras.zh: 内斯维特表示，该公司将为工作室提供从镜头长度到角色应该穿什么颜色的衣服等方方面面的反馈。

paras.en: "Our goal is how we can drive audiences from YouTube, from TikTok, from Instagram to our platform, and also create those kinds of synergies [with] legacy media," he said.
paras.zh: “我们的目标是如何将观众从 YouTube、TikTok、Instagram 吸引到我们的平台，并与传统媒体创造这种协同效应，”他说。

paras.en: Holywater recently adapted Season 3 of Fox's reality TV hit "Farmer Wants a Wife" into a microseries fit for the platform. The company also plans to create a scripted series featuring 30 three-minute episodes inspired by Fox's "Fear Factor: House of Fear."
paras.zh: 霍利沃特最近将福克斯真人秀热门节目《农夫想要妻子》第三季改编成适合该平台的微连续剧。该公司还计划根据福克斯的《恐惧因素：恐惧之屋》的灵感，制作一个有 30 集三分钟剧集的有剧本剧集。

paras.en: Holywater currently relies on a combination of subscription fees, which make up about 80% of its revenue, and money from advertisers. Nesvit said the company is also exploring incorporating brand integrations. The company is already profitable, its co-founders said.
paras.zh: Holywater 目前主要依靠订阅费（约占其收入的 80%）和广告商的收入。内斯维特表示，该公司还在探索品牌整合。联合创始人表示，该公司已经实现盈利。

paras.en: Co-founder Anatolii Kasianov said creating the videos is "very cost efficient," with an estimated expense of between $150,000 and $200,000 for an average 70-minute series.
paras.zh: 联合创始人阿纳托利·卡西亚诺夫 (Anatolii Kasianov) 表示，制作这些视频“非常具有成本效益”，平均 70 分钟的系列视频预计费用在 15 万至 20 万美元之间。

paras.en: The company's partnerships with content studios, he said, help to bring down customer acquisition costs.
paras.zh: 他说，该公司与内容工作室的合作有助于降低客户获取成本。

paras.en: "You attract organically the audience that loves that [intellectual property]," he said.
paras.zh: “你有机地吸引了热爱[知识产权]的观众，”他说。

paras.en: While Fox saw collaboration as the way into the format, some longtime Hollywood executives are betting they can skip the partnerships and create microdrama platforms in-house.
paras.zh: 虽然福克斯将合作视为进入这种形式的途径，但一些好莱坞的长期高管认为他们可以跳过合作伙伴关系并在内部创建微剧平台。

paras.en: Jana Winograde, Susan Rovner and Lloyd Braun, who have collectively held leadership roles at NBCUniversal, Showtime, Warner Bros. Discovery and ABC, have jointly founded a microdrama startup called aTwist.
paras.zh: 贾娜·维诺格莱德 (Jana Winograde)、苏珊·罗夫纳 (Susan Rovner) 和劳埃德·布劳恩 (Lloyd Braun) 曾共同在 NBCUniversal、Showtime、华纳兄弟探索频道和美国广播公司 (ABC) 担任领导职务，共同创立了一家名为 aTwist 的微剧初创公司。

paras.en: The company, which officially launched in September, has garnered tens of millions of views as of late November across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, where content lives in addition to the app.
paras.zh: 该公司于 9 月份正式成立，截至 11 月底，在 TikTok、Instagram 和 YouTube 上已经获得了数千万次浏览量，除了应用程序之外，这些网站还提供内容。

paras.en: "One of the specialties that we have is really what it means to be a great storyteller," Rovner told CNBC in an interview. "I was president of Warner Bros. Television. I was there for 22 years. During my time there, we had over 18 series go over 100 episodes, so I definitely think we have an expertise in getting people to care about these shows, care about the characters, invest."
paras.zh: 罗夫纳在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“我们的专长之一就是成为一名出色的讲故事者。” “我曾是华纳兄弟电视台的总裁。我在那里工作了 22 年。在我任职期间，我们制作了超过 18 个剧集，超过 100 集，所以我绝对认为我们拥有让人们关心这些节目、关心角色并进行投资的专业知识。”

paras.en: "A lot of our competitors' completion rates are very low, their churn rates are very high," Rovner said. "They can often bring people into the store but they can't keep them."
paras.zh: “我们的许多竞争对手的完成率非常低，他们的流失率非常高，”罗夫纳说。 “他们经常能把人带进店里，但却留不住人。”

paras.en: The average churn rate for the most downloaded microdrama apps is nearly 60% so far in 2026, according to Sensor Tower data. The market intelligence firm notes that the number of users lost in each quarter this year has roughly equaled the number of users gained.
paras.zh: 根据 Sensor Tower 的数据，截至 2026 年，下载次数最多的微剧应用的平均流失率接近 60%。这家市场情报公司指出，今年每个季度流失的用户数量大致等于新增的用户数量。

paras.en: ATwist seeks to keep viewers enticed through high-stakes, compelling characters and unique stories. The app has already ordered second seasons of shows and puts a particular emphasis on talent, according to the co-founders.
paras.zh: ATwist 致力于通过高风险、引人注目的角色和独特的故事来吸引观众。联合创始人表示，该应用程序已经订购了第二季的节目，并特别重视人才。

paras.en: Jesse Tyler Ferguson, known for his role as Mitchell on "Modern Family," and his husband, Justin Mikita, a Broadway producer, have collaborated on the musical series "Theater Kids vs. Zombies" for aTwist. It premiered on Oct. 15.
paras.zh: 杰西·泰勒·弗格森 (Jesse Tyler Ferguson) 因在《摩登家庭》中饰演米切尔而闻名，他和他的丈夫、百老汇制片人贾斯汀·米基塔 (Justin Mikita) 合作为 aTwist 制作了音乐剧《剧院孩子大战僵尸》。该剧于 10 月 15 日首播。

paras.en: Other series that debuted last month included "Honey, I Think Our House Is Haunted" starring Mario Lopez and "Unboxing the Killer Doll" starring Paris Hilton.
paras.zh: 上个月首映的其他剧集包括马里奥·洛佩兹主演的《亲爱的，我觉得我们的房子闹鬼》和帕丽斯·希尔顿主演的《杀手娃娃拆箱》。

paras.en: In May, aTwist announced an exclusive partnership with Skydance's linear television channel BET to create horizontal microdramas that air first on BET and later stream in vertical format on aTwist's app.
paras.zh: 5 月，aTwist 宣布与 Skydance 的线性电视频道 BET 建立独家合作伙伴关系，制作横向微剧，首先在 BET 上播出，然后在 aTwist 的应用程序上以纵向格式播放。

paras.en: "That brings a lot of awareness to our brand, a lot of marketing," Winograde said. "But it also gives these linear networks the opportunity to get programming at an incredibly low cost that, from what we're seeing, the audience loves."
paras.zh: “这为我们的品牌带来了很多知名度，也带来了很多营销活动，”维诺格莱德说。 “但它也让这些线性网络有机会以极低的成本获得节目，从我们所看到的来看，这是观众喜欢的。”

paras.en: Winograde suggested aTwist could strike similar partnerships in the future.
paras.zh: Winograde 表示 aTwist 未来可能会建立类似的合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: Large streaming companies, which have already faced competition from social media apps and YouTube, are exploring ways to incorporate microdramas inside their existing apps.
paras.zh: 大型流媒体公司已经面临来自社交媒体应用程序和 YouTube 的竞争，它们正在探索将微剧整合到现有应用程序中的方法。

paras.en: NBCUniversal's Peacock launched its own vertical video channel within the app this summer that features both original unscripted series and more traditional vertical dramas. NBCUniversal is also eyeing international development by investing in an Indian microdrama platform, EloElo Group's Story TV, earlier this month.
paras.zh: NBCUniversal 的 Peacock 今年夏天在应用程序中推出了自己的垂直视频频道，其中既有原创的无剧本剧集，也有更传统的垂直戏剧。 NBCUniversal 也在本月早些时候投资了印度微剧平台 EloElo Group 的 Story TV，着眼于国际化发展。

paras.en: "At NBCUniversal, we see significant opportunity in mobile-first storytelling and emerging formats like microdramas to engage audiences and meet evolving viewing habits," Deepak Arya, executive vice president for corporate strategy and development at NBCUniversal, said in a press release.
paras.zh: NBCUniversal 负责企业战略和发展的执行副总裁 Deepak Arya 在一份新闻稿中表示：“在 NBCUniversal，我们看到了移动优先叙事和微剧等新兴格式的巨大机遇，可以吸引观众并满足不断变化的观看习惯。”

paras.en: Disney+, Paramount+ and Netflix similarly launched vertical channels embedded in their services this year. Notably, the channels are meant to help viewers discover traditional content and so far haven't featured original, vertical-first series.
paras.zh: Disney+、Paramount+ 和 Netflix 今年同样推出了嵌入其服务的垂直频道。值得注意的是，这些频道旨在帮助观众发现传统内容，但迄今为止尚未推出原创的、垂直优先的剧集。

paras.en: On top of those media companies, head of Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios Mike Hopkins told CNBC's Julia Boorstin in an interview last month that the tech company was interested in producing its own microdramas.
paras.zh: 除了这些媒体公司之外，Prime Video 和亚马逊米高梅工作室的负责人迈克·霍普金斯 (Mike Hopkins) 上个月在接受 CNBC 的朱莉娅·布尔斯汀 (Julia Boorstin) 采访时表示，这家科技公司有兴趣制作自己的微剧。

paras.en: Despite the flurry of investment, Hollywood still faces the challenge of how to translate viewing hours into profit, especially for shorter content.
paras.zh: 尽管投资热潮，好莱坞仍然面临着如何将观看时间转化为利润的挑战，尤其是对于较短的内容。

paras.en: Leading U.S. microdrama app ReelShort posted a net loss of $12 million in 2025 despite bringing in total revenue of $785 million, according to research compiled by Media Partners Asia, or MPA.
paras.zh: 根据亚洲媒体合作伙伴 (MPA) 编制的研究报告，美国领先的微剧应用 ReelShort 公布，尽管总收入为 7.85 亿美元，但 2025 年仍净亏损 1200 万美元。

paras.en: The app, which was founded in 2022 by California-based Crazy Maple Studio, currently reaches about 65 million users every month, according to the company's LinkedIn profile.
paras.zh: 该应用程序由总部位于加利福尼亚州的 Crazy Maple Studio 于 2022 年创立，根据该公司的 LinkedIn 资料显示，目前每月约有 6500 万用户。

paras.en: However, high marketing and content costs have weighed on the company's bottom line. MPA expects ReelShort to reach profitability for the first time this year, with an estimated $40 million in net profit.
paras.zh: 然而，高昂的营销和内容成本给该公司的利润带来了压力。 MPA 预计 ReelShort 今年将首次实现盈利，净利润预计为 4000 万美元。

paras.en: Media Partners Asia CEO Vivek Couto told CNBC that acquiring new users is the largest cost, with ReelShort spending an estimated 55% of its revenue in 2025 on marketing.
paras.zh: Media Partners Asia 首席执行官 Vivek Couto 告诉 CNBC，获取新用户是最大的成本，预计 2025 年 ReelShort 将其收入的 55% 用于营销。

paras.en: Couto also noted high content spend, especially since microdrama apps typically require a high volume of content.
paras.zh: 库托还指出，内容支出很高，特别是因为微剧应用通常需要大量内容。

paras.en: "The content is very hit-driven … it wears out fast," Couto said. "The churn rate for this sector is high, so you have to fill that slate all the time, and you have to win back those users."
paras.zh: “这些内容非常受热捧……它很快就会过时，”库托说。 “这个行业的流失率很高，所以你必须一直填补这个空白，并且你必须赢回这些用户。”

paras.en: Correction: A previous version misstated Holywater Tech's full name in first reference. Co-founder Anatolii Kasianov also said expenses run between $150,000 and $200,000 for an average 70-minute series. A previous version misstated the average series length.
paras.zh: 更正：之前的版本在第一个参考文献中错误地表述了 Holywater Tech 的全名。联合创始人阿纳托利·卡西亚诺夫还表示，平均 70 分钟的系列剧费用在 15 万至 20 万美元之间。之前的版本错误地表述了平均系列长度。

articles.title: Trump demands probe into ‘record setting error’ after third-quarter GDP data gets massive revision higher

paras.en: President Donald Trump on Thursday falsely deemed the latest gross domestic product revision a mistake, claiming that it should be "immediately investigated."
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周四错误地认为最新的国内生产总值修正是一个错误，声称应该“立即调查”。

paras.en: Data released Wednesday from the Commerce Department revealed that the U.S. economy exhibited much stronger growth for the third quarter than initially estimated, showing that real GDP grew at a 4.3% annualized rate. That was revised upward from the department's advance estimate of 3.4%.
paras.zh: 美国商务部周三公布的数据显示，美国第三季度经济增长远强于最初预期，实际GDP年化增长率为4.3%。该数字是该部门预先估计的 3.4% 上调的。

paras.en: That revision was a "RECORD SETTING ERROR," Trump said in a Truth Social post, suggesting that the initial release could have influenced the outcome of the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, where Democrats flipped both chambers of Congress and even multiple governorships.
paras.zh: 特朗普在《Truth Social》帖子中表示，这一修订是一个“创纪录的错误”，暗示最初的发布可能会影响 2026 年美国中期选举的结果，民主党在这次选举中推翻了国会两院甚至多个州长职位。

paras.en: "I would like to wish a Happy Thanksgiving to even those who issued fake Economic Numbers, just prior to the Election, and corrected them yesterday, three weeks late, showing that the GDP was actually 4.3%, versus 3.4%, A RECORD SETTING ERROR, and one so grave that it should be immediately investigated," Trump wrote.
paras.zh: 特朗普写道：“我祝愿那些在选举前夕发布虚假经济数据并在三周后的昨天更正这些数据的人感恩节快乐，这些数据显示GDP实际上是4.3%，而不是3.4%，这是一个创纪录的错误，而且这个错误如此严重，应该立即进行调查。”

paras.en: However, the difference between the advance estimate and the figure in the second release is far from being an all-time record. It was the largest revision since the 1.2 percentage point revision seen in the second quarter of 2020.
paras.zh: 然而，预先估计与第二次发布的数字之间的差异远未达到历史记录。这是自 2020 年第二季度 1.2 个百分点修正以来的最大修正。

paras.en: On an absolute basis, the latest revision was tied for 16th among all revisions from the advance estimate to the second release since 1990. It also tied four other quarters with a similar 0.9 percentage point difference — and was approximately double the average revision of 0.43 percentage points for all 147 quarters.
paras.zh: 从绝对值来看，最新修订在自 1990 年以来第二次发布的预先估计的所有修订中并列第 16 位。它还以类似的 0.9 个百分点的差异与其他四个季度并列，大约是所有 147 个季度 0.43 个百分点的平均修订的两倍。

paras.en: The upward revision shows Trump's policies are "delivering results" that defy expectations, White House spokesman Matthew Middleton told CNBC.
paras.zh: 白宫发言人马修·米德尔顿 (Matthew Middleton) 向 CNBC 表示，向上修正表明特朗普的政策正在“带来超出预期的结果”。

paras.en: Revisions to U.S. economic numbers are not out of the ordinary. Initial reports count on partial survey data and early estimates. Those data are later updated with more survey responses — which sometimes leads to changes from the initial reports.
paras.zh: 美国经济数据的修正并不罕见。初步报告依赖于部分调查数据和早期估计。这些数据随后会随着更多的调查回复而更新——这有时会导致初始报告发生变化。

paras.en: GDP data is revised repeatedly over a five year period. By the time the final revision is done, the average absolute error from the second release to the final is 1.14 percentage points.
paras.zh: GDP 数据在五年内反复修订。到最终修订完成时，第二次发布到最终版本的平均绝对误差为1.14个百分点。

paras.en: The advance estimate for Q3 U.S. GDP, which came just days before Election Day in early November, was still better than the figure economists had expected at the time. It also showed a significant step-up in growth from the second quarter.
paras.zh: 就在 11 月初选举日前几天，对美国第三季度 GDP 的预先估计仍然好于经济学家当时的预期。与第二季度相比，增长也显着加快。

paras.en: Because that was a strong showing for the economy, some on Wall Street consider this week's revision to be a confirmation of the economy's recent growth trend.
paras.zh: 由于经济表现强劲，华尔街的一些人认为本周的修正是对经济近期增长趋势的确认。

paras.en: Jim Baird of Plante Moran Financial Advisors said immediately following the release that it "reinforces an increasingly familiar tension" that the economy is "performing quite well, but its resilience also gives the Fed an even stronger case for further rate hikes."
paras.zh: Plante Moran Financial Advisors 的吉姆·贝尔德 (Jim Baird) 在消息发布后立即表示，这“强化了一种日益熟悉的紧张局势”，即经济“表现相当不错，但其韧性也为美联储进一步加息提供了更有力的理由”。

paras.en: "The economy isn't merely hanging in there. It continues to demonstrate considerable resilience, with consumers spending, businesses investing and few signs that restrictive monetary policy is creating significant cracks in the broader expansion," the firm's chief investment officer said.
paras.zh: 该公司的首席投资官表示：“经济并不仅仅是停滞不前。它继续表现出相当大的弹性，消费者支出、企业投资，而且几乎没有迹象表明限制性货币政策正在对更广泛的扩张造成重大影响。”

paras.en: Traders are currently pricing in a nearly 100% chance of a hike at the Federal Open Market Committee's December meeting, per the CME FedWatch tool. They're also anticipating an additional hike in January.
paras.zh: 根据 CME FedWatch 工具，交易员目前预计联邦公开市场委员会 12 月会议上加息的可能性接近 100%。他们还预计一月份还会进一步加息。

paras.en: — CNBC's Jeff Cox and Fred Imbert contributed reporting
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Jeff Cox 和 Fred Imbert 贡献了报道

articles.title: Who is Levent Alpöge, the reclusive genius behind AI’s math conquest?

paras.en: Levent Alpöge got back to the place he was crashing in New York City around 4 A.M. on November 20. He was almost done. He could almost sleep.
paras.zh: 凌晨 4 点左右，Levent Alpöge 回到了纽约市坠机地点。 11 月 20 日。他快完成了。他几乎可以睡觉了。

paras.en: All that was left was to download the 17 million lines of code he’d spent the night preparing for public release. It needed to go up on his personal website, alongside a four-page statement he’d tinkered with all week. But for the moment, the code still sat on the servers of his employer, the artificial intelligence company Anthropic—which had gone public just hours earlier with the largest valuation in stock market history, making Alpöge a rich man. Once the upload was complete, he would also be one of history’s most famous mathematicians.
paras.zh: 剩下的就是下载他花了一晚上准备公开发布的 1700 万行代码。它需要出现在他的个人网站上，同时附上他花了一周时间修改的四页声明。但目前，该代码仍然保存在他的雇主——人工智能公司 Anthropic 的服务器上——这家公司在几个小时前刚刚上市，估值创下了股市历史上最高的估值，使 Alpöge 成为了一名富翁。一旦上传完成，他也将成为历史上最著名的数学家之一。

paras.en: The code was the product of untold computing resources, months of work and decades of dreaming. It proved the Riemann hypothesis, a 167-year-old math problem so formidable that it is almost beyond words; in public talks, experts have tended to simply treat it as an over-the-horizon aspiration, a “vanishing point” perspective against which all other math problems shrink. Just weeks earlier Terence Tao—arguably the world’s most famous mathematician—had declared the hypothesis out of AI’s reach (let alone that of humans) until perhaps 2050.
paras.zh: 该代码是无数计算资源、数月工作和数十年梦想的产物。它证明了黎曼猜想，这是一个有着 167 年历史的数学难题，其难度之大几乎难以用言语来形容；在公开演讲中，专家们倾向于简单地将其视为一种超越地平线的愿望，一种“消失点”的视角，所有其他数学问题都会在这种视角下缩小。就在几周前，陶哲轩——可以说是世界上最著名的数学家——宣布这一假设在 2050 年之前人工智能都无法实现（更不用说人类了）。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Now the challenge is vanquished. Alpöge’s quiet upload capped off an epochal year in which AI has systematically conquered humanity’s oldest discipline in a sequence of escalating, dramatic and controversial discoveries. And in nearly every episode of this earthshaking war for math’s soul, Alpöge has figured somehow—part battlefield champion, part horseman of the AI apocalypse, part Forrest Gump. His eccentric ways have shaped this saga, maybe more than any other single person on Earth, and thereby the course of history.
paras.zh: 现在，挑战已被克服。 Alpöge 的安静上传结束了划时代的一年，在这一年中，人工智能通过一系列不断升级的、戏剧性的和有争议的发现，系统地征服了人类最古老的学科。在这场数学灵魂之战的几乎每一集中，阿尔波吉都以某种方式出现——一半是战场冠军，一半是人工智能启示录的骑士，一半是阿甘正传。他古怪的方式对这个传奇的影响可能比地球上任何其他人都要大，从而影响了历史的进程。

paras.en: That is perhaps why people are so divided over Alpöge. “Who is this person who’s behind some of the most striking applications of AI to mathematics?” says Henry Cohn, a mathematician at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. “This is a really interesting question that deserves a deeper answer than you can get from following him on X.”
paras.zh: 也许这就是为什么人们对阿尔卑格的看法如此分歧。 “人工智能在数学上的一些最引人注目的应用背后的这个人是谁？”麻省理工学院数学家亨利·科恩说。 “这是一个非常有趣的问题，值得比在 X 上关注他所得到的更深入的答案。”

paras.en: Depending on who you ask, Alpöge is a reviled online troll—an agent of chaos laughing as his fellow mathematicians watch their intellectual landscape get carpet-bombed by his Silicon Valley cohort—or a reluctant public figure—a shy academic who has integrity and wants to forge a future where AI is mathematicians’ collaborator, not their usurper. Or maybe he’s an arrogant genius who has a chip on his shoulder and is bent on leveraging his access, his internal models and unlimited tokens, to prove his doubters wrong by snatching every remaining mathematical trophy off the shelf.
paras.zh: 取决于你问的是谁，Alpöge 是一个被谩骂的网络巨魔，一个混乱的代理人，当他的数学家同事们看着他们的知识图景被他的硅谷同伴进行地毯式轰炸时，他会大笑；或者一个不情愿的公众人物，一个害羞的学者，他正直，想要创造一个人工智能是数学家的合作者，而不是他们的篡夺者的未来。或者，他可能是一个傲慢的天才，一心一意地利用他的访问权限、他的内部模型和无限的代币，通过抢走架子上所有剩余的数学奖杯来证明他的怀疑者是错误的。

paras.en: Whatever the truth is, it’s hard to know because Alpöge won’t tell. He refuses to speak to media. This article has been assembled from interviews with dozens of friends, mentors, collaborators and acquaintances.
paras.zh: 无论真相是什么，都很难知道，因为 Alpöge 不会透露。他拒绝接受媒体采访。本文根据对数十位朋友、导师、合作者和熟人的采访整理而成。

paras.en: Alpöge’s online persona is confusing and tempestuous. He topples famous conjectures with glib and gleeful social media posts—and then gets baited into emotionally replying to anonymous commenters. His X bio starts with the self-effacing descriptor “idiot” but follows with a litany of world-class accolades. There are few photographs of Alpöge online, but they all present a consistent picture: thick eyebrows over an angular, almost-elfin face, thin bangs halfway between a Beatles mop top and a bowl cut and an impish smile that reveals a slight gap between his front teeth and an unmistakable capacity for mischief.
paras.zh: Alpöge 的网络形象令人困惑且暴躁。他用巧言令色、兴高采烈的社交媒体帖子推翻了著名的猜想，然后情绪激动地回复了匿名评论者。他的 X 简介以谦逊的描述词“白痴”开始，但随后获得了一连串世界级的赞誉。网上很少有 Alpöge 的照片，但它们都呈现出一致的形象：粗眉毛覆盖着一张棱角分明、近乎精灵般的脸，刘海介于甲壳虫乐队的拖把上衣和碗形发型之间，顽皮的微笑显露出门牙之间的轻微缝隙和明显的恶作剧能力。

paras.en: According to numerous sources close to him, though, behind the irreverent visage is a fierce hunger for respect and recognition, paired with a boundless belief in his own capabilities—a drive shocking even to the world-class polymaths who know him. No goal is too ambitious. Even the Riemann hypothesis—math’s one true holy grail—proved to be no limit.
paras.zh: 然而，据众多与他关系密切的消息人士透露，在他不敬的面容背后，是对尊重和认可的强烈渴望，以及对自己能力的无限信念——这种动力甚至让认识他的世界级博学者都感到震惊。没有什么目标是太雄心勃勃的。甚至黎曼猜想——数学真正的圣杯——也被证明是没有极限的。

paras.en: “He has this will to take on the world and win,” says Scott Armstrong, a mathematician at New York University and a rare Alpöge confidant. “He’s got it in spades.”
paras.zh: 纽约大学数学家、Alpöge 罕见的知己斯科特·阿姆斯特朗 (Scott Armstrong) 表示：“他有征服世界并取得胜利的意志。” “他确实做到了。”

paras.en: In today’s world, where large teams are the norm for any assault on frontier research problems, Alpöge is an anomaly: he mostly works alone, except, of course, for the powerful internal models he has privileged access to. “Here is a person that is larger than life,” Armstrong says. “I keep asking myself, ‘When they make the movie, who is going to play Levent?’”
paras.zh: 在当今世界，大型团队已成为攻克前沿研究问题的常态，但 Alpöge 却是一个反常现象：他大部分时间都是独自工作，当然，除了他有权使用的强大内部模型之外。 “这是一个比生命更伟大的人，”阿姆斯特朗说。 “我一直问自己，‘当他们拍电影时，谁来扮演莱文特？’”

paras.en: Levent Alpöge was born on April Fool’s Day, 1992, along the central stretch of Long Island.
paras.zh: Levent Alpöge 诞生于 1992 年愚人节，位于长岛中部。

paras.en: His parents, both Turkish immigrants, realized their son’s intellect was remarkable when he was just three years old. As his mother told a Turkish newspaper in 2014, she was reading him one of his favorite books and said she was too tired to continue, so Alpöge picked up where she’d stopped. At first she thought he had memorized the page, but when she gave him another book, he kept reading. Somehow, he’d learned without instruction. On the advice of professionals, they enrolled him in a nearby gifted program.
paras.zh: 他的父母都是土耳其移民，在儿子三岁时就意识到他的智力非凡。 2014 年，他的母亲告诉一家土耳其报纸，她正在给他读一本他最喜欢的书，并说她太累了，无法继续读下去，所以阿尔波格从她停下来的地方继续读下去。起初她以为他已经记住了这一页，但当她给他另一本书时，他继续读下去。不知怎的，他在没有指导的情况下就学会了。根据专业人士的建议，他们为他报名了附近的一个天才项目。

paras.en: Levent Alpöge’s one sister, Elif, is a decade older, which made him practically an only child for much of the time. Alpöge was extremely athletic and especially into distance running and soccer—with his favorite soccer team being Istanbul’s Beşiktaş Gymnastics Club.
paras.zh: 莱文特·阿尔波格 (Levent Alpöge) 的一个姐姐埃利夫 (Elif) 比他大十岁，这使得他在大部分时间里几乎是独生子。阿尔波格非常擅长运动，尤其是长跑和足球——他最喜欢的足球队是伊斯坦布尔的贝西克塔斯体操俱乐部。

paras.en: He picked up coding early. In 2009, at age 17, he connected with bioinformatics professor Xenophon Papademetris of Yale University. Papademetris’s group assigned Alpöge a research problem the team had little time for. The idea was to use Nvidia graphical processing units (GPUs)—the technology now powering the AI revolution—to recognize vascular structures in medical images.
paras.zh: 他很早就开始编码。 2009年，17岁的他结识了耶鲁大学生物信息学教授Xenophon Papademetris。 Papademetris 的团队给 Alpöge 分配了一个研究问题，但该团队几乎没有时间进行研究。这个想法是使用 Nvidia 图形处理单元 (GPU)（目前正在推动人工智能革命的技术）来识别医学图像中的血管结构。

paras.en: “He helped do one of the first GPU implementations of an image analysis algorithm,” Papademetris says. “He was a 17-year-old kid who could say, ‘I will do it.’” The professor recalls what he wrote of Alpöge in his college recommendation letter, “His enthusiasm was contagious, his energy was boundless, and his confidence in his ability to overcome obstacles almost frightening.”
paras.zh: “他帮助完成了图像分析算法的第一个 GPU 实现，”Papademetris 说。 “他是一个 17 岁的孩子，可以说，‘我会做到的。’”教授回忆起他在大学推荐信中对阿尔波格的描述，“他的热情具有感染力，他的能量无穷无尽，他对自己克服障碍的能力的信心几乎令人恐惧。”

paras.en: Alpöge’s algorithm was enough to “punch your ticket to any university in the country,” Papademetris says. “My letter was irrelevant.” As a bonus for the achievement, a team at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology’s Lincoln Laboratory named an asteroid “Alpöge.”
paras.zh: 帕帕德梅特里斯说，阿尔波格的算法足以“帮你拿到国内任何大学的门票”。 “我的信无关紧要。”作为这项成就的奖励，麻省理工学院林肯实验室的一个团队将一颗小行星命名为“Alpöge”。
